tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 paN chen er te ni zhib 'jug

tei:div.tei:p: ca da ru tsho 7paṇa chen rin po che zhing ri / sgo / tho ri gyu ci ci ci gshegs de da lta bzhugs yod na/ nga tsho phyi ci me ci ci /ci ci ci ci/ ga r+sha gyu chog tso ci ci logs su bsdad/ 7paṇa chen rin po che bod me sbyo nang bzhugs te thabs shes gang yong gnang rgyu yin pa gtan gyel ba red/ de cu'i thog nas tan tan nus pa gang tsam thon thub rgyu yang / da cha de ltar med pa red/ 7paṇa chen rin so che dgongs pa gzhan du khegs dus ha cang phangs sto byung /7gong sa mchog gis/7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang ngos dbar dam sel gang yang med/7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas thabs dang / bod mi rigs kyi don du dgongs pa bzhes bzhin bzhugs yod/ nga rang bod nang bsdad nas de rang zhu gi yod/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/mi ngas bshad pa'i skad cha yang dag pa yin min/ dus tshod zung thung nang dpyad bsdur byed dgos don med/ de dag la rim pas dus tshod kyi bden dpang byed nges yin//7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/tsho ci —— —— rna /k+to — gtsang phrug bas lags kyis btsos/
sdon gling dang dkar chagamedabya༅/ /7paṇa chen yer te gi zhib 'jugagatsa/nga drug stobs lags kyis brtsams/

7paṇa chen zher te gi zhi' 'jugadabya༅/ /7paṇa chen zher te gi zhib 'jugalhu1ma pa no/ gtsang phrul stobs lags/dpe sgrig na khan/ bsam mkhar ngag dbang gau zhe/haṃ ma che ring /mdun gog 'char 'gon pa/ mig don ra/deb tshad/ 5 3785yig ung / 22yig gardogags/ 700/mtsho050/ lngas/par gzhi/ 2012711730dang no bsgrigs/par thengs/ 2012712712dang po btang/par grangs/ 0011000dpe deb ang rtags/ 978—81—920189—9—7 'brel gtugs kha byang / ཿ0ba/300796)〉tha'i00 007960brngub0 9459752422〈'ar bzhi sger 'dag yin pa sa'adra bzhudang la ra 'debs mi tshog〉00ba511211 020126775thabaḥ57smo109/'i2

ci sngonaglengadang dkar chal༄༅ / /7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'dug gleng slong ba'i gtam/dang po/ 7paṇa chen er ni zhib 'jug la go ba bzhes stangs/bzhugs yun thung ba'i 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po'i sku tshe de/sangs rgyas bstan pa dang bod mi mang gi ched/ gna' bo'i ghi ri se'i so khe ra ti dang / rgya gar gyi sems dpa' chen po ghan dhi/ a me ri kha'i mar thin lu si khen/lho a h+phe ri kha'i man ti la bzhin/ bod mi mang la ngo gnong mi dgos pa'i kha yod lag yod kyi phyag rjes bzhag yod na/(kha che pha lu'i bslab bya/)las/ byas pa can gyi sems pa pham ma 'jug/byed rgyu mdun du yod dus byed mkhan mang // gsungs pa bzhin/ sku tshegs dang skyo gar gyi khrod nas zhi bar gshegs pa'i skyes chen khong la/ zhib 'jug dang phyir dran gyi gdeng 'jog ma zhus na/ o rgyan rin po ches/ bod la drin chen byas kyang drin mi go/ zhes pa'i zhal gsung de gnam rdo mgo lhung gi tshul du nga tshor 'phog gin mi 'dug gam/a'e dbyin si than gyis/ skye bo zhig gi rin thang la lta dus khos byas rjes ga re bzhag yod med la blta dgos pa las/ kho la ga re thob yod med dī

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing 'jugabalta rgyu med gsungs pa bzhin/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod la ci zhig bzhag min gzigs skabs/ 'khang ra bya 'os su gyur pa'i zhal gsung 'ga'i tshig re bzung nas/de ni khong gi dgongs pas bcad pa'i mdzad log yin zhes 'ud sgrog mi byed par/zhal gsung bka' slob de tsho/ dus rabs dang / spyi tshogs kyi rgyab ljongs ci 'dra zhig gi 'og tu gsungs min la dbye zhib gnang rgyu de/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i sku tshe la zhib dpyod gnang skabs/ snang med du 'jog mi rung ba'i gnad don gal chen zhig yin/(7paṇa chen er ti ni zhib 'jug)ces pa dar lung rna ba'i bu khar sim dus/ blos mi chun pa'i dran stangs shig las/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam sprul la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mdzad pa yod pas/ rang ga ba'i skye bo zhig gis sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam sprul la zhib 'jug gi kha spobs shod pa ni/ lcags kyi pha bong la byi pa kha tsha'i dpe ltar/ rig 'tsho ma zin pa'i 'chal gtam sgrog pa kho rang ngal ba'i rgyu yin pa'i bka' bkyon phebs rgyu shes mod/bzod gsol sngon btang gis a 'thas su tha snyad 'di bed spyod gtong ba'i nying dgos ni/ nga tshos de ring gi dus rabs 21 pa'i bsam blo dor nas/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po dang lhan cig dus rabs 20 pa'i bod kyi skyo gar la skyid sdug mnyam myong zhus rjes/ khong dang dus rabs 20 las rgyang du gyes pa'i da lta'i gnas bab kyi thog nas/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i sku tshe la gdeng 'jog gnang rgyu de yin/stag tshang lo tsā bas/ /rang nyid mchog tu rlom pa'i nga ro yi/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod dam pa'i tshul min la/ /sgro skur med par rang gi ngang dzāl rnams/ /'khor du sgrogs pa sangs rgyas tshul lugs yin/ /zhes dang /

sdon gleng dang dkar chagamakhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ blun po ngo mtshar bskyed pa'i har gyi gtam// chen po'i ngo bsrung brtsegs pa gcam bu'i tshig/ dad pa'i 'khun bu slong ba'i sgrung gtam dag/ ring du spangs te drang po'i lam la zhugs//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 7paṇa chen er te ni zhib 'jug gi rtsa don ni/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po dus rabs 20 bod gangs can ljongs kyi chos srid rig gnas srung spel khrod/ dngos yod kyi go bab gang tsam zin min dang /khong gi dgongs bzhed dang mdzad spyod kyis/ bod kyi gnad don sel bar phan gnod kyi shugs rkyen ci 'dra zhig byung min la/ phyogs lhung dang bstod smad kyi sgro skur spangs shing / mi rigs rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi thabs lam dpyad nas/ sku tshe hril por zhib mo'i blo yis 'jug rgyu yin la/ zhib 'jug kyi rmang gzhi de yang /7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i zhal gsung bka' slob kyi dgongs don las mi 'da' ba zhig dang / rmang gzhi de ga'i thog nas zhib 'jug gi rkang 'dzugs rgyu de/bdag gis bshad pa'i (7paṇa chen er ti ni zhib 'jug)la go ba bzhes stangs kyi rtsa don yin/ /gnyis pa/ 7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'dug gi ming byung tshul/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus chu rgyun ring mo'i dbus/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen por tshong pa rgyags pa dang / bod kyi dpa' bo'i mtshan gyi cod pan bsgron myong mod/ 'on kyang / da phan khong gi sku tshe hril po'i mdzad pa khyon yongs la zhib dpyod gnang ba zhig mthong chos su ma gyur cing / sna zin spu zin gyi mdzad pa 'khod pa'i rnam thar re zung yod pa dag kyang / bod snga rabs pa'i masad rnam rtsom 'bri'i shan shugs thebs tedu/

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhing 'jugaspyi 'gros rags bshad thar thor las bye brag dang zhib cha thon pa zhig med/da cha kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po zhi bar gshegs te mi lo nyer bzhi phyin zin pas na/ khong dang khong gis bzhud myong ba'i dus rabs nyi shu pa de/ bod kyi lo rgyus shul rgyun ri nga mo'i cha shas gal chen zhig chags yod/'di nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po/ dus rabs 20 pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus shul lam ring mo'i dbus su blos bslangs te/ phyogs su ma lhung ba'i zhib 'jug dgos gal mthong zhing / zhib 'jug de yang 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po kho nar zhib 'jug ma yin par/ khong dang rigs bsgres te dus rabs 20pa'i bod kyi chab dpal rig gsum gyi snang tshul skor zhig la'ang zhib 'jug thub pa'i dge mtshan ldan 'duga'on kyang / da phan kho bos mthong ba'i bod rgya dbyin gsum gyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha khag la cha mtshon na/ yongs grags dpar skrun 'grems spel byas pa'i yig cha mi nyung ba zhig gi nang / srid gzhung so so'i chab srid khe phan dang bstun nas/ lo rgyus dngos 'khyog bshad zur g.yol byas pa mang zhing /yongs grags yig tshags dang lo rgyus dngos tshig thor bkod nas gsang nyar phyir shor byung ba rnams dang / 7paṇa chen bcu par 'brel 'dris yod pa'i mi snar bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho'i dbar te bag cung tsam mngon gyin 'duga'adir bzhed pa mi mthun pa'i lo rgyus yig tshags de dag phan tshun kha gsab dang zhib bsdur gting zab cig byas rjes/ zhib tshags pos dkyus la bsgril te/ lo rgyus dang / dus bab/ khor yug ci 'dra zhig gis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i thugs gshis skyed sring byas pa dang /bye brag gi mdzad pa re rer zhib dpyod kyi chod sdom gang thub 'jog khul byas yod/6

sngon theng dang dkar chagazhib bsdur las 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku gshegs rkyen dang / sku gshegs kha'i snga phyi'i gnas tshul/ rig gsar skabs kyi 'thab rtsod/ btson ra'i sku ngal/ gsang yum bzhes tshul/ ming don mtshungs pa'i bod rigs sa khongs rang skyong rtsod len/ bod kyi chab dpal rig gsum rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel ched sku ngal ci ltar skyon yod pa bdun rtsal du bton nas 'bri khul byas yod/bod kyi yig tshags nang lo rgyus kyi dge 'bri ba las skyon 'bri bar bzur gang thub gnang ba des/ phyi rabs zhib 'jug pa rnams chab srid khe phan ched log bshad byas pa'i rgya'i yig tshags la brten dgos stabs/ dngos don lo rgyus ma rtogs pa'i dka' ngal byung dang 'byung bzhin yod/rgya gzhung gi yig bo'i nang / phyi lo 1956 lor/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rgya gar du chibs sgyur skabs chibs bsur bcar ba'i rgya gar gzhung gi rlangs 'khor steng / bod dang rgya gar gyi rgyal dar re btsugs yod pa rgya dpon gyis mthong bas/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis la bod kyi rgyal dar phab nas rgya nag gi rgyal dar 'dzugs pa'i blang bya bton/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ bod kyi rgyal dar mar phab ste/ rgya nag gzhung gi rgyal dar ma btsugs na/ khong nyid rlangs 'khor nang phebs rgyu min pa bkod yod/ 'on kyang / bod kyi lo rgyus yig tshags dang /7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen gyi rnam thar nang de'i skor zur tsam yang 'khod mi 'dugayang snying rgya mi'i yig tshags nang bkod pa bzhin bden pa yin nam/ kho bo rbad de mgo bo rmongs su bcug song /7gong sa 7rgyal ba'i dbang pos/ lo rgyus gang yin pa de ji bzhin 'bri dgos pa'i bka' phebs pa bzhin/ 'dir phyi rabs pa rnams zer sgros dang rgya mi'i yig tshang kho nar brten mi dgos pa'i ched/ lha phog klu phog dang 7/

7paṇa chen zher te gi zhing 'juga'adre phog bgegs phog la 'dzems med kyis dpyad gzhi'i yig cha rnams/phan tshun kha gsab dang zhib bsdur gting zab zhus rjes/ gzhan gyis bsam gzhigs byed mi phod pa'i mdzad spyod 'gar blo spobs chen pos lta tshul bton yod la/ gzhan gyis spyir btang du brtsis te chag yang btang ba'i mdzad pa 'gar/sngog 'don gting zab kyis spyir btang min pa'i mdzad pa zhig tu ngo sprod byed khul 'di/ bdag gis bshad pa'i 〈7paṇa chen er te ni zhib 'jug 〉ming byung tshul yin/rgyu mtshan btsal zhing bsam blos zhib rtog byed khul lags kyang /rgyu mtshan 'tshol stangs dang bsam blo gtong tshul nor bas zhib 'jug byed stangs steng / skabs mtshams la lar lung dang zer sgros kho nar brten pa'i skyon cha shor song snyam pa'i the tshom ni blo pham byed dgos pa zhig yin mod/dpyad gzhi khungs btsan pa'i thog rigs pas bsgrub dka' ba dang / bshad tshul mi 'dra ba rnams skabs su gang bab kyi thad kur bkod de/ zhib dpyod thar thor zhus te chod sdom gang thub bzhag yod pas skyon cher mi bsam snyam na chag yang yong ba zhu//8

sngon gleng dang dkar chagathugs rje che zhu/mi lo 5 yi ring las khungs kyi las ka dang / slob 'khrid kyi bar gseng sogs/ dus tshod kyi lhag ma yod tshad la 'bad pa brgya dang brtson pa stong gis zhib 'jug byas pa'i (7paṇa chen er te ni zhib 'jug )gis/ khyed klog pa ngo/ rnams la thugs phan ji tsam gsos min shod dka' yang / zhib 'jug gi las ka de 'gro skabs dka' ngal ji snyed cig 'phrad byung /(7paṇa chen er te ni zhib 'jug / ji ltar grub pa'i brgyud rim la phyir bltas byed skabs/ phyogs dang zur gang sa nas rogs ram dang /skul lcag gnang mkhan gyi blos thub grogs po re gnyis shig yod pa khong tsho ni/(7paṇa chen er te ni zhib 'jug ) gi 'gul shugs gtso bo de chags yod pa'i tshor snang byung bas/ grub 'bras kyi phyed ka grogs po'i yin pa ngo sprod ched/brgyud lam 'di nas (7paṇa chen er te ni zhib 'jug /'bri ba'i brgyud rim khrod/ bod mi'i sgrig 'dzug kyi shes yon lhan tshogs kyi drung gzhon grogs mchog bde khang bsod nams bzang po lags kyis/ dbyin yig gi dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha phon che zhig bod bsgyur dang / lo rgyus rig pa'i mkhas dbang bkra shis tshe ring lags kyis dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha rgyus ston gnang ba/shes rig las khungs kyi nyams zhib dang rtsom sgrig pa chu tshe ring lags dang / bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen sa rā mtho slob kyi lo rgyus dge rgan che mo bod mi mang spyi 'thus bsod nams rgyal mtshan lags/ bod kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul tshogs pa'i nyams zhib pa zla ba bkra shis lags gsum gyis gal che'i dgongs tshul gsungs pa/ bod kyi mdzod khang gi bod yig dpe skrun 'gakā

la'akho chen zher te ni shib 'duga'adzin dang rig gzhung nyams zhib nga gcig lcogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bdag gi shes bya'i grogs po na ga sangs rgyas bstan dar lags kyis gal che'i dgongs tshul dang zhu dag gnang ba/spo rā mtho slob kyi rtsom rig dpon bsam mkhar ngag dbang rdo rje lags dang / dga' ldan chos gling nang bstan slob gnyer khang gi bod dge gnyan mgon dgra lha/ rda sa rigs slob gong dkar ngag rnam gsum gyis zhu dag gnang ba/ 7paṇa chen er te ni zhabs zhu las don lte gnas khang gi 'gan 'dzin dga' spag blo bzang rdo rje lags kyis dgongs tshul gsungs pa/gtsang pa lha bris nub rgya bu chung lags kyis sku par gnang ba/ rtse rnam par rgyal ba phan bde legs bshad gling gi phyag mdzod thub bstan yar 'phel lags kyis gang spyi'i rogs ram gnang ba bcas la snying dag pa nas thugs rje che zhu/de bzhin 'brel yod mang po zhig gis bcar 'dri dang len dang gnas tshul gang mkhyen mkho 'don gnang bar thugs rje che zhu/(1625331 06701 1632300500khyi'i 367158986/51/10ba)las drangs pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha dang / rgya yig gi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha (/ lkos61645sna dze 60/nya char+sā) (167/ri /rme rlab/ khrimarnye —46ca ra7)(lko /྅lko144 /lto stom7)(lto/chi kyisu 12 ((1 ༈༈)༅/ lo1114mnya)ri /spyo 7(1// /1)(3314449 6 7864lkolha)zhes pa sogs rgya yig gi dpyad gzhi tshang ma rang ngos nas bod bsgyur zhus yod pas/dogs gzhi yod na khungs btsan pa ma dpe las/ bdag gis bod skyur byas pa rnams yang dag tshad 'dzin mi gnang ba zhu/ / 10

dkar chagadang po/ gleng slong ba'i gtam/ (5)gnyis pa/ thugs rje che zhu/ (9)le'u dang po/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis/le tshan dang po/ bde ba can dang 7rgyal ba yab sras/ (15)le tshan gnyis pa/ mi mjed zhing dang yab sras thugs bskyed/ (17)le tshan gsum pa/ kha ba can dang yab sras thugs bskyed/ (19)le tshan bzhi pa/ kha ba can du yab sras 'gro don mdzad lhunal/ (21)le tshan lnga pa/ sham bha la dang 7paṇa chen rin po che/ (23)le'u gnyis pa/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i sku tshe/sa bcad dang po/ sku che'i smad kyi cha/le tshan dang po/ sku gshegs kha'i zhal chems/ (29)le tshan gnyis pa/ sku gshegs pa'i snga phyi/ (45) le tshan gsum pa/ sku gshegs pa'i rgyu rkyen/ (62)le tshan bzhi pa/ gsol cog steng lus pa'i mdzad 'char/ (85)le tshan lnga pa/ go gnas slar gso/ (93)11

7paṇa chen zher te gi ging 'jugale tshan drug pa/ rgya lo dang / phun dbang / ting gsum mjal 'phrad/ tsho (101)le tshan bdun pa/ bod rgya'i 'brel zam/ (109)le tshan brgyad pa/ chol gsum bod khams zhabs kyis bcags pa/ (129)le tshan dgu pa/ bod khul la gzigs skor gyi thugs tshor/ (165)le tshan bcu pa/ gsang yum bde chen dbang mo/ (175)le tshan bcu gcig yab gzhis sras mo rig 'dzin dbang mo/ (191)le tshan bcu gnyis/ ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong rtsod len/ (198)le tshan bcu gsum/ yang dar bstan pa'i me ro gsos pa/ (206)le tshan bcu bzhi/ bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling / (219)le tshan bco lnga/ bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum/ (228)le tshan bcu drug bod dar rgyas thebs rtsa lhan tshogs/ (245)le tshan bcu bdun/ bod gangs rgyan mthun gnyer tshong khang / (253)le tshan bco brgyad/ phyi yul du chibs sgyur/ (258)le tshan bcu dgu bod rigs las byed par blang bya dang thugs re/ (259)le tshan nyi shu/ mi rigs mthong chung la 'thab rtsod/ (268)le tshan nyer gcig wagong sa mchog la dad dam sems khur/ (377)le tshan nyer gnyis btsan byol mi mang la bcangs pa'i 'khreng zhen (287)le tshan nyer gsum/ sku rkyang du lus pa'i tshong pa rgyags pa/ (293)le tshan nyer bzhi/ phyir dran khrod kyi gdung tshor/ (304)sa bcad gnyis pa/ sku che() bar gyi cha/le tshan dang po/ gzhung bla gcig sgril gyi dgongs bzhed/ (311)(2 tshan gnyis pa/ bod bstan srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa/ (319)

sdon gleng dang dkar chagale tshan gsum pa/ gung khran tang la thugs blo log pa/ (329)le tshan bzhi pa/ yig 'bru khri bdun gong 'bul/ (340)le tshan lnga pa/ yig 'bru khri bdun gyi snying don/ (350)len tshan drug pa/ bzod dka' ba'i dbu mnyel/ (354)le tshan bdun pa/ mi lo dgu'i btson ra'i dbu ngal/ (383)sa bcad gsum pa/ sku che1) stod kyi cha/le tshan dang po/ 'khrungs yul dang khyim rgyud/ (401)le tshan gnyis pa/ yang sprul btsal 'tshol gyi brgyud rim/ (407)le tshan gsum pa/ yang sprul ngos 'dzin thad gzhung bla'i rtsod rnyog (413)le tshan bzhi pa/ lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen rin po che chags pa/ (427)le tshan lnga pa/ yab sras lhan 'dzoms kyi skal bzang / (434)le tshan drug pa/ rtse slob grwa dang 'phrul 'khor slob grwa/ 447)le tshan bdun pa/ nang bstan gsan sbyong dang ljags rtsom/ (453)le tshan brgyad pa/ yab sras lhan gyis bstan srid bskyangs pa/ (463)le tshan dgu pa/ yar thon gyi mdzad pa than thun/ (469)le tshanabacu pa/ yab sras 'phags yul du chibs sgyur/ (477)le tshan bcu gcig pa/ dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul/ (497)le tshan bcu gnyis pa/ gdung rten gsar bzhengs/ (503)le'u gsum pa/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon /le tshan dang po/ sku phreng rim byon gyi 'khrungs 'das re'u mig (507 )mjug byang / (508)13

7rgyal 'a yab sras rnam gnyis le'u dang pho/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis/le tshan dang pho/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams/nub phyogs bde ba can ni mgon po 'od dpag med kyi zhing khams yin zhing / zhing khams de ni las dag skye bo'i zag med sems kyi myong bya las/dug gsum gdon gyis myos pa'i so skye 'ching ba kun ldan nga 'dra tshos spyod yul min par gsungs/ 'o na/ las dag rgyal sras rnams la bde ba can gyi zhing bkod de ji ltar du snang ngam snyam na//chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston /las/bde ba can gyi zhing de ni/ /mnyam zhing shin tu rnam par dag/ bai ṭu r+ya yi sa gzhi la/ gser gyis mig mang ris su bris/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'khyil zhing babs/ /ye shes gsal ba'i me 'od 'bar/ /rin chen byang chub shing gi11

7paṇa chen er te ni zhib pa'ajugagatams/ /pad+ma'i sbubs las brdzus te skye/ /bsam gtan zas kyis rtag tu 'tsho//tshul khrims dag pa'i gos kyis bklubs/ /rang lus 'od kyis 'jig rten snang //thams cad bzod pa'i stobs dang ldan/ /kun kyang myang 'das bde ba che//rdo rje'i tshe la mnga' dbang thob/ /de phyir phal pa'i 'byung bzhi dang / /rtsi shing gzhan gyi ming yang med/ /ma dag skye ba rnam bzhis dben/ /bkres skom 'thab rtsod ga la yod/ /nyi zla sgron mes ci zhig bya/ /na tsha sdug bsngal rga shi med/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i nyon mongs bral/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi// chos kyi longs spyod rgyun mi chad//1ces dang / ('chi med rnga sgra )las kyang / 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams/ /de na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med/ /su zhig de yi mtshan brjod na/ /de ni de ru skye bar 'gyur/ /'chi ba'i dus su ston pa ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun bcas pa mthong //de na bud med yod pa min/ /mnga' na gnas pa yod ma yin/ /rin chen rnams kyi pad+mo las/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'byung bar gyur/ /zas dang gos dang sman rnams dang / chos gos mal cha lhung bzed rnams/ /sems kyis bsam ma thag tu ni/ /de dag mod la 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams//bde ba can gyi bsngags pa brjod/ /ces gsungs par ltar/ bde ba can ni de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi zhing khams yin/ de yang / chos sku snang ba mtha' yas longs sku tshe dpag med/ sprul sku mgon po 'od dpag med gsum las/ mgon po 'od dpag med bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don du sku skye bzhes pa'i rnam sprul de/1chos 'byung ma las pa'i dpo' sto na stod cha/shog105nang /16

7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis/kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna bar sim pa'i/rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs 7paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku'i skye ba'i phreng ba rnams lags so/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dngos yin pa'i gtan tshigs ni/ mkhas dbang bkra shis tshe ring gis dkyil khang ma/khan zur blo bzang sbyin pa'i (1821—/891)gsung 'bum/ ldi lir btab pa'i shog ngos 497 nas 510 bar gzigs par 'tshal gsungs/ /

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhib ca'ajugale tshan gnyis pa/ mi mjed zhing du yab sras thugs bskyed/bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od dpag med/ /sras kyi thu bo 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mar skur bzhengs pa'i/ /7rgyal ba yab sras gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes bod yul mun pa'i gling 'dir bsam bzhin srid pa bzung ba'i 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen rnam gnyis/ nub phyogs bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od dpag med dang / gang gi sras kyi thu bo 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul yin/ (dam chos pad+ma dkar po /las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis 'gro ba kun 'dul ba'i 'phrin las la dbang ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de nyid spyan ras gzigs kyi gtsug gi tog ltar 'bral med du bzhugs/spyan ras gzigs kyis sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi gtsos sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bcu gcig gi drung du/ bod kyi mgon skyabs mdzad pa'i dam bca' skabs/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis khyod sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs ngas kyang bya'o zhes dam bcas so/spyan ras gzigs kyis sems can 'dul ba'i dam bca' bzhin ma grub pas/ dbu tshal pa bcur gas shing / sku lus dum bu stong du bye skabs/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med skad cig de nyid du phebs nas/ dbu dang sku lus zhig cing bye ba rnams phyag gis chun por bcings nas/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod sdug bsngal ma byed cigakhyod kyi dbu tshal pa bcur gas pa 'di ni zhal ras bcu gcig tu byin gyis brlab bo/ sku lus rnam pa stong du bye ba 'di ni/ phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan par byin gyis 18

7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis/brlabs te/ slar yang 'gro don la snying stobs skyed pa'i skul ma mdzad gsungs pa ltar/bod kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'dir/ 'phags pa spya na ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku bsnyan gyi dbu gtsug steng / rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi sku bsnyan chung ngu bzhengs pa'i srol yang byung /mi mjed kyi 'jig rten 'dir rnam 'dren bzhi pas mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi 'phrin las bskyangs pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pas/ rgyal po 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / khye'u snang / kun tu dga'/ mi bdag lha skyes/ chos rgyal dkon mchog 'bangs/'dul 'dzin rin chen dpal/ chos rgyal dge ba dpal sogs rgya gar ba'i rigs dang /rje gnya' khri btsan po/ tho ri gnyan btsan/ srong btsan sgam po/ khri srong lde btsan/ khri ral pa/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/gu ru chos dbang / byang bdag dbang po'i sde sogs bod yul kha ba'i ljongs su sku skye bzhes pa bzhin/2 kun gzigs 7paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ 'phags pa rab 'byor dang / rig ldan 'jam dpal grags pa/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed/slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas/ dge tshul pad+ma'i ngad ldan/ 'od gzhon nu/'tsho byed gzhon nu/ rig pa'i khu byug grub chen dril bu pa/ bla ma dri ma med pa/ bha wa bha dra/ pad+ma sam bha wa/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sogs rgya gar ba'i rigs dang /dgas po lha rje/ sa skya paṇa chen/ khug pa lhas btsas/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal sogs/3bod yul kha ba'i ljongs 'dir sprul pa'i sku skye mang du phebs nas bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad pa'i thugs bskyed 'khrungs so/ /37gong sa mchog gi 'khrungs rabs/ 7paṇa chenarinapo 7 'khrungs rabs/4 chos rgyal dgonamachog 'bangs gi skyes rabs/19

7paṇa chen ber te ni zhing 'jug le tshan gsum pa/ kha ba can du yab sras thugs bskyed/ sngon gyi dus sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas thun mong snang ngor bla ma dri ma med kyi sku ru phebs dus/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs thun mong snang ngor chos rgyal dkon mchog 'bangs kyi sku skye ru phebs/ las can gyi skyes mchog gnyis o rgyan yul du mjal 'dzoms byung zhing / ma 'ongs kha ba can gyi yul du bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad pa'i lung bstan mdzad/ de yang / chos rgyal dkon mchog 'bangs au ḍi ya nar bzhugs pa'i bla ma dri ma med dang mjal zhing sho lo ka lngas bstod pa phul/bla mas kyang byang phyogs de nas byang phyogs su/ bod na rigs btsun par grags pa thams cad kyis bkur ba zhig tu khyed kyis lus blangs shing /khyed kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa zhig gis/ rgya gar nas nga spyan 'dren du thongs zhes/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs rgyal khri srong sde btsan gyi sku skye ru phebs skabs/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku skye ru phebs pa dang / rgyal pos slob dpon bsam yas su gdan 'dren pa'i lung bstan/bla ma dri ma med kyis/ 'di nas skye ba gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du thugs rjes zungs/ /bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar 'dzin/ /mi dbang mdzod la bod khams bde bar skyongs/ /o rgyan gnas su ji 20

7rgyal zha yab sras rnam gnyis/skad smras pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang gnas der lha 'dre 'dul du 'gro/ /dge slong nga la ba den pa yod mod kyang / /mi dbang khyed kyis grogs ched rtag tu dge//'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i lung bstan yin/ /yab sras tsan dan dri bzhin du/ /'bral med 'gro ba'i phan bde 'byung / /4zhes (bka' gdams pha chos bu chos / su zhib phra gsal ba ltar/bod brgyud nang bstan gyi gtso 'dzin 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyi thugs 'brel 'di/ thol byung stes dbang zhig ma yin par/ spyir 'gro ba mi'i rigs 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i 'jig rten 'di dang / yang sgos su kha ba gangs can pa'i zhing gi skye 'gro rnams chos spyod zhi ba'i dpal la longs su spyod phyir/7gong sa mchog gis bod bstan srid kyi mdzad khur bsnams shing / 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog gi grogs mdzad nas 'jig rten dge ba'i lam du dkri ba'i rgyal sras spyod pa'i mdzad pa zhig tu nges pa rnyed do/ /jibaka' bdam sa pa chos bu chos/21

7paṇa chen er te ni zhing 'jugale tshan bzhi pa/ kha ba can du yab sras 'gro don/mang garu'i nyi 'od kyis tshig pa'i snyigs dus kyi skye bo 'gas/ nang bstan chos lugs kyis bod kyi chab srid phung la sbyar ba'i gdon 'khrul gyi gtam shub tu smra zhing / 7gong sa mchog gis bod kyi dbu khrid gnang dgos min la dogs slong gi lta tshul 'don pa dang / 'byung 'gyur gyi bod la 7paṇa chen mchog sprul gal 'gangs ji tsam che min thad gleng slong tsam byed mkhan med pa'i dus ngan 'dir/lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' de la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du gyur gsungs pa ltar/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis ni bod khams skyid sdug mnyam myong byed pa'i 'ching thag dang / bde skyid kyi 'byung rtsa nyag cig yin/phyi lo 742 lor/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku skye ru phebs te bod brgyud nang bstan dar spel gnang skabs/sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas slob dpon pad+ma sam bha ba'i sku skye ru phebs nas lha srin dam la btags shing bsam yas bzhengs pa'i grogs mdzad/ phyi lo 840lor/ rgyal po glang dar mas 'dul ba'i bstan pa rmang nas bshigs rjes/ phyi lo 1040 lor/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku skye 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' ya sa kyi sku skye jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha dbus gtsang du gdan drangs/ jo bo rjes byang chub lam gyi sgron me brtsams te bod kyi nang bstan dag ther mdzad/ 22

7rgyal ba yab sras nan gnyis/de ltar bod la sprul sku'i lam lugs byung ba dang bstun/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 7rgyal dbang sku phreng rim byon du phebs shing / sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas 7paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon du phebs te/ yab sras bla slob bkur res kyis bod gangs can gyi rgyal bstan dar spel gtong gnang mdzad/de lta'i las byang la thugs 'dris zab pa'i skyes rabs la thugs kyis nges pa 'drongs pa'i kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pas/ phyi lo 1979 lor/7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gis pe cing du mngags pa'i sku tshab rnams la/mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi ras bris thang ga zhig dang / shing par las gsar du btab pa'i ston pas gsungs pa'i shes rab kyi le'u'i dpe cha zhig 7gong sa mchog la phyag rtags su bskur te/ 'di 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen par 'bul rogs/ 'di ngos kyis yul mdo smad kyi khul nas shing par gsar du brkos pa yin/mkhan slob chos gsum gyi dus bod la mdo sngags kyi chos dar ba glang dar skabs nyams/ bstan pa phyi dar mdo smad nas 'go btsugs pa red/bar lam dus kyi khug la slebs nas mi bzhi shog khag gis bstan pa rmang nas bshigs te med pa chags pa'i skabs su/ ngos kyis yul mdo smad kyi sa nas ched du brkos pa'i par phud de/ 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen par 'bul rgyu yin pas/ bstan pa yang dar brjod dgos gsungs so//55sku ngo 'ju chenal bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/phyi lo naX bla 9tshes na zhin/23

7 paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'jugale tshan lda pa/ sham bha la dang 7paṇa chen rin po che/sham bha la ni sngon shākya'i rgyal po'i blon po sham bha ka zhes pas yul de bzung bas ming de thogs shing/ bod kyi skad du bde 'byung 'dzin pa zer/mi rnams kyi ya mtshan ngo mtshar can gyi zhing khams su brtsi ba'i sham bha la ni/rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs su yod cing / grong khyer de lha sa las chung zhing / pho brang ka lā pa bod nang yod par gsungs/6a lags cedro tan zhabs drung gis/ sham bha la chags sa'i gnas ni u rob kyi gling yin gsung pa ni/ dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i sham bha la dang /dbyin skad du (56308pa /75/zhes pa 'di sham bha la don gcig ming gi rnam grangs tu dgongs bcad gnang bar sems shing / shaṅga ri la ni phyi lo 1933 lor jem se hal spyon gyis brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung(10/ri//07/ 70/ /zhes pa'i nang gi rtog ba13) yul zhig gi ming yin pas de gnyis la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod/7de bzhin bon po rnams kyis da lta'i dbyi lang yin pa bshad kyang / sngon chad dbyi lang gi ming la par sig ces smra/sham bha la yi yul gyi bkod pa dbyibs zlum zhing kai la sha'i dum bu drug sa pa'i pa kai la sha'i dum bu de/ phyed phyed du bgos pa'i g.yas phyed ma/nyidage 'dun chos 'phel gyi sasu nga rtsom/pod/dang po /thog105nang /bod spongs dpe snying dpe skrun lang /snyi lo 1994lor/ 7pa yul mi mang bi ched du/'os 9nang /bkra zhis tshe ring sogs kyi brtsams/chung tshe ring ṣ+pe bsgyu ra/bod kyi dpe mdzod 'ang /phyi 'o naX1༷lo ra/24

7rgyal 'a ya' sras rnam gnyis/rgyab ri rgyal lhun po'i ngos la bstan cing / mdun chu bo si ta'i phyogs la bstan pa/ mtha' bzhi gang sa ris phyi nang gnyis su bskor ba'i dbus su/ sham bha la'i grong khyer ka lā pa yod pa gsungs/grong khyer ka lwa pa'i pho brang mdun gyi lho ngos su/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang pos bzhengs pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i blos bslangs dkyil 'khor gtsos/rigs ldan rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i blos bslangs dkyil 'khor dang / shar nub gnyis su mtsho yis mdzes par brgyan/rigs ldan zhes pa ni drang srong rigs tha dad pa rnams/ rdo rje theg pa la rigs gcig tu mdzad pas rigs ldan zhes grags/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas kyi skyes rabs gnyis pa rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa/sham bha la yi rigs ldan dang po'i sku skye ru phebs pa nas/ 7paṇa chen rin po che dang sham bha la'i 'brel ba byung bar snang zhing / 7paṇa chen sku phreng dang po mkhas grub rje/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pa'i sku skye yin pa ni/ mkhas grub rjes/rigs ldan grags pa dus kyi mthar yang ni/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar ci yang mdzad/ ces gsungs//8 bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud dar ba dang / kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng dang po mkhas grub rje dang / sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan sogs kyis/ sham bha la'i skor mang du gsung zhing /7paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes kyis/ sham bha la yi lam yig dang /7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pas sham bha la yi smon lam sogs mdzad yod/namakhas grub rje'i rnam thar mkhas pa'i yid 'phrogashog ngos 17 nang /dpe gzugs/25

7paṇa chen ber te ni zhib 'jugade ltar 7paṇa chen sku gong ma rnams kyis sham bha la yi dmag gis/kla klo'i dpung 'dul ba'i dus tshod bstan par ma zad/ gdan sa chen po bkra shis lhun po'i kun gzigs pho brang gi bar khyams g.yab 'khor gyi ldebs ris la/gangs ri'i dbus su sham bha la'i zhing bkod kyang bzhengs yod/ 'on kyang /sham bha lar bgrod par rig sngags kyi mthu gdeng khel nges ma bsgrubs pa rnams la gcan gzan gyi 'tshe ba dang / yul gyi kha phyogs log nas bgrod mi thub par gsungs/ 7paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyis/byang phyogs sham bha la yi grong khyer du/ /rigs ldan drag po'i bkod pas kla klo'i tshogs//bcom nas 'gro kun 'dren pa'i mdzad bzang mchog/ /mngon du gyur te bla med go 'phang stsol//9 zhes gsungs par ltar/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rnam sprul 7paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas mchog ni/ spyir 'dzam gling dang yang sgos bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/ nag phyogs kla klo'i tshogs kyi dpung bcom zhing rgyal bstan skyong ba'i ched/ sham bha la nas byon pa dang /ma 'ongs rigs ldan gyi mtha' ma drag po 'khor lo can gyi skye bar bzhes nas kla klo'i tshogs bcom skabs/ sku ngo mas dmag dpon gyi thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu yin pa gsungs/de yang / 7paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi zhal gsung las/ bla ma mchog khyed deng dus nas bzung ba'i/ /lo ni bdun brgya tsam zhig rdzogs pa na/97paṇa chen dpal lngan ye shes kyi tham bha la'i smo na lam/26

7rgyal 'a yab sras rnam gnyis//rigs ldan drag por gyur nas kla klo'i dpung / /bcom nas rdzogs ldan bzhin du mdzad pa'i dus/ /10 zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ha lam phyi lo 2424 nas 3470yas mas nang / chu bo si ta'i lto phyogs kyi 'phags pa'i yul gyi bye brag ma kha nas bzungs/ 'a dzam bu gling 'dir kla klos dbang bsgyur nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa'i dus/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis sham bha la yi rigs ldan drag po 'khor can du sprul te/ rlung gi rta la bzhon/ ku sha'i gdung thogs pa'i sham bha la'i grong khyer gyi dmag dpon mdzad de/ kla klo'i tshogs dang drag po g.yul gyi dmag 'khrug bkye ste/ kla klo'i ston pa byed pa'i blo gros 7paṇa chen rin po ches btul te/ kla klo thams cad tshar bcad dag pa'i lam bkod/tshangs pa sham bha la dang / lha'i dbang po gling bcu gcig gi rgyal por bkod nas/mthar 7paṇa chen gyi sprul pa bsdu bar gsungs so/tshangs pas dge ba'i khrims rnam par dag pa bcas pa la brten nas/ mi rnams kyi tshe yang stong brgyad brgyar 'phel zhing / mgon po klu sgrub slar bde ba can nas sngon gyi sku lus la 'jug pa sogs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang rig pa'i gnas shin tu dar bar 'gyur ro/11 tshangs pa ni 7paṇa chen rin po che sham bha la nas bod yul du phebs skabs/ sham bha la'i rgyal po gdung dmar can 7paṇa chen rin po che'i rjes su 'brangs yong ba/ bod yul kha ba'i ljongs 'dir lha chen tshangs pa zhes/ spyir bod dang / yang sgos 7paṇa chen rin po che'i bran bzhin du/grogs dang 'phrin las sgrub mkhan zhig tu thugs bskyed pa zhig lags so/ /107pa r+ṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi sham lha la 'e smon lam/117paṇa chen dpal lngan ye r+shas kyi sham bha la 'i la ma yig 27

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/le'u gnyis pa/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen no'i skya tshe/sa bcad dang no/ skya che'i smad kyai cha/(1979— 1989)le tshan dang po/ skya gshegs kha'i zhal chelas/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 27 nyin bdag da dung pha yul du yod/nyin de dag gi ring bdag gi dran pa'i ngogs nas dus nam yang brjed dka' ba'i thal rlung 'tshub cing / kho ra khor yug gi bya dngos thams cad mi snang bar gyur/ zla 1 tshes 2 9 nyin gyi sa srod nga tsho nang mi rnams go gral la 'dzoms te sgron me'i 'od rlabs 'og tu/ lo gzhon rnams dza la'i me drod la lag pa sro zhing /rgan pa rnams lag las byed zhor bod ljongs rlung 'phrin la nyan nas bsdad yod/rlung 'phrin las dgung grangs 51 la son pa'i khyad du 'phags pa'i chos lugs kyi dbu khrid/ rlabs chen gyi rgyal gces pa/ 7paṇa chen er ti ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gtsang gzhis ka rtse bde chen skal bzang pho brang du sku mya ngan las 'das song zhes 'das brda bsgrags song /bkra mi shis pa'i gsar 'gyur de rna bar thos ma thag a pha'i bzhin gyi rnam 'gyur rbad de 'gyur zhing / pha ma gnyis gcig gi gdong la gcig gis lta bzhin yin srid kyi ma red zer/ pa lags nga tsho'i rlung 'phrin gyi gsar 'gyur 29

7baṇa chen nar te ji zhib 'dugal yid ma ches pas grong pa'i sar skad cha 'dri bar phebs song /mi snyan gtam de bden/ zhes pa ltar phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 27gyi mtshan mor/ bde chen skal bzang pho brang gi gzim chung bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling gi gzim khri'i steng/ sku la gos chen gyi na bza' ser po mnabs pa'i skyes chen zhig kha ba ri bo'i la klung gang sar rgyug nas bod don 'thab rtsod dang /bod skyobs re 'bod kyi gsung sgra dal gyi lhod de/ bde ldan gyi zhing du gshegs pa'i gnas ngan thos pa'i snang ༄1la de/ bdag gi dran lam nas nam yang yal gyi mi 'dugamago nag bod mis khyed la yid ches kyi gdeng 'jog 'dang ma song /zhes 7rgyal ba shākya thub pas dag pa lha yi zhing nas gsung sgra bsgrags la/ bod kyi dpa' bo khyed rang phebs pa snga bas nga tshor lag thogs rgyag gi/ zhes 'phags yul dh+wa ram shā lar chab srid skyabs bcol du bzhugs pa'i 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang pos skyo gdung gi 'bod sgra zhig kyang bsgrags 'dug1skyes chen khong ni las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bod mi rigs kyi bu rabs tsha rgyud kyi mtshan snyan la gnod pa'i shul rjes phra mo tsam yang nga'i lo rgyus nang mi 'jog pa'i dam bca' bzhag yod gsung mkhan/ dus rabs 20pa'i kha ba ri pa'i rgya stag srab med kyi dpa' rgod/ 7paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas sku phreng bcu pa chen po lags so/nga tshos 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po 'i sku tshe hril po'i mdzad 'phrin la zhib tshags pa'i mjal kha ma zhus gong / khong sku gshegs kha'i zhal gsung bka' 1phyi lo 19997paṇa chen rin po che sku 6 ngan la sa 'das te mi lo bcu 'khor ba'i dus dran thog stsal ba'i 7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob/spre pa r+ṇa chen bcu pa chen po sku mya ngan las 'das te lo bcu 'khor ba'i rjes dran tshogs chung i rjes dran dus deb/30

skya che 'i smad kyai cha/slob kyi mdun du bzhengs te thugs zhib cig gnang na/ khong gi rlabs chen gyi dgongs gzhi yongs rdzogs dpog dka' yang / dgongs pa can gyi zhal chems bka' slob dag las/ dka' tshigs dang 'o brgyal gyi ngang nas nga tsho dang zhal gyes zhus pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la/ yang dag pa'i ngos 'dzin thub pa'i nges shes 'brongs ba'i yid ches byed kyi yod/phyi lo 846 lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes btsan po glang dar ma'i don snying la lkog mda' 'phen pa'i lo rgyus kyi chag sgo dbu tshugs pa nas bzung / sgang pa bod kyi rgyal khab/ ces srol rgyun ngag sgros kyi tha snyad mag mog cig las/ bod rje srong btsan sgam pos mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi rtsa khrims dkyil 'khor nang /lha chos dge ba bcu'i bca' khrims kyis 'tsho ba'i bod btsan rngo6) gdung rgyud de/sil bu dang / sa skya/ phag gru/ rin spungs/ gtsang pa/ dga' ldan pho brang bcas sus kyang stod dzā ti dbyug pas dung sa nas/ smad rgya mo dar zab 'thag sa yan gyi mtho khri la 'gyings pa'i bla chen mi chen rnams/ gdung drug bod kyi bstan srid bya bar gros kha ma thub pa'i lo rgyus kyi stong cha skong zhing /rig gnas gsar brje'i dus gzir khrod rtsa med shul gtor du btang ba'i kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa nas dgu pa bar gyi sku gdung za ma tog bzhugs pa'i mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal dbu 'byed dang dga' ston gyi gtso skyong gnang phyir/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 9 nyin/ pe cing gi zhogs pa'i phyag tshod 8dang skar ma 30 thog pe cing nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog nyid kyi grogs po krung dbyang chab srid cud kyi kru'u zhi shin krung zhun 2dang / krung dbyang hru'u ci khru'u nad lta 'e zu nag gi srid zhi cing jin gyi pha yin zhing /de snga nub byang cud kyi 'am khrid gnang myo nga phyi lo 1954 lor/rgyal srid spyi byab khang bi drung yig 31

7pa ṇa chen yer te ni zhib 'jugayi hru ci 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blon chen yan ming h+pha/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi u sgron krang gzhon pa nyel / zla 1 tshes 11 nyin krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi bka' rgya bzhin/ bod rang skyong ljongs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi rag sdis/ lo rabs 60 nang kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gzim khang bdun gyi ma zin phyag gis bzhes te/ khyed rnams kyi gzigs dang / bsam 'char yig cha 'di ngos rang nas bris shing / ngos rang ngo mas bzo bcos byas pa yinatshe mo dang /cang gi dril bsgrags las 'gan 'dzin/de rjes 'thab phyogs gcig gyur dang mi rigs las khungs kyi 'gan bzhes/phyi lo 19547rgyal ba 7pa ca chen pe cing chebs sgyur ska bas sne 'e na pa gzu bo yin/ skyo nag dbus gzhung gis 7pa'o chen rin po che dang 'brel ba byed malan gyi las 'gan sprad/rig gsar ska bas bcon du tshud cing /lo rabs naXnang r+ya ra rmi nga co gnas spar gso byung /hu'u pa'o phang dang 'brel che zheng 'thab phyogs gcig gyur kyi 4 sa 'gan bzhes/bod kyi las don sgor gye gros mol dang gnyis la bzhugs shing /lo rabs na pa'i nang 7paṇa chen rin po cher rgyab skyo ra shugs chen sdo/sa/336433 ྅44gyi //4277 shā lo55me skya tshe'i mi da kyai cha/yig cha 'di'i don du dka' las mang po brgyab yod/ yin na'ang / skyon brjod phog skabs yig cha de'i don du mi mang po zhig la ma nyes khag g.yog phog yod/ces lhan rgyas su bcar ba'i tang srid dmag gsum gyi dbu khrid tshor gsungs/zla 1 tshes 12 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs tang srid dmag gsum gyi las byed pa'i tshogs 'du bskongs te/ phyi lo 1988 lo'i bod mi'i sger langs skabs 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas pa'i chab srid bcon pa rnams glod 'grol dgos pa nan gsung gnang pas/ phyi lo 1988 zla zha nang 'dzin bzung byas pa'i bod kyi chab srid btson pa yongs grod 'grol gtong rgyu'i khas len byung /4btson srung bas chab srid btson pa rnams sang nyin gnang nyin glod rgyu yin pa bshad stabs/ chab srid btson pa rnams kyis kyang rang rang so so'i btson chas rnams/ btson khang cig pa'i nyes don nyes gsog gi btson par ster ba'i gnas zhesal byung 'duga'on kyang / blo pham dgos pa zhig la/ zla 1 tshes 27gyi mtshan mo kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku mya ngan las 'das rkyen/bod kyi chab srid btson pa rnams slar yang btson chas g.yogs te mu mthud btson 'jug byas 'dug3zla 1 tshes 13 nyin gyi tho rengs lha ldan rgyal sa nas chibs thon gyis/gtsang ljongs gzhis rtse'i phyogs su chibs zhal bsgyur/ dbus gtsang gnyis kyi sa bab mtshams gam pa la 56) rtser/ chibs 'khor las bsho la te la btsas gsos shing lha rgyal 'then/ gam pa la rtse dang yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i bla ri bla mtshor/bod khams bde zhing rgyal bstan dar ba'i thugs smon gnang zhing / rim pas myang smad nyi ma rdzong gi phyogs su chibs sgyur gnang / skabs der gtsang khul ser 4chab srid brtsanazur dga' ldan grwa bag gror bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/phyi lo naX bla 8tshes 15nyin/5chab srid btsonazur dga' ldan gyu bag gror bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/phyi lo 2༷༷ zla 8tshes 15nyin/33

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhib 'jug skya khri ma 'bum gyis gser sbreng dang dung rgya'i chibs bsu dang bcas/ dpal gyi chos sde chen po gdan sa bkra shis lhun por zhabs sor bde bar 'khod/gsar du bzhengs pa'i mchod khang shar 7paṇa chen sku gdung bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi bzo bkod rnams/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog nyid kyi 'char bkod dgongs bzhed ltar legs par grub pa gzigs skabs/ thugs dgyes tshor chen po gnang bzhin/ mkha' la nyi zla'i gzi 'od bzhin/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mun pa bsal/ /zhes bsngags brjod kyang gnang 'dugazla 1 tshes 22 nyin bkra shis lhun po'i skal bzang khyams ra chen mor/mchod khang shar 7paṇa chen sku gdung bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi rab gnas dang /dga' ston gyi dngos gzhi'i mdzad sgo dngos su gtso skyong gnang / skabs der 31gas bzhugs sku mgron mi sna khri gnyis lhag tsam 'dug6phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 23 nyin/ da lta'i char rgya nag gzhung gis srid 'dzin gyi sa khongs bcu gcig tu dum bur bcad pa'i bod khul gyi bla dpon rnams bzhugs mol tshogs 'du bskongs te/ phyi lo 1949 nas da lta'i bar gung khran tang gis bod la rogs skyor byas pa las gtor bshig btang ba mang zhing /tha na da lta'i char yang bod la ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong zhig lag bstar don 'khyol med pa'i lo rgyus kyi chag sgo la chod sdom gnang /7chos lugs thad lo rabs drug cu pa nas rtsa 'gog byas pa'i bod brgyud nang bstan gyi bla sprul sku ngos 'dzin gnang phyogs skor gyi lam ston dang /dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur dang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs/ bod kyi dgon 57paṇa chen rin po che'i sadan sa bkra 'is lhun po /shog ngos 15༷nang /mi rigs dpe smu na lang /phyi yig dbe byu na khang /199 lor/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bka' slob/pyi lo 1998lor phyi dril las khungs kyis bod sgyur dang dpa ra smun zhus/34

kyi che'i mi da kyi cha/pa brgya cha dgu bcu rtsa gtor btang ba rnams nyams gso'i mdzub khrid las khungs/ bod brgyud nang bstan mdzub khrid u yon gsar 'dzugs/8 chab srid thad 'byung 'gyur gyi bod la tshol gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i ming don mtshungs pa'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag bstar don 'khyol dgos pa'i bsgrags gtam yang spel 'duganya7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/ bcings 'grol btang nas lo 40lhag gi ring / phyogs yongs nas grub 'bras mi dman pa zhig thob yod/ yin na'ang / de rnams shin tu blos gtong dka' ba'i don mang po zhig dang brjes pa'i grub 'bras shig red/ mchod khang shar 7paṇa chen sku gdung bkra shis rnam rgyal dbu 'byed byed kyi dga' ston zab rgyas byed pa'i skabs 'dir/ ngos kyi chos grogs 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa zhe drags dran gyi/10 zhes sku ma gshegs sngon du ches mtha' ma'i tshogs zhugs gsung bshad gnang /skabs der 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po kho nas lam ston bka' slob gnang ba tsam min par/ bod kyi sa khul khag lnga'i bla chen dpon chen mnyam 'dzoms kyis/ 'a byung 'gyur bo da kyi las don rab dang rim pa'i steng tshogs 'du dang / bsam tshul gsung res/ gros bsdur gtam bshad gnang ba sogs/mi sems 'gul ba'i mdzad 'phrin de dag gis/ bod rigs sa khul khag lnga'i rig gnas spel res dang / dpa' 'byor mnyam las/ bsam 'dun gcig gyur bya rgyur phan nus nges can zhig thon yod/nagung thang rin po chos 7paṇa chen rin ngo che dgongs rdzogs bka' slob dang /kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bka' slo ba/shog ngos nananang /1 992phyi dril la sa khungs kyi bod sgyur dang ra 'i na zhus /5kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bka' slo ba/thog ngos 94nang /phyi lo 1998lor/phyi drel la sa khungs kyis bod sgyur dpa ra 'i na zhus/ 07 ༈ lkolko〉 r+sā4rdo44 khu sta 35

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'dume mdor na/ dus der 7rgyal mchog bcu gsum pa chen po'i chu sprel zhal gdams gnyis pa ltar/ bod mi rigs kyi bu rabs tsha rgyud kyi sems khong nas nam yang brjed dka' ba'i zhal gsung bka' slob gnang grub pa dang /khong sku ngo mas phyag bstar ma'i mtshan bkod gnang ba'i khong nyid kyi sku par tshon khra can de/ tshogs zhugs bla dpon tshor dran rten phyag rtags su sku ngo mas re re bzhin bstsal te/ 'di ni nga'i bsam pa'i mtshon byed cig yin pas/ khyed tshos bla ma rgyags pa nga ma brjed pa byos/11 zhes gsungs/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog gis/ da bar rgya nag gzhung gis lo ngo bzhi bcu'i ring bod du 'gro song btang ba de/ blos btang pa'i rin thang dang bsdur na bsdur thabs med pa'i gyong gud chen po byung yod gsungs pa/lo rgyus kyi chod sdom sub thabs med pa zhig tu gyur stabs/ rgya nag gzhung gis khong gi zhal gsung bka' slob log 'grel gyis/ mi rnams go ba log par len rgyu'i thabs shes byas yod pa ma zad/ zhal chems masag 'grel byed pa'i las 'gan de bka' zur nga phod la gnang 'dugabaka' zur nga phod kyis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis 'gro song chen po btang ba red gsungs pa de'i don ni/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs dpe cha mang po mer sreg btang ba de tshor gsungs kyi yod pa red/ dpe cha de tsho rtsa chen po zhe drags yin dus gong brgyab mi thub pa zhig red/ khong chos byed mi sna zhig yin dus/ dpe cha de tsho rtsa chen por brtsis nas khe las gyong che ba rag 'dug gsungs pa red/12 ces gsungs/11bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams sgrig 〈7pa ṇa chen bcu pa rjes dran/〉thog ngos 118 nang /bod ljongs mi dam ngas dpe kun khang /pyi ngo 1989zla phyinang / 216nga11ba 08581dzipu mi smo 8706/17198905khu ciXtshosastu༄55 36

skya che'i mi da kyai cha/ zla 1 tshes 25 dang 26 so sor/ thag ring ri grong gi gseb nas/7paṇa chen rin po che'i gser zhal mjal rgyur skom pa chu 'dod ltar rgyug yong ba'i zhing 'brog mi mang la dgyes brtse'i mjal kha gnang zhing / mjal mang ba tshor phyag dbang gnang skabs/ bde chen skal bzang pho brang gi mkha' dbyings su glo bur du sprin dkar po mjal dar sgron 'dra dpyangs pa zhig shar/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gam bcar zhabs gras skal bzang la/ mgyogs po par rgyobs/mgyogs po par rgyobs/13 zhes bka' gnang /'on kyang / skal bzang lags kyis par chas 'khyer med stabs khyim du par chas len par phebs/ par chas 'khyer nas phyir 'khor skabs 'ja' tshon de yal zin/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ par brgyab pas zhes bka' rtsad gnang skabs/ skal bzang gis mgo bo g.yug bzhin rgyag thub ma song zhus/gnas tshul der thugs pham pa'i bzhin las yag po ma byung /14 zhes gsungs/phyi lo 1938 zla 2 tshes 19 nyin/ mtsho sngon zhing chen zhun ta rdzong pus mdo ma ru sde pa'i mkha' dbyings su 'ja' tshon lnga sna zhig 'char ba de/mi tshos pus mdo dpon tshang gi ma yum la 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog 'khrungs ba'i phebs bsu'i brda ltas la ngos 'dzin byas yod kyang / phyi lo 1989 zla 1tshes 26 nyin/ gtsang ljongs gzhis rtse bde chen skal bzang pho brang gi mkha' dbyings su sprin dkar po 'ja' tshon dpyangs 'dra 'char ba de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bde ldan gyi zhing du phebs skyel zhu mkhan zhig yin pa'i brda ltas la sus kyang dogs pa byung mi 'dugame bod dogagreng /thog ngos 19nang /dbang 'dus kyi bcams/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe sgrun lang /phyi lo 1999lor//snor+sā7lolko khri7thatho' khutsho4 14/ khu7lolko 134/ tha megli khu spe 37

7paṇa chen er te gi zhib 'dugazla 1 tshes 25 dang 26 gnyis la/ zhogs pa nas dgong dro'i bar dad ldan ser skya khri tsho lnga lhag la phyag dbang bar mtshams med pa gnang bas/sku stod kyi pur rtse dreg pas tshos shing / phyag skrangs kyang dad ldan mang tshogs blo pham mi yong ba'i ched/ sku ngal khyad bsad kyis phyag dbang gnang / mjal zhu ba'i khrod kyi bza' tsho zhig la bu phrug mtshes ma zhig skyes yod pa der/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis ming 'dogs yong ba'i gsol 'debs zhu skabs/ thugs mnyes po'i ngang bu der bkra shis don grub dang / bu mo der shes rab sgron ma/15 zhes bstsal/ de ni 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod phrug la ming gnang ba mtha' ma/ de yang yin/dad ldan mi mang la phyag dbang gnang skabs/ zhabs phyi sku 'khor tshor/ sku nyid kyi tshon khra can gyi sku par de/ mjal phyag tu bcar ba'i dad ldan mi mang la dran rten phyag rtags su rgya gang cher 'grems spel dgos pa'i bka' gnang zhing / thugs brtse'i bzhin ras mjal zhu ba'i phyogs la gzigs bzhin/ tshong pa rgyags pa nga ma brjed pa byos ā/ zhes gsung shugs drag pos lan bzlos kyis gnang rjes/ bod ljongs kyi gsar 'god pa dbang 'dus la/nga ni 'gro mkhan yin zhes thengs mang gsungs/16gdong mdog skyo la gos hrul ba'i dad ldan mi mang gi mdog skya gzigs skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs sems mi bde ba chen po byung ste/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che gsar pa hu'u cin tha'o la/ ngos rang na ning dang da lo 'dir slebs pa'i mthong tshul gnyis bsdur nas bltas na/ bod mi mang gi sems khams bde thang na ning las zhan du song ba'i tshor snang byung / 'di ltar lo re nas lo re zhan du phyin pa yin na/ nga tsho lhung sa gang 'dra zhig la lhung nas/zags sa gang 'dra zhig la zags rgyu red dam/15bod don gleng /shog ngos 9nang /dbang 'dus kyis brtsams/bod smo ngas mi dmangs dpe byu na khang /phyi lo 1999lor/15bod don gleng /thog ngos 19 nang /dbang 'dus kyis brtsams/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /phyi 'o 1999lor/38

kyi tshe'i mi da kyai cha/ngas hru'u ci gsar pa'i 'go khrid 'og tu/ ngos rang thengs rjes ma bod la yong skabs/ bod mi mang gi sems khams bde thang la 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung ba mthong thub pa'i re ba byed kyi yod/17 ces gsungs/ phyi lo 1988zla 10 nang bod rang skyong gi drung che rnying pa hu'u cin hwa bod nang gsos rlung mi (rngo/ 1—1 /bye/ she(1 :re/ /cedro 711'dang ba bshad gnas sa btang nga / nga tshab tu hu'u na tha gsar du 'byor/ 4 9ci / tsho6 rnasna 8/ra rikyi gasna sna ga zhe spro ri ci༈mdzo( 8 ci/ ༷ tsā ri ri ri ri ci ci ༷ni ci pa ci ri ṇ+ḍaṃ(phri lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 2nyin/ gzhis ka rtser mi ma nga la mjal ba sanang bzhin pa )mjal mang ba'i lag tu bzung ba'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i 'od par des/kho d+ku bzhin la mtshar sdug gi 'od mdangs rgyas shing / bod khams la bde skyid kyi nyi gzhon 'phro ba'i re bas khengs mod/ blo pham pa zhig la 7paṇa chen bcu byu11 /re/ /nge 71( she/rga :) ces 1de /re/ rwade/pa ma ga sa hu'u na tha la ba la ba zhal mas / yab la sa rab rgyal mtshan gyis/ mi la ma smad gsum gyi 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug a khu dang a ne la bcol nor du song ba bzhin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog mya ngan las 'das te 177paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi ba 'a slob/thog ngos 108 nang /phyi dril la sa khungs kyis bod bsgyur par 'grem sa byas/phyi lo 1998lor/39

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'dunazla gsum song ba'i rjes su/ hu'u cin tha'os lo rgyus thog bod la drag po'i dmag don bka' rgya thengs dang po de bsdams/da lta nga tshos 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog gi mgul brang g.yon pa'i steng / mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi dran rten sku par bsgron pa'i shad ma'i phyu chen nag po zhig dang / mis bzos ko ba'i stod gos nag po zhigazhabs lham yu ring nag po zhig mnabs te/ mun pa nag po'i khrod du glog bzhu'i 'od rlabs la brten nas/ mi mang la phyag dbang gnang bzhin pa'i sku par zhig mjal thub/ciri bye rtosnyo rilkotshori sgyuri 4rnyechori ciri gci ci ze rtodro ci dzo ri ru 〉dri〉 ri ci ci lhashā3—————sko————————————— nga —(phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 27 mtshan mo mi ma nga la mjal /wa gnang bzhin pa/)de ni phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 27 nyin gyi mtshan mo ste/ 7paṇa chen rin po che sku zhi bar ma gshegs sngon gyi chu tshod 'ga' shas kyi gong du bsgron pa'i sku par zhig yin red la/ bod mi mang la mjal kha ches mtha' ma'i skabs kyi sku par dang /khong gi sku tshe hril po'i nang gi sku par mtha' ma de yang red/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog sku mya ngan las 'da' kha'i gnas tshul khag la zhib tshags po zhib 'jug byed skabs/ sku mya ngan las 'da' rgyu'i brda ltas 40

skya tshe'i mi da kyi cha/mi nyung ba zhig rab dang rim par thon 'dugaphyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 22 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis mchod khang shar gdung rten bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi bum rten nang / rdo rje skyil krung chos ston phyag rgya'i ngang bzhugs nas/ khams dkar mdzes kyi bla ma lam brag rin po cher ngos yang 'di ltar bsdad na legs/18zhes gsung zhing /mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal du 7paṇa chen rnam lnga'i sku gdung rten 'jug byas rjes/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gcig pa'i sbyin sreg cho ga gnang skabs/ phyag gi rdo rje phyir 'phags te ji tsam btsal kyang rnyed mi 'dug phyi lo 1989 zla 1tshes 22 nyin mchod khang shar rab gnas dang dga' ston mdzad sgo'i gsol ja dang 'bras sil rlangs pa 'phyur bzhin pa/ sku mdun du 'dregs 'bul zhu skabs/de dag tshang ma phyir slog gnang mdzad 'dug19yab gzhis sras mo rig 'dzin dbang mos/ phyi lo 1989 zla 1tshes 9 nyin/ yab mchog pe cing nas bod du phebs khar bdag la sham bha la'i lo rgyus gsung byung / bsam rgyu rtsed mo (skabs der sras mo dgung lo 5la son/)las med pa'i bdag gis/ yab mchog dam par rtsed chas yod med bka' 'dri zhus kyang /ma 'ongs pa nga tsho sham bha lar mjal yong gsungs pa las gzhan gyi bka' lan ma phebs/nam rgyun yab mchog dam pa phyogs su chibs sgyur skabs/ gnam thang bar phebs skyel zhus pas chog mod/ thengs der (phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 9nyin//khong gis bdag la sems 'khreng chen po gnang gi 'dug la/ zhabs phyi sku 1816050 khu'i(༷ mi0ji bsgo'iX ji 7499193 /yo'ikhu/5 1 0mi ji sa0 ba800ji 99956 mi 19gzhis kyi gdanas bkram lhun gyi chos rig pho nya/deb dang po /lcags pa blo bzang phyogs legs kyi rjes dran rtsomasag41

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'juga'akhor zhig bdag gnam gru'i nang 'bod par btang ste/ ma 'ongs par nga'i rogs pa byos a/ a ma lags kyi zhal la nyan po dgos/ zhes sga/ma nan che ba'i zhal ta 'ga' gnang byung / khong gis 'di nas ngos kho tsho dang kha bral rgyu red/sems nang skyo snang ha cang che/ ngos kyi re bar sku zhabs chos ngos la lta skyong gnang ba ltar/ rjes sor ngos kyi khyim tshang 'di la gzigs skyong yag po gnang rogs/ zhes zhabs 'bring sku 'khor tshor zhal chems 'jog gnang mdzad 'dug gsungs/20tshes 26 dang tshes 27 nyin/ mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi rab gnas dang dga' ston gyi mdzad sgo grub pa dang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi khri chen gung thang rin po che dang / gser rta bla rung dgon gyi mkhan chen 'jigs med phun tshogs/ dga' ldan khri tshab 'brog mi byams pa blo gros/21 'a ba' ba phun tshogs dbang rgyal/ krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi bod rigs sde tshan gyi 'gan 'dzin ran ring / krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang mi rigs sde tshan gyi 'gan 'dzin li tso min sogs/ pe cing dang bod rigs sa khul lnga nas phebs pa'i bod kyi mtho rim bla dpon tshos/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la thon phyag zhu bar bcar/skabs der rin po che mchog mdzad 'phrin gzhan dang gzhan gyis khong tsho dang lhod bzhugs gsung gleng gnang rgyu'i dus tshod med kyang / thon mjal du yong ba'i bla dpon rnams dang sku par sgron dgos gsungs shing / bla dpon 'ga' zhig gis 7paṇa chen bcu par mdzad dka' bzos par 'tsher snang gis/mjal rten dang sku phyag phul te zhal gyes zhu rtsis gnang mkhan tshor/ we/ nga tsho 20/ smo1: 〉〉165pa: /d+ku stse 7lo tsho64 21phyi lo 1986lor 7paṇa chen bcu ske chen po sa dga' ldan khri tshab tu bsko sa/42

sku che 'i mi da kyi cha/mnyam du sku par zhig sgron dgos/ ngos dang mnyam du sku par sgron rgyu mtha' ma de yin/22 zhes gsungs/ tshes 26 nyin 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la thon phyag zhu bar bcar ba'i gung thang rin po ches/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dar spel ched/ da lta'i char gal che shos 7paṇa chen rin po che'i sku phya la srung skyob gnang rgyu de yin pas/sku gzugs la thugs lcag gnang rogs/ zhes gsol 'debs nan du zhus par/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/ khyed kyis thugs khur gnang bar thugs rje che/da lta ngos ngal gso rgyas mi rung / da dung dad ldan bod mi khri tsho lhag la mjal phyag gtong dgos yod/ mjal phyag tshar ba dang ngal gso rgyag rgyu yin/ zhes bka' phebs/7gong sa bcu bzhi pa chen pos/ 7paṇa chen rin po che rang gi gdan sa bkra shis lhun por chibs sgyur gnang ste sku mya ngan las 'das pa ni/ skyes bu dam pa'i dgongs pa can gyi ma/dzad pa zhig tu gzigs pa bzhin/ skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i skyes chen khong gis/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gyi gangs can skye 'gro'i blo sna chos la skul phyir/ zhing khams kyi gnas mal gzhan du phebs rgyu'i brda ltas gsal po bstan kyang / mya ngan 'a das chen las/de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa'i tshe/'phags pa kun dga' bo la/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs par bzhed na ni/bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag par yang bzhugs so/ zhes gsungs pa la/kun dga' bo bdud kyis non pas lan ci yang ma gsol bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs pa nges par gtad par gsungs pa dang 'dra na a ku rin po ches 7par chen bcu pa 'i smor/stustumegatam gleng 'al par la gnang ba'i gsungs/43

7paṇa chen zher te gi zhib 'jugabar/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi sku drung na 'khod pa'i kha ba ri pa'i skye bo su zhig gis kyang / gegs bar sel ba'i zhabs rim dang / thugs bskyed dam bca'i dgongs don bzhin/ da dung yang mgon skyabs dam par 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa'i brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs bstar 'bul lta ci/ nga ni 'gro mkhan yin/zhes lan zlos kyis gsung pa la'ang dogs pa tsam yang ma byung ba de/ da gzod 1)// 1ngos shāX/ (ste/ //// /sku//dre/ཿ)du/ ྅dro/dem na skyabs dam pa ra ba phangs mas dang 'a da gdung lags /44

skya che'i smad kyi cha/le tshan gnyis pa/ skru gshegs pa'i snga phyi/ na gzhon rnams kyi dngas gtsang gi bsam pa dug gis sbags song /zhes ste ri si'i skyes chen so khi ra thir/ ngo log pa'i nag nyes btsugs te khrims khang gis srog khrims bcad pa dang / mchod khang shar7paṇa chen sku gdung bkra shis rnam rgyal rab gnas dang dga' ston gyi mdzad sgor kha g.yar nas/bod rigs sa khul lnga'i bla dpon bskongs pa kha bral gyi bya spyod du 'jigs te/sku 'das bkrongs mi shes pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa rnam gnyis/ rang dbang dang drang bden gyi ched du yod tshad blos gtong gnang mkhan gcig mtshungs red/mi rnams kyis bod mi mang la kha yod lag yod kyi phan pa sgrub mkhan 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po yang / ghi ri si'i so khi ra thi dang / si phan gyi sar we thi dbyi tha la'i tu'u no dang 'dra bar/ mi rigs dang / chos lugs/ rang dbang /drang bden/ 'dra mnyam gyi ched 'chi bdag gson 'dre'i lag 'og tu shor ba'i dogs gzhi byed bzhin 'dugayab gzhis rig 'dzin dbang mos/ phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 28 nyin/bdag a ma lags dang lhan du pe cing nas lha sa bar ched gtong gnam gru dang /lha sa nas gzhis rtser thad phur gnam gyur bsdad de yong ba yin/ gnam gru'i nang gi 'brel yod las byed pa rnams kyis/ yab mchog dam pa sku gzugs bde po med tshul las/ sku gzhan don du gshegs skor gsang rgya gang dam byas te/gnas tshul drang po gsung mkhan zhig gtan nas ma byung /45
