skya che'i smad kyai cha/ma la yi rgyab 'dabs nas gling lnga zhi bdes skyong bzhin pa'i 7gong sa mchog gis gsan dus/ bod kyi rang dbang rtsod len pa dngos gnas shig med pa chags song dgongs pa'i phangs sems dang thugs skyos/45 bzhin mdangs 'gyur bzhin thugs dam spyan dmigs la bzhugs 'dug46gzhis lus bod mi tshos sku thang gsal zhing brjid bag ldan pa'i mgon skyabs dam pa/ glo bur sku'i bkod pa bsdus stangs la the tshom dang dogs 'char tshad med skyes te/ nga tsho'i bla ma gung khran tang gis bkrongs song /zhes sgrog mi phod pa'i gdung 'bod mgrin pa nas mid cing / gzhan yul sa mtha' na skyabs bcol kyi 'tsho bas ngal ba'i byes pa tshos kyang / rgya gar gyi rgyal sa ldi lir rngam ston gyi khrom skor dang tshags shog thog rgya nag gzhung gis/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku bkrongs pa'i rgol gtam yang bsgrags 'dug477paṇa chen rin po che'i sku 'khris su las ka byed bzhin pa'i las byed mi sna tshos/ sngar nas bzung 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la snying gi na tsha yod pa'i lo rgyus shig rtsa ba nas med pa bshad la/ snying nad thengs gcig kyang byung ma myong ba gsungs/ de bas kyang / phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 9 nyin pe cing nas bod du chibs kha bsgyur khar/ sku gzugs la khyon yongs nas brtag dpyad thengs gcig gnang 'bras su/ sku gzugs yongs su bde thang dang rgyu gtan yin pa rir sprod byung yod gsungs/48'on kyang / rgya nag gzhung gis bod khul gang sar 7paṇa chen bcu ji phyi yu la du rang dbang /shog 411nang /lha 'u nga blo bzangagan tshoms kyis bod sgyur byas/ldi li bod khang dpar sgrun zhus/bye lo na008lo ra/jigaphyi lo 1989shes bya dus deb/phyi dril khungs kyi gzhung 'brel dus deb/ji phyi lo 1989zhes bya dus deb/bod gzhung phyi dril las khungs/cananga'i pha 4 la gyi ya nga ba'i lo rgyus/shog ngos 18nanang /bstan 'dzin dpal 'bar/snar thang dpar khang /phyi lo 1994lor/57

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhing 'jugapa mchog mgul snying gi stun gzhi gro bur du 'phar nas sku gshegs pa dngos yod yin pas/ dkrog gtam bshad tshe lam seng btson 'jug bya rgyu yin pa'i sdigs ra bskul 'dug lha sa gtsug lag khang gi dge 'dun pa zhig gis/ bod mi tshos rgya nag gzhung la 7paṇa chen rin po che dug sprad nas sku bkrongs med na/dpang rtags dang khungs skyel ra sprod dgos pa'i sbyar yig bkrams par brten/dge 'dun pa dang btsun ma gang byung du nyes brdung gtong gi 'dug ces gsungs/49tha'e lhan gyi gsar shog (skyo nag na dus bab /ces pa'i nang / phyi lugs gso rig la nang byan chub pa'i gsang yum bde chen dbang mos/ kun gzigs mchog la khrag shed mtho ba'i nad gzhi dang / khrag tshil 'phel zad kyi nad/ mkhris rgyu gsher rtsi'i nad/ snying khams mi bde ba'i nad gang yang med pa'i bsgrags gtam spel ba dang / —phyi lo 1985 nas kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che bod la chibs sgyur gnang rim bzhin/ sku gzugs 'phrod bston zhabs zhu'i sku bcar bla sman/bod ljongs bod lugs gso rig zhib 'jug khang gi sman pa 'bum rams pa kurma 'ebyes 'phel lags (7paṇa chen rin po ches kurma chos 'phel lags la khyed nga'i sman pa byed 'dod dam gsu ngas nas sku nyid kyi bla sman du bskos/)kyang / phyi lo 1989 zla 1 nang 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi lhan du bcar 'dug karma chos 'phel lags kyis gsungs na/7paṇa chen rin po che sku gzugs shin tu thang bas/ nam rgyun mtshams re mgul cham phog pa dang mgrin pa bstun pa phud/ spyir btang stun gzhi bzhes kyi med pa gsungs/504 phyi lo 1989zla tshes 11nyin/16211ba165gsar khang /5༷spung ma'i bod ljongs/phyi lo 1995deb ji/shog ngos nanang /spyi'i deg grangs na /58

skya che'i smad kyai cha/gzhis bzhugs chab srid bcon zur lha phrug gis brtsams shing /phyi lo 2004 lor/ bod gzhung bde srung las khungs kyis dpar skrun gnang ba'i bden don gsal ba'i sgron me zhes pa'i deb kyi shog ngos 247 nang /7paṇa chen rin po che'i sku bcar bod sman mkhas pa can gyis/ skabs de dus rgya mis dam drag byas te nyin shas gong nas nga tsho mi su gcig kyang 'khris su gtong gi mi 'dug sku'i bsnyun gzhi gang yin min rtsa ba nas shes ma byung gsung gi 'dug ces 'khod 'dugacig byas na lha phrug la 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i bsnyun gzhi shes rtogs med pa gsung mkhan gyi gam bcar sman pa de bla sman kurma chos 'phel yin srid/gang ltar bla sman kurma chos 'phel lags kyi zhal gsung dang / rgya nag rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen rgyun las u yan lhan khang gi 'a das brda'i nang / sku ngal che drags nas sku'i snying kham/sa kyi stun gzhi glo bur du ldang bas/ myur skyobs zhus kyang ma phan pas sku grongs song zhes pa gnyis rbad de 'gal zla chags 'dug5/gsum pa/ rgyun ldan min pa'i bya spyod 'ga'/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher rgya nag gzhung gis gsol dug phul bar dogs nas/ bod khul gang sar ngo rgol byed pa'i 'os langs rgya nag gzhung gis gcod ma thub pas/ gcig nas sku gdung pe cing la gdan 'dren zhu rgyu'i lkog jus bshams pa dang /52 phyogs gzhan zhig nas dgongs pa rdzogs nas nyin gsum gyi rjes/ glo bur du mi mang la ga nga mjal btang nas ngo rgol gyi rnam pa 'jags thabs byas 'dug51bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/7pa ṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/shog dad9nang /cad ljongs mi dam ngas dpe skrun lang /pyi lo 1989lor/ 5dbakras thi na phyag mdzod dga' spag blo bzang rdo rjes 7paṇa chen rin po'i'i skor gsung pa/59

7paṇa chen yer te gi zhib cigazhugad lta a rir bzhugs pa'i sku 'bum dgon pa'i bla ma a kya rin po ches/7paṇa chen rin po che nam rgyun gzigs skor la chibs sgyur skabasa'/ chos g.yog dang / drung yig sogs zhabs phyi nang ma dang / sku srung ru khag sman don ru khag bcas las tshan gsum gyi skor thang phebs lam yod mod/ phyi lo 1989lor/ 7paṇa chen rin po che bod la phebs thengs mtha' ma'i skabs/ nam rgyun thugs mnyes shos gnang sa'i sku srung ru dpon zha'o yang gtsos sku srung ba dang /sman don mi sna tshang ma gsar pa brjes 'dug gsungs pa thos dus/53phyi lo 1985 lor/ sku ngo bka' zur kun bde gling gis dbu khrid pa'i bod gzhung sku tshab pe cing du phebs skabs/ 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis sku ngo kun bde gling la nang mol snying gtam gyi tshul du/ da lta'i skabs la 7paṇa chen rin po che'i zhabs zhu'i gnas stangs la/ nam zhig mgo rnyog zhig mi yong ngam snyam pa'i sems ngal rgyun chags su yong gi 'dug gsungs pa'i bka' mol de blo yul du lhang la 'char byung /54rgyal spyi'i dpar skrun dang rgyang bsgrags gsar 'god pa 13822121200gyis/ phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 27 nyin dgung mo/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal gsar bzhengs gnang mkhan gyi las mi tsho dang lhan du mtshan tshogs kyi thugs spro gnang / mtshan mo'i chu tshod 1yol tsam la 7paṇa chen rin po che sku thang mnyel bas sku mgron tshor thugs spro pos bzhugs dgos gsungs shing / khong rang bde chen pho brang gi gzim chung du chibs sgyur gnang /555 sang gtam speng zhal par/la kya rin po ches 7paṇa chen bcu pa 'i sko ra gsungs pa /54brka' zur kun bde gleng 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyis tshe'i lo rgyus/deb gnyis pa/thog ngos 89nang /phyi lo naX po ra/551522312120ba271623380670116698236302377 ba8220019260

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/sku gzim ma gnang gong gi chu tshod phyed ka tsam zhig gi ring phyag dpe gzigs rgyu'i 'char gzhi gnang zhing / gsol dpon blo bzang zhesal khrims la gzim chas kum pa li thol pa zhig khyer dgos pa'i bka' gnang / gzim dpon gyis gzim chas thol pa khyer nas tshur gzim chung du bcar skabs/ gzim chung gi mtha' tshang ma rgya mi'i spyi bde nyen rtog pas bskor 'dug pa gzigs/ nyen rtog pa de tshos gsol dpon blo bzang tshul khrims gzim chung nang gtong rgyu phar zad/ phyag tu bsnams pa'i gam pa li'i gzim chas de yang shed kyis 'phrog ste phyir 'gro dgos pa'i nyen brda btang 'dug56skabs de'i spyi bde nyen rtog de rnams gsar pa yin pa dang / phal cher de'i gong rtsa ba nas mthong myong med pa'i mtho rim spyi bde las byed pa zhig gis mngags gtong byas pa zhig yin pa'i snang ba byung bar gsungs/577paṇa chen rin po che stun gzhi bzhes tsusgrol du bshad pa'i tshes 28 nyin/bde chen pho brang nang ha cang dam bsgrags byas te/ sku 'khor du dgung grangs 80brgal ba'i yongs 'dzin rgya yag rin po che ma gtogs/ sku phung gi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad rgya dpon dang rgya rigs sman pas bskor zhing / gzim chung gi gzim sgo tshang ma rgya dmag gis bkag stabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs blo 'khel sa'i zhabs phyi nang ma sku bcar don grub lags dang /spen pa lags/ blo bzang bstan 'dzin lags/bkra shis stobs rgyas/ chos tshe ring / a mdo skal bzang lags sogs su gcig kyang sku mdun du btang med pas/ sku'i stun tshul dang zhing la gshegs stangs skor zhabs 'bring nang ma su la'ang gsung rgyu med/58 /561322lnga/5160ba271535680smostuXng16228ba056067ba tshi ba32300192 57158231212002〉/16250706 (0(1/10tams07006masa'i 98820019258zla ba bsam grub dang bkras sun gyis 7paṇa chen rin ngo che'i skor gyi tsheg tho bod kyi 'gro ba mi'i thob thang dang mang gtso 'ange la rgyas lte gnas lang gi yig tshag 61

7paṇa chen ler te ni zhib 63rdug le tshan gsum pa/ sku gshegs pa'i rgyu rkyen/phyi lo 1988 nas 1989 bar ni/ bod rgya phyogs gnyis gas/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la kha rdung dang sdig mod byed pa'i lo zhig red/ phyi lo 1985 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis dgon pas rang kha rang bzo dang /slob gso yar rgyas kyi thebs rtsa'i ched/ gangs rgyan tshong khang / zhes pa'i tshong khang mang po zhig bod khul gang sar gsar du btsugs pa der/ bsam blo'i gnas tshad dman pa'i bod mi mang po zhig gis shes bzhin dang shes bzhin min pa'i sgo nas/bla mas tshong rgyags gi 'dug ces kha rdung gtong bzhin snang ba mi 'gro ba byed pa'i mur/ phyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 27 nyin/ lha sar zhi ba'i sger langs byung /phyi lo 1979 lor/ ting zha'o phing gis/ rang btsan ma gtogs de min gnas tshul gang yang gros mol byas na 'grigs 'thus zhes pa'i gtam des/mi lo 20 ring rtsa ba nas 'brel ba chad pa'i bod rgya'i dbar 'brel mthud byung ba dang sbrags/ dus yun gang 'tshams ring zhi 'grig gi las rim zhig 'go tshugs mod/ phyogs gnyis kyi bsam tshul rgyang khyad che bas/ zhi 'grig las rim der 'bras bu gang yang byung mi 'dugader brten/ phyi lo 1987 zla 4 nang / btsan byol bod gzhung gi mtho rim mi sna'i tshogs chen zhig 'tshogs te/ 'das zin pa'i lo ngo 30 ring gi bod rang btsan las 'gul la phyogs yongs nas phyogs bsdoms dang / slad bod don las 'gul gyi srid jus gtan 'bebs shig gnang 'dug lo de'i zla 962

sku che'i smad kyai cha/tshes 21 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog gis bod rgya zhi 'grigs kyi grol mol yong thabs su/ rgyal spyi bden pa'i rgyab skyor skul slong ched/ a rir zhi bde'i gros 'char don tshan lnga gsal bsgrags bskyangs 'dug59zhi bde'i gros 'char lnga ni don dngos su bod don rgyal spyi'i thog bskyal ba zhig yin pas/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod kyi gnad don ni rgya nag nang khul gyi gnad don zhig yin pas/ de la phyi log gi rgyal khab sus kyang the jus mi chog pa shod pa'i skad cha la ber rgyug tsha nan zhig bzhus pa red/ der brten/rgya nag gzhung gis bod nang srid jus dam bsgrags dang / 7gong sa mchog gis a rir spel ba'i zhi bde'i gros 'char don tshan lnga la ngo rgol bya dgos pa'i skul slong khyab bsgrags shugs chen byas rkyen/ bod mi tshos rgya nag gzhung gi srid jus ma bzod pas/ phyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 27 nyin/ bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar zhi ba'i sger langs byung 'dug60 rgya nag gzhung gis 7gong sa mchog gis a rir spel ba'i zhi bde'i gros 'char lnga la bcangs pa'i zhe 'khon yod tshad/ phyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 27nyin/ lha sar byung ba'i zhi ba'i sger langs la g.yogs te/ lha sa'i zhi ba'i sger langs ni 7gong sa mchog gi ngan skul byas pa zhig yin pas/ de'i 'gan yongs rdzogs 7gong sa mchog gis bsnams dgos pa'i rgol gtam spel 'dugargya nag 'a thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blon chen yan ming phos/phyi lo 1987 zla 10 tshes 17 nyin/ bod gzhung la phul ba'i tshig tho'i snang /lha sar byung ba'i kha bral ring lugs pa nyung shas kyis spel ba'i zing cha de ni/ la'i ru tshogs kyis ngan skul dang jus 'god byas pa'i tshabs che'i chab srid 59bod du la ga bstar byas pa 'i 6 dmar gyi srid jus dang bya thabs/'os178nang bod gzhung gi dril/phyi lo naXnalor/phyo phyi lo 1987zla 1 tshes 17nyin/bod gzhung ngu nas 'thab phyogs gcig 'gyur khang gi blon chen yan ming phyi'i tshig thor bstsal ba'i bka' lan/63

7paṇa chen ber te ni zhing 'jugakyi don rkyen zhig red/ de'i dmigs yul ni mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur gtor bshig dang / bod kyi brtan snying mthun sgril gyi rnam/ pa gtor bshig btang nas/tā las phyi rgyal du mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i nag nyes gyi bya spyod la gzhogs 'degs bya rgyu de red/lha sa'i zing cha ni tā la'i bla ma chab srid kyi btsan byol ba zhig yin pa'i thog nas mes rgyal kha bral gyi las 'gul spel ba'i 'bras bu zhig red/der brten/ da res kyi don rkyen de'i 'gan yongs rdzogs tā la'i ru tshogs dang kha bral ring lugs pa nyung shas de tshor yod/61ces bshad de/ lha sa'i sger langs kyi byed gte gtso bo dang / nyes don nyes can tshor khrims lugs ltar nyes chad gcog rgyu yin pa bshad de/ bod mi 9 la me mda' brgyabs nas bsad pa dang /ches mang po zhig dus yun ring por btson 'dzug dang rdung rdeg dam drag byas 'dug7gong sa mchog gis ribod nang gi gnas tshul ha cang gi dza drag can du 'gyur ba'i gnas tshul dngos la dgongs nas/ phyi lo 1987 zla 10 tshes 3nyin/ rgyal spyi 'gro ba mi'i thob thang gi sgrig 'dzugs yongs rdzogs kyis/ bod mi'i bden don gyi zhi ba'i 'thab rtsod la rgyab skyor gnang ste/ rgya nag gzhung gis nye sa med kyi bod mi dmar gsod btang ba'i bya spyod mtshams 'jog byed dgos pa dang / 'dzin bzung byas pa'i bod mi rnams grod bkrol gtong dgos pa'i 'bod skul gsal bsgrags gnang 'dug6 2rgya nag gzhung gis 7gong sa mchog gis bod don rgyal spyi can du bskyal ba dang / bod mi mang gi lha sar zhi ba'i sger langs byas pa'i kha gtad 7paṇa 51phyi lo1987bla 10tshes 17nyen/rgya nag 'thab phyogs gcig byur las khungs kyi blonachen yan ming chus bod gzhung la la sul ba'i tshig tho/snyonabaden don gas la ba'i sgron me/sog 5༷nang /lha phrug gi brtsams/bde srung las sungs kyi dpar ci na byas/phyi lo naX4lo ra/64

kyi tshe'i smad kyi cha/chen rin po che gcog bcug nas/ khong nyid 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las kur bed spyod gtong rgyu'i sems ngan bcangs te/ phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 11nyin/ phyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 27 dang / zla 10 tshes 1 nyin gyi lha sa'i don rkyen rtog zhib dang thag gcod byed par mngags 'dug7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog ni/ bod brgyud nang bstan pa'i bla chen ang gnyis pa dang / bod dang rgyal spyi'i khrod mtshan snyan dang shugs rkyen chen po yod pas na/ 7gong sa mchog dang bod rang btsan rtsod len pa tshor kha gtad gcog rgyur gzhan gyis tshab byed thabs med pa'i khyad chos yod/gal srid 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod nang zhi bde dang / chos dad rang dbang yod pa gsungs tshe/ rgyal spyi'i steng 7gong sa mchog gis zhi bde'i gros 'char dang / bod mi'i sger langs kyi 'bod sgra'i dgongs don/ dngos bden min pa'i gnas su chags nges pa'i nus pa yod/ der brten/ rgya nag gzhung gis dus nam yang 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ 7gong sa mchog la rgol gtam gtong ba'i re ba bcangs kyi yod la/ las don de bsgrub pa'i don du 7paṇa chen rin po cher dmigs bsal gyi mthun rkyen yang sbyar yod/phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 11 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po che lha sar zhabs sor 'khod pa dang / lha sa khul gyi dge 'dun pa'i tshogs 'du bskongs te/dge 'dun pa tshos bskyar du ngo rgol skad 'bod gnang tshe/ bod de 'dzam gling dang 'brel ba gang yang byed sa med par sgo brgyab nas lhag nyen yod pa'i nyen brda gnang zhing / nyen rtogs pas mi mang la me mda' brgyabs pa der/me mda' gnam la brgyab nas mde'u rkang par phog pa red ces gsung zhing /lha sa'i smon lam chen mo 'tshog rgyur dus skabs snying 'jags yin tshul rgya nag 65

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'dugagazhung la snyan seng zhus/63gsar lam khag tu rgya nag dbus 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blon chen yan ming sprus/ phyi lo 1987 zla 10 tshes 17 nyin/ btsan byol bod gzhung la phul ba'i tshig tho dang / rgyal spyi'i gsar lam khag tu bsgrags pa'i rgya nag dbus gzhung gi gcig gyur gyi skad cha de gsal bsgrags gnang 'dugagasar bsgrags kyi nang don ni gsham gsal ltar red/bod ljongs kyi lha sa nas gsar brje ngo log pas 'phung dkrug bslangs/'di ni phyi rgyal kha bral ring lugs pas jus 'god dang / ngan slong / ngan skul gyi cha rkyen 'og byung ba red/ don rkyen gyi ngo bo ni mes rgyal kha bral du gtong rgyu de yin la/ de'i mtha' 'bras ni bod mi rigs dang / bod mi dmangs kyi khe phan brlags pa dang / bod ljongs mi dmangs 'dus pa'i rgyal yongs mi rigs so so'i mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i khe phan la rgyab 'gal byas pa zhig yin pa the tshom spu tsam yang med ces gsungs/7paṇa chen rin po ches gsung bshad dang / blon chen yan ming cis/btsan byol bod gzhung la 'bul ba'i tshig tho'i skad cha dbar mi 'dra sa gcig yod pani/ blon chen yan ming spus/ tā la'i ru tshogs kyi ngan skul zhes bkod yod pa dang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi tā la'i ru tshogs kyi ngan skul zhes/7gong sa mchog la thad kur mtshan smad zhu ba'i brjod tshig bskyur nas/ de'i tshab tu kha bral ring lugs pa zhes gsung 'dug kha bral ring lugs pa ni bod rang btsan nam rgya nag gzhung kha bral 'dod kyi bsam 'dun dang bya spyod spel mkhan la go dgos/snyo se ṭor she 0wel/ci ga pa7mi dzi//66

skya tshe'i mi da kyi cha/da dung 7paṇa chen rin po ches yan ming phos ma gsung pa'i bka' slob cig gsung yod pa ni/ don rkyen 'di rigs rkyerno med khor rkyang ga la yin/ngas bltas na bud shing med par/ rlung 'bud me sbar byas kyang me 'bar mi srid/der nges par du 'bar bya'i dngos po thos 'tshams zhig yod pa na/ da gzod 'bar ba yin/ dpe 'dis nga tsho'i bya ba'i khrod du'ang mi 'dang sa yod pa mtshon pa yin zhes gsungs pa de red/phyogs gzhan zhig nas phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 26 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches gtso skyong gnang ba'i krung dbyang las don tshogs chung dang / ljongs tang ud kyi drung che hu'u cin has gtsos/ tang srid dmag gi 'go khrid/ gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mi gsum re dang / da dung dgon sde gzhan gyi 'thus mi bcas bzhugs pa'i tshogs 'du bskongs/rgya nag gzhung gis ngos nas phyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 27 nyin/lha sar byung ba'i bod mi'i sger langs de/ 7gong sa mchog gis ngan skul byas pa'i rgol gtam yig cha bod gzhung la phul zin pas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis kyang / bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar byung ba'i bod mi'i sger langs de/7gong sa mchog gis ngan bskul gnang ba zhig yin pa'i rgol gtam dang / bod mi zhi rgol ba tshor bka' bkyon/ drag chas nyen rtogs pas drag gnon byas par gdeng 'jog bya rgyu'i re ba dang bcas mngags pa zhig yin pas de ltar gnang dgos mod/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis rgya nag gzhung gi re ba dang blangs bya las ldog ste/ phyi lo 1887 zla 9 tshes 27 nyin/ bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar bod mi chos rang btsan skad 'bod kyi 'os langs byung ba de'i nyer len rgya nag 67

7paṇa chen zhir te ni zhib 'duni gzhung la yod/64 de ni g.yon phyogs shog khag gi lta grub kyis bzos pa dang /'o1 mang ring gsog sbas kyi srid jus lag bstar byas pa'i ngan 'bras shig red/rgya nag gzhung gis bod de dbu 'phongs kyi sa khul zhig tu bskrun pas zing 'khrug de byung ba red/65 de'i 'gan tshang ma rgya gzhung la yod pa las bod mi tshor le 'da' med/66bod nang dus bde zhi 'jags med par/ bod mi rnams 'dod pa mi khengs pa'i gnas su lhung ba'i le 'da' de/ rgya nag gzhung gi drag gnon gyi srid jus la yod pa las/ bod mi rigs la le 'da' byed rgyu gang yang med/67pa dang / bod skad la do snang dang shes rtogs med mkha/ na rgya nag gsar 'god pas/ gang byung du dbyen dkrug byas pa las byung ba zhig yin pa gsungs/da dung khong gis zhi ba'i sgor langs de'i khrod bod mi zhi rgol ba grangs dgu la/ drag chas nyen rtogs pa dang dmag mis me mda' brgyabs te dmar gsod btang yod kyang / kho pa tshos bod mi gcig kyang bsad med pa'i skad cha de bden pa min pa'i gsal bshad gnang ba dang sbrags/68 bod mi tshos zhi ba'i sger langs byas pa de nor ba zhig yin mod/ de bas kyang rgya gzhung gi drag chas nyen rtogs pas/ bod mi zhi ba'i sger langs pa tshor me mda' gang byung du brgyabs pa de nor tshabs che/ der brten/ bod mi zhi rgol ba rnams la rgya nag gi srid jus 547paca chen rin po ches rgyanag gzhung la kha rdung btang ba/pe cingakakhe te ren sems san/08 /kyisang 00ci'i 5950ba55ma go 'joms dan sa pa 'i lha casa'i gnas tshul/yi ga mang /du8smi44288se ṭor she wa spel bya 57155 tshigang//567paṇa chen rin ngo ches rgya nag gzhung la kha rdung btang ba/pe cing /khe te ren se mas san/dzum smo01 1725ma 1950ba577pa ca chen ren po che/rnam pa gzhis can gyi bod kyi chos kyi dbu khrid/yig mang /ka 3034sa8968yig ang /6874788se myor ṭi wa wel/8 737༄57561/68

kyi tshe'i mi da kyai cha/bzhin slob gso gtong ba las/ btson 'jug dang mnar ga cod gtong mi rung /69da lta 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas pa'i chab srid btson pa rnams glod grol gtong dgos gsung ste/ zhi ba'i 'os langs nang bzhugs mkhan chab srid btson pa 58 btson bkrol gnang /707paṇa chen ri na po ches tshogs thog nas srid jus don 'khyol zhes/dga' ldan dgon pa'i dpe cha dang / gser thang sogs phyir slog dang / gar song rtsa med du gyur pa'i sku gsung thugs rten gyi blu yon gyi rin gong phab nas dga' ldan la sgor 950000/00 dang / se rar 788000/00 'bras spungs la 776000/00 gnang ba ma zad/ rgyal khab rig dngos do dam las khungs khag nang yod pa'i dgon sde'i bca' dngos tshang ma dgon pa so sor phyir sprod dgos pa'i bka' rgya gnang /bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi rdo rje tshe ring gis/ dgon sde khag la srid jus don 'khyol byed pa'i yig cha khyab bsgrags byed skabs/ 'bras spungs dgon gyi dge 'dun pa ye shes chos 'phel gyis/lo rgyus thog bod rang btsan yin pas/ bod ra nga btsan gyi skad 'bod byed mkhan tshor nyes pa med pas/ kho tsho lam seng glod 'grol dgos skor tshogs thog nas skad 'bod byas/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi drung che hu cin has sku zhabs ye shes chos 'phel 'dzin bzung byed pa'i bka' rgya gtong skabs/7paṇa chen rin po ches ye shes chos 'phel la dgag pa rgyag pa'i gtam bshad gsung rjes/ de ring khyed kyis tshogs 'du'i thog bsam 'char bshad par brten/ ngas nyes med gu yangs byas te 'dzin bzung byed kyi min/ slad phyin mu mthud zhi a kya rin po ches/e shi ya rang dbang rlung 'phrin khang gi gtam gleng zhal pa ra thog gsungs/ 'chab srid btson zur 'jam dpal smo na lam kyi mi tshe'i lo rgyus nang gsal /69

7paṇa chena'ar te gi zhib 'jugabya spyod 'di 'dra spel na nges par du khrims gcod nan po byed kyi yin pa gsungs/7paṇa chen bcu pa'i thugs rje'i bka' drin las sku zhabs ye shes chos 'phel 'dzin bzung khrims gcod gang yang phog med kyang / phyi lo 1989zla 1 tshes 27 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po che zhing la phebs rjes/ zla 3 tshes 8nyin sku zhabs ye shes chos 'phel 'bras spungs dgon pa nas 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byas 'dug phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 24 nyin/ bod rang btsan 'thab rtsod kyi sne khrid pa 'jam dpal smon lam 71sogs/ chab srid btson pa 597paṇa chen bcu pa'i sku drin nyag gcig las grod grol thob/ da dung dga' ldan dgon pa'i sprul sku g.yu lo zla ba tshe ring gtsos/ ser smad phyag mdzod thub bstan tshe ring dang bcas pa'i chab srid btson pa 9 lhag yod pa rnams/ring min glod 'grol gnang rgyu yin pa bkra shis lhun po'i 'dus tshogs steng /7paṇa chen bcu pa sku ngo ma'i zhal sgo las khyab bsgrags gnang 'dug7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bka' mol de dag ni rgya nag 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blon chen yan ming bas/ phyi lo 1987 zla 10 tshes 17nyin/ btsan byol bod gzhung la phul bsgru tshig tho dang 'gal ba ltag sprod red la/7gong sa mchog gis bod nang byung ba'i lha sa'i sger langs ni rgya mis bod nang dam drag gi srid jus lag len bstar ba'i ngan 'bras red ces gsungs pa'i bka' slob la rgyag gcig mchong gi mjug ston rgyab skyor zhig chags yod/rgya gzhung gis bod kyi zhi ba'i sger langs yod tshad/ lam seng drag gnon dang dmag don bka' rgya gtong 'dod yod kyang / 7paṇa chen bcu 71da lta bod kyi 'gro ba mi'i thob thang dang mang gtso 'phe la rgyas khang gi 'gan 'dzin gzhon pa /70

skya ma'i min kyi cha/pa mchog gis/ drag gnon dang dmag don bka' rgya bdams rgyur ngo rgol gyi tha tshig bsgrags shing / chab srid btson pa rnams grod bkrol btang dang / rgya nag gzhung gis bod thog 'dzin pa'i srid jus la gnad don yod pa/ khong dang 7gong sa mchog gi dbar 'gal zla gang yang med pa/ bod nang gi 'os langs kyi 'gan yongs rdzogs rgya gzhung la yod pa'i bka' mol de dag la/rgya nag gzhung bsam gzhigs dang / dogs slong / zhib 'jug mi bya ka med byung yod/ skad cha gsal po bshad na/ 7paṇa chen bcu pas rgya nag gzhung gi sa nas mi rigs dang chos lugs rang dbang gi khe bzang len mkhan thub pa las/rgya nag gzhung la 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i sa nas rag dgos pa'i khe bzang ste/ 7gong sa mchog la skyon brjod dang / rgol gtam gtong ba'i khe bzang de rag gi med/de snga pe cing du slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan gnang myong zhing / da lta o si kri li yar skyabs bcol du bzhugs pa'i yon hu'u phing gis/ rgya nag gi srid 'dzin zur pa hu'u ya'o h+phang gi dbang cha shor rjes/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod la dbang sgyur byed pa'i 'thab rtsod dam du btang yod/ 'thab rtsod de'i khrod 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la skyon brjod bya dgos pa'i bka' btang ste/bod mi'i 'du shes kha bral du gtong rgyu'i re ngan bcangs mod/ 7paṇa chen mchog gis/ rgya nag gzhung gis re 'dun khas len lta ci/ 7gong sa mchog bod du phyir phebs gnang rgyur thugs re dang dga' bsu'i rnam 'gyur bstan cing / bod don thag gcod legs po bya dgos pa gsungs/der brten/ rgya nag gzhung gi bsam par/ gal srid bod rang dbang gi las 'gul 'di/ 7gong sa mchog dang 7paṇa chen rin po che'i nus pa mnyam rub kyi las 'gul zhig tu gyur tshe/ dbang cha gcig sdud byed pa'i rgya nag gzhung gi 'gegs su 'gyur stabs/ rgya nag gzhung gi dpon rigs tshos phyi lo 198871

7paṇa chen ser te gi zhib 'jugadabyar mjug nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa lkog bkrongs bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi gting 'dug pa gsungs/72skad cha de ni skabs de'i gnas tshul la mtshan rig dang mthun pa'i chod sdom zhig tu mthong gi 'dug7paṇa chen rin po ches phyi phyogs su rgya mi'i spu ded phyogs gsar lam khag tu/ me mda' gnam la brgyab ste/ mde'u rkang par phog pa red/dge 'dun pa tshos bskyar du ngo rgol skad 'bod byas tshe/ bod de 'dzam gling dang 'brel ba gang yang byed sa med par sgo brgyab nas lhag nyen pa'i bka' bkyon gnang ba der/ bod mi 'gas rgyal khab dang dad sems btsongs shing /bod kyi bde sdug la mi blta bar pe cing gzhung dang grogs sgrig byed mkhan de 'dra zhig 7paṇa chen yin mi srid pa smras shing /73 3 lo 1988 nas lha sa khul gyi bod mi 'gas/ tshong pa rgyags pa dang / rgya bla ma zhes pa'i mtshan smad dang skur 'debs zhu ba'i tsha rlabs shig phyur 'dugaphyi lo 1988 zla 1 nang 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog da dung lha sar bzhugs yod cing / lha sa'i smon lam tshogs par zla ba gnyis las med/7paṇa chen rin po ches lha sa'i smon lam chen mo 'tshog rgyur dus skabs snying 'jags yin tshul rgya nag gzhung la zhus par brten/ se 'bras dga' gsum gyi dge 'dun pa rnams smon lam 'tshogs par 'gro rgyu min pa'i gleng phyogs dgon pa'i spang lam nas lha sa ru bzhir khyab/7paṇa chen rin po ches dge 'dun pa rnams la go bskon blo 'gugs kyis/ smon lam 'tshogs par bcar dgos pa'i slob gso gnang skabs/ lha sa'i 720〈khu 'i ——rku ci 227 ba 98—202 lko na44/ k+ṣa ces / 30 ro 7 mgo 'joms dgo rme rngu 'i lha sa'i gnas tshul/yig mang duḥkhu74288se myor she wa spel / 5 5mtsho775༷//72

sku che'i mi da kyi cha/khrom lam gyi rgas 'khogs 'gas/ tshong pa rgyags pas smon lam 'tshog par shog zer na/ khyod tsho rtsa ba nas 'gro rgyu med pa'i ngan skul byas/ mu cor de yang hol rgyug gi dge 'dun pa 'gar/ me 'bar ba'i sgang la shing shag pa'i dpe ru song ste/sdom pa shor ba'i sprul sku (7paṇa chen rin po che//smon lam tshogs ring / gtsug lag khang nang du 'gro mi chog pa'i than skad bsgrags/don dngos su 7paṇa chen bcu pas/ phyi lo 1987 lo'i lha sa'i zhi ba'i sger langs thag gcod de drangs phyogs su gnang ba des/ bod mi rnams la sngar med kyi blo stobs dang ngar shugs sprad stabs/ phyi lo 1988 lo'i sger langs bya rgyur skul ma thebs 'dug 'jam dpal smon lam lags kyis/ nga tsho glod grol btang skor khyab bsgrags byas rjes btson khang gi phyi sgo nas 'don dus/ dgon pa'i dmangs gtso bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang gi 'go 'dzin/ dgon pa'i rlangs 'khor 'khrid nas sgo 'gram du nga tsho bsu bar 'byor 'dugarlangs 'khor nang 'dzul te dgon par shar bskyod byas/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la nga tsho dgon pa'i nye 'gram du 'byor skabs/ grwa pa dang mi skya mang po zhig nas lag tu dkar gtsang kha btags 'khyer te sgug nas bsdad 'dugadagon pa'i rdo gcal du 'byor te rlangs 'khor las babs ma thagaphebs sgug byed mi rnams kyis sems gso'i 'tshams 'dri zhu ba dang / khag cig gis bsang gsol byas song / tshang ma'i ngo gdong nas 'dzum mdangs rgyas bzhin/nga tshor dgon pa'i rdo gcal du yod pa'i dgon pa'i za khang du/ gsol ja dang bzhes mog 'degs 'bul zhus pa dang / mi re re bzhin dkar gtsang mjal dar g.yogs nas/ nga tsho'i sker kha btags kyis khengs bzhin sdod shag khag tu phyir log byas gsungs/73

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 6'jugaphyi lo 1987 lor/ bod rang btsan sger langs kyi sne khrid pa rnams/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi thugs rje'i bka' drin nyag gcig las btson grol thob pa ma zad/ dgon pa'i dmangs gtso bdag gnyer khang gi kru'u ren gyis/ rlangs 'khor 'khrid nas phebs bsur bcar ba dang /bod mi mang dang chos grogs dge 'dun pas gzengs bstod kyi mjal dar khyer nas phebs sgug zhus pa'i ngang tshul las/ chab srid btson pa rnams ni dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal ba lta bu'i gzi brjid kyi bag chags shig bod mi mang gi sems ngogs su sbyin stabs/ slar yang phyi lo 1988 zla 3 tshes 5 nyin gyi zhi ba'i sger langs bya rgyu'i blo stobs sbyin 'dugargya nag gzhung gis phyi lo 1988 zla 3 tshes 5 nyin gyi lha sa'i zhi rgol de'i byung rkyen ni/ phyi lo 1987 lo'i sger langs skabs/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis thag gcod yag po ma byung ba'i ngos 'dzin dang sbrags/krung dbyang hru'u ci khru'i rgyun las u yon dang srid khrims u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'dzin ja'o hri rtog zhib byed par mngags 'dugaphyi lo 1988 zla 6 tshes 9 nyin/ krung dbyang hru'u ci khru'i rgyun las u yon dang srid khrims u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'dzin ja'o hri/ phyi lo 1987zla 9 tshes 27 nyin/ lha sa'i zhi ba'i sger langs rtog zhib ched du bod du 'byor zhing / kho pas bod kyi dgon pa khag tu grwa rgyun gsar 'jug byed rgyu dang /chos kyi byed sgo spel rgyu/ dgon pa dang / lha khang nyams gso byed phyogs bcas la tshod 'dzin nan po byed dgos pa dang / dge 'dun par dmar po'i srid don zab khrid dgos pa/ nang chos kyis rgya nag gzhung gi chab srid la zhabs 'degs zhu ru 'jug dgos pa sogs/ bod mir drag gnon byed thabs 'ga' 74

skya tshe'i mi da kyai cha/gtan 'bebs byas pa ma zad/74phyi lo 1988 lo mjug gi rgyal yongs mi mang 'thus mi tshogs chen steng / bod la gnas skabs ring rgyab skyor byed dgos pa mi 'dug bod ha cang yar rgyas phyin 'dug bod pas rogs dngul tshang ma dgon par byugs nas/bu thams cad grwa pa bzos stabs/ bud med mang po zhig mo hreng du lhag 'dug pa bshad/75skabs der 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ gsol cog steng phyag mtshur rdeb bzhin/ da lta bod la rgyab skyor mi dgos pa'i yar rgyas ga re phyin 'dugangs bltas na da lta bod nang dngos gnas skyo po 'dug blo mthun khyed kyis sngon ma'i bod kyi rdzong khag dang / dgon sde grwa tshang khag gi rig dngos gtor skyon byung ba de dag ma shes pas red/ dper na/ bkras lhun dgon par cha mtshon na/sngon ma 7paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi sku gdung yod kyang / da lta sku gdung mchod khang gcig las mthong rgyu med/ ngas bltas na bod nang la da lta thob pa las shor ba mang pa yod/76 ces gdung rtse kha gtad 'thab rtsod gnang 'dugagong gsal gyi skyon brjod dang 'dra bar/ phyi lo 1988 lo'i skabs bdun pa'i rgyal yongs 'thus tshogs thengs dang po'i bod ljongs 'thus tshogs kyi tshogs 'du'i steng / 7paṇa chen bcu mchog gis/ bar lam dus skabs gcig la/ bod ljongs su zing 'khrug thengs kha shas byung red/ tshang ma grwa pa 'ga' shas kyis 'go khrid nas blangs pa red/ yin na'ang / lam seng mang tshogs mang po rjes su 'brang gi yod pa red/ des bshad don chos lugs ni mang tshogs nang bag chags ha cang gi chen po yod pa red/ der brten/ nga tshos nges par du chos lugs kyi 74bod du la ga bstar byas pa'i chu dam ra gyi srid jus dang bya thabs/thog ngos 7༷nang /phyi dril la sa khungs par/ gyi lo zhaXlo ra/75bod du la ga bsnar byas pa'i chu dmar gyi srid jus dang bya thabs/shog ngos 7༷nang /phyi dril las khungs pa ra/ phyi lo naX lo ra/75bkras phunadang zla ba bsam grub kyi tshig tho/bod kyi 'gro ba mi'i thob thang dang mang gtso 'phelargyas lte gnas khang /75

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugalas ka yag po byed dgos/ grwa pa dung rdeg tsha nan dang dgon pa gtor dgos pa'i bshad stangs de tsho'i skor la/ ngas 'di ru tha tshig ma bton rang bton la/nga tsho slar yang sngon gyi nor 'khrul shor ba'i 'dam dong nang du rtsa ba nas lhung mi rung / zhes gsungs /'on kyang / phyi lo 1989 zla zha nang thon pa'i nang rgya nag gung khran tang nang khul gyi gsang ba'i snyan zhu zhes pa zhig bton pa'i nang / skabs de'i bod rang skyong ljongs dmar shog tshogs pa'i drung che hu'u cin tha'os/ bod kyi spyi tshogs nang chos lugs dang / chos lugs mi sna'i gnas bab mtho drags par brten nges par du bod kyi las don thag gcod yag po zhig byed dgos/thog mar chogs lugs kyi shugs rkyen chung du gtong ba dang / chos lugs mi sna'i gnas bab dma' ru gtong dgos zhes bkod yod/77nga tshos hu'u cin tha'o yi bshad pa skad de dang / phyi lo 1988 lor/7paṇa chen rin po ches skabs bdun pa'i rgyal yongs thengs dang po'i bod ljongs 'thus tshogs su bstsal ba'i bka' slob gnyis rbad de 'gal ba ltag sprod du gyur yod pa de las/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang rgya nag gzhung dbar gyi 'gal zla'i rno ngar de tshad ji tsam slebs yod pa mthong thub/mdor na/ rgya nag gzhung gi ngos nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog ni/7gong sa mchog dang kha bral ring lugs kyi phyi dgra srung ba'i 'dogs khyi lta bu zhig tu re nas gces nyar dang bdag po brgyabs mod/ da cha 'dogs khyi des phyi dgra dang mnyam bsdebs kyis sbyin bdag la rgol mkhan zhig du 'gyur ba mthong sa yid ches rtsa ba nas brlags yod la/ mu mthud gso nyar byas tshe 77rgya nag ge mi rigs sa gnas rang sbyo nga gi khrims srol cadang bod kyi dngos yod gnas sta ngas smor bgro gleng /thogan17nang /phyi dril las lungs/pyi lo naX5'o ra/76

skya che'i mi da kyi cha/sbyin bdag la nyen kha sprod mkhan zhig tu gyur bzhin pa'i sems 'tshab byung yod pa ni bshad ma dgos pa zhig red/da lta 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku rkyen de/ lo rgyus kyi gab tshig cig yin mod/ sku gshegs kha'i 'khrug cha dod pa'i gnas tshul de dag la brten nas/ rgya nag gzhung gis sku bkrongs pa'i dogs gzhi byed mkhan yang ji snyed cig 'dug la/ mang po zhig gis sku bkrongs pa'i kha tshon yang gcod kyi 'dugadaper na/ sku zhabs yon hu'u phing gis/ rgya nag gzhung gi dpon rigs tshos phyi lo 1988 dbyar mjug nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa lkog bkrongs bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi gting 'dug pa gsung 'dug la/78 rgya rigs rtsom pa po wang li zhung gis/phyi lo 1987 dang 1982 so sor/ lha sa'i zhi ba'i sgor langs la/ rgya nag gzhung gis lam seng dmag don bka' rgya gtong 'dod yod kyang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis dmag don bka' rgya bdams rgyur ngo rgol gyi tha tshig bsgrags shing /chab srid btson pa rnams glod grol btang ba dang /rgyal spyi dang rgyal nang gang du 'tshams gzigs su chibs kha bsgyur kyang / rgya nag gzhung gi bsam blo'i nang gung rgol gyi gte po btsan rgyal a ri dang gos thung gcig nang rkang pa brgyus shing / nub phyogs dgra dbye'i stobs shugs dang lhan du krung gor rgol mkhan du mthong ba'i 7gong sa mchog sku tshe brtan zhing / mgyogs myur bod la phebs thub pa dang / khong gi bzhed don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i thugs smon khrom bsgrags gnang ba'i 'bod sgra de tsho/ gung khran tang gi brang snying la lcags mda' 'phen pa ltar gyi zur gzer sbyin yang /slar yang 'dzin bzung btson 'jug byed stangs ma shes shing / thad kur nag nyes ba ngas kyang ma shes/ mdor na/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gung 180〈khu khri sna'i yo 〈co 3 ma/blo brgya 98—202 lo r+sā4lko chulha'i 20 ro 77

7paṇa chen mar te ni zhing 'jugakhran tang gi khrims thog tu glags ma khel pas gsol dug phul ba yin yang srid/79ces gsungs/yang rgya rigs rtsom pa po lis yis/ 7paṇa chen gro bur dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gsang ba der gleng brjod ha cang mang zhes pa'i rtsom yig nang /7paṇa chen rin po che la rgyus mnga' yod pa'i mi drag cig gis bshad don/lo shas ring rgya nag gzhung gis bod la 'dzin pa'i byed stangs yod tshad dang /khong la 'thab phyogs gcig sgril gyi lag char gang byung du bed spyod btang ba der/thugs gting nas mi dga' yang phyi rol yul gyi rgyu rkyen dbang gis yus dus 'ga' zhig tu rang nyid kyi thugs dgongs dang 'gal ba'i tshig kha shas gsung myong /yin na'ang / 7paṇa chen rin po che'i ngos nas rgya nag gzhung la dus nam yang thugs mos gnang gi med/ lhag par du nye ba'i lo shas ring bod kyi ser skya pho mo mang pos rgya nag gzhung la ngo rgol rab dang rim pa byung bar/ rgya nag gzhung gis khrag dri bro ba'i drag gnon byas pa nas bzung / 7paṇa chen rin po che rgya nag gzhung la mi dga' ba de nyin re las nyin rer shugs che ru songayod/tha na/ mngon gsal du rgya nag gzhung la skyon brjod gnang ba ma zad/skyon brjod kyi mdung rtse de thad kur rgya nag gzhung gis bod la 'dzin pa'i mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus/ las byed pa'i srid jus bcas la gtad pa red/ der brten/ rgya nag gzhung gis phyi'i rnam pa tsam las 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la brtsi 'jog dang yid ches byed khul byed pa las/ don ngo ma'i thog snga sa nas khong la gzab nan gyi sgo nas dogs zon dang so myul byed 79rtsa rigs rtsom pa po wang li zhung la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshigs tho/78

kyi che'i mi da kyai cha/bzhin yod pa gsungs/80 mi rnams kyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku bkrongs mkhan ni/ hu'u cin tha'o yin pa'i dogs gzhi byed kyi 'dug ta cang ya mtshan dgos pa zhig ni 7paṇa chen bcu pa stun gzhi bzhes par bston skabs/ khong gi gam bcar du yod pa'i skabs de'i bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che dang po hu'u cin tha'o dang /krung dbyang hru'u ci khru yi rjes snon hru'u ci wun ca pa'o gnyis/ da lta rgya nag dbus gzhung gi srid 'dzin dang srid blon gyi las gnas 'dzin bzhin yod pa de red/hu'u cin tha'o bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tang gi drung cher bsko bzhag byas pa der/ rgya nag gi mtho rim nang khul du bshad srol mi 'dra gsum 'dugadang po/ hu'u cin tha'o ni nyams myong gis phyug pa'i mi zhig yin pas/ de snga'i krung dbyang rtsa 'dzugs khang gi 'go 'dzin sung phing gis/ hu'u bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tang gi drung cher bsko rgyu'i bsam 'char phul bar bshad/gnyis pa/ de snga'i krung dbyang srid khrims u yon lhan khang gi dbu 'dzin ja'o hres/ krung dbyang la hu'u cin tha'o hu'u cin ha yi tshab/ tu bsko rgyu'i thad ga'i bsam 'char phul ba ma zad/ dngos su hu'u cin tha'os rang 'gul gyis/ bod kyi dus zing 'joms mkhan du khas blangs pa bshad/gsum pa/ krung dbyang gis hu'u cin tha 'o tshud pa'i krung go'i 'jon thang can gyi mi bcu bdams te/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung cher su 'os ba bas cin tha'os bzhed snang tsam med par bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 80bsnya na 'dzin dpal 'bar gyis deb nang /phyi lo 1989zla na pa'i krung go'i dpyid ka zhes pa 'i dus deb las bshus 'dug79

gnang nas nyi ma tshe ring la 'dra par len du bcug pa ma zad/ mi sna'i thugs gshis dang bzhugs stangs kyi mtshon bya'i don/srong btsan rigs gsum gcig bsdus yin pa nyi ma tshe ring la shes su bcug la/ sun snang med par bzhugs stangs dpe ston yang yang gnang ste khong nyid kyi dgongs bzhed nyi ma tshe ring la gsungs/)36nang bstan chos lugs zhib 'jug(de ni bod kyi chos lugs dang / rig gnas/lo rgyus bcas brgyud rim ldan pa'i sgo nas legs bsgrig dang / phyag dpe bka' rtsom gnang rgyu de yin/ de ya nga khong gis/ rtsa khrims kyi gtan 'bebs ltar na/ mi dmangs 'thus tshogs rgyun ud kyi u yon krang gzhon pa skabs gnyis las byed mi chog pas/ skabs rdzogs pa'i dus su ngas nges par du phyir 'then bya rgyu yin/ de'i dus su ngas ched mngags chos lugs las don la zhib 'jug bya rgyu yin/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang /9ga nye ma tshe ring gi 7paṇa chen bcu pa rjes dran rtsom mi ga dus dang gnas kyi bkod pa la sa brgal ba'i zhal gdams/) krung go'i pod smongs/91

7paṇa chen nar te ji zhib chogazhug7paṇa chen sku phreng gong ma tshang mas gsung rtsom shul bzhag gnang yod/ngos kyis kyang mi rigs kyi rig gnas ched du legs skyes nges can zhig 'bul rgyu yin gsungs/)37rgyu'i mdzad 'char tshang ma 7paṇa chen rin po che'i gzhung don las sgrub khang / gzhis rtse bde chen skal bzang pho brang gi gzim chung bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling gi gsol cog steng lus 'dugamador na/ gsol cog steng lus pa'i mdzad 'char de dag tshang ma bod kyi las don thad don snying dang rin thang chen po yod pa zhe ci ga yin ste/chos lugs kyi gnad don thog nas bshad na/ bod kyi bla sprul gyi yang srid ngos 'dzin bya rgyu de lam lugs can dang / tshad ldan can/ sgrig gzhi can du sgrub thabs bya rgyu'i thad dgongs pa zab mo bzhes yod pa/ra brten/ gnad don de tsho thag gcod zin rjes/ ma 'ongs par dus bab la 'gyur ldog ci zhig byung yang /sprul sku'i yang srid ngos 'dzin bya rgyu de chab srid kyi lag char bed spyod mi thub par gyur nges yin pa dang / de bzhin grwa rgyun gsar 'dzugs dang / nang chos slob gnyer lam lugs srol rgyun dad pa'i 'du shes dor nas/ rig pas brdar sha gcod rgyu'i 'du shes gsar pa gsar 'dzugs byas te/ bod rgyud nang bstan pa'i chos lugs kyi ngo bo ngo ma bsngog 'don gnang rgyu'i don snying ldan la/de bzhin bod kyi rig gnas dang / slob gso/ skad yig bcas dus rabs dang mthun pa'i thog nas gong 'phel gtong rgyu'i thad/ de bas kyang gzigs rgyang ring ba'i 'char gzhi de tsho don snying ldan pa zhe cig red/ dper na/slob tshan tshang ma bod kyi skad yig thog nas slob khrid byed pa'i slob grwa chen mo gsar 'dzugs byas te/ chung ba rlung 'phrin dang che ba tshan rig lag rtsal gyi gal che'i rnams grangs khag kyang bod kyi skad yig thog nas slob khrid bya rgyu de bo kyi lo sa thog byung myong med pa zhig yin/ /97rgya nag (rgyang lta dus deb//gsar 'god pa hru'u dges/bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrilas/〈7pa'o chen rjes dran ched deb/〉shog ngos 184nang /bod spongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /phyi lo 1989zla phyinang /92

skya tshe'i smad kyai cha/le tshan lja pa/ go gnas slar gso/mi mang po zhig gis kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po'i u yon krang gi go gnas 'di/ khong sku sger gyi khe phan ched gung khran tang la rgyal 'tshong gi sprel lad 'khrab cing / rgya nag gung khran tang gis kyang 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog chab srid kyi lag char rang gar bed spyod gtong ched/ u yon krang gi dbu gnas phul ba'i go 'dzol byung ste/ rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi dang / rgya mi'i khog rtse/tshong pa rgyags pa sogs kyi mtshan smad zhu mkhan yang byung yod/'on kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po che'i ngos nas/ gces pa'i bslab pa'i sdom pa tshun btang ste/ u yon krang gi dbu gnas bzhes pa de/ bod mi mang dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched du red 'dug phyi lo 1978 lor/ krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blo chen yang cin ran la/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/ khyed tshos nga'i las ka slar gso byos dang / ngos da lta bod mi ma/nga dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don du las ka byed dgos yod/ ces gsungs/phyi lo 1977 nang ting zha'o phing krung go gung khran tang gi chab srid gar stegs su thengs gsum pa'i ro langs brgyab pa dang / phyi lo 1978 zla 1datshes 22 nyin/ krung gung skabs 11 pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs 3steng / hwa go h+phang yongs su pham nyes btang zhing / rig gnas gsar brje dngos su mjug bsgril ba'i khyab bsgrags byas/93

7paṇa chen yer te gi zhib 'jugating zha'o phing gis dngos yod nas bden pa 'tshol dgos/ mi mang la lo mang gi snying nad 'don pa'i thob thang yod dgos/ rang nyid la skyon dang rjes lus yod pa spam brdzu byas pas phan thogs med pas/ rang skyon dang rjes lus ngos len dgos pa bshad de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang 'dra bar/lo mang btson du tshud pa'i mi drag rnams/ glod grol dang go gnas slar gso byed pa'i chab srid dus 'gyur gyi tsha rlabs shig 'phyur/ lo dgu dang zla ba brgyad ring la/ gar song cha med du gyur pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog phyi lo 1977zla 10 par 98btson grol thob mod/ go gnas slar gso bya rgyu lta ci/ khong la g.yogs pa'i ngo rgol gsum(gung khran tang la ngo rgol/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la ngo rgol/mi dmangs la ngo rgol/)gyi zha nag de yang phud med/pe cing me 'khor 'bab tshugs rnying pa'i nye 'gram/99shar phyogs spyi khyab tsung tung pu'i sgo rtags ang 7 pa'i nang / de snga go min tang gi mi drag bsdad myong ba'i shing khang thog gcig ma zhig na/100 sku srung tsam med par pe cing gi mi ser dkyus ma'i 'tsho ba skyel bzhin bzhugs pa'i 1017paṇa chen rin po ches/nyin ltar zhogs pa snga po nas bzhengs te zhal 'don grub rjes/ lo mang btson 'jug gis gog pa'i sku lus gso phyir/ pe cing rlangs 'khor 'bab zhesags nas khrang an lam chen brgyud/ gnam bde sgo mo che'i thang chen bar/sku dpung g.yug ste gom zheng chen pos mi tshogs kyi dkyil du rgyug shar grod pa dang /gnam bde sgo mo che'i thang chen du lus sbyong rtsed bzhin pa'i mang tshogs 98gyi yu la du rang dbang zhes pa 'i nang /phyi lo 197 bla natshes 25nyin lapa ṇa chen ren po che btson nas zod grol btang ba'i gnas tshul gsana'adug la/btsan byol zad gzhung gi yig cha khag nang phyi lo 1978zla nang mi lo 14bcon bcus byas pa'i 7pa ṇa chen rinapo che grod grol thob/99snyag lha phun tshogs bkra shis kyis che'i lo rgyus /deb gsum pa /zhog ngos/11༷nang /bod kyi dpe mdzod lang /pyi lo 1 995lo/1༷༷kerte ren po cher bca' 'dre zhus pa'i ches tho/phyi lo zhaX7zla 11tshes na1zhin/smoX1stag snye phun tshogs bkra shis kyi mi che'i lo rgyus/deb gsum pa/shog ngos/149nang /bod kyi dpe mdzod khang /phyi lo 1995lor/94

skya che'i smad kyai cha/ dang mnyam du lus sbyong gnang / zhogs pa'i ljags smin grub rjes dpe gzigs gnang zhing / dpe klog gis sku thang ngal skabs khrom gzhung du spro 'chams gnang zhor tshal khrom las nyin re'i gsol tshigs kyi sngo tshal gzigs kyi yod/pe cing grong khyer gyi mi ser dkyus ma'i 'tsho bas/ mgon po tshe brtan la lus dal sems lhod kyi snang ba zhig sbyin mod/ khong ni 7paṇa chen rin po che yin pas/ lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs 'gan bzhes dgos stabs/krung dbyang la zhu dgos pa'i dgongs 'char ha cang mang po yod/ don gyi dog kha tshig la sgril te zhus na/ bod mi mang dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched phyag las gnang ste/ shor zin pa'i dus tshod kha gsab gnang 'dod yod pa de red/7paṇa chen rin po ches ting zha'o phing gis dbu khrid pa'i krung dbyang gi 'go khrid gsar par thugs re chen pos/ rgyal khab mi rigs don gcod u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'dzin yang cin ran brgyud/ dbus gzhung gis khong gi las gnas slar gso yong ba'i re ba zhus shing / yang cin ran gyis ting zha'o phing gi bka' ltar/ gsang yum bzhes na las ka bkod sgrig chog pa bshad 'dug102sangs rgyas shākya thub pas gnang ba'i chos gos rnam gsum dang /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen bla kho tshang 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos stsal ba'i bslab pa'i sdom pa phyir 'bul zhus te/ rgya mo li cas gsang yum du bzhes pa las thob pa'i u yon krang sku gzhon gyi sku dbang phra mos/bod brgyud nang bstan dang / bod mi rigs/ bod kyi chab dpal rig gsum gyi me ro gso 'am/ yang na/ mkhan chen bla kho tshang 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos gnang ba'i ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sdom khrims dam srung bgyis nas/102wang le zhung la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/byi lo naX9zla tshes zhananyin 95

7paṇa chen ser te gi zhib 'jugape cing grong khyer gyi ha shang dkyus ma'i tshe mtha' skyel dgos/ gdam ka de ni mi lo 14 btson khang gi sku ngal las thar ma thag pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i sku mdun du lhags pa'i sku ngal che shos de red/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i khri thog tu bzhugs pa'i mgon po tshe brtan gyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i sku tshe tsam ma yin par/ khu gong sa ma chog chab srid skyabs bcol du phebs ring / lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs 'gan bzhes dgos pa de/ rgyal ba yab sras thugs bskyed byung rabs kyis thugs thag bcad pa zhig red/byang a ri'i srid 'dzin ken na shes/ mis dka' tshegs dang / 'gog rkyen/ nyen kha bcas la ma 'dzems par/ rang gis nges par du byed dgos pa de byed kyi yod cing / de ni 'gro ba mi'i bzang spyod red/ ces gsungs pa ltar/pe cing gi mi ser dkyus mi'i tshe mtha' 'khyol ba'i sdom ldan 7paṇa chen zhig gis/ lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs 'gan sgrub thub kyi med pas/mi lo drug brgya'i ring la gtsang mar gnas pa'i sdom khrims dang / u yon krang sku gzhon gyi dbu gnas mgo 'tshong bskyon te/ yang dar bstan pa'i me ro gsos shing /bod mi rigs kyi rnam shes skyob rgyu de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos bzang spyod dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa zhig tu dgongs te/ gsang yum bzhes rgyur gnad khag / mi 'dug ngos da lta bod mi mang dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don du las ka byed dgos yod/ ces yang cin ran la bka' lan bskyon//de'i sbo ra zheb phra gas nga yum bde chen dbang mo'i le tshan nang bris yo da/)rgya nag gzhung gis rin po cher gsang yum bzhes dgos pa 'i btsan bka' gtong ba'i dmigs yul/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches bod 96

skya che'i sma da kyai cha/mi mang la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen gcog rgyu dang / khong dpe ston du byas te bod rgya gnyen sgrig gi lam nas mi rigs mthun sgril gyi 'bod sgra bsgrags te/gung khran tang gis bod mi mang la sdug thang tshod med btang ba'i 'khon 'dzin zhi ched du dmigs pa zhig yin mod/'on kyang / bod mi mang gis de ni ban de rgyags na chang 'thung dran pa'i dpe ltar min par/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs bod kyi dge 'dun pa rnams dang / btsun ma dang bud med btsan sgrig byed bcug pa sogs/'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi bzod glags dka' ba'i sdug ngal ji snyed cig bod mi mang gis dngos myong dngos mthong yin stabs/ khong la'ang sku ngal de 'dra zhig phul bar bsam ste/ sngar bzhin bsam blo'i dbu khrid dang 'di phyi'i mgon skyabs dam par bkur stabs/ ting zha'o phing gi lkog jus 'bras med du gyur yod/phyi lo 1978 lor/ rgya nag gzhung gis g.yas phyogs la dkar 'don byed pa'i skabs/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blo chen wu'u lan h+phu'u yis/pe cing gi dmangs 'thus rgyun las dang srid gros rgyun las tshogs 'du bskongs/tshogs thog tu 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gdan 'dren zhus te/ dgongs 'char gsung ba'i blang bya bton /7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/ 'dir bzhugs lhan rgyas mang por ma nyes khag g.yogs kyis rdung rdeg dang / mnar gcod tshad med phog pa dang /tha na/ btson khang la'ang tshud yod/ nga tsho ni phyir mngon gsal dod pa'i mi sna che gras yin pas/ spyi tshogs steng snyan grags cung zad ldan pas mi rnams kyis brjed mi srid/ ma nyes khag g.yogs phog kyang yo bsrang byed pa las sla/'on kyang / g.yon gyi nor 'khrul gyis rgya che'i mang tshogs dang /97

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhing 'jugaspyir btang las byed/ de bzhin sa thag ring ba'i zhing 'brog khul du/ ma nyes khag g.yogs kyis gyod gzhi'i nor 'khrul mang dag bzos yod pas/ kho tsho mi rnams kyis brjed de ma nyes khag g.yogs dkar 'don byed pa ha cang dka'/dbus gzhung gis srid jus don 'khyol byed skabs/ nges par du thog mar rgya che'i gzhi rim mang tshogs gtso gnad du 'dzin pa las/ grags can mi sna dang dmigs bsal mi sna gtso gnad byed mi rung gsungs/da dung khong gis wu'u lan h+phu'u la phyag mdzub gtad nas gsungs don/nang sog la dpe bzhag na gtso gnad de khyed wu'u pu'u krang min par/ nges par du nang sog tu gnod 'tshe phog pa'i rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs dang /gzhi rim gyi las byed pa rnams ma nyes khrag g.yogs dag sel byed rgyu gtso gnad du 'jog dgos/gom pa gang phyir bshol byas te brjod na/ 'thab rtsod dang btson 'jug byas pa'i mi 'di dag gis g.yas phyogs pa'i gtam bshad spel yod na'ang /da lta lo 20 lhag phyin pas bsgyur bkod legs po byas yod/ dmag 'khrug gi nyes can pa tshang ma bsgyur bkod legs po byas te/ nor 'khrul gyi skad cha 'ga' shas brjod par ha las dgos don ci yang med/ de ni mi bsad pa dang me brgyab pa yang ma red/ ngos kyis bltas na phyag yangs po brkyangs te/ khong tsho tshang mar gu yangs dag sel rnam par dag pa zhig byas na legs pa gsungs/103gsung bshad grub rjes 'thus mi tshos 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bka' mol la/ bsngags brjod kyis thal mo yun ring brdabs pa dang / lkog nas dga' spro'i ngang 7paṇa chen rin po che'i blo stobs la bsngags brjod zhus shing /10 lapa'o chen sku preng bcu pa'i ma dzad rnam/shog ngos 155nang / 7paṇa chen er te ni zhabs zhu khang nas rtsoms sgris byas/phyi tsha da 09lor 98

skya tshe'i mi da kyai cha/tshogs 'du grol ba dang tshogs bcar ba tshang mas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi gam du bcar te dga' spro'i ngang phyag btang ste/ dgongs 'char la rgyab skyor dang rjes su yi rangs kyi rnam 'gyur bstan/phyi lo 1979 zla 7 tshes 2 nyin/104skabs lnga pa'i rgyal yongs chab srid gros tshogs kyi tshogs 'du gnyis pa'i steng / rgyal yongs chab srid gros tshogs 'thus mi u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'dzin gzhon pa'i dbu gnas phul ba dang /tshogs thog nas rig gsar skabs btson 'jug byas pa'i bod kyi btson pa rnams cha rkyen gang yang med pa'i sgo nas glod grol dgos pa dang / bod la chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol dgos pa'i gsung bshad tsha nan gnang ba'i bka' drin las/ bod khams hril por mi lo nyi shu'i ring bsang gsol dang /ma ṇi bgrang mi chog pa'i srid jus mun nag can la mjug byang bkod nas/ma ṇi 'don chog pa'i chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus shig 'char 'go tshugs/phyi lo 1980 zla 6 rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyis 'os sgug u yon gyi dbu gnas phul rgyu'i thag gcod byas shing / phyi lo 1980 zla 8tshes 20 skabs lnga pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus ma'i tshogs chen thengs gsum pa'i tshogs steng / slar yang rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang sku gzhon gyi dbu gnas phul/ de ni phyi lo 1964zla 10 nang / skabs gsum pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen steng nas/ srid blon kra'u e len gyis srid gzhung gi snyan sgron skabs/ phyi lo 1959zla 4 nang rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi u yon krang sku gzhon kyi go gnas phul ba gnas dbyung btang rjes/ mi lo 16 rjes su slar yang go sa ba ra ces sa pa zhig red/104btsan byol bod mi 'i rgyun ma'i la ga deb nang zla natshes da 'khod 'dug99

7paṇa chen ser te ni shing 'jug lo rabs 80 'go stod du bod khams hril por mi dmangs kung hre rtsa 'thor mthar phyin song med pas/ mi dmangs kung hre'i ngal rtsol skar mas bod mi'i 'tsho ba'i dka' sdug ha cang che yang / lo rabs 60 nang gi rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul khrod/ dmar srung dmag dang hur brtson can tshos/ log spyod 7paṇa chen rtsa med bzos/ 7paṇa chen tang rgol pham par rgyobs/ 7paṇa chen ru tshogs thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/tshozhes rnga dung dar 'phyar gyi khrod nas mi lo bcu drug ring brlags pa'i nyin zhig su yon krang sku gzhon 7paṇa chen er te ni zhes pa'i mtshan bzang de/yig ge shes mkhan tshos bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par ngos las mjal zhing /yig rmongs tshos ru khag gi rgyang bsgrags las gsan skabs/ mdog skyo la gos hrul ba'i bod mi mang gi bzhin las re ba'i mdzum mdangs rgyas/ 'on kyang / u yon krang sku gzhon 7paṇa chen er te ni zhes pa'i gtam snyan dang lhan du/ 7paṇa chen bcu pas gsang yum bzhes yod pa'i gleng phyogs shig kyang / bod khams yongs su khyab cing / dol rgyugs kyi skye bo 'gas skur 'debs yang zhu myong /7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos dga' zhen bzhi'i /05gsung sgra bsgrags shing /rgya rigs bu mo zhig gsang yum du bzhes te/ gung khran tang dang mnyam las gnang ba de/ dus rabs kyis yongs su pham nyes su btang zhing / 'a chad 'u la thug pa'i bod 'di skyob phyir/ dus dang bstun pa'i mdzad pa zhig tu ma rtogs par/ khong ni gung khran tang dang rgya la phyogs pa'i skye bo zhig tu 'khrul ba'i mu cor la/ khong gis/bod mi mang dang 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs bzhed bsgrubs na/ming chad dang dka' ngal ci la'ang 'dzems rgyu min/ zhes gsungs/ /meX5nas rgyal la cadaga' zhin/krung rgo gung bran tang ladaga' zhin/rang gi mi regs lodaga' zhen/rang gi dad pa byed pa 'i chos lusas la dga' zhin/100

skya che'i mi da kyi cha/ le tshan drug pa/ rgya lo dang / cin dbang / rtang gsum mjal 'phrad/7paṇa chen bcu nga mchog dka' sdug che la bzhugs yun ring btson khang las grol rjes/ bod la gces pa'i bsam pa 'dzin pas/ mi lo 18btson khrims phog pa'i bod don 'thab grogs phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang /tshe rabs bskal ba'i sngon nas las smon thugs 'brel zab pa'i 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po'i gcen po rgya lo don grub rnam gnyis mjal 'phrad byung /de ni 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog btson nas grol rjes/ thog mar mjal 'phrad byung ba'i gzhis byes bod kyi mtho rim mi sna zung zhig yin nga/sa/ 7gong sa mchog dang bod mi mang gi bde sdug gnas stangs skor/ sngar myong phyir dran gyi snying gtam lhug stsol gnang 'dod los kyang che/phyi lo 1979 lor/ rgya lo don grub pe cing phebs skabs/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa dang nang mol mjal 'phrad byung zhing / rgya lo don grub kyis bod rgya gnyis kyi bsam tshul rgyang khyad che la/ de'i bar du ming chad yong bzo 'dug pas slad bod rgya gnyis 'grig yong bar ngas las ka byed rgyu min brjod skabs/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ rgya lo don grub la nam yang brjed mi nyan pa'i bka' slob cig gnang yod pa ni/ rgya lo lags 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs don dang /bod mi dmangs kyi las don la phan gyi yod na/ ming chad dang dka' ngal la 101

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'juga'adzems med gnang da sa gsungs pa red/106ri ri / 444 ——— — ri— tre ri spriXrmyerdoX6ci sa rme /zhiX 〉 /mitā r+yā kauthosmyurdzi sdu4rngo ci cha ci/ — — — chu sa //ra /cis mirāXdz+rasañtsatra cingaskuci 'i chotshordo'itshorngo'ispyo nya/ri bye /shā ru/ci/rte mi cu 〉ri/sbyiXcangs / phyi 〉ltis ci sna chu ci ci /shā rmo bye ༷sdushā/ gaX rnya dris tsha/rgyu cichis sh+lau pyi ci ci ༷bye 〉 〉༷ sdi /snyeX //sdu ri ci pa stomigabyung——— ——— —— — ——— (7paṇa chen rin po che dang rgyal lo nan grub/)phyi lo 1979 lor/ mi lo 18 'a ga sa'i chin khren btson khang las btson grol byung yang / las gnas bskyar gso bya rgyu lta ci/ 'tsho ba'i gnad na tsam na 'khyol med pa'i 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal/ ma sprang la gyar ba'i bu phrug khyim du/ yul dus nges med kyi skyabs bcol zhu ba na pa'i phun tshogs dbang rgyal la 'tshams gzigs su phebs/7paṇa chen mchog sa g.ya' ba'i phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi gnas stangs gzigs ma thag nga'i grogs po/ nga tsho ga sa kyis nga tsho'i mi rigs la phan 'a gas byed 'a da bcangs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ nga tsho ga sa ka lo mang btson khang du bcug pa red/ khyed kyis lo bco brgyad btson khang nang bskyal ba dang /nga lo bcu lhag bkag nyar byas byung / nged ga sa kyis nga mi rigs kyi las ba bas pa na las/ khrims 'gal gyi las ka gang yang byed ma myong /1//sdu 3 phun tshogs bkra shis kyi mi tsho 'o rgyus/ deb gsum pa /zog ngos zha ༷ nang / bod kyi dpe mdzod lang / bye lo 1995 lo ra/

kyi che'i mi da kyi cha/da lta ngos glod 'grol byas ma thag yin pas dbang cha med/ der brten khyed la chab srid kyi rogs ram bya rgyu dka' las khag po 'dug 'on kyang /'tsho ba'i thad nas khyed rang la ga re dgos na'ang ngas rogs ram byed chogamatha' ma gnas stangs legs su song mtshams/ ngas khyed la rogs ram de bas mang ba byed chog107 ces bod gangs can pa'i skye 'gro'i snang ngor/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam sprul 7paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas sku ngo mas/dmar po'i gzhung lugs kyis bslu brid kyi dmar po'i btsan gnon du tshud pa'i bod mi dmar po'i ring lugs pa zhig gi 'tsho ba'i gnad don tsam ma zad /chab srid kyi steng la'ang rogs phan gang thub gnang rgyu'i skal bzang zhal bzhes la/ bod mi gsar brje ba khong la sems 'gul dang / re ba/ ngar shugs 'phar ma zhig sbyin yo da pa bshad ci la dgos/phyi lo 1980 lor/ 'ab 'a pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal go gnas slar gso byung yang / mi lo bco brgyad mun pa'i btson khang gi 'tsho ba skyo pos/ lus phung gcong nad kyis zin nas pe cing sman khang du lus skabs/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog slar yang phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi mdun du stun gso 'tshams 'drir phebs/ snyun gsos 'tshams 'dri phud khong gnyis la thun mong gi bar snang zhig yod pa ni/ ji ltar byas te bod kyi gnad don sel zhing / bod phyug po dang shes rig ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su khrid thabs la bka' mol gnang rgyu de red/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ ngos kyis g.yon gyi nor 'khrul dang lugs mthun min pa'i gnas tshul/ de bzhin mi mang gis sdug bsngal myangs pa dang / ma nyes khag g.yogs kyi gnas tshul byung ba sogs mthong dus/ sems 1༷7bod mi sa/sar brje ba zhigasog ngos 422nang /chung tshe ring gis bsgyu ra/bod kye dus bab kyis pa ra/phyi 'o daX5lor/103

skya tshe'i mi da gyi cha/med ces gsungs/108 zhal gsung de ni phun tshogs dbang rgyal la/ mu mthud bod rigs kyi don du blo stobs chen pos bya ba sgrub dgos pa'i skul ma zhig kyang yin nges/phyi lo 1980 zla 3 tshes 14 dang 15 nyin gnyis ring / srid 'dzin hu'u ya'o pang gi gtso skyong 'og krung dbyang dbus chab srid cud kyis bod kyi las don skor gyi tshogs 'du thengs dang po 'tshogs/ tshogs thog tu 7paṇa chen rin po che yang gdan 'dren zhus nas dgongs tshul dris/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/phyi lo 1963 lor kra'o yon le la phul ba'i yig 'bru khri bdun gyi snyan zhu'i snying don bskyar du gsungs te/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod la 'dzin pa'i srid jus nor 'khrul can la rno ngar ldan pa'i skyon brjod gnang ba dang / slad phyin gyi byed phyogs dgongs 'char gnang rnams/ gang nyid kyi blo nye dang bod don 'thab grogs phun tshogs dbang rgyal la nang mol snying gtam gyi tshul du gsungs pa zhig kyang red/ skyon brjod de ni 7paṇa chen rin po che btson grol thob rjes/slar yang rgya nag gzhung gis bod la 'dzin pa'i srid jus nor 'khrul can la/skyon brjod dang 'thab rtsod gnang ba'i dbu 'byed kyi dus tshigs shig kyang red/ krung dbyang chab srid cud kyis bod kyi las don tshogs 'du'i steng /krung dbyang gis bod la 'dzin pa'i srid jus nor 'khrul can la kha ri kha thug gi skyon brjod dang / slad phyin byed phyogs kyi dgongs 'char tsha nan gsungs pas/krung dbyang dbus gzhung gis slad lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen gsar pa'i 'og bod kyi las don byed phyogs la don tshan brgyad can zhig khyab bsgrags byas/don tshan brgyad kyi don snying ni/ mi rigs kyi gnad don gral rim meX slob dpon chen po 7pa'o chen rin po che/'jam dpa la rgya mtshos brtsams/bde srung nyams zhib lang gi bod bsgyur byas/pyi lo 1998lor/105

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jugagyi gnad don yin zer ba'i skad cha shod pa mjug sgril byas te g.yon gyi dug rgyun gtsang sel dang / bod mi mang la rang khyim rang bdag yong ba byas te dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas/ lhag par du bod kyi las don gtan 'bebs dang /byed thabs tshang ma nges par du bod rigs las byed pa dang / bod rigs mi dmangs kyi kha zhe gnyis med kyi mos 'dun dang rgyab skyor 'thob pa zhig yin dgos pa 'khod yod/phyi lo 1980 zla 8 tshes 26 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog rgyun ldan bzhin zhogs pa'i sku sbyong dang ljags smin grub ste/ yun ring bral ba'i bod khul du 'tshams gzigs la phebs rgyu'i sta gon gnang bzhin pa'i skabs/rgya'/ khab mi rigs don gcod khang gi 'gan 'dzin yang cin ran/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gzim khang du bcar te/ krung dbyang dmag ud kyi kru'u zhi ting zha'o phing dang mjal 'phrad du phebs dgos pa'i snyan seng phul te zha'o phing gi khyim du gdan 'dren zhus 'dug ting zha'o phing gis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog mjal ma thag mchog nyid dang 'phags pa lha ni rgyal khab kyi 'go khrid khrod nas sku na gzhon shos shig red/ma31ga nyid ni nga 61) rgyal khab kyi rgyal gces pa yag shesas shig red/ mchog nyid kyis yig 'bru khri bdun spyi yongs nas yang dag pa zhig yin rung / nor 'khrul gyi cha shas kyang yod/109'on kyang / thag gcod byed stangs shugs che drags yod/stabs yag pa zhig la phyi tshe1 1964 dang / phyi mtho 1966 'o6) rig gnas gsar ba 'i cha las thar yod/ 'thab rtsod dang dung rdeg gi chag sgo de ga nyis 'a/sa 109rgyanas gzhung gis 7pa ca chen rin po che'i yeg 'bru khri bdun nang chor 'khrul yod pa red ces pa'i don ni/ 7pa k+ṣiṃ chen rin po ches mi rigs dang chos 'u sas rtsa medadu gdong ba zhes gsungs t+yā 'i bka'aglo la de red/ bka' mol rdor kra'u e la na dang ting zha'o ming sogs dgongs 'tshoms byung yo da la 'o rabs brgya bcu rngu 'i nang 7paṇa chen rin po chos yig 'bru khri bdun nang tha' dras pa'i tshig kha thas byung yo da gsungs pa 'i tshis de rmi nga red/106

kyi che 'i sma da kyi cha/thar thub pa ni ha cang yag po red/phyin chad khyed kyis blo rgya chen pos las don sgrub chog thugs dogs gnang mi dgos/ rig gnas gsar brje'i las don tshang ma nor 'khrul yin pa bshad tshog de la mchog nyid zhed mi dgos/ de ni krung dbyang gi 'go khrid kyis bshad pa red ces gsung chog chos lugs las don thog srid 'dzin gyi bka' rgya gtong ba'i thabs sgru rma spyong mi rung / 'on kyang / chos lugs thog nas bshad na'ang thal cha 'gro rgyu med/ de ltar ma byas na spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs dang mi mang gi khe phan dang rgyab 'gal chags kyi red/mchog nyid rgyal khab kyi dbu khrid kyi gras shig yin pa'i cha nas/ do snang yod tshad chos lugs kho nar min par chab srid la'ang do snang gnang dgos/krung dbyang gis bod kyi gnad don sel rgyu'i chod sems bzhag yod/ dngos su byas pa yin na/ de ni ha cang khag po zhig kyang ma red/ mchog nyid bod ljongs tsam ma zad/ bod khul gzhan dang / tha na rgyal spyi'i thog tu yang shugs rkyen yod pas/ rgyal khab kyi las don la byas rjes 'jog pa'i re ba yod/ — — — ———wa ge gatsho ri/rto ((1 ྅ ༷rngo chu /༷2ne chi/ ci/tsamatsho ri bye rte/ne+e ci/tre dro /ciX ri riri chos tso haṃ chogaX gci(tshoshārnyesami par peXs ri ci / ci'i wariri rigs ci chi ri/ sna rtsi ca na ci ma rteci /miciringe ci tu ci ci ri ci ri (7paṇa chen rin po che dang ting zha'o phing )107

7paṇa chena'ar te ni zhib 'jugamachog nyid bdag gi khyim du gdan 'dren zhus te bka' mol gnang ba 'di/ mchog nyid phyi mi zhig min pas yin/ phyin chad gnad don ga re zhu dgos kyang / rtag par kho tshor ('thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blon chen u lan phu dang / yang cin ran/ )bshad na chog ces bshad/110 ting gis mjal 'phrad des 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i phyogs gang ci'i thad bzang phyogs kyi 'gyur ba zhig mngon kyang / phyi lo 1963lor/ ma nyes kha g.yogs kyis 1//tang la ngo rgol byed mkhan yin pa'i gyod gzhi nor 'khrul can de/ btson grol byung nas mi lo 14 rjes su ste/ phyi lo 1987zla 3 tshes 10 bar dkar 'don dag sel byas mi 'dug gnad don da sgor lta dus rgya nag gzhung gis 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'dzin pa'i srid jus ni /lag pa gcig gis glod pa dang / lag pa gcig gis dam por bzung pa'i srid jus shig lag bstar byed bzhin yod pa mtshon thub//110 1/spyo /ri rlob/ 31r+shaci yo cha7 694 111 dang la ngo rgol/spyi tshogs ring lugs la ngo rgol/mi dmangs la ngo rgol/108

skya tshe'i smad kyi cha/le tshan bdun pa/ 'od rgya'i 'brel zam/7paṇa chen rin po ches/ 'dzam gling thog gi ri bo mtho shos (lha ma la ya )de/ ngos dang 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis kyi bar du gnas yod/der brten/ ngos kyis sgrub thub pa'i bya ba mang po zhig 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas gnang thub kyi med la/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas gnang thub pa'i bya ba mang po zhig ngos kyis bsgrubs thub kyi med/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir ngos gnyis kyi las 'gan bgo bsha' rgyag dgos/112gsungs/bod rgya gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i thad 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs gzhi dang dgongs 'char dag la/ khong 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa'i dus su rgyab skyor dang /dang len byed mkhan zhig byung mi 'dug la/ sku gshegs rjes kyi bcu tshan dang po'i nang du yang / gdengs 'jog gnang mkhan zhig byung med/khong sku gshegs rjes kyi lo ngo nyi shu song ba'i da lta'i dus/ spyir 'dzam gling gi dus bab dang sgos su bod rgya'i chab srid 'gyur gros las/ da lta khong gi dgongs gzhi sa 'gro lam gzhan zhig med pa dngos ra 'phrod skabs/ bod rgya'i dbar khong gis 'dum 'grig gnang ba las byung ba'i bod rgya zhi 'grig gi dus skabs bzang po zhig dam 'dzin ma thub pa'i gyong gud ni nam yang gsab thabs med pa zhig yin pa shes kyi yod/112 166 8221khukhyi(01 6298bsgo'iXs/mtshotha ba2 185 6713862121/ 0ba brngubaḥkhu1760025 109

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jugaphyi lo 2008 zla 11 tshes 4 nyin/ bod rgya 'brel mol thengs brgyad pa'i skabs/ bod gzhung gis rgya nag mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims kyi sgrom gzhi'i nang / bod ri gas yongs la ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong yong thabs kyi bsam 'char don tshan drug can gyi dgongs don de/ phyi lo 1962lo ra / lpa paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis rgya nag gzhung la phul ba'i yig 'bru khri bdun nang / dbus gzhung nas bod rigs yongs kyi khe phan dang mthun pa'i thun mong gi srid jus shig lag len bstar rgyu'i snyan zhu dang /yang sgos phyi lo 1987 zla 4 tshes 15 nyin/ pe cing mi dmangs tshogs khang chen mo'i bod ljongs tshoms chen du 'tshogs pa'i tshogs 'du'i steng /bod rigs gcig gyur gyi rang skyong 'dzugs rgyu lugs dang mthun pa/ khrims dang mthun pa/ rgya che'i bod mi dmangs kyi bsam 'dun yin pas phyir bshol byed pa'am log spyod zer ba'i gnad don gang yang med/113gsung pa'i bar/tshig sgros khyad par las don snying la he bag til 'bru tsam mi 'dugagal srid rgya nag mi mang spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims 'og bod rigs rang skyong gi srid jus ming don mtshungs pa zhig lag bstar don 'khyol byung tshe/ bod kyi gnad don sel ba'i ngos 'dzin gnang gi yod na/ nga tshos lo rabs naX nang rgya nag mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims kyi sgrom gzhi'i nang / chol gsum gcig tu sgril ba'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi dgos 'dun kha gsal zhing / dngos don dang ran pa zhig bton thub mi 'dug snyam/phyi lo 1959 zla 4 tshes 17 nyin/ rgya gar byang shar ti tsi pu ru/11 bod mi gsar brje ba zhigashog ngos 5zhiXnang /chung tshe ring gis bsgyur/bod kyi dus bab kyi par/phyi lo naX zhi'o ra/110

kyi che'i mi da kyi cha/7gong sa mchog gis rgyal spyi'i thog gros 'dun don tshan 17 gzhung 'brel ngos len med pa'i bsgrags gtam spel ba nas/ phyi lo 1979 bar/ bod rang btsan gtsang ma bskyar gso'i 'thab rtsod dang langs phyogs thog phebs yod kyang /phyi lo 1979 rgya nag gi 'go khrid ting zha'o phing gis/ sku ngo rgya lo don grub brgyud/bod gzhung gis bod rang btsan rtsod gleng ma byas tshe/ gnad don gzhan tshang ma'i thog gros bsdur byas nas chog rgyu bshad pa de/ 7gong sa mchog gis phyi lo 1974 nas bod la tshad mtho'i bde skyid byung na/ bod rgya mnyam gnas gnang rgyu'i dgongs gzhi dang gzhi rtsa'i cha nas gcig gyur byung yod/'on kyang / lo rabs 80 pa'i nang gi bod rgya zhi mol gyi gnas tshul de ni/ rgyal srid rgyal po'i sku bsod/ /srid don blon po'i bye brag /ces pa'i dpe ltar dngos gzhi bod rgya'i dbar las don gnang mkhan tshos/ rgya nag gzhung la 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs pa kha gsalnga zhig go brda sprod ma thub pa'am/ yang na/dus bab tshod 'dzin dang chab srid tshod bgam ma thub pas/ da lta'i dgos 'dun ltar kha gsal zhing dngos yod dang 'tshams pa zhig 'don ma thub par snang /krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs su/ bod la ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong dgos pa'i 'thab rtsod de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis thugs nus yod rgu 'do na sa'i dgongs gzhi red la/ phyi lo 1982dang 1984 so sor/ bod rgya 'brel mol du phebs pa'i btsan byol bod gzhung gi sku tshab rnams la'ang / khyed tshos bod rang btsan ji ltar rtsod rtsis yod dam/da༄ra na/khrod rang bcan phrod snun li ri dang ni/su'u len khyis sod rang getsan yong ched krung gor dmag brgyab ste/ bod 'di krung go'i lag nas 'phrog ste/bod rang btsan rtsod rgyu'i dus tshod cig yong gi red dam/ 'di 'dra rtsa ba nas yong mi srid pa'i gnad don zhig red/ su'u len dang / a ris krung gor bod 111

7paṇa chen zhir te ni zhib 'jugakyi ched du dmag rgyag rgyu de rtsa ba nas mi srid pa zhig red/gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyis krung gor dmag brgyab ste bod 'di len gyi red dam/ rgya gar gyis krung go glag 'khel gyi ma red/ 'di yang re ba med pa zhig yin/gna' snga mo bod rang gis yar langs te dmag rgyag gi yod/ deng sang de ltar yong thabs med/ krung gor mi grangs dung phyur bcu lhag tsam yod/ nga tsho yongs rdzogs bsdoms na'ang khri 400 lhag tsam las med pas ji ltar byas te glags 'khel gyi red dam/yang zhi ba la re ba brgyab ste/ rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs la re ba dang /mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs la re ba byas kyang / rgyal spyi'i thog gros chod ci 'dra zhig yod kyang / rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs kyi sgrig yig nang don dag gal che ba yin na/bde 'jags u yon lhan khang nang gros bsdur dgos kyi yod/ bde 'jags u yon lhan khang gi nang du rgyun las rgyal khab lnga yod/ de'i nang gi gcig gis rogs pa byas kyang gros bsdur byas te thag gcod byed dgos pas/ rgyal khab lnga'i nang krung go yod/ krung gor gros bsdur ma byas par yong thabs med/ der brten/ rgyal spyi'i spyi tshogs kyis kyang 'gyur ba gtong thabs med/114 der brten/mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs nas kyang 'gyur ba gtong rgyu med/rang btsan skor da lta phar bzhag de min tshad mtho'i rang skyong zhig yong thabs bya dgos/ khyed tshos mna' 'brel rgyal khab ces pa tshig don zhor 'phros su bsam tshul gleng pa las/ rtsa don thog la dngos su brjod na khong tsho dogs 'phrogs byed kyi red/ ham pa che drags na 'grigs kyi ma red/ bod mi rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par 1147paṇa chen bcu pa mchos gi bka' gro ba/zhog ngos 14 nang /phyi dril la sa khungs kyis bod sgyur dang par 'grems byas /phyi lo 1998lo ra/112

skya tshe'i smad kyai cha/dad mos chen po dang / gus brtsi tshad mtho po yod lugs shugs chen shod dgos/de bod mi rnams kyi rtsa don yin pa'i lam ston gnang yod/115phyi lo 1982 lor/ bod rgya 'brel mol du phebs pa'i bod kyi sku tshab stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis dang / 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal/ rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan dang bcas pas/ bod gzhung gi dgos 'dun//don tshan dgu can zhig dang /de dang 'brel ba'i don tshan brgyad can zhig dus tshod byung na de dang 'brel yod don tshan lnga can zhig yod/dgos 'dun gtso bo ni bod la rang thag rang gcod kyi lam nas mna' 'brel rgyal khab dgos pa de red 'dug)dag 7paṇa chen rin po cher spyan 'bul zhus te/ da res bka' mol zhu rgyu 'di dag yin/ dge skyon yo bsrang gi bka' slob gnang rogs byos/ bka' gang gnang ba ltar bya dgos pa'i bka' mngags (gong sa mchog gi bka' mngags/)yod ces zhu skabs/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ khyed tsho phyi rgyal rang dbang lung pa'i nang bsdad yod pa red/ khyed tsho'i bsam blo dang ngos kyi bsam blo gtong stangs 'dra yi ma red/ khyed tshos bsam blo yag po gtong dgos/ dgos 'dun don tshan de mang drags 'dug gsungs te/116bod gzhung gi dgos 'dun don tshan dag las/ don tshan gsum tshur bton te/ dgos 'dun 'grig gi 'dug dang mi 'dug so sos bsam blo gtong dgos/ byed thabs 'di chings rdo dkris te rgyag dgos/ bod kyi gnas stangs 'di byi'u phrug gi sgo nga kha gas ma thag pa lta bu zhig red/ khong khro langs skabs btsir tsam byas na lam seng shi 'gro ba'i lam ston gnang yod/117115ste ga lta phun tshogs bkra zhis kyi mi che'i lo rgyus dang /deb gsu ma pa/'os ngos na ༷ nang /bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gis par/byi lo 1995lor/115 sku ngo 'ju chen la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i zenatho/gong tshes zhin/117sku ngo 'ju chen la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i zin tho/gong tshes nyin/113

7paṇa chen ler te ni jib 'jugarte/ ci ci phya jimi/'i sgru byu saX33 ciX ri rnga ri7 lnge rdo rdoX tso/twe peci r+sha 4༷ / rmesi ༷ ༷༷༷༷/sbyogu r+sha dī / du/rdorto ci ci ri ri sa sdu/ci sna ri tsho / me ci 4 48) /rdobye/ byeX tsho gyi me ciXri /skyes/ri risku'ici tsho / ca sgro ritsho na su/ba che'i 3 )/ mi —) / / rdo sna tsho ༷:yiri ri na ———— — ci / ri sa ci ga byudzi —6 ri / —— —snye /ljong zhi //ri ko pa — —ri yongaci yedzog salke dzha — rī r+sha choX/ tre mi ri r+sha04pa sgo 3rdo dzi klo sko/snyo sgo 6 7 lhurta cas /rmi snang|/ ca 4cazhi/ na tsho 5ci ci 9bla)/ ri tshoX chu ru sna ra ri/the ri rizu rirdo ci tsho cista na ri riwa/rnyirnga ༷ru/bye436//mi cho sa/sna ༷༷sko ༷ /ri / ri na ci dzā riḥ ༷༷ ༵༵/shā ri ra〉rtsi 'i //985zhe sna ri/ri ṣ+ṭṛ(7paṇa chenarinangotshe phun tshogs dbarngo rgyal / 'ju chen thub bstan rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan )sog rngo6) las la/ bsod nams chos 'phel mkhas pa ltar / lo rabs 80 nang gi bod kyi mtho rim 'go khrid dang / lhag par bod rgya'i dbar phyag las gnang mkhan bod kyi sku tshab tshos/ 7paṇa chen rin po che gung khran tang la rgyus mnga' che zhing bod la dkar ba'i mi zhig yin pas/ bod rgya zhi 'grig thad khong la gzhan gyis tshab byed thabs bral ba'i khyad chos ldan pa zhal bzhes gnang ste/bod rgya zhi 'grig gi las 'gan de khong la blos 'gel dang yid ches gnang ste /khong lam ston bzhin phyag las gnang yod tshe/ bod kyi gnas bab 'di da lta gnas stangs gzhan zhig yin nges red/'on kyang / skabs der las kyi sne mor gtogs pa'i dbu khrid 'ga' dang /118 sku tshab rnam pas 7paṇa chen rin po cher chos lugs lta ba'i gus zhabs dang che mthong las/ bod rgya'i dbar khong gi phyag las gnang bar blos 118nyi lo 1979 bod kyi sku tshab pe cing dang ngo phebs skabs/ btsan byol nang gi la sa kyi sne mo ra gtogs pa 'gas/ bka' zur nga pod dang / phu na tshogs dbangargyal lajugs re gnang ba las/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher thugs re de tsam gnang mi 'dug bka' zur nga pho da dang gun dbang la phyags rtags sogs rdo sgri/ /nang ba la sa/ 7pa khu chen rin ngo cher dmigs gsal gang yang gnang mi 'dug

skru che'i smad kyi cha/mi 'khel ba'i thugs dogs byung 'dugadaper na/ skabs de'i bod kyis sku chab rnams kyis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi lam ston bzhin ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong dgos pa'i dgos 'dun las ldog ste/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis mna' 'brel rgyal khab ces pa tshig don zhor 'phros su bsam tshul gleng ba las/rtsa don thog la dngos su brjod na khong tsho dogs 'drogs byed kyi red/ ham pa che drags na mi 'grigs gsungs pa'i lam ston la ma gsan pa ra/ chol gsum gcig sgril gyi rang thag rang gcod yod pa'i mthun phyogs mna' 'brel rgyal khab ming don mtshungs pa sprod dgos pa'i dgos 'dun rang 'jags bton 'dug119de bzhin krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blon chen yang cing ren gyis phun tshogs dbang rgyal la/ btsan byol gyi sku tshab tshos 7paṇa chen rin po che dang nga phod la mjal 'phrad du phebs na yang / khong chos khyed la gzhan las rnam 'gyur zhe drags kyis yag pa 'dzin gyi 'dug gsungs/120nga tshos yang cin ran gyi skad cha de las/ gnad don gal chen zhig shes thub pa ni/bod kyi sku tshab tshos bod rgya'i dbar 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis phyag las gnang rgyur blos mi 'khel ba'i gnas tshul de red/rig 'dzin tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos/rang sems kha btags dkar po/ /nag nog med par zhus yod / /mi sems snag tsha'i ri mo/ /'bri 'dod yod na bris shog /119shes bya/phye lo 1984zla smonashog ngos 17nang /pyi dril la sa khungs kyi gzhung 'brel dus deb/spyodaXbod masar brje ba zhig shog ngos ji khyenang /chung tshe ring gis bod bsgyur byas/bod kyi dus bab kyi par/phyi lo zha ༷can ra/115

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugagasungs pa ltar 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod kyi gnad don sel zhing / 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa bod du zhabs sor 'khod rgyu'i slad/rgya nag gzhung la bod khul gcig dang sa khul lnga gcig tu bsgril rgyu ni khrims dang mthun pa/ bod mi mang gi mngon 'dod yin pa thengs mang gsungs myong la/dgongs bzhed de mngon 'gyur slad phyi log tu yod pa'i nga tsho las lhag pa'i sku ngal skyon bzhin yod pa ni/phyi lo 1984 lor/ rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ nam yin yang chol kha gsum kha 'bral mi dgos pa zhig la dgongs pa bzhes rogs zhus par/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che bzhin mdangs 'gyur bzhin gsung shugs drag pos/ blo gros rgyal mtshan don dag gal chen 'ba' zhig gi ched du/ phyi logs su sdod pa khyod tsho'i bsam blo'i nang 'khor ma thub pa'i don gnad de 'dra 'ang nga chos sgrub bzhin yod/121 ces gsungs/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis 'bad brtson ga tshod gnang yang /lag pa gcig gis zlog pa yong thabs med dus/ ri bo hi ma la yi rgyab tu bzhugs pa'i bod mi rnams kyis kyang / khong dang lang phyogs gcig gyur dang /lta stangs gcig gyur dgos pa de bas kyang kha tsha dgos gtugs su gyur yod stabs/ btsan byol bod mi'i sku tshab dang mjal 'phrad nam gnang la/ nga tsho gzhis byes dbar rdog rtsa gcig sgril byed dgos kyi 'dug bsam phyogs gcig mthun byed dgos kyi 'dug mang nyung la ma bltos par rang gi nus pa de gcig gyur yong ba byed dgos/ zhes gsungs/122121phyi lo naX4lo ra/rgya ri blo gros rgyala'i tshan la gas sa rwa mtho slob tu phebs skabs dri bar la na de ga rang bskyon/12nas ngo 'ju chen la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshig tho/gong tshes gin/116

skya tshe'i smad kyai cha/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ phyi lo 1986 zla 3 tshes 28 nyin/rgyal yongs dmangs 'thus skabs 6 tshogs thengs 5 bod kyi 'thus mi'i tshogs chen steng / phyi rgyal du bod mi mang po zhig da dung yang bsdad yod/ khong tsho ni nga tsho'i spun zla yin/ 'on kyang / chab srid kyi langs phyogs dang / lta ba mi 'dra bar brten/ bod kyi gnad don 'di yang rgyun ring gi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin pa gsungs/phyi lo 1986 zla 4 nang / 7paṇa chen rin po che o si kri li yar chibs sgyur skabs/ 7gong sa mchog gis 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'tshams 'dri zhal par phul 'dug 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la rang btsan dor nas/ mes rgyal du phyir log gnang rogs zhu skabs/ 7gong sa mchog gis/ngos rang ngos kyi bod rang btsan rtsod rgyu yin/ khyed nyid khyed kyi mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong rtsod/ gang ltar bod mi mang bde skyid dang / 'phel rgyas byung na 'grig/ red ces gsungs pa 'khod/123skabs der nga tsho'i dgos 'dun nang dbu ma'i lam gyi srid jus med la/rgya nag mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims kyi snying don mi 'gal ba'i thog nas/ bod rigs yongs la ming don mtshung pa'i rang skyong yong thabs kyi dgos 'dun yang min/ dus skabs de'i srid jus dang dgos 'dun ni/bod rigs yongs la bde skyid tshad dang ldan pa'i srid jus dang / bod chol kha gsum nang khul kha bral ma yin par chig sgril thog rang gi 'gan dbang rang gis byed pa'i mthun phyogs mna' 'brel rgyal khab ming don mtshungs pa'i dgos 'dun gcig dang / tha'e lhan la don tshan dgu tsam dgongs bzhes gnang yod pas bo la bas lhag pa'i dgongs pa bzhes 'os pa'i dgos 'dun gnyis smon phyi lo 1986lor/dkar mdzes bod rigs ju khul las byed pa 'i tshogs chen steng bstsal ba'i bka' slo ba/117
