7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jugani nga tsho'i dgos 'dun gyi gtso bo red 'dug1247paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod rgya zhi mol legs sgrub yong ched/bod rgya dbar dngos gzhi'i gros mol ma gnang gong / bod kyi sku tshab rnams la/bka' mol gnang skabs 'tshab 'tshub ma byed/ zhed snang byed mi dgos/ya nga mkhregs po dang tshig rtsub ma shod/ dgos 'dun gsal po 'don dgos pa sogs kyi lam ston gnang ba dang /125 gros mol bsgrubs pa dang bod kyi sku tshab tshams kyis zhus pa'i gnad don gang dang ci la krung dbyang dogs 'brogs dang go 'dzol byung ste/ gros mol gyi 'gog rkyen du gyur nyen pa'i gnas tshul ji byung / sku nyid kyi grogs po zhi krung zhun sogs la nang mol 'dri rtsad gnang rjes/slad phyin bod kyi sku tshab tshos yid gzab gnang phyogs kyi lam ston yang phebs 'dug7paṇa chen rin po ches/ phan tshun gyi 'brel ba yag tu gtong ba las/sdug tu mi 'gro ba'i dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ krung dbyang la phog thug gi bka' mol gnang rgyu mi 'dug khyed tshos phyag las kyi 'gan yag po bsnam dgos/don med kyi gtam drag po ma gsungs/ skad cha rdzig po shod pa'i skabs spro snang chen po yo da 'gro/ don dngos thog phan thogs kyi yod pa ma red/ don dag lam seng 'grub rgyu khag po yod kyang / 'brel lam yag po chags na grub 'bras gang 'tsham thon gyi red/ lhag par du khyed tshos 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' la brtsi bkur yag po zhu dgos/ gal che shos ni ngang rgyud ring ba'i bsam blo gtong dgos gsungs/124bod rgya 'brel ba'i skor gyi sal che'i yis cha pyo gas bsgrigs/shong ngos zhinanang /pyi dril par bang /phyi lo 1994/125su ga lha phun tshogs bkra shes kyi mi tshe'i lo rgyus/deb gsu ma pa/'ong ngos na ༷nang /bod kyi da pe ma dzod khang /phyi lo 1995lor 118

sku che'i smad kyai cha/ rin po ches bod kyi sku tshab rnams la gnang ba'i lam ston de ni/rgyu mtshan yod pa dang / mtshams tshigs yod pa/ phan nus yod pa'i lam ston zhig yin mod/ skabs de'i nga tshe'i mtho rim sku tshab mi sna'i dbar la brgyud lam mi 'dra ba dang / dgos 'dun mi 'dra ba sogs kyi rgyu rkyen sna mang la brten nas/gal/ 'gangs che la don snying ldan pa'i gnad don 'ga' zhig sku tshab rnam pas mkhyen gyi med pa snang /lhag par du khyed tshos 7gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' la brtsi bkur yag po zhu dgos/ zhes pa'i zhal gsung de sku tshab rnams pa'i bka' mol gnang stangs gang la ltos nas gsung gi yod pa/ bdag gis de bas kyang tshod dpog thub kyi mi 'dugadaper na/ phyi lo 1982 lor/ bod kyi sku tshab gsum 7gong sa mchog gi bka' lag khyer dang bcas pe cing du phebs skabs/ sku tshab rnam pas 7gong sa mchog gi bka' mngags bzhin kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i sku mdun du bcar skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ khyed rnam pas hu'u ya'o h+phang gi bod kyi gnad don sel ched du bton pa'i don tshan lnga'i skor (phyi lo 1981lor rgya lo don grub la hu'u ya 'o phang bi don tshan lnga sprad yod pa de/ phyi lo 1982 lo sku tshab gsum 'gro dus rtsa ba nas shes rtogs mi 'dug136)mkhyen gyi yod dam zhes bka' dri phebs//rgyu rkyen ci yin ma shes kyang sku tshab gsum la don tshan lnga yi skor gang yang shes rtogs mi 'dug pas/ nga tshos de'i skor gang yang shes rtogs med la/bka' mngags kyang gnang ma byung zhus/ gnas tshul der 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog thugs drag tu khros te/ de 'dra dpe srid kyi ma red/ rgya nag gzhung gi las shog steng bris yod pa red/ las dam brgyab yod pa red/ yi ge de rgya yig dbu 1naca sango 'ju chen la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i zin tho/rgong tshes nyin/gangs skyid sazim khang /1 19

7paṇa chen ser te gi zhib ca'ajugacan red/ phun dbang nga tshor ngo bshus yang sprad byung / de 'dra'i gnas tshul zhig khyed rang tshos shes ma byung zer na/ de ga 'dra yin nam/ khyed tshos bsam blo yag po gtong dgos/ bsam blo gzab gzab gtong dgos/ khyed tshos rgya gar nang krung go'i gzhung tshab khang gi mdun du skad 'bod zhe drags brgyabs/rgya nag gi dbu khrid tsho'i gsob gzugs mer bsreg gtong gi yod pa de/ phyi rgyal pas tshags shog gi mdun ngos su 'don gyi 'dug bsam blo gting zab ma btang bar dob ste mthong dus yid tshims tshims 'dra po zhig yong gi red/ bsam blo ngo ma btang na yi ge de klog tshar rjes g.yug bzhag gi red/krung dbyang gi dbu khrid tsho'i nang nas/ 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen par bdag po rgyag dgos kyi red shod mkhan dang / rdog rol gtong dgos shod mkhan rigs gnyis yod/ khyed tshos byed stangs de yag po ma byung na/rdog rol gtong dgos shod mkhan tshos/ bdag po rgyag dgos shod mkhan tsho'i thod pa'i steng mdzub mo btsugs yong gi 'dug khyed tshos de tsho mkhyen dgos zhes thugs re gnang /127'on kyang / btsan byol bod mi phal mo che'i snang ngor 'char ba ni/rgyal spyi'i gsar lam khag gi nang du dril bsgrags phyin na/ rgyal kha chen po zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod kyang / don dngos thog rgyal spyi'i gsar lam nang gi gnas skabs rang bzhin gyi dril bsgrags des/ bod mi rigs kyi las dbang dang mdun lam thag gcod mi thub par/ de las ldog ste phyogs gnyis po'i 'gal ba de bas che ru 'gro bzhin yod/ma gzhi 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos rgya nag gzhung gis bod du 'dzin pa'i mi rigs kyi srid jus dang / chos lugs kyi srid jus/ shes yon srid jus sogs la thugs blo mi khengs kyang / stobs chen rgyal khab rgya nag gi mnga' khongs 127sku ngo 'ju chen la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i zin tho/ gong tshes nyin/gangs sgyid gzim khang /120

sku che'i smad kyi cha/nas/ bod mi rigs kyi mdun lam dang las dbang thag gcod bya rgyu de/ ldog thabs med pa'i dus kyi 'khor phyogs shig yin pa khong la nges pa rnyed yod/chabs cig srid 'dzin hu'u ya'o bang 〈1915nas 1989〉dang/128kra'o tse yang 〈1919nas 2༷༷5〉/ 29 klang dbyang chab srid cus kyi 'gan 'dzin zhi krung zhun/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi 'gan 'dzin yang min phen/krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso dge bsnyen kra'o phe'u khra'u/thod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi hru'u ci hu'u cin hwa sogs/ khong gi r+shazhi rgya che ba'i mtha' skor gyi khor yug nang / bod la sha tsha dang dga' zhen che ba'i gnad yod mi sna'i mthun 'gyur dang/de bas kyang dbus gzhung gi nang du/ 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen par bdag po rgyag dgos zhes brjod mkhan gyi stobs shugs nges can zhig kyang yod par brten/ bo| skabs de dag dam por gzung rgyu de ngesad mi rigs kyi mdun lam dang las dbang thag gcod byed pa'i yang dag pa'i thabs lam gcig pu de yin pa khong gis de bas kyang gsal po mkhyen gyi yod/phyi lo 1987 lor/ bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar zhi ba'i ngo rgol langs skabs/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis mi rigs las byed par blang bya gnyis bton yod pa ni/ dang po/ chab srid thog nas yid rton 'pher ba dang / tang gi kha la nyan pa/tang gi 'go khrid srung skyong / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam la bskyod rgyur dga' ba dang / gnyis pa/ rang mi rigs la brtse dung yod pa/ rang mi rigs kyis las ka yag po bsgrub thub pa/ rang mi rigs kyi tshab mtshon pa dang mgrin tshab pa byed thub pa/ rang mi rigs kyi snying stobs mtshon thub pa dgos pa'i cha rkyen 128hu'u nan li'u rmi nga rdzong du skyes/phyi lo 198༷rgya nag gi srid 'dzin gnang /phyi lo 1987lo go gnas phab/snyen ga nan rdzong du skye sa/phyi lo 1987ba smonang rgya nag gi srid 'dzin gnang /byi 'o 1989zla phyinang go gnas phab/121

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhib ca'ajugabaton yod/ rin po ches 'don gnang mdzad pa'i cha rkyen gnyis la/ skabs de'i rgya nag mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzin kra'o tse dbyang gis/ 'di ni ha cang yag po 'dug pas/ ngas khyed la rgyab skyor yod ces gsungs/130gzhan yang / krung dbyang chab srid cus kyi hru'u ci zhi krung zhun gyis/ nga'i mdza' brtse ldan pa'i grogs mchog 7paṇa chen rin po ches legs par 'grub pa'i mdzad rjes rnams la/ ngas dga' spro chen pos rgyab skyor hur thag byed kyi yod pa gsungs/1317paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod kyi dus chen dang mdzad rā'i skabs/bod rigs mtho rim 'go khrid chos bod chas gyon dgos pa'i dgongs 'char thengs mang gsungs kyang / bod kyi mtho rim 'go khrid tshos snang med du gtong gi yod stabs/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che hu'u cin har/ khong sku ngo mas bod bzo'i phyu pa zhig gnang / hu'u cin has gal che'i mdzad sgo dang tshogs 'du'i skabs phyu pa de bsnabs kyi yod stabs/ g.yon thal che ba'i bod rigs gung bran pa tsho yang mi 'dod bzhin bod kyi phyu pa gyon dgos pa byung yod/'on kyang / kho tshos 7paṇa chen bcu par mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon phyer/krung dbyang gi bka' bzhin bod bzo'i phyu pa gyon pa yin zhes bshad/phyi lo 1986 lor/ hu'u ya'o h+phang rgya nag srid 'dzin gyi go gnas las phab cing / phyi lo 1988 lor/ bod rang ljongs tang gi drung che hu'u cin ha bod nas phyir 'then byas/ bod la sha zhen che ba'i bod kyi dbu khrid dang mi mang mang medaXkun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bka' slob/shong ngos 111nang /phyi dril la sa khungs kyi bod bsgyur pa ra 'grems byas/phyi 'o 1998lo ra/me 1bod kyi rig sanas lo rgyus dpyad sazhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgregs /〈7paṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉thog ngos 27nang /bod ljo ngas dmangs dpe skru na khang /phyi 'o 1989blo phyinang / 122

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/pos/ go thos su hu'u cin ha 'pho len byed kyi yod tshod/ de'i skor krung dbyang thad gtogs las khungs khag la drang bden gyi zhu 'bod gnang rogs zhes/7paṇa chen bcu par phyag 'phrin phul 'dugahu'u cin ha bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che las phyir 'then dang /hu'u ya'o phang rgya nag gi srid 'dzin go gnas phab skabs/ g.yon thal che ba'i las byed dang dpon rigs 'gas/ dus chen ltar shog sbag spar ba dang /chang rag btung ste rgyas spros kyi thugs spro btang nas/ bod rigs kyi rgyab rtsa pham nyes byung song / hu'u cin ha log mi thub pa dang / 7paṇa chen yang log thub kyi med lugs bshad/mkhas dbang tshe ring shākyas/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches hu'u cin ha ni bod rang skyong ljongs gi tang gi drung che yag shos de yin pa gsungs pa ma zad/phyi lo 1987 zla 3 tshes 28 nyin/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi bod kyi 'thus mi gros tshogs steng gsung shugs chen pos/ hu'u ya'o phang srid 'dzin go gnas nas phab kyang / khong gis bod kyi gnad don thog 'dzin pa'i gu yangs srid jus la bstod bsngags gnang yod/7paṇa chen rin po che'i gsung bshad des/ hu'u ya'o phang ni bod kyi gnad thog do khur gnang mkhan gyi gung khran tang gi 'go khrid gcig pu de yin par bstan pa ma zad/ 'go khrid gsar pa tshos kyang hu'u ya'o phang gis/bod kyi gnad don thog 'dzin pa'i gu yangs srid jus snang med du dor mi rung ba'i dran skul gnang ba zhig kyang yin pa gsungs//32 lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 27 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po che dgongs 13216221820111pa 067570(byas073 9322411123

7paṇa chen ber te ni zhib 'jugapa mya ngan las 'das rjes kyi zla zha ba'i tshes 5 nyin/ lha sar slar yang gzhi rgya che ba'i zhi ba'i ngo rgol byung / skabs der rgya nag gzhung gis dkar nag dbye phye med par khrag dri bro ba'i drag po'i bka' rgya btang ste drag gnon byas 'dugaskabs der lha sa'i ngo rgol las 'gul ji ma ji bzhin mthong ba'i gsar 'god pa thang ta'o zhon gyis bris pa'i (me mda'i brtse gri thad skar lha sar gtad pa/zhes pa'i nang / phyi lo 1989 zla 3 pa'i tshes 10 nyin/ zing cha'i nang shi ba'i lha sa'i mi grangs 387 rin gyi yod pa dang / de'i nang nas mang che ba ni me mda' phog nas shi ba red/ mi grangs 721 la rmas skyon shor yod cing /de'i nang mi grangs 126 la rmas skyon tshabs chen phog yod/ mi grangs 359gar song cha med du gyur zhing / mi grangs 2100 lhag 'dzin bzung bkag nyar byas yod pa dang / chos lugs las rigs kyi mi grangs 83 shi ba dang /mi grangs 37 la rmas skyon shor ba/ mi grangs 100 gar song cha med du gyur pa/mi grangs 600 lhag tsam g.yas g.yon nas 'dzin bzung byas yod pa/ da lta phyogs mtha' khag nas yong ba'i bod mi'i grangs tho da lta len bzhin pa'i sgang yin zhing / drag chas nyen rtog phyogs khag nas kha sang bar spyi bde thing dang cus ma lag nas 'dzin bzung byas pa'i mi grangs 123 rtsis spyod byas yod pa dang /de min khag gcig drag chas nyen rtog cus nas nyar tshags byas yod ces 'khod yod/lha sa'i zhi rgol gyi las 'gul la drag gnon byas pa ma zad/ phyi lo 1987 lo dang spyi lo 1988 lo'i zhi rgol las 'gul skabs 'dzin bzung byas pa'i btson pa rnams/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i bka' drin las glod 'grol gtong rgyu byas kyang / kho tsho glod 'grol ma btang bar mu mthud btson 'jug byas yod/skabs der rgyal spyi'i stobs shugs gang 'dra zhig gis kyang skyob ma thub par/124

sku che'i smad kyai cha/bod kyi gnas stangs de slar yang lo rabs 60 nang phyir log brgyab/ mthar/ting zha'o phing 'chi khar btsan byol du yod pa'i bod mi dang 'brel ba byed rgyu med pa'i kha chems nag po zhig bzhag pa'i gnas btang bar sdug tu phyin yod/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 28 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku mya ngan las rjes/ rgya nag gzhung gis phyi lo 1989 zla 2 tshes 16 nyin/pe cing g.yung ho dgon du 7paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid btsal 'tshol dang /dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul ched/ krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi dbu 'dzin dge bsnyen kra'u h+phu kru'i mtshan thog nas/ 7gong sa mchog gdan zhu'i mgron shog cig phul 'dug133gdan zhu'i mgron brda de ni/ phyi lo 1959 nas da lta'i bar rgya nag dbus gzhung gis/ 7gong sa mchog la gzhung 'brel gyi gdan zhu phul ba gcig pu de red la/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos bod kyi gnad don sel bar/ 7gong sa mchog dang rgya nag gzhung dbar 'brel mthud kyi nus pa thon pa mtha' ma de yang red/gdan zhu'i mgron shog de 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i grogs po snying pa krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi dbu 'dzin dge bsnyen kra'u phu'u kru dang /krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blon chen yan min h+phu/ u yon krang gzhon pa nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs kyis thugs khur dang 'bad brtson las byung ba zhig red 'duga'on kyang / skabs de'i btsan byol bod gzhung gi dbus lhan khang ba 'a sa 7gong sa bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen 133 5khris/sa/baḥ 5601320ba 22166 674pa/lngas bta00smo 20spu'i/dzi 201076yo 125

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugamakhas dbang mkhan po khro ru tshe rnam gyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i zhal chems thugs la bcangs te/ pe cing nas lha sar zhabs sor 'khod 'phral/ bod sa stod smad bar gsum nas don gnyer can gyi slob bu ji snyed cig bskongs te/sgra tsan dra pa dang ka lwa pa'i slob sbyong 'dzin grwa gnyer pas/ bod khul du ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu ltar gyur pa'i sgra mdo de gnyis kyi bstan pa rgya mtsho ltar 'phel/phyi lo 1988 zla 10 tshes 27 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs dgongs bzhin/ bod brgyud nang bstan zhib 'jug khang gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/bod ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ si khron/ kun su'u/ yun nan/ nang sog pe cing dang bcas pa nas/ zhib 'jug pa chen mo 21 dang / zhib 'jug pa gzhon pa 27zhib 'jug mi sna 17 bcas/ khyon mkhas dbang drug cu lhag cig la bod brgyud nang bstan zhib 'jug khang gi zhib 'jug pa'i mtshan gsol gnang /da dung /gangs can rig brgya'i sgo 'byed lde mig)ces grub mtha' dbyer med kyi dpe rgyun dkon pa'i gsung rab dpe tshogs dang / zhib 'jug pa tshos zhib 'jug 'bras bur bstan bcos gsar rtsom dang / dpe dkon 'tshol zhib kyis /gangs ljongs rigs pa 'i dpe tshogs/)sogs dpar skrun dgos pa'i mdzub ston gnang /bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling nas da lta a rir bzhugs pa'i sku 'bum dgon pa'i dgon bdag sakya rin po che dang / gud sir bzhugs pa'i khams rdza chu kha ba snga 'gyur snying ma'i bla' ma nam mkha' rin po che sogs/ bod dbus gtsang khul gyi bla sprul 50 dang / khams khul 30 lhag tsam/ a mdo nas 100tsam zhig bsdu skong gnang yod la/chos lugs thad dpal ldan sa skya pa dgu dang / dge lugs pa brgya dang drug cu re drug bka' brgyud pa bco lnga/ rnying ma pa nyer lnga/ rdo nang pa drug226

skya che'i smad kyai cha/skabs bzang po de nges par du chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i re ba zhu yi 'dug ces zhu ba gnang rogs gnang zhus pa yin/rgya don gyis kyang go skabs yag po zhig yin pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang ste/khong rang ngo mas phyag bris de rgya gar du bsnams nas/ tā la'i bla ma'i phyag tu phul te khong pe cing du nges par phebs thub pa'i kha ta bya myoglo rnam pa bstan byung /rjes la yi ge de rgya lo lags ngo mas tā la'i bla mar phul gnang yang / tā la'i bla mas khas len ma gnang ba red zer/134skabs de'i gnas tshul dngos ni 7gong sa mchog 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul la phebs 'dod byung ba ma zad/ gnas tshul de'i skor bod gzhung bka' shag la dgongs skor zhus 'dug 'on kyang /bka' shag gis rgya nag gzhung gi gdan zhu gnang mkhan gyi las khungs kyi go gnas dma' drags 'dug pas/ 7gong sa mchog 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul la phebs gnang mi yong ba'i thag gcod gnang 'dug135gnas tshul der gzhigs skabs/ nam rgyun nga tshos mgron brda 'byor tshes dang dngos gzhi chibs sgyur dbar nyin grangs 7 las med pas/dus tshod kyi cha nas phebs ma thub pa'i gsung tshul de yang zhib 'jug bya gzhi zhig red 'dug skabs der btsan byol bod gzhung gis/ 7gong sa mchog 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul du phebs par/ dang po/7gong sa mchog dang rgya nag gi dbu khrid ting dang mjal 'phrad dgos pa dang /gnyis pa/ 7gong sa mchog a mdo sku 'bum dgon du chibs sgyur chog pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gnyis bton nas/ phebs mi dgos pa thag gcod gnang 'dug 1 4bye yo 1993krung bo'i bod ljongs deb gsum pa /1 5skabs der bsa' rkye las thog yin pa sku ngo 'ju chen gyis ma ri'i kunaspeng bsnyan 'phrinathog gsungs/127

7paṇa chen ler te ni zhib ca'adugader brten/ 7gong sa mchog gis blo pham dang bcas bcar rgyu khas len ma byas gsungs/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun mi la ras pas/ pha khyod yod dus bu nga med/ /bu nga yod dus pha khyod med/ /gsungs pa ltar/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs/ btsan byol bod gzhung gi langs phyogs mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong min la/ btsan byol bod gzhung gi langs phyogs mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong yin dus/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po sku zhi bar gshegs zin/ gral mi 'grig pa'i gnas stangs ngan pa der/ 7gong sa mchog thugs phangs snang gi nyams dang bcas/7paṇa chen rin po che zhing gshegs de bzhugs yod na nga tsho phyi logs su bsdad/7paṇa chen rin po che bod nang bzhugs te/ thabs shes gang yong gnang rgyu yin pa gtan 'khel ba red/ de 'dra'i thog nas tan tan nus pa gang tsam thon thub rgyu yang da cha de ltar med pa red gsungs/136rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan rin po ches/ gal srid 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa da lta sku 'tsho bzhugs yod na/ bod kyi gnad don gang la gang 'tshams zhig thag gcod thub nas/ bod nang du byung ba'i don rkyen la drag gnon dang /bod kyi rig gzhung 'jig nyen/ khor yug gtor bshig mi rigs mthong chung gi thabs sdug nyam nga ba dag byung mi srid pa gsungs/137 stom tshig de dag ni 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i rin thang la lag len gyi steng nas nges pa rnyed pa'i dngos thog bden smra'i chod sdom zhig kyang yin/ /1 phyinas bya/shog ngos 7nang /phyi lo naXtre bla nanang /1 7phyi lo na ༷ sa da bod kyi mtho spob tu gnang ba'i bka' spob/128

skya tshe'i mi da kyi cha/le tshan brgyad pa/ bod khams zhabs kyis bcags pa/lo rabs 80 lo 'go nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gnas stangs de phyogs yongs nas phran bu'i slar gso byung zhing / mi lo 16 ring dar lung snyan gyis thos pa med cing phra chung spyan gyis gzigs snang du ma gyur pa'i gangs can bod kyi gdul bya rnams/ chos dad rang mos dang / rig gzhung nyams gso /don ldan rang skyong / dpal 'byor dar rgyas kyi gnas bab ji chags gzigs skor 'tshams 'drir phebs chog pa'i re 'dun rgya nag gzhung la thengs mang zhus kyang / rgya nag gzhung gi dpon rigs tsho'i sems su/ khong bod la phebs na/chab srid dang chos lugs kyi gnas bab 'jog tshul go 'dzol ba dang / chos lugs byed sgo spel thal che bas chos lugs thog gnad don lhag pa/ skyon cha gsungs pa las grub 'bras mi gsung pa'i blo dogs ji snyed cig byung ste/ bod la chibs sgyur gnang rgyu'i dgongs pa rtsa nas 'khrol mi 'dug1387paṇa chen rin po ches yang nas bskyar du re 'dun thengs mang zhus mthar/ krung dbyangs 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi 'go 'dzin yang cing ran gyis/ khong bod du phebs par chos lugs kyi tsha rlabs mi yong ba dang / bsam blo dang chab srid krung dbyang dang gcig gyur byed dgos pa/ lhag par mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur srung skyob byed dgos pa'i cha rkyen gsum zhal bzhes gnang tshe/me nangod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgregs/〈7ske 'o chen rin po che'e rjes dran ched deb/〉shogangos 110nang bod ljo ngas mi dmangs dpe byu nakhang /phyi lo 1989zla zhinang 129

7paṇa chena'ar te ni zhib 'jugabod la phebs chog pa'i chog mchan sprod rgyu yin pa bshad/1397paṇa chen rin po ches 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blang bya zhal bzhes gnang ste/ phyi lo 1980 lor/ mtsho sngon bod khul du rtog zhib la phebs rgyu'i sta gon gnang bzhin pa'i nyin zhig krung dbyang dmag ud kyi kru zhi ting zha'o phing dang btson grol rjes thog ma'i mjal 'phrad byung /ting zha'o phing gis/ khyed rang da res gsham rim du phebs dus/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kyi bya ba tshang ma nor 'khrul red ces gsung chogakhyed rang skrag mi dgos/ de dag ni krung dbyang gi 'go khrid tshos bshad pa red ces brjod chog pa bshad/ ting gi bka' rgya des 7paṇa chen rin po che'i 'das pa'i lo ngo nyi shu'i ring gi gyong kun dag kha gsab gnang rgyu'i rtsa che'i go skabs shig thob yod/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po btson grol rjes gang gi lte khrag 'pho sa'i ma yum mtsho sngon bod rigs sa khul /40dang / kun su'u bod rigs sa khul 14/gnyis su thengs dang po'i gzigs skor du phebs/ phyi lo 1980zla 7 tshes 1 nyin/ mtsho sngon sku 'bum brgyud chab char zhabs sor 'khod/gna' mi bod kyi gtam dper/ yul brag khug yin yang / phug ron nyi ma dro ba//zhes pa ltar/ khong mtsho sngon du phebs thub par dgyes tshor dpag med kyis nga rang dga' spro shin tu skyes/ nga rang mtsho sngon la brtse dung yod ces gsungs/mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi tang srid dmag sam gyi 'a khri las byed pa'i tshogs 'du bskongs te/ mi lo 20 ring rgya me 9bden don gsal ba'i sgron me/shog ngos 11༷nang /lha phrug yis brtsams/bde srung las khungs kyis par 'grem sa byas/phyi lo naX04lor/me zarang skyo nga khul cadang zi ling thad gtogs rdzong 1bcas khyon bod rigs ngong 8yo da/141bod rigs grong khyer 1dang rdzong 7yod /130

48 5 nya 'a jig rke7 skyu ra 〉/ dzo' mi ar+shakā ༄༄mi dhe mtsho/ga che thoX snyo 447770〈lilo7 4 ༄ 〉la 〉 〉 〉zlo tsha /tshi snyidzosabisko go〉kār/ rdu7744nes/r+sha༄7847 69 bsnas/ 55 chu ra lnga lhun〉〉〉༄ rtsibatsal33 7 6 7〉〉 ༄ r+sha〉ca4 la 4 lnga'i 〉〉〉〉to ༅rdo)rngotsho ridzā :pho( 5 tha / ༄snyal 〉 〉 no nye) tsha 'i blo tsha'o ga pharakhyir 〉pho tsho 〉 〉〉〉 cinagyi༄9 12༷ r+sha /phyi 〉 54)su sngarke sto rno ri lomir / // paX 69〉〉phroX'i 604 bo shubatso༄༄7 ༄༄rme tsha nga 56tsa n+d+ra 〈 shāgashes rke 4 ṭa74〉 ri pho byu sa lha ga mi te zigang pa ) pho /o tsho pa ༷ byu ༷kyi spyote 'i pa la saX ga / rterte ni4rjethemanya la pa ra cig co nga 'kho ra rdiX dīkhu tsho /55 4847 4 gyi nyu ( gas 0〉 sdu pa༄ ༅7 46 kho tsashāshā ne du4 spu ri ༄sna tsho zhe 4 7 / rkyo 497)pho 4 ༷〉〉 〉tsatsha 4sgo 'i༄ 4 〉lham 4 78byol ( 6dethol42 〉〉〉 〉〉༷ rke rkelas)tsho (3khu pho༄myu 'i ( 4359)rtsa444༄rdo tshokhu7 7 9 zlasti ༄4 5 07256༷༷〉tsayorar 94 7 6 97 8pa tā/ ho /rmo 4blo 'i kho ra ༄4neci sgo 4 47) 〉〉tshos 'a bye ༄la tsang gasgrusno ༷ ga tsho 4860ra lde sna snang 0 kār+sha675 sta3lkosaX༄༄༄shrī ra —ga' ju 〈5tso : ༄tha ra ༄ ༄ 2 4ci ra cu sa4 7 7 〉 khushā dzo ne sder/shā ri 534 tsa nga ༄༄shrīXmi9༄ ri848 ri rmerme chisang yinacigatsa sko7 ri / sna rna gu(4༄ poslotsha natsho06lo tsho ca 7 lon (7rdo dzā 9 ci la ༄ cha ga nyamisgyud rka nga shārnyi ba 〉ming ༄ 6 zhes rtse rke rabaci ngas lho〉 sgolho3 04 766 7 5 7shā sne 'a tshang stotshi saḥphuho rnyi ( 44 r+sā la sa/rdo 8 578 7/stosmyoXs :༄ 7 5 48na/li lormedza ༷ 7 0 4 las she cho ma tsho 477 6 (7 shāri so ri /mi ri4'tshori74rngo༄riX5zhe༄77074 7 7 4༄ ri ngari ga lto / 3 4rdzog/ sa)47 rirngo7smra ga ge rdzo gu ༷ rketo sa thosto nga mi rā 4 24 3 ༄ shā tshonu ba sgo'i ga/4 27 〉 (5〉spe las4 4 97 ri nga

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'dug rtsa ba nas sgo brgyab zin pa'i chos lugs kyi cho ga mngon gsal du spel chog pa'i rgyal sgo phye bas/ gzhi rim bod 'bangs rnams nang bstan slar dar gyi las 'gor 'jug pa'i skas 'dzegs thog ma bskrun/kha nas mi rigs slob 'bring gi 'bod sgra bsgrags kyang / don du sgo byang tsam bod yig bris med pa'i reb gong rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring dang /rtse khog rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring / gcan tsha rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring sogs kyi sgo byang bod yig gsar bzo dang / dpe mdzod gsar rgyag gi phyag gron zhal 'debs gnang / khul so so'i 'go khrid las byed pa'i tshogs chen bskongs te/ming don mtshungs pa'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong lag bstar don 'khyol dang /tang gi chos dad rang mos srid jus dngos 'bebs/ bod rigs sa khul gyi slob grwa khag tu/ bod kyi skad yig ang dang por sbyong spyod dgos pa'i dgongs 'char tsha nan gsungs/ lo de'i zla 11 tshes 23 nyin (zla 10 tshes 16 ma dzad rnam bden pa'i rang mdangs zhes par gong tshes 'khod/)mtsho sngon gyi rma lho pus mdo'i phab gzhis brgyud /kun su'u zhing chen gyi gan lho bod rigs sa khul bsang chu rdzong bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du zhabs sor 'khod/bla brang bkra shis 'khyil ni 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gdan sa yin la/ mdo smad mdo sngags rig gnas kyi bste gnas gal chen zhig kyang yin/bla brang bkra shis 'khyil dgon du 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa thub bstan chos kyi nyi mas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen gnang myong ba ma zad/ mgon po gang nyid kyi yongs 'dzin bla ma bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi gdan sa yang yin pas/bkra shis 'khyil du zhabs sor 'khod par thugs la dgyes tshor med pa ci la srid /1 32

kyi che'i mi da kyi cha/rin po che bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du zhabs sor 'khod ma thag yongs 'dzin bla ma bla kho rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gdung rten la mjal kha zhus shing / bla brang dgon pa nyams gso legs po dgos pa'i bka' rgya gnang / bsang chu rdzong du mang tshogs tshogs chen dang / rnga pa khul gyi rim pa khag gi tang srid dbu khrid kyi bzhugs mol tshogs chen bskongs te/chos dad rang mos dang / mi rigs srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol dgos pa'i tshogs chen bskongs rjes/ mtsho sngon rtse khog dang kun su'u yi gan rgya'i rtswa sa rtsod gleng gi don rkyen las mi bsad byung ba'i khyim la 'tshams gzigs thugs gsos gnang /zla 11 tshes 15 dad ldan mang tshogs la sman bla dang / tshe lha rnam gsum sogs kyi ljags lung dang sbrags mjal mang bstsal/ zla 12 tshes 3mi mang la tshe dbang gnang dus/ pe cing du rgyal yongs nang bstan tshogs 'du la phebs dgos pa'i snyan seng 'byor bas/ kun sto bod rigs sa khul gyi 'tshams gzigs rtog zhib gnang mtshams bzhag ste/ lo rjes ma'i zla 4/5 kan su'u dang zi khron du 'ong zhes gsungs te pe cing du chibs kha bsgyur/ thengs der nyin grangs 151 ring 'tshams gzigs rtog zhib gnang yod/142phyi lo 1982 zla 6 tshes 29 nas zla 8 tshes 24 bar gyi nyin grangs 55 ring / mi lo 18 ring zhal bral ba'i bod dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du zhabs sor 'khod/ de ni 7paṇa chen bcu pa btson grol rjes bod khul du phebs thengs gnyis pa dang / bod dbus gtsang du phebs thengs dang po yin/chibs sgyur gyi dgongs don gtso bo/ phyi lo 1980 lor/ krung dbyang chab srid cus kyis bod kyi las don gtan 'bebs byas pa lag bstar don 'khyol ji byung 1437pa ṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa kun stor phebs pa /(7na lha 'i lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs//kan sgo srid gros shu yon lhan lang gis par/1 33

7paṇa chen mar te ni zhing 'jugal rtog zhib dang / slad phyin phyug po dang / shes rig ldan pa'i bod ljongs gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i mdzub khrid gnang rgyu gtso bo yin/7paṇa chen rin po che gong dkar gnam thang du gnam gru las bshol ma thag bod /dbus gtsang /)ni nga'i pha yul gnyis pa yin la rang nyid kyi khyim tshang yang yin/ 'di gar 7paṇa chen rim byung gi gtso dgon yod pas/ngos rang bod la dmigs bsal gyi brtse dung dang / dga' zhen/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu bod dang / bod kyi mi dmangs/ bod kyi ri klung rtsi shing / bod mi dmangs kyi bde sdug bcas dran gyi 'dug ces/ khong nyid bod dbus gtsang du zhabs sor 'khod thub par dga' skyo'i thugs tshor gsungs/brnyan 'phrin brgyud dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi mi mang rnams la/mjal rten 'khyer mi dgos/ nga ni bod kyi spyi don sgrub ched yong ba las/ sger don du mjal rten bsdu bar yong ba ma yin pas/ khyed tsho mjal khar yong skabs mjal rten rtsa ba nas 'khyer mi dgos/ nga'i 'tsho ba ha cang yag po yod/mang tshogs kyi 'bul rten gang yang mi dgos/ mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba yag po yod na nga lhag par du dga' po 'dug ngos kyi las 'gan ang dang po de/ bod kyi sa khul du blta zhib byas nas phyogs yongs kyi gnas stangs la shes rtogs thub pa bya rgyu de yin/ bod kyi thun min rig gnas srung skyob dang / dka' ngal dang nor 'khrul yod pa'i gnas stangs khag yar rgyas gtong ched/ ngos nas bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dbu khrid tshor snyan seng zhu rgyu yin zhes gsungs/mi lo 18 zhal gyes zhus pa'i dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du slar yang zhabs sor 'khod skabs/ rje btsun mi la ras pa lto brag mar pa'i drung nas/pha yul mang yul gung thang gi skya rnga rtsa ru phebs dus kyi snang tshul dang gnyis su 134

skya tshe'i mi da kyai cha/ma mchis pa ni/ pho brang po ta la dang / nor bu gling kha/ gdan sa gsum dang /bkra shis lhun po/ sa skya dgon pa/ snar thang dgon pa sogs bod brgyud nang bstan gyi dgon pa dang / dgon pa de dag tu bzhugs pa'i lha sku rten gsum gyi /rgya cha 99 rtsa gtor phyin pa'i gnas tshul la thugs pham tshad med 'khrungs phyi lo 1982 zla 7 tshes 17 nyin/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'go khrid las byed pa'i tshogs 'du skong gnang ste/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyis lo mang ring chos lugs srid jus lhug gtong byed rgyu las ldog ste dam drag byas yod pa'i skyon brjod gnang ba ma zad/ tre la ci / ci bye 〉 shāris ——— tsho ——rtse ri — ————— ——— wa snye — wa ga snyeri mi tsho ri/sna sa muñtsaraḥ/༷/lngetshad/sdig4 / ri //rdori gci ༷ r+sha — ci / ci'i ri (pe ci mi 4 ri morngotsho ri chu sku gyi ri 4//shā ri cing 44 ci byusha rdo pyi cirin)dzha ༷ga ri — 44 — 3 /༷/ci shāXri du ri/sgo ga ji / chi risgyu sku ga ci ri:ri( ri las ra ri rdo ririg ( ri zhe/shā /sgo pas rī //ston ri tsho /sku sna ///): ri'i ci ri mi lhobasdiskyiXsdu mikyi lha tshone sdu pa0swāX ri ci waX ṭā (phyi lo 1982 lor 7pa ṇa chen rin po che dbus gtsang du chibs sgyur/)bod mi mang gi chos dad bsam blo'i dgos mkho skong ched/ bdag cag gi ston pa dngos kyis rab gnas byin 'bebs gnang zhing rgya bza' kong jos rgya nag nas gdan zhu gnang ba'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i bzhugs gnas/135

7paṇa chen mar te ni zhib 'dus dbus 'gyur lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi chos grwar/ dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi mi mang khri tsho 30 tsam la mjal phyag bka' slob rtsol dus/ mi tshogs kyi 'tshang kha'i khrod du las can skyes bu gcig tshe las 'das pa ma zad/ bco brgyad lhag tsam mi tshogs kyi rdog brdzis 'og rmas skyon byung / shod rgyun du/ dad ldan pa 'gas 7paṇa chen rin po che'i chibs 'khor gyi 'khor rjes la'ang lce ldag kyang brgyab skad/jo shāka rnam gnyis dang / nor bu gling kha/ se ra/ 'bras spungs/ dga' ldan/ rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sde/ zha lu/ bkra shis lhun po/ gnas snying /sa skya dgon pa dang bcas par gnas mjal dang / dad ldan bod mi khri tsho dang khri tshor mjal kha tshe dbang gnang / dbus gtsang gi grong gseb dang / 'brog khul/slob grwa/ bzo grwa khag la 'tshams gzigs gnang skabs/ rig gsar skabs bathedz+ran 'a(1ga byas pa'i ngesad mi rnams dkar 'acesan dag serwaku gnang zhing /mjal rten mi dgos gsungs kyang / bod mi mang gis dad pas phul ba'i mjal rten ma bzhes ka med byung ba dag dmangs nas blangs te dmangs la spyod pa'i mdzad thabs bskyangs te/ sa gnas de nas phul ba'i mjal rten rnams/sa gnas de gar slob grwa dang sman khang gnyer ched zhal 'debs phul/bod rang skyong ljongs tang srid dmag gsum gtsos rim khag dbu khrid tshor/ las khungs khag gi sgo byang bod yig 'bri dgos pa dang / dgon pa khag nyams gso/ grwa btsun gyi 'tsho bar lta skyong gi skyob gso sprod dgos pa/rin med sman bcos/ slob gso gong spel/ nyam thag slob phrug rin med slob sbyong gi go skabs sprod dgos pa sogs/ zhing 'brog mi mang gi kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi dka' ngal ji snyed cig kha yod lag yod kyis thag gcod gnang /136

skya che'i sma da kyai cha/ 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po'i dbyar dus kyi bzhugs sgar/ nor gling rtag brtan mi 'gyur gling du gnas mjal zhu dus/ las smon thugs 'dris zab pa'i bod gangs can ljongs kyi chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid/ 7skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po'i bzhugs khri stong par mjal skabs/ thugs kyi mtsho mo dran pa'i rlung gis g.yos te/7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang ngos gnyis ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rjes 'jug pa zhig yin la/ lo rgyus thog dge ldan pa'i ring lugs gsar gtod mdzad mkhan/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i chos brgyud 'dzin mkhan mched grogs dam pa zhig kyang yin/ mes rgyal dang rgyang thag ring por bzhugs pa'i 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa zhe drags dran gyi/ zhes nam rgyun blo rgya nam mkha' las yangs par grags pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/ 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po dran pa'i gdung 'bod dbang med du shor/phyi lo 1982 zla 9 tshes 20 nas zla 10 tshes 21 bar/ nyin grangs 31 ring kun su'u bod rigs sa khul du gzigs skor rtog zhib tu zhabs sor 'khod/ de ni 7paṇa chen rin po che bod khul la phebs thengs gsum pa dang /kun su'u bod rigs sa khul du phebs thengs gnyis pa yin/ chibs sgyur gyi dgongs don ni dbul zhing phongs pa'i bod mi mang la rdzun 'phyugs bston gsum thebs pa'i gyod gzhi dkar 'don dang / tang gi mi rigs srid jus dang chos lugs srid jus don 'khyol dngos 'bebs/ da dung bod rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas slob gso gong spel slad rtsad zhib dang mdzub ston gyi mdzad 'phrin skyong rgyu/ zhor la bla brang du bzhugs pa'i yongs 'dzin bla kho rdo rje 'chang gi sku gdung la mchod 'bul zhu rgyu sogs yin/137

7paṇa chen nar te ni gizha 'jugathengs der gan su'u zhing chen khongs kyi bod rigs sa khul bsang chu rdzong dang / co ne rdzong / bā tse rdzong / 'brug chu rdzong / the bo rdzong / rma chu rdzong /klu chu rdzong bcas/ zhing chen 'dir yod kyi bod rigs sa khul gyi rdzong khag bdun gyi dad ldan mang tshogs kyi chos dad dgos mkho dang / 'tsho ba'i dpal 'byor/chos dad rang mos/ dgon sde nyams gso/ bod skad yig sbyong spyod/ shes ldan mi sna gso skyong gi gal che'i bya bar lam ston dgongs 'char dang / srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol dgos pa'i skul ma gnang ba ma zad/ slob gso yar bskul la smin pa'i zhal 'debs krung sgor khri drug gnang / dad ldan mi mang chig 'bum brgyad khri lhag la mjal mang dang / dmigs brtse ma/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/byams smon/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ rigs gsum mgon po/ bstan 'bar ma sogs kyi ljags lung bstsal/phyi lo 1982 zla 9 tshes 21 nyin/ si khron /43zhing chen khongs kyi bod rigs sa khul la gzigs skor rtog zhib tu phebs/ chibs sgyur de ni rin po che si khron bod rigs sa khul la phebs thengs dang po yin/ rin po ches kun su'u bod rigs sa khul gyi tang srid dmag gsum gyi phebs skyel dang bcas/ zla 9 tshes 21 si khron zhing che rnga pa khul mdzod dge rdzong / rnga pa rdzong / 'bar khams rdzong /dpal skyid/ thugs rje chen po'i sa khul gyi bod rigs mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dang /chos lugs kyi dgos mkho dang / chos dad rang mos/ dgon pa nyams gso/bod skad yig dar spel/ ched las mi sna gso skyong/ bzo grwa khag gi lag rtsal gong mtho'i ched chos srid gnyis thad nas lam ston mdzub khrid dang / kirti dgon par rnga yul stod smad bar gsum gyi mi mang khri phrag brgal bar mjal mang bstsal/meji dar rtse ma do gtso bo byas pa'i lams khulagyi rdzong khag bcu dgu dang /'bar khams gtsos pa'i mdo smad kyi rjong khag bcu bzhi yo da/138

skya che'i mi da kyi cha/'bar khams mi mang la rdzi 'gag gi rur mjal mang bka' chos gnang rjes/ rgyal rong khog tu lha sa'i jo bo dang dang mtshungs pa'i grags can gyi thugs rje chen po'i gtsug lag khang bskyar gso/ bai ro'i gnas ri dang /tsha kho ngag dbang grags pa'i sku gdung sogs la gnas gzigs grub rjes/'bar khams mi rigs dge 'os slob grwar gzigs zhib dang / khrin tu'u na yod pa'i gnas chen khag tu mchod mjal la phebs zhor/ lho nub mi rigs slob gas gdan zhus ltar phebs/slob chen der mi rigs las byed par rang gi mi rigs kyi don du skad cha shod rgyu'i thob thang yod la/ skad cha yang nges par du shod dgos/ de 'dra byas na da gzod mi rigs las byed pa'i nus pa thon thub rgyu red/ lto nub mi rigs slob grwa 'di dmigs bsal mi rigs kyi slob grwa chen po zhig yin stabs/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed gang mang gso skyong byed dgos pa ma zad/ rang mi rigs la sha tsha zhing la rgya ldan pa'i 'du shes spel dgos pa'i skul ma gnang /phyi lo 1984 zla 9 tshes 14 nas 17 bar/ kun su'u zhing chen khong dpa' ris bod rigs rang skyong rdzong du phebs/ de ni kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che bod khul la byon thengs bzhi pa dang kun su'u bod rigs sa khul la chibs sgyur gnang ba thengs gsum pa yin/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches shin cang yul gur rang skyong ljongs su 'tshams 'dri gzigs skor gyi las don grub nas/pe cing du phyir log byon pa'i bar lam nas kun su'u zhing chen na/ bod rigs rang skyong rdzong gcig tu kha gyar ba'i dpa' ris bod rigs rang skyong rdzong du 'tshams 'dri rtog zhib tu chibs kha bsgyur ba zhig red/rin po ches dpa' ris bkra shis phyug lung rtswa thang du dpa' ris mi 139

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugamang la mjal ja dang / tshe lha rnam gsum/ rigs gsum mgon po/ sham bha la'i smon lam/ skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ dmigs brtse ma sogs kyi dbang lung gnang ba dang / rdzong tang srid dmag gi 'go khrid tshogs 'du bskongs te/srid jus don 'khyol lag bstar nan du dgos pa'i bka' slob dang / gsar du btsugs pa'i dpa' ris rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring dang / mchod rten thang bkra shis dar rgyas gling dgon/ yar lung thur chen dga' ldan byams pa gling dgon sogs la gzigs skor/ bod skad yig bod kyi srol rgyun rig gzhung /mi rigs kyi gyon chas gyon te bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun bzang po rnams mi nyams gong spel dgos pa'i bka' slob bka' bkyon ji snyed cig gnang ste pe cing du phebs/phyi lo 1985 zla 8 tshes 27 nyin/ bod dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du zhabs sor 'khod/ de ni 7paṇa chen rin po che bod khul du zhabs sor 'khod thengs lnga pa dang / bod dbus gtsang du phebs thengs gnyis pa yin/chibs sgyur gyi dgongs don snying po bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes te lo ngo nyi shu 'khor ba'i dus bon srung brtsi dang / bod phyi lo 1984 gtan la phab pa'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi bca' khrims bzhin/ bod du srid jus don 'khyol ji yod la rtog zhib ched chibs kha bsgyur/zla 9 tshes lha sa'i mdzad sgo khag grub rjes krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa pe cing du phyir log pa dang / 7paṇa chen rin po che bod du bzhugs te lha sa dang / gzhis rtse/ sto kha/ nag chu bcas kyi zhing 'brog mi mang gi 'tsho ba'i bde sdug dang / slob grwa'i shes yon/ 'phrod bsten mthun rkyen/ bzo grwa'i lag rtsal/dgon pa'i chos lugs rang dbang / rim khag las byed pas bod du mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol ji gnang la rtog zhib gnang 140

sku tshe'i mi da kyai cha/ste/ bod ljongs kyi kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi dka' ngal ji snyed cig kha yod lag yod kyis thag gcod gnang /zla 9 tshes daX gtsang ljongs gzhis rtse bde chen skal bzang pho brang du/ gtsang khul mi mang khri tsho du mar bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang bzhi sta gon dang phyag dbang bka' slob stsal/gtsang smad kyi mi mang la 'tshams gzigs grub mtshams/ gtsang stod khul gyi lha rtse rdzong dang / ngam ring rdzong / sa skya rdzong gsum la gzigs zhib tu phebs/gtsang stod lha rtse rdzong du 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos gsar bzhengs gnang bar grags shing / gtsang stod khul du snyan pa'i grags pa che ba'i lha rtse chos sde dga' ldan 'og min gling la gnas gzigs grub pa dang sbrags/ rdzong dpon dang 'brel yod 'go khrid tshor lha rtse khul gyi 'tsho ba rab 'bring tha gsum gyi mang tshogs kyi khyim du 'tshams gzigs sne 'khrid dgos pa'i bka' phebs/ rdzong dpon gyis 'thag las ched gnyer ba rmo bo sgrol ma'i khyim du sne 'khrid zhus/rin po che rmo bo sgrol ma'i khyim du phebs pa dang / 'thag khri'i steng gi snam bur phyag gis phur phur gnang bzhin sbyin bdag la thugs brtse chen pos/khyed rang chos snam bu btags nas so so gyon yas red dam/ yang na phyi la phran bu 'tshong gi yod/ srid jus lag bstar ci ltar 'dug las byed pas spyod tshul gang 'dra 'dug chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus don 'khyol yag po byed kyi 'dug gam zhes bka' 'dri gnang ba dang / de rjes mgar ba rdo rje'i khyim du phebs/mgar ba rdo rje ni gtsang stod lha rtse'i khul du so nam zhing las la mkho ba'i lcags bzo ba zhig yin la/ khong gis bzos pa'i lha rtse'i bod gri zhes bzo lta legs shing che chung 'tsham pa'i gri de/ lo rabs 80 nang bod dbus gtsang du brin 141

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhib 'jugakha rgyugs shing rgyal phyi rgyal nang du dar khyab byung yod/spyir bod khul spyi dang yang sgos gtsang khul gyi goms srol ngan pa zhig la/ lcags balnga'i las ka gnyer ba'i rigs la mgar ba zhes rigs ngan du lta ba'i 'du shes 'gyur slad/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis rdo rje dang khong stan thog gcig gi steng dpung pa mnyam gshib kyis sdod du 'jug gnang ba dang /rdo rje'i khyim gyi 'tsho ba dang lag shes kyi skor la bka' rtsad phebs/nam rgyun mchod bsgoms nang bshams shing/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rnam spral du dad mos zhu ba'i 7paṇa chen rin po che mchogarigs ngan mgar ba'o las su bskos pa rdo rje rang nyid dang dpung pa mnyam gshib kyis stan thog gcig la 'dug dus/ rdo rje'i sems pa rbad de 'khums te rin po che'i bka' rtsad la/ bka' lan yang ji bzhin rgyag mi thub pa 7paṇa chen bcu pas mkhyen rjes/ rdo rje'i phrag par phyag gi rdab rdab mdzad bzhin/khyod kyis gus lugs zhe drags byed mi dgos/ dus rabs 'gyur tshar ba red/khyod rang bzo pa dang nga las byed pa yin pas/ nga tsho tshang ma 'dra mnyam yin na mchog dman gyi dbye ba med gsung bzhin rdo rje'i bzo las skor la bka' rtsad gnang /mgar ba rdo rje 7paṇa chen rin po che'i mdzad tshul la sems 'gul tshad med thebs te/ rdo rje'i khyim du thang stong rgyal pos lcags dung skabs spyad myong ba'i tho gdan cig dang / lha rtse'i lcags zam 'dzugs dus lhag pa'i lcags long gcig khyim rgyud kyi g.yang du nyar nyar ba yod kyang / rig gnas gsar brje'i rnying bzhi rtsa gtor gyi skabs/ khyim rgyud kyi nor bu de gnyis brlag nyen yod par bsams te/ grong phyi'i ljon shing chen po zhig gi rtsar sbas pa da bar du 142

skya che'i mi da kyi cha/bsdad yod pa bton nas rin po cher 'a bul 'dod yod ces zhus/7paṇa chen rin po ches/ khyod kyis bod kyi rig rdzas rtsa chen gnyis srung skyob thub pa ni/ bya ba gal 'gangs shin tu che ba zhig byas pa'i bstod bsngags gnang ste/ gtsang stod ngam ring rdzong du chibs thon gnang /gtsang stod ngam ring rdzong khul ni rje tsong kha pa chen pos bka' bzhi'i grwa skor gyi dam bca' 'jog sa dang / kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng dang po mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gi 'khrungs yul yang yin/ khul 'dir ngam ring chos sde byams pa mi 'gyur gling yang yod/ bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi skabs ngam ring rdzong ni bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i chos gzhis rdzong chen zhig yin pas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog ngam ring du phebs thub par thugs la dgyes tshor los kyang yong / khri gdugs nyi ma dgung du lding dus/ 7paṇa chen rin po che ngam ring du phebs 'byor zin/ nyin gung gi gsol tshigs grub pa dang ngam ring rdzong slob 'bring du gzigs zhib tu phebs/ rin po che bod khul du chibs kha nam bsgyur la mdzad brel ha cang che bas/ phyag las la nyin mtshan gyi dbye ba med/ngam ring du phebs pa'i nyin de yang / mtshan mo'i glog sgron 'og tu ngam ring rdzong tang srid dmag gsum gyi dbu khrid bzhugs mol tshogs 'du bskongs/rdzong tang ud dang rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gnyis kyis/ ngam ring zhing 'brog mi dmangs la srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol ji ltar gnang lugs kyi las bsdoms snyan seng la thugs ma dgyes pas/ de mur snyan seng mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i bka' phebs pa dang sbrags/ ngam ring rdzong gi slad phyin gyi zhing 'brog mi mang gi ched du srid jus lag bstar ji 'gab lam ston bka' 143

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib rngubazhugaslob gnang / bzhugs mol tshogs 'dur bzhugs pa'i ngam ring rdzong gi tang srid dbu khrid dang / gzhis rtse sa gnas/ bod rang skyong ljongs 'brel yod dbu khrid rnam pas rin ngo che'i mdzub khrid bka' slob tsha tsha 'ur 'ur ngang zin thor bkod skabs/7paṇa chen rin po ches bka' slob gnang zhor du/ dbu g.yon du sgur te hru'u cir gzigs tsam gnang ba dang / g.yas su sgur te rdzong dpon la gzigs tsam gnang rjes/ thugs dgongs 'tshoms chen pos/ gsung ma byon par bzhugs/ dus kyi skar cha gsum tsam phyin rjes/ da 'di 'dra red/ngas bod skad brgyab/ khong gnyis /ngam ring rdzong gi sred gzhung rdzong dpon dang tang ud kyi hru'u ci/)kyi rgya yig gis zin tho bkod gsungs/ rin po ches ljags dbugs ring po zhig 'then pa dang sbrags/ de yang g.yon gyi srid jus kyi nor 'khrul dang lhad skyon zhig red ces gsungs/144phyi nyin der phyi lo 1969 gtsang stod lha ngam phun gsum nas/rgya nag la gzhung la ngo rgol gyen langs byed skabs kyi 'go khrid mi sna/ rdzong rtse ba rgyal mtshan sogs ngam ring gi dpa' rgod drug dmar gsod gtong yul/ngam ring skyems mtsho'i 'gram ngogs slong mkhan sgang thog tu ngam ring rdzong dang /lha rtse rdzong / sa skya/ ding ri/ sa dga' rdzong / 'brong pa rdzong bcas kyis dad ldan mi mang khri tsho brgal bar bka' chos dang mjal mang / ngam ring dgon pa bzhengs phyogs kyi skor la lam ston dang / ma dngul zhal 'debs bstsal te lha ldan du phyir phebs gnang /zla 11 tshes 20 nyin bod btsan po'i 'byung gnas lto kha sa khul rtsed 144 gangs ljongs reg sanas/199 dus deb/spen pa tshe ring brtsams/144

skya che'i smad kyai cha/thang grong rdal dang / 'phyongs rgyas/ sne gdong / grwa nang rdzong / gong dkar rdzong sogs su rtog zhib kyis/ rig gnas gsar brje rtsa med gtong dgos pa dang /g.yon gyi bsam blo gtsang sel/ srid jus lhug gtong / dpal 'byor 'khrug gtong / thon skyed gong 'phel/ lhag par du mi rigs srid jus/ chos lugs don 'khyol/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur las ka yag po bya dgos pa'i skul ma dang /bod ni rang skyong ljongs shig yin pas tang gi srid jus dang / rtsa khrims nang gsal ba'i gtan 'bebs ltar mi rigs kyi skad yig bed spyod byed rgyur mthong chen byed pa/ mi rigs kyi yul srol goms gshis la brtsi 'jog byas te rang skyong gi khe dbang nged spyod gang legs byed dgos pa'i tshogs chen dang /dad ldan ma/nga tshogs la bka' chos dang mjal mang gnang /lto khar zhugs ring bod rje'i bang so dang / yum bu bla khang / khra 'brugabasam yas sogs la phebs nas rig dngos gna' shul nyams gso dang / srung skyob bya lugs mdzub khrid bka' slob tsha nan gnang ba ma zad/ gong dkar du chibs sgyur skabs/ lho kha sa khul dang gong dkar rdzong gi tang srid dbu khrid tshos skyid gshongs ra smad dgon la chos lugs kyi goms srol ltar/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher maṇa shel rten 'dod 'bul ba'i las 'gan sprad/skabs der ra smad dgon du phyi lo 1959 gong gi dge 'dun pa bzhi las lhag med cing / dge 'dun pa bzhi po des rin po cher rten 'dod 'bul skabs/ rin po ches skyid gshongs ra smad dgon la dge 'dun pa ga tshod yod pa'i bka' rtsad gnang / dge 'dun pa ga ge mo zhig gis nga tsho bzhi las med/ nga tsho bzhi ni bod la dus 'gyur ma byung gong gi dge 'dun pa yin/skyid gshongs ra smad dgon par srid jus don 'khyol rtsa ba nas ma byung zhing /145

7pa ṇa chen yer te gi zhing 'jugasrid jus don 'khyol yong ba'i re 'dun thengs mang zhus kyang / lan rtsa ba nas phebs ma byung zhes zhus/145 yid skyo dgos pa'i snyan seng de 7paṇa chen rin po che'i snyan du gsan pa dang / tshogs thog de ga rang nas ra smad dgon gyi sa khang bdag dbang ra smad dgon pa rang la phyir sprod dgos pa dang / ra smad dgon du dge 'dun pa lnga bcu gsar bcug chog pa'i bka' 'khrol gnang /146grwa nang rdzong du phebs skabs bod kyi lo rgyus thog skad grags yod la yun ring lo rgyus ldan pa'i dgon pa dang po de bsam yas yin pas/ de na rang rang ngo mas rgyal srid spyi khyab khang la snyan seng zhu rgyu yin la/ ljongs tang ud dang mi dmangs srid gzhung / lho kha sa gnas/ grwa nang rdzong sogs nas rgyab skyor shugs chen byas te/ bsam yas gtsug lag khang nyid snga ma ji bzhin nyams gso 'dzugs skrun byed dgos pa gsungs/ phyi lo 1986 7paṇa chen bcu pas zhu 'bod 'og rgyal khab nas gser khe 50407/6 dang / krung sgor khri 1000000'gro gron btang bas/ phyi lo 1989 bsam yas dgon pa rtsa ba'i cha nas nyams gso legs par grub/ cilho kha'i chibs sgyur grub mtshams nag chu sa khul gyi 'brog pa mang tshogs la 'tshams gzigs su chibs kha bsgyur/ shod rgyun la/ byang nag chu sa khul gyi tang srid dmag gsum dang 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis/ rta dmag ru sgrig dang /nam mkhar me mgyogs 'phen pa'i che bstod dang bcas phebs bsu zhus/ nag chu zhabs brtan dgon pa'i tshogs chen rdo gcal steng / byang nag chu'i dad ldan ming mang khri tsho lnga drug cig la mjal kha dang / nag chu sa khul gyi glog bsnyan 145lo rabs caXdang za nang nang dkar rdzong srid gzhung ra smad dgon du btsugs pa dang /lo rabs naXnang dgon pa 'i sa khang bdag dbang dgon par phyir log byas mi 'dug14kyis ra ma tho slob kyi bdo sprod slo ba dpon 'jam dpal shes rabs la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/phyi lo naX11zla tshes zhinan/ 146

sku che'i smad kyai cha/khang gi thang chen steng / lam rim gsol 'debs dang / yon tan gzhi gyur ma/skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya gsum gyi bka' chos/ mi rigs rang gi goms gshis bdag nyar gces skyong dang / bod skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod dgos pa'i bka' slob gnang /nag chu sa khul tang srid dmag gsum gyi 'go khrid las byed pa'i tshogs chen bskongs te/ bod nag chu'i 'brog pa mang tshogs la srid jus don 'khyol dang / chos dad rang mos/ bod skad yig slob khrid gtso 'dzin dgos pa'i dgongs 'char gsungs te/ zla 11 tshes 25 nyin phyir lha sar phebs te bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tang srid gnyis la mi rigs srid jus dang / chos lugs srid jus/ slob gso'i srid jus gsum la dgongs 'char drug bton nas de dag lag bstar dngos 'bebs dgos pa gsungs te/ phyi lo 1985lo'i bod khul gzigs skor legs par grub ste pe cing du chibs kha bsgyur/phyi lo 1986 zla 1 tshes 7 nas 16 bar/ rig gnas gsar brje'i rlung 'tshub khrod/ mi lo 20 rtsa chad du gyur pa'i lha sa'i smon lam chen mo slar gso'i ched bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar zhabs sor 'khod/ de ni 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog bod khul la zhabs sor 'khod pa thengs drug pa dang / bod dbus rigatsang du zhabs sor 'khod pa thengs gsum pa yin/ chibs sgyur gyi snying don lha sa'i smon lam chen mo bskyar gso gnang rgyu yin/ lha sa'i smon lam chen mo ni/ston ston pa shākya thub pas rgya gar gyi grong khyer mnyan yod du/ phyi lo'i ston gyi 511me 'brug zla 1 tshes 1 nas tshes 15 bar mu stegs ston pa drug dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran pa dang / tshes 8 nyin mu stegs ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa tshar bcad de rnam par rgyal ba dran gso zhu ched/ rgya gar du cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus ston dar/147

7paṇa chen ber te ni zhib 'dugasngon byon ston pa'i rnam thar/ rjes 'jug gdul bya'i nyam len zhes pa ltar/ phyi lo 1409 dge lugs bstan pa'i srol gtod rje tsong kha pas/jo bo'i sku la dbu rgyan dang mchod pa sna tshogs bshams shing / tshes 8 dang 15 gser chab kyis bsnyen bkur tshogs mchod dpag med mdzad pa dang /dar chen bco lnga rang rang gi phyogs su btsugs te dge 'dun khri phrag la bsnyen bkur ba'i srol bzang las lha sa'i smon lam bskyar gso gnang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyi dge 'dun gtsos dge 'dun khri phrag gi tshogs mgon du/ 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po tshogs phebs kyi smon lam tshugs srol yod/phyi lo 1613 lor/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos rgyan gyis/mi lo drug ring lha sa'i smon lam chen mo'i tshogs mgon du phebs shing / dge bshes mkhas pa 'dems sgrug gis smon lam tshogs dbur mtshan nyid dam bca' bzhag ste/ rnam 'grel dang / dbu ma/ phar phyin/ 'dul ba/ mdzod bcas gzhung chen lnga bgro gleng byas pa brgyud/ mtshan nyid bzang rim kyi ang dang gnyis la/dge bshes lha rams bzhes pa'i mtshan srol gsar du btod pa'i chos kyi dus chen chen po ste/ lha ldan smon lam che mo'i zhes pa de'o/phyi lo 1966 lor/ rig gnas gsar brje'i drag char dang rlung 'tshub khrod rtsa ba nas med pa bzos pa'i bod brgyud nang bstan gyi chos kyi dus chen rlabs po che de dag slar gso gnang rgyu de yang / bstan pa bskyar dar gyi mdzad khur bsnams bzhin pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i thugs 'gan dor du med pa zhig yin stabs/ mi lo 20 bar mtshams chad pa'i lha sa'i smon lam chen mo bskyar gso gnang bar chibs kha bsgyur/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ da res ngos rang yong nas 148

kyi tshe'i smad kyi cha/'gan tshang ma 'khur te gtso skyong byas pa yin la/ ngo sa la shes bya yon tan dang nus pa gang yang med/ rang nyid kyis 'jon na'ang red/ ma 'jon na'ang red/da res kyi las ka 'di byed dgos kyi 'dug ngos kyi re bar mi ring bar 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bod la phebs te smon lam chen mo sogs chos phyogs kyi gal che'i thugs 'gan bzhes pa'i smon 'dun gnang bar ma zad/7gong sa mchog dang rin po che sku nyid kyi dbar dam sel med pa'i mched grogs shig yin pa/ bod kyi chos lugs khag dang chol gsum bod rigs nang khul mthun lam dgos pa'i chos srid bka' slob bstsal/ smon lam ched khyon gron dngul sgor 167000 bstsal zhing / 'brog ri bo dga' ldan pa'i dge bshes 'brog mi byams pa blo gros dga' ldan khri tshab tu bskos shing / ser smad dge bshes ye shes dbang phyug sogs/ dge bshes rtse phud bzhi la dge bshes lha rams pa'i phyag rtags bstsal ba dang / nang bstan yang dar kyi rten 'brel du lha sa'i dar chen bzhi'i steng bkra shis dar chen zhes pa gsar 'dzugs dang //47 byams pa gdan 'dren dang / bco lnga mchod pa/ jo bo'i rag rdo tshun gyi mdzad sgo khag tshang ma'i gtso skyong gnang zhing / slar phyin smon lam chen mo'i byed sgo khag sngar bas 'thus tshang gra rgyas su gtong dgos pa'i gal che'i bka' slob gnang //48cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes 8 nyin 'du tshogs la bsnyen bkur zab rgyas gnang ba ma zad/ rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che hu'u cin ha gtsos tang dang /dmangs 'thus/ srid gzhung / chab gros kyi dbu khrid rnams sbyin bdag gi tshogs gral du 'khod/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang srid dmangs chab bzhi'i (tang dang /147dar chen la'an bzhi 'i/dga' lngan ngar chen/tha ba skya reng dar chen/bskal bzang ngar chen/jus yag dar chen/142bod ljongs nang bstan/phyi lo 1985deb srung smo/'og ngos 104nang /149

7paṇa chen nar te ne+e zhing 'jugasrid gzhung / chab gros/ dmangs 'thus//drung yig chen mo bzhis spos skor la phebs pa de/gung khran tang gis bod brgyud nang bstan la de snga byas ma myong zhing / phyis kyang 'byung mi srid pa'i gus zhabs dang thugs khur de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi thugs rje'i sku drin dang stobs shugs kho na las byung ba zhig yin pa lo rgyus kyi bden dpang byed kyi 'dugaphyi lo 1986 zla 1 tshes 227nyin/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dge 'os ched sbyong slob grwa'i tshad 'dzin slob gtsor gdan zhus ltar phebs/ de ni 7paṇa chen rin po che bod rigs sa khul la zhabs sor 'khod pa thengs bdun pa dang /mtsho sngon bod rigs sa khul la chigs sgyur gnang thengs gsum pa yin/ chibs sgyur gyi dgongs snying gtso bo mtsho sngon bod yig dge 'os ched sbyong slob grwa'i slob gzhi/ sgrig gzhi/ las sgrub mdzub khrid dang / zhor du mtsho sngon gyi bod rigs sa khul gyi chos srid bya bar rtog zhib gnang rgyu yin/ mtsho sngon dge 'os ched sbyong slob gar yongs grags su mtsho sngon 7paṇa chen slob grwa zhes 'bod kyi yod/phyi lo 1986 zla 9 tshes 8 nyin/ si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod rigs khul dang / yun nan bde chen bod rigs sa khul//rgya thang /bde chen/'ba' lung rdzong gsum yod// bod rang skyong ljongs chab mdo sa khul la rtog zhib tu phebs/de ni 7paṇa chen rin po che bod khul la zhabs sor 'khod pa thengs brgyad pa dang / si khron dang yun nan bod rigs sa khul la chibs sgyur thengs gnyis pa/bod rang skyongs ljongs su chibs sgyur thengs bzhi pa bcas yin/chibs sgyur gyi dgongs don snying po khams khul gyi rnyog zing drang bcos/mi rigs dang chos lugs dad mos kyi srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol dang skul ded ched yin/ thengs de'i chibs sgyur la yongs grags su/ 7paṇa chen 150

sku che'i smad kyai cha/rin po che'i khams khul gyi gzigs skor zhes 'bod kyi yod/ zla 9 tshes 14nyin pe cing nas dar rtse mdor zhabs sor 'khod/dar rtse mdo'i gnam thang nye 'khris su khul de'i khams pa'i mi mang la tshe dbang dang bka' slob gnang / dar rtse mdor si khron zhing chen khams pa sa khul gyi rdzong khag so sos/ phebs bsur bcar ba'i 'go khrid las byed nyis brgya lhag cig 'byor/ kho tsho phal mo che'i lus la mnabs pa'i gyon chas tshang ma/dpa' zhing brjid pa'i bod khams pa'i chas gos kyi dri ma tsam med par/ rgya chas spras yong pa der 7paṇa chen bcu pa thugs gting nas khros te/ khyed tsho tshang ma bod pa red/ ngos kyis de snga nas bod rigs kyis bod chas gyon dgos pa ma go ma thos med pa'i khyab bsgrags byas yod/gung khran tang gis mi rigs so so'i rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud slad/lo rer tshogs chen thengs gnyis 'tshogs te dril bsgrags byed kyi yod pa red/dgongs don gsal bsgrags khyed tshos mthong thos ma byung ngam/ thos yod na nga 7paṇa chen bla mar skyag skyag red dam/ yang na/ krung dbyang gis bod chas gyon mi chog lab kyi 'dug gam/ gal srid lab mkhan yod na da 'dir ngos la rtsis sprod dang / bod mis bod chas mi gyon pa zhabs 'dren red/phar ltos dang dar rtse mdo'i lung pa 'di khang pas khengs 'duga'on kyang / tshang ma rgya khang ma gtogs bod khang gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dug khyed tsho bod rigs las byed pas bod khang brgyab dgos pa bshad yod pa red/bshad pa de ma nyan par rgya khang brgyab 'dug bod khang ma brgyab par rgya khang brgyab dgos zer mkhan de da lta nga la shod dang / lcags zam kha yan chod de nga tsho bod rigs kyi sa char 'khod bsdad yod pa red/ bod rigs kyi sa cha la 151

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhib 'jugabod kyi rig gzhung lugs srol byed dgos pa red/ tshogs 'du'i gros chod nang chos lugs rang mos/ srid jus gu yangs/ yul lung dang mi rigs so so'i rig gzhung dang shes rig nyams pa sor chud/ mi nyams gong 'phel gtong chog gi yod/ces gsal bsgrags dang khyab bsgrags mang po ma go ma thos med pa byas yod pa red/khyod rang tshos krung dbyang gi gros chod khyab bsgrags byas par yid ches med pa bshad rgyu yod na da lta shod shog de min so so'i mi rigs dang lung pa 'tshong mkhan zer na de 'dra'i rigs la bshad kyi yod pa gsungs te/ rgya chas dang bod chas spras pa'i mi mang so sor phyes bcug ste/ bod chas mnabs te 7paṇa chen rin po che chibs bsur bcar ba'i bod pa rnams la bstod bsngags dang /phyag rtags sku par dang / ljags mdud/ byin rten/ dpe cha/ rogs dngul zhal 'debs gnang ste bod kyi yul srol goms gshis sogs/ bod kyi rig gzhung ma nyams pa srung skyob byed dgos pa'i skul ma gnang /dar rtse mdo bod yig slob grwa ni/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs rje'i bka' drin nyag gcig las gsar du bskrun pa'i bod yig slob gling zhig yin la/ slob gling der dpal lha dang nyag chu kha nas/ 7paṇa chen rin po che sku ngo mas bod yig dge rgan du gdan zhus bsko gzhag gnang ba'i mkhas dbang gnyis kyang yod/ mu ge'i sgang la zla lhag gi dpe ltar/ 7paṇa chen rin po che dar mdo nang bstan slob gling du phebs te/ slob phrug khag cig la chos kyi dri ba 'ga' shas gnang skabs/ slob phrug gcig gis rgya skad cig shor bas/7paṇa chen rin po ches slob phrug de la khyod kyis bod skad shes kyi med dam/ngas bod skad shes kyi yod gsungs nas bka' bkyon phebs shing / slob grwa'i dge rgan chen mo yar longs shog gsungs nas chos kyi thog la dri ba kha shas bzhes/152

sku che'i smad kyi cha/dge rgan des kyang rgya skad tshig gcig kha nas shor bas/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/dge phrug la khag ci yod/ dge rgan gyis kyang bod skad ma 'dang ba'i bzo 'dra /rtsi sa bras sngar64/snyi/lde nu dze sa ge da cesa~X po mthong byung gsungs/ dar rtse —— dzo — ṇi〉/// 3〉 sa ri ci / snying sa mdo ru lhags pa'i gnas tshul de / /ci wa rtenapa ༷ rte rdzu/sdu nyam khams pa sa khul gyi rdzong khag ’// — bye sha ci ba/ponacad cesazug05 95 ba//rdob/ 95 ba/'i/ba/ ci sdu/sa ci thabazlumad /)sa (grab pas/ shwakyapaṇa cesazug rin po che dar rtse mdo nas mi nyag dang / rta'u rdzong / brag 'go rdzong /gser rta rdzong / dkar mdzes rdzong bcas su chibs sgyur gnang ༄ dus/ gzhi rim mi mang lta ci byesas (phyi lo 1982lor 7paṇa chen rinapochelams khul du chibs rte rngo bye rdzong gi bod rigs tang yon las byed tshun gyis/ bod chas spras te 7paṇa chen rin po cher phebs bsu zhus/dkar mdzes tre dor dgon ni khams khul mdo sngags rig gnas kyi bsti gnas shig yin pas/ gnas chen der khams khul mi mang la gsung chos dang /mjal mang gnang skabs mi tshogs kyi 'tshang ga'i nang / las can gyi skye 'gro gnyis 'das grongs su gyur/gung khran tang lha med smra ba'i dmar shog tshogs pa yin pas/ srid gzhung gi las byed pa dang / lhag par tang yon zhig gi ngos nas chos la dad pa byed mi chog stabs/ nam rgyun 7paṇa chen rin po che phebs bsur bcar dus/rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen u yon krang gzhon par phebs bsu'i rnam pas nang sems kyi dad 'dun zhu ba las/ sku phyag phul na tang gshis 153

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'dugadang 'gal bas mi chog mod/ 'on kyang / thengs der 7paṇa chen rin po che dkar mdzes rdzong du chibs sgyur skabs/ rdzong gi tang yon las byed pa tshos ji ltar byas rung / da thengs 7paṇa chen rin po cher sku phyag 'bul rgyu yin pa bshad nas tshang mas sku phyag phul/149dkar mdzes rdzong gi chos srid mdzad pa grub rjes ser shul rdzong dang /sde dge rdzong / 'jo mda'/ skam thog gru kha brgyud chab mdo sa khul dang / go 'jo/smar khams rdzong / 'ba' thang rdzong / li thang rdzong / 'dab pa rdzong / cha phreng rdzong /sa dam brgyud yun nan zhing chen gyi khongs su rgyar ba'i rgyal thang rdzong dang / bde chen bod rigs sa khul du chibs kha bsgyur/ dkar mdzes khul bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi 'go gtso tshor/ sde dge dgon chen gyi dgon shul mang po zhig mi ser dang gzhung gis bdag bzung byas pa rnams/ dgon par phyir sprod pa'i zhu gtugs gnang ba don smin byung /zla 9 cedros 3 nyin/ sde dge par khang du gzigs zhib gnang zhing /'jig rten mig 'byed gsung rab sde// legs nyes gsal ba'i me long yin//rig brgya 'dus pa'i gter mdzod che// skye rgur phan pa'i sman gyi mtsho// sde dge par khang chen mo zhes// yangs pa'i khyon la lhang nger grags// sngon rjes bzang 21'i gzhi kresag nas// phyi rjes chen dzes 'alnga(ga pa 'a'argal // zhes bsngags ba1dud kyi phyag bris dang rab gnas gnang ba sogs/150 khams khul du kha yod lag yod kyi chos srid rig gsum don 'khyol gyi mdzad 'phrin rlabs po che zhig bskyangs shing /de snga bod yig sbyong 'dod med pa'i slob ma mang po zhig 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i bka' slob kyis/ mi rigs kyi la zhen dang bod skad yig sbyong ba'i spro ba 'phel 149ma da' zur dbra phrug ngag dbang la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshig tho/phyi lo naX zla 7 tshes na nyin/150khams sde dge rgyal po'i srid don lo rgyus bzhugs so /zhog ngos 2phyi nang spung go bod rig pa dpe 'i na khang /naX09lor/154

sku che'i smad kyai cha/ba byung yod/zla 10 nang yun nan zhing chen gyi khongs su yod pa'i bde chen bod rigs sa khul gyi bde chen rdzong dang / rgya thang rdzong / 'ba' lung rdzong gsum la rtog zhib tu chibs sgyur gnang / si khron shang khri rdzong du zhugs skabs su yun nan bde chen rdzong la kha ba chen po babs te/ shang khrin nas krung tan bar gyi gzhung lam kha bas bcad/ rgya dpon 'gas deng skabs gangs zhod che bas lam kha yag po med stabs/ u yon krang gi chibs sgyur la bar chad gtong nges bshad de phebs bshol zhus kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po ches bod rigs mang tshogs 'gro thub pa'i lam khar nga 'gro mi thub pa gtan nas med/ dka' khag ci 'dra zhig 'phrad kyang bde chen bod rigs sa khul la rtog zhib tu phebs rgyu yin pa gsungs/dus yun zla ba gnyi sa kyi ring grang rlung gi dka' khag la phar rgol mthar phyin gnang mthar/ zla 10 tshes 9 nyin rgyab phyag tshod 7 thog bde chen rdzong gi krung tan du bde blag ngang zhabs sor 'khod cing / khul de'i bod rigs mi mang gis bod kyi gom/sa srol ltar phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus/rgyal thang dang bde chen khul gyi bod rigs mi mang la mjal mang dang gsung chos/nyam thag 'ga'i khyim du rtog zhib tu chibs sgyur gnang ste/ srid gzhung nas khong tshor rogs ram dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang /bde chen bod khul gyi bod kyi skad yig gong spel la dmigs/ sku ngo mas phyag gron gnang ste rgyal thang bod kyi slob grwa gsar 'dzugs dang / rgyal thang sum rtsen dgon gyi grwa pa lnga la gzhis rtse bkras lhun dgon du slob gnyer gnang rgyur sku sger nas mthun rkyen sbyar/ bde chen gyi rim khag gi dbu khrid bskongs te/ g.yon thal gyi srid jus dang bsam blor skyon brjod gnang ste/ bod kyi skad yig 155

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhing ca'ajugasbyong spyod spel gsum dang / chos dad srid jus don 'khyol/ bstan dgon nyams gso/ bod skad yig slob khrid byed pa'i lag bstar chod yig gtan 'bebs gnang /phyi lo 1987 zla 7 tshes 21 nas zla 8 tshes 23 bar/ dbus gtsang du zhabs sor 'khod pa/ de ni 7paṇa chen rin po che bod khul du chibs sgyur gnang thengs dgu pa dang / bod dbus gtsang du zha bas sor 'khod thengs lnga pa yin/ chibs sgyur gyi dgongs don snying po phyi lo 1987 zla 3 tshes 28 nyin/rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs skabs drug pa'i tshogs chen thengs lnga par zhugs mkhan gyi bod kyi 'thus mi tshogs chung gros bsdur thog bka' zur nga phod la bod du bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum byed rgyu de bzhin khrims thog 'gan len yod pa'i srid jus gtan 'bebs yong thabs kyi skul ma gnang ba bzhin/phyi lo 1987 zla 7 tshes 19 rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs skabs bzhi pa'i thengs lnga pa'i thog 7paṇa chen rin po che dang bka' zur nga phod pe cing nas bod du ched phebs kyis/ gros gzhi zin bris 'don gnang mdzad par tshogs thog nas gros 'cham byung ste/ lha sa dang / gzhis rtse/lho kha bcas kyi slob 'bring gsum du slob gzhi yongs rdzogs bod skad yig gi lam nas slob khrid byed pa'i tshod lta'i 'dzin grwa btsugs/ slob grwa de gsum gyi sbyangs 'bras 'bur thon byung ba mkhas dbang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las dang /bod rang skyong ljongs kyi hru'u ci bstan 'dzin gyis zhal bzhes gnang /phyi lo 1987 zla 10 tshes 14 nyin/ mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho lto bod rigs rang skyong khul du zhabs sor 'khod/ de ni 7paṇa chen rin po che bod khul du chibs sgyur gnang thengs bcu pa dang / mtsho sngon bod rigs sa khul du 156

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/zhabs sor 'khod thengs bzhi pa yin/ chibs sgyur gyi dgongs don snying po mtsho lho lung g.yang 'gag chu glog sa tshugs dang / rgya ra 'gag chu mdzod las grwar mdzub khrid dang / zhor du bod rigs mi mang gi 'tsho ba'i dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas slob gso/ chos dad rang mos/ mi rigs srid jus sogs la rtog zhib gnang rgyu yin/zla 9 tshes 27 dang 10 tshes 1 so sor/ bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar bod rang btsan sger langs zhi rgol skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mtsho ston bod khul du gzigs skor gnang bzhin yod/ zla 10 tshes 8 lha sa'i don rkyen la khrims lugs gzhir bzung nas byed gte la nyes chad nan po gcod dgos pa dang /yol ba'i rgyab nas bkod jus byed mkhan gting 'bru byed dgos pa gsungs lugs (krung gung tang bi lo rgyus yig cha par skrun khang gis pa ra 'grem sa byas pa'i krung go gung khran tang gis srid dbang bskyangs pa'i lo bzhi bcu /zhes pa'i gnang bkod 'dug pa/ de skabs mtsho sngon nyin re'i rgya yig tshags par steng spel/mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling gi slob ma 'gas/ slob gling nang 7paṇa chen rin po che'i zhal gsung la ngo rgol gyi sbyar yig 'grems rtsis byed skabs/slob spyi rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis mkhyen te/ dge las slob ma yongs rdzogs tshogs 'du bskongs te/ tshags par steng bkod thon byung ba'i skad cha de rigs/7paṇa chen rin po ches rtsa ba nas gsungs med pa dang / gnas tshul der 7paṇa chen rin po che ha cang thugs pham byung 'dug pas/ de'i skor mtsho sngon gyi 'brel yod dpon rigs tshor 'dri rtsad byed bzhin 'dug ces brgyud bsgrags byed sar/ nga rang yang dngos su yod ces da lta khrims drung drung 'phar bkra shis rgya 157

7paṇa chen er te ni zhib chogadugamatshos gsungs/151 bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa khul du yang 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ me mda' gnam la brgyab nas mde'u rkang par phog pa red/ gsungs pa'i zhal gsung la go ba mi lon pa'i lha sa'i mi mang 'gas/ ma 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur dang 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i zhal gsung la ngo rgol gyi rnam pa mtshon byed/ gang gis gsungs pa'i gtam bshad lad zlos byed nga 'i tsha rlabs shig skyid shod kyi ri klung kun la khyab/'on kyang / don dngos su 7paṇa chen bcu par phrad pa'i sku ngal ni/phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 10 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog la phrad pa'i sku ngal dang gnyis su med de/ gdan sa'i dge 'dun pa dang bod mi mang la rang btsan gyi ngo rgol mi gnang ba'i slob gso dang / rgya dmag gis zhi ba'i mi mang la drag gnon mi chog pa'i bkag 'gog gnang skabs/ phyogs gnyis gas kha dung dang /ming chad kyi sku ngal bsam yul las 'das pa zhig bzed dgos pa su zhig gis khas len dang ngos 'dzin thub myong med/phyi lo 1987 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog lha sa'i don rkyen rtog zhib tu chibs sgyur gnang / pe cing rgyal sa nas chibs thon khar nga phod ched mngags kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar te/ da res bod la phebs ring gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig 'phrad kyang sku rlung mi gnang ba'i snyan skul zhus kyang /152 lha sar zhabs sor 'khod pa'i phyi nyin/ krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa dang bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'brel yod 'go khrid cha bgos kyis/151rgya dag ngo sprod gnas bci sa/'og ngos 85 nang / bkra shis rgya rmi tshos rtsom sgrig byas/ bod kyi gros tshogs dang srid jus nyams zhib khang ge dpa ra 'grem sa byas/phyi lo naX8lor/152bod kyi reg sanas ngo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7paṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉shog ngos 9nang /bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe sku na khang /phyi lo 1989bla sbyinang /158

skru che'i smad kyai cha/gdan sa gsum gtsos dgon sde khag tu las don rtog zhib tu mngags/ dgong dro rtog zhib tshogs chung gis zhib 'jug snyan tho snyan seng skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches thugs snang chen pos gsan/ dgong zas tshar ba dang las don tshogs chung gi las byed pa rnams/ 7paṇa chen bzhugs gling rdo rje pho brang du bskongs te phyi lo 1987 lha sa'i khrom gzhung nang bod mis khrom skor byed pa'i brnyan 'phrin/las don tshogs chung gi las byed tshang mas mnyam du blta dgos pa'i bkod khyab gnang / bod rang skyong ljongs gi 'go khrid ga par zhes bka' rtsad gnang skabs/ kho tsho tshogs bcar zhus med pa mkhyen rjes dgongs 'tshoms chen po bzhes 'dugabarnyan 'phrin nang dge 'dun pa dang / btsun ma tshos/ khu mtshur sgreng ste bod rang btsan yin/ 7rgyal ba rin po che sku tshe khri lor brtan pa'i 'bod sgra bsgrags pa'i rjes su/ na gzhon dang byis pa 'gas rjes su 'brangs te rgyug 'gro gi yod/zhi rgol ba rnams gtsug lag khang gi mdun 'byor ba dang brnyan 'phrin rdzogs tresang /7paṇa chen rin po ches brnyan 'phrin de gzigs rjes/ spyan khro mig tu ldir zhing gsung sgra drag pos/ 'di nas rdzogs pa red dam gsung skabs/pe cing nas lha sar 'grul bzhud kyis lus ngal ba'i steng / nyin gang dgon sde khag la bzhugs mol tshogs 'dus rbad de thang chad te brnyan 'phrin blta bzhin gnyid cog rgyag bzhin pa rnams hob gsad kyi 'drogs/7paṇa chen rin po ches/ krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi 'gan 'dzin gzhon pa li tso min la zhal phyogs te/ li tso min/ khyed rang 'di gar gnyid nyal ba yong ba yin nam zhes bka' bkyon phebs/15315355la brtsa mi bang rgyaX 65me kyi sa babaX'i 159

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'dugade rjes na bza'i phu thung yar la brje bzhin/ glog brnyan ston mkhan gyi pho gzhon der phyag 'jug gnang bar phebs skabs/ krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa'i 'go khrid las byed tsho ga byed 'di byed med par gyur 'dug 'gro/nga tsho tshang ma 'gro/ gsung bzhin tshogs khang gi phyir chibs kha bsgyur/ dgung na mtho zhing lha sa'i gsos rlung ma ldang bas sku khams rnyog pa'i gung thang tshang snga sa nas gzim grub zin mod/ gung thang skad thongs gsungs te bka' 'gug gnang /'go khrid las byed tshang ma so so'i rlangs 'khor nang 'dzul zin kyang /tshang ma yong gi 'dug gam/ zhes bka' rtsad phebs/ rang skyong ljongs kyi las byed pa 'dug gam zhes bka' rtsad phebs skabs/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi las byed med pa mkhyen pa dang sngar bas sku drag tu khros/ tshang ma so so'i rlangs 'khor nang bsdad de ngos kyi rjes la shog ces gsungs/ krung dbyang las don tshogs chung gi 'go khrid las byed tshos/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' gsung ci sgrub zhu rgyu las/sus kyang kho tsho rang gang du 'gro rgyu yin min shes kyi med la/ bka' 'dri ni de bas zhu mi phod/ dus kyi skur ma lnga tsam phyin pa dang bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che hu'u cin ha yi sgo 'gram du 'byor/ las don tshogs chung gi las mi zhig gis hu'u cin ha yi gzim sgo brdungs/dgun zla dang po'i lha sa'i gnam gshis ha cang grang zug che zhing /lha sa'i mtshan mo'i chu tshod 12 yol zin pas/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che hu'u cin ha snga nas gzims grub pas/ nyal gos ling ling du gyon te sgo phye bzhin pa'i hu'u cin has sgo phye ba dang / 7paṇa chen rin po che mjal dus/hang sangs ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas/ rin po che gnas tshul ga re lhags 'dug ces bka' 'dri zhus/ hu'u cin has skad cha shod mtshams ma rdzogs gong / 160

skya che'i mi da kyai cha/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches gal srid bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'go khrid kyis ngos la yid ches med na/ ngos kyi da lta rang lha sa nas thon chog gsungs/hu'u cin has 7paṇa chen rin po che dang / krung dbyang las don tshogs chung gi 'go khrid 'ga' kho pa'i khyim du bsus rjes/ brnyan phab dngos gnas de nga tshor bstan ma byung / spyi bde mi snas dkyil nas bcad 'dug pa shod skabs/hu'u cin ha yi sgo 'gram du 'byor ba'i rlangs 'khor las/ hu'u cin ha'i drung yig rgyug yong ste/ brnyan phab cha tshang ba de 7paṇa chen rin po cher phul/7paṇa chen rin po che dang bcas pa/ phyir bzhugs gling rdo rje pho brang du phebs te/ brnyan 'phrin 'khor 'thag de gzigs/ gtsug lag khang gi yangs steng nas drag chas nyen rtog pa zhig gis/ a ma'i ro/ me mda' rgyobs/ zhes bka' rgya btang zhing me mda'i skad sgra grags pa dang / 7paṇa chen rin po ches da 'grig song gsungs te/ yar bzhengs nas brnyan phab ston mtshams 'jog tu bcugabarnyan phab 'khor thag de khong nyid kyi khug ma'i nang blugs pa dang / gsung ngag 'jam po'i sgo nas tshang ma thugs rje che/ ngos kyi mnyam du phyi po lhag song /nga tsho tshang mas spyi bde nyen rtog pas me mda' brgyab pa mthong yod/ khyed tsho sku las khag song / ngos kyis ma 'grig pa mang po zhus song / thugs rje che tshang ma sku gzim la phebs rogs zhes gsungs/154sang nyin dgong dro de dgon sde khag tu don rkyen rtog zhib tu mngags pa rnams/ slar yang bzhugs gling rdo rje pho brang du las don snyan seng zhu ba'i tshogs 'du bskongs/ dga' ldan dgon pa'i las don tshogs chung / krung dbyang chos don las khungs kyi las byed tsa'os/ gnas tshul zhi 'jags red 'dugami mang rnams zhi stod ngang skyid po bsdad 'dug ces bshad/ 7paṇa chen rin 154 ngabraskyugadam gleng zhal pa ra steng /6 kya rin po ches 7paṇa chen bcu rngu 'i sko ra gsungs pa/161

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhi' 'dusapo ches tsalo'i snyan seng zhu ba'i mtshams bkag ste/ thugs khro bzhin bgres song tsa'o lags/ nga'i re bar tshogs 'du rjes ma'i skabs las don snyan seng da lta las zhib tshags che ba'i re ba yod ces gsungs/ tshogs 'du rjes ma'i skabs tsa'os 7paṇa chen rin po cher dgongs sel zhus shing / zhib tshags pa'i las don snyan seng zhus/ phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 11 nas zla 2 tshes 11 bar gyi nyin sum cu'i ring / bod dbus gtsang du zhabs sor 'khod pa ni/ 7paṇa chen rin po che bod khul du chibs sgyur gnang thengs bcu gcig pa dang / bod dbus gtsang du zhabs sor 'khod thengs drug pa yin/ chibs sgyur gyi dgongs snying lha sar byung ba'i don rkyen drang bcos dang / lha sa'i smon lam chen mo go sgrig mdzub khrid ched yin/ skabs de'i gnas tshul gang byung rnams/ le'u gnyis pa'i sa bcad gsum pa sku gshegs rkyen zhes pa'i nang zhib brjod byas yod/ tshes 27 lha sa nas gzhis rtser gzigs zhib chibs skyur gyis/ gzhis rtse sa khul tang srid las khungs khag dang / bkras lhun dgon pa/ gzhis rtse grong khyer/ pa snam rdzong / rgyal rtse rdzong / lto kha'i sna dkar rtse rdzong bcas kyi tang srid tshan pa khag la chos lugs don 'khyol dang / chab srid dngos bstun/ dpal 'byor rogs skyor/ slob gso dar spel gtong ba'i las don snyan zhu gsan zhing dgongs 'char mdzub ston gnang rjes/ bkras lhun dang / dpal 'khor chos sde/gnas snying dgon pa sogs su mang tshogs la gsung chos dang mjal mang gnang ste/ zla 2 pa'i nang phyir lha sar phebs te pe cing du chibs kha bsgyur/phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 3 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po dgung grangs 50 hril por 'khor ba'i dus bzang la song / mdo dbus khams gsum 162

skya tshe'i smad kyi cha/sog yul dang bcas pa'i chos sde chen po mtha' dag gi bla sprul che khag dang /sku tshab/ rgya nag dbus gzhung gi 'brel yod dpon rigs thun mong nas brtan bzhugs 'degs 'bul zhus/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 9 nyin/ pe cing nas bod kyi grong khyer gnyis pa gtsang ljongs myang smad gzhis ka rtser zhabs sor 'khod pa de/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog bod khul du chibs sgyur gnang thengs bcu gnyis dang /bod dbus gtsang khul du zhabs sor 'khod thengs bdun pa yin/ chibs sgyur gyi dgongs don snying po rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gtor bshig tu btang ba'i 7paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa dang dgu pa bar gyi sku gdung lhag lus rnams gcig tu bsgril ba'i mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi rab gnas mdzad sgo'i dbu 'byed dang dga' ston du chibs kha bsgyur/pe cing nas gong dkar gnam thang brgyud lha sar phebs skabs/lo rabs 60 nang7paṇa chen rin po cher dbu nyes phog skabs/ gzim shag sngog bsher byas nas thon pa'i yig 'bru khri bdun gyi ma zin dang / sku par/mo yig mi lam brtag pa'i yi ge sogs 'dus pa'i yig cha tshang ma/ bod rang skyong ljongs srid gzhung gi drung che rag sdis kyis 7paṇa chen rin po cher rtsis phul zhus/ zla 1 tshes 12 bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tang srid dbu khrid tshogs 'du bskongs nas/ phyi lo 1988 'dzin bzung byas pa'i btson pa rnams slod grol dgos pa'i dgongs 'char bka' bkyon shugs chen gnang stabs/dga' ldan bag gro (grags can gyi chab srid btson zur dang bod don 'thab rtsod pa/)sogs btson pa rnams glod grol gtong gtan 'khel/ btson srung ba tshos kyang chab srid btson 163

7paṇa chen mar te ni shib 'jugapa rnams/ sang nyin gnangs nyin zhig glod rgyu yin pa bshad de btson chas rnams nyes don nyes gsog gi btson pa rnams la sbyin/ bkra mi shis pa'i lha sa/'i rlung 'phrin dang /bod ljo ngas nyin re'i tshags par steng / bod gangs can ljongs kyi dpa' rgod 7paṇa chen snang ba mtha' yas sku phreng bcu pa chen po dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i gtam ngan bsgrags ma thag glod grol gtong gtan 'khel ba'i chab srid btson pa rnams slar yang btson chas g.yogs te mu mthud btson 'jug byas/155bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa nas gzhis rtser phebs 'byor zin rjes/ khong nyid kyi mdzub khrid gtso skyong 'og bod ljongs dang / mtsho ston/ kun su'u/ si khron/ yun nan zhing chen khongs kyi bod rigs sa khul gyi bla dpon gnad yod tshang mar gdan zhu'i mgron shog phul te/ gzhis rtse bkras lhun dgon par bod kyi sa khul lnga gcig sgril gyi bsam blo yod dgos pa dang / gung khran tang gi bod la 'dzugs skrun byas pa las gtor bshig btang ba mang ba yod pa'i lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi sdom tshig bskyon rjes/sku tshe hril po'i nang bod sa hril po nas bod dbus gtsang gi mnga' ris sa khul la phebs ma myong bas/ phyi lo 1989 zla 7/8 nang mnga' ris sa khul gyi bod rigs mi mang la gzigs par phebs rgyu'i zhal bzang yod bzhin/ phyi lo 1989 zla 1tshes 27 nyin gyi mchen dgung nga tsho dang gtan du zhal gyes zhus pa'i skyo gar byung /ches mtha' mjug gi zhal chems su/ thams cad kyi sems bde po byos/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de 'jig gi ma red/ krung go gung khran tang gcig pu ma red/deng sang sun len yin na'ang / phyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar yong gi yod pa red/bstan pa yang dar zhig yong gi red/ des na khyed rnam pa thugs bde po byos shig gsungs/ /155chab srid btson zur dga' ldan ga bag gro bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshig tho 164

skya che'i smi da kyi cha/le tshan dgu pa/ 'od khul gzigs skor gyis sprad pa'i myong tshor/phyi lo 1980 zla 3 tshes 14 dang 15 nyin/ srid 'dzin hu'u ya'o pang gis gtso skyong gnang ste/ krung dbyang gis bod kyi las don skor gyi tshogs 'du thengs dang po bskongs/ lo de'i zla 5 tshes 6 nyin srid 'dzin hu'u ya'o phang dang /srid blon gzhon pa wan li/ bka' zur nga phod gsum gyis dbu khrid pa'i bod don rtog zhib gnang mkhan krung dbyang las don tshogs chung gis/ da bar gung khran tang gis bod la 'dzin pa'i srid jus nor 'khrul byung ba dgongs sel dang sbrags/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che ran rung bod nas phyir 'then zhing /slad phyin krung dbyang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus don tshan brgyad lag bstar don 'khyol byed mir dbying h+pha thang bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung cher mngags mod/ 'on kyang / khos bod du chab srid 'thab rtsod ang dang por 'dzin pas/bod mi mang gi dka' ngal la bzang phyogs kyi 'gyur ba gang yang ma thebs/phyi lo 1982 zla 6 tshes 29 nyin/ rin po che mchog gong dkar gnam thang du zhabs sor 'khod ma thag bod du chibs sgyur gnang thub par dgyes tshor chen po byung zhing / bod mi mang gi bde skyid don du sku las skyon 'dod dang / phyag las bsgrubs na sku ngal med pa gsungs pa dang / sku 'gram du las ka byed pa'i mi snar/ nga la skad cha ba shad du mi 'jug pa dang / las ka byed du mi 'jug pa gtan nas byed thub thabs med/ nga ni stod por sdod mi thub pa zhig yin pas/165
