7paṇa chen mar te ni zhing 'dunangs khyed tsho yang skyid po byas nas bsdod 'jug gi min/156 zhes bstan pa yang dar dang bod gong spel gtong rgyu'i thugs 'dun gsal por gsungs kyang /bod rang ljongs tang gi drung che dbying h+pha thang gis/ 7gong sa mchog dang / 7paṇa chen rin po che/ phun dbang gsum/ bod nang tang gi sgrig 'dzugs gtan lhing gtor bshig gtong malan gyi byed gter ngos 'dzin byas te/ khong gsum la chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod byed pa'i srid jus da dung yang nga ra 'jags mi 'dug7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bod la phebs pa'i gtam bzang brgya la stong brgyud kyi bod khams su khyab rjes/ lha sa dang / mnga' ris/ nag chu/ chab mdo/nying khri/ lho kha/ mtsho sngon/ zi khron/ kun su'u/ yun nan dang bcas pa'i bod mi rnams/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas gom 'gros dang / rta/ rlangs 'khor la bsdad de la rgyab chu brgal gyis/ gtsang ljongs gzhis rtse phyogs su chas 'ong /'on kyang / bod rang skyong ljongs kyi dang gzhis rtse sa khul sogs 'brel yod las khungs rnams kyis/ 7paṇa chen rin po che bod du chibs sgyur gnang bar dga' bsu'i rnam 'gyur lta ci/ 7paṇa chen kho yong bar ga re hang sangs rgyu yod/ kho rang dgongs pa zhus te bod du yul skor la yong ba red/ khyed tshos 7paṇa chen yod bsams nas ltag shed byas na/ 7paṇa chen gyis kha rgyags pa gang bshad de rgya nag la 'gro gi red/ nga chos khyed tshor rtsis rjes la rgyag chogaces mi mang la sdigs ra skul ba ma zad/157155slob dngo na chen ngo lapaṇa chen rin ngo che/shog ngos nazhan nang /'jam dpal rgya ma tshos brtsams/ bde srung bod gnas nyams zhib khang sga bsgyur/phyi ma 1997nang /157gzhis bzhugs bkras lhun dgon gyi grwa zur zhig la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshig tho/pyi lo daX8zla 5tshes daXnyin/166

skya tshe'i mi da kyai cha/phyi lo 1982 zla 7 tshes 21 nyin/ rin po che mchog lha sa nas rgyal rtser chibs sgyur skabs/ lam bar du phebs bsur bcar ba'i bod khams kyi sa phyogs gang sa nas phebs pa'i mi rnams bkag 'gog ched/ spyi bde'i las byed pas mi mang la ske rag gi chab rtse sogs bed spyod kyis nyes rdung tshad med btang bas/ mi mang po zhig la rmas skyon phog pa dang / tshes 22nyin gzhis ka rtser chibs sgyur skabs / phebs bsur bcar ba'i gnas rnying khar pa'i bu bstan 'dzin phun tshogs 'dzin bzung dang sbrags/ spyi bde'i las khungs su 'khrid de 'phrog bcom dang chad pa btang ba ma zad/153 phebs bsu dang zhal mjal zhu bar 'gro mkhan gzhan rnams kyi las ku'i skar thob /skabs der mi mang kung hre cha tshang mjug sgril med/)rtsa bcag btang ba sogs kyi dam drag byas/159hang sangs shing ya nga dgos pa'i gnas tshul gzhan zhig ni/ 7paṇa chen rin po che gdan sa bkra shis lhun por zhabs sor 'khod skabs/ 7rgyal dbang sku phreng dang po rje dge 'dun grub kyis gsar bzhengs gnang zhing / bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs chen 'du khang nang bzhugs pa'i dgon pa'i rten gtso/ thub dbang bdud 'dul mar snyan shal gser kong phul grub pa dang bla brang rtser phebs/7paṇa chen gong na rim bla brang rtser chibs sgyur gnang skabs/rtse gsol thab nas gsol ja gsol tshigs 'bul lam yod pa bzhin/ lo rabs 50 nang 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis kyang / 7paṇa chen gong ma na rim gyi phyag srol bzhin/ bla brang rtser rtse gsol thab nas phul ba'i gsol ja dang gsol tshigs bzhes myong /1586 dmar gyis bod nang mi spyo da la sa 'das pa'i bya ngan ji byas dngos byung gnas lugs rags bsdus gsal bar ma po nga ba'i me long phyi lo 1959nas 1984bar/shes rig pa ra khang /159sa/zhis bzhugs bkras lhun gyu zur/gong tshes nyin/167

7 paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'dug phyi lo 1982 lor/ bla brang rtser zhabs sor 'khod skabs/ zhabs phyi sku 'khor tshor nga tsho gsol tshigs mchod do zhes bka' phebs kyang / rtse gsol thab ni lo mang bdag med du lus pa'i khang gog rtsab hral zhig yin pas/7paṇa chen bcu pa rtse bla brang du zhabs sor 'khod skabs/ rtse gsol thab nas gsol chas 'bul mkhan su zhig med/ zhabs 'bring sku 'khor tshos gsol tshigs la gzhan du chibs sgyur yong ba zhu skabs/ thugs pham pa'i bzhin las spags bzos nas 'grig gi red rtsam pa 'khyer shog gsungs/ 'on kyang / skabs thog tu 7paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi mchod rtsam du grags pa'i lhan dkar mo'i 160gsol rtsam zhig kyang dus skabs der phul thub med pa'i tshod du snang /7paṇa chen bcu pa ni rgyal khab rim pa'i 'go khrid las byed pa zhig gi ming thog nas bod du las don rtog zhib tu phebs pa zhig yin kyang / khong la gzhi rgya che ba'i rgya zas le'u bco brgyad lta ci/ tha na gsol rtsam ngo drag pa zhig kyang 'bul rgyu med pa de'i thog nas/ skabs de'i bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs de/ ji lta bu'i dka' sdug gi gnas su lhung yod pa de bas gsal por mtshon yod/bod rang skyong ljongs tang dang / srid gzhung / gzhis rtse sa ud dang /srid 'dzin kung hru'u/ gnad sa bkra shis lhun po'i dmangs gtso bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang //skabs der bkras lhun dgon pa srid gzhung gi btang 'dzin nan po'i 'og tshud cing dmangs bdag las byed rnams dmar shed che ba snang //bcas kyis/ 7paṇa chen rin po che bod du chibs sgyur gnang bar phebs bsu'i sne len yag po zhig zhus mi 'dug1507paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi gsal rtsam de gzhis rtse'i nye 'gram lhan zhes pa'i yu la gyi nas dkar mos bzos pa de 'bul la ma 'dug cing /khul de'i mi rnam kyis yul de nas thon po'i gnas dkar la lhan dkar mo'i nas zhes 'bod sro la 'dug168

kyi tshe'i mi da kyi cha/ shod rgyun la/ lhun po'i don gyi bdag po kun gzigs mchog nyid yin pa'i brda mtshon phyir/ sku rgyab tu bkra shis lhun po yongs su tshud pa'i sku par zhig sgron te/ bkras lhun dmangs gtso bdag gnyer khang gi las byed tshor sprod dgos pa'i bkod mngags gnang ba gsungs/phyi lo 1989 lor/ bod la chibs sgyur mtha' ma'i skabs su yang /phyi lo 1982 lor/ dbyin h+pha thang gis gtsos bod rang skyong ljongs tang srid dmag gi 'go khrid tshos/ khong bod la phebs par dga' bsu'i rnam 'gyur ma byung ba'i gnas tshul dran gso gnang ste gsungs don/ phyi lo 1982 lor/ngos bod la thog mar slebs skabs mi kha shas (bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi spyi khyab hru'u ci dbying h+pha thang /)kyis/ nga bod la yong gyur dga' bsu byed kyi med kyang / bod rigs mi mang gis nga la dga' bsu zhus byung gsungs/dbying h+pha thang gi 'go khrid pa'i g.yon thal gyi 'go khrid tshos/7paṇa chen rin po che la dga' bsu med pa smos ci/ gdan sa bkra shis lhun po'i dmangs gtso bdag gnyer khang gi 'go khrid chos kyang / phyi lo 1964nas phyi lo 1983 bar/ bkra shis lhun po'i don gyi bdag po 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'tshams 'dri 'brel gtugs gang yang zhus mi 'dugaganas tshul de las dus yun mi lo 19 gdan sa bkra shis lhun po'i las don spyi bye brag gang la'ang / don gyi bdag pos bkod 'doms bslab gcun gnang ba'i sku dbang tsam yang ma byung / phyi lo 1983 lor/ bkras lhun dmangs bdag gis 7paṇa chen bcu par 'tshams 'dri'i phyag rtags dang /bkra shis lhun po'i spyi sgos kyi gnas snyan mdor bsdus shig phul 'dug pa de ni/phyi lo 1964 lo tshun 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'brel gtugs zhus pa'i phyag 169

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jugo 'phrin dang po yin/ phyi lo 1983 zla 5 tshes 15 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches pe cing nas bkras lhun dmangs bdag la bstsal ba'i bka' lan phyag bris nang /bka' gdams bstan pa'i gnas mchog lung rigs yon tan gyis phyug pa'i rang gdan bkra shis lhun po'i dge 'dun spyi dang / dmangs gtso bdag gnyer gyi 'gan khur ba thun mong la/ ched spel/ de nas 'di lo'i dpyid kur ngos la 'tshams zhu dang 'brel rang gdan bkra shis lhun po'i spyi sgos kyi gnas snyan mdor bsdus shig phul 'byor byung ba de ni khyed tshos/ phyi lo 1964 lo tshun ngos la btang ba'i yi ge dang po de yin stabs dga' spro chen po byung /khyed tshos de 'dra byas pa ni lugs dang mthun zhing / tshul dang 'tsham la rang nyid gzhan bskul du mi gyar ba'i thabs shes spyang la mkhas pa zhig kyang yin te/ rang re'i 'brel ba ni lo rgyus kyi steng nas grub cing dngos don gyi lam nas nges pa'i bla ma dang slob ma'i 'brel ba dang / don gyi bdag po dang /rang gi gdan sa'i 'brel ba sogs la skad cig tu 'dres pa'i 'brel ba thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin pa'i rkyen gyis red/ngos rang snga lo phyi lo 1982 lor/ bod la lta zhib dang 'tshams 'drir yong thub pa ma zad/ rang gdan bkra shis lhun por rang cag bla slob zhal 'dzoms dang gzhis byes ngo 'phrad byung ste rang gzhan thams cad dga' bas mchi ma shor zhing spro bas rol gar 'khrab pa de lo rgyus kyi deb ther thog 'khod zin/ da gzod krung dbyang gis thugs khur bla med gnang nas rang re'i sku gdung gsar pa bzhengs bya rgyu ma zad/ de'i 'gan khur gtso bo de ngos rang nyid nas byed rgyu yin zhes 'khod/170

྅/ tshe'i smad kyi zurnga/dbyin h+pha thang gi g.yon gyi bsam blo'i gdug rgyun ji tsam che yang /7paṇa chen rin po che bod la phebs thengs dang po'i skabs/ ngos ni chos phyogs kyi bla ma zhig yin gshis mi dmangs kyis ngos la dad pa byed kyi yod pas/ chos lugs kyi byed sgo ma spel na mi 'grig gsungs te/161 mi mang khri tsho sum cu lhag tsam la mjal kha gnang zhing / phyi lo 1982 zla 7 tshes 20 nyin/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mtho rim 'go khrid tshogs 'du'i steng / bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyis lo mang ring chos lugs srid jus lhug gtong byed rgyu phar bzhag ste/de las ldog ste dam drag byas pa'i zhal rtsod bskyon par/ bka' zur nga phod kyis 7paṇa chen rin po cher chab srid ang dang po dang chos lugs ang gnyis par 'jog dgos pa'i bsam 'char phul/162dbying h+pha thang 7paṇa chen rin po che'i skyon brjod gnang ba sems la yog stab sa/ rgya nag dbus gzhung la bcos sgyur gyi srid jus gsar pas/7paṇa chen gyis khengs dregs byed kyi 'dug ces snyan seng zhus pa ma zad/1637paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang bsam 'char mi mthun pa rnams/ gsang tar brgyud dbus gzhung la 'phral mar snyan seng zhus/'on kyang / rgya nag gi srid 'dzin hu'u ya'o phang gis dbu khrid pa'i dbus gzhung 'thab phyogs gcig gyur lhan khang gis/ phyi lo 1982 zla 7 tshes 15 nyin/ khyed tshos rgyal khab kyi don chen la srung rtsi zhu ba'i blta stangs 'dzin te/7paṇa chen la mthun sgril byas nas zhesar 'gugs thabs kyi brtson len byed dgos pa'i bkod khyab btang yang / dbying h+pha thang gis 7paṇa chen bod du blta 161bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7paṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉shog ngos 11nanang /bod ljongs me dam ngas dpe sgrun khang /phyi lo 1989bla canang /1phyinabod mi gsar brje ba zhigashog ngos 45phyinang /chung tshe ring gis bsgyur/pod kyi dus bab kyi pa ra/phyi lo naX lor/1phyi bod mi lasar brje ba zhigasog ngos 44 nang /chung tshe ring yis bsgyur/bod kyi dus bab kyi par/phyi lo nyaX lo ra/171

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhi' 'jugazhib byed ring gi gnas tshul zhes pa'i yig cha bzos te/ zla 11 tshes 4 nyin rgya nag dbus gzhung la ther 'don gyi tshul du gsang 'phrin bskur 'dug164dbying h+pha thang gtsos pa'i bod sdod rgya gzhung 'go khrid tshos/ bod nang tang gi las gar gnod skyon gtong mkhan gyi mi gsum yod pa ni/ tā la/paṇa chen/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal bcas red/ rgyal khab kyi phyi rol du tā las 'dzam gling gang sar bskyod nas bod rang btsan gyi las don sgrub bzhin yod/rgyal khab nang (yin yang tang gi phyi rol /du sgyur bcos kyi srid jus gsar pas/7paṇa chen khengs dregs chen po chags yod pa bshad/phyi lo 1984 lo'i dpyid kur /dbying spa thang dang /rag sdis/yangs gling rdo rje tshud pa'i /bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'go khrid khag cig pe cing du gzigs skor la 'byor/gzigs skor de'i skabs yangs gling rdo rjes krung dbyang gi dbu khrid kra'o tse yang dang hu'u ya'o h+phang la/ phyi lo 1978 lor/ skabs bcu gcig pa'i tshang 'alnga(mas 11sa 31gas thengs gsam pa/ rgyal skuthongs sa ang dang nge1 chab srid ra ra kyi 'thab rtsod byed pa nas dpal 'byor gong 'phel gyi gnad don la bsam gzhigs byed par 'pho 'gyur phyin yod/ yin na'ang lha sa'i nang gi dbying h+pha thang gi gtsos 'go khrid 'gas/ bod nang ang dang po ni chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod mu mthud rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos par brtsi bzhin 'dug kho tshos chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod 'di'i rtsa ba'i dmigs 'ben ni tā la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen/phun dbang bcas yin pa shod kyi 'dug pa'i snyan seng zhus/165kra'o tse yang gis bod nang byed bzhin pa'i las ka de nor 'khrul red/154bden don gsal ba'i sgron me/shog ngos na45nang /lta phrug yis brtsams/bde srung las khungs kyis par 'grems byas/phyi lo naX lor/1///khro mi gsar brje ba zhigasog ngos 455nang /chung tshe ring nas bsgyur/bod kyi dus bab kyis par/phyi lo naX lor/

sku che'i mi da kyi cha/dpal 'byor gong 'phel gtong rgyu de bod tshud pa'i rgyal khab kyi las don ang dang po de red/ phun dbang dang paṇa chen rin po che gnyis ka nga tsho'i mi red la/nga tshos tā la'i bla ma rang phyogs su 'gug thabs byed bzhin yod/ der brte na khong tsho chab srid 'thab rtsod bya yul du bzhag pa ni nor ba yin pa gsungs shing /srid 'dzin hu'u ya'o phang yang sku rlung bzhengs te/ dpal 'byor gong 'phel gtong rgyu ni rgyal khab hril po'i las don ang dang po de red/ gral rim 'thab rtsod byas pa la brten nas nga tsho'i rgyal khab la ha cang dka' tshegs che ba'i dus tshod byung yod/ ta la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen rin po che/ phun dbang gsum chab srid 'thab rtsordo kyi dmigs 'ben du 'jog pa ni nor ba red ces gsungs/ gnas tshul de byung nas yun ring ma song ba'i nyin zhig dbying h+pha thang gis bod kyi chab srid kyi dgra bo gsum ste/ 7gong sa mchog dang / 7paṇa chen rin po che/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal gsum la chab srid 'thab rtsod byas pa'i srid jus la/ krung dbyang gis dngos su skyon brjod yongs grags su byas stabs/phyi lo 1984 zla 4 nyin zhig dbying h+pha thang dang / rag sdi/ yangs gling rdo rje/rdo rje tshe brtan dang bcas pas/ pe cing du yod pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gzim shag tu bcar te/ sngar byas nor 'khrul ngos len dang dgongs pa dngas pa'i skyabs 'jug zhus 'dug7paṇa chen rin po che btson grol rjes kyi bod khul rtog zhib ni/lo rabs 80 nang yin pas/ bod mi mang dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur dang rig gnas gsar brje'i dka' sdug las thar zhing / skabs bcu gcig pa'i 173

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugathengs gsum pa'i tshogs chen srid jus kyi cha rkyen gsar pas/ mi mang rnams sems khams bde thang dang / shes yon dar rgyas/ dpal 'byor gong 'phel/chos dad rang mos la gzhol ba'i dus skabs shig yin pa shod dgos mod/don dngos su ma'o kru zhis gral rim 'thab rtsod ang dang por 'jog pa'i rig gnas gsar brje'i dung rdeg gi las 'gul da dung mtshams chad med pas/ bod mi rigs la kla klo/ bod yig shes pa yig rmongs/ bod brgyud nang bstan la phan med lta ba'i 'du shes dang mthong chung /bod mi rigs kyi tshab mtshon thub cing rigs zhen 'jon thang che ba'i bod rigs las byed pas dkon la/ g.yon thal che ba'i spo gnas 'go 'dzin dang mi rigs las byed pa'i gdug rtsub srid jus kyis/ bod mi mang gi phyi'i dpal 'byor 'tsho ba zhan pas gos hrul zhing mdog skya la/ nang chos lugs don 'khyol gyi srid jus med pas sems khams bde thang ha cang zhan pa mkhyen dus/bod kyi rang skyong gi/ rgya yi don dag spyod/166 kyin 'dug pa'i zhal rtsod gnang zhing / slad bod la ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong dang / rgyal bstan yang dar/ 'tsho gnas legs 'gyur/ slob gso dar spel bgyis te/ bod mi rigs kyi skyo gar myur skyob dang 'byung 'gyur gyi bod ljongs dpal yon gnyis kyis phyug pa'i mi rigs shig tu mngon 'gyur slad/ rang nyid kyi yod tshad 'bul ba'i zhum med snying stobs rdo rje'i brag la brkos so//1567paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i ba 'a slo ba/ deb dang po/shog ngos 135 nang /7pa ṇa chen er te ni zhabs zhu las don lte gnas lang gis pa ra/ byi lo naXcan ra/174

skya che'i mi da kyi cha/le tshan bcu pa/ gsang yum bde chen dbang mo/dpal mnyam med bka' rgyud kyi ston pa sgra sgyur gyi bla chen mar pa lo tsa ba chos kyi blo gros kyis sems can gyi don du bdag mo bzhes pa dang /7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bstan pa yang dar dang bod mi mang skyob pa'i mdzad pa skyong phyir gsang yum bzhes pa gnyis/ sems bskyed che chung sogs gang nas bltas kyang rnam pa kun tu mtshungs par mthong ngo /bsgrubs na khyim du gnas na'ang thar pa yod//'phags bod rgyal blon mar pa la sogs bzhin// ma bsgrubs ri 'gor gnas kyang ngan song rgyu//'phyi ba sa yi khung bur mtshams bcad bzhin// zhes gsungs pa bzhin slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsa/ dpal sa skya bdag khri rin po che/ smin gling khri chen sogs/gsang ba sngags kyi khri la mnga' brnyes shing / grub rtags rgya mtsho'i klong brdol pa'i skyes chen 'gas/ dgas/ bya dgos dbang ci rigs las gdul bya'i khams dang mos par gzigs te/ gang la gang 'dul ba'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab 175

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing 'jugapa'i thabs tshul las gsang yum bzhes pa'i las byang yod mod/shar rgyal ba tsong kha pas srol gtod pa'i bka' gdams gsar ma'i lugs 'dzin/ 7paṇa chen mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang nas bzung /mi lo drug brgya'i byung rabs lo rgyus ldan pa'i 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma'i bar/ bka' gdams gtsang ma'i nyams len lhur bzhes las gsang yum bzhes pa'i lo rgyus gleng rgyu med/'on kyang / phyi lo 1980 lor/ mi lo 14 ring gar song cha med du gyur pa'i bod mi'i sems dbus kyi zla gzhon 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bod yul du phebs pa'i gtam bzang brgya la stong brgyud kyis bod khams hril por khyab pa'i gtam snyan dar 'phyar dang lhan cig 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsang yum bzhes yod pa'i than skad cig kyang shab shob kyi gleng gzhir gyur/mi lo 10 yi rig gnas gsar brje'i dus ngan ring / bod mi mang la mi bsad rta 'khyer gyi god chag spos ci/ rab byung pho mo nang phan tshun gnyen sgrig btsan sbyor byas pa sogs/ 'gro ba mi yis bzod par dka' ba'i rdung rdeg ji snyed cig bod mi mang gis dngos myong dngos gzigs yin stabs/7paṇa chen bcu pas gsang yum bzhes pa'i gleng phyogs la'ang / de tsam gyi 'drogs 'go langs pa'i 'khang ra zhu mkhan zhig byung mi 'dugad lta nga tshos zhib 'jug byed skabs rgya nag gzhung gis 7paṇa chen bcu pas gsang yum bzhes dgos pa'i sku ngal de/ calo rabs 60 pa'i rig gnas gsar brje'i dus skabs dang lhan du 'go tshugs 'dugaphyi lo 1962 7paṇa chen rin po cher ma nyes skyon 'dzugs kyis/176

sku che'i smad kyai cha/khong gi gcung po'i bza' zla pad+ma ma dbyangs can la btsan g.yem byas pa'i bston 'dzugs byas 'dug mi rnams kyis srid dka' ba'i gnas tshul der yid ches byed kyi med stabs/ tshogs chen steng pad+ma dbyangs can 'khrid nas 7paṇa chen rin po ches btsan g.yem ji ltar byas tshul brjod rgyu yin pa'i khyab bsgrags byas/gnas tshul de 'dra zhig dngos su byung med pas/ pad+ma dbyangs can mi mang gi mdun du 'khrid thub med/ 'on kyang / kho mo'i skad cha dang cha 'dra ba zhig sgra bsdud 'khor lo'i nang sgra 'jug byas te tshogs chen thog pad+ma dbyangs can gyis ther 'don gtam bshad yin khul gyis te bsgrags 'dugasgra 'jug byas pa'i skad kyi nang / ga dus yin na'ang kho pas nga la skyon 'dzugs byas byung / thengs shig btsan g.yem byas byung zhes bshad/ yin na'ang mi rnams kyi bud med kyi skad gdangs de pad+ma dbyangs can gyi skad gdangs min pa shes kyi yod/167phyi lo 1966 zla 1 tshe 2 nyin/ rgya gar khongs 'bras ljongs sgang tog nas spel ba'i gsar 'gyur nang / dgung grangs 28 la phebs pa'i bod brgyud nang bstan gyi dbu 'dzin 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog la/ bod dmag khul khang zhes pa'i dmag dpon krang go has bdams 'a tshol zhus pa'i bod kyi bu mo zhig gsang yum du btsan sbyor byas zhes dang /168phyi lo 1969 zla 9 tshes 12 nyin/ ldi li gsar khang gis/ phyi 'o1 1968 7paṇa chen bcu pas rgya nag gzhung gi bka' bzhin/ rgya mo zhig dang 'a ngas sa ba ra zhal bzhes ma gnang rkyen/ ngal rtsol bsgyur bkod khang 1 shā1shāshārnyi /shā/shāXshāshāX/ ba87267 49182 btso0'iX 2010ra yo

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/bsre byas pa'i srid jus bod la lag bstar ched yin pa bshad/169ting zha'o phing gis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsang yum bzhes pa'i gnas tshul dngos gsang ba byed dgos pa'i bka' rgya btang stabs/170gung khran tang gi mtho rim dpon rigs ting zha'o phing dang / zhi krung zhun/ ting dbyi khra'o/ yang cin ren/ tung kud wu sogs/ ches mtho'i dpon rigs khag cig gis ma gtogs/ bod rigs mi mang gtsos 'dzam gling mi mang gis lta ci/tang phyi'i rgyal khab rim pa'i 'go khrid las byed tshos kyang 7paṇa chen rin po ches gsang yum bzhes pa'i gnas tshul dngos de shes kyi med/ der brten/gsang yum ji ltar bzhes tshul la bshad srol ji snyed cig byung 'dugaphyi lo 1980 zla 11 tshes 11 nyin/ dong kong gsar 'god pa (26309 lo ba9)gis bshad pa ltar na/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i chibs 'khor kha lo pas/tung kud wu'i /gsang yum gyi spo bo//rlangs 'khor kha lo par/ kher rkyang yul por lhags pa'i 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i skyo gar gnas tshul gleng skabs/ tung kud wu'i rlangs 'khor kha lo ba 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gnas stangs la snying rje tshad med skyes te/ khong la skyid sdug mnyam myong zhu ba'i gsang yum zhig bzhes pa'i re ba zhu ba'i gros kha bcad/7paṇa chen bcu pa'i chibs 'khor kha lo pas/ rinapo cher gsang yum bzhes pa'i snyan skul zhus par thugs dgyes bzhin zhal bzhes gnang bas/lo na 21 la son pa'i tung ku wu'i tsha mo li 'jas/ dgung grangs 42 la phebs pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi gsang yum la 'os sbyor byas pa bshad/171 695cha cha33 miska spyo 6sgo tha ri khudzispe17༷ rme kyu rin po ches 7pa'o chenabacu pa 'e skor la gsung pa'i tshig tho/171 22zhusastus/3 1980611—11650pal 68ba0773637 179

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhing 'jugayab gzhis rig 'dzin dbang mos/ phyi lo 1978 zla 2 nang /7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang 'dra bar/ ma nyes kha g.yogs kyi gyod gzhi phog pa'i rgyal khab rim pa'i grags can 'go khrid 'ga'/ krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi go sgrig gnang ste/ krung go gsar pa'i ri klung gi 'gyur ldog gzigs phyir yul skor du gdan 'dren zhus/yul skor ru khag gi 'gan 'dzin gzhon pa tung kud wu ni/ phyis su 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gsang yum du gyur pa'i li 'jas kyi spo bo yin/ yul skor tshogs pa'i dbu khrid kyi khrod du dgung na gzhon shos yin pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po che dang / tung kud wu'i sku srung na gzhon gnyis blos thub grogs po chags zhing /sku srung der khong la gsang yum zhig 'os sbyor yong ba'i re ba zhus/ dus yun zla ba gnyis kyi yul skor las 'gul mjug sgril rjes/ sku srung na gzhon des tung chi wu'i tsha mo li 'jas la/ dmag mi'i bu mo zhig 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gsang yum du ngo sprod yong ba'i re ba bton/172lo na 19 son pa'i bde chen dbang mo'i sgra 'dzin bu gar snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kyi bu gar 7paṇa chen zhes pa'i mtshan bzang thos ma thag kho mo rang nyid dang gnyen sgrig bya rgyu'i bsam tshul bton pa dang sbrags/ sku srung na gzhon de brgyud 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog mjal rgyu'i 'dod pa bstan zhing /mi bab rdzig pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi pho nyams kyis li 'jas kyi yid dbang rbad de 'phrog nor 'khrul gyi gzigs tshul zhig las 7paṇa chen rin po che yang / shar phyogs kyi me tog tu 'bod pa'i li 'jas kyi mdzes sdug gi bslu brid kyi rgya ru tshud de/ gsang yum du bzhes rgyu'i thugs thag bcad pa gsungs/17na ṣ+ṭha tsho r+ṣa ཿ kyis (17160 /ṭ+wāṃ/te(4r+sha /lko / 4lo lo 2008—4—2 4/740180

skya che'i smad kyai cha/shod tshul 'dra min sna tshogs de dag ni ting zha'o phing gis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsang yum bzhes dgos pa'i blang bya bton pa de/ phyis chab srid kyi nor 'khrul tshabs chen zhig shor ba shes stabs gsang ba byed dgos/zhes yang can ran la bka' rgya btang rkyen/ gsang yum bzhes pa ni/ khong nyid kyi thugs 'dod yin pa las rgya nag gzhung gis btsan sbyor min pa'i rnam pa mngon phyir/ yang can ran gyis thabs brgya jus stong gis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pas krung dbyang dbus gzhung la gsang yum bzhes chog pa'i snyan zhu phul du bcug pa dang 173phyogs gzhan zhig nas 7paṇa chen rin po cher brdzus pa'i mi zhig gis/ li 'jas dang /gsang yu ma /'khrungs sa brgyab pa'i dkrog gtam bzos te/li 'jas 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi sku sger drung yig yin tshul bya dgos pa'i bkod khyab btang yod/ gsang yum gyis kyang phyi tshul du gung khran tang gi bka' ltar drung yig yin khul gnang dgos byung 'dug de ltar ma gnang ba yin na/7paṇa chen bcu pas bod mi mang la lo mang zhabs zhu bsgrub pa'i byas rjes rnams nag sub la 'gro rgyur brten/ bod mi rigs kyis khyed 〈gsang yum 〉la khong khro byed nges red ces rgya nag gzhung gis gsang yum la sdigs ra skul 'dug174phyogs dang zur gyi gnas tshul mang po zhig sngog 'don byed skabs/da gzod nga tshos kha tshon bcad nas zhu thub pa zhig ni/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsang yum bzhes pa de khong gi dgongs pa min par/ ting zha'o phing gi blang bya'i bkod sgrig 'og byung ba zhig yin pa dang / phyis su las 'dzol bkod sgrig de gung khran tang gi mtshan mthong dang / ting zha'o phing gi gzugs brnyan la 17 55spo 0376607330ba 65meng 38 babaX669323114 1741989—4—492109703808368pas8181

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'dugaganod pa'i chab srid kyi nor 'khrul zhig tu shes rjes/ gsang yum bzhes med khul rgyun 'khyongs byas te/ kun gzags 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dang rjes dran mdzad sgo'i skabs/ gsang yum dang yab gzhis sras mo rig 'dzin dbang mo bkag 'gog byas pa ma zad/ gsar lam khag tu khong rnam gnyis kyi gnas tshul gang yang 'god kyi med/phyi lo 1989 zla 4 tshes 4 nyin/ gsang yum bde chen dbang mos/shang kyang gi dus deb (ba' ci'i/09)zhes pa'i nang gsal bsgrags shig gnang don/ngas mi rnams kyi lo rgyus kyi bden pa de shes thub pa bya nges yin/ nga dang 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bza' tshang yin pa ni bden pa'i lo rgyus zhig red/ nga tshos lo rgyus la brtsi bkur byed dgos nges yin zhes gsungs/173 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsang yum bzhes pa bod mi mang gis mkhyen gyi yod la/ de ni gung khran tang gis btsan sbyor byas pa zhig yin pa yang bod mi mang gis shes kyi yod pas/ bod mi mang gis gsang yum bde chen dbang mor khong khro byed don med/phyi lo 1978 lor/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches gsang yum bzhes dgos pa smos ci/ rgya mo zhig gsang yum du bzhes dgos par thugs mi spro ba'i steng /yab yum rnam gnyis kyis kyang dgag cha shugs chen gnang gi yod stabs/ dus yun zhig nang 7paṇa chen bcu pa dang yab yum rnam gnyis dbar la'ang 'brel ba zhan po chags pa'i sku ngal yang byung 'dug7paṇa chen rin po ches gsang yum bzhes tshe/ rgya nag gung khran tang gis mi rigs mthun sgril gyi 'ur gtam dang / kun gzags 7paṇa chen rin 175 1989—4 49ji balnga 〉/0330851877mi182

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing ca'ajuga.a mdo'i bla ma zhabs drung dkar po ni mtsho sngon zhing chen mi mang 'thus tshogs kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa yin zhing / mi rnams kyis zhabs drung dkar po kho rang la sdom pa med par rgya mo zhig dang 'khrungs sa skyon yod pas/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsang yum bzhes par go bskon blo 'gug byed rgyu dang blang byas pa bshad la/ gung khran tang gi gsang ba'i myul ma zhig tu dogs pa byed kyi 'dugaphyi lo 1978 lo smad 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos gsang yum bzhes rgyu yongs 'dzin rgya yag rin po ches mkhyen 'phral/ sakya rin po che pe cing du ched gtong gis phyag 'phrin gnang / yongs 'dzin rin rtso ches 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsang yum bzhes pa de dus kyi mdzad pa zhig tu dgongs bzhes gnang yang / yab yum gnyis thugs 'phral gzod med ngang / 7paṇa chen gong ma rim byon gyi gsang yum bzhes med/ khong gis gsang yum bzhes na/bslam sdom blos gtong dgos pas mtshan snyan la gnod skyon thebs nges/nam zhig bod la log rgyu'i nyi ma shar tshe/ bod mi mang la 'grel bshad ji ltar rgyag dgos gsungs te zhal bzhes gnang mi 'dugabod mi mang gtsos 'dzam gling mi mang phal mo ches/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches gsang yum bzhes pa ni/ sku ngal chen po'i 'og de ltar gnang dgos byung ba'am/ yang na/ de snga sku srog la thug kyang blos btang ma myong ba'i rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa/ bod mi mang gi don chen sgrub phyir/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad 'phrin zhig tu ngos 'dzin zhu bzhin 'duga'o na/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gnas bab ci 'dra zhig gi 'og tu gsang yum bzhes sam/ gnas tshul de'i skor la sku 'bum dgon pa'i bla ma 184

skya che'i smad k+shi cha/sakya rin po che dang / grags can gyi rgya rigs rtsom pa po wang li zhung gnyis la gsal cha chen po 'dug cing / khong gnyis kyis gsungs na/ phyi lo 1977 lor/btson grol byung ba'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bod mi mang dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched du phyag las gnang 'dod chen po yod/'on kyang / krung dbyang gis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la g.yogs pa'i zha mo gsum dag sel lta ci/ skabs der las gnas kyang slar gso byas med/ krung dbyang gi 'go khrid chos/ khong gi las gnas slar gso gnang ba'i thugs re chen pos bsgugs kyang / dgongs bsam don thog tu ma 'khyol stabs/krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang dang rgyal khab mi rigs don gcod khang gi blon chen yang cin ran la/ las gnas slar gso yong ba'i re ba zhus/ngal gso'i dus gseng nam yin la tā se rtsed rgyur ngan goms su shor ba'i ting zha'o phing dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi blon chen yang cin ran sogs tā se rtsed bzhin pa'i nyin zhig skabs/ yang cin ran gyis lab shor gleng zhor du 7paṇa chen gyi las gnas slar gso dgos pa'i re ba 'don gyi/zhes ting zha'o phing la snyan seng zhus/ ting gis 7paṇa chen gyis gsang yum bzhes na las ka bkod sgrig byas chog pa bshad/yang cin ras phyir 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i sku gam du bcar te/krung dbyang gis khye da la las ka bkod sgrig gnang 'dod 'dug 'on kyang / gsang yum ma bzhes na krung dbyang khyed la blos 'khel gyi mi 'dug gsang yum bzhes na khyed kyis bod mi rigs kyi ched du las ka byed thub kyi red ces zhus par/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ gsang yum bzhes rgyu gnad khag mi 'dugagal che shos ngos da lta bod mi rigs dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched las ka 185

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'dugabyed dgos yod gsungs/nam rgyun bzhin nyin zhig phyi dro ting zha'o phing dang / yang can ran/tung kud wu'u sogs ta se rtsed bzhin pa'i skabs/ yang cin ran gyis 7paṇa chen gyi gsang yum bsnas rgyu khas blangs song / zhes ting la snyan seng zhu skabs/ting gis de chab srid kyi nor 'khrul shor ba red/ gsang ba byed dgos/ zhes bka' rgya btang 'dug ting dang yang gi sbag rogs grogs po tung ku wud kyis/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsang yum/ bzhes rgyu yin tshul rang gi khyim du bshad/gsang yum gyi a mas kho mo rang gi bu mo che ba 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gsang yum du 'bul rgyur ya nga can ran la 'brel ba byas/blo mthun tung kud wu dang / kra'o e len gyi bza' zla ting yi khro'o/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi yang can ran gsum kha mthun gyis mdzub ston ltar/gsang yu ma gyi a mas rang gi bu mo gcen gcung gnyis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i sku mdun du 'khrid de/ rin po che gsang yum bzhes na bu mo rgan pa 'di phul chog zhus/7paṇa chen rin po ches bu mo rgan pa thugs 'dod ma gnang stabs/ slar yang kho mos bu mo chung ba 'di phul chog zhus par 7paṇa chen rin po ches zhal bzhes gnang ste gsang yum du bzhes rgyu'i thugs thag bcad/1777paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis li 'jas gsang yum du bdams pa ni/ li 'jas gcen mo las mtshar sdug ldan par gzigs pa zhig ma yin par/li 'jas lo na gzhon zhing klad pa bsil bas/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches bzo lta ga re bzos bzos la dgongs pa bzhes pa zhig red/ ces rgya rig mkhas dbang wang li zhung gis gsungs/177〈1〉wa nga li gzhung la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshis tho/gong tshes nyen/〈na〉byayas/batha smo60760ba khyim 49187/bab0050 186

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/mi //rdo ma —24)(( ci〈snane+e 4shā rmo rā bye tsha /ri ri(1 sdu)/ther+shardoX/ / lge rī ཿtrī traṃ /phyu/drici ru ༷zlordo /ci rici)༄ ༷ wa /ci /sdu ༵ci chi hrīrdo tshan+dha4ris bye rir ci :ri ci tsho mjisna 〈snang r+shami mi ca dro ri ༷spyo 6 tre/ri ri/rdo 7 di ri mi ri gās8〉 kā sna ri la sa ci ci ༷ byeX ri ri trī ris tsho / shāḥ//chu/rdo ci pho riri ci/jidzo phyogargyuX//rdo sku/ phyacitho ci4rje ci sa jici4 du (7paṇa chen rin sdo che dang gsang yum bde chem dbang mo/ sras mo rig 'dzin dbang mo )skabs ra krung dbyang nas ga na ga lag khyer sprod rgyu dka' ngal che yang / yang can ran gyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang li 'jas rnam ga sa kyi tshab sa / ga na ga lag khyer sa par na gar sprad cing / pe cing mi rigs rig gnas pho brang du/ rgyal khab kyi dbu khrid li nyan dang / krang tad phin/yang tā kre/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ kra'o phu'u kru'u sogs kyi ga na na gtso nga 'og gzab cing rgyas pa'i mdzad dang sbrags/ li 'jas kyi mtshan la paṇa ba chen dbang mo sa pa'i mtshan gsol/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sa gsang yum ba sa rgyu'i thag gcod la/ yab yum rnam ga sa kyis mos mthun rtsa ba nas med pa ma zad/ bkag 'a ga shugs chen gnang yang ma gsan stabs/ rang ba na rgyu yin sa 'jigs skul yang gnang da sa byung yod/mi rnams kyis 7paṇa chen bcu pas gsang yum ba sa pa dus bstun gyi mdzad pa ga la bsam sa byed thub kyang / 'phral rkyen thun 187

7paṇa chen ler te ni zhib ca'ajugamong snang ngor yang can ran dang / zhabs drung dkar po'i zhus dbang du song zhing / phyi lo 1978 zla 6 ting zha'o phing sku ngo mas jus bkod dang chog mchan gnang ba zhig yin pas/ krung go'i gnam 'og gi skye bo su zhig gi 'gog par mi nus/rgya nag gzhung gis 7paṇa chen bcu par btsan gyis gsang yum bzhes bcug pa'i nor 'khrul gyi srid jus rtug pa sa 'gebs kyis bsam pas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gang du chibs zhal bsgyur kyang / gsang yum lhan rgyas su phebs mi chog pa'i bkag 'gog byed kyi yod la/ khong la gsang yum bzhes mi 'bod par sku sgor gyi drung yig ces pa'i ming gnas btags yod/ tha na/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul skabs lhan bzhugs mi chog pa'i bkag 'gog byas/bsam rgya chung ba'i bod mi 'gas kyang / da lta'i char yang 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi mdzad par gnod dogs/ gsang yum bzhes pa'i gnas tshul sba gang thub byed kyi yod la/ rgya bod spyi tshogs khrod gsang yum gyi chags sems g.yo sgyus 7paṇa chen bcu pa dbu skor btang ba bshad la/ rgya nag gzhung gis 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i phyag las la gsang ba'i lta rtog byed mkhan gyi myul mar mngags pa yang bshad/gsang yum bde chen dbang mos/ bdag dang 7paṇa chen rin po che thog ma mjal phrad byung sa ni pe cing gi me 'khor 'bab tshugs yin zhing / dka' ngal chen po de las /skabs der 7paṇa chen bcu pa btson grol thob kyang sku ngal chen po'i 'og gnas yod//thar thub pa'i ched 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang gnyen sgrig zhus pa yin/mi rnams kyis gus mos 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang gnyen sgrig byas pa de/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi go gnas dang phyag dngul la bltas te gsang yum byas pa bshad kyang / bdag dang 7paṇa chen mchog thog mar mjal skabs/ khong la gang yang mi 'dug188

sku che'i smad kyai cha/tha na/ khrom nas thug pa bzhes dkar gang mchod byed kyi gla phogs med pa'i nyam thag cig red/ skabs rer pe cing grong khyer gyi gsang lam du chibs sgyur gnang skabs/ de snga ngo shes 'dris grogs yin nga 'i dpon rigs rnams kyis kyang /7paṇa chen rin po cher g.yas g.yon du byol gang thub kyis/ 'tshams 'dri zhu mi dgos pa gtso gnyer byed pa las/ mdun du 'khor mi ha cang gi dkon ngo ra gyur yod gsungs/ gang ltar gsang yum bde chen dbang mor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la dad pa zhu mkhan gyi bod rgya sog gsum gyi dad ldan mang pos kha rdung ji snyed cig phog yod la/ tha na/ da lta'i 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gyi rang dbang yongs rdzogs gung khran tang gi tshod 'dzin dang bkag rgya'i 'og tshud yod/bde chen dbang mo ni phyi lo 1958 lor pe cing du 'khrungs shing tung chi wu'u tsha mo yin/ pe cing bud med mtho 'a bring slob grwa thon rjes/ krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi dpung sde 69 nang du sman pa'i phyag las gnang /zhi an dmag sde bzhi pa'i gso rig slob grwa che mor tshud kyang / phyi lo 1979 zla 1nang lo na 20 la son pa'i li 'jas kyis/ zhi an dmag sde bzhi pa'i gso rig slob chen nas slob gzhol rtsa dgongs zhus te/ dgung grangs 4'a phebs pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po che'i gsang yum du gyur/ da lta pe cing chab srid gros tshogs su phyag las gnang bzhin yod/gsang yum bde chen dbang mos/ kho mo'i tshe stod kyi mi tshe ni bod pa zhig yin/ bod kyi gal che'i dus chen dang mdzad sgo'i skabs/ bod dbus gtsang dang /khams/ a mdo sogs kyi srol rgyun rgyan cha lus la mnabs myong gsungs/ bde chen dbang mo 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gsang yum du gyur pa nas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pas bod brgyud nang bstan gyi dge lugs pa'i grub mtha'i 'dul khrims ltar/za 'og gi phyu chen las rab tu byung ba'i chos gos banabs kyi med/189

7paṇa chen ser te gi zhib ca'ajugaphyi lo 1983 zla 6 nang dgung lo 44 la phebs pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po che dang / lo na 34 la son pa'i gsang yum bde chen dbang mo rnam gnyis la rigs kyi myu gu'i sras mo zhig 'khrungs shing / mi rnams kyis sham bha la'i sgrol dkar du 'bod pa'i sras mo khong gi mtshan la/ paṇa rig 'dzin dbang mo/zhes 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku ngo mas mtshan gsol gnang /gsung rgyun du/ zhabs 'bring sku 'khor tshos gsang yum la mngal sbrum pa'i skor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i snyan du sgron skabs/ bu red pas zhes bka' rtsad phebs shing / sras mo zhig 'khrungs 'dug zhu skabs/ thugs pham pa'i bzhin las/a kha/ bu zhig yin dgos/ zhes zhal sgo las thol byung du bsgrags ma thag 'o ya/dga' mo yong / gsang yum la 'tshams 'dri dang / sku gzugs la thugs bcag dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang ba gsungs/ / 190

sku che'i smad kyai cha/le tshan bcu gcig yab gzhis sras mo rig 'dzin dbang mo/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 28 nyin/ sham bha la'i sgrol dkar du grags pa'i rig 'dzin dbang mo'i yab mchog 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/ nyin de nas rig 'dzin dbang mo'i sems ngogs kyi 'od snang yod tshad nag thom du gyur/pha med dwa phrug tu gyar ba'i rig 'dzin dbang mo'i mgo 'don 'tsho skyong yod tshad gsang yum bde chen dbang mo'i mgo 'og tu lhung skabs/ dman bu mo'i blo rgya las/ mtshan gyi snyan pa gling lnga'i khyon du grags 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi sras mo zhig yo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i mdzad pa'i mjug skyong dang /rgyun 'dzin bu rabs shig tu gso skyong byed pa'i 'gan 'khris/ zas brjed gnyid chag gi sems khral byung ba los kyang bden/mi lo 10 son pa'i rig 'dzin dbang mo slob chung 'grim pa'i mtshan mo zhig gsang yum la rig 'dzin dbang mo'i 'byung 'gyur 'gro don dang /mi che'i rin thang bsgrub phyir thag ring a ri'i yul du slob gnyer du mngags dgos pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rmi lam lung bstan zhig byung /178 phyi lo 1996 zla 7 tshes 21 nyin/ dgung grangs 13 la son pa'i rig 'dzin dbang mo slob chung thon rjes/ gsang yum la ston pas gnang ba'i lung ba ba gas a ri'i yal da 11ba gnyer du mngags/1 8 /ṣ+ṭhatshe lko ṣ+ṭha nyachaX telan〉〉skalaX191

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhib 'dugapha bzang po 'tsho gzhes skabs pe cing na yod pa'i 7paṇa chen gzim shag tsung tu'u pur/ ma ma dang / kha lo ba/ gsol thab pa sogs zhabs g.yog drug gi stor skyong 'og 'tshar longs byung ba'i rig 'dzin dbang mo/ bcu gsum byis pa'i lo nas 'tsho gnas khor yug la gnam sa'i bar khyad chod pa'i rgyus med sa mtha' 'grim skabs/ skra ser spre'ur 'bod pa'i nub phyogs pa dang dpung pa mnyam bsdur gyis rang 'tsho rang gis skyong dgos thug dus/ nar ma son pa'i gzim shag bu mo'i sdug bsran las/ bzod dka' ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'jags mi srid pa'i sems ngal gyis/ byis dus kyi spro snang yongs su bcom skad/a ri'i grong khyer ni'u yog tu 'byor rjes gsang yum gyi ngo shes kyi mdzub ston las/ dus yun zla ba gsum gyi ring 'tsho ba'i khor yug tha zhan du khas 'che ba'i/ phu lu kha ling 128 slob 'bring du slob zhugs gnang / slob grwa der shi ya'i tshong pa'i bu phrug bzhi las gzhan rnams mi rigs nag po'i bu phrug zhe gcig yin stabs/ yul phyogs 'du shes kyis e sha ya'i slob phrug bzhi dang gzhan yul gyi skyid sdug mnyam du myong 'dod kyis/ khong tsho dang gleng mol byed skabs rgya nag nas yong ba'i slob phrug bzhi pos/ kong tung gi log skad las dbyin ji'i skad legs po zhig shes kyi med stabs/ kho tsho dang sems gtam shod pa'i go skabs yongs su bcom skad/179goms na dmyal ba'i gting la sdug bsngal med pa'i dpe ltar/ rig 'dzin dbang mo yang mi rigs nag po'i 'tsho bar goms 'dris su gyur te/slob tshan grol ma thag gri chung khyer te slob phrug phan tshun rjes ded gtong res byed pa'i rtsed mor rbad de dbyings zhugs/ yab gzhis rig 'dzin dbang mos/179 363 114sto1༄77chaX 〉lo31—4loloX192

kyi tshe'i mi da kyi cha/de lta bu'i 'tsho bas nga'i lus sems la sngar med kyi ngar shugs shig sprad byung /de ni dka' ngal la gdong len byed rgyu de red/ nga rang 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bu mo zhig yin pas/ ngas brnyas bcos dang dka' ngal yod tshad la 'thab rtsod byed dgos gsungs/rig 'dzin dbang mo a rir 'byor nas zla ba gsum song rjes/ pe cing nas yugs mor lus pa'i gsang yum bde chen dbang mo thug 'phrad du 'byor/gsang yum gyi ngo shes kyis thabs shes las sras mo rig 'dzin dbang mo kha li pho ni ya'i (07110701 'a/hre ci rgyal spyi'i sger btsugs sku drag slob grwar slob bsgyur gnang zhing / 7gong sa mchog la chos 'brel zhu myong zhing / nang bstan chos lugs la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan pa'i brtan skar chen mo'i drag 'dzing mkhan /si ti phan shi gha mchog la sras mor mgo 'don 'tsho skyong yong ba'i re ba zhus/ si ti phan shi ghas rig 'dzin dbang mo gung seng nam yin la/ rang khyim du bsus shing kho pa'i mi gzhis las rig 'dzin dbang mor a ri ba'i snying stobs dang / rang btsan gyi bsam blo'i shan shugs chen po thebs pa gsungs/a mi ri kha'i grong khyer wa shin kron gtsug lag (7'bya'i 0970ba/slob grwa'i chab srid tshan par slob gnyer gnang dus/ si ti phan shi gha gis sras mo rig 'dzin dbang mo thug 'phrad du phebs kyi rmed/ sras mo'i thugs la si ti phan shi gha lags ni rang nyid kyi a pha gnyis pa lta bu'i dung zhen las khyim tshang a rir spos pa lta bu'i dro skyid sbyin/rig 'dzin dbang mo me li cin slob grwa chen mo'i chab srid tshan khag tu yig rgyugs lam nas zhugs shing / phu 'jas nyi ya chab srid slob grwa chen mo nas slob mthar phyin/chab srid slob sbyong gnang rgyu de sras mo'i phugs 'dun gyi mngon 'dod cig dang /mi che'i rin thang skrun pa'i bya gzhag la mkho che ba'i lag cha gal chen zhig tu ngos 'dzin gnang gin medug ste/193

7paṇa chena' ra te gi jib 'dugastong— ltabor li — —— nga ma spre sha // )/ / ///mi4 / 1 7/lhabye / tshu ci ri 0)/sme 2//ri ci sa/thon tsho no/teci chos cig cha sku ༷/ci ri ri'i chi rirnga/rdo rtsorje riri //ga/bye//ci mi 44/jismo ci wa ༷ /tsho/ ci ཿci sku ci ri ji ci ri tshal 77〉 ci susdu ri / chu ri d+ku ṭa ( yab gzhis sras mo rig 'dzin dbang po)sras mo rig 'dzin dbang mos/ chab srid slob tshan bdams bsgrigs kyi slob sbyong bya rgyu de bdag la mtshon na gal 'gangs che shos kyi bya ba zhig yin/yab mchog dam pa sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs kyi grogs 'dris yod do cog chab srid mi sna yin la/ chung ngu'i skabs nas khong rnam pa'i gnas tshul gsar shog dang bsnyan 'phrin gyi lam nas mthong myong / 'di 'dra'i khor yug gi bag chags zab li 'og bdag la nam du yang chab srid kyi bag chags mthug po zhig bzhag byung /de bas kyang bdag ni 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i bu mo zhig yin pas/ ngas yab mchog dam pa'i zhal chems ltar pha shul bu mos 'dzin thub pa'i dam bca' bzhag yod la/bod mi rigs kyi ched du las ka zhig kyang byed 'dod yod/ ngas bod khul gyi dpal 'byor dar spel dang / bod rgya mi rigs 'brel mthud kyi zam pa zhig byed dgos pas/ chab srid ma shes na ji ltar 'grig bdag a rir slob gnyer byed skabs su yang phugs re 'di rtsa ba nas brjed ma myong gsungs/194

kyi che'i mi da kyi cha/a ri'i slob grwa 'grim pa'i lo ngo bzhi yi ring / ni'u yog tu 'tshogs pa'i bod rig pa'i tshogs 'du dang / 'dzam gling rgya gram dmar po'i 'tshams 'dri tshogs 'du/ 'dzam gling bud med kyi chab srid tshogs chen sogs la zhugs shing / nam rgyun slob grwa'i rgan bdag dang lo rā ci slob grwa'i rgyal spyi'i 'brel ma thud pa'i 'gan yang bzhes myong / phu 'jas nyi ya chab srid slob grwa chen mo thon rjes/ dbyin ji'i nyi'u kun (0580(7)slob grwa chen mo dang / yang na/ a ri'i ka lun pi ni ya'i (0'a/0070/ma/slob grwa chen mo gnyis gang rung du slob gnyer gnang rgyu'i dgongs gzhi yod kyang /stabs ma legs pa zhig la phyi lo 2000 lor/ srid 'dzin wu'u cin tha'o dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blon chen li'u yan tung gnyis kyis/gsang yum la sras mo rgya nang du phyir bsu dgos pa'i bka' rgya btang bas/ yab gzha ngas rig 'dzin dbang mo'i sku che'i bya gzhag gi 'grul bzhud la rgyags phye gsog pa'i ming grags che ba'i slob grwa chen mo de gnyis 'grim khom ma byung /phyi lo 2000 zla 8 nang pe cing du phyir log gis chin ha gtsug lag slob grwa chen mo'i nang / dngul rtsa rig pa'i bum rams pa'i slob gnyer gnang dgos pa'i bkod sgrig byas/ phyi lo 2010 zla me nang pe cing chen ha slob grwa chen mo nas/ dngul rtsa rig pa'i 'bum rams pa'i slob mthar phyin/de ni bod rigs shig dngul rtsa rig pa'i 'bum rams pa thon pa dang po yin/slob zhor du bod kyi rgya gram dmar po'i mtshan 'dzin tshogs gtso dang 'dzam gling rogs skyob tshogs pa'i blo 'dri yul gyi thugs 'gan bzhes kyi yod/ go thos su/sras mo a rir slob sbyong mngags pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni/ phyi yul rang dbang lung pa nas bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung thog rang dbang gis slob sbyong thob phyir dmigs pa zhig red 'dug la/ gsang yum gyis btsan byol bod mi'i mtho rim mi sna 'gar de ltar yong ba'i gsol 'debs kyi phyag bris kyang bskur skad/195

7paṇa chena'ar te ni zhib 'jugaphyi lo 2000 lor/ dgung lo 18 la phebs pa'i rig 'dzin dbang mo/rgya nag dbus gzhung gi bkod sgrig ltar 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul ched bkra shis lhun pos gtsos bod khul du gzigs skor du phebs/ de ni phyi lo 1989 bod la phebs rjes su/ bod la phebs thengs dang po yin zhing / phyi lo 2002lor slar yang nyin zhag 40 ring bod brgyud nang bstan slob sbyong dang bod mi mang la 'tshams gzigs gnang bar phebs/ skabs der 'khrungs skar yang bod du btang skad/ rig 'dzin dbang mo bod la phebs skabs/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi sras mo bod du phebs pa'i gsar 'gyur/ bod khams yongs su rlung ltar grags shing / bod rigs ser skya khri stong mang pos dngas gtsang gi mjal dar bsnams te sras mor phebs bsu zhus/bod mi'i chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog ri bo hi ma la'i rgyab tu bzhugs shing / 7paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po che gung khran tang gi khri mun btson du btsud pas/ mgon med sdug gis mnar ba'i bod mi tshos/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher bcangs pa'i dad sems yod tshad yab gzhis rig 'dzin dbang mo'i steng du 'phos te/ dad sems dang / brtse dung /yid ches/ re 'dun lhad med cig bcangs bzhin yod stabs/ rig 'dzin dbang mo'i thugs la sngar med kyi 'gan khri'i 'du shes 'khrungs te/ phrag steng nas ljid tig tig gis snon bzhin pa'i tshor snang sbyin gyi yod pa gsungs/da lta nar ma son pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi sras mo rig 'dzin dbang mo mchog pha shul bu 'dzin gyi dam bca' dang bod mi rigs la zhabs 'degs bsgrub pa'i phugs re/ da dung gsang yum gyis khyed rang 7paṇa chen rin po che'i bu mo zhig yin pas/ bab chags pa'i 'tsho ba skyel dgos la/ mi sger gyi la rgya dang bod mi rigs kyi la rgya dgos pa'i dran skul dang zhal tas lus sems ngal skad/196

sku che/be+e sma da kyai cha/yab gzhis rig 'dzin dbang mos/ mi rnams kyi mthong snang du bdag la sdug bsngal ci yang med par snyam gyi yod/ bdag la bdag gi dka' ngal yod/ gal srid bdag 7paṇa chen rin po che'i sras mo zhig min na/ 'khyog dka' ba'i 'gan 'khri 'di 'dra 'khyer dgos don med/ bdag kyang bu mo gzhan dang 'dra bar bud med tshos rmi lam tshun du re zhing sgug pa'i dpe gsar gyon chas 'khrab ston dang 'char 'god kyi bya ba dag kyang bdag gis shes srid/ yin na yang / bdag gi 'gan 'khri shin tu che/bod mi mang gis yab mchog dam par dad pa byed pa'i sems khams 'du shes bdag gi lus steng du 'phos te/ dad pa dang / re ba/ brtse sems che yang / bdag ni da lta slob gnyer ba zhig yin pas bod mi mang gi ched bya ba ci yang sgrub mi thub gsungs//180180 rdo 3 114 1577chaX lo446 〉bolaX197

7paṇa chena'ar te ni gis 'jug le tshan bcu gnyis/ ming don mtshungs pa'i 'od rigs rang skyong rtsod len/mi rigs sa khul rang skyong zhes pa 'di/ bod rang skyong ljongs la bshad na'ang 'dra/ bod rigs rang skyong khul khag dang / rdzong la bshad na'ang 'dra/nges par du ming don mtshungs pa zhig dgos/181phyi lo 1987 zla 4 tshes 15 nyin/ pe cing mi mang tshogs khang chen mo'i bod ljongs tshoms chen nang bod rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs dbu brnyes pa'i tshogs chen steng / 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ gcig gyur gyi bod rigs rang skyong ljongs 'dzugs rgyu'i re 'dun ni tshul lugs dang mthun pa dang /khrims dang mthun pa zhig yin la/ rgya che'i bod mi dmangs kyi bsam 'dun dang mthun pa zhig red/ de ni cha rkyen 'dzoms min gyi gnad don zhig yin pa las/phyir bshol byed pa'am log spyod zer ba'i gnad don gang yang med/182 ces rgyal khab rim pa'i dpon rigs 'dus pa'i tshogs chen thog bsgrags gtam spel ba gnang 'dugazhal gsung bsgrags gtam de'i mjug ston gyi tshul du/ phyi lo 1989zla 1 tshes 23 nyin/ slar yang gtsang ljongs gzhis rtse bkras lhun dgon du/sa khul khag lnga po zla bsgril gtong dgos zhes pa'i skad cha de/ log spyod pa dang /181kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi brka' slob/shog ngos 114nang /phyi dril las khungs kyis dpar 'grems byas/phyi lo 1998lor/men bod mi gsar brje ba zhigashog ngos 56༷nang /chung tshe ring gis bod sgyur byas/bod kyi dusabab kyi par/phyi lo naXphyir ra/198

kyi :tshon smad kyi cha/gsar brjer ngo rgol ba/ ngo log pa red zer ba'i shod tshul la nga mos mthun med/ ces bod rigs sa khul lnga'i tang srid dmag gsum gyi dbu khrid dang /bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grags can bla sprul/ rgyal khab rim pa'i blon chen bzhugs pa'i 31gas chen steng skuthongs grags su khe|ma bsgrags gnang 'dug183nya ces ma thebs pa ma ga31gas// ma31 mtha' ma bsto|ra ba min// ces pa ltar/ phyogalo 1961 nas 1962 yas mas su bod nang bod rgyal gces rang dbang 'thab 'dzing tshogs pa zhes pa zhig bas/gas 'dug la/184 4paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang / yongs 'dzin rgya yag tshang rin po che rnam gnyis yang /31gas pa'i de'i 11sa bsdur nang mnyam bzhugs gnang 'dugabod rgyal gces rang dbang 'thab 'dzing tshogs pa'i bod rang btsan bsgrub bya'i las 'char 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la snyan seng zhu skabs/7paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas da lta lam seng rang btsan ma lab par/go rim bsgrigs nas bya rim bo/ma stabs gnyis par rang btsan bkod chog gsungs pa ma zad/185dus la babs tshe 7paṇa chen rin po che yang tshogs pa de'i tshogs mi ces mar zhugs rgyu yin zhes gsungs/186phyi lo 1964 lor/ dgung grangs nyi shur phebs pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu 18 kun gzigs 7pa r+ṇa chen bcu pa ma chog gi bka' slob/thog ngos 98nang /phyi dril la sa khungs par 'grem sa byas/phyi 'o 1998lor/184 tshogs pa de ni byi lo 1941 nas 19phyin g.yas g.yo na du btsugs pa zhig red 'dul la/tshogs rngu 'i dmigs yul bod rang btsan bsgrub rgyu/tshogs mi'i gras 'bri yu la ba bsod nams dbang rgyal/ cha pa ju na tshogs tshe brtan/ byams pa chos dbang / nam rnam bkra shis don grub/ rin sung bso da nams dpa la 'byor/ phran zugs bsod nam sa chos 'ab la/ thang spel bun tshogs rnam rgyal bcas mi drug dang / 7paṇa chen rin po che dang /yongs 'dzin rgya yag tshang rnam gnyis nas phyi 'o ga nas rgyab skyor zhu yi 'dug yig cha de'i nang yo ngas 'dzin 6 yag tshang zhes 'khod 'dug kyang / dus skabs dir rgya ya ga rin po che sku 'bum la phyir log sanang zin pa dang / yongs 'dzin gyi 'gan gtso bo dngul chu rin po ches gnang gi yod pa sa phal cher yongs dzin dngul chu spru la sku yin par snang / 185dus 'gyur ma byung gong bod du chab sred skyong rim/shog ngos min nas 188bar/bod kyi dpe mdzod khang /gyi lo naX lor/186dus 'gyur ma byung gong bod du chab srid skyong rim/shog ngos 18 nas 188bar/bod kyi dpemadzod khang /phyi lo na007lor/199

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhing 'jume pa mchog gis/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi gsung chos ra ba'i yangs steng du/dad ldan mi mang khri tsho 'dus pa'i tshogs mgon nas/ bod rang btsan thob thub nges red/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa phyir log thub nges red/bod rang btsan yin/ 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho khri lor brtan pa'i gad rgyang bsgrags myong mod/lo mang ring gung khran tang dang mes 'tshig mer gtugs kyis 'thab rtsod lo mang gnang ba'i nyams myong gi bslab byas/ bod kyi gnad don 'di gung khran tang gis 'gul skyod ma btang bar/ gzhan sus kyang thag gcod mi thub pa'i nges pa rnyed yod de/ phyi lo 1978 zla 12 rgyal yongs srid gros kyi tshogs chen steng / 7paṇa chen rin po ches 'das pa'i lo mang ring ngos rang gi nyams myong la bltas na/ krung go'i mi rigs khag dang lhan du mes rgyal khyim tshang chen mo'i nang mnyam 'dzoms byas na/ gzhi nas bod la 'od stong 'bar ba'i 'byung 'gyur zhig thob rgyu yin pa thag bcad nas zhu thub kyi 'dugaslad phyin ngas gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid la brtsi bkur dang / mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur/ mi rigs mthun sgril la srung brtsi/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher lhag bsam dag pa'i zhabs 'degs/ bod mi rigs kyi phan bde srung skyob bcas bya rgyu ni/ srog la thug kyang blo brtan 'gyur med kyis mtha' 'khyongs byed rgyu yin/ de ni ngas da phan lo mang nyams myong dngos la zhib rtog gis phyogs bsdoms byas te sems thag bcad pa zhig yin zhes gsungs/de bzhin btsan byol gzhung dang mtho rim bla dpon rigs tsho la yang /rgya nag gzhung dang 'brel med rgyang ring du bzhugs pa'i srid jus kyis/ bod kyi gnad don la nus pa thon mi thub/ stag phrug 'dzin par stag tshang du 'dzul 200

kyi che'i mi da gyi cha/ dgos/187 bod mi rigs la sha zhen dang bod mi rigs 'di yar thon dang gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa yong rgyur nus pa 'don dgos snyam na/ rgya nang kho nar ma gtogs phan yod kyi nus pa dngos 'brel zhig 'don mi thub pa'i dgongs 'char gsungs/ krung go mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims kyi nang tshad mtho'i rang skyong ngam chol gsum gcig tu bsgril ba'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi lam nas/ bod kyi gnad don sel ba'i bsam blo'i sgrom gzhi thog ma/ri bo hi ma ya la'i rgyab mdun na bzhugs pa 'i 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen su zhig gi dgongs gzhi yin min mi shes kyang / phyi lo 1962 lor/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches gung khran tang la phul ba'i yig 'bru khri bdun nang / dbus gzhung nas bod rigs yongs kyi khe phan dang mthun pa'i thun mong gi srid jus shig lag len bstar rgyu'i re ba yod ces dang /phyi lo 1987 zla 4 tshes 15 nyin/ pe cing mi dmangs tshogs khang chen mo'i bod ljongs tshoms chen du/ bod rigs gcig gyur gyi rang skyong 'dzugs rgyu de lugs dang mthun pa zhig yin pa dang / khrims dang mthun pa/rgya che'i bod mi dmangs kyi bsam 'dun yin pas/ phyir bshol byed pa'am log spyod zer ba'i gnad don gang yang med/188 ces gsungs pa de ni rgya nag mi mang spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims nang / chol gsum gcig tu sgril ba'i ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong gi lam nas bod kyi gnad don sel rgyur/ gsal kha dod pa'i mngon 'dod thog ma de yin par snang /7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi dgongasas pa'i klong du bcangs pa'i bod 187 rti rin po che la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'e zin tho/song tshes nyin/188pod mi gsar brje ba zhigashog ngos 560nang /chung tshe ring gis bod bsgyur byas/bod kyi dus bab kyi pa ra/gyi lo naXzhi'o ra/201

7paṇa chen ser te ni gime 'jugarigs sa khongs rang skyong gi don snying ci ltar lags sam zhe na/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/ nga tshor ho kong dang / me kol lta bu'i rgyal khab gcig la lam lugs gnyis kyi tshad mtho'i rang skyong de 'dra mi dgos/ nga tshor dgos pa ni ming don mtshungs pa'i rang ljongs yin/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi /rtsa khrims )dang /mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi bca' khrims/ )kyis sprad pa'i rang skyong gi khe dbang de dgos zhes gsungs//89 de yang gsal por brjod na/ krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims kyi mtshams tshad nang / bod rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi rgyal khab las khungs shig yin dgos yod pa dang / sa gnas mi rigs bod pas skyong bzhin pa'i bod rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi rgyal khab las khungs des/bod mi dmangs la rang khyim rang bdag gi dbang cha sprad de/ bod mi mang gi gang yag po red bsam pa de yag por brtsis nas sa khongs rang skyong gi srid jus dang / slob gso/ dpal 'byor/ nor srid/ bde 'jags sogs/bod kyi khyad chos dngos dang bstun pa'i khrims bzo'i bdag dbang dang lag bstar gyi 'gan dbang cha tshang yod pa'i dmigs bsal gyi gu yangs shig dang /rang dbang bdag skyong gi khe dbang zhig yod dgos pa gsungs/190kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi 'don gnang mdzad pa'i rang skyong gi dgos 'dun de dang / phyi lo 2008 lor/ btsan byol bod gzhung gis rgya nag gzhung la phul ba'i bsam 'char bar khyad par spu tsam med na/rgya nag gzhung gis 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs 'char de khrims 'gal dang kha bral yin pa'i bsgrags gtam spel ma myong na/ btsan byol bod gzhung gi 189phyi 'o 1986dkar mdzes bod rigs sa khul gyi las byed pa 'i tshogs chen thog gnang ba'i gsung ba da/1907paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i bka' slob/deb dang po /7pa'o chen ser te ni zhabs zhu khang gis par/phyi lo daX6lor/202

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugapa'i dgongs 'char yang yang gsung myong / 'on kyang / chab srid khor yug gi dbang gis/ khong gi dgongs 'char de dag la phyogs gnyis gas kha dung dang / skyon brjod phog gin yod/ skyon brjod dang kha rdung de dag gi dbar du/7paṇa chen rin po che ni grogs med kher rkyang du lus pa'i skyo snang myong dgos mod/ bod mi mang dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched/ ming chad dang gnon shugs gang la'ang ltos pa med par/ gang gnang thos par dgongs pa'i phyag las de mtha' 'khyol gnang yod/phyi lo 1980 zla 11 tshes 7 nyin/ mtsho sngon rma lto bod rigs rang skyong khul rtse khog sdong gi glog brnyan las khungs kyi sgo byang rgya yig thog bris yod pa gzigs rjes/ khyed tsho la 'di na mi rigs rang skyong gi lad mo tsam las 'ong gi mi 'dug bod yig med na ci zhig bod rigs rang skyong zhes pa red/ da cha dbang cha tshang ma rgya yis bzung na 'grig gi ma red/ dbang cha gtso bo de nga tsho bod rigs rang skyong byed dgos gsungs shing / gcan tsa rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring du/mi rigs rang skyong de ming la rang skyong zer ba ma gtogs/ don la rang skyong yod pa ma red/ ming tsam red/ mi rigs kyi don dag tshang ma skad yig red/mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso skyong byed rgyu de red/ mi rigs kyi khe dbang red/de tsho tshang ma la dog brdzis btang ba red/ phyin chad de lta bu'i gnas tshul tshang ma bsgyur dgos gsungs/phyi lo 1985 lor/ bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes te lo ngo 20'khor rten 'brel zhu ba'i las byed pa'i tshogs chen thog tu/ bod ljongs su mi rigs kyi las ka yag po byed dgos na/ dang thog tang gi mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi srid jus lag len yag po bstar dgos/ mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi bca' khrims de/ bod ljongs su lag bstar mthil phyin byed thub pa'i 204

kyi che'i mi da kyi cha/'gan len byed dgos pa gsungs/phyi lo 1986 lor/ dkar mdzes sa khul gyi las byed pa'i tshogs 'du'i steng / mi rigs rang skyong dngos 'brel ming don mtshungs pa'i rang skyong dgos kyi red/ ming la rang skyong zer nas don la rang skyong med mkhan gzhan skyong 'dra po dang / yang na tshab skyong 'dra po de 'dra byas na 'grig gi ma red/dngos gnas drang gnas nga tshos mi rigs rang skyong byed dgos pa'i zhal gsung lam ston phebs/ phyi lo 1986 zla 11 nang rgya nag dbus gzhung gis/bca' khrims kyi yig cha slob sbyong dgos pa'i gsal bsgrags zhes pa'i nang /mi rigs rang skyong skor gyi khrims lugs tshud med stabs/ thengs 20 pa'i rgyun las tshogs 'du'i steng 7paṇa chen rin po ches khrims 'dzin las khungs la bsam 'char bton kyang / kho tshos mi rigs sa khul du mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi bca' khrims slob sbyong byed dgos zhes par 'gyur ba btang yod/gnas tshul der 7paṇa chen rin po che dgongs tshoms chen po byung ste/rang skyong gi bca' khrims slob sbyong dang lag len bstar rgyu ni nga tsho grangs nyung mi rigs kho na'i gnas tshul min par/ gtso bo rgya rigs/ rgyal khab kyi las byed pas nges par du slob sbyong dang lag bstar byed dgos pa'i gnad don zhig red/ de ni mi zhig gis gyon chas mi gyon pa min pa sbyin bdag gis kho par gyon chas ma g.yogs pa dang gcig pa yin/ nga tshor dbang cha yod pa de bed spyod ma byas pa min par/ mi tshos dbang cha sprod kyi med pa red/192 ces gsung rtsod bskyon pas bca' khrims bcos sgyur btang ste/ mi mang nyin re'i tshags par steng bkod yod/ /192kun gzigs lapaṇa chen rin po che'i bka' spob/shog ngos 55nang /phyi dril las khungs kyis pa ra/phyi lo1998lo ra/205

7paṇa chen mar te ni jib 'jugale tshan bcu gsum/ bstan pa yang dar gyi me ro gsos pa/nga rang la nus pa gang yod pa rnams bton nas/ bod dang bod rigs sa khul smos ci/ tha na sog po'i sa khul dang bcas par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa sor chud la 'bad brtson zhu gi yod/bod brgyud nang bstan pa tshos 7paṇa chen sku na rim ni mgon po 'od dpag med kyi rnam sprul du bzhed cing / sngon smon las kyi mthu nus btsan pos/bod mi'i lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang lhan du/ bod khams skyong ba'i thugs bskyed rnam dag 'khrungs bshad/ de yang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi rnam par sprul skabs/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rnam sprul slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bod du gdan 'dren zhus/slob dpon gyis bod yul mun pa'i gling gi lha srin gdug pa tshar bcad nas/rgyal bstan stobs kyis bskyangs te bstan pa snga dar rgyas/rgyal po glang dar mas rgyal bstan rmang nasabashigs rjes/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi rnam par spral skabs/sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rnam spral jo bo rje dpal ldan a tī sha/'ebrom gyis dbus gtsang du gdan 'dren zhus dhe rgyal bstan dag ther mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs zhus pas bstan pa phyi dar du 'bod pa bzhin/206

skya che'i sma da kyi cha/ phyi lo 1950 nas rgya nag dmar pos bod brgyud nang bstan rmang nas bshig dus/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gis/ lhun rtse rdzong gnas skabs bka' shag nas sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rnam spral kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po cher/ 7gong sa mchog phyogs g.yol du ledros ring / 7paṇa chen rin po ches bod kyi rgyal bstan srung skyob la mthu nus 'don pa'i gsol 'debs zhus 'dugalo rabs 80 lo 'go nas bzung nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/bde 'jags med pa'i ko gru dang rta por chibs te/ bod gangs can ljongs kyi grong dang grong khyer zhabs kyis bcags te/ bstan dgon nyams gso'i mdzad khur bzhes te rgyal bstan yang dar gyi mdzad khur bzhes pa der/ bstan pa yang dar du 'bod dgos pa 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i dgongs gzhi rma med cig red 'dug phyi lo 1979 lor/ pe cing du phebs pa'i bod kyi sku tshab rnams kyis/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la thon phyag zhu skabs/ rin po ches gzhi ras la dpar ba'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis thang ga chen po zhig dang / shing dpar la btab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa'i shes rab kyi le'u'i phyag dpe zung / 7gong sa skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen par/ 'tshams rten phyag rtags kyi tshul du bskur ba gnang ste/'di 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par 'bul rogs/ shing par 'di ni ngas yul mdo smad kyi khul du shing par mang po gsar du brkos pa yin/sngar mkhan slob chos gsu spe kyi dus su bod la mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos dar ba/bod du glang dar mas bsnubs kyang bstan pa phyi dar yul mdo smad nas 'go 207

la'akho chen zher te ni shing 'dus btsugs pa red/ bar lam dus kyi khug la slebs nas mi bzhi shog khag gis/bstan pa rmang nas bshig nas med pa chags pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ ngas yul mdo smad kyi sa nas ched du brkos pa'i shing par gyi par phud de/ rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen par 'bul rgyu yin pas/ 'dir (bstan par yang dar /zhes brjod dgos pa gsungs/193phyi lo 1984 lor/ bkra shis lhun po'i dmangs bdag la gnang ba'i phyag 'phrin nang du'ang / ngos rang gzhi rkang sbyangs rtogs nus gsum de tsam mi ldan rung / bla ma lha'i lung las ngos bzung zhi nga sems bskyed las smon gyis mtshams sbyar nas/ 7paṇa chen bcu par skyes pa zhig yin gshis/ /rgyal bstan yang dar )gyi bya ba spyi dang /yang sgos rang skyong gdan sa chen po bkra shis lhun po 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed rgyu ni/ gzhan dkri mi chog pa'i rang 'khri bla na med pa zhig yin gyings brtan cing 'gyur med kyi sgo nas rang gdan bkra shis lhun po 'di nyid/snyigs dus bstan pa'i gnas sa zhig tu 'gyur bar 'bad rgyu yin pas/ de ga'i mkhan slob dge 'dun bgres gzhon tshang mas ngos la yid ches dang 'brel/rgyab skyor gzhogs 'dregs sgo kun nas gnang ba'i re ba zhu rgyu yin zhes bsna/kāspu/194bod brgyud nang bstan rin po che chags 'jig gi gnas su lhung skabs/ me tog gangs la phog pa'i lha skal 7gong sa skyabs mgon rgyal ba'i dbang po'i lhan/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi dbu 'phang dgung la 'dregs rgyu de/lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen rin po ches 'dor thabs med pa'i thugs 'gan zhig 19 sku cingo 'ju chen la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/thong tshes nyin 1947ri r+ṇa chen sku phreng bcu ri 'i chab thosagasum 'bum ga pa /bkras lhu na pa ra ma/208

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/tu dgongs bzhin yod pa ni/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i zhal sgo las/ ngos rang sngon chad srog la thug kyang rgyal ba shākya thub pa dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa/bod mi rigs blos btang ma myong la/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dang bod mi rigs kyi ched du/ gnam gyur bsdad myong la btson khang du'ang bsdad myong gsungs/mthar mi bab jig cing dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bod gangs can pa'i rgya stag ngar ma 'dra ba'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i mgul snying gi 'phar rtsa yang bod mi rigs dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don chen gyi ched du shor yod/dmangs gtso bcos sgyur dang rig gnas gsar brje'i gdon rlung 'tshub ma'i khrod/ tshar du dngar ba'i rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rten thams cad mer bsregs shing / ngo mtshar stong gis bskrun pa'i mkhar dgon thams cad rmang nas bshigs/ 'di phyi'i skyabs su bkur ba'i bla sprul mkhan gsum/sdug gsod dang / btson 'jug skya sar phab/ dad ldan mi mang gis gsang ba dam po'i sgo nas ma ṇi 'bru gcig 'don pa shes tshe/ tshe srog ma shor na btson du 'gro rgyur the tshom mi dgos pa'i mun nag gi lo zlar rdzogs tshig bkod nas/gu yangs kyi srid jus mag mog gsal ba'i phyi lo 1979 lo nas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bstan pa yang dar gyi mdzad pa skyong ba'i 'go tshugs/phyi lo 1980 lo nas ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu ltar gyur pa'i/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi chos lugs byed sgo bskyar gso dang / dad ldan mi mang gi chos lugs dad mos kyi re ba skong ched/ rin po ches sku nyid kyi na za'i phur rtser dreg pa chags shing / phyag ngar skrangs te snyun zug skyon na'ang / nyin mtshan sbrel te zhing 'brog mi mang la phyag rjen pas phyag dbang gnang gi yod/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i zhal sgo las/ phyag dbang sprod rgyu de dka' las zhe drags 'dug7gong sa mchog de gar bzhugs med pa red/ gal te khong bzhugs yod tshe ngos 209

7paṇa chen ler te ni zhib 'jugaganyis kyis khag bgos byed chog deng skabs ngos rang gcig pus 'gan 'khur rgyu red /mi kha shas kyi phyag dbang sprod rgyu de skyid po'i bya ba zhig red bsam pa yin/ dngos gnas byas na de ltar min/ chos lugs ni rtsa ba zab cing rmang gzhi brtan pa'i dad pa zhig yin pas lam sang med pa bzo mi thub/ mi tshang mar dad pa yod cing / gung khran tang la rang nyid kyi dad pa yod pa dang / bod rigs la'ang rang nyid kyi dad pa yod/ nga tshos chos nyid 'di dang brgal mi rung /dad pa yod na mi legs pa gang yod dam/ mi dmangs ni sems bzang can zhig red/ kho tsho'i dad pa byed yul ni lha yin pa las mi min/ ngos kyis mang tshogs la phyag dbang sprad tshe kho tshor dga' spro skye ba dang / phyir rang yul du log nas thon skyed yag po byas na mi legs pa gang yod dam/mi kha shas kyis mthong gsal red/ ngos gzhi rim du 'gro thengs rer dngul sgor mo mang po len pa red zer/ dngos gnas byas na khyed tshos mthong gsal red/ ngos la dngul byung rjes de dgon pa chung khag la byin nas rogs skyor byed pa yin/ ngos rang nyid kyi ched du dngul blangs pa min/ngas dgon pas rang kha rang gso bya rgyu dar spel gtong ba dang / dgon sde khag gis rang nyid kyis tshal 'debs pa dang / tshong khang 'dzugs pa/ 'brog ra gnyer ba bcas dar spel gtong gi yod/ yin na'ang dpe cha 'don rgyu gtso gnyer bya dgos gsungs pa ltar/195lha ldan jo bo rnam gnyis kyi bzhugs gnas gtsug lag khang dang /dga' ldan/ bkra shis lhun po/ sa skya dgon pa/ bsam yas/ se ra/ 'bras spungs/195nyan zhin gyi phyir dran nang /210

kyi che'i smad kyi cha/li thang dgon chen/ sde dge dgon chen/ dkar mdzes dgon pa/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil/ sku 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med bstan dgon nyams gso dang dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho zas ched/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku sger gyi khug ma nas dngul dmar grangs med cig zhal 'debs 'bul gnang mdzad yod/ma'o tse tung gis rig gsar las 'gul khrod/ bod kha ba can pa'i khyad nor sangs rgyas dngos kyi ring bsrel bzhugs shing / ston pa dgung grangs 12 dang sku tshad mnyam pa'i jo bo'i zhabs pus la sta re bsdun zhing / gzungs bzhugs bton nas thal rdul khrod bskyur ba dang / gtsug lag khang gi lha khang rnams su phag tshang dang / gsang spyod/ bong ra/ rta ra bzos/lha sa'i ra mo che gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dgung lo na sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje gshags gzong dang tho bas sku gzugs stod smad dum bur bcad pas ma tshad/ sku lus yongs su gzong dang tho rjes med sa med par byas pas shang dang zhal ras la'ang tho rjes mang du snang / sku gzugs stod smad dum bur bcad pa de dag sku gsung thugs rten chag dum gzhan dag rnams dang mnyam du lha sa'i 'bud rdzas kung sir bskyal te bzhag yod pa nas stod ling smad ling dbral te/ sku stod rgya yul du dbor bar bshad de gar song cha med gyur pas/ dad ldan bod mi rnams kyi brang khog gi snying dmar gson por bton pa ltar/ yid blong blong por gyur te lus sems bag mi phebs pa'i lo zla mang po phyin pa'i nyin zhig ste/phyi lo 1983 lor/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs rje'i 'bad rtsol las/ pe cing gung ku'i mdzod khang nas bod kyi rig dngos btsal 'tshol chog pa'i skal ba shar/ bsod nams las kyi bskos thang las/ sku bsnyan stong tsho phung gsog 211

7paṇa chen ber te gi zhib 'dugabargyab pa'i khrod nas lo mang gar song cha med du gyur pa'i ra mo che jo d+ku sku stod kyang rnyed son byung yod/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog gis/ ngos rang la brgya cha dgu bcu go lnga jo bo'i sku bsnyan red lab chog pa 'dug gsung bzhin/thugs dgyes pa'i ngang jo yi sku stod 'khrul med du ngos 'dzin gnang zhing /196sku nyid kyi gzim khang du gdan 'dren zhus te/ gam bcar lha bris bkras lhun dka' chen blo bzang phun tshogs la spyan 'byed gser chab sgron bcug ste/197mjal dar sgron zhing mchod 'bul zhus/ sna/da ———mo ri / sto dbyedagestuX sdid ༷ — tsho——— —————— /rnar choXbye snang cha rdo //rdo/khro /jisnye // shā tshe ri tho // ci7mini //bye ciX sta ri / / tsho /mo ri ༷ 4༄4༷shāX cig1mi d+ku ṭaṃgye /rngociX cadro ri tsho tsho /cho zhe༄ chi /skyisari blo / rdo shā ri/cho ci /4) ritsho tsho phag chi —sku ci ci 6ri tsho ri rinaXcisna gu te ri ༷ tshos snarnyi shāri dri ci mi ci na na 4) sdi ri sko she riri pa ri rirte na /thos / ci ra ri4 )ci /༷༷ chi sa ༷/ci sna ༷tsho ཿ ci ༷ ri 7shā ciXtsā — — 1——bye paṇachenabacupam ༵ /gisaramachejo bo btsal 'tshol gnang ba ser smad ri 'bur sprul skur slad lha ldan du gdan zhu bya phyogs skor lam ston dang / rgyal yongs chos tshogs kyi tshogs 'du'i thog rdo bo rin po che bzhugs yul ra mo che gtsug lag khang yin pas/ nyams gso bya dgos pa'i da ngas 'char tsha nan gsungs/1987paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs rje bka' drin las/ ra mo che gtsug lag 195 dge sdig la sa kyi myong ba/ deb thogis pa /sog ngos 4༷ nang / ser smad ri 'bur sprul sku sa bcams/shes ris par khang / pyi lo 1989 lor/197 bkras lhun bka' chen blo bzang sun tshogs kyi zhal gsung /khron1༷ sdi ga la sa kyi myong ba/ deb gnyis pa /sog ngos 41 nang / ri 'bur sprul skus brtsam ༄/shes rig pa ra khang / phyi lo 1989 lo ra/

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/khang sogs nyams gso bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs chog mchan gnang ba dang / lha sa 'bud rdzas kung sir lhag bsdad pa'i sku brnyan rnams rim bzhin phyir sprod nyams gso byed skabs/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku gzugs kyi smad chad de rnyed son byung bas/ ra mo che gtsug lag khang la gdan drangs/ jo bo'i sku stod phyi lo 1983zla 3 tshes 15 nyin gyi chu tshod 12 par lha ldan gtsug lag khang du phebs 'byor ma byung bar 'jim las bzos te dkar chag shel dkar me long ltar gzugs bzhugs phul ba'i skor gna' rabs 'dzugs skrun ru khag gi rig 'dzin dpal 'byor lags sogs pas ra sprod mdzad 'dugabod mtha' dbus kyi dad ldan rnams kyis sprin dkar po tshad la btsugs shing / sa nag po 'dom la 'jal te dbus lha sa'i jo bo rnam gnyis mjal du yong yang / bod snying pa'i skabs jo shāka rnam gnyis kyi sku mdun du/rgyu sa le sbram las grub pa'i gser kong bcu phrag lnga drug yod pa rnams/ lo rabs 60 nang gung khran tang gis me skyogs kyi mde'u bzos te pho brang po ta lar brgyab tshar bas/ jo bo rnam gnyis kyi sku mdun du mar me 'bul sa'i gser kong gcig kyang lhag med/phyi lo 1985 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pas bod gangs rgyan spyi sdom mthun gnyer khang gi ma dngul nas/ jo bo shakya mu ne'i sku mdun du gser kong zhig dang /phyi lo 1986 lor/ lha ldan smon lam ts+tshan mo'i skabs/ slar yang dzo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku mdun du gser kong zhig phul/ dus de nas jo shaka rnam gnyis kyi sku mdun du gser kong rtsa ba nas med pa'i lo rgyus kyi sa bcad kha skong gnang /rgya nag gzhung gis gtor bshig khrod lhag pa'i bod kyi sku rten rnams/ga ge mo'i rig dngos do dam zhes par bcug nas phyir sprod srid jus dngos 213

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhes 'jug 'bebs byed kyi med stabs/ phyi lo 1983 lor/ pe cing du bod kyi sku brnyan btsal 'tshol du 'byor ba'i 'thus mi dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang /rgyal khab chos don las khungs mnyam sbrel tshogs 'du'i steng / pe cing gu kung du yo da pa'i bod kyi rig dngos phyir sprod dgos pa ma zad/ sku brnyan rnams mdzod khang gcig nas bton te mdzod khang gzhan zhig tu ma bcug par/ dgon sde tshor bgo 'grems bya dgos pa'i bka' gsung tsha nan phebs pas/ pe cing gung ku rig dngos do dam khang du yod pa'i bod kyi rig dngos sgam drug brgya dang /khren tu'u rig dngos do dam khang du bod kyi rig dngos kron lnga tsam yod pa rnams bod kyi dgon sde khag la bgo bsha' rgyag pa'i skal ba byung /da lta ma na li ru bzhugs pa'i mkhyen brtse lags kyis gsungs na/phyi lo 1985 lor/ 7paṇa chen rin po che lha sar gzigs skor du phebs skabs/nor bu gling du yod pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs rig dngos do dam u yon lhan khang gi mdzod khang nang / lo rabs drug bcu pa'i nang bod kyi dgon sde khag nas gzhung bzhes btang ba'i sku brnyan ji snyed cig rdo phung bzhin blugs yod pa rnams kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos gzigs rjes/ sku'i lus steng chags pa'i sdom thag dang sa dul dag la ljags dbugs skyon bzhin/da cha sku brnyan de dag btson nas glod grol btang ste dgon sde khag la bgo 'grems bya dgos/ khyed tshos ltos dang / nga yang btson khang nas glod 'grol btang mi 'dug gam/ zhes khonge sku ngo mas thugs 'gan bzhes gnang ste/nor gling rig dngos do dam khang gi sku brnyan rnams/ bod dbus gtsang khul du nyams gso byed bzhin pa'i dgon sde khag gi rten gtso'i dod du bgo 'grems gnang /214

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/yun ring lo rgyus ldan zhing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar ba'i sku brnyan de rnams kyi khrod nas/ ra sgreng dgon gyi rten gtso jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rjer (dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur skabs 7paṇa chen rin po ches bod kyi dbon sde khag gi sku rten rtsa chen khag 'thor du me gyar ba'i ched bsdu rub mdzad par phyi lo 1964 lor khong sgri nag nyes su gyur yod/)gser gyi dbu rgyan dang snyan rgyan 'bul grub rjes/ ra sgreng dgon pa'i dgon bdag dwa sgreng rin po cher phyir gsol bstsal gyis / slad bor brlag mi yong ba'i skul lcag gnang /bod rang skyong ljongs rig dngos do dam khang du btson 'jug byas pa'i zhol par khang gi bka' 'gyur shing brkos par ma rnams/ rang skyong ljongs kyis bod ljongs nang bstan mthun tshogs la rtsis sprod byed dgos pa'i dgongs bka' nan po phebs pa ltar/ phyi lo 1985 zla 5 nang rtsis sprod byung /199phyi lo 1985 lor lho kha sa khul du rtog zhib tu chibs sgyur skabs/ bsam yas gtsug lag khang ni bod kyi dgon pa dang po yin pas/ sngon ma bzhin nyams gso bya dgos/ ngos rang ngo mas rgyal srid spyi khyab khang la snyan seng zhu rgyu yin gsungs pa bzhin/ bsam yas nyams gso'i 'gro gron ched sgor khri bzhi stong lhag cig btang yod/200phyi lo 1986 lor/ ma'o tse tung gi rig gsar rtsed mo'i khrod nas lhag pa'i bla rgan re gnyis yod pa tshos ma gtogs/ dgung lo nyi shu man gyi rab byung dge 'dun pa gtsos/ bod rigs na gzhon rnams kyi rna bar lha sgrung du gyur pa'i lha sa'i smon lam chen mo zhes yongs su grags pa'i chos kyi mdzad sgo dang /dge bshes lha rams gtong ba'i lam srol slar gso'i gtso skyong gnang / smon lam 31 sa ma skyes rabs kyi bka' 31sa gnang zhing / ces rngo6) rags rgyag 199bod pho ngas nang bstan/phyi pho naX 61naXlho kha'e rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrilas /deb dang po /sdod nyo ngas mi dmangs dpe skrun lang / 215

7paṇa chen ber te gi zhib 'jugagi las yul dngos su sku ngo phebs kyis rags rgyag gi cho ga thams cad mdzad/ smon lam sbyin bdag tu bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi drung che u cing ha gtsos/tang srid dmag gsum gyi dpon rigs tshogs gzigs la phebs nas sku 'gyed phul/ drung yig chen mo bzhis (tang gi drung yig dmangs 'thus drung yig srid gzhung gi drung yigachab gros drung yig)spos sna 'khrid pa'i dus bzang shar ba de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gzi shugs nyag cig las byung bar su yis 'gong bar nus sam/lo rabs 80 nang sku rten nyar zhing ma ṇi 'don chog pa'i srid jus shig shar yang / gzhung sger chos gsum gyi sku rten thams cad/ lo rabs 60pa'i rig gnas gsar brje'i rnying bzhi rtsa gtor khrod rtsa ba nas rmeg med bzos zin stabs/ bod yul stod smad bar gyi khyim tshang so so'i nang phyag dang mchod 'bul zhu sa'i sku brnyan rtsa ba nas med par gyur/ ya nga ba'i gnas tshul de dag 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos mkhyen rjes/ gam bcar lha bris bkras lhun dka' chen blo bzang phun tshogs la/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi ris med lha sku'i sku thang /ston pa gtso 'khor gsum dang / tshe lha rnam gsum/ 'gro ba'i mgon po gsum//rnam par snang mdzad/ 'od dpag med/ sangs rgyas smanabla//rigs gsum mgon po/lhag pa'i lha mchog gsum//rdo rje sems dpa'/ klu dbang / lha mo lo gyon ma//dang / chos brgyud khag gi gtso 'khor lha sku mkhan slob chos gsum/ sa chen gong ma rnamalnga/ mar mi dgas gsum/ rje yab sras gsum/ jo rngog 'brom gsum/ bu jo yab sras/(bu ston rin chen grub/ nam mkha' chos grub/ tā ra nā tha//sogs kyi bris thang par 'debs kyis/tshol gsum bod kyi yul du 'grems spel gnang bas/ dad ldan mi mang gi khyim du dad rten lha sku rtsa ba nas med pa'i sa bcad kha skong mdzad/216

sku che'i smad kyai cha/sum gnyis sa yi khyon la dbang sgyur nus pa'i bod chen po'i stobs shugs de/ bon po dang snying ma/ sa skya dang 'bri gung / bka' rgyud dang dge lugs sogs/ grub mtha' phyogs zhen gyi g.yul 'gyed pa'i khrod/ rang gnya' rang gis bcag pa'i lo rgyus kyi las 'dzol la dgongs 'tshoms gnang bzhin/bod brgyud nang bstan gyi chos brgyud khag gi mthun sgril la dus dang rnam pa kun tu sems khur thugs 'grus gnang rgyu de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i thugs khur gnang yul gtso bo zhig yin/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ ngos rang dge lugs pa yin kyang chos lugs gzhan dag la phyogs ris byas te zur nas bltas te bsdad mi yong /chos brgyud gzhan rnams la gcig gyur gyi lta rtog byed rgyu yin/ phyogs ris rtsa ba nas byed mi yong / ngos ni grub mtha' ris med bya rgyu yin/ deng skabs grub mtha' gzhan dag tsho gang ci'i thad zhan pa yod pa de dag nges par du nyams pa sor chud yag/ po yong rgyu yin pa gsungs te/201 snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i bstan pa'i mdzad khur gser rta bla rung lnga rig nang bstan slob gling gi mkhan chen 'jigs med phun tshogs dang / mnyam med bka' brgyud bstan pa'i mdzad khur mkhan po khro ru tshe rnam/ dpal ldan sa skya//sa skya'i bstan pa'i khur su la bsnams dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba ma shes//zha ser dge ldan lugs kyi bstan pa'i khur 'brog mi byams pa blo gros (phyi lo 1986 7paṇa chen rin po ches dga' ldan khri tshab tu bskos//so sos bsnams dgos pa'i bka' bsgos gnang ba ma zad/bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling du chos brgyud bzhi dang / g.yu drung bon dang bcas pa'i slob gnyer ba 'du bskongs kyis/ phan tshun legs na01kun gzigs lapaṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bka' smro ba/shog ngos 149nang /phyi dril las khungs/phyi lo 1998lo ra/217

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhing 'jugacha 'don spel dgos pa'i lam ston gnang / bkra shis lhun po'i mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi ldebs ris su yang / sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad pa'i chos brgyud bzhi'i srol gtod lha sku 'bri bzhengs gnang ste/ phyin chad bod kyi chos brgyud khag mthun lam yong ba'i rten 'brel dang mig ltos su dmigs pa zhig yin/ zhes 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i zhal sgo las bsgrags so//202naXdaphyi lo 1989zla 1tshes nanamachod lang shar dbu 'byed mdzad sgo'i bka' slob 218

skya che'i smad kyai cha/bcu bzhi/ bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling /mang gtso'i bcos sgyur gyi rlung 'tshub khrod bod kyi bstan dgon gyi brgya cha brgyad cu rtsa gtor zin kyang / lo rabs 60 'go stod du 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis ma'o kru zhir/ bod du nang bstan ched sbyong slob grwa zhig gsar 'dzugs chog pa'i re 'dun zhus pa khas len thob ste/203 3 lo 1962 lor gnas chung du gdan sa gsum gyi dpe cha ba lhag bsdad rnams bsdu bskong gis/tshad ma rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi slob gnyer khang gsar 'dzugs gnang rgyu'i 'char bkod gnang mod/204 bod ljongs su g.yon lhung bsam blo'i rtsub kha rgod pas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs pa mthun 'gyur dang rgyab skyor rtsa ba nas thob mi 'dugaphyi lo 1980 lor/ dgon pa chos sgo phye bas dad ldan mang tshogs kyi chos lugs dad mos kyi dgos mkho bskongs thub kyang / sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa lag lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan par thug yod stabs/ yang dar bstan pa'i bya ba 'di yang lung rtogs gnyis thos bsam sgom sgrub gnang rgyu de yin dgos/'on kyang gral rim 'thab rtsod byed pa'i lo rgyus chag sgo'i khrod du/ mdo sngags gsung rab la nang byan chub cing 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mkhyen pa rgyas pa'i bla chen mkhas chen rnams/ dmar srung dmag dang / hur brtson can zer ba tshos/da skulapa ṇa bcu pa 'i gsung pod ga pa/ bkras/ lhun par ma/na 4dge sdis la sa kyi myo nga ba/ser sma da ri 'bur sprul skus brtsams/shes/ ris par bang /phyi lo 1989lo ra/219

7pa ṇa chen yer te gi zhib ca'ajugasdug gsod dang / ltogs gsod/ dmar gsod du btang tshar bas/ chos sgo phye ba'i dgon pa re gnyis yod pa dag tu/ lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan par mnga' brnyes shing / gzhung chen 'chad khrid kyis bstan pa 'dzin skyong thub pa'i gser ri lta bu'i skyes chen nyin mo'i skar ma ltar du gyur pas/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi mdo sngags bshad sgrub 'dzin skyong spel ba'i
