'phrin las kyang skya chad sngo gtugs kyi gnas su lhung /phyi lo 1985 lor/ bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes te lo ngo 20'khor bar rten 'brel tshogs chen steng / kunari gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis mig sngar grwa btsun rnams lo na bgres shing rgyun 'dzin byed mkhan dkon pa'i gnas su gyar yod gshis/ nga tshos chos kyi grub mtha' ris med kyi sgo nas chos byed mi sna gzhon skyes khag cig skyed sring dang gso skyong gis/nang bstan rig gnas shul 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas btang ste/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyi chos kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho skong thub pa byed dgos gsungs te/snga zhugs su bod ljongs nang bstan slob grwa /mi rnams kyis lha sa 7paṇa chen slob grwa dang / yang na/ gnas chung slob grwa so gas 'bod kyi yod//dang / nag chu nang bstan slob grwa /nag chu sa khul du yod//zi khron nang bstan slob grwa /de snga sde dge dgon du yod/ phyis dar rtse mdor gnas spos byas 'dug/zi khron bla rung lnga rig nang bstan slob grwa /de ni sngon phyi lo 1980 lor/snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bla ma grub dbang mkhan chen 'jigs med phun tshogs kyi gser rta bla rung du dge 'dun grangs 2 kyis nang bstan gsan sbyong gnang yul gyi dgon pa der/ lnga rig nang bstan slob grwa 'dzugs rgyur 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po dang mkhan po zhal gros byung ba bzhin/ phyi lo 1987 zla 5 tshes 15 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pas zi khron zhing chen dkar mdzes khul gser rta rdzong la bka' rgya gnang don/ mkhan rin po che 'jigs med phun tshogs kyis gser rta bla rung dgon par lnga rig nang bstan slob grwa zhig gnyer rgyu'i gra sgrig gnang ba de/ha cang gi bya ba bzang po zhig red/ der brten/ ngos kyis mos mthun dang gsar skrun gnang rgyu'i chog mchan 220

skyu che'i smad kyai cha/bkod pa yin/ re bar khyed rnams kyis do do tan tan gyis dbo/sa nges rgyab skyor gnang ste yag po sgrub dgos pa'i bka' yig btang ba ma zad/ sku ngo mas phyag bstar ma 'i phyag 'phrin las/ dgon pa'i ma tshan la gser rta bla rung lnga reg nang bsta na slo ba gling zhes mtshan gsol gnang // 205mtsho sngon nang bstan slob grwa//sku 'bum dman par yo da/)kan su'u nang bstan slob grwa//bla brang bkra shis 'khyil na yo da/)chol gsum bod kyi khyon du nang bstan slob grwa ji snyed cig gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i nang / rig gnas gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod khrod nas lhag pa'i mdo sngags rig gnas rgya mtshor nangabyan chub pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen re gnyis yod pa rnam/sa gdan drangs te dpe khrid gnang ba'i gsol 'debs zhus/lha sa nang bstan slob gar ser byes mkhan zur lhun grub thabs mkhas/dga' ldan dgon pa'i 'brog mi byams pa blo gros/ 'bras spungs tshul khang bla ma/stag lung rtse spral rin po che/ 'on rgyal sras rin po che/ rtse slob grwa'i byams pa 'phrin las/ ༷nig chu nang bstan slob grwar bon po'i bla ma a kya/ skyin tor rin po che sogs gdan zhu dang / kun su'u nang bstan slob garno 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa dang / gung thang rin po che rnam gnyis kyis gtso khrid gnang gi yod/chos sde dgon pa khag nas ris med kyi grwa rgyun bsdus te bod brgyud nang bstan gyi lung rtogs bstan pa'i me ro gsos/'dul khrims gtsang zhing nang bstan chos lugs kyi byang tshad mtho ba'i bla spral rnam/sa/ dmangs gtso bcos sgyur dang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gas skyong bdag nyar byed mkhan lta ci/ kho tsho ni gnod 'tshe myong mkhan dang /thub tshod myong mkhan/ bka' bkyon bzed mkhan gtso bo de yin pas/ sku yon 205 44 ske/ lko 478 shā 〉(2 khugashā 221

7paṇa chen zher te ji zhib 'jugagasan sbyong gi dus skabs rtsa ba nas byung med/206lo rabs 80 nang bod mi mang gi chos lugs dad mos kyi dgos mkho bzhin ming grags che ba'i spral sku rnams ngos 'dzin zhu 'dod yod kyang /spral sku de rnams mi lo 30 ringari gso skyong bdag gces byed mkhan med rkyebs/rmong tshogs la nang bstan 'chad khrid dang / bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi thugs 'gan bzhes thub kyi med / 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i dgongs par/bstan pa yang dar gyi skabs 'dir sa steng rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po 7skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa rgya gar du bzhugs yod pas/yang dar bstan pa'i khur 'di nged la bab 'dug dgongs te/ sku tshab cig bod khams la lta skor du mngags 'bras/bod khul gyi sa cha la lar grwa pas tshong byed pa dang gyon chas 'dra min gyon pa/ grong khyer khag gi mi tshogs 'du sar thig sgrom spo lo rgyag pa/ 'brog khul kha shas su bla rdzun grub rdzun dang skya min ser min gyi gnas tshul 'dra min la kha g.yar te/ chos dang mang tshogs la zhal 'debs slong ba dang mgo skor thebs pa'i snang tshul par brgyab ste yig ngag gnyis thog nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la snyan seng zhus/207gnas tshul de dag la 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog thugs 'tshab chen po byung ste/ yongs 'dzin rin po che gtsos bod kyi bla chen rnams pe cin du bskong te bka' bgros zhib rgyas mdzad mthar/ bstan pa yang dar gyi skabs 'dir 'dul khrims gtsang zhing / nang bstan rig pa ched khrid/ dgon pa do dam bdag gnyer/bod kyi rig ga nga gi gzhi rtsa'i shes bya dang / deng rabs tshan rig gi shes bya shes naX67paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i bka' slob/deb bzhi pa /thog ngos 18༷nang /7paṇa chen er de ni zhabs zhu las don lang / byi lo naX7lor/daX dad gdung yid byi mchod sprin/shogazhiXnang /thar gdong rin po che rjes dran/rong po blo bzang snyan grags kyis bsgrigs/pyi 'o daX lo ra/222

skya tshe'i smad kyai cha/mkhan gyi bla spral khag cig gso skyong dang skyed sring gnang rgyu ni/ bstan pa yang dar la kha tsha rdogos gtugs kyi bya ba zhig tu gzigs te/phyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 1 nyin/ de snga 7paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas/ pe cing nub phyogs dgon pa ser po'i lha khang du/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' ris med kyi sprul sku rnams rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ chos ra'i rnam pa kho na byas pa'i nang bstan slob gso de/deng rabs kyi slob khrid gtong phyogs su bsgyur nas/ bla sprul rnams lhan cig tu chos srid kyi bya ba rgya mtshor slob sbyong gnang sa'i bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling gsar 'dzugs gnang /2087paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ rgyal ba'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum dang / mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtshor 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i sde snod gsum la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi theg gsum lam gyi rim par gzhol ba'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum bcas dang ldan pa ma zad/ tshan rig gi shes bya dang / deng rabs kyi yon tan/'jig rten gyi tshul lugs sogs kyang shes pa byas te dus rabs kyi mi gral shogs shing go chod pa/ bod brgyud nang bstan 'dzin skyong gi srog shing mi sna dang / sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi zhib 'jug mi sna/ rgyal spyi'i nang bstan rig pa spel res mi sna/nang bstan rig pa ched khrid mi sna/ dgon sde bdag gnyer gyi mtho rim mi sna sogs dgos gtugs che ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu khag cig skyed sring byas te/'dzam gling zhi bde srung skyob la rang gi legs skyes 'bul thub pa bya rgyu ni/209bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i dmigs zhaX8grung rgo bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling gi cha 'apyin/na097paṇa chen bcu pa chen po 'i bka' slob/deb gsum pa /shog ngos 178nang /7pa r+ṣa chen er te ni zhabs zhu khang /phyi lo naX lor/223

7paṇa chen yer te gi zhig 'dugayul gnyis sdo yin zhes gsungs/bod zla 4 tshes 15 nyin 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang gnang ba'i bgegs bskrad skabs/ skyes dman zhig tshogs dbus nas langs te/lag pas sdigs mdzub kyi nyams bstan nas/ gdong pa chen por spos shing so hrig hrig tu 'cha' ba byas par/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bgegs bskrad kyi song zhig ces pa'i mtshams su/ yungs dkar 'thor ba dang bud med de glo bur du 'gyel song ba la/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches rnam rtog ci yang med par/de ring ma'o yi gam gyi gdon 'dre de btul ba yin/ da sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya nag la yang nyi ma ltar shar yong gsungs/210bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling dngos gzhi dbu 'dzugs pa'i nyin mor/bod kyi khul du bod brgyud nang bstan lo rgyus la byas pa che zhing / mang tshogs khrod mtshan snyan che ba'i bla sprul bsdu skong gnang ste/ lam rim gyi dbu nas chos thun gcig gnang ba dang / bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling gi slob khrid dge rgan du bod dbus gtsang khul nas mkhas dbang 'brog mi byams pa blo gros dang / mkhan po khro ru tshe rnam/211 dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las/ rdo rje rgyal po/dge bshes ye shes dbang phyug mkhan po klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ dka' chen rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ khams khul nas mkhan po chos grags/ mkhan po 'jigs med phun tshogs/mkhan po pad tshe/ sprul sku kurma seng ge/ mkhan po yon tan bzang po/ mdo smad nas shar gdong blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho/shing bza' skal bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/spru sku bstan pa'i nyi ma/ bse tshang blo bzang dpal ldan/ dge bshes dge 'dun rgya ma31 'ebyo ces bsaskya/ sdo/ba tresags gdan zhus gnang /na10dad bdung yid kyi chod sprin/zosacadanang / thar dong rin po che rjes dran/rong po sgro bzang snyan grags kyis bsgrigs/phyi lo 2༷༷ lor na11mkhan po tshe rnam sogs mkhas pa 'ga' 'khrungs yu la khams yinakyang phyag las gnang yu la gyi sa khul gyi longs nas zhus pa yin/224

kyi tshe'i smad kyai cha/bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling gi slob gzhir/ spyod 'jug chen mo dang /lam rim chen mo/ byang chub lam sgron/ blo sbyong don bdun ma rtsa 'grel/ rgyud bla ma /nges shes sgron me/ grub mtha' rin chen phreng ba/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa/be'u 'bum sngon po/ dpe chos rin chen spungs pa/ gsang 'dus 'grel pa bzhi sbrags/ bla ma lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ rin 'byung brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi lo rgyus deb ther/ thu'u bkan grub mtha'/ bod sog chos 'byung /rnying ma'i grub mtha' tshes pa'i zla ba/ bka' brgyud grub mtha' grub pa'i me long /sa skya'i grub mtha' dbang gi rgyal po/ dge lugs grub mtha' bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan/jo nang grub mtha' gdong lnga'i nga ro/ bod kyi brda sprod rig pa/ dag yig ngag sgron rtsa 'grel/ snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu/ mngon brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan/bod kyi yig gzugs/ rgya'i skad yig sogs bdams sgrig gnang / ched sbyong rig gzhung tshan khag myur skyob ched mkhan po khro ru tshe rnam gyis gtso khrid byed pa'i sgra rig 'dzin grwa dang / skar rtsis kyi 'dzin grwa gnyis 'dzugs gnyer gnang / sgra'i 'dzin grwa la sgra ka lwa pa rtsa 'grel dang / tsan+dar pa rtsa 'grel/ dbyangs can ma rtsa 'grel/pā ni ba'i bshad lung / sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas khrid/ skar rtsis la gnam rig skar rtsis spyi dang / bye brag skar rtsis kun 'dus nor bu rtsa 'grel/ nag rtsis sogs slob khrid gnang /phyi lo 1988 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling gi slob dpon du gdan 'dren zhus pa'i mkhas dbang khro ru tshe rnam gyi bzhugs shag tu chibs sgyur gyis/ sgra tsun dra pa stongs nyen 'dug pas nga chos bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byed dgos pas/khyod nyid bod du log rjes slob sbyong 'dzin grwa zhig 'dzugs thub pa e 'dug ces bka' mngags gnang /225

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'dul mkhas dbang mkhan po khro ru tshe rnam gyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i zhal chems thugs la bcangs te/ pe cing nas lha sar zhabs sor 'khod 'phral/ bod sa stod smad bar gsum nas don gnyer can gyi slob bu ji snyed cig bskongs te/sgra tsan dra pa dang ka lā pa'i slob sbyong 'dzin grwa gnyer pas/ bod khul du ltag chu chad pa'i rdzing bu ltar gyur pa'i sgra mdo de gnyis kyi bstan pa rgya mtsho ltar 'phel/phyi lo 1988 zla 10 tshes 27 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs dgongs bzhin/ bod brgyud nang bstan zhib 'jug khang gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/bod ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ si khron/ kun su'u/ yun nan/ nang sog pe cing dang bcas pa nas/ zhib 'jug pa chen mo 21 dang / zhib 'jug pa gzhon pa 27zhib 'jug mi sna 17 bcas/ khyon mkhas dbang drug cu lhag cig la bod brgyud nang bstan zhib 'jug khang gi zhib 'jug pa'i mtshan gsol gnang /da dung (gangs can rig brgya'i sgo 'byed we mig/ces grub mtha' dbyer med kyi dpe rgyun dkon pa'i gsung rab dpe tshogs dang / zhib 'jug pa chos zhib 'jug 'bras bur bstan bcos gsar rtsom dang / dpe dkon 'tshol zhib kyis (gangs ljongs rigs pa'i dpe tshogs/)sogs dpar skrun dgos pa'i mdzub ston gnang /bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling nas da lta a rir bzhugs pa'i sku 'bum dgon pa'i dgon bdag sakya rin po che dang / sud sir bzhugs pa'i khams rdza chu kha ba snga 'gyur snying ma'i bla 'am nam mkha' rin po che sogs/ bod dbus gtsang khul gyi bla sprul 50 dang / khams khul 30 lhag tsam/ a mdo nas 100tsam zhig bsdu skong gnang yod la/chos lugs thad dpal ldan sa skya pa dgu dang / dge lugs pa brgya dang drug cu re drug bka' brgyud pa bco lnga/ snying ma pa nyer lnga/ jo nang pa drug226

bon po lnga/ min mi rigs gzhan gyi bla pal ga tsam ga yod ༵༵༵༷kyi/ /la 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog da ngas pa (zhan ga gas pas/ bod brgyud nang bstan slob gling la sub dka' ba'i da chag byung ste/ na gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i da ngas ga ba na lag len 'khyol rgyu lta ci/ nang bstan slob ga ra la brtson pa'i bla sprul rnams kyang / rim ba na phyogs ba mtshams brgyad la 'thor /da cha slob gling da snga'i rnam pa tsam las lhag med par snang / /mi / wa tā tshoX sku ci ci 'i /sku re /shā kyi ri dīp+ta /rkeri nirmye/shā/byidzi na/ sgor+shatāk+ṣa〉tho gyi cho ga gi — 3)tre pe riX dzocis sa ri ci ri ga ci ma tsho rme 3/ ciXl kā naXbla ci no ci ri bye ni (rdo ༷ mi ci shā ga dro ri 〉 rmeskoX re / mu ri gtsu ga rje pa lhardo mi casdu rmi ma sdu 'du ca ga sang rishā tsho /ri k+ṣe ri saḥrā dice sa /33/ ci // // 〉 ji dro cici rtso gci 'a ri ༷ spre /tsho /r+sha ) ho ༷ 4 jistu rngo/ ci mi chi sa ca'o/)hoḥ rdo rdosbyi nar+sha spyashā/tsho misna cho tsho ri/ri༄rdo ci'iri ri(/rtengabodabargyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gleng ci)

7paṇa chen mar te ni zhib 'jugale tshan bcu lja / bod skad yig sbyo1nga spyod spel gsum/lha sar bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i slob phrug chos/ bod yig bed spyod byed pa'i rang dbang dgos zhes skad brgyab yod pa red/ kho tshos re ba zhu ba'i thabs lam gyi byed stangs de la nga tshos bstod bsngags byed mi thub kyang /kho chos bton pa'i re ba ni tshul dang mthun pa zhig red/2127paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/lo rabaso 60 pa'i nang gung khran tang gi snying bzhi rtsa gtor zer ba'i las 'gul khrod/ bod kyi skad yig de rnying pa bzhi'i khongs su brtsis pa dang /tshan rig dang mi mthun tshul bsgrags te/ 'brel sgra'i phrad gis dang / la don gyi phrad du/ tshig phrad cing zhing shing gsum las cing las gzhan rnams bed spyod mi chog pa/ slar bsdu'i phrad rtsa ba nas mi dgos/213 yig mgo dbu 'khyud 6 ༄7//nya dang / chig shad 'di 66/ nyidang gnyis shad 66//mi 'di sogs bed spyod mi chog pa/rang snang gang dran gyis rgya yig brda sprod kyi 'gro stangs cus ha'o 660 nyidang / ghan than ha'o 66 mi sogs btsan sbyor byas pa ni/ dus skabs der dpar skrun byas pa'i ngo sa ma //dang//ma'o kru zhi'i gsung rtsom//rnying pa dzesags da lta yang nga 31) 21dbyi yo 1989zla 1tshes na zhin/kun gzigs 7pa ṇa chen rin po che'i bka' slob gces bsgrigs/tho/ga ngos 111nang zad gzhung phyi dril la sa lungs kyi par btab/pyi lo 1998lo ra/na1 rgya dmar gyis bod nang mi spyod las 'das pa'i bya ngan ji byas rags bsdus /thog ngos na nanang /bod gzhung tshes rig dpa ra khang /228

kyi tshe'i mi da kyai cha/mthong lam du gyur yod/phyi lo 1978 zla 12 nang skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i steng / 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ da lta bod kyi skad yig shi la khad du gyur yod gsungs te/ bod skad yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod dgos pa'i dgongs 'char gsungs pa'i thugs rjes/ krung dbyang nas bod yig bed spyod btang chog pa'i gu yangs kyi 'od snang sab sib cig sprad kyang /bod du g.yon gyi bsam blo'i dug shas che bas/ pe cing nas 'char ba'i nyi 'od kyi srid jus bod du tag tag 'tsher rgyu lta ci/ bod yig ni spyod mkho chung zhing chos lugs rmongs dad kyi yi ge rjes lus can yin par bsnyad de/ bod yig shes mkhan yig rmongs su brtsis/ bod yig yi ger mi brtsi ba'i mthong chung dang /khyad gsod/ dma' 'bebs byed kyi yod stabs/ bod kyi slob grwa khag tu bod yig slob khrid mi byed la/ slob ma rnams kyis kyang bod yig ni phan med kyi yi ge zhig yin par bsam ste sbyong 'dod byed kyi med/phun tshogs bkra shis kyis/ tshogs chen bcu gsum 'tshogs tshun bod rgya yig rigs gnyis kyi dpe deb 'don dgos lugs gtan 'khel yod kyang /skabs der chab mdo'i sa khul du las don gzhan zhig la phyin te tshur log mkhan zhig gis/ tshogs 'du'i sar chab mdo'i ngos la dpe cha rgya yig las bod yig dgos kyi mi 'dug ces bshad/ sa gnas sa thog tu brtag zhib byed skabs chab mdo'i rdzong khag bcu gsum mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis/ gong rim nas btang ba'i bod yig gi deb nyung drags 'dug pa bshad/bod rang skyong ljongs tang srid las khungs khag gi yig cha dang / slob grwa'i slob khrid tshang ma rgya yig spyod pa las bod yig spyod srol med/ bod yig 229

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'dugatshags par de rgya yiganas jibazhinabasgyurakhar medayigatshags pa gyi kha yig ma'o kru zhi'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma yin par bsnyad de/ rgya yig rang bkod pa las bod yig med pa sogs kyi gnas tshul yod pa gsungs/stabs legs pa zhig la 7paṇa chen rin po che'i las gnas slar gso byung ba dang bstun/ chol gsum bod kyi khul la zhabs kyis bcags te/bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi rkang pa'i steng rang rkya 'pher ba langs te mdun skyod kyi lam du chas dgos na/ bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum bya rgyu ang dang por 'jog dgos pa'i gzigs pa rgyang ring ba'i mdzad 'phrin las/ bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum gyi bya bar legs spel nyes 'gog dang / gna' bzang deng spyod kyi dgongs 'char chu mo'i rgyun ltar spel/bod kyi slob grwa phal mo ches rgya yig gtso sbyong byed pa las/ bod skad yig slob khrid mi byed pa dang / slob ma rnams kyis kyang bod yig sbyong 'dod kyi dngas kha med pa'i gnas tshul/ rin po ches mkhyen rjes/ dgongs 'tshoms chen pos/ bod yig sbyang rgyu ni rang gi mi rigs kyi 'os 'gan zhig yin pas/phan thogs rung ma thogs rung ci nas kyang bod yig sbyong dgos/ bod rigs sa khul du bod skad mi shod pa dang bod yig ma bkol na/ sa 'di nas bod rigs zhes nga/'i mi rigs 'di rang shugs su rtsa med 'gro nges yin/der brten/ khyod tshos mi rigs rang gi skad yig dang rig gnas rgyun 'dzin gong 'phel gtong rgyu de bya ba gal chen zhig tu brtsi dgos/ zhes bod phrug tshos bod mi rigs kyi skad yig la/ la rgya zhen dgos pa'i sha tsha'i bka' bkyon gnang rgyu 'di/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa bod kyi mtha' dbus gang sar 'tshams 'dri rtog zhib gnang dus chad ma myong ba'i brjod gzhi gtso bo zhig red/230

kyi che'i mi da kyai cha/phyi lo 1982 lor/ btson grol rjes bod dbus gtsang du thengs dang po chibs sgyur skabs/ bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa'i las khungs khag dang / slob grwa khagabazo grwa/ tshong khang sogs kyi sgo byang tshang ma rgya yig gis bris yod pa gzigs dus thugs dgongs 'tshoms chen pos/ sa 'di ni bod rigs sa khongs rang skyong byas pa'i sa zhig yin pas/ rang skyong las khungs kyi sgo byang la bod yig med na/ji ltar bod rigs sa khongs rang skyong lab dgos/ sgo byang tshang ma bod yig gam bod rgya shan sbyar du 'bri dgos pa gsungs/ bod ljongs khul gyi sgo byang tshang ma bod yig tu mthong thub pa de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa ma chog btson grol rjes su bod dbus gtsang du phebs thengs thog ma'i skabs/ mig mthong lag zin gyi bod skad yig la thob pa'i rgyal kha de red/7paṇa chen rin ngo ches/ bod kyi sa khul khag lnga'i dpon rigs tshor/bod skad yig la mthong chung byed pa de/ bod mi rigs kyi khe dbang la mthong chung byed pa zhig dang / bod mi rigs med par gtong ba'i byed thabs shig yin pa/bod rigs sa khul du bod kyi skad yig mi slob pa de/ rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims dang 'gal ba zhig yin pas/ bod rigs rang skyong byas pa'i sa khul nas bod yig mi spyod na/ de la rang skyong ji ltar 'bod dam/ zhes bod rigs sa khul du bod kyi skad yig ang dang por 'jog dgos pa'i dgongs 'char dang skyon brjod de yang / kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog zhugs pa'i tshogs 'du'i goms srol lta bur gyur yod/phyi lo 1980 lor/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi tshogs 'du'i steng / da lta bod yig gi dbugs chad la khad dam/ shi la khad du gyur yod/ bod skad yig slob sbyong yag po byed dgos pa de ni/ phyin chad bod yul 'dzags skrun byed skabs nye bar mkho ba'i lag cha chos rtsa bar gyur pa zhig rir 1)༷)1

7paṇa chena'ar te ni zhing 'jugayin pas/ bod rigs sa khul bod skad yig gtso sbyong / gtso spyod kyi srid jus don 'khyol dgos pa'i rtsod len shugs chen gnang bas/ phyi lo 1984 lor/krung dbyang gi yig cha ang drug pa'i nang du/ bod khul du bod skad yig gtso sbyong byed du 'jog dgos pa'i rtsa don gtan 'bebs bya dgos byung yod/'on kyang / srid jus dang yig cha de rigs pe cing nas bod ljongs su skyod pa'i ri chu 'phrang gsum gyi dka' ngal las/ bod du 'byor skabs yig cha las yig cha'i dgongs don lag len du skyel mi dgos pa'i srid jus des/bod skad yig gi tshe srog la bzod dka' ba'i 'jig nyen 'phrad rkyen/ phyi lo 1982 dang / phyi lo 1985 bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes te lo ngo nyi shu 'khor ba rten 'brel zhu ba'i tang srid las byed pa'i tshogs 'du'i steng / bod rang skyong ljongs kyi gzhung don yig rigs dang / gzhung yig 'grems spel/rtsa tshig khyab bsgrags/ tshags par/ dus deb/ slob gzhi/ glog brnyan/ snyan sgron/rgyang bsgrags bod yig bed spyod gtong dgos pa dang /bod rigs las byed pas thog mar bod yig slob sbyong yag po byed dgos pa gsungs te/ bod rigs las byed dang las bzo ba'i slob deb ces pa'i deb phreng dang po dang drug pa bar rtsom sgrig dang slob sbyong byas/ slob grwa'i slob gso tshang ma bod skad yig thog nas slob khrid byed rgyu'i dam 'dzin/rgya yig sbyong ba de bod skad bod yig sbyong ba'i tshab byas na mi 'grig pa'i bka' tsha nan gnang yang / go ba med pa'i glang rgan ltar gyi sa gnas dpon rigs tshos/snang med do chung ngang bskyur te lag bstar don 'khyol gyi sbrang char zhig rtsa ba nas 'bab ma thub/phyi lo 1986 lor/ bod ljongs slob grwa chen mor slob ma bsdu skabs/232

kyi che'i mi da kyai cha/bod skad yig la mthong chung byas pa'i tshabs che'i gnad don la dgongs 'tshoms yod mus thog khams khul la chibs sgyur skabs chab mdo slob 'bring gi slob mas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog chab mdor phebs par dga' bsu zhu/zhes rgya skad kyi thog nas lab par/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches bod skad rgyag dgos pa'i bka' gnang / slob ma tshos ha cang skad gdangs dma' ngo sa/ 7paṇa chen rin po che chab mdor phebs pa dga' bsu zhu zhes zhus la/ slob ma 'gas bod skad shod par ngo tsha nas phan tshun yib res byed pa gzigs dus de bas dgongs 'tshoms chen po byung ste/khyed tshos bod skad bshad par ngo tsha na/ ma bshad na tshog la/ bod la gyon par ngo tsha na de yang ma gon na chog mod/ 'on kyang / khyod tshos sha dang rus pa ji ltar byed rgyu yin/ khyed tsho'i skye yul bod rigs khyim yin pa ji ltar byas kyang bsgyur thabs med/ khyod tsho'i pha mes yang mes rnams bod rigs yin/gal srid khyod tsho'i byed tshul der bltas na/ khyod tshos mi rigs bsgyur rgyu yin pa 'i bka' bkyon phebs/'gyel ba'i sgang la dog brdzis kyi dpe ltar chab mdo'i gzigs skor grub pa dang / yun nan bde chen khul du chibs sgyur gnang / khul de'i bod rigs slob ma rnams kyis rgya chas spras te/ skad bzang mtho pos/ rgya skad kyi thog nas dga' bzu zhu/ dga' bsu zhu/ zhes 7paṇa chen rin po che phebs bsur bcar/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches chibs 'khor bkag te slob phrug tshor bka' rtsad gnang don/ d+ku 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ grogs po chung chung tsho/ khyed rnams bod rigs yin nam rgya rigs yin/ slob phrug tshos/ nga tsho tshang ma bod rigs yin/233

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'jug 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ 'o na/ khyed tsho tshang mas bod chas ma gyon pa dang / bod skad mi rgyag pa gang yin nam/ slob phrug chos/ nga tshor bod chas med/ nga tshos bod skad mi shes/ zhes zhus/2/4da dung kho tshor btags pa'i ming tshang ma krang / wang / li'i sogs rgya ming yin/ ya nga dgos pa'i gnas tshul de la zhib 'jug gnang skabs/ rgya ming ma btags na slob grwar mi tshud pa dang / slob grwa'i nang rgya yig las bod yig rtsa ba nas khrid kyi med pa mkhyen rjes/ 'brel yod kyi 'go khrid las byed tshogs 'du bskongs te/ bod rig slob phrug tshang ma'i rgya ming bod ming du bsgyur zhing /bod yig slob khrid dgos pa'i yig cha zhig bzos/khyim bdag 'gas bod yig bslab na mdun lam med pa dang / dus tshod 'phro brlag tu btang ba'i bsam 'char gtong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul mkhyen dus/ khyod tshos bod yig bslab na byis par mdun lam med zer ba khag mi 'dug deng skabs rgya yig ma shes na las byed par 'gro sa med pa dang /dpon po byed mi thub/ yin na'ang khyod tshos nga tsho rang gi mi rigs kyi mdun lam 'di la'ang bsam blo zhig e btang / rang gi mi rigs kyi ched du rang rang gi skad yig cig sbyang mi dgos zer na/ bsam blor 'a dang zhig rgyobs dang /zhes snying la rus pa zug pa'i bka' bskyon phebs/2/5phyi lo 1988 lor/ bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i slob phrug tshos/bod nang bod skad yig bed spyod spel gsum byed pa'i rang dbang dgos pa'i khrom skor skad 'bod byas par/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ phyi lo 1989 zla 1214 7paṇa chen rin po rnam thar/ rgya yigashog ngos dmi nang /21570 ṇa chen rin po che yu na nan bod khul du phebs pa/bsod nams kyi 7pa ca chen rjes dran rtsom yig nang /234

kyi che'i mi da kyai cha/tshes 23 nyi na/ mi rigs shig la so so'i skad dang yi ge rtsa ba brtan po yod pa 'di tsam bed spyod gtong rgyu'i dbang cha med pa gang yin nam/ nye dus lha sar bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i slob phrug tshos/ bod yig bod spyod byed pa'i rang dbang dgos zhes skad brgyab yod pa red/ kho tshos re ba zhu ba'i thabs lam gyi byed stangs de la nga tshos bstod bsngags byed mi thub kyang / kho tshos bton pa'i re ba ni tshul dang mthun pa zhig red ces rgyab skyor gnang /bod mi rigs dar rgyas dang yun gnas thub pa'i srog rtsa bod kyi skad yig yin pas/ bod kyi bdag por 'gyur ba'i slob ma rnams la bod mi rigs kyi srog rtsa bod skad 'dir/ rin thang ngos 'a dzin dang 'du shes legs gyur ma thub na/ 'byung 'gyur bod kyi mdun lam la re ba med pa mkhyen rjes/sku sgor gyi phyag gron zhal 'debs las/rgyal thang bod yig slob grwa dang / dar rtse mdo dwa phrug slob grwa/ zhun hwa rdzong sbis mdo bod yig slob 'bring / mtsho sngon zhing chen mi rigs dge thon slob grwa/ yongs grags su mtsho sngon 7paṇa chen slob grwa chen mo zhes 'bod/ chab mdo 7paṇa chen slob grwa (meng gzhan chab mdo slob 'bring gnyis pa//sogs dang / rgya nag dbus gzhung dang bod rang skyong ljongs srid gzhung la re 'dun dgongs 'char zhus te/phyi lo 1985 lor/ bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo dang / phyi lo 1987 lor mal gro gung dkar rdzong slob grwa sogs/ bod rigs sa khul du bod yig slob grwa ji snyed cig gsar 'dzugs mdzad/phyi lo 1987 lor/ krung dbyang gi dbu khrid pheng kren dang hu'u chi li yi gam du/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku ngo bcar gyis/ bod khul du bod kyi skad yig gi sbyong spyod spel gsum byed par/ bca' khrims kyi khag theg ldan 235

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jug pa'i srid jus gtan 'bebs dgos pa'i dgongs 'char gsungs/ lo de'i zla 3tshes 28 nyin rgyal yongs mi mang 'thus tshogs skabs drug pa'i tshogs thengs lnga par zhugs mkhan/ bod kyi 'thus mi'i tshogs chung gros bsdur thog bka' zur nga phod la/ bod du bod yig slob sbyong byed rgyu bca' khrims thog nas gtan 'bebs lag bstar dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang ba ma zad/bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi krung ren sku gzhon phun tshogs bkra shis bod du phyir log mtshams/ krung dbyang gi yig cha'i dgongs don gzhir bzung gra sgrig gang 'tsham byas te/ 'tshogs nye ba'i bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen steng / bod du bod kyi skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum byed spel gsum gtan 'bebs byed pa'i yig cha gra sgrig dang /tshogs chen de'i gros 'cham yong ba byed dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang /phun tshogs bkra shis bod ljongs su log ma thag 7paṇa chen bcu pa dang bka' zur nga phod kyi bka' mngags bzhin/ bod ljongs su bod skad yig (bod ljongs su bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang / bed spyod/ gong spel//bcas bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs 'ga' zhes/ don tshan bcu can gyi yig cha'i gsal bshad bzos/7paṇa chen bcu pa dang bka' zur nga yod bod du zhabs sor 'khod bstun/da res bod ljongs su skabs shig log yong bar las don gzhan cher med/ gtso bo bod yig sbyong spyod spel gsum ji ltar byed dgos skor la yong ba yin zhes gsungs/rin po ches rgya nag mi mang spyi mthun rgyal khab gyi rtsa khrims dang /mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong gi rtsa khrims rgyab rtsar bsnams shing / u yon krang skye gzhon bka' zur nga phod dang / bod rang skyong ljongs kyi bstan 'dzin hru'u 236

skya ma'i mi da kyai cha/ci dpung rogs su sne 'khrid kyis/ bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi tshogs 'du'i thog bod ljongs su (bod skad yig slob sbyong dang / bed spyod/spel gsum /byed pa'i srid khrims 'di dang de dgos pa'i zhal rtsod bskyon /7paṇa chen bcu nga/ mchog sku ngo ma'i zhal sgo las/ nga tsho gnyis /nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/)nas las ka 'dir u tho1gas brgyab ste/ mtshams re rgyag res brgyab/ nga mi 'di rlung langs po song tsang / cog tse'i sgang du khu tshur yang brdabs nas mi 'ga' rer rlung langs dgos pa bzos/ nga phod dang /phun dbang / phun bkras tshang mas ha rub ba rub gnang / lhag par blo mthun wu cing hwa sogs kyis rgyab skyor gnang ste/ gros chod thebs chag cig 'jog thub pa byung zhe sa gsungs/216lo der bod rang skyong ljongs bod skad yig slob sbyong dang / bed spyod byed pa'i mdzub khrid u yon lhan khang btsugs te/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che 'gan 'dzin dang / bka' zur nga phod 'gan 'dzin gzhon pa/skabs de'i bod rang skyong ljongs tang ud kyi drung che gzhon pa bstan 'dzin sde tshan 'gan 'dzin du gtan 'bebs gnang /217(bod du bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum /byed pa'i gros chod bzhag thub kyang / gros chod de lag len du 'khyol rgyur 7paṇa chen rin po che thugs khral chen po yod pa ni/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ bod du bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum byed rgyu'i gtan 'bebs lag bstar bya rgyu dka' mo red/deng sang lha sa nas dpon po mtho po bod pa yin zer ba tshang mas bod yig bzang po zhig mi shes pas/ bod yig bris na kho tshos 'don shes kyi ma red/214kun gzigs 7paṇa chenabacu pamachog yi bka' slob/zhog ngos/can nang phyi dril la sa khungs kyes pa ra 'grems byas/gyi lo 1989lor/na17bden donagasal ba'i sgron me/ shog ngos na44nang /lha phrug gis brtsams/bde srung las khungs par 'grem sa byas/phyi lo daX lor/237

7paṇa chen mar te ni zhi' 'jug de'i stabs kyis dka' mo zhig red/ yin na'ang/ ngas sems thag bcad nas lo 'ga'i nang de lag len bstar thub pa bya rgyu yin zhes gsungs//218(bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum /byed pa'i gros 'char gtan 'bebs la/ rgya rigs las byed pas ngo rgol dgag rgyag byas pa lta ci smos/bod rigs mtho rim dpon rigs tshos kyang / tshogs thog de rang nas dza drag dang rno ngar chen pos dgag pa brgyab pa ma zad/ phyi lo 1987 zla 8 tshes 7nyin/ bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par steng / bod nang btsan dbang gi sgo nas bod yig lag len bstar rgyu 'di 'grig gam/ zhes mtshan 'khod bsdu rub kyis/7paṇa chen rin po ches (bod du bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum /byed pa'i bka' slob la dgag pa rgyag pa'i sgyu1ma yig spel/gnas tshul der 7paṇa chen rin po che dgongs 'tshoms dang sbrags bka' lan skyon don/ khyed rang tsho ni khrims kyi shes bya dang / mi rigs kyi shes bya/lo rgyus kyi shes bya ha cang dman pas red/ snying rje/219 zhes kho tsho'i rtsom 'chal la dgag lan bskyon/stabs ma legs pa zhig la/ phyi mtho 1987 zla skyo nang / rgya nag gi rgyal sa pe cing du skabs gnyis pa'i bod skyor las don gros tshogs zer ba bskongs/krung dbyang gi dbu khrid hu'u ji li dang / rgyal khab slob gso u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gzhon pa he tung khrang sogs rgya mi'i 'go khrid chos/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod du (bod yig sbyong spyod spel gsum /byed pa'i gros chod gtan 'bebs kyi kha gtad du langs te/2187paṇa chen bcu pa chenapore bka' slo ba/deb dang ngo /105nang /7pa ṇa chen er ce ni zhabs zhu khang /phyi 'o canaX5lor/141kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bka' slo ba/shog ngos 85nang /bye dril las khungs kyi par 'grems byas/phyi lo 1998lor 238

skya che'i mi da gyi cha/bod du rgya skad rgya yig slob sbyong dang bed spyod bya rgyur mthong chen byed dgos pa'i bka' rgya bsgrags pa ma zad/ bod skad yig sbyong spyod kyi zhib srol rgyun ring nar 'gyangs dang / gang 'dod kyis bzo bcos chog pa'i nus med kyi yig cha zhig bzos te tshod blta yin zhes bkrams par/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ ngas gdung rtse kha gtad kyi 'thab rtsod byas te/ bod yig 'di bod kyi sa khul du phan thogs pa zhig bzo rgyu yin zhes gzi spobs kyi gad rgyangs bsgrags/ — chi ci 44la — 4 kogung༄༄ rī ciXs 0kā ci ci ri rilha'ilhu/———ka dhe — —— — ——————————— ——— ————— ba ci ci tre riX/bye /shā sdu sbya rdornyi ri nges / ri dz+wa ri r+sha ri tshu /cho sa//tsu sna'i dro/k+ṣis sdo sa ji〉ci dro ri r+sha /ru ci ༷ /ci ciX/ri rdoriX ༷ ci / / ci ri ci nga /he /rdojiḥ/droX ri4( sgo /rte /rdo ci ci ri tho ri rna ri ci rig sgyu //zhesawa mi cu'i(snaji chos ri ri/smi3 dzha ri/ chosashe zangasme skye 〉 ri 43 4cigetsho ———— ris shāḥ4 5 yo po'i— — —— waX —(7pa r+ṇa chen bcu ri mchos bod khul gyi slob grwa las tā gzigs zhib la phebs pa /)7paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang bka' zur nga phod kyis gsungs pa'i bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong dang / bed spyod/ 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu'i gtan 'bebs zhes pa'i gros 'char don tshan bcu drug gi snying don ni/ rim pa khag gi srid gzhung las khungs kyis las ka sgrub pa'i byed sgo'i nang bod yig gtso bor byed dgos pa dang / slob chung nas slob chen bar bod skad yig gtso sbyong /slob tshan gzhan khag bod sgyur gyi slob khrid dgos pa dang yig rgyugs kyang bod yig thog nas len dgos/ slob grwa khag gi nang bod skad yig slob khrid dge rgan 239

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jugagaso sbyong dang / spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs kyi bod yig shes ldan pa gang na su bzhugs slob grwa'i bod yig dge rgan du gdan 'dren zhus go 'gan sprod rgyu/bod rigs las byed pa dang las bzo ba yongs kyis nges par du bod yig slob sbyong legs par byed rgyu dang / bod yig mi shes pa'i da yod bod rigs las byed pa rang lo 45 man dang / las bzo rang lo 40 man tshang mas nges par du bod yig sbyang dgos pa ma zad/ lo gsum nang tshun du rtsa ba'i cha nas bod yig 'bri klog 'pher ba'i rigs la lag khyer dang bya dga' chad gcod srid jus lag bstar bya rgyu/bod khul gyi gzhung zhabs khag dang / khe las tshan khag gi las bzo ba bsdu skabs dang phogs rim spar skabs/ bod skad yig chu tshad med du mi rung ba gal che'i gnas tshul la brtsi rgyu/ gzhung yig dang / sbrag tar/ dngul 'dzin/tshong 'dzin sogs kyi nang bod yig gtso bor spyod rgyu/ rang skyong ljongs sam rim gong las khungs nas mar la yi ge yong skabs / rgya yig gcig pu ma gtogs bod yig med na ma gi nas len mi dgos pa dang / bod yig yod na rgya yig med kyang de len dgos/ ma gi nas yar gong rim la yi ge sprod skabs bod yig rkyang pa sprad pas mchog rgya yig med nang 'grig pa sogs kyi khrims thog gtan 'bebs /yig sgyur dang / brnyan 'phrin/ par skrun/ rtsom sgrig 'khrab ston/gsar 'gyur/ sgo byang / kha byang / sbrag tar/ yid rton 'dzin yig khrims yig sogs bod skad yig spyod dgos pa sogs yin/phyi lo 1989 lor/ lha sa slob 'bring / lha sa grong khyer slob 'bring dang po/ gzhis rtse slob 'bring / lho kha slob 'bring gnyis pa bcas kyi/ 'bring rim dang mtho 'bring gi rtsis dngos rdzas gsum gtsos/ slob gzhi yongs rdzogs bod 240
rbeb tsharno/ ——
sna /slob 'bring dongapo

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhib 'jugaphyi lo 1998 lor (bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum /byed pa'i tshan pa med pa bzos pa ma zad/ bod skad yig nga da spel gsum byed pa'i lag bstar gtan 'bebs kha phyogs gzhan du bsgyur ba dang / phyi lo 2003 lor/slar yang 7paṇa chen rin po ches bzos pa'i srol yig la bzo bcos brgyab /bod du bod skad yig nga da spel gsum gtso bo byed da sa pa'i tshig 'bru dag ba na yod/ rkya nga sa rgyal ba'i dbang pos/ da lta bod nang rgya gzhung sa spel ba na pa'i srid jus la 'gyur ba ga ma btang tshe/ 'a lo nas rtsis pa'i mi lo bco lnga tsam gyi rjes bod kyi rig gzhung rtsa med rtsa 'thor 'gro rgyu yin pa'i thugs 'tshab bka' slob phebs/ / 〉༷/snaXrte/rmimiXshang/da rdomimaXm la ris / byer/ spe /ci ci ci chu'i46 ci stodapa pa ris(rtsi ri ci ga / ri snye spya4//zhi /ci /stobasredz+razujisgro kyi mu : ji nyi ri ci / ri/rdo mi ༷sru pye/rte ci rishodo khris/spyo mi ci ri ciri ri ri sirnyi ci ri ri ri/rdo/ri trī mi ci ༷ tsho ri rterdoX/rdo /tshuX rdo chisaciX /rdokhro /〉kring rdo ri ci/ ri rtso tshoX/ 〉shāX/tri ༷༷/ri(byine ri) tsho mi (7pa ṇa chen bcu pa / bka' zur nga phod/)244

sku che'i smad kyi cha/bco drug thod dar rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs/spyi tshogs kyi rtsa ba dpal 'byor zhes pa ltar/ mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs shig dang / mi rigs shig tha na khyim tshang gang zhig yin rung / dpal 'byor gyi rtsa ba brtan po med na 'thor zhig tu 'gro ba chos nyid red/rgya nag gzhung gis phyi lo 1958 nas 1980 bar/ bod mi mang la dpal 'byor gyi thad nas ya nga snying rje med par bshu bzhog byed cing / chab srid kyi thad nas gdug rtsub dgu ldan gyis gnya' gnon tshabs che stabs/ bod mi'i nang sems khams bde thang dang phyi dngos po 'phel rgyas gnyi sa kyi steng /'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis bzod dka' ba'i gnon shugs dang / gtor bshigaganod skyon tshabs chen btang zhing / bod rigs chags 'jig gi so mtshams su bskyal/ phyi lo 1983 nas sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs kyi srid jus gtan 'bebs byas zin yang / bod khul du dmangs gtso bcos sgyur dang /zing 'khrug zhod 'jags/ rig gnas gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod dang bshu gzhog gi ngar shugs 'jags med pas/ bod mi dmangs kyi dpal yon gnyis kyi rma kha da dung yang gsos med/phyi lo 1985 zla 8 tshes 31 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog gis/ bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes te lo ngo 20 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i tshogs chen steng / bod kyi dpal 'byor gong 'phel mgyogs myur gtong rgyu de ni bod kyi las ga'i lte ba'i las 'gan yin la/ lo rgyus thog nas 245

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugalus pa'i mi rigs khag dbar don dngos thog 'dra mnyam med pa'i gnas tshul rim bzhin med pa bzo rgyu'i rtsa ba'i byed thabs shig kyang yin zhes/ rgya gzhung gis bod mi mang gi 'tsho bar rogs skyor dgos pa'i dgongs 'char zhus kyang /rgya nag gzhung gis sngon la shar rgyud phyug po bzo ba'am mi 'ga' phyug po bzo dgos/ zhes rgya nag shar phyogs sam rgya mi rigs phyug 'gyur bzo ba las/ dbul zhing phongs ba'i bod mi mang gi 'tsho ba'i gnad don la do snang til 'bra tsam byed 6) med/ ra nga mdang dgong 'brog pa 'ga' re'i khyim tshang la song nas bltas pa yin/ de min mjal ba tshang ma'i ngo la bltas na tshang ma'i gdong mdog ha cang skyo/gyon pa btsog222 dbul zhing phongs pa de lo rabs 80 bod mi mang gi gnad don gtso bo zhig yin pa gsungs te/ rgya nag gzhung dang bod kyi dpon rigs 'dus pa'i tshogs 'du gang sar/ g.yon lhung bsam pas bod mi mang la mi bsad rgyu brlag gi gyong gud tshabs chen bzos yod pas/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod mi mang gi 'tsho ba'i thad gyong gud kha gsab byas te/ kho tsho'i lto gos kyi gnad don thag gcod bya dgos pa'i bsam 'char dang skyon brjod gnang 'dugaphyi lo 1987 lor/ rgya nag rgyal khab 'char gzhi u yon lhan khang zhes pa'i 'char 'god snyan zhu'i nang / rgya nag dbus gzhung gis mu mthud dbul zhing phongs pa'i sa khul khag la rogs skyor byas te/ dbul bcos phyug sgyur gyi lam la bskyod dgos pa'i las don skor mang po bkod yod pa'i nang / grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul la gang 'dra byed dgos min skor tshig gcig kyang 'khod med/gnas tshul der 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog thugs gting nas dgongs 'tshoms drag tu bzhes te/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon 1447paṇa chen bcu pa ma chos gi bsa' slo ba/deb dang po /shog1 4nang /7paṇa chen er te ni zhabs zhu khang /phyi lo daX05lor/246

kyi che'i smad kyi cha/gyi tshogs chen steng / sngon la khyed tsho /rgyamerigs//phyug po byas na ma 'grigs pa med/ nga tshos (bodami rigs/)gyon chas ral pa gyon nas gang sar slong mo byed par phyin chog ces zur za'i gtam bshad gnang /223bod mi dmangs bde skyid ldan pa'i 'tsho bar rol thub pa bya rgyu de/7paṇa chen rin po che'i dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'dor du med pa'i 'gan 'khri zhig tu dgongs bzhin yod la/ bod mi'i 'tsho ba bde skyid kyi lam/ du 'gro bar rang gi 'jon nus la brten pa las gzhan rten gyi bsam pa yod mi rung zhing /da bar bod kyi gyong gud thams cad rig gnas slob gso dang tshan rtsal rjes lus las byung zhing / de yang mthar gtugs na dpal 'byor 'phel kha dal ba las byung ba mkhyen rjes/ bod kyi rig gnas slob gso gong spel gtong ba'i thebs rtsa gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i 'char 'god gnang /7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis/ngas bod ljongs 'phel rgyas yong ba'i thebs rtsa tshogs pa btsugs nas/ phyin chad dngul mang po byung tshe dpal 'byor gong 'phel gtong rgyu dang / slob grwa dang /sman khang / rgan gso khang 'dzugs rgyur rogs ram byed chog pa dang / nyams gso byed dgos pa'i dgon pa nyams gso byed rogs byas te/ mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal dang sems gcong bcos rgyu de ni/ nga tsho'i mi rabs 'di'i 'gan 'khri yin pa gsungs/ci phyi lo 1987 zla 4 tshes 15 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku ngo mas 'gan 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan bzhes te/ rgya nag gzhung gis 'dzin skyong 'og bstun mi dgos la/ rin po che sku sger gyi khe bzang len ched du yang min par/dan kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchos gi bka' slo ba/shog ngos 5zhinang /phyi dril la sa lungs kyi par 'grem sa byas/phyi lo 1998lo ra/247

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugabod kyi rig gnas slob gso dar spel la mkho ba'i dpal 'byor rogs ram byed pa'i ched/ dmangs khrod rtsa 'dzugs rang bzhin ldan pa'i bod dar rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs gsar 'dzugs gnang / tshogs pa'i byed sgo rnam gsu ma gyi las 'gan gtso bo ni/ rgyal spyi'i ma/dza' grogs mi sna dang / rtsa 'dzugs/srid gzhung / tshogs pa/ lhag par phyi sdod bod rigs spun zla bcas la 'brel gtugs sogs thabs lam sna tshogs brgyud/ bod kyi 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag khag la ram 'degs rang bzhin gyi ro gas phan mkho 'don ched ma dngul gra sgrig gnang rgyu de yin/2247paṇa chen rin po che sku ngo ma'i zhal sgo las/ bod dar rgyas ma dngul tshogs pas bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i 'phel rgyas la rogs ram dang mnyam du/ bod rigs sa khul gzhan par don dag 'ga' bsgrub rgyu yin/ma dngul tshogs pas bod ljongs nas rang gi phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi slob grwa chen mo zhig 'dzugs par gra sgrig byed bzhin yod/ slob chung nas slob grwa chen mo bar yod la/shes ldan mi gang 'dra mkho na de skyed sring bya rgyu yin/ che phyogs nas tshan rig lag rtsal dang chung phyogs nas sgra sdud 'khor lo zhig gso byed pa dang tshem bzo slob pa zhig gsar skrun gnang rgyu yin pa gsungs/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos gtso 'gan bzhes pa'i bod dar rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs kyis/ bod du bod yig slob chen gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu phud/ da dung dmigs yul gzhan 'ga' yod pa ni/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis/ nad pa mang po zhig tha na 'gro 'dug byed mi thub kyang /byam khrir brten nas yong ste sgor mo nga'i mdun du bzhag ngos la nad gdon 234bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7paṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉shog ngos 77nang /bod ljo ngas mi dmangs dpe rgyu na khang /pyi 'o 1989zla zhinang / 248

skya che'i smad kyai cha/sel ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus/ gnas tshul de dang de 'dra ba 'phrad dus/ nga yi blo shin tu mi bde bar gyur/ kho tsho de 'dra phyug po min pa ngas los shes mod/'on kyang / kho tshor nad byung tshe sman pa mi bsten par nga btsal bar yong ba la ngos yang bya thabs med pa red/ngas sgor mo dag mngon med kyis byam khri'i 'og tu 'jog pa'am/yang na phyir nad pa 'khur yong ba'i mi la sprad de/ sgor mo 'di ni 7paṇa chen gyis khyed la gnang ba'i sgor mo yin/ kho rang sman par bsten nas sman gso byos shod kyi yod/ ngos kyi da lta btsugs pa'i bod 'phel rgyas jogs skyor ma dngul lhan tshogs la da dung sgor mo de 'dra med/ gal srid sgor mo yod tshe/bod khul du sman khang 'ga' nges par du btsugs nas/ bod kyi pha mes kyis ngos skyed sring byas pa'i drin lan 'jal rgyu yin pa gsungs/225 phyi lo 1988 lor/ sud se rgya gram dmar po'i lhan tshogs dang mnyam 'brel gnang ste/ gzhis ka rtse sa gnas 'phrod bsten slob grwa dang / gzhis rtse rdzong span gzhung shang bod kyi gso rig slob grwa dang / lto kha 'phyong rgyas srong btsan gso rig slob grwa/ bod rang skyong ljongs las rigs dge 'os sbyong brdar/ lho kha 'dus 'dril gcong nad 'gog bcos lte gnas/ dar rtse mdo da phrug slob grwa sogs/ bod ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ zi khron/ kun su'u/ yun nan dang bcas pa'i bod dang bod khul du/ rnam grangs 46 la kha gtad rogs skyor gnang /kha gtad rogs skyor gyi rnam grangs khrod/ rig gnas srung skyob dang /bod yig gi slob grwa chung 'bring gsar 'dzugs/ rtsa che'i dgon sde nyams gso dang srung skyob/ bod lugs gso rig sbyong brdar slob grwa/ bod sman bzo grwa/ grong na 5gung gzhon tshogs pa'i krung dbyang hru'u ci khru'u yi hru'u ci tho bzang si 7paṇa chen rjes dran rtsom yig/249

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'jug gseb sman pa'i sbyong brdar/ bod kyi rig gnas dpe deb dpar skrun/ dgon pa nyams gso dang / rig dngos srung skyob/ tshan rig dar spel/ chu log dang /gangs skyon/ dbul skyor rgud skyob la zhal 'debs 'bor chen gnang yod/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs thebs rtsa lhan tshogs kyis/ snga rting du yo rob dang / byang a ri/ sud se/ su'u kun/ no we/'jar man/ a ri sogs kyi srid gzhung gi rtsa 'dzugs dang / tshogs pa/ mi sgor/phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigaso spun zlar re skul 'brel gtugs gnang ste/rogs dngul rgya sgor khri 949 byung ba'i khrod nas/ rgya sgor khri 60 lhag tsam nub phyogs rgyal khab khag tu yod pa'i bod rigs spun zlas gnang ba zhig yin/ma dngul zhal 'debs de dag bod ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ si khron/ kun su'u/yun nan sogs bod rigs sa khul gyi mi mang tshor 'tsho snon dang / rgud skyob/slob gso'i rogs dngul/ 'phrod bsten rogs dngul sogs la rgya sgor khri 37 snyoganang ba'i nang nas/ bod ljongs su brgya cha 46 dang / bod khul gzhan la brgya cha 54 gnang / ma dngul gtong phyogs thad rig gnas slob gsor rgya sgor khri 11 ca dang / spyi tshogs phan bde'i ched rgya sgor khri 26 gnang skuthod/226shod rgyun la/ sud sir yod pa'i bod rigs spun zlar 'brel ba zhu sa'i 7paṇa chen rin po che sku sger gyi don gcod cig kyang 'dzugs 'char yod pa gsungs/phyi lo 1989 lor/ bod mi mang gi khyad du 'phags pa'i 'thus tshab/ bod dar rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs gsar gtod dang 'gan 'dzin gyi las 'khur bsnams bzhin pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pas/ bod dar rgyas thebs rtsa lhan tshogs la sub tu med pa'i gyong gud dang bar chad byung ba/nan5zhen chang ge chod rtsom /tan rtan byi smo nas bod mi mang gi don du dngos phan bya ba khaga' zhig sgrub pa/250

(7pa ṇa chen bcu pa ma chog gis bod kyi slob gso dang 'phrod bsten ched zhal 'debs gnang bzhin pa )7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i lo gcig gi rjes su ste/ phyi lo 1991 zla 6 tshes 26 nyin/ bod dar rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs kyi bdag dbang yongs rdzogs/ bod rang skyong ljongs mi dmangs srid gzhung gis gzhung bzhes btang zhing / da lta'i char thebs rtsa'i ming tsam las kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i thog ma'i dgongs bzhed ltar/zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi rig gnas slob gso dang / dpal 'byor 'tsho ba/rang byung rgud skyob sogs la bya ba ngo ma'i thog nas phan thogs rtsa ba nas med pa zhig chags yod/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i mdzad par go ba mi lon pa'i bod mi 'ga' re'i snang ngor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa rgyas spros che zhing rgyu nor la mnyes pa zhi bsams kyang /227 rin po che rang ngos nas rang nyid bla dpon zhig nan sta ga la phun tshogs bkra zis kyi mi tsho'i 'o rgyus/deb gsum t+yā /thos ngos daXsmonang / bod kyi dpe ca/dzod lang /phyi lo 1995lo ra/251

7paṇa chen yer te gi zhib 'jugayin pa'i rgyas spros kyi 'tsho ba yongs su spangs te/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu dbul zhing phongs pa'i bod mi mang gi 'tsho ba mgyogs nas myur du phyug 'gyur gyi lam du skyod rgyur thugs 'grus chen po gnang gin yod/phyi lo 1980 lor/ a mdo dang / phyi lo 1982 lor/ dbus gtsang / phyi lo 1986 lor/ khams phyogs gang du chibs bsgyur gnang skabs/dbul zhing phongs ba'i bod mi mang gi 'tsho bar brdab gsig mi 'gro ba'i ched/brnyan 'phrin brgyud lam nas khyed tshos ngos mjal du yong tshe/ ngos la 'bul ba ci yang mi dgos/ khyod tshos ngos la 'bul ba mang po phul nas rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba dang thon skyed/ yang na phyogs gzhan par gyong gud bzos tshe/ ngos blo pham yi chad dang sems skyo chen po skye nges yin pa'i bka' slob gnang / phyi lo 1986lor/ zi khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod khul nas yun nan zhing chen gyi 'thus mi li'u chin pu'u krang la/ bod khul du nga'i thob thang nyis brtsegs yin pas rgyas spros cung zad byas kyang chog 'on kyang / sne len gyi cha nas gtan 'khel gyi tshad gzhi ltar bsgrub dgos/ 'tsho ba'i cha nas rtsam pa yod pa tsam gyis chog pa gsungs/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 23 nyin/ gtsang gzhis ka rtser bod rigs sa khul lnga'i bla dpon bsdus pa'i bzhugs pa'i tshogs 'du'i steng /ngas da bar sdod shag nang tsha glog gi sgrig chas btsugs med/ 'a khyags dus sa snum blugs snod chen po zhig la i khung phug nas me bsro gi yod/ nga lkugs drags nas tsha grog sgrig chas me thab las legs pa yod pa ma shes pa min/de gnyis kyi khyad par nga'i klad pa'i nang gsal zhing gsal ba yod/ 'on kyang /ngas da lta bod gangs can ljongs kyi yul 'di la bsam blo gtong dgos pa las/thog mar rang nyid kyi don dag bsgrub mi rung bsam gyi yod ces gsungs/ /252

skru che'i smad kyai cha/le tshan bcu bdun/ bod gangs rgyan : sdom mthun gnyer tshong khang /lha sa'i mang tshogs 'ga' re dang dgon sde'i grwa btsun dang / mtho rim mi sna kha shas kyis ngos la nor 'khrul gyi go ba 'ga' len bzhin yod/ chos lugs kyi dbu 'dzin zhig gis 'di 'dra byas na mi 'os zer/ ngos rang chos lugs kyi 'go 'dzin zhig yin pas/ 'di 'dra byas na 'os min ngos kyis da dung yang gsal po zhig shes ma song / yin na'ang / ngas tshong khang 'dzugs gnyer byas par rang gi dmigs yul zhig yod/ de'i thad ngas gsang dgos don ci yang med/ngos rang lha sa'i gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum la 'gro myong /lo bcu'i zang zing nang dgon pa kha shas kyi dngos po khyer song ba dang / dgon pa'i bu lon chad yod pas grwa pa chos srid jus don 'khyol byed dgos pa'i re ba 'don bzhin 'dug ngos ni bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin stabs/ ci zhig byed dgos sam/ de'i phyir ngos kyis tshong las ga nyer nas dgon pas rang kha rang gso byas te/ dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho ba'i chu tshad mthor 'degs dang / rgyal khab kyi khur po yang du gtong bsam pa yin/de ni ngos kyis gangs rgyan tshong khang 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yin /zhes 7paṇa chen rin po che sku ngo ma'i zhal sgo las/ bod gangs rgyan spyi sdom mthun gnyer khang gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i dmigs yul 'grel brjod gnang 253

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhing ca'ajugayod/228bod rnying pa'i skabs gdan sa che khag gi dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho zas thad/bod sde pa gzhung gis mgo 'don 'tsho skyong gnang bzhin yod la/ de min gyi gzhis dgon dang bla brang khag la rang rang gi chos gzhis dang 'brog ra yod pas/dad ldan mang tshogs kyis sku 'gyed phul min la ma ltos par/ dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho zas la dka' ngal ci yang med/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod la dbang sgyur byas rjes/ bod kyi dgon sde khag ni mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyi gte bor rtsis te rtsa med rtsa gtor btang /spyir lo rabs 80 pa'i srid jus gu yangs dang / yang sgos 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs rje'i bka' drin las/ bod mi mang gi chos lugs dgos mkho bzhin dgon sde 'ga' zhig chos sgo phye zhing / dge 'dun pa grangs tshad nges can zhig dgon pa'i skyid sdug nang 'dzul zhugs chog mod/ 'dzin skyong do dam thad spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi cha rkyen 'og tu/ dgon pas dgon pa gso ba'i srid jus lag bstar dgos pa'i bka' rgya btang ste/rgya nag gzhung ngos nas bod kyi dgon sde nyams gso dang dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho zas ched/ dgos nges kyi mthun rkyen dang rogs ram gang yang byed kyi med pas/ dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho zas dang dgon pa nyams gso'i rgyu gron tshang ma dbul zhing phongs pa'i dad ldan mi mang gi sku 'gyed phran bu kho nar brten dgos/bod brgyud nang bstan la lo rgyus kyi chag sgo de lta bu zhig 'phrad cing /228pong zha'o pen byi dran gso'i rtsom yig254

sku che'i smad kyai cha/bod mi'i chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma rgya gar du bzhugs ring / bod nang gi yang dar bstan pa dang bod mi mang skyid sdug gi 'gan khur yongs rdzogs/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku rkyang gi thog tu babs yod/ gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og bod stod smad bar gyi mi mang rnams kyis khrung khrung lho bzhud kyi tshul ltar/7paṇa chen rin po che'i mdun du rang rang pha yul gyi dgon pa chos sgo phye zhing nyams gso don 'khyol yong ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu bar bcar gyi yod/ phyi lo 1980 lor/ rkyang ṇa chen bcu pa btson grol gyis thengs dang po mdo smad khul du chibs sgyur gnang skabs/ grags can gyi chab srid btson pa li thang spral sku bstan 'dzin bde legs rin po che/ mdo khams li thang nas a mdo mazlo sngon du 7paṇa chen rin po che mjal khar bcar te/ li thang dgon chen chos sgo phye med pa dang / khams khul mi mang gi nyes med zha mo ma phud nga sa/ser skya mi mang da dung bshu gzhog mnar gcod 'og gnas yod pa'i snyan seng dang sbrags/ 7paṇa chen rin po che li thang dgon par phebs gnang yong ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus pa ni dpe mtshon tsam red/229bod rigs mi mang gi chos lugs dgos mkho skong rgyu de/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi gtso 'dzin gzho na pa 7paṇa chen rin po ches dor du med pa'i 'gan bab khur 'khri zhig yin mod/ chos dug tu lta ba'i gung khran tang gis/spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi cha rkyen gzhir bzung / dgon pas dgon pa gso ba'i srid jus las/ bod kyi dgon sde khag gi chos rgyag chos thebs kyi dpal 'byor gnad don thag gcod gnang rgyu de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i sku mdun du lhag pa'i sku ngal che shos shig yin/nan bod kyi 'gro ba mi'i thob thang gis bton pa'i spru' sku bstan 'dzin bde the gas smo ra gye dmigs bsal stan tho/255

7paṇa chen ber te gi zhib 'jugabastan pa yang dar dang dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho gnas thag gcod slad /dgon pas khe las gnyer te rang stobs rang spel bya rgyu 'di/ dus dang bstun pa'i thabs mchog cig tu dgongs te/ phyi lo 1985 lor/ thog mar sku nyid kyi dgon pa bkra shis lhun por tshod lta'i khe las/ bod gangs rgyan spyi 'doms mthun gnyer khang gsar 'dzugs gnang zhing / gangs rgyan tshong khang gi nyams myong las bod kyi dgon sde gzhan du yang khe las gnyer rgyu'i bla med kyi dgongs gzhi mngon 'gyur yong bar thugs 'grus chen po gnang /bod gangs rgyan dar spel spyi 'doms mthun gnyer khang gi lte ba'i las khungs/ thog mar 7paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi bzhugs nas gzhis rtse bde chen skal bzang pho brang du btsugs kyang / rjes su skyid skyid na khar gnas spos/ gangs rgyan gyi yan lag las khungs dang / tshong khang / bzo grwa sogs/gzhis rtse dang / lha sa/ 'gram/ rgya nag gi grong khyer che khag dong kong / bal yul/sud si sogs phyi rgyal yul gru khag la'ang gsar 'dzugs gnang yod/gangs rgyan tshong khang gi las bzo ba rnams bod chol kha gsum nas skong 'gugs gnang zhing / khe las do dam gyi zab khrid ched rtsis pa dang drung yig zab sbyong du mi grangs 31 rgya nag tu gtong gnang mdzad/ bde chen pho brang du bod yig dang / rgya yig dbyin yig gsum gyi zab sbyong 'dzin grwa dang /rlangs 'khor kha lo ba'i 'dzin grwa/ bod rum bzo grwa/ lha bris pa'i 'dzin grwa/shing bzo'i 'dzin grwa btsugs/ zab khrid grub rjes dngos gzhi'i sde tshan khag tu las bgos bskyon/bod gangs rgyan spyi 'doms mthun gnyer khang gi dmigs yul bsgrub bya ni/ phyi lo 1987 zla 5 tshes 5 nyin/ gangs rgyan tshong khang dbu 'byed 256

skya tshe'i mi da kyai cha/mdzad sgo'i steng 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku ngo ma'i zhal gsung las/ dang po/ rang gdan bkra shis lhun po'i dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen rnams legs bcos gtong rgyu/ gnyis pa/ bod kyi spyi tshogs spyi la sman pa'i phan bde'i bya ba dang / rgud skyob kyi bya ba/ dbul bcos phyug sgyur gyi bya ba sna tshogs bsgrubs nas/ bod mi dmangs la thad kur zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu/ gsum pa/ bod kyi tshong zog dpal 'byor dang bzo tshong dpal 'byor gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa yong thabs kyi sgo nas mthun sgril dang / phyug po/ shes dpal ldan pa'i bod ljongs gsar pa 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du nus pa 'don rgyu/ bzhi pa/ bod rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs kyi bya gzhag la g.yas gzhogs g.yon 'degs byas te bod kyi rig gnas dang /slob gso/ 'phrod bsten tshan rig lag rtsal sogs kyi bya gzhag gong du spel nas/rang re bod mi rigs sngon thon mi rigs kyi tshogs gral du tshud pa'i ched du lag rjes 'jog rgyu/ lnga pa/ mi rigs kyi rang gsum /mi rigs kyi rang gsum ste/ rang gi la rgya/rang la yid ches/ rang nyid yar brtson/ )la legs skyes 'bul rgyu yin pa gsungs/na ༷phyi lo 1986 lor/ bod gangs rgyan spyi 'doms mthun gnyer khang gis/ gdan sa gsum gyis gtsos dbus phyogs kyi dgon sde khag la dgon pas dgon pa gso ba'i ma rkang ched/ krung sgor khri 15 lhag tsam zhal 'debs dang /ra mo che jo bo'i sku mdun la gser kong / snar thang dang / dben dgon nyams gso/ yun nan rgyal thang dga' ldan sum rtsen dgon pa'i grwa gzhon lnga dang /dkar mdzes nas drug rta'u nas bzhi/ nang sog nas bcu gcig bcas la gangs rgyan gyi ma dngul mthun rkyen sbyar nas/ bkra shis lhun por gzhung chen bka' pod lnga la thos bsam byed par skong 'gugs gnang /gangs rgyan mthun gnyer khang gis bod kyi slob gnyer bar mthun rkyen na ༷7pa ṇa chen bcu pa chen po 'i bka' slob/deb gsum pa/shog ngos phyinanang /lapa ṇa chen er te ni zhabs zhu bang /phyi lo pi ༷gyi 'o ra/257

7paṇa chen zher te gi zhib 'jugadang / dgon pa nyams gso/ rgud skyob/ sku rten gsar bzhengs sogs kyi thad kha yod lag yod kyi rgyab skyor gnang yod la/ gangs rgyan tshong gnyer khang gis ma dngul grabs gsog gis/ phyi lo 1990 lo nas dga' ldan dgon pa sngon ma bzhin nyams gso gnang rgyu'i 'char bkod zin mod/ phyi lo 1989 lo ra/7paṇa chen rin po che mchog glo bur du sku mya ngan las 'das pas/ 'brog ri bo dga' ldan dgon pa nyams gso lta ci/ bod gangs rgyan spyi 'doms mthun gnyer khang yang 7paṇa chen ba cu pa mchog dang lhan du mtshan gyi lhag mar gyur ro/ /le tshan bcu brgyad/ sbya rgyal yul grur chibs skyod/phyi lo 1951 lor/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi mtshan thog nas/ bod rgya chings yig don tshan bcu bdun dang 'brel chags skor gyi ched pe cing du chibs sgyur gnang / phyi lo 1956 lor/ bod brgyud nang bstan pa'i gtso 'dzin gnyis pa'i mtshan thog nas/ rgya gar byang chub chos tshogs kyi gdan zhu ltar rgya gar du chibs sgyur gnang / phyi lo 1986 lor/ krung go bod brgyud nang bstan gyi dbu 'dzin gyi mtshan thog nas/ bal yul du 'dzam gling nang pa'i tshogs chen thengs 15 gdan zhu ltar chibs sgyur gnang /phyi lo 1986 lor/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen u yon krang sku gzhon gyi mtshan thog nas/ o si kri li chibs sgyur gnang / phyi lo 1988 lor/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi u yo krang u yon gyi mtshan thog nas/ meg se kho dang / pi ru/ sto li wa ya/ chi li/ a jan kre na/yu ru ku/ bhi ras dzal sogs/ lho a mi ri'i yul gru khag tu phyi dril dang / rig gzhung brje res kyi mdzad 'phrin skyong bar chibs sgyur gnang // //258

kyi tshe'i mi da kyi cha/le tshan bcu dgu/ 'od rigs las byed par blang bya dang thugs re/bod pas bod pa bcom zhing bod pas bod pa rtsa med gtong rgyu de/rgya nag gzhung gis bod la 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i srid jus shig yin/ srid jus de'i g.yo 'og tu klad med bod rigs rkyal stong 'ga' la/ go ming dang dbang cha 'dra min sprad de skul slong byed kyi yod/ go thob dang dbang cha'i ched gung khran tang gi khyi rgan gzhogs rgyug byed mkhan mi rigs las byed pa 'gas/g.yon thal gyi bsam blo'i dug rgyun gtsang sel ma thub pas/ bod mi rigs kyi don du skad cha mi shod pa dang / bod mi rigs kyi khe phan la ngo log rgyab gtod byed pa/ gcig gyur dang gcig gyur gyi 'ud gtam khrod nas/ mi rigs sa khul gyi dmigs bsal srid jus yig tshags kyi gseng du lus yod/bod rigs las byed pa 'tshar longs la sems khur dang / gces skyong gnang rgyu de 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis thugs khur gnang sa gtso bo zhig yin la/ bod rigs las byed par bcol ba'i thugs re che shos de yin/lta ba 'thom sbrid can gyi mi rigs las byed pa dang / kha bshad don la mi gnas pa'i mi rigs srid jus gzigs skabs/ mi rigs las byed pa'i khrod du lhag pa'i gnad don gtso bo/ srid don las byed pa mang drags pa dang / ched las lag rtsal las byed pa nyung drags pa/ las byed pa'i spus tshad kyis mi rigs sa 259

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugakhul gyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i dgos mkho dang 'phrod mi thub pa'i dgongs 'char gsungs/231der brten/ mi rigs rang skyong gi khe dbang longs su spyod thub min gyi 'gag rtsa'i gnad don gcig ni/ mi rigs rang skyong gi 'go khrid las byed pa'i dpung khag gso skyong bya rgyur thug yod stabs/ gnad don de'i thad 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis phyir bshol gtan nas gnang myong med cing /spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen gsar pa dang / dgos mkho gsar par gzhigs pa'i mi rigs las byed pa gso skyong gnang rgyu de ni/ khong gis 'bad 'thab gnang ba'i gnad don mtha' dag gi khrod nas gal che'i cha shas shig kyang yin/phyi lo 1982 lor/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tshogs chen steng /ngas bltas na bya thabs sna tshogs bzung nas/ rang skyong khul gyi mi rigs las byed pa'i bsdur tshad nges par du rim bzhin 'phar dgos la/ da yod bod rigs las byed pa gso skyong bya rgyur shugs ston do dam brgyag pa dang sbrel/ ched las lag rtsal sna tshogs kyi las byed pa gso skyong shugs chen bya rgyu ni/ bod kyi sa khongs rang skyong gi las ga'i nang gi las 'gan kha tsha dgos gtugs che ba zhig yin pas/gso skyong byed pa'i mi rigs kyi las byed pas sems thag gtsang bcad kyis/tang gi srid jus lag len mthar phyin bstar thub la/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi khe phan gyi tshab kyang byed thub pa/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi khe phan gyi don du skad cha shod phod pa'i las byed pa zhig tu gso skyong bya dgos pa'i dgongs 'char gnang /na 1phyi lo 1985lor/7paṇa chen rin ngo chos dkar mdzes sa khul gye tang sri da dmag gsu ma bci sa pa 'i tshogs chen byu nga thi gsung bshad/snye260

kyi tshe'i mi da kyai cha/mi rigs gzhan gyis bod mi rigs 'di la mthong chung dang / thub rtsod/gnya' gnon gtong bzhin yod na'ang / rang stobs rang spel gyi la rgya dang ngar shugs med par/ sna khung rkub la btsugs te skyid nyal rgyag pa'i skyag pa mi za ba'i bod rigs las byed pa 'ga'i bya spyod gzigs skabs/ thugs pham pa'i sku rlung bzhes kyi yod/7paṇa chen rin po ches pe cing du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla tshor/bod kyi lo gsar la rtsam pa dang mar sogs kyi legs skyes gnang dang sbrags/slob gnyer ba tshor bod mi rigs kyi skad dang yi ge slob sbyong dang / rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang / slob sbyong la hur brtson dgos pa'i skul ma gtong ba gnang ba ma zad/ bod rigs slob ma kha shas kyis slob sbyong mi byed par dang / snying rus med pa/ da dung mi rigs slob gling gi slob ma kha shas kyis slob sbyong stod yangs su btang dang chang rag 'thung ba'i spyod ngan la bka' skyon gnang /232phyi lo 1986 lo'i dbyar kha'i nyin mo zhig pe cing mi dmangs tshogs khang gi bod ljongs tshoms chen la gzigs zhib tu phebs/ stabs ma legs pa zhig la ldebs ris shig tu bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rkang bro glu len dang / mi rnams chang gis myos pa'i spro snang mtshon lugs 'khod pa'i ldebs ris gzigs rjes/thugs mi dgyes pa'i bzhin las lhan phebs sku 'khor tshor/ nga tsho'i bod rigs las byed pa kha shas ni dngos gnas 'di 'dra zhig red/ rim pa mtho 'bring gi las byed pa'i nang gi mi kha shas kyis kyang nyin gang chang 'thung rgyag pa dang /chang rag sbang nas sdod pa red/ nga rang nang sog dang / shin cang la 'gro myong /sa de ga'i mi rnams kyis 'bad brtson lhod med kyi sgo nas rang rang gi bya ba sgrub smon krung bo'i bod ljongs/phyi lo da011zla 11shog ngos 5 nang /261

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhi' 'jugabazhin 'dugang tsho'i bod rigs las byed pas gang zhig byed kyin yod pa red dam/ rin thang bral ba'i dus tshod tshang ma chang rag gi nang du sbang bzhin yordo pa red/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob chen gyi bod rigs dge rgan zhig gis/ngos la bod rigs slob ma mang pos bod la sems khur byed kyin med zer/ngas gnas tshul der brtag dpyad byed myong / mes rgyal nang khul du yod pa'i bod rigs slob ma tshud pa'i bod rigs gzhon nu khag gis/ dngos gnas slob sbyong yag po mi byed pa dang yar thon gyi bsam blo med/ gzho na nu kha shas la mi rigs kyi la rgya med par nyin gang lha sa'i ja khang nang 'dzul sdod pa red/nga'i go thos la deng skabs lha sar tha na dpe ma/dzod khang 'dra chags zhig kyang med zer/ de ni dgod bro ba 'dra zhig ma red dam/233 zhes thugs pham pa'i bka' ba(1na phebs/bod kyi dar rgud kyi kha phyogs yod tshad bod rigs las byed par thug yod stabs/ bod rigs las byed pa tshos rang gi rkub stegs dang / go gnas/lto phogs kho nar mi blta bar/ bod kyi bya ba'i don du yod tshad blos gtong dgos pa'i blang bya dang skul lcag gnang gin yod pa ni/ phyi lo 1982 lor/ pe cing du 'byor ba'i bod rang skyong stongs kyi las byed phun yon dang / de mo dbyangs sgron gnyis la/ bod kyi las byed par sems shugs dgos/ bod mi rigs kyi la zhen snying la bcangs te/ blo khog chen pos dka' las rgyag pa'i dus red ma gtogs/skyid po gtong ba'i dus chod ma red/ der brten/ go sa'i zha mo sa la zags mi yong ngam snyam nas bag 'khums te sdod pa'i dus tshod min zhes dang /234zha me7paṇa chen rin po che dang long gi brogs po gsar 'argod pa/krung go bod kyi shes rig zhib 'dugad 4dge cig las kyi myong ba/stod cha/thos ngos 99nang /ser mi da ri 'bur sgrul sku sa brtsaca sa/phyi 'o 1989lo ra/262

skya tshe'i mi da kyi cha/phyi lo 1983 lor/ mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi khul gtso blo bzang la/ nga'i re ba la khyod kyis dang por rang nyid kyi dpon sa kho na bsam mi rung ba dang / gnyis pa mi dmangs kyi don du las ka byed pa'i bsam pa 'dzin dgos/ mi rigs shig la rang gi snying stobs dang la rgya dgos/ gtso bo rang gi 'bad brtson brgyud nas rang gi mi rigs dang / rang gi rig gnas/rang gi tshan rig gong du spel dgos/ bod rigs las byed pas rang gi mi rigs yar rgyas 'gro ba'i don du/ thog mar mi rigs de'i skad yig bslab ste sha tsha'i zhabs 'degs dgos pa'i re ba yod ces gsungs// rga / ba rga sdoḥ sgo //rdo ci rdoX rdo ma ji du //sdi/ sha/ ci lta sna ཿ/ma tshul ci ri/ ri par ༄ sku ge tsho rtsi byuzlo76 grotsho cho~X ru ci'i ci ༷ mi du ri(riX riXrdo rtso 3 55casaX nga 2 ——— — —6snyi/she ‘maḥjizangage 7pa ṇa chen bcu pa rme chog dang phun dbangaka 'phags pa la rag sdi/phyi lo 1983 lor/ bod rang skyong ljongs srid gros kyi u yon de sngon bla brang gi zhabs 'bring lha smon bsod nams lhun grub kyis pe cing du 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog mjal 'phrad zhu skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/lha smon khyod rang bod ljongs srid gros kyi 'go khrid nang lo na chung gras dang / shes yon gang 'tsham yod pas phyin chad bod mi rigs spyi'i bde rtsa'i ched nus stobs gang yod 'don dgos/ bod mi rigs kyi phan bde'i ched rang gi phogs dang /go gnas/ tha na srog kyang blos gtong phod na de ni gzhi nas mi bzang po zhig red/gung khran tang gi dbang cha bed spyod dang / tang yon gyi ming khyer nas rang don 263

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing 'jug kho na sgrub mkhan gyi mi la dogs zon byed dgos pa'i lam ston gnang /235bod rigs las byed pas thog mar bod yig yag po sbyangs te/bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas gsum gyi 'dzin skyong yod tshad bod rigs las byed pas/ bod skad yig gi lam nas byed dgos pa de/ming don mtshungs pa'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong 'dzin skyong srid jus yin pa/dus dang rnam pa kun tu nan brjod gnang gi yod la/ bod kyi rkang pa'i steng bod pa rang nyid langs thub par thugs re chen pos/ bod rigs las byed pa tshor rang bkur gyi bsam pa dang / rang la yid ches kyi bsam pa/ rang la gces pa'i bsam pa dgos pa'i blang bya gsum 'don gnang mdzad/ blang bya de gsum la mi rigs kyi rang gsum zhes brjod kyi yod/dang po/ rang bkur gyi bsam pa zhes pa ni/ rang nyid kyi bya spyod thams cad mi rigs dang 'brel dgos pa ma zad mig dpe'i nus pa yang 'don dgos/gnyis pa/ rang la yid ches dgos zhes pa ni/ mi rigs gzhan dag gis sgrub nus pa'i bya ba de mi rigs rang gis kyang bsgrub thub pa dgos pa de yin/ gsum pa/rang la gces pa'i bsam pa zhes pa ni/ rjes lus kyi rigs thams cad med par bzos te sngon thon gyi rigs yod tshad bslabs na mi rigs de da gzod dbyar mtsho rgyas pa ltar gong 'phel yong nges yin zhes bstan/phyi lo 1980 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gam bcar lha bris dka' chen blo bzang phun tshogs la/ dka' chen khyed kyis dge phrug gso skyong gis/ bod kyi thang ga'i sgyu rtsal mi nyams dar spel gtong dgos gsungs la/ phyi lo 1988na 5bod kyi rig gnas ro rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs /〈7paṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉shog ngos 1 nang /bod ljongs mi dam ngas dpe skrun khang /byi lo 1989blo canang /264

kyi tshe'i mi da kyi cha/lor/ khams khul gyi lha bris pa nyi ma tshe ring la/ bod kyi dgon rnying gi ldebs ris la rtog zhib dang ched rtsom 'bri ru bcug pa ma zad/ nga'i re bar phyis su mi sna bkod sgrig byas nas rin thang bral ba'i ldebs ris dag bshu 'bri byas te/bod kyi snga mo'i rin thang che ba'i sgyu rtsal brtsams chos rnams phyi nang du mtshams sbyor bya dgos/nga tsho bod mi rigs rjes lus thebs pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni slob gso rjes lus yin pa der thug yod/ nga tshor rang gi mi rigs kyi shes ldan pa dang las rigs so so'i ched mkhas pa 'bor chen mkho ba red/ khyod kyis bod kyi rig gnas nges par du 'dzam gling du spel dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang bar ma zad/ nyi ma tshe ring la 7paṇa chen gyi lha bris pa zhes pa'i mtshan bstod kyang gnang ba sogs/ bod rnying pa'i shes ldan ched mkhas pas bod kyi gna' shul rig gnas myur skyob dang dar spel dgos pa'i skul ma gnang /phyogs mtshungs g.yon gyi dug gshis ldan pa'i bod rigs las byed pa tshor/ bod mi mang gis gyon pa ci zhig gyon pa dang / 'tsho zas ci zhig za ba/'dug khang ci zhi ga gi nang du 'dug pa dang / kho tsho'i rig gnas yon tshad ji 'dra yin pa sogs la nges par du bsam blo gtong dgos/ mi rigs rang gi las byed pa zhig gis/ gal te mi rigs rang gi skad cha bshad mi shes pa dang /mi rigs rang gi skad yig spyad nas srid jus dang chab srid kyang bsgrags mi thub na/ rang skyong dbang cha ji ltar lag len byed thub/ rang nyid kyi pha yul la mi gces pa dang / rang nyid kyi mi rigs la mi gces pa/ rang gi pha yul gyi 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'degs zhu mi 'dod pa'i mi de dag rgyal gces pa zhig yin mi srid pa'i tha tshig bsgrags/236na cigazhis kyi bod rigs las byed pa spen tshe yi ched rtsom /lapa ṇa chen rin po che mya ngan la sa 'das te lo gcig 'alor bar dran gso zhu/265

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugad dung khong gis bod yig gtso bo byed pa ni mi rigs rang skyong gi don dag gal chen zhig yin/ pha mas bu phrug slob grwar gtong dus bod pa yin kyang / mar yong dus rus pa bod yin kyang bod kyi bro ba med pa zhig ma byed/pha mas yar slob grwa la skyel dus bod pa yin na'ang / slob grwa nas thon skabs rgya dang khyad med pa zhig de 'dra ma byed/ bod pa yin na bod kyi bro ba cung yod pa dang / bod la cung zad sha tsha dgos/ rang gi mi rigs kyi la rgya zhig dgos/mi rigs kyi la rgya ni sa gnas mi rigs ring lugs ma red/ nga tsho mi rigs chung khag la yon tan de 'dra med pas gyong kha mang po rag gi yod pa red/ phyin chad tang gis mi rigs rang skyong lag bstar byed rgyu red/ nga tsho mi rigs rang gis rang khyim rang bdag byed dgos pa red/ yin na yang / yon tan med na dbang 'dzin mi thub gsungs/go thos su/ phyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 27 nyin/ lha sar byung ba'i bod mi'i sger langs las/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che hu'u cin has bod ljongs 'dzin skyong mi thub par bsnyad de pe cing du phyir 'then byas pa dang / kud dbyang zhing chen gyi drung che hu'u cin tha'o bod du ma 'byor ba'i bar brgal dus yun ring / pe cing du bod kyi las don skor gyi tshogs 'du tshogs/tshogs chen de'i thog 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ da cha bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che de yang bod rigs kyis 'gan khur dgos pa'i dgongs 'char gsungs par/rgya gzhung dpon rigs tshos da lta bod rigs las byed pa'i khrod bod rang skyong ljongs tang gi drung che'i las khur 'jon pa'i mi zhig med tshul shod skabs/7paṇa chen rin po ches bod rang skyong ljongs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi rdo rje tshe ring ming 'don gnang 'dug 'on kyang / rdo rje tshe ring yar langs te ngas bod rang skyong ljongs 266

le tshan hai shā/ mi rigs mthong chung la 'thab rtsod/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bod la phebs thengs mtha' ma ste/ phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 9 nyin/ lha sar zhabs sor 'khod pa dang pho brang ta lar rtse bskor du chibs sgyur gnang / skabs der rin po che'i phyag mdzub la rma ras shig dkris yod pa/ po ta la'i sku gnyer glang mdun blo chos lags kyi gzigs/blo chos lags kyis 7paṇa chen zhabs gras nyi ma lags su bka' 'dri zhu skabs/khong gis 7paṇa chen rin po che pe cing nas bod du chibs thon gnang khar/ bod kyi las don skor la rgya nag gzhung gi dpon rigs dang zhal rtsod skyon shugs chen skyon zhing / gsol cog steng phyag rdzog zhus stabs phyag la rmas skyon phog pa gsungs byung /238phyag rdzog la rmas skyon rkyen ni/ gong du brjod pa'i phyi lo 1988 zla 6tshes 9 nyin/ krung dbyang hru'u ci khru'i rgyun las u yon dang srid khrims u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'dzin ja'o hri/ phyi lo 1987 zla 9 tshes 27 nyin/ lha sa'i zhi ba'i gyen langs kyi gnad don rtog zhib ched du bod du yong skabs/ kho pas bod kyi dgon pa khag tu grwa rgyun gsar 'jug byed rgyu dang / chos kyi byed sgo spel rgyu/dgon pa dang / lha khang nyams gso byed phyogs bcas la tshod 'dzin nan po byed dgos pa dang / dge 'dun par dmar po'i srid don zab khrid dgos pa/17 glang zur blo cho sa lags ku bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshegs tho/phyi ra daX11zla miXtshes 17zhin/268

skya che'i smad kyi cha/nang chos kyis rgya nag gzhu nga gi chab srid la zha bas 'degs zhu ru 'jug dgos pa sogs/ bod mir drag gnon byed thabs 'ga' gtan 'bebs byas pa ma zad/239phyi lo 1989 zla 1 nang 7paṇa chen rin po che bod la chibs thon ma gnang gong / ja'o hri pe cing du phyir 'khor nas mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi steng / bod la gnas skabs ring rgyab skyor byed dgos pa mi 'dug bod ha cang yar rgyas phyin 'dug bod pas rogs dngul tshang ma dgon par byugs nas/bu thams cad grwa pa bzos stabs/ bud med mang po zhig mo hreng du lhag 'dug pa bshad/240 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ gsol cog steng phyag mtshur rdeb bzhin gsung don/da lta bod la rgyab skyor mi dgos pa'i yar rgyas ga re phyin 'dug ngas bltas na da lta bod nang dngos gnas skyo po 'dug blo mthun khyed kyis sngon ma'i bod kyi rdzong khag dang / dgon sde grwa tshang khag gi rig dngos gtor skyon byung ba de dag ma shes pas red/ dper na/ bkras lhun dgon par cha mtshon na/sngon ma 7paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyi sku gdung yod kyang / da lta sku gdung mchod khang gcig las mthong rgyu med/ ngas bltas na bod nang la da lta thob pa las shor ba mang pa yod gsung skabs byung bzhig red/241de ni 7paṇa chen bcu pas bod mi mang gi bde sdug ched/ rgya gzhung gi dpon rigs dang mdung rtse kha gtad du 'thab rtsod gnang ba mtha' ma de yang yin/rgya nag gzhung gis bod mi rigs ni kla klo dang / rjes lus/ mun nagan 9zad du lag bstsa ra byas pa 'i rgya dmar gyi sred jus dang bya thabs/shog ngos 7༷nang /phyi drir la sa khungs pa ra/ byi 'o daXlor/na ༷bod du la ga bstar byas pa'i rtsa dmar gyi srid jus dang bya thabs/shog ngos 70nang /gyi dril la sa khungs par/ phyi yonaXm ra/241bkras phun dang bla ba bsam grub kyi tshig tho/bod kyi 'gro ba mi'i thob thang dang rmi nga gtso 'phel dus lte gnas khang /269

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhing 'dugagadug rtsub yin pa'i rnam pa ston ched/ mtshon bya dbul phongs dang / rjes lus/blun rmongs/ dmu rgod/ skyug bro ba'i rnam pa sha stag yin pa'i bod kyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i grog bsnyan/(zhing bran byams pa )dang /skye mi chog pa'i mi/)(khrel gzhung med pa'i dga' rogs/) (khas len sgrub pa//(pa sangs dang kho mo'i spun mched//zhes pa sogs/mig 'don pa'i skor min na/ mi'i pags pa bshu ba'i skor yin pa dang / lag pa gcod pa'i skor min na/ rkang pa gcod pa'i skor yin pa/ phru gu dgon pa'i rtsig zur gyi gyang 'og tu gson sbed gtong ba'i skor min na/ skye mi chog pa'i mi yi skor yin pa/ pha yis bu mor log g.yem byed pa'i skor min na/zhang pos tsha mor log g.yem byed pa'i skor yin/ yang min na/ a ma dang phru gu mnyam du sdod pa sogs/ 'gro ba mi rnams kyi bsam yul las 'das pa'i skyug bro ba'i bya ba yod tshad bod mi'i mgo bor g.yogs te/ bod mi rigs kyis bya spyod kyis 'dzam gling mi mang gi sems la shugs rkyen ngan pa zhig 'jog thabs byas yod/brnyan phab ltad mo dang rtsom yig de chos lo rabs 70 dang 80nang / spyir 'dzam gling mi dmangs yongs dang / yang sgos rgya nag gi mi dmangs kyi khrod du shugs rkyen ha cang gi ngan pa bzhag yod/ skabs de dus kyi rgya mi na gzhon su zhig la bod la 'char snang ci 'dra zhig yod ces dris tshe/ spyir kho pa bod la 'gro myong med cing bod mi gtan nas mthong ma myong yang / kho pa'i sgra 'dzin rna ba'i bu gar bod ces thos ma thag bsam pa'i 'char snang shod skabs/kla klo dang / rjes lus kyi mi rigs shig yin pa'i lan 'debs yong rgyu ni the tshom spu tsam mi dgos pa'i tshod dpag cig red/270

skru tshe'i mi da kyi cha/bod kyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i glog brnyan dang rtsom yig phal che'i rnam pa'i rgyab ljongs ni/ gral rim 'thab rtsod gtsor byas pa'i bod kyi bran g.yog dang bran g.yog bdag po'i bar gyi 'thab rtsod dam/ yang na/ mun nag gi spyi tshogs las bcings grol thob pa zhe cig mtshon par byas yod/ dper na/bod mi spyi yongs kyi gral rim dang 'tsho ba'i 'thus tshab mtshon par byas pa'i (zhing bran byams pa /zhes pa'i grog brnyan de'i nang / bod rnying pa ni 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba zhig mtshon par byas yod/mi mang pos bod kyi dgon pa'i dung chen gyi skad sbom po de thos skabs/bod mi phal mo che'i 'tsho ba mtshon par byas pa'i (zhing bran byams pa//zhes pa'i glog brnyan yid la 'khor zhing lus yongs su 'dar zhing / yid sems skrag snang yong gi 'dug pa shod kyi yod/ glog brnyan de'i nang byams pa'i a mas so so'i nas 'bru do po rang nyid kyis sgal par 'khyer te/ zhol nas rtse pho brang du 'bru bun gyi bskyed 'jal yong skabs/ rtse'i skas 'dzegs skabs lam du phrug gu skyes nas sdod dgos byung / phrug gu de ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi tshab mtshon byams pa red/ skabs der gnyer pa yong nas mo la 'bru 'khyer mi yong ba gang yin zhes gshe gshe btang bas/ bran g.yog mo rang dbang med par skyes ma thag pa'i byams pa rgas mo zhig la bcol nas mu mthud 'bru bun 'jal du bskyod/'bru bun 'jal sa der mi kha shas la rta lcag gzhus te rkub khrag ral yog yog tu yod pa'i khongs su/ mo rang gi bza' zla yod pa der 'tham 'khyud byas shing sdug bsngal dang dngas skrag gi ngang nas shi/ zhing bran gyi bu byams pa lo na rim gyis son pa'i nyin zhig kho rang 271

7paṇa chena' ra te gi zhing 'jugabacol rgas mo des/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang du mchod mjal la 'khrid/ rgas mos mar me'i mchod thigs rgyag bzhin pa'i skabs/ byams pas mchod gtor brkags te mchod mer gses te bzos pa dkon gnyer gyi mthong ma thag 'bras spungs dgon par khrims gcod byed par 'khrid pa dang / dgon pa'i nang gi bla ma dang sku drag chos/ byams pas mchod pa brkus pa'i chad par/ lce bcad nas tshe gang kha grags mi chog par lkug pa nang bzhin sdod dgos pa bzos/da dung glog brnyan de'i nang / sku drag zhig phyogs su chibs sgyur skabs/gnyer pas byams pa yang mnyam du 'khrid/ sku drag rta la bzhon skabs byams pa chibs bkyag byed bcug dang / sku drag rta la bzhon nas 'gro skabs/ byams pa dang rta dang mnyam du rgyug bcug pa/ rta lam med pa'i sar sku drag de byams pa'i sgal par bzhon/ byams pa thang chad de sku drag dbyugs pas/ kho gnyis gas nyes dung tshad med btang rkyen/ byams pa dran pa 'thor nas lus/ skabs der rgya dmag kha shas slebs pa dang kho tshos byams pa sman khang du 'khrid/byams pa sman khang nas drag skyes byung ste dmag ma'i em rjes byams pa rta la bzhon 'jug skabs/ khos rta la mi bzhon par chibs bkyag byas nas bsdad/ rgya dmag des byams pa rta la bzhon bcug pa dang / gnyer pas rta de 'khrid du bcug rgya dmag rgyang du chod pa dang gnyer pas byams pa rta las babs bcug pa dang / lag pa bsdams nas rta rgyug pa'i mnyam du 'drud nas phyin/sgrung de skyo gar ngang rdzogs bzhin pa'i skabs/ rgya mi gung khran slebs pas byams pa'i tshe smad la bde skyid kyi nyi ma shar zhing / kha yang grags rgyu yod pa zhig mtshon par byas yod/glog brnyan /khrel gzhung med pa'i dga' rogs/)zhes pa'i mi sna gtso bo chos mtsho 272

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/yin zhing / chos mtsho'i lo rgyus 'di ltar bris yod/ chos mtsho ni byang thang gi 'brog sde zhig gi tsho dpon gyi bu mo yin pa dang / kho mo chung dus a pha ru tsho gzhan gyi tsho dpon zhig gis bsad/ da lta mo rang gi a khu'i slob gso dang skul slong la brten nas byang thang du pha gsod lag dmar ba de btsal nas dgra sha len rtsis yod/nyin zhig mor stes dbang du bod byang thang gi rtswa thang steng na 'tsho ba'i pho gsar zhig dang 'phrad/ kho gnyis bar rim bzhin phan tshun ldog tu med pa'i brtse dung chags/ brtse dung zab nas zab tu phyin kyang mor pa'i dgra sha len pa'i 'dun pa sngar bzhin yod/ha las dgos pa zhig la mo'i bza' zla de ni rang gi pha gsod mkhan gyi bu yin/ da cha chos mtsho pha gsod lag dmar pa'i bu rang gi gam du gnas pa ma zad/ brtse dung bcol yul yin pas ci bya gtol bral du gyur/ mthar mos gdam gses byas pa ni a pha'i dgra sha len ched rang gi bza' zlar me mda' brgyab nas bsad de/ glog brnyan gyi mjug 'bras skyo gar gyis spyi bsdoms byas/chos mtsho'i gzugs brnyan ni bod kyi bsngags brjod kyi yul du gyur pa'i mdzangs ma'i khyad chos las yongs su 'gongs te/ dga' phod pa dang / snang phod pa/ chags phod pa dang / brtse phod pa/ dgod phod pa dang / ngu phod pa'i bud med ya ma brla ba zhig red/ bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas las yongs su brgal te/pho gsar dang mnyam du me mdar 'chang zhing / gri g.yug ste g.yul ngor mchongs nus pa/ rang gi 'dod pa mngon gsal gyis phyir bstan cing / dgos mkho la rgyab 'gal mi byed par bza' zla dang ci dgar byed nus pa zhig 'khrab yod/phyi lo 1984 lor/ (khrel gzhung med pa'i dga' rogs//zhes pa'i glog brnyan de 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gzigs rjes/ glog brnyan de ni 273
