7paṇa chen nar te ni zhing ca'ajugabod mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba mi mtshon par/ bod mi rigs la dma' 'bebs byas pa zhig dang / mi rigs kyi gnad don yod pa zhig yin pas ston mi nyan pa'i dgongs 'char 'brel yod rgyal khab las khungs dang / grog brnyan par skrun tshan par phyag bris gnang /242skabs drug pa'i rgyal yongs mi mang 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs lnga pa'i bod kyi 'thus mi'i tshogs chung gi gros/ bsdur steng / phyi lo 1986 lor/(pa sangs dang kho mo'i spun mched//ces pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi rtsom yig der dgongs 'char shugs che gnang ba ma zad/ bka' zur nga phod brgyud bsam 'char khag 'brel yod sde khag so sor nges sprod dgos pa'i bkod rgya gnang/ 'on kyang / rgya nag gzhung gis 7paṇa chen rin po che'i bsam 'char la kha gtad kyis/(pa sangs dang kho mo'i thun mched/)ces pa dang //byamasapa//zhes pa'i glog brnyan gnyis la rgyal khab rim pa'i bya dga' sprad yod/yang / rgya gzhung gis bod du shes ldan mi sna gso skyong mi thub tshul bshad de/ phyi lo 1985 lor/ rgya nag gi zhing chen 19 nang bod ljongs 'dzin grwa zhes pa'i slob grwa mi nyung ba zhig gsar 'dzugs byas pa dang / bod nang slob sbyong rtse phud kyi slob grwa chung ba thon pa'i bod rigs slob phrug grangs 1300slob yon gron dngul bod kyi slob gso'i gron dngul nas btang ste / rgya nag tu btsan khrid byas par thugs 'tshab kyis/ bod phrug tshor bod nang slob sbyong sprod dgos pa las/ chung dus bod dang kha bral na bod kyi rig gzhung dang goms gshis brlag rgyu yin pa gsungs te bkag 'gog gnang /gnas tshul der phyi lo 1986 lor/ be cing du 'tshogs pa'i bod skyor 1587paṇa chen bcu pa chen ngo 'i bka' slob/deb gnyis pa/shog ngos 155nang /7paṇa chen er rte ni zhabs zhu lang /phyi lo 3༷༷ lor/274

sku tshe'i smad kyai cha/las don tshogs 'du thengs gnyis pa'i steng / krung dbyang hru'u ci khru'i hru'u ci hu chi lis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs 'char la kha gtad kyis/ rgya nag tu bod kyi 'dzin grwa 'dzugs rgyu der 'thab jus kyi don snying ldan yod pas mtha' 'khyongs byed dgos pa'i 'chal gtam bsgrags/de dang 'dra ba'i gnas tshul mang po zhig la/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog gis mdung rtse kha gtad kyis 'thab rtsod dang bka' 'gog gnang gi yod/ dper na/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi rgyun las u yon thengs 20 steng / nga tsho ni las la brtson zhing dpa' sems che ba dang /blo gros ldan pa'i mi rigs shig yin/ gung khran tang gis bod mi rigs la ba phyugs kyi 'du shes 'dzin te/ dang po 'o ma bzhos/ de nas spu btog bsad/lpags pa bshus/ sha zos/ rus khog tshong rgyu'i bsam blo gtong gi/ de 'dra yong gi ma red/ nga tshor snang med mthong chung byed mi chog bod rgan bod rgan ma shod/ces rno drag ldan pa'i dgag rgyag dang skyon brjod gnang /phyi lo 1985 zla 8 tshes 31 nyin/ bod rang skyong ljongs dbu brnyes te lo ngo nyi shu 'khor ba'i rten 'brel mdzad sgo zhu ba'i ru bstar gru bzhi'i bang rim nang / bod rigs zhing 'brog mi dmangs kyis ma gtogs/ las byed pa dang / sman pa/ sa zhib mi sna'i nang yod pa'i bod rigs las byed dang /las bzo ba tshos bod chas ma gyon pa gzigs rjes/ krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa'i dbu khrid hu ji lir/ rten 'brel zhu ba'i ru bstar gru bzhi nang zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi ma gtogs las byed dang / las bzo/ sman pa/ sa zhib mi sna'i nang yod pa'i bod pa tshos bod chas ma gyon pa des/ nga tsho bod pa dus nam yang zhing 'brog las don las tshan rtsal las ka mi shes pa'i mtshon tshul dang /rlangs 'khor kha lo ba'i bang rim nang dge rgan tshang mas rgya chas dang / dge 275

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib zhi'ajugagazhon tshang mas bod chas gyon pa de las nga tsho bod rigs nam yang dge phrug yin pa'i mtshon tshul yin pa'i skyon brjod gnang /hu ji lis phyin chad bod rgya mi rigs tshang mas bod chas gyon dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs bzo ba'i khas len la/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ rgya rigs las byed pas bod chas gyon par re ba byed kyi med/ bod rigs kyis bod chas gyon na nga yid tshims song gsungs/ skabs der mtho rim bod rigs las byed 'gas/ krung dbyang gi bka' bzhin bod chas gyon pa yin/ zhes 7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs 'char la mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan yod/phyi lo 1988 lor/ kra'o tse dbyang rgya nag gzhung gi srid 'dzin skabs/thengs shig ri bo hi ma ya la yi lho ngos kyi cha shas shig hin bod sa mtshams rtsod rnyog las/ rgya gar gzhung gi sa char khas len byed rgyu yin pa 7paṇa chen bcu pas gsan pa dang dgongs 'tshoms chen pos/ pe cing krung nan he srid 'dzin las khungs su thad kur bcar te/krung ne han gyi srid 'dzin gzhung don khang gi cog tse'i steng phyag mdzog rdeg bzhin gsung shugs drag pos/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs khyed tshos ngos la rgyal 'tshong pa'i rgol gtam btang byung / da lta yang bod kyi sa cha rgya gar la khyed tshos sprod kyi/ gnas tshul 'di ga 'dra byas pa red dam/da cha su rgyal 'tshong pa chags 'dug gsungs/ srid 'dzin kra'o tse yang gis/7paṇa chen rin po cher phyag gtong bzhin/ dgongs pa ma 'tshoms/ rin po che/sku rlung ma gnang dang / sku rlung ma gnang / zhes gsal 'debs zhus//24324355tsho17172(63213thaXs 22187 co〉 me(312 bab0050 206313 20105༷mang 276

kyi tshe'i smad kyi cha/le tshan nyer gcig lagong sa mtshog la dad dam sems khur/bod khams nang dkrug dang sil bu bzos te dbang sgyur byed rgyu de/gung khran tang gi srid don gyi snying po yin pas/ dgung grangs 11 las son med pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gung khran tang gi lag tu thebs shing / gzhung bla'i don rkyen dang / 7paṇa chen sku gong ma'i skyo gar bskyar bshad yang bshad kyis 'khyog bshad log 'grel byas te/ sku na phra ba'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog 7gong sa mchog dang / bod gzhung la thugs mi dkar ba'i bla ma zhig tu skyed sring ched/nus shugs yod dgu bton te go bskon blo 'gug byas 'duga'on kyang / sngon smon las kyi mthu las/ phyi lo 1951 zla 7 tshes 19 nyin/ gro mo bka' shag nang bzhugs pa'i 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mchos/shar phyogs pe cing rgyal sar gung khran tang gi lag tu tshud pa'i pus mdo mgon po tshe brtan/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu par 'khrul bral ngos 'dzin dang sbrags/bstan 'dzin 'phrin las 'jigs med chos kyi dbang phyug ces mtshan gsol dang sbrags/ mchog spral rin po che gang myur rang skyong gdan sa bkra shis lhun por phebs nas/ gartson bsam slob gnyer la thugs 'grus kyis gong ma'i rnam thar bdag gir skyong gnang dgos pa'i bka' tar bstsal/phyi lo 1952 zla 4 tshes 18 nyin gyi phyi dro'i chu tshod 4 thog rab brjid yid dbang 'phrog pa'i pho brang po ta la'i gzim chung nyi 'od 'khyil bar/277

7paṇa chen ber te ni zhing 'jugagangs can ljongs kyi 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal ba yab sras thog ma'i mjal 'phrad kyi zhal mchid thig stsol gnang cib sogs/ 'brug mo hor du bsdad kyang / bsam pa gling la dkar/ /zhes pa ltar/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos 7paṇa chen sku gong ma na rim gyi rnam thar bdag gir skyong ched/ 7gong sa mchog gi dpung 'degs su shar bskyod gnang rgyu'i chod sems bcangs pa ni/ phyi lo 1954zla 4 tshes 23 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos 7gong sa mchog la phul ba'i bka' yig nang /lar nas phran rang gi chos srid byed sgo gang ci gegs med legs grub yong ba'i lugs gnyis kyi grogs rgyab re ltos zhu yul/ 7gong sa mchog nyid las gzhan du ma mchis pas/ gang ci'i blo 'char nang gnas zhu 'os rim zhu chog pa thugs brtse'i 'ching ba mi lhod pa'i skyabs 'jug dang / blang dor ston pa'i nang ma'i bka' slob kyang da mkho bzhin yang yang lhug stsol yong ba bcas rnam mkhyen dngas shel me long du mnga' mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsal/244dus rabs 20 pa'i dus dkyil du byung ba'i gzhung bla'i don rkyen dang / go gung dmag 'khrug bod rgya dus zing sogs/ dmag 'khrug dang dus zing khrod du byis dus kyi sems khams 'tshar longs byung ba'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog ni/ rang byung khams dang spyi sgyutshogs khor yug gi shugs rkyen las/ thugs gshis kha ri kha thug dang / sku rlung bzheng sla po yod pa des/ lo rabs 50nang 7gong sa mchog dang lhag par bod sde pa gzhung gi sku drag tshor gzigs tshul mi legs pa zhig byung yod mod/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa dus dang rnam pa kun tu 7gong sa mchog la thugs brtse dad dam g.yo med 'char bzhin 'dugan447pa ṇa chen sku preng gsum pa'i gsum 'bum gachab shos le tshan/bkras thi na dang ra ma/phyi lo 199 lor/278

skya che'i smad kyai cha/phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 20 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos zla 3tshes 17 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog lha sa nas phyogs g.yol du phebs pa'i gnas tshul gsan ma thag tang sangs pa'i ngang 7gong sa mchog gang du yod min dang /dgongs tshul ci yod bka' 'dri gnang / 7gong sa mchog phyogs g.yol du phebs pa mkhyen rjes/ sku phywa'i gnas stangs la thugs khral gyis thugs sems 'chol te chig lab skyon zhor/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gang myur bde thang ngang lha sar phyir phebs thub par sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyi mkhyen/ mkhyen/zhe sa gdung shugs drag po'i thugs smon mdzad cing / sku nyid kyi rgya yig dge rgan grang phing la/ 7gong sa mchog gi gnas tshul gang yod snyan seng zhu dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang /245phyi lo 1964 lor/ lha sa'i smon lam chen mo'i smon lam mjug bsgril gyi nyin/ krang cing sus 7paṇa chen bcu pa tshogs dbus su gdan drangs te/7gong sa mchog la rgol dung dgag rgyag dgos pa'i btsan bka' phab kyang /7paṇa chen bcu pas krang cing wu'u yi blang bya las yongs su ldog ste/ bod kyi dbu khrid 7gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa red/ thams cad mkhyen pa sku tshe khri lor brtan par shog bod rang btsan yin/ zhes bsgrags gtam spel/246phyi lo 1967 lor/ slar yang 7gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul red la/ bod mi rigs kyi bla na med pa'i bde skyid kyi 'byung khungs shig kyang red/ thams cad mkhyen pa log spyod pa red zer mkhan de tsho/ so sor dmyal khams su lhung ba'i lam kha bzos yod pa red/ ngos nas thog mtha' bar gsum du 7rgyal dbang thams na45slob dpon chen po lapa ṇa chen rin po che/'jam dpal rgyal ma tshos brtsams kyibade srung nyam sa zhib lang nas par 'grems byas/phyi lo 1998lor/daji bden don gsal ba'i sgron med/shog ngos 2 nanang /lha phrug nas brtsams /bde srung las khungs kyi par 'grems byas/phyi lo naX4lor/27 9

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'jugacad mkhyen pa tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi skyabs gnas yin par yid ches yod ces khrom bsgrags gnang /bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang mgon po tshe brtan rnam gnyis/ 7rgyal ba yab sras kyi thugs 'brel tsam ma zad/ chung byis pa'i dus nas bod brgyud nang bstan gsan sbyong dang / rgya dkar nag gnyis su chos srid mdzad par lhan rgyas chibs sgyur gnang myong ba'i chos grogs dam pa zhig kyang yin pas/mi yul lung par phyogs g.yol du bzhugs pa'i 7gong sa mchog gi sku phywa dang 'tsho gos gnas mal thad/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la bzod dka' ba'i sems ngal rgyun chags su 'khor bzhin yod/phyi lo 1979 lor/ stag lha phun tshogs bkris sogs btsan byol bod gzhung gi sku tshab dang thog ma'i mjal 'phrad skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/thams cad mkhyen pa sku khams bzang ngam/ kha bral du phyin pa'i mi lo 20 nang /ngos kyi sems su dus nam yang 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ci ltar byas yod dam snyam nas sems pa sdug gis mnar ba 'di/ da cha dngos su sku khams bzang po byas te bzhugs yod pa shes dus/ sems nang dga' tshor chen po byung /slad phyin sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa'i smon 'dun zhu rgyu yin/ zhes 7gong sa mchog gi phyag 'phrin phyag zung gis bsnams te dbu dpral gyi mtshams la thal sbyar te/ lo rgyus kyi yab sras mdza' gtsug gus srol nyams med phyag len gnang bzhin thugs smon gsol 'debs zhus/phyi lo 1982 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog btson grol rjes bod la phebs thengs dang po'i skabs/ nor gling rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang du bzhugs pa'i 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs khri stong par lus pa gzigs skabs/280

kyi che'i smad kyi cha/dran pa brgya shar gyi thugs sems 'khreng bzhin/ 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs khrir mjal dar phul ba dang sbrags/ 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa dang ngos gnyis ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rjes 'jug pa zhig yin la/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i chos brgyud 'dzin mkhan mched grogs dam pa zhig kyang yin pas/7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa snga tsam yul rgyar gyi 'tsho ba mjug sgril gyi bod la phebs thub pa dang / khong dang thun mong du 'byor phyug ldan pa'i bod ljongs 'dzugs skrun gnang rgyu'i smon 'dun yod/247 mes rgyal dang rgyang thag ring por bzhugs pa'i 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa zhe drags dran gyi/zhes bzhin mdangs log pa'i zhal sgo las gsung la 'dar skad thon/7gong sa mchog mgyogs nas myur du bod la chibs sgyur zhabs sor 'khod pa'i thugs re ni/ dus rabs 20 lo rabs naX nang 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis thugs khur che shos gnang sa zhig red 'dug pa ni/ phyi lo 1980zla 9 nang pe cing gi gsar 'god pa zhu'e shin has la/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa tshur phyir log phebs 'dod gnang gi yod pa red/ khong tshur phebs na nga tshos dga' bsu zhu rgyu yin/nga tshos 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa tshur log phebs rgyur brtson len bya rgyu'i rmang gzhi ni nga tsho'i las ka yag po byed rgyu de yin zhing / nga tshos las ka yag ngo byung na 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa tshur log phebs kyi red/khong rgya nang du gzigs tsam gnang bar phebs rgyu'i re ba chen po yod ces gsungs pa ma zad/2487gong sa mchog la zhal par bsrings te/ 7gong sa mchog dang phyi rgyal 2477/ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhak+ṣa //r+sācho yo4 mi tham nas bod kyi rig sanas ma rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7pa ṇa chen rjes dran/〉shog ngos 18 nang /281

7pa ṇa chen ber te dze+e zhib 'jugadu bzhugs pa'i bod rigs spu zla tshos/ gnas stangs ngo ma shes par gnang ste/mgyogs myur mes rgyal gyi pang du phyir phebs gnang ba'i re 'dun zhu rgyu yin zhes gsungs/phyi lo 1982 lor/ bod rang skyong ljongs tang srid dmag gsum gyi 'dus pa'i tshogs chen steng / bod ljongs gsar pa 'dzugs skrun bya rgyur 'brel yod gnad don la gros sdur byed pa'i skabs 'dir/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla tsho rang shugs su dran gyi 'dug kho tsho rang gi pha yul dang rgyang du bral nas gzhan yul la gyar te /mes rgyal dang kha bral zhing rang gi spun zla dang yang kha bral ba de ni/ rgyal gces kyi bsam pa yod mkhan zhig dang / mi rigs la sha zhen yod mkhan su 'dra zhig yin rung sems kyis mi bzod pa'i gnas tshul zhig red/mi rigs gcig pa yin pa'i spun zla gcen gcung gi ngos nas mtshon na/khong tsho'i gnas bab de rigs la/ ngos kyis snga phyi bar gsum du do snang dang sems khur chen po byed kyi yod/ lhag par du 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par de bas thugs khur chen po zhu yi yod/ ngas snying thag pa nas 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa mes rgyal du phyir log phebs rgyur spro sems 'khol ba'i dga' bsu zhu rgyu yin zhes gsungs/249 phyi lo 1986 lor/ lha sa'i smon lam chen ma3) tshogs mgon nas/mi ring bar 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bod la phebs rgyu byung nas/lha sa'i smon lam la sogs pa'i chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo de tsho'i gtso skyong gnang rgyu'i bskal ba bzang po yong ba'i smon 'dun gnang ba dang / phyi lo 1986 lor/na497paṇa chen bcu pa chen po 'i bka' slo ba/deb gnyis pa/shog ngos na74 nang /lapaṇa chen tsher te ni zhabs zhu khang /phyi lo naX7lor/282

skya che'i smad kyai cha/bal yul du tshe dpag med kyi bka' dbang gnang skabs/7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang phran bar dam sel gang yang med/ thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas thabs dang / bod mi rigs kyi ched du dgongs pa bzhes bzhin bzhugs yod pa red/ ngos rang bod nang bsdad nas de rang zhu yi yod/ de snga thams cad mkhyen pa dang ngos gnyis bar dkrug shing brgyabs te dka' ngal bzos pa ma zad/ deng skabs bod phyi nang gnyis su dkrug shing rgyag mkhan mi 'ga' re yong gi 'dugasu gcig gis dkrug shing rgyag thub rgyu ma red gsungs/230 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen dbar rgya mi gung khran tang gis dkrug shing rgyag gi yod la/ bod kyi mtho rim mi sna dang / grwa pa/ bla sprul 'gas kyang dkrug shing rgyag gi yod/7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sku khams gsal thang dang / bod la chibs bsgyur gnang thub pa'i thugs smon gnang ba ma zad/ gang gi bzhed dgongs lhun gyis 'grub pa'i smon 'dun dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas gnang gin yod pa ni/7paṇa chen rin po che bal yul du chibs bsgyur skabs/ 7gong sa mchog gi sku tshab tu mngags pa'i a lags 'jigs med brgyud/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa da res zhal mjal thub re chen po byung yang mjal thub ma song /zhal ma mjal bar lo sum cu tsam phyin stabs sems la dran bzhin blo pham 'dugathams cad mkhyen pa sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa dang / sku'i 'phrod bsten zab bzhes yong ba/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang bod rigs mi dmangs kyi don la sngar bzhin thugs khur che bzhes yong ba zhu rogs zhes ljags lan na5 shes bya/pyi 'o 1985shes bya phyi dri'i la 'i khung / kyi par 'grem sa byas /283

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhib 'jugabaskur/251phyi lo 1986 lor/ mda' zur dbra phrug ngag dbang bod du gnyen 'phrad du skyod skabs/ 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa sku tshe zhabs pad brtan cing thugs kyi bzhe da don lhun gyis 'grub par shog ces/ ngos kyi zhu gi 'dug zhu rogs zhes 'tshams 'dri'i ljags lan yang bskur gnang yod/ phyi lo 1987 lor/sku ngo mda' dpon stag lha phun tshogs bkra shis lags pe cing du phebs skabs/7paṇa chen rin po cher bal yul bod mi 'gas spel ba'i las 'dzol la dgongs sel zhus par/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches ngos rang bal yul rgyal po'i sku mgron du bal yul du bskyod skabs/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'khyug tsam mjal rgyu'i re ba chen po byung yang / srid don gnas tshul gyi rkyen pas mjal thub pa byung ma song /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' yig bstsal ba shin tu dga' po byung / thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku tshe yun ring brtan pa'i smon lam zhu bzhin yod pa'i bka' lan gnang /bod kyi gnad don sel rgyur 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rlabs chen dgongs gzhi'i 'og shar bskyod dang / 7gong sa mchog gi zhal gsung bka' slob la phyi log tu yod pa'i bod gzhung gi las byed dang / mi mang tshang mas bka' brtsi dang len zhu dgos pa'i lam ston gzhen skul yang gnang yod/phyi lo 1984 lor/ btsan byol bod gzhung gi sku tshab tshor/ bod mi ser skya mtho dman tshang mas 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' la brtsi bkur zhu dgos/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ni bod kyi gnad don yin pas/rgya nag gzhung gi dpon rigs tshor/ bod mi dmangs kyis 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par dad gus brtsi bkur mtho po yod lugs shugs chen shod dgos na517paṇa chen bcu rngu chen po'i bka' slob/deb gnyis pa/zhog ngos 159nang /7paṇa chen er te ni zhabs zhu lang /pyi lo daX7lor/284

skya cha'i smad kyai cha/gsungs/ phyi lo 1986 lor/ bal yul bod mi tshor/ gal che shos tshang mas mthun po byas te/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' la brtsi rgyu de yin pa gsungs/dus rabs 20 lo rabs 80 pa'i nang 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen rnam gnyis dbar phyag 'phrin gyi lam nas thugs brtse'i 'tshams 'dri dang / bod rgya'i dbar bod kyi gnad don la bka' mol thengs mang byung ba ma zad/ 7paṇa chen rin po che pe cing du mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi 'thus mi gnang skabs/khong gi gzhung las khang gi zhal par thog 7gong sa mchog nas zhal par thengs gnyis phul ba rgya nag gzhung gis lkog nyan byas/ zhal par thengs gnyis pa phul pa'i mdun phrag 'ga' shas kyi rjes su/ 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyi bka' mol der/ legs sgrig nan tan byas te rgya nag gi gsar shog khag nang bton stabs/ slar yang bka' mol gnang bde ma byung /phyi lo 1986 lor/ 7paṇa chen rin po che o si ṭa li yar chibs sgyur gnang ba'i dus/ o si ṭi li yar gnas sdod bod mi zhig gi khyim du chibs sgyur skabs/ lta rtog bya mkhan rgya mi de las g.yol thub ste/ 'jar man nub mar chos srid kyi mdzad 'phrin skyong bzhin pa'i 7gong sa mchog dang zhal par las dgyes brtse'i bka' mol lhug stsol gnang /253 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ngos nas 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par 'brel ba yang yang zhu bzhin yod la/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bod du phyir chibs sgyur gnang rgyu'i gros mol byed par/ ngos nas 'brel mthud byed kyi yod ces gsungs/phyi lo 1988 zla 1 tshes 24 nyin lha sa'i bzhugs gling rdo rje na5 phyi yu la du rang dbang /'og ngos 41nanang /lha lung blo bzang phun tshogs kyis ba'i ra/lngi li bod khang /bye lo naX8lo ra/285

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib cigazhugapho brang du bzhugs pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po cher/ 'jar man gyi gsar 'godapas 7gong mchog bod du chibs sgyur gnang rgyu'i gnad don thad/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher gzigs tshul ga 'dra yod med bcar 'dri zhus par/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas bod mi mang la bde skyid byung na ngos phyir log gi yin zhes thengs mang gsungs myong bas/ da lta bo da kyi phyogs gang spyi'i thad sngon dang bsdur na 'phel rgyas chen po phyin yod pas/mi mang gi bde skyid sngon chad dang bsdur na da lta yag tu phyin yod/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas gsham gyi dam bca' bzhes te/ snga tsam mes rgyal gyi pang du log ste/ nga tsho phyar ba gru 'degs kyis bod dang bod mi mang gi ched don snying ldan pa'i bya ba 'ga' sgrub thub/ ngos dang 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chos lugs thog chos grogs dang / mi sger gyi 'brel ba ha cang zab mo yod/yin na'ang / nga tsho'i 'gro sa'i lam gcig gyur ma red/ngos nas 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa snga tsam phyir phebs kyis/nga tsho gcig gyur gyis rgyal bstan dar spel dang / 'gro phan bde skyed spel ba'i lam bur bskyod gnang rgyu'i re ba zhu bzhin yod/ de ni bod mi mang gi mngon 'dod cig kyang red ces gsungs/253yang gsar 'god pas/ khyed kyi dgongs par 7gong sa mchog phyir phebs srid kyi red dam ces zhus par/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ de ni khong nyid kyi thag gcod gnang rgyu zhig red/ gal srid 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa nyin zhig mes rgyal gyi pang du phyir log phebs tshe/ ngos nas mjal dar ring shos r+sā sa phebs bsu dang por bcar rgyu yin zhes gsungs/25418570te 94cha ༷ ba2550 770 73 rnge/tshe/ (chem 2009 4 234ca'atshes (24 92550 pa /shā: hoḥ /(77740 2009 4 286

kyi che'i smad kyi cha/le tshan nyer gnyis/ btsan byol mi dmangs la bcangs pa'i 'khreng zhen/phyi rgyal du yod pa'i 7gong sa mchog dang / bod rigs spun zla tsho rang shugs kyis dran gyi 'dug ngas dus dang rnam pa kun tu khong tshor sems khur byed kyi yod/ bka' slob 'di phyi lo 1982 lor/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tshogs chen steng / 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku ngo ma'i zhal sgo las gnang ba zhig red/phyi lo 1979 lor/ bod kyi sku tshab dang po pe cing du phebs skabs/ 7gong sa mchog dang phyi rgyal du yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla'i gnas bab la bka' rtsad zhib phra gnang yod/7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung gi thad kya'i 'dzin skyong dbu 'og tu yod pa'i btsan byol bod mi chig 'bum lhag tsam 'dis/ 7gong sa mchog gis dbu khrid pa'i bod gzhung gi sgrig 'dzugs 'og tu/ gdung shugs chig sgril med par/ the wan bka' shag dang / tsho pa bcu gsum/ bod sog las khungs/dol rgyal tshogs pa sogs/ 7rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin med par bstan srid klung la bskur ba'i las 'dzol de tsho/ ri bo hi ma la yi mdun ngos su bzhugs pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsan dus/ bzod dka' ba'i thugs khral gyis/btsan byol bod mi rnams mthun lam dog rtsa chig sgril gyis/ 7gong sa mchog gi dbu 'og dpung 'degs su/ shar bskyod dgos pa'i gzhen skul yang nas bskyar du gnang gin yod/287

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhib cigadugaphyi lo 1984 lor/ pe cing du phebs pa'i btsan byol bod gzhung gi bka' blon sku bgres 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal dang / dril bsgrags drung che las 'phar rgya ri blo gros rgyal mtshan/ bka' zur stag la phun tshogs bkra shis bcas par/ khyed tsho bod mi nang khul mthun sgril yag po byed dgos/rdog rtsa gcig sgril byed dgos/ bsam phyogs ga cig mthun byed dgos/mang nyung la ma bltos par rang gi nus pa de gcig gyur yong yas shig bzo dgos/ngos kyi mdun la thug par yong mkhan gyi mi kha shas kyis gnas tshul khyad mtshar de 'dra shod kyi 'dugakhyed rang chos 'gan yag po len dgos/ 'gan ma blangs na bod mi re res bsam blo mi 'dra ba re btang na las sla po yong ge ma red/ khyed rang tsho mi yi lung par bsdad de bka' bkyon gtong mkhan dang khrims gtong mkhan med pa 'dra/ khrims dang sgrig lam mi 'dug bsam ste snang ba gang dran byas na/ des phan thogs yong gi red dam ma red bsam blo yag po gtong dgos/ khyer rang tsho 'gan 'khyer mkhan red/'gan khur yag po byed dgos gsungs/255lo rabs 80 mjug dang 90 lo 'go/ btsan byol bod mi'i mtho rim mi sna phyogs khag gnyis su gyes pa'i rda sa'i chab srid nang 'khrug de/ bal yul nas bod la gnyen 'phrad du phyin pa'i a mdo blo bzang gis 7paṇa chen rin po che'i snyan du gsol skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che thugs khral gyis bzhugs bzod mi bde bar gyur te/lo mang mjal 'phrad kyis ngo shes thugs 'dris zab cing / de skabs bka' khri las thog sku ngo 'ju chen thub bstan mchog la bslab 'doms gnang don /khyed tsho phan tshun mthun po byed dgos/ khyed tsho gzhung gi 'gan 'khyer mkhan na55 bka' zur 'ju chen la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshig tho/yong tshes nyin/288

skya tshe'i smad kyai cha/ tshos khog pa chen po byed dgos/ phar phyogs nas sdug po ci zhig bshad kyang de la gu yangs kyi bsam blo gtong dgos/ ngos kyi sar mi 'ga' shas slebs song / kho tshos skad cha mang po zhig bshad kyi 'dug khyed chos shes kyi red/ de 'dra mi yong ba bzo dgos/da lta mi res bsam blo re gtong yas kyi gnas stangs de byed sa bsdad yod pa ma red/khyed tsho rang dbang lung pa'i nang bsdad yod pa red ma gtogs/ nga tsho 'dir mi re re bsam blo re gtong sa'i gnas stangs bsdad med ces nang gtam gzhen skul nan du phebs256phyi sdod bod mi su zhig 7paṇa chen rin po che mjal khar bcar kyang / rin po ches btsan byol mi dmangs tshos sha khag khag dang gri so so'i bsam tshul dor te/ bod bstan srid kyi don du 7gong sa mchog gi dbu 'og tu/ gdung shugs tshig sgril dgos pa'i gzhen skul gnang gi yod pa ni/ phyi lo 1986 lor/ mda' zur dbra phrug ngag dbang brgyud/ btsan byol bod mi tshor gzhen skul bka' slob phebs don/ phyi rgyal nas 'di khul nang mi thug 'phrad la 'ong mkhan rnams ngos kyi sar mang po thong gan 'dugakhong rnam pas bod chas gyon pa de mgo nas mjug bar du cha tshang ba gyon te yong gi/'ga' zhig gis phyi rgyal gyi skad yig yag po shes kyi yod pa yang mthong byung bas bstod bsngags yod/nga la blo pham zhig kyang bshad rgyu yod/ khyed tsho phyi rgyal la yod pa'i bod rigs nang khul la/ kho dang nga zer nas ma 'chams pa'i gnas tshul de 'dra go 'ong gi 'dugade dpe mi srid pa'i gnas tshul sdug po red/ 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa chos srid gnyis kyi mdzad pa 'phrin las rgyas dgos na/ phyi rgyal la yod pa'i ser skya mi mang tshang mas ya rabs kun spyod dang ldan pa'i thog nas 'cham mthun byed dgos ma red pas/so so la sa cha lag mthil tsam med par mi'i lung pa'i nang sdod dgos song /256bka' zur 'ju chen la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/gong tshes nyin/289

7paṇa wo'ar te ni zhib 'jug 'cham mthun byas na so i lto gos thog la yin na'ang yag po yong gi ma red pas/ ngas de 'dra bshad kyi 'dug ces/ khyed tsho phar song nas so so'i dga' po nye po dang mi dmangs 'dzoms sa la bshad na/ de yis phan ma thogs na'ang gnod skyon gang yang med pa'i ljags lan bstsal/257ru gem riX chi ci‘ri/ / ba dz+ra rmi dz+ra/thu na /(phyi lo 19807pa ṇa chen mchog dang bka' khri zur pa bkras ma thong bstan 'din rnam rgyal bcas pa 'i bod kyi sku tshab rnams pa )phyi lo 1980 lor/ bkras mthong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyis dbu khrid pa'i btsan byol bod mi'i khrod kyi gzhon skyes lnga las grub pa'i sku tshab lta skor tshogs pas 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la mjal 'phrad zhu skabs/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches 'brug nang yod pa'i bod mi rnams la dka' ngal chen po byung song / da cha khong 'i gnas stangs ji ltar chags yod ces thugs 'tshab kyis bka' rtsad gnang zhing /258phyi lo 1986 lor/ bal yul dang o si kri li yar chibs sgyur skabs/ bal yul rgyal po dang i so kyi li yi srid 'dzin rnam gnyis la/ rgyal khab de gnyis su yod pa'i bod mi skyabs bcol ba rnams la byams skyong rogs mgon gnang ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus shing /rgyal khab de gnyis su yod pa'i bod mi tshor/ gal che shos ni tshang mas mthun 257 mda' zur dbra phrug ngag dbang la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/gi lo naX bla 7 tshes 4 nyin/naldan sku sger drung zur blo bzang sbyin pa la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshig tho/ bye 'o naX07 bla 5 tshes na nyin/290

kyi tshe'i mi da kyai cha/po byas te/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' la brtsi bkur zhu rgyu de yin/tshang ma thugs mthun po yong ba'i re ba yod/ de ni ngos kyi re ba yin la yid ches kyang yod/7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs yod pa red/ khong gi dbu khrid kyi 'og la khyed tsho phyi rgyal du yod pa tsho'i las ka yag po yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug ces gsungs/259phyi lo 1981 lor/ rgya gar sto phyogs byes kyi bkra shis lhun por/ khyed tshos dus dang rnam pa kun tu snyigs dus bstan pa'i mgon dpung dam pa/ 7gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa mdzad 'phrin rgyas ched mchog gsum la gsol 'debs zhu dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang /'byung 'gyur bod kyi gnad don 'di/ bod kyi bdag por gyur pa 'i na gzhon rnams kyi shes yon slob gso'i byang tshad las/ bod kyi gnad don bzang ngan la rag lu sa stabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches bod rigs na gzhon rnams kyi slob gsor mthong chen gyis/ bod nang bod yig slob grwa ji snyed gsar 'dzugs gnang ba ma zad/ phyi logs su yod pa'i bod rigs na gzhon tsho'i rig gnas slob gso'i thog la'ang sems khur gnang gi yod/phyi lo 1987 lor/ stag la phun tshogs bkra shis pe cing du phebs skabs/7paṇa chen rin po ches/ phyi rgyal du yod pa'i gzhon skyes tsho'i shes yon yar rgyas gtong thabs/ dngos yod gnas tshul dang bstun de lag bstar bya rgyu gal che/ gal srid dngos yod kyi gnas tshul dang bstun pa'i lag bstar ma thub tshe skad cha stong pa chags kyi red/260rgya gar nang yod pa'i gzhon skyes tshos las khungs 'dzin skyong tsam ma yin par/ spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang / dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong phyogs bcas kyi lag rtsal slob sbyong 25911 khyikhu masastuX 167 491111986 98324 dgaX sta ga la phun tshogs bkra shis kyi mi tshe'i lo rgyus/shog ngos 277nang / bod kyi dpe mdzod khang /phyi 'o 1995lor/291

bya rgyu gal che ba'i gzhen skul gnang /261gzhen skul lam ston de khong nyid kyis bod khams myul ba'i chod sdom du/ bod nang chab srid kyi las byed mang zhing / shes yon can dang lag rtsal pa nyung ba'i gnad don des/ bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas gsum bod mi rigs rang nyid kyis 'dzin skyong byed dka' ba'i dngos myong dngos gzigs yin pas/gzhis byes bod mi'i re ba'i mig zhags 'phen yul/ gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang 'dzin skyong gi las sner 'gyur nges pa'i btsan byol bod mi'i gzhon skyes rnams kyis/rang ming bkod thub tsam dang 'dzin byang 'gongs thub tsam las/ spyi tshogs tshan rig dang / bzo skrun lag rtsal/ dpal 'byor do dam gyi ched las 'jon nus dang bral tshe/7gong sa tā la'i bla ma pho brang po ta lar gdan 'dren thub rgyu lta ci/ btsan byol bod gzhung yang yun ring 'tsho gnas mi thub pa zhig tu gzigs rgyang yangs pa'i zhal gdams yin pa ngos bzhes ma gnang thub med du gyur yod/ / na smos ga la phun tshogs bkra shis kyi mi cha'e lo rgyas/shog ngos na nang /bod kyi dpe mdzod khang /pyi lo 1995lor/

skya tshe'i mi da kyi cha/le tshan nyer gsum/ sku rkyang du lus pa'i tshong pa rgyags pha/ma byas mi kha snang ba// nga dang pho rog nag chung //byas kyang mi kha mi 'dug/ khong dang skya khra hor pa//zhes pa ltar/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bod rigs kyi bu rabs tsha rgyud kyi mtshan snyan la gnod pa'i shul rjes phra mo tsam yang / khong gi lo rgyus nang mi 'jog pa'i dam bca' brtan yang / rgya nag gzhung dang go ba mi lon pa'i bod mi 'gas/ khong gi sku tshe hril por rgol dung dang / mi kha/ 'phya dmod/ bskur 'debs kyi gleng phyogs 'dra min zhig bzos 'dugargya nag gzhung dang bod mi 'gas/ bod mi dmangs kyi khrod du 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi shugs rkyen gcog thabs byas pa ma zad/ lha sa ba 'gas sdom pa med pa dang / rgyas spros che ba/ rgyu la mnyes pa'i tshong pa rgyags pa zhes mtshan smad zhus pa dang / phyi lo 1988 lor/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog bod du gzigs skor la phebs pa'i gnas tshul bod ljongs brnyan 'phrin las khungs nas ston skabs/ lha sa ba rgan khog 'gas thu lu brgyab te/ tshong pa rgyags pa zhes dmod mod byas pa dang /262 a mdo mtsho sngon slob chen gyi slob ma 'gas kyang /phyi lo 1987 lor/ lha sa'i zhi rgol skabs gnang ba'i bka' slob la ngo rgol gyi zhagazhabadag gi las rogs ga ge ma sa kho rang gi spo bo la gas kyis de ltor mtshan sma/da zhus pa 'i gnas rtsol mthong ba gsungs byung /293

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhib 'jugayig chen sbyor ba'i sta gon byas/263phyi lo 1986 lor skabs 15 'dzam gling nang pa'i tshogs chen steng /bal yul gzhung gis 7gong sa mchog skabs 15 pa'i 'dzam gling nang ba'i tshogs chen la gdan zhu ma gnang ba de/ rgya nag gzhung gis gnon shugs 'og 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gdan zhu gnang ba des lan pa'i bshad yam cig byes kyi bod mi'i khrod khyab pas/bal yul bod mi 'gas 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen por ngo rgol gyi rnam pa mtshon phyir/ phyi lo 1986 zla 11 tshes 3 nyin gnam thang du chibs bsur ma bcar ba dang / nang pa'i tshogs chen dbu 'byed mdzad sgo'i skabs bal yul gzhung gis/ bod mi tshor sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i mgron brda mang po btang yod kyang / bod mi tshos 7paṇa chen rin po cher ngo rgol gyi rnam pa mtshon phyir 'dzul zhugs byas med/264 bod mi tshos de ltar ngo rgol byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/7paṇa chen rin po che nang pa'i dbu khrid dang / bod mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas che mthong yod kyang / khong rgya mis chab srid thog bed spyod gtong gi yod pa der ngo rgol yin pa bshad/265'on kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po ches tshogs chen de'i thog 7gong mchog mjal 'phrad yong ba'i thugs re chen po gnang ste/ rgya nag gzhung la bal yul nang chibs sgyur gnang skabs gnas zhesal mi lhag pa'i khas len gnang ste chibs 177rgya nas ngo sprod rags bsdus /shos ngos 85nang /shar 'brong bkra shis rgya mchos bsgrigs/bod kyi gros tshogs dang srid jus nyams zhib lang /phyi lo naXna'o ra/2641/khyikhu ma 505107 0600ba1621/98693834 265 1 60(70565104 ba khukhu1663 198698264 294

skya che'i smad kyai cha/sgyur gnang 'dug266'on kyang / gzhis byes gnyis kyi bod mi re zung gis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la ngo rgol dang / ming chad/ skur 'debs byed pa'i skul slong byed mkhan de rgya nag gzhung yin dang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi mdzad pa log par mthong ba'i bod mi re zung yin min da dung yang gsal kha chags med/rgyu mtshan gang la she na/ 7paṇa chen rin po che bal yul du zhabs sor 'khod skabs/ bod mi ser skya mang po zhig gis lag tu mjal dar dang /me tog bsnams te phebs bsu zhu skabs/ lag tu dbyug pa thogs pa'i bal yul nyen rtog pas phebs bsu pa rnams kyi rgyab nas bzung ba bshad la/ rgya nag gzhung gis kyang bal yul gzhung la/ 7paṇa chen rin po che phyir sdod bod mi su gcig la'ang 'brel ba bya 'jug mi rung ba'i nan skul byas 'dug267ma'o kru'u zhis/ khyed tshos 7paṇa chen mi rigs kyi dbu khrid cig tu gso skyong byed bsam gyin yod mod/ ngas bltas na khos 'go khrid byed thub rgyu ma red/ces bod sdod krung dbyang sku tshab krang cing wu'u la mdzub ston byas pa dang / ting zha'o phing gis / 7paṇa chen dang las don mnyam sgrub byed skabs/ rig pa rtse gcig tu sgrim dgos pa las/ phru gu chung chung zhig la ngos 'dzin byed mi rung /kho ni chab srid kyi rlung 'tshub khrod nas gso skyong byung ba zhig yin pas/ las don mnyam sgrub byed skabs thabs shes la brten dgos pa dang / mnyam las yod dgos la 'thab rtsod kyang yod dgos/ zhes krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gi blon chen yang cin ran la ngan skul byas yod/26635ba/sku ཿsaḥ/6004600 28144491ngas babaXsgo'iji 26755nu ki ji i00760ba 22143 khyim 4pa rga0btsong/kyi 20107687 295

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhing 'jugatha na/ phyi lo 1964 lor/ g.yogs pa'i ngo rgol gsum (gung bran tang la ngo rgol/ mi dmangs la ngo rgol/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la ngo rgol//gyi zhwa nag ljid thag chod cig yog pa de/ phyi lo 1987 bar dag sel byas med pa ma zad/ mthar phyi lo 1989zla 1 tshes 27 nyin/ ha cang dogs gzhi'i 'og 'das bgrongs su gyur/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la tshong pa rgyags pa zhus pa'i skur 'debs la/ ri bo hi ma la yi rgyab mdun du bzhugs pa'i 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis kyis 'grel brjod gnang stangs mi 'dra ba 'dug ste/ phyi lo 1987lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bkras shis lhun po'i 'dus tshogs steng 'di ltar gsungs 'dug lha sa ru ngos la tshong pa rgyags pa zhes kha gtong gi yod pa red/ de'i skor de phran bu bshad na ma gtogs ngos skyid po rang mi 'dugatshong pa rgyags pa zer dgos don ngas gangs rgyan btsugs pa des/ci 4ri mu mi dro/riX mi — —— —— /ngos la tshong pa rgyags pa zer gyi yod pa 2 ca9niX riri 7 7 ) mi44 ci ༷/wa ༷ de dri ༷ ri/——— /zhi tswareng/ tshong nge ngos rang ser gyi cheng nga 0 ཿrdzushāḥsna dro n+dha / jiXs/ ༄6 'u :tshaXnāX ———5zeng / / na ( gi / gu)rdzas shāsne / chas ༵༵ snyi rdokhye / byerdo ci ci /skye)sngu tre rdesdu ༷4gci la pa nga brgyab pa san na ma 'geg pa kro ༷ /sdu tshosto rme khoX/rdordo khye riXtsho /sgyu 04 red/ ngos wer gyi ched nga 31nga brgyab paX ge〉〉ci rko ri ge sdu ci reX snyos tsho ri ci / na / sa —— /—gu sna rna — wa phy-i tsamatshardo1〉 /ri mad pye sabye da sa ri /kāhārnga rdo 6 rnasko ci kād+dhir+sha py-i rdo sna ༷dī da na pa tshong pa rgyags pa da dung (7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku rkyang du sgom la bzhugs pa ) tsho 'di las rgyags tshod gcig yod na ༷sdu shis lhun po dgon pa gso thub pa ma zad/ bod kyi dgon pa gzhan dag

kyi che 'i mi da kyai cha/tsho yang gso thub kyi red/ nga sha rgyags los kyi tshad da lta ldang ba 'dug ngos la gangs rgyan tshong khang gi sgor dog gcig za rgyu ma byung / da dung ngos kyi khang pa sogs gangs rgyan gyi las byed tshos zin bsdad 'dug ngos kyis g.yar ba yin/kho chos ngos la tshur bu lon yod pa ma gtogs kho tshos ngos la sgor rdog gcig kyang sprad ma byung /ngos kyis gdan sa bkra shis lhun por bkod 'doms byed kyi yod dus gangs rgyan tshong khang la'ang byed dgos pa red/ nam zhig gi tshe khyed tsho rang mgo thon pa'i skabs la ngos la rnyog dra bzo mkhan med na/ ngos rang phreng ba zhig 'khyer te khang pa zhig nang skyid po byas te bsdad bzhag na/ kho tsho rang gang byed na'ang de la 'gan khur dgos don mi 'dug da lta'i cha la 'gan ma 'khye ra ba la khungs 'khyol gyi mi 'dug ngos 7paṇa chen rin po ches tshong rgyag gi 'dug zer mkhan de/ngos la ma nyes kha g.yogs red ces gsal 'debs gnang yod/268tshong pa rgyags pa zhu ba'i skur 'debs de/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mcho gis gangs rgyan spyi sdom mthun gnyer khang btsugs pa'i gnad don min par/ kha bral la dgag pa skyon pa'i 'bod sgra'i 'og nas/ bod la ming don mtshungs pa'i mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong rtsod len gnang bar/ 7paṇa chen gyis bod btsongs pas tshong pa rgyags pa yin pa'i skur 'debs zhus pa'i ngos 'dzin gnang mkhan yang yod/7gong sa 7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gis/ 7paṇa chen rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs tshar dus da cha lag gtugs rgyag gi 'dug 7paṇa chen rin po che zhal bzhugs skabs bod rang btsan gyi skor la/ rgya mi'i spu phyogs ded nas na 87pa'o chen bcu pa chen po'i bka' slo ba rdob gsum rngu / shog ngos 145nang /lapa ṇa chen er te di zhabs zhu lang /phyi lo 3007lor/297

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'dun bka' mol ma gsungs rang gsungs byung ba de'i rkyen gyis/ mi kha shas kyi 7paṇa chen rin po cher tshong pa rgyags pa zhu mkhan byung yo da gsungs/2697paṇa chen bcu pa chen po sku nyid kyi ngos nas khong rang la 'tshong pa rgyags pa'i bskur 'de bas zhus min la ma bltos par/ rgya mis dbang sgyur byas pa'i bod nang bzhugs te/ bod mi rigs dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i ched/gang gnang thub pa dang gnang 'os pa de/ dka' tshegs dang / 'gog rkyen/nyen kha sogs la 'dzems med kyis bsgrubs yod la/ gnang mi thub pa gang yin pa de/ bod rgya 'brel mol ched pe cing du phebs pa'i btsan byol bod gzhung gi sku tshab rnams la gsal 'debs zhus yod/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/khyed tsho dang ngos 'dra yi ma red/ ngos 'dir bsdad nas gang byed dgos she na/dang po/ bod kyi bstan pa dang dgon pa tshang ma rmang nas 'jig tshar ba slar gso thub pa'i 'gan de ngos kyis byed dgos/gnyis pa/ bod mi mang la mthun sgril dang gcig sgrig bsam blo'i nyams myong med pa red/ gcig sgril bzo ba'i 'gan de ngos kyis byed dgos/ gsum pa/ bod mi mang gi shes yon slob gso dang dpal 'byor gnas tshad ha cang skyo po red/ shes yon slob gso med na rang gi 'gan rang gis len thabs bral zhing / mi la dpal 'byor med na gang yang byed mi thub/ der brten/gzhis lus bod mi'i shes yon slob gso dang dpal 'byor gong spel gtong rgyu de/ngos kyis byed dgos pa'i las 'gan red ma gtogs/ ngos ni khyed tsho ltar rang dbang gi yul du med pas bod rang btsan yin lab thub kyi ma red/ de khyed tshos dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ zhes phyi lo 1984 lor bod rgya zhi mol du phebs zhag byi lo 19997paṇa chen bcu pa dargongs pa rdzogs nas ji lo 1༷ba'i rjes dran ma dzod sgo'i steng /rjes dran go sgrog tshogs chung gi ched deb/298

kyi che'i mi da ky-i cha/mkhan sku ngo stag lha dang 'ju chen sogs la gsungs 'a dug270'on kyang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis dgongs pa pa dang mdzad 'phrin la go ba mi lon pa'i mi 'gas/ dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas khong gi dgongs gzhi dang mdzad pa phal mo cher 'dod pa med pa'i rnam 'gyur dang /ngo rgol/ dgag cha ji snyed cig byas 'dug dper na/ phyi lo 1986 lor/mi lo 20 rtsa ba nas chad pa'i lha ldan smon lam chen mo slar gso dang de'i tshogs mgon du chibs sgyur skabs/ gdan sa'i dge 'dun pa 'gas sdom pa shor ba'i spral sku smon lam skabs gtsug lag khang du 'gro mi chog ces gleng phyogs bzos shedro /271 paṇa chen rin po ches smon lam gyi tshogs mgon gnang skabs/smon lam bzhugs khri'i sku rgyab kyi rlung khra 'gyel ba bshad/272bkras lhun po'i dka' chen bgres po zhig gis/ bkra shis lhun por gzhung bka' pod lnga byung na dpal 'byor mi dgos/ zhes gangs rgyan tshong khang gsar 'dzugs gnang rgyur 'dod pa med pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa dang / lha sa ba 'gas lha sa gangs rgyan tshong khang gi rgyal sgo'i sgo lcags steng skyag pa byugs pa/mtsho sngon slob chen gyi slob ma 'gas ngo rgol gyi sbyar yig 'grem rtsis byas pa'i gnas ngan dang 'chal gtam dag 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos gsan skabs/ngos rang las don mang po zhig bsgrub 'dod yod/ 'on kyang / mi mang pos bsam shes thub kyi mi 'dug ces/ 'u thug pa'i gsung skad kyang yang yang shor 'dug273na ༷sku ngo 'ju chen la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/gong tshes nyin/na 17pa ṇa chen rin mo che'i tho bkod med pa mdzad pa/li tso min/krung bo'i cha 'phrin na nazhes bya rtsom sgrig pa zur pa blo bzang sbyi na pa sa a ri'i kun gleng steng gsungs/da ⑫ paṇa chen rin po che dang long gi grogs pa gas ra 'god pa/krung go bod kyi shes rig dus deb/299

7paṇa chena'ar te ni zhib 'jug lha sa'i dgon sde khag gi dge 'dun pa 'gas/ lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i bzhugs khri de 7rgyal ba rin po che'i bzhugs khri yin pas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis smon lam gyi tshogs mgon gnang zhing / smon lam bzhugs khrir bzhugs rgyu mi 'os pa'i gleng phyogs bzos 'dugadon dngos su smon lam chen mo phyi lo 1409 lor/ rje tsong kha pas thog mar gsar 'dzugs gnang ba zhing / 7gong sa 7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog sku na ma son pa dang slob gnyer ma grub pa'i skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che gtsos dge lugs pa'i bla chen tshos sa smon lam tshogs dbu gnang myong gi yod/dper na/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis se 'bras kyi mkhan po lo drug gnang skabs/ lha sa'i smon lam chen mo'i tshogs mgon gnang zhing / ri bo dge ldan pas dge bshes lha rams pa'i dam bca' 'jog pa'i srol gtod mdzad yod/li tso min gyis 7paṇa chen rin po che'i tho bkod med pa'i mdzad pa'i nang / kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ ngas smon lam chen mo'i gtso skyong byed par phyin pas de ga'i chos phyogs kyi mi sna re zung gis/ chos khrims ltar na sdom pa shor ba'i spral sku smon lam tshogs chen ring la gtsug lag khang du 'gro mi chog ces pa'i gleng phyogs bkrams nas rnyog dra bzo yi 'dugakho tsho'i skad cha de dag la dmigs te ngas 'brel yod kyi chos phyogs mi sna bskongs nas ched mngags kyis gtam bshad byas pa yin/ ngas kho tshor bshad don la khyed tsho'i khrod nas mi la las sdom pa shor ba zer ba'i go don ci 'dra yin pa gsal po ma shes par/ sdom pa shor ba'i spral sku gtsug lag khang du 'gro mi chog ces pa'i ham gtam gyi dmigs yul ni/sungs smon lam chen mo'i gtso skyong 300

skya che'i smad kyi cha/bya rgyur bkag 'gog byed bsam pa red/ yin na'ang rgyu mtshan gang yang med/ gang yin zer na/ gcig la chos khrims bstan bcos nang gsungs pa'i sdom pa shor ba dang sdom pa phul ba gnyis rbad de tha dad red/ngas sdom pa gang zhig la srung 'dod med dus rang 'gul gyis sangs rgyas la 'gyod bshags zhus nas grwa chas phud pa de ni/ ngas sdom pa gcig pu de sangs rgyas la phul ba yin/ byed stangs de ni ngas sdom par lhag bsam dag po yod pa'i byed stangs yin pas byed chog pa zhig red/ de yang sangs rgyas la dad pa zhu ba las mtshan shas mi zhu zer gyi red na/ tag tag rgyal ba'i gdams ngag la brtsi srung dag po zhu ba zhig yin/ de las ldog ste khyed tsho'i khrod kyi mi la las rgyab tu sdom pa dang 'gal ba'i bya ba byas yod na'ang / da dung chos gos gyon nas bsdad pa de dag dngos gnas sdom pa shor ba'am gtong ba zer dgos kyi red/gnyis su ngas chos gos ma gyon na'ang / da dung 7paṇa chen er te ni yin yin pa dang 'od dpag med kyi spral pa yin yin pa red na/ gtsug lag khang du 'gro mi chog pa gang yin nam ga'engs/274was phyi lo 1986 lor/ bal yul du 'tshogs pa'i 'dzam gling nang bstan chos tshogs kyi tshogs chen thengs 15 la chibs sgyur skabs/ mi lo sum cu lhag tsam dgyes zhal mjal ma thub pa'i 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad dang /phyi rgyal du bzhugs pa'i spun zla thug 'phrad yong rnyer thugs re chen pos/ 7gong sa mchog la thub dbang gi sku dang / 'bul rten gya nom pa dang / byes bzhugs dad ldan bod mi rnams la ljags mdud dang / byin rten/ sku par ji snyed cig gra sgrig gnang ste phebs yod/2747paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi tho bkod med pa'i mdzad pa/li tsa'o min/krung go bod kyi cha 'phrin dra ba/301

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'dusa'on kyang / srid don gnas tshul gyi rkyen pas/ 7gong sa mchog mjal 'phrad thub rgyu lta ci/ go thos su/ bal yul bod mi 'gas/ dar cha nag po 'phyar te 7paṇa chen bcu par ngo rgol byas par rten/ lum wi nir gnas mjal tsam las/mchod rten bya rung kha shor dang / 'phags pa shing kun sogs/ bal yul rgyal khab kyi gnas chen khag tu gnas mjal zhu bar bcar thub med/ rgyu rkyen mang po zhig ni rgya nag gzhung gis dkrug shing brgyabs pa 'akyus byung ba snang / skabs 'gar rgyal zhen la rgya'i gdong 'bag gyon nas rang nyid kyi khug ma skyong mkhan srid don pa 'gas/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos tshong rgyag gi/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pas gsang yum bzhes 'dugaces 7gong sa mchog la gnas 'phrin ci rigs shig btang rung / lo rabs 80nang 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis thengs gsum zhal ta gnang myong bas/ lha sa nas btang ba'i gnas 'phrin ngan pas/ 7gong sa mchog gi thugs dgongs rtsa ba nas dkrug thub med pa ni/ 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad rnam (phyi yul du rang dbang )zhes pa'i nang /7paṇa chen rin po che nged gnyis bka' mol yun ring gnang ma thub kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po ches gang gsungs pa de'i thog nas khong rang gi chos dang / yul mi/ lung pa bcas la dad zhen tshad ldan dngos gnas yod pa shes te blo bzod bde po byung / lha sa nas gnas 'phrin ngan pa 'byor ba'i nang /khong gis tshong las rgya chen po gnang yod par skyon brjod dang / gsang yum bzhes yod tshul bshad 'dug kyang blo mi bde ba de tsam ma byung gsungs/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos bod phyi nang gang du yang / 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i bzhed don lhun gyis grub pa'i smon 'dun khrom bsgrags 302

skya che'i mi da kyai cha/ su gnang bar/ gung khran tang gis tā la'i log spyod shog khag tu dogs te/ khong gi dgongs gzhir dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas kha gtad mjal zhing yod la/kha bral la ngo rgol yod pa'i zhal gsung bsgrags gtam las/ bod mi 'gas rgya phyogs su bsam tog cor bsgrags kyi yod/ khyod shi nga gson gyi bod rgya'i chab srid 'thab rtsod kyi g.yul ngor/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod 'bangs sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i khur thang ri rab zhig bsnams kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog sku 'tsho zhing bzhugs skabs/ bod mi phal mo ches khong gi bka' drin tshor shes lta ci/ ha las na'ang khong ni 7paṇa chen du ngos 'dzin las/ dus rabs 30 pa'i bod la bka' drin che shos kyi mi de yin pa su zhig gis kyang ngos 'dzin thub med/da dung bod rgya zhi 'grig yong thabs gnang skabs/ phyogs gnyis gas skyon brjod dang blos mi khel ba'i bsam pa bstan pa ma zad/ sku tshe hril po zur 'bud dang / tha na/ phyogs gnyis gas tshong pa rgyags pa'i ya la bston 'dzugs byas pa de/ nye rabs bod kyi lo rgyus thog zhe gting nas gnong 'gyod zhu 'os pa'i lo rgyus kyi pham kha dang bslab bya zhig ma red dam/ /303

7paṇa chena'ar te ni zhib 'jugale tshan nyer gsum/ phyir dran khrod kyai gdung tshor/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gson mi yul du bzhug yun thung yang / 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa'i ring bod yul stod smad bar gsum zhabs kyis bcags shing / bod mi rigs dang sangs rgyas bstan don chen la/kha yod lag yod kyi phyag las gnang bas/ da lta'i dus su dngos dngos rjen rjen gyis shul bzhag re mjal rgyu yod/ bod mi tshos 'das pa'i bod kyi las dbang la phyir dran byed skabs/ bshad chog chog gi skad cha zhig yod pa ni/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku 'tsho zhing bzhugs skabs bod mi'i rang skyong dang / chos dad rang mos/bod skad yig gi rin thang red/7gong sa mchog gis/ 7paṇa chen rin po che 'tsho zhing gzhes nas bzhugs pa'i skabs/ bsam blo'i nang 7paṇa chen rin po ches bod nang shugs skyon rgyu gang yod bskyon gyi red bsam nas blo bzhag sa zhig yong gi yod kyang /7paṇa chen rin po rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs rjes/ bod nang gnas tshul gsar pa lhags dus bsam blo'i nang 7paṇa chen rin po bzhugs yod rogs byas na snyam pa'i lag 'thogs ha cang chen po yong gi 'dug ces gsungs/275nga tshor mig mthong lag zirno du gyur ba'i dpe mtshon gsal shos shig ni/na75spyi 'jus dang bka' sas la bstsal ba'i bka' slob/deb gnyis pa/thog 44nang spya drilalas khungs nas dpar bskun zhus/naX1lor/304

kyi che'i smad kyai cha/rgya nag gzhung gis nam rgyun shar rgyal ba tsong kha pas phyag btab pa'i 'brog ri bo dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi dgon pa ni rang btsan gyi dgon pa dang /gsar brje ngo rgol byed sa'i lte gnas/ mi ngan bsdu rub byed sa yin pa sogs bshad de/276 lo rabs drug cu'i rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa ba nas rtsa gtor btang ba ma zad/bod khul du chos dad rang dbang yod par shod pa'i phyi lo 1983zla 9 tshes 13 nyin/nyes don nyes gsog gi bya spyod la dung rdeg nan po gtong dgos zhes par khag btags te/ dga' ldan dgon pa'i tha' bzhi dmag gis bskor zhing / nang gi sa gnas gal chen khag tu me mda' sbag sngag gsemags te rgya dmag dang / spyi bde'i mi sna brgya skor dgon pa'i nang btsan 'dzul byas/spyi bde mi snas dge 'dun pa rnams 'gul skyod byed mi chog pa'i bka' rgya btang zhing / ming tho thon rim bzhin zur bka' btang zhing / lag pa gnyis thag pas bkyig byas rjes btsan 'khrid byas/ skabs der dga' ldan dgon pa nyams gso'i 'gan 'khur ba gtsos grwa ba 32 dang / 'tshems bzo mi skya lha sa ba blo bzang / lha bris bstan dar/ tshul khrims grags pa bcas 'dzin bzung byas te stag rtse rdzong du 'khrid/ dga' ldan dgon pa nyams gso'i 'gan 'khur ba yar 'phel sogs mi gnyis srog thog gtong rgyu gtan 'khel zin/dus de nas bzung mdo stod smad kyi grwa rgyun dga' ldan du gsar 'dzugs mi chog pa bzos277gzhis ka rtser yang gnas zhesal ha cang ha cang jo( drag che bas/bkras na dgon pa'i nang nas bla ma che ba zhig rang srog bcad/ gnas zhesal dpa zhirgya dmar gyis bong nang bya nganaji byas dngos mthong phyi lo 1959nas 1984bar/thes rig pa ra khang /da zu dmar gyis bod nang bya ngan ji byas dngos2thong /phyi 'o 1959nas 1984bar/shes rig pa ra khangan305

7paṇa chen nar te ni jib 'dugade dag 7paṇa chen rin po ches gsan rtogs byung rjes/ khong sku ngo mas krung dbyang gi 'brel yod dbu khrid btsal nas gnas tshul snyan seng zhus pa dang /mgyogs myur bya thabs spel nas g.yon gyi nor 'khrul khyab spel byed rgyur bkag 'gog byed dgos pa'i re ba zhus/ krung dbyang nas 7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs 'char dang len byas te nor 'khrul skabs 'phral yo bsrang byas/gal srid 7paṇa chen rin po ches krung dbyang la gnas tshul lam seng zhus med na/ de'i ngan 'bras ni blo yul las 'das pa zhig 'byung srid /yus ta h+pha yis/ rlabs chen gyi mi sna byung ma myong ba'i mi rigs ni/'dzam gling steng ༵༵ snying rje ba'i skye 'gro'i tshogs shig red la/ rlabs chen gyi mi sna byung yang der brtsi bkur dang dga' zhen/ yid smon bcas mi byed pa'i mi rigs ni re ba med pa'i bran g.yog gi mi rigs shig red gsungs pa ltar/lo rabs 20 dus smad du byung ba'i bod bstan srid kyi god chag la/ kha yod lag yod kyi gdong len gnang mkhan gyi skyes chen zhig byung yang / bod mi 'gas skyes chen de'i dgongs par log rtog gis/ tshong pa rgyags pa'i cho lo bstsal ba de/nye rabs bod kyi lo rgyus khrod ya nga zhing yid skyo dgos pa'i mi rigs 'di yi pham kha dang bslab bya zhig yin/ngang pa 'dam la chags nas// re zhig sdod dgos bsams kyang //mtsho mo dar kha 'grigs nas// rang sems kho thag chod song //zhes gsung pa ltar/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ ngos la las ka mang po yod/ yin na'ang / mi mang po zhig gi ngos la bsam shes thub kyi mi 'dug ces zhal gsung bka' slob de gnang ba'i nyin gsum gyi rjes su/krung dbyang brnyan 'phrin las khungs kyis/ 7paṇa chen rin po che sku gshegs 306

skya che'i smad kyai cha/pa'i 'das brda btang song / skye bo'i tshogs kyi thos mi 'dod pa'i gtam ngan de/ri bo hi ma la'i rgyab ngos su bzhu gas pa'i 7gong sa/ mchog gis gsan ma thagargyal gces dpa' bo/ khyed sku gshegs snga bas bod don la lag 'thogs rgyag gi 'dug ces gsungs/ dus de nas khong ni rgyal 'tshong ba zhig las rgyal gces shig tu gyur yo da/7paṇa chen bcu pa sku mya ngan las 'das pa dang / tshong pa rgyags pa'i ming gnas sbyin mkhan tsho'i sdug snying tshim long ma byung bar/ gung khran tang gis bod la 'dzin pa'i srid jus slar yang lo rabs 60 nang phyi log brgyab ste/mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong dang / chos dad rang mos/ lha sa'i smon lam chen mo/ bod skad yig sbyong spyod spel gsum/ bod dar rgyas rogs skyor thebs rtsa lhan tshogs/ bod gangs rgyan spyi 'doms mthun gnyer tshong khang /bod sman slob grwa/ bod ljongs las rigs lag shes dge 'os 'dzin grwa/ lho kha 'phyongs rgyas srong btsan bod sman slob grwa/ sto kha 'dus 'dris gcong gnad 'gog bcos lte gnas/ gzhis rtse'i dus 'khor blosabaslangs dkyil 'khor/bod kyi 'phrod bsten slob grwa/ bod ljongs nang bstan slob grwa//lha sa 7paṇa chen slob ga)/lha sa srong btsan sku brnyan/ bod brgyud nang bstan mdzub khrid u yon lhan khang /pe cing srong btsan gsol mgron khang / dga' ldan nyams gso/ gzhis rtse'i glog khang / bod yig slob chen/ dar mdo nang bstan slob grwa/ dgon pas dpya khral mi dgos pa'i tshong gnyer/ zhing 'brog khe tshong tshong gnyer la dpya khral mi dgos pa/bod mi rigs 'tsho gnas dang dar spel gyi rmang rdor yin pa'i las don las 'char thams cad/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po dang lhan du bde ldan gyi zhing du phebs song /307

7paṇa chen ber te ni zhib 'jugablo pham dgos pa zhig la 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang khong gi las 'char gyi gar stegs khrod du slebs pa ni/ tā lar dgag rgyag dgon pa bcos sgrig dung rdeg tsha nan/ bla chen lkog gsod/ dmag don bka' rgya/ bsam blo'i slob gso/ nyes med dmar gsod/ grwa btsun tshad bkag rtswa rin chu rin/spu khral sug khral/ tshong gnyer dpya khral/ gter kha bsngog 'don/ shing nags gcod bregs/ yar 'brog glog khang / me 'khor lcags lam/ nang sa'i 'dzin grwa/nub brgyud gsar spel sogs/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun nas drag gnon dang / do dam/ mi ser spel yul/ bshu gzhog gi srid jus shig lho mon gyi sprin nag bzhin g.yo dus/ tshong pa rgyags pa'i bka' drin gyi zungs khrag las thob pa'i lo rabs 80 pa'i bde skyid kyi dus bzang la phyir dran dang zhib bsdur gyi gtam rgyud gleng bzhin/ drin chen lag pa rang gis brdung ba'i gnas tshul la gnong 'gyod dang / 'khang ra byed mkhan ni/ mun rub pa'i skar ma bzhin dus da lta yang gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis thon bzhin yod/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs/ bod khul gyi chos sde dgon pa khag gis za khang dang / tshong khang / khe las kyi las rigs ci zhig gnyer kyang dpya khral 'bul mi dgos pa dmigs bsal thob thang yod kyang /7paṇa chen rin po che sku gshegs pa dang rgya nag gzhung gis bod kyi dgon sde khag gi ja khang dang / tshong khang / tha na lha sa'i bar skor nang thang khrom 'don mkhan dbul zhing phongs pa'i zhing 'brog khe tshong ba rnams la'ang /khe las tshan pa gzhan dang gcig mtshungs kyis gzhung la tshong khral sgrub rgyug dgos pa'i bka' rgya btang yod/ bka' rgya bzhin ma sgrub na tshong gnyer mi chog pa'i khrims gzhi gsar bzo byas pa de ni/ bod mi sger pa so sor dngos dngos rjen rjen gyi tshong pa rgyags pa'i la yog dang po de yin/308

skya che'i smad kyi cha/bod khams spyi la byung ba'i gyong gud ni brjod kyi mi langs mod/phyi lo 1985 zla 8 tshes 2 nyin/ rgya nag gzhung gis/ bod nang me 'khor lcags lam dang / yar 'brog g.yu mtshor glog khang bzo skrun bya rgyur chog mchan sprad kyang / kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos yar 'brog g.yu mtsho ni/bod kyi chos phyogs nas lo rgyus nang gi mtsho ngo mtshar can gyi mtsho chen bzhi yi nang nas gcig yin pas/ yar 'brog g.yu mtshor glog khang bzo skrun byas tshe/ bod la char chu dus su mi 'bab pa dang / lo phyugs rtag tu mi legs pa'i gnas tshul 'ong rgyu lags na/ ngos gtsos pa'i bod mi dmangs kyis ngos len rtsa ba nas byed thabs med gsungs nas/ glog khang rgyag rgyu dang / me 'khor lcags lam bzo rgyu bkag 'gog gnang yod/'on kyang / phyi lo 1989 zla 8 tshes 28 nyin te/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i zla ba brgyad kyi rjes su/ yar 'brog g.yu mtshor glog khang gsar rgyag las grwa btsugs pa dang / bod ljongs mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs nas yongs bsgrags su gsar 'gyur spel don/rgyal khab kyis snga sa nas yar 'brog grog khang gsar rgyag byed 'dod kyang /mi kha shas kyis rmongs dad kyis bshad tshul spel nas/ da bar glog khang gsar rgyag byed rgyur bkag 'gog byas yod/ 'on kyang / da cha yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i glog khang gi las grwa dngos su 'go tshugs nas gegs med 'grub bzhin yod pa'i gnas ngan bsgrags pa dang / me 'khor lcags lam bzos yod pa ni dpe mtshon tsam lags so//309

skya che'i bar gyi cha/ sa bcad gnyis pa/ sku tshe'i bar gyi cha/(1959 —1979)be tshan dang po/ gzhung bla gcig sgril gyi dgongs bzhed/rgya nag gung khran tang gis bod la btsan 'dzul byas pa ma zad/ bod rgya mnyam gnas sgrig 'jags ma byung bar/ bod mi'i chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid 7gong sa mchog dang gzhung sa chen po thos byol du phebs dgos byung ba 'di/than pa'o san gyis/ 7gong sa mchog bod dmag khul khang du gzigs mor gdan zhu phul ba'i thol byung gi byung rim des dag sel thub rgyu ni ha cang dka' mo zhig yin/lo rgyus kyi las 'dzol de ni dus rabs 20 lo rabs 10 pa'i dkyil nas/spyi don ras su bor ba'i nang khul 'thab rtsod de/ lung shar don rkyen dang / dwa stag don rkyen/ gzhung bla'i don rkyen/ zhes bod sde pa gzhung gi sku drag nang rul zhing /lha 'dres mi shes pa'i gzhung bla'i don rkyen gyi ngan 'bras shig yin pa ni nyi shar sbar mos khebs thabs med pa zhig red/phyi lo 1923 lor/ bod gzhung gis bkras lhun bla brang la dmag phogs bzhir zur 'gel dkri byas pa'i don rkyen las/ bod gzhung dang bkras lhun bla brang dbar 'gal ba shugs chen byung / mthar 7paṇa chen dgu pa thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma rgya sog yul gyur phyogs g.yol du phebs dbo/sa byung ba dang / mi lo 15ring rgya sog yul du ya nga yid skyo dgos pa'i yul rgyar 'tsho bas thugs bsrun te/rang yul kha ba gangs ljongs kyi gdan sa bkra shis lhun por chibs kha bsgyur ba'i 311

7paṇa chen ser te ni jig 'duga'adun pa 'gog med du 'khrungs te/ phyi lo 1938 lor/ khams skye rgu mdor zhabs sor 'khod kyang / skye rgu mdo nas gzhung bla'i don rkyen gtsang sel ma thub pas bod la phebs ma thub par dgongs pa rdzogs/phyi lo 1951 zla 12 tshes 1 nyin/ bkras lhun bla brang dza sag ci 'jigs med dang / rgya nag gzhung gi nub byang dmag srid cud kyi bod skyod dmag dpon phen ming rnam gnyis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bod du phebs rgyur gra sgrig dang /gzhung bla'i don rkyen gtsang sel ched lha ldan rgyal khab tu 'byor/ bod gzhung gis dmag dpon krang go har phebs bsu zhus pa bzhin/ phen ming dang ci 'jigs med zung la dgos pa'i re 'dun bton yod/ phan ming la krang cingawu dang krang go has phebs bsu zhus yod mod/ bod gzhung gis ci 'jigs med la phebs bsu lta ci/ci 'jigs med ni dza sag cig kyang min pas/ khong gis sne khrid byas pa'i 7paṇa chen bzhugs sgar bod skyod las don u yon lhan khang lha sa grong khyer nang gtong rgyu min pa bshad/1der brten/ ci 'jigs med kyis kyang rta dmag ru bsgrigs kyis/ lha sa'i bar skor la rngam ston khrom skor thengs shig byas te/ rgya chas spras te bka' shag nang bcar te/ sku ngo sa dbang rnam pa/ da cha gang 'dra gnang rtsis yod dam zhes 'dri rtsad btang skad/ri gzhung bla'i las sne ba 'gas sgor nad gzhung don steng drangs te/bla brang rgya mis bed spyod 'og shor ba dang / gzhung zhabs 'gas bla brang la gnas dus tshod rtsis kyis/ lugs mthun min pa'i sdug thang btang yod kyang / bkras bla'i dza sag ci 'jigs med kyis bod kyi lugs srol las brgal te/ rgya chas spras te bka' shag lhan rgyas sar bcar ba de ni/ gung khran tang gi rta rgyab tu bzhon te/16 cha bdams bsgrigs 'donathengs 15thog582nang /dbod bzhugs bkras lhu na grwa zur zhib la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshig tho/ཿgong tshes nyen/312

skru che'i bar gyi cha/bod gzhung la lo rgyus kyi 'khon lan slog gin yod pa'i dogs pa zhig sa dbang rnams par byung 'dug la/ phyis su dogs pa de yang gnad du 'khel 'dug pas/gzhung bla'i 'gal zla dang 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gnas bab la gnod skyon shugs chen thebs 'dug rnam rtog dgra ru langs na/ /khang stong kun ma sdang / /zhes pa ltar/7paṇa chen bcu pas kyang bod gzhung la lo rgyus kyi zhe 'khon slog nges pa'i bsam nor zhig sku ngo sa dbang rnams la byung stabs/ phyi lo 1952 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mdo smad sku 'bum nas stod dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du chibs sgyur gnang skabs/ bla brang zhabs 'bring 'gas brgyud skul gang yin shod dka' yang /rgya nag gzhung gi bod stod sku tshab krang cing wu yis bka' rgya dang h+phan ming gis gdug rtsub drag spyod la ngo bsu ched/ bka' blon dang / gdan sa'i mkhan bla/mi drag 'ga' mngags nas rnam pa tsam gyi phebs bsur bcar 'dug7paṇa chen rin po che lha sar chibs sgyur skabs/ thog mar ma'o dang /kru'u te gnyis kyi 'dra par chen po gnyis 'khyer yong ba der/ phebs bsur bcar ba'i mi mang mi dga' ba chen po byung ste/ lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen rin po che lha sar phebs pa bzhin/ dga' dad spro gsum gyi sgo nas che mthong gus bkur zhu mkhan med tshod du snang la/ da dung chibs sgyur gnang mkhan 7paṇa chen red mi 'dugama'o red 'dug ces mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur dang skad 'bod brgyab 'dug3mi mang gi khrod mgon po tshe brtan ni rgya mis rgya nag tu ched du 7paṇa chen rdzun bzo byas pa zhig red/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen dgu pa'i yang srid ngo ma ni bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs chen sprul skur ngos 'dzin zhus pa'i li thang rdo rje btsan rgol rgyal skyobs/deb dang po/shog12༷nang /tsong kha lha mo tshe ring a skyes rma chen bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug khang /313

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugatshe ring yin pa'i gleng phyogs ched du bzos te/ mgon po tshe brtan la rgya phrug dang /rgya bla ma zhes pa'i mtshan smad zhus/pha spun dgra ru langs kyang / /rus pa gser gyi dpe ltar/ sngon gyi las dbang btsan po'i mthu las/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po mchog gis phyi tshul rgya mi'i spu ded phyogs tsam las/ ser po gser dang 'dra ba'i mgul snying de/ 7gong sa mchog dang bod mi dmangs kyi phyogs su g.yo ba las/gzhung bla'i 'gal zlar sbrid nas bsam sbyor ngan pa'i mdzad log gnang rtsis shig gzim pa'i mnal lam tshun du 'khor myong med pa ni/ phyi lo 1953 zla 1 tshes 5nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ 7gong sa bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog la phul ba'i phyag 'phrin sbug dam nang /༄7/ /lha mi'i rnam 'dren 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog gi zhabs khri'i drung du/ nang ma spros med kyi zhu 'bras/ nang ma'i phyag sam lhug po bstsal 'byor la bka' drin che zhu dang 'brel/ phebs dgongs zab mo rnams la snying la mi brjed pa'i gzungs gi ri mor bris chog pa snyigs lnga'i rang mdangs che bdor/ bar lam bod ljongs chos kyi zhing 'dir bstan srid mi spyi'i bde skyid bcas la nyams chag 'thus shor rim song shin tu thugs dag pa'i rang bzhin yang / de dag la tshul bstan thugs skyo dub kyi rnam pa spangs te zhabs pad bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor yun brling ngos bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas yun gnas dang / chab srid mi spyi'i dge mtshan 'phel rgyas sogs don ldan lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las bzang po khyab gdal du skyong ba'i thugs bskyed kyi go cha bla lhag tu bskyed pa'i bka' drin skyong bar zhu zhes gsol ba 'debs rgyu dang /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal pos/ bstan pa kho na lhar bcas 'gro ba yi/ /bde legs 314

ci 'i tshe'i bar gyi cha/kun gyi rtsa ba yid ches nas/ /lus srog yal bar gyur kyang mi gtong ba'i/ /snying stobs chen pos dam chos 'dzin gyur cig/ gsungs pa ltar/ rang ngos nas kyang tshul der gcig las gnyis su med pa'i phyar ba gru bzhi'i ram 'degs zhu 'os shes nus gang thon dam don zhu rgyur/ji phebs gzhung bla'i zhabs 'bring bsam pa dge dang mi dge sna tshogs yong nges kyi rmongs zhen ngan dbang du song tshe sngar phan kyang / yab sras gzhung bla'i dbar dam sel bod ljongs bstan 'gro'i bde don la nyams mas che gyur/slad kyang de rigs mi byung nges med kyi rang bzhin dal rten 'di nas rang zhabs rnams la stangs 'dzin mi 'chol ba'i bslab bya khyab 'doms thugs nan nges zhu chog par/gtso cher 7gong sa mchog nyid nas spyi sgos bstan 'gro chab srid kyi bde don gang ci mi nyams gong 'phel nyams pa sor chud kyi dgongs bzhed skyabs 'jug gi stangs 'dzin da mus zhar yang mi stod nges/ de kha'i zhabs 'bring rnams la bka' khyab zab 'doms yang yang yod pa ma zad/ lhag tu rnam mkhyen du ji mnga' ba bzhin gzhung bla'i dbar gyi don gnad mjug 'khrun thag ma chod pa'i 'phro can rigs tshang ma/ khungs 'brel drang po'i gzhung srong gi sgo nas 'phral 'khrun legs chod thugs rje che/ gzhung bla gnyis ku'i zhabs 'bring mi dmangs dang bcas pa dam gtsang rtsod med bod spyi'i bde don la rgyar rdog rtsa gcig sgril 'phyar ba gru 'dregs lam chags nges rang shugs kyi yong gnang drang zhur/de don bka' shag sogs la bka' khyab skyong 'os kyang thugs rje che ba ma zad/ lar nas phran rang gi chos srid byed sgo gang ci gegs med legs grub yong ba'i lugs gnyis kyi grogs rgyab re ltos zhu yul/ 7gong sa mchog nyid las 315

snyedaṇa chena'ar te gi zhi'agadugagazhan du ma mchis par gang ci'i blo 'char nang gnas zhu 'os rim zhu chog par thugs brtse'i 'ching ba mi stod pa'i skyabs 'jug dang / blang dor ston pa'i nang ma'i bka' slob kyang da mkho bzhin yang yang lhug mjal stsol ba bcas rnam mkhyen dngas shel me long du yud mnga' mkhyen/ mkhyen/ zhu 'degs dang bcas/bod chu sbrul phyi lo 1953 zla 1 tshes 5 nyin /dge bar phul/47paṇa chen bcu pas lo rabs 5༷ nang / 7gong sa mchog la phul ba'i phyag sam phal che ba'i nang / yab sras gzhung bla'i 'gal ba dam gtsang slad/7gong sa mchog gi bka' shag la do dam bka' nan gang zab gnang skyong dang /'di nas nang sgang gi zhabs 'bring tshor kho bo bdag gis bka' rgya gzab nan zhus chog pa/ zhes 'khod pa'i phyag sam mang dag cig mjal rgyu 'dug par bsam tshe/7paṇa chen bcu pa'i dgongs par da cha lo rgyus kyis bzos pa'i gzhung bla'i zhe 'khon yar lung gtsang por bskyur nas/ bod bstan srid bde thabs slad/ gzhu nga bla gcig sgril gyis gung rgol gra sgrig gnang rgyu'i dgongs pa brtan po zhig yod pa rtogs thub/7gong sa mchog gis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku mya ngan las 'das te/ mi lo 10 dang 20 'khor ba'i rjes dran tshogs 'du so sor/ phyi lo 1959 lo'i sa phag cho 'phrul smon lam skabs/ ngos rang grwa skor dam bca' 'jog rgyu yin par brten/7paṇa chen rin po che nas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i smon lam mdzad chen thog 'tshams 'dri zhu ba gnang yod/ sku tshab tu de dus sngon ma mgron gnyer dang / rjes su drung yig che mo yin pa gcung lags ched mngags gnang ba'i mdun/ 7paṇa chen rin 47paṇa chenasku phreng bcu pa 'i chab sogagasum 'bum gabakras lhun pa ra ma/316

skya tshe'i bar gyi cha/po ches rnam kun ltar shog bu'i thog min par phyag sam zhig bskur ba gnang 'dugaphyag sam de'i nang gnas tshul rtsa ba nas yag po mi 'dug da cha gzhung bla gnyis rdog rtsa chig sgril gyi thog nas shugs rgyag rgyu ha cang gal chen po 'dug pas/ zhib phra'i byed phyogs gang 'dra yod bka' slob gnang rogs zhes 'khod/drung yig chen mo gcung lags kyis ngag thog nas/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i 'khrungs yul mdo smad phyogs nas sku nye de 'dra slebs te/ khong tshos 7paṇa chen rin po che'i 'khrungs yul gyis mtshon/ mdo stod smad khul la rgya mis gdug tsub dang mnar gcod gang 'dra gtong gi yod pa rnams/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i snyan la gsal po slebs par brten/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches nga tsho rdog rtsa chig sgril thog nas nus pa shugs che zhig 'don dgos pa'i dgongs pa yod pa/gcung lags kyis 'grel bshad mang po zhig bskyon byung / de dus nga tsho bros byol 'gro rgyu'i bsam blo nam yang med/grwa skor dam bca' zin rjes/ gnas tshul nyin re bzhin dza drag che ru 'gro yi yod kyang / bsam blo'i nang 'char gzhi gang yang med/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag sam nang nang bsdur gyis gra sgrig byed dgos pa 'khod 'dug kyang /skabs der sngon la le gang 'grigs dang snying 'jags yong thabs bya rgyu las/de min gyi 'char gzhi gang yang med pa dang / gnyis nas gnas tshul dza drag chen po chags pa'i gnas stangs 'og bka' lan yang spyi 'gre zhig ma gtogs 'bul rgyu ma byung gsungs/57paṇa chen bcu pa chen po gung khran tang gi rogs skyor las/ 'khrul bral ngos 'dzin dang bod du phebs thub pa zhig yin stabs/ khong dang rgya nag 5shes bya/naX ༷ba zhanang /phyi dris/la sa khungs kyi par/ 317

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'dugagazhung dbar rang bzhin thugs 'brel yong rgyu brjod ma dgos kyang / rkyang lto ru shi yang kha byang btad kyi dpe ltar/ gang gi mgul snying brang gsum bcol yun nyag cig 7gong sa mchog gi dbu khrid pa'i bod gzhung las rgya nag gzhung min la/h+phan ming gi g.yo 'og tu tshud pa'i bla brang zhabs 'bring tshos/ bod gzhung la dus bstun 'khon lan 'jal ba dang / tha na/ bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po bod gzhung gi mnga' 'og tu 'dug mi dgos par/ gzhung bla srid dbang 'dra mnyam gyi bsam blo bcangs mkhan tsho la yang / bka' bkyon chen po phebs kyi yod 'dug thengs shig lha smon bsod nams lhun grub la/ khyod sogs nga'i gam du sdod mkhan tshos/kha gcig sgril gyis nga la mgo skor gtong gi 'dug ngos la yid ches med na ngos kyis bla brang gi 'gan ma khur yang tshog gsungs6/ /zhibod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam sa bsgrigs/〈7paṇa chen rjes dran/〉shog ngos 131nang /byi lo 1989bla phyin/ /318

skru che'i bar gyi cha/le tshan gnyis pa/ bod bstan srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa/phyi lo 1951 zla 5 tshes 23 nyin/ btsan bshed kyi 'og tu bzhag pa'i don tshan bcu bdun gyis/ bod mi mang gi bde sdug nam ring sgrung gis 'khyol thabs bral bas/ phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 10 nyin/ lha sa gling bzhi nas bod mi dmangs kyis rgya nag gzhung la rngam ston khrom skor byas/ rgya dmag gis pho brang po ta la dang / nor bu gling khar me skyogs drag char 'bab 'bab brgyab kyang /las dbang gi bkod sgrig cig gis 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang lha sa nas phyogs g.yol gyis/ lho kha sa khul gong dkar skyid gshongs ra smad dgon du bde 'byor thub yod mod/ gzhis rtse bkras lhun dgon na bzhugs pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ lha sa'i don rkyen dang 7gong sa mchog gi gnas stangs skabs thog tu mkhyen rtogs gang yang byung med/phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 19 nyin/ gong dkar skyid gshongs ra smad dgon nas rgya gar du phyogs g.yol gnang bzhin pa'i 7gong sa mchog gis/gzhis rtse bkras lhun dgon na bzhugs pa'i kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la/ lha ldan rgyal khab tu byung ba'i gnas tshul dang / slad kyi byed phyogs zhib gsal/ gang nyid phyogs g.yol du chibs sgyur gnang gi yod pas/ phebs thub na 7paṇa chen rin po che rgya gar la phebs rogs/7 gal srid phebs ma thub tshe ngo ba da kyi bde don skor grogs phan gang thub gnang skyong yong ba 7phyi yul du rang dbang /shogand nang / lha bi nga blo bzang dpal ldan gyis bsgyur/snyi li bod khang gis par/ 319

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhi' 'jugazhes/ sbug dam sbyar ma'i phyag bris shig thugs brel 'themab dang bcas bstsal/87gong sa mchog gis 7paṇa chen rin po cher bstsal ba'i phyag 'phrin de/ dza sag kun bde gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan brgyud/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la nges 'byor dgos pa'i bka' mngags gnang ba bzhin/ dza sag sku ngo kun bde gling gis sna dkar rtse rdzong sdod rtse drung 'od zer dpal 'bar (khong phyes su btsan byol nang 'byor nas rda sa bu khyim du bzhugs kyang / da lta 'tsho bzhugs med/)lags/bkra shis lhun por 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i sku mdun du/ 7rgyal ba'i bka' yig 'bul bar ched du brdzangs/ 'on kyang / bka' yig de kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i phyag tu son yod med da lta su la'ang shod rgyu med/phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 20 nyin dgung / gzhis ka rtser bca' stod/ krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi drung che gzhon pa hu'u ping dang / krang ting (7paṇa chen rin po che'i rgya yig dge rgan yin//gnyis kyis/ zla 3 tshes 10nyin gyi lha sa'i don rkyen tshang ma snyan seng zhus/ 7paṇa chen rin po che thugs hang sangs pa'i ngang hu'u ping la/ 7gong sa mchog gang du yod med dang /khong la dgongs tshul ci yod bka' 'dri gnang yang / hu'i ping gis las don u yon lhan khang gi tar 'phrin nang gsal bzhin/ 7gong sa mchog ngo log zing 'khrug pas btsan khrid byas nas/ da lta gang du yod med da dung gsal po shes kyi mi 'dug phal cher lho kha'i phyogs su phebs yod pa 'dra zhes pa las /7gong sa mchog gi gnas stangs dngos gang yang shes kyi med/7gong sa mchog gi sku phywa'i gnas stangs la bkras lhun dgon par bzhugs pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po che thugs 'tshab chen pos thugs sems rbad na ga gsun tshogs bkra shis kyi mi ma'i lo rgyus/ bod kyi dpesadzod khang /phyi lo 1995lor/320

skya che'i bar gyi cha/de 'tshol te/ gar yod mi shes/ zhes pa'i bka' mol chig lab skyon bzhin/ngo log zing 'khrug pas 7gong sa mchog lkog bkrongs byed srid dam/ kho chos 7gong sa mchog sa gnas ga 'dra zhig la 'khrid rtsis yod dam/ lho kha khul yin nam phyi rgyal la 'gro rtsis red/ gal srid phyi rgyal yin na rgya gar nang yin nam/yang na/ a mi ri ka yin/ krung dbyang nas de'i skor ga re bshad 'dug ces hu'u ping la bka' rtsad gnang yang / hu'u ping la gnad don de skor kha gsal shod rgyu med stabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che de bas thugs 'tshab che bzhes kyis/7gong sa mchog gang myur bde thang ngang lha sar phyir phebs thub pa/sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes gdung shugs drag po'i thugs smon thengs mang gnang zhing / rgya yig drung yig hu'u peng cing gi lag pa nas 'jus te/ drung che lags/ 7gong sa mchog gi gnas tshul ga re yod na'ang /nga la lam seng snyan seng dgos pa'i bka' stsal/9 da dung 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang pos gtsos bod kyi bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen rnams zhabs pad yun du brtan pa dang / bod bstan srid kyi gegs bar zhi ba'i ched/ rin chen gnyis pa las grub pa'i gser zangs kyi tshe lha rnam gsum dang sgrol ma stong tsho gsar bzhengs mdzad/phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 28 nyin/ srid blon kro'u in lan gyis/bod sa gnas srid gzhung med par bzo rgyu dang / de'i tshab tu bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'khur rgyu/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'dzin 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho btsan khrid byas pa'i ring / gtso 'dzin gzhon pa 7paṇa chen rin po ches 'gan 'dzin las tshab gnang dgos pa'i btsan bka' phab/9slob dpo na chenapo 4paṇa chen rinapo tshe/'jam dpa la rgya mtshos brtsam sa/bdesang yis zhib khang /phyi lo1998lor/321

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'jugaphyi lo 1910 lor/ 7gong sa bcu gsum pa rgya gare du phyogs phebs skabs/ len yus kyis 7gong sa go gnas phab tshul bshad de/ 7paṇa chen dgu pa 7gong sa mchog gi go gnas su bzhugs dgos pa'i lkog g.yo bshams te/7rgyal ba yab sras dang bod nang khul kha bral gtong ba'i sems ngan bcangs kyang / 7paṇa chen dgu pas lan yus la/ gong gsal byed stangs de tsho rgya bod dang / bod dbus gtsang nang khul bar 'gal zla bzo ba'i bya spyod yin pas/'phral du mtshams 'jogs byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan tha tshig nan po sgrog pa gnang ba'i phyag bris ngo ma khag gnyis/ da lta bod rang skyong ljongs kyi yig tshags nang yod/10 ces gsungs /phyi lo 1910 dang / phyi lo 1959 gnyis kyi mi 'dra ba ni/ phyi lo 1910lor/ lan yus kyis 7gong sa bcu gsum pa'i go gnas gnas dbyung btang zhes dang / phyi lo 1959 lor/ kra'u e lan gyis 7gong sa bcu bzhi pa go gnas rang 'jags zhes pa de yin pas/ 7gong sa mchog gi sku dbang mtshan lar gnod skyon 'gro gi med stabs/ kra'u e lan gyi blang bya dang len gnang /phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 30 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches bod mi dmangs la yig thog bka' slob bstsal ba'i nang / ngo log 'khrug zing slong mkhan log spyod pa tshos/ 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma btsan khrid byas pa de la/ngas gdung sems mnyam skyed dang sems khur chen po byed kyi yod/ ngo log 'khrug zing slong mkhan tshos bkag sdom byed pa'i 'og nas/ khong mgyogs myur thar thub pa'i re 'dun byed kyi yod/ khong btsan khrid byed pa'i ring ngos la bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren u yon gyi las tshab pa'i las don byed dgos pa bka' dang len zhu rgyu yin pa gsungs/10dung dkar gsung 'bum/ca/thog ngos 5༷nang /mi rigs dpe spu na khang /byi lo da004lo ra/322

skya che 'i bar gyi cha/7paṇa chen bcu pas kru'u ren las tshab kyi go gnas kyi steng nas/ bod 'bangs sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i gdung 'bod/ ming du grags pa'i (yig 'bru khri bdun )gyi brtag dpyad snyan zhu rtsom 'bri gnang ba'i go skabs byung /(kha che pha lu'i bslab bya )las/ dgra bo 'phral gang 'phral du 'dul 'dod na/ /skabs thog grogs la bkug nas sdod pa bzang / /thabs kyi sgo nas don rtsa len zer na/ /mda' gri mdung gsum 'phyar rgyu smyon pa'i las/gsungs pa ltar/ phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 29 nyin/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis spel ba'i bka' rgya bzhin/ zla 4 tshes 5 nyin gzhis rtse nas lha ldan phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'dzin las tshab gnang / lo de'i zla 4 ches 14 nyin/ skabs gnyis pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang po'i gros tshogs su phebs shing / kra'u e les krung nan ter phebs bsu'i ston mo bshams/ phyi lo 1959 zla 4 tshes 15 nyin/ mtho kru'u zhis rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi ches mtho'i tshogs chen thengs bcu drug pa bskongs te/ bod kyi gnad don skor la gros bsdur zhib tshags byas/ skabs gnyis rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang po'i steng / 7gong sa mchog rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi tshogs gzhon dang /bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi gtso 'dzin gyi goganas rang 'jags/ 7paṇa chen rin po che rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang sku gzhon du bsko gzhag byas/skabs gnyis pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang po de/ chol gsum bod mis rgyal sa lha sar rgya dmar gzhung la ngo 323

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhis 'jugargol sger langs byas shing / bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid 7gong sa mchog rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du phyogs g.yol legs par grub ste/ bod kyi gnad don rgyal spyi'i gleng phyogs gtso bor gyur pa dang stabs 'khel yod pas/tshogs thog nas bod kyi gnad don la gleng slong yong rgyu brjod mi dgos pa'i gleng gzhi zhig red/rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid blon kra'u e len gyis/ bod kyi ngo log zing 'khrug tshar gcod dang / dmangs gtso bcos sgyur legs grub byung ba'i srid gzhung snyan sgron rjes/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches drag po'i ngo log zing 'khrug slong mkhan la rgol gtam gsung bshad gnang ba dang sbrags/ chabs cig tu lhag bsam rnam dag gis 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog log spyod pa'i mtha' skor las grol te mes rgyal du phebs nas/ thun mong thog dmangs gtso rang dbang dang /phyug po/ bde skyid bcas ldan pa'i bod gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i re ba yod pa'i gtam gshad gnang /tshogs chen grub ste bod du chibs kha bsgyur nas yun ring ma song bar/slang yang rgyal khab btsugs nas lo bcu 'khor ba'i dus ston ched/ phyi lo 1959zla 9 tshes 25 nyin/ pe cing du phebs dgos pa'i mgron brda 'byor ba bzhin/zla 10 tshes 14 nyin rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi rgyun las lhan khang gi gros tshogs thengs bcu pa'i thog bod kyi las don skor snyan sgron gnang /phyi lo 1959 zla 10 tshes 21 nyin/ rgyal yongs mi dmangs chab srid gros mol lhan khang dang / pe cing grong khyer u yon lhan khang gnyis kyi thun mong thog bskong 'tshog byas pa'i tshogs chen la gdan zhus bzhin phebs/ tshogs 324

kyi che'i bar gyi cha/thog nas bod kyi gnas tshul ngo sprod gsung bshad gnang /4rdo ci sa sku cim / sdu ri 4 shā sna thorjorte ca ri 49skyesdu ru ri ci ri cigaX chi/ smra sna dro ri mu rici rtse ri///marterno zhe da/jizhes sdo nga//////khyi pe ༷༷ cho ——— — — 24 skel /nga ri ma ————— — —— chozing ——4 tho rnya ri rino nasaX — — (7pa ṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang / ma'o kru'u zhi/)phyi lo 1959 zla 10 tshes 22 nyin/ ma'o kru zhis 7paṇa chen rin po che dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ 'phags pa lha gsum mjal 'phrad gnang ste/ bod kyi dmangs gtso bcos sgyur dang / chos lugs bcos sgyur/dpal 'byor dang rig gnas 'dzugs skrun gyi gnad don skor la mdzub ston byed skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches ngo log zing 'khrug nod 'jags dang /dmangs gtso bcos sgyur legs sgrub yong ba rgyab skyor dang hur brtson zhu rgyu yin/'on kyang / gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun gyi dgongs don bzhin/ bod kyi gnas bab thag gcod yong ba dang / lhag par bcos sgyur skabs drag po mi thon pa gtso don yong ba'i re 'dun zhus/phyi lo 1958 yi dpyid ka 7paṇa chen rin po che'i yab dang / a mdo dang khams kyi 'jam dmag 'brel ba yod pa ma zad/ a mtsho 'jam dmag shog khag cig lho kha gri gur brten gzhis byas pa'i chu bzhi sgang drug bstan srung nga nga ma la sgril btang ba rgya mis shes kyi 'dug la/11 gnas tshul der 11ngag rgyun lo rgyus deb naX pa /shog ngos 155 nang /bar zhi rje drung ngag dbang bsun skyong khi brtsams/bod kyi dpe mdzod khang /phyi lo naX15/
