7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jug7paṇa chen rin po ches rgyab skyor gnang ba yang rgya mis shes kyi 'dug/2der brten/ rgya nag gzhung gis 7paṇa chen rin po che'i yab kyis/chu bzhi sgang drug bstan srung dang dmag la me mda' dang / go mtshon mthun sbyor zhus pa'i dogs pa byed kyi yod kyang / skabs der 7paṇa chen rin po ce bod la bzhugs yod pas lag pa 'chang thub mi 'dug phyi lo 1959 lor/7paṇa chen rin po ce pe cing du chibs sgyur ring / gzhis ka rtse bzhugs pa'i khong gi yab yum gnyis kyi gzim khang bsngogs bsher byas te/ khong gnyis zhing bran bdag po che shos yin par bshad de 'thab rtsod phul brten/ phyi lo 1960 lor/yab yum sku 'khor nyen 'gan de las g.yol ched phyir lha sar gnas spos zhus/bcos sgyur med na yar rgyas med ces pa ltar/ bod rnying pa'i lam lugs la bcos skyur dgos pa ni dngos yod kyi gnas stangs shig yin stabs/rgya nag gzhung gis bod la dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur gtong rgyu shod skabs/7paṇa chen rin po ches mos 'dun gnang zhing / gzhis ka rtse sa khul dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byed pa'i tshod lta'i dpe mtshon du bdams yod/ 'on kyang /kha dan tshig la mi gnas pa'i gung khran tang gi dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur ni/bod kyi rig gnas dang bcas pa rtsa med gtong ba'i lkog jus kyi rang mtshang mngon/phyi lo 1960 zla 3 tshes 18 nyin/ gzhis rtser kron hru'u yi li'u kron yon gyis/ bkras lhun dgon par dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur las don ru khag ched 'byor gyis mtho rim mi snar mnar gcod gtong ba'i 'go tshugs/skabs der bkra shis lhun po'i tshogs chen dbu mdzad gral rim mnga' bdag medamadzad rnam rgyal chen snying rje'i rol mtsho/phyi lo 1959bla 9 tshes nanyin/7gong sa mchog dang na rusajal 'phrad skabs kyi bka' 'dri bka' la na326

skya che'i bar gyi cha/yin par bsnyad nas/ sdug sbyong tshad med gtong skabs/ rgya dmar gyi las byed phyis su bod rang skyong ljongs kyi kru'u ren bu chung gis/ khong gi spyan la rdog rgyag gzhus rkyen spyan ya ga cig long ba bzos13 phyi lo 1960 lo'i lo mjug tu 7paṇa chen rin po che lha sa nas gzhis ka rtser chibs kha bsgyur/ bcos sgyur byed lugs de nor 'khrul gyi srid jus yin pa'i skyon brjod chen po gnang ba dang / gdan sa bkras lhun dgon pa'i dmangs gtso bdag gnyer gyi kru'u ren mig dmar las gnas phab ste/ chos 'byor khang gsar dmangs gtso bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang gi kun ren dang /tā bla ma ngag dbang sbyin pa kru'u ren gzhon pa/ nor brang nor srid la bsko gzhag gnang /rgya nag gzhung gis kyang bcos bsgyur gyi srid jus 'di/ nor 'khrul yin pa khas len ma zhus thabs med du gyur te/ lo de'i lo mjug nas dgon pas dgon pa bzo ba'i srid jus mdzub khrid gnang ste/ chos byed rkang 'dzin gyi dge 'dun pa phud pa'i lhag 'phros rnams/ shing bzo dang / lcags bzo/ tshem bzo/'brog ra/ zhing las thon skyed kyi las grwa /snar thang dang / gzhis rtse'i nye 'gram gdong dkar du gas ra slog brgyab//gsar 'dzugs rgya bskyed gnang //4phyi lo 1959 dgun kha 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po pe cing du chibs sgyur skabs/ ma'o kru'u zhir/ bod du dgon pa kha shas lhag yod pa tsho'i nang dge 'dun pa 'ga' shas yod kyang chos 'chad nyan med la/ tshogs kyang mang po tsho sa thub kyi mi 'dug de ltar byas na rtsa ba nas 'grigs kyi mi 'dug pas/1 rgya dmar gyis bod nang mi spyod las 'das pa'i bya ngan ji byas dngos byung gnas lugs rags bsdu sa gsal bar mthong ba'i me long /phyi lo 1959nas 1984bod gzhung shes rig dpar lang /14gzhis kyi gdanas bkra shis tsun po 'i grwa zur zhig la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/gong tshes nyin/327

7paṇa chen ser te gi zhib 'dul chos kyi las ka byed mkhan khag cig la/ rgyal khab nas 'tsho ba'i 'gro gron gnang dgos pa dang gso skyong byed dgos kyi 'dug de min gzhan rnams ngal rtsol byas te rang kha rang gso byas na'ang 'grigs kyi red/ dge 'dun pa yong rdzogs ngal rtsol byas te rang kha rang gso byed dgos byung tshe chos kyi slob sbyong rtsa ba nas yong thabs yod pa ma red ces zhus/ma'o kru'u zhi sku ngo mas chog mchan 'og phyi lo 1959 gong bod la dge 'dun pa khri bcu gnyis yod pa nas/ dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byas rjes grwa pa khri gnyis lhag pa'i khrod nas/ stong phrag lnga la rgyal khab nas phogs sprod rgyu dang /chig khri lnga stong rang kha rang gso gnang rgyu byas/ phyi lo 1960 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bod la phebs skabs/ dpe cha gzigs 'dod yod mkhan tshor/gnas chung du chos lugs rigs gcig rkang 'dzin pa'i 'dzin grwa lnga gsar du btsugs gnang /stabs ma legs pa zhig la phyi lo 1963 lo nas srid jus rbad de 'khru log ste gzhis rtse khul gyi chos lugs mi sna dang / hur brtson pa re 'gas bkras lhun dgon pa'i nang / dmigs bsal srid dbang bskyar gso byas tshul dang /tang la nye bar bsten pa'i grwa pa hur brtson can rnams mgo bo btegs mi thub pa'i rdung rdeg phog tshul bshad pa dang / gdan sa se ra dang 'bras spungs kyi dmangs bdag kru'u ren gyis der rgyab skyor byas te/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches 'char 'god gnang ba'i las gzhi dag med pa bzos/ phyi lo 1958 lor/'phrul 'khor slob grwa nas hrag sgrug brgyab ste gsog nyar byas pa'i las byed rnams dang / bla brang las byed rnams 7paṇa chen ru tshogs kyi byed gte'i nyes ming 'og gzhis rtse'i mi mang bskongs nas 'thab 'dzing byas/ /1515gzhis kyi gdan sa bkra thi/sa thi na po'i grwa zur zhig la bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshig tho/gong tshes nyin/328

kyi che'i bar gyi cha/le tshan gsum pa/ gung khran tang la bugs blo log pa/phyi lo 1960 dang 1962 so sor/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis u yon krang sku gzhon dang / bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kun ren las tshab kyi mtshan gnas nas/bod ljongs dang / mtsho sngon/ zi khron/ kun su'u/ yun nan dang bcas pa'i bod khul du/ mang gtso'i bcos sgyur dang ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang ba'i las don la rtog zhib ched chibs kha bsgyur/ma'o kru'u zhi'i zhal las chos lugs dad mos yin pa'i 'bod sgra bsgrags kyang / lag len ngo ma'i nang bod kyi nang bstan dgon pa tshang ma rtsa med bzos shing / grwa btsun skya sar phab ste chos lugs kyi bya ba sgrub mi chog pa/sa gnas kyi 'go khrid tshos kha yag ngo dga'i las sdom snyan sgron zhe cig las/bod mi dmangs kyi dngos yod dka' ngal dbus gzhung la mi zhu ba/hol rgyugs kyi zing 'khrug zhod 'jags dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur zer ba'i las 'gul khrod/ bod mi rigs kyi brgya cha 99 la ngo log zing 'khrug pa zhes/ ma nyes kha g.yogs kyi nyes pa 'dra min g.yogs te/ srog thog dang /dung rdeg btson 'jug/ 'dzin bzung byed pa'i bya spyod ngan thal du phyin pas/bod mi mang po zhig mug shi dang / btsan shi/ sdug shi la song / 329

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing 'jugadamangs gtso'i bcos sgyur zhes/ gzhung sger chos gsum gyi rgyu nor yongs rdzogs rgya nag gzhung gis gzhung bzhes btang zhing / zhing 'brog thon skyed yong 'bab la/ rgyal gces spyi 'bru dang / 'bru lhag spus tshong / spyi dmangs gsog 'jog bsdu 'bab zer ba sogs ming 'dra min btags te khralarigs chen po btsan bsdu byas pas/ bod mi mang gi 'tsho ba'i thog bzod dka' ba'i dka' ngal sprad pas/ lto chas za sa'i phor pa tsam yang 'don rgyu med/phyi lo 1962 lor/ 7paṇa rin po che mtsho sngon dang / zin khron/ shing cang / kun su'u bod rigs sa khul du gzigs zhib tu phebs/ mtsho sngon gyi sa khag 'ga' shas nang la spyi ba'i za khang med pa bzos rjes/ mi ser kha shas ja phor tsam yang med pa'i gnas su gyur 'dug gnas tshul de dag 7paṇa chen rin po ches gzigs rjes sku rlung bzhengs shing ha cang thugs 'tshab chen po bzhes nas/khong sku sger gyis 'gro gron gnang ste ja phor nyos nas mi mang la gnang /bod mi mang gis 'gro ba mi'i rigs gekyis bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin yod pa 7paṇa chen rin po ches mkhyen rjes/ pe cing nas ma'o kru'u zhi dang kra'u e lan gyis bod mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu/zhes bu ram las mngar ba'i gtam bshad spel kyang / don dngos bya ba'i steng /bod mi rigs kyi skad yig dang / mi rigs kyi las byed pa gso skyong bya rgyu sogs/mi rigs kyi khe dbang yod tshad rtsis med rdog rol btang ba mkhyen rjes/tshogs 'du'i skabs lcog steng phyag brdab nas sa gnas dpon rigs tshor sngon chad mang tshogs kyis bla mar sku 'gyed 'bul srol yod pa las/ bla mas mang tshogs la ja phor nyo dgos pa thos myong tsam yang med/spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang lto slong ba'i sprang po zhig gi lag tu'ang phor 330

kyi che'i ber gyi cha/zhig yod pa red/ cang ce'i hre dang / mā pu'u h+phang gis mtsho sngon dbang bsgyur byas ring / bod mi dmangs la ja phor tsam yang med pa'i tshad la slebs med/da cha gung khran tang gi 'og tu bod mi dmangs gi 'tsho ba'i thad ja phor tsam med pa'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin yod ces/bod mi dmangs kyis 'gro ba mis bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal myong tshul ji bzhin 'khod pa'i brtag dpyad snyan zhu zhig rgya nag dbus gzhung la phul/16 phyis su snyan zhu'i zhu tshig der spyi tshogs gsar par ngo rgol dang /cang ce'i hri dang / ma pu'u h+phang jag tshogs la bstod bsngags byas pa'i nyes ming bkal 'dugamador na/ phyi lo 1958 nas 1962 bar gyi mi lo bzhi yi ring /bod nang dgon pa 6000lhag yod pa'i khrod nas brgya cha 97 la gtor skyon btang zin pa dang / bla sprul sngags 'chang sogs chos byed mi drug 'bum nas chig 'bum chig khri tsam la nyes ming sna tshogs btags te 'thab 'dzing dang / sdug sbyong tshad med btang ste skya phab dang / dmar gsod btang ba dang / bod mi 92000 rkyen 'das su song 'dug/7phyi lo 1960 zla 9 nang rgyal khab btsugs nas lo ngo 11 'khor ba'i dga' ston la pe cing nas gdan zhu bzhin chibs kha bsgyur/ srid blon kra'u e lan dang 'thab phyogs gcig sgyur gyi blon chen li we han gnyis la/ bod mi dmangs kyis sdug bsngal ji ltar myong gi yod pa'i dgongs 'char zhus par/ khong gnyis kyis 7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs 'char la mthong chen byas 'dug15slo ba dpon chen po lapa ṇa chen rin po che/'jayodapa' sumatshos brtsams/bde sru nga nyams zhib khang phyi ngo 1998lo ra/me bod du lag bsta ra byas pa 'i rgya dmar gyi srid jus /gyi dril/shog45phyi lo naXnapor/331

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing 'jugargyal ston dus chen tshar ba dang / krung dbyang gis li we han dang /khrin hru'u thung / wang h+phin bcas kyi phebs rogs 'og 7paṇa chen rin po che rgya nag lto phyogs sa khul du ngal gso dang / gzigs skor la phebs rgyu/ dus mtshungs lha'i tshogs 'du zer ba chung gras tshogs rgyu dang / skyid snang bag yangs kyi yul skor spro 'cham zhig byed rgyu'i thag bcad/ mi 'ga' shas kyis khong tsho ni rgyal yongs su 'grul skor byed par phebs thon gnang ba red ces bshad//87paṇa chen rin po ches li we han dang wang zhin gnyis la/ mang tshogs kyis 'thab phyogs gcig gyur ni grogs por gsol ston bsham rgyu de red ces bshad kyi yod/ ngos la khyed tshos gsol ston bsham mi dgos la/ yul skor spro 'cham la'ang phebs rogs byed mi dgos/ ngos la blo bde bag phebs kyi bsam blo de rigs med/ khyed rang tshos yid gzab chen po'i sgo nas lo 'ga' shas ring gi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur dang / mi rigs kyi las don skor la zhib bsher byed rgyu'i re ba yod/gtso 'dzin ma'o tse tung gis gung khran tang gis gzab nan zhes pa gal chen po 'dzin gyi yod ces gsungs yod pa ltar/ khyed chos gzab nan ngang nga'i bsam 'char 'di dag bdag ces gnang ba'i re ba yod la/ gzab nan ngang bod kyi gnad don skor thag gcod byed rgyu'i re ba'ang yod ces gsungs//9li we han gyis nga'i ming 'di legs po zhig mi 'dug wi han zer ba'i go don ni rgya mi'i khe phan srung skyob byed rgyu lta bu zhig go gi yod rung / don dngos thog ngas spun zla'i mi rigs la sems 'khur chen po byed kyi yod/ ngas tang gi srid jus ltar nan tan gyis spun zla'i mi rigs kyi mi dmas kyi khe phan la srung 18slob dngo na chen mo 7paṇa chen rin po cho/zhog ngos smo na'ajam dpal rtsa mtsho/bde srung bod gnas nyams zhib/pyi lo 1997lor/19slob dbon chen mo 7pa ṇa chen rinapo che/zhog ngos 1 na'ajam dpal skyo mtsho/bde srung bod gnas nyams zhib/phyi lo 1997lo ra/332

skya che'i bar gyi cha/skyob byed bzhin yod ces zhus/khong rnams pe cing nas khren tu'u dang / khrung chin/ wu'u han/ lu'u hran sogs la bskyod cing / lu'u hran gyi gzigs skor grub rjes/ kre cang dang /cang su'u/ h+phu can sogs phebs zhing mthar hrang he la phebs/ skabs de dag tu li we han dang 7paṇa chen rin po che rnams gnyis bod don skor la zhal ta thengs mang gnang zhing / 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ rang nyid kyis zhus pa'i bsam 'char de dag snying nad gsang phyir min la/ rang nyid la ma nyes khag g.yog byung ba'i bston btsugs byas pa zhig de bas min/ de dag tshang ma bod mi dmangs kyi khe phan dang / bod yar bskyed dang 'phel rgyas/ nang bstan dar rgyas bcas kyi ched du yin zhes gsungs/hrang te ru gzigs skor gnang skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang li we han bod don skor la zhal ta thengs bcu gsum gnang ba rnams/yig thog tu zin bris bkod rjes li tso min gyis bod sgyur byas/ yig cha der (7paṇa chen dang li we han zhal ta gnang ba'i zin bris gnad bsdus//zhes pa'i ming btags te krung dbyang la phul zhing / krung dbyang gis yang cing ran bod du rtog zhib tu mngags/phyis su zin bris de yig 'bru khri bdun gyi ma zin lta bur gyur 'dugali we han dang 7paṇa chen rin po che sogs lto phyogs khul du yul skor gnang skabs/ dmag dpon krang go hwa bod nas pe cing 'byor zhing rgya nag dbus gzhung la bod don snyan seng zhus/ srid blon kra'u e lan gyis/krang go hwa yi snyan zhu gsan pa dang bod du dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur btang rjes sger la dbang ba'i lam lugs nyung mthar lo bzhi'i ring mi 'gyur rgyu dang / zhing bran rnams la thon skyed hur thag 'bad thag byed du 'jug rgyu dang /333

7paṇa chen ser te ni gis 'jugatshang mar blo bde bag phebs yong ba byed du 'jug rgyu/ de bzhin ngal rtsol gyi nus shugs srung skyob byed rgyu dang / thon skyed gong 'phel gtso bor gtong zhes pa'i mdzub ston byas/kra'u e lan gyis grang go har khyed kyis zhing bran dang / bcings 'grol thob pa'i mi la spyod bzang gi srid lugs lag len bstar dgos pa dang /mi sems brtan snying yong ba byed ched/ nyo sgrub nyung du btang ste ngal rtsol dang 'tsho ba'i gnad don skor bsam blo gtong dgos pa nan bshad byas/ kra'u e lan gyi mdzub ston de ni 7paṇa chen rin po ches dgongs 'char dang len gnang ba zhig red la/ krang go hwas bod kyi las don thog g.yon lhung nor 'khrul shor kyi yod pa gsal ston byas pa zhig kyang red/phyi lo 1961 zla 1 tshes 5 nyin/ yang cin ran sogs krung dbyang sku tshab kyis bod du rtog zhib byed sgo grub te/ phyir rgyal sa pe cing du 'byor ba dang spyi khyab drung che ting zha'o phing la snyan seng zhus/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis bod kyi las don skor gyi g.yon lhung srid jus ther 'don gnang bas/7paṇa chen rin po che dang / bod stod rgya gzhung dpon rigs krang cing hu'u dang krang go ha sogs kyi dbar 'gal ba shugs chen byung /ting zha'o phing gis/ bod sdod dmag dpon krang go hwa dang / krang cing hu'u/ yang cin ran sogs mtho rim mi sna dang tshogs 'du'i skabs/ 7paṇa chen dang las don mnyam sgrub byed skabs/ rig pa rtse gcig tu sgrim dgos pa las/phru gu chung chung zhig la ngos 'dzin byed mi rung / khong ni chab srid kyi rlung 'tshub khrod nas gso skyong byung ba zhig yin pas/ las don mnyam sgrub byed skabs thabs shes la brten dgos pa dang / mnyam las yod dgos la 'thab rtsod 334

skru che'i bar gyi cha/ kyang yod dgos pa'i ngan skul byas/20 ting gi skad cha de las rgya nag gzhung gis 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'dzin pa'i dogs zon dang / srid jus yang mngon rjen du mthong thub/phyi lo 1961 zla 1 tshes 23 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po che pe cing du zhabs sor 'khod pa dang / ma'o kru'u zhis krung nan te ru 7paṇa chen bcu pa dang /li'u hra'o ci/ kra'u e lan/ phran yun/ ting zha'o phing / li we han/ krang cing hu'u dang bcas pa tshogs 'dur bskongs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches bod mi dmangs la za 'bru sprod dgos pa dang / dngos 'brel chos dad rang mos dgos pa/ bod mi 'bor chen 'dzin bzung bya rgyu mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i re 'dun zhus/ rgya nag gi srid 'dzin ma'os khyed thugs khral gnang mi dgos/ dgongs 'char de dag nges par du dang len zhu gi yin/ da lta bod kyi g.yon lhung srid jus yo bsrang byed dgos pa bshad de/ g.yon lhung srid jus ji ltar yo bsrang byed pa'i don tshan drug kyang mdzub ston byas/21 g.yon lhung srid jus yo bsrang byed pa'i mdzub ston ni gsham gsal ltar red/dang po/ da lta'i skabs su rogs res tshogs tshung 'dzugs rgyu las mnyam las khang 'dzugs rgyu min/ zhing pa rnams snying 'jags yong ba byed dgos pa dang / 'tsho ba legs bcos gtong dgos/gnyis pa/ mtho rim mi sna sum stong lhag gi las don legs par bsgrub dgos pa dang / kho tshor thos 'tshams kyi las don bkod sgrig byed dgos/ gsum pa/ paṇa chen mchog gis bton pa'i las bral dge 'dun pa naXslob dpon chen mo 7pa ṇa chen rin po che/shog ngos 1 ldanang /'jam dpal zu mtsho/bde sru nga bod gnas nyams zhib khang /phyi lo 1997lo ra/21 44/zlo ji khukhu7 6khusko4 3tsā zlo shādzi 3 335

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhing 'thugakhag cig nyar dgos pa'i dgongs 'char la mos mthun zhu rgyu dang / mi stong phrag kha shas nang chos kyi shes yon thog gso skyong byed rgyur mos mthun byed rgyu/bzhi pa/ g.yas lhung la ngo rgol byed dus g.yon gyi nor 'khrul shor ba ni brjod mi dgos pa zhig red/ gzhis rtse sa khul du mang tshogs kha shas kyis paṇa chen rin po che'i yab yum dang / ci 'jigs med/ lha smon sogs kyi nang sngog bsher byas yod pas/ bya spyod de dag yag po ma red /lnga pa/ rang skyong ljongs ga dus 'dzugs min skor dang / tā la'i bla ma dgos dang mi dgos pa'i skor gyi gnad don 'di dag thad/ gnad don gtso bo ni 'dems bsko byed rgyu red/ thog mar rdzong dang grong sde rim pa'i mi dmangs srid gzhung de 'dems bsko'i lam nas 'dzugs rgyu dang / de'i rjes gzhi nas rang skyong ljongs kyi 'thus mi 'dems bsko byed rgyu yin/drug pa/ bod las don u yon lhan khang dang / paṇa chen rin po che bar gyi 'brel ba de sngon las dam pa byed dgos pa dang / las don u yon lhan khang gis paṇa chen mchog la bod kyi phyogs so so'i gnas tshul mkhyen rtogs thub par byed dgos/ paṇa chen mchog gis dgongs 'char ga re yod na'ang las don u yon lhan khang la gsung rgyu dang / de yang paṇa chen rin po ches dbus dang /chab mdo sa khul bcas kyi gnas tshul la thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang ste/phyogs de gnyis kyi mtho rim mi sna dang / ngal rtsol mi dmangs dang 'brel ba mang po byed rgyu'i re ba yod ces bton 'dug22phyi lo 1961 zla 1 tshes 24 nyin/ slar yang kra'u e lan gyis gsol tshigs su gdan 'dren zhus pa dang sbrags/ bod kyi bcos sgyur yongs rdzogs na slob da ro na chen mo paṇa chen rin bo che/shog ngos 1 phyinang /'jam dpal rgya rme tsho/bde srung bod gnas zhams zhib khang /bye lo 1997lo /336

skya tshe'i bar gyi cha/mang tshogs kyi dgos mkho gzhir bzung dgos/ bcos sgyur gyi las 'gul khrod g.yon gyi gnad don byung yod/ de ni g.yol thabs med pa zhig red/'on kyang /'go khrid kyi thog nas bshad na do dam thub med/ sku nyid phyir log rjes g.yon lhung dag bcos gnang dgos/ mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byed mkhan dang /mi dmangs la gnya' gnon byed mkhan ma gtogs gzhan rnams srung skyob byed dgos/ da phyin sku nyid dang / bod las don u yon lhan khang / krung dbyang gi 'go khrid dbar grogs po'i 'du shes bcangs te sems nang gi skad cha gang yod/ rang dbang dang / 'dzems bag med par mang tsam gsungs dgos pa bshad/23krung dbyang gi srid 'dzin dang srid blon rnam gnyis kyis/ 7paṇa che na bcu pa mchog gis zhus pa'i dgongs 'char la gdeng 'jog dang khas len gang yag gnang bas/ rin po che mchog mchog thugs sems spro ba'i ngang bod khul gyi sa cha gzhan rnams la mu mthud gzigs skor chibs sgyur gnang mod/7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs 'char gyi snying don dbus gzhung gis da dung yang gsal po zhig rtogs thub med/rgya nag dbus gzhung nas bod las don u yon lha khang gi 'go khrid rnams gzhi rim mi mang dang 'brel 'dris rtsa ba nas med pas/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs 'char de dag dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyis 7paṇa chen rin po che gtsos pa'i bod kyi mtho rim sku drag 'ga' zhig gi khe dbang la gnod skyon phog yod pa sdug nad mi theg pa'i 'bod sgra zhig las/ gnod 'tshe phog yul gtso bo de zhing 'brog mi mang yin pa gtan nas mthong ma thub pas/237sku bo/sngo khu 4464 7〉cha: caji 337

7paṇa chen nar te ni gis 'jug7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs 'char la bsam blo'i gting nas mthong chen zhig byas med/ phyi lo 1961 lo/ khams kyi dkar mdzes dang / a mdo'i rnga pa khul du gzigs zhib gnang skabs/ li cing chon sogs kyis bod la bcos bsgyur dang zing 'khrug gzhod 'jags btang bas/ mi mang dus bde zhi 'jags ngang 'tsho ba legs bcos byung yod lugs kyi snyan seng rdzun ma yar zhu byas/7paṇa chen rin po ches li cing chon gyi snyan sgron shod mtshams bkag nas/ khyed kyis bshad pa'i gnas tshul dang ngas shes pa'i gnad don gnyis 'gal ba red/khyed tshos ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags rgya che thal drags pas/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs dang / mang tshogs dkyus ma sogs zing 'khrug slong mkhan la brtsis pa dang / 'tsho ba'i thad thon skyed mar chag pa/ mi ser mang po'i grod pa mi rgyags pa/tha na ltogs shi thebs pa'i gnas tshul yang byung 'dugabacos sgyur khrod dgon pa mang che ba gtor ba dang / btsan gyis grwa pa skya bab tu bcug pa sogs chos dad rang mos la brtsi srung byas mi 'dugami kha shas (7cing chon/)kyis nga la rgyun du bod rigs dang / chos lugs kyi gnad don skor kho na gleng gi 'dug ces skyon brjod byed kyi yod pa red/ nga rang bla ma zhig dang bod rigs shig yin pa'i cha nas bod kyi gnad don dang / chos lugs kyi gnas don bshad dgos pa ni rang bzhin zhig red/krung go gung khran tang gi dmigs yul gtso bo ni blo gcig sems gcig gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu zhig red/ khyed tshos sa cha 'di nas mi ser gyi ngo tshab byas nas skad cha mi bshad pa de ga re yin nam/ krung dbyang la dngos yod gnas stangs snyan seng mi zhu ba gang yin/ mi dmangs la dka' ngal 338

kyi che'i bar gyi cha/'phrad skabs khyed tshos mig btsum nas sdod dgos don gang yin/ nga tsho grangs nyung mi rigs kyi las byed pas tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang la/grangs nyung mi rigs kyi mang tshogs rnams kyi bde sdug zhu rgyu'i 'gan dbang yod pa red/nga tshos tang dang mang tshogs bar gyi zam pa zhig gi tshab byed dgos pa las/ de'i dbar la rtsig gyang zhig bzo mi rung / khyed rang ni blo mthun rgan gras shig yin pas/ dus bab la lta stangs kyi blo sgo 'byed rogs gsungs shing / bod mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal ji bzhin 'khod pa'i gnas tshul dngos/ zhib tshags ngang yig thog tu phab nas ma'o kru'u zhir 'bul rgyu'i dgongs pa 'khrungs/li cing chon ni g.yol thal che ba'i rgya dpon zhig yin zhing / nam rgyun 7rgyal ba yab sras rgya nag grong khyer gang du phebs kyang / tang gi drung che dang po dang / zhing chen gyi 'go 'dzin gtso bo des phebs bsu zhu bzhin yod mod /phyi lo 1955 lor/ 7gong sa mchog dang 7paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis pe cing nas bod du phyir phebs kyis si khron zhing chen gyi tang gi drung che dang po li cing chon gyis 7gong mchog la mjal bcar zhus med la/ phyi lo 1956lor/ khams nang li cing chon gyi stangs 'dzin 'og bcos sgyur 'go tshugs/phyi lo 1962 lor/ li cing tshon krung gung lho nub las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin gtso bo dang / si khron zhing chen gyi drung che/ khren tu'u dmag khul khang gi chab srid 'thus mi dang po bcas kyi 'gan 'khur bzhin yod/339

7paṇa chen zher te gi zhib 'dugale tshan bzhi pa/ yig 'bru khri bdun tang la phul/ ri bong bya glags kyis khyer na/ /'bod sa a sngon gnam/ /zhes pa ltar/bod bstan srid ched 7gong sa mchog phyogs g.yol gnang zhing / mgo nag bod 'bangs mu ge dang mnar gcod kyi myang ngam thang du lus skabs/ bod mi mang gi re ba'i mgon skyabs zhu sa 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog las med/phyi lo 1961 lor/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che rgya nag rgyal khab btsugs te lo ngo 12 'khor ba'i rten 'brel zhu phyir pe cing du chibs thon gnang skabs/ lha ldan rgyal khab kyi nye 'khris gzhung lam g.yas g.yon du/mdog skya la gos hrul zhing gla med ngal rtsol gyi sdug khral ljid mos mnar bzhin pa'i bod mi tshos/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i sku gam du rgyug yong zhing/ dad skyo zung gi tshor 'du las bzhur ba'i mig chu khrum khrum phyis bzhin/ rgya dmar gyi dpon rigs tshor bdag tshor za 'bru dang sman bcos mkho sprod yong ba zhu rogs zhes skyabs 'jug zhus/24lha sa nas pe cing du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i lam zhor du/ zi khron dang /kun su'u/ mtsho sngon bod rigs sa khul sogs la gzigs zhib gnang skabs dbul zhing phongs pa'i mtsho sngon bod rigs sa khul gyi rgan po zhig 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi sku mdun du bcar yong te/ khyed kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa na4bden don gsal ba'i sgro na me/ཿshog ngos na munang /lha drug gis brtsams /bde srung la sa khungs kyi par 'grem sa byas/gyi lo daX lo ra/340

sku che'i bar gyi cha/gtor du ma 'jug bod gangs can gyi yul 'di brlag tu ma 'jug mi rnams ltogs shi ru mi gtong ba'i skyabs 'jug nan du zhus/25gnas tshul des 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs la g.yo 'gul tshad med thebs te/ 'brug mo dor du bsdad kyang / /bsam pa gling la dkar/ /zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ pe cing gi rgyal don dus chen grub te rgya nag lho phyogs su yul skor chibs sgyur skabs/ bod mi mang gis bzod dka' ba'i sdug bsngal myong tshul rnams/spyan gyi mdun nas skad cig tsam yang ba med stabs/ khrung chin du phebs pa nas bzung yul skor 'grul bzhud kyi gru gzings nang yig 'bru khri bdun gyi ma zin phal mo che zin bris gnang /26rgya nag lto phyogs kyi yul skor ljongs rgyu grub nas phyir pe cing du 'khor ma thag zhabs 'bring gtso khag la snyan zhu'i ma zin ji ltar byung min blta ru bcug pa ma zad/ bkras mthong ci 'jigs med dang / tā bla ma ngag dbang sbyin pa sogs la'ang bka' bsdur gnang / zhabs 'bring sku 'khor tshos/rgya nag gzhung la zhu dgos pa'i gnas tshul gsungs dgos pa yongs rdzogs gsungs zin pas/ yang bskyar gnas tshul dang dgongs 'char gnang mi 'os/ci ste gnang rgyu lags na tang krung dbyangs dgongs gzhi 'khrug rkyen du mi 'gro ba thugs gzab dgos pa zhus/dza sag ci 'jigs med kyis nus shugs gang spusad kyis yig 21ga nas dgongs tshul mi gnang ba'i re 'dun zhus te bkag 'gog gnang mod/ bod kyi chos dang mi rigs kyi bde sdug la sman pa'i legs bcos phran bu byung na/na skabs thog i bsam gzhigs/dpa la ljan rgyal gyis brtsams /bod kyi dus bab kyi pa ra 'grems byas/na bod kyi rig gnas 'o rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7pa ṇa chen rjes dran ched dbe/〉shog ngos 17phyinang /me rigs dpe skun khang /phyi lo 1989ba phyinang /341

7paṇa chen mar te ni gi' 'jugang mi gcig gi khe phan dang tha na nyes chad gang 'dra zhig gnang rung 'gyod pa spu tsam med pa gsungs te yig thog nas gong 'bul zhu rgyu mtha' 'khyongs gnang /phyag bstar ma'i bod yig gi ma zin grub mtshams/ bod kyi mtho rim dpon rigs bka' zur nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / 'bras spungs klu 'bum bshes shes rab rgya mtshor dgongs 'char bsdu len ched phul kyang /srid don dran 'khrul gyi blo gros ldan pa'i bka' zur nga phod kyis/ brjod tshig drag po med pa zhig ngag thon nas snyan zhu gnang gal gsungs shing / lnga rig gnas la nang byan chub pa'i dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos/ rig gzhung lta ba'i gzigs stangs shig las/ snyan zhu de yig gzugs dang dag sdeb med pa/rjod byed tshig gi sbyor ba yang bde po mi 'dug pas/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches mu mthud slob sbyong la thugs brtson gnang ba'i dgongs tshul las/ brjod bya don gyi cha la tshig 'bru gcig kyang khong gnyis gas ma gsungs/27phyis su 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la 'thab 'dzing dang / skyon brjod/'thab rtsod zhu skabs/ shes rab rgya mtsho lags ni yig 'bru khri bdun gyi yig cha'i lkog jus pa dang / rtsom 'bri mkhan/ gting du gab nas bsdad pa'i mgo bde g.yo sgyu che ba'i gsar brje'i ngo log pa rgan gras zhig yin pa bshad de/mang tshogs la skyon brjod dang 'thab rtsod byed du bcug mthar dgung grangs brgyad cu lhag la son pa'i shes rab rgya mtsho lags gdug rtsub sna tshogs btang zhing / ma nyes kha g.yog 'og sku gshegs/yig 'bru khri bdun gong 'bul mdzad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan skor/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku ngo ma'i zhal sgo las/ spyir bod mi yongs la ma nyes na slob dpon chen mo 4pa ṇa chen rin ro che/'jam dpa lī gyo mtshos bzums/bde drung nyam sa 'ib lang sga par 'grems bya //phyi tsha 1998'o ra/342

kyi che'i bar gyi cha/khag g.yogs dang / dmar gsod/ nyes dung / btson 'jug ltogs shir srog thog btang song / lhag lus rnams kyis rang yul du rang gi 'tsho ba bskyal te bsdad kyang / bzod par dka' ba'i nyes pa dang / btsan gnon/ bshu gzhogamanar gcod sogs gtong gi 'dugargyu mtshan de dag la brten nas/ ma'o tse tung gis bod mi dmangs kyi bde sdug shes pa'i slad/ bod kyi gnas rig gtor bshig dang / bod mi dmangs kyis dka' sdug ji ltar myong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul zhib cing phra ba yig thog tu bkod nas gong phul zhus pa yin/skabs der mi mang po zhig gis ma phul na yag gi red ces bsam 'char gsung byung / nga yod kyis kyang de ma phul na yag gi red gsungs byung /kru'u e lan nas kyang phal cher ma phul na yag gi red ces gsung byung / yin na'ang / bod mi dmangs kyi bde sdug gong rim la snyan seng zhu ma thub na/sa gnas dpon rigs tshos spel ba'i bya spyod dag nga tsho 'gro ba mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas nad kyis 'khyogs kyi mi 'dug pas/ ngas snyan zhu 'di phul ba yin ba yin zhes gsungs/28rje btsun sa skya paṇa chen gyis/dam pa mang po khas su mi 'che la/ /gal te dka' ba'i khas ni blangs gyur na//rdo la ri mo brkos pa ji bzhin du/ /shi yang gzhan du 'gyur ba mi byed do//gsungs pa ltar dgongs 'char snyan zhu bod yig ma zin nas rgya yig tu bsgyur ba'i skabs/ yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang dngul chu rin po ches don gnad da sku ngo 'ju chen la bcar 'dra zhus spro 'i tshig tho/song tshes/ nyin/343

la ṇa chen mar te ji zhing 'dugader dngos su the gtogs gnang / phyi lo 1962 zla 5 tshe 15 nyin/ yas mas kyi mtshan mo zhig pe cing 7paṇa chen 'phral sel bzhugs sgar gyi mchod khang nang /yongs 'dzin rin po ches mchod me dang gzim spos sogs mchod rdzas gzhan khag kyang sgrig bkod zin rjes/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mchod khang du gdan 'dren zhus te khri thog tu bkod/yongs 'dzin gyis gang zhig gnang rgyu yin pa mkhyen gyi med kyang /bka' 'dri zhu ma yod pas yongs 'dzin gyis zhal bkod ltar gnang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa khri thog tu 'khod dang yongs 'dzin rin po ches sku 'khor gzhan rnams phyir bton nas gzim sgo bskyon zhing / mchog gsum yi dam gyi lha tshogs la dad pa'i dmigs pa sngon du btang nas sku phyag gsu/ma phul ba dang / 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog la yang sku phyag phul/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches yongs 'dzin gyi sku phyag 'bul ba skyor dgos dgongs te lam seng khri thog nas bzhengs skabs/yongs 'dzin rin po ches brjid nyams dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ 7paṇa chen rin po che khri steng du bzhugs su bcug pas ma bzhugs ka med du gyur/lha la mi skrag klu la mi skrag yongs 'dzin gyi sku phyag phul ba la skrag ces gsung rgyun yod pa'i dpe ltar/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi srol rgyun goms srol nang sprul sku rnams thos bsam slob gnyer gnang skabs/ sku nar ma son pa'i sprul sku rnams yongs 'dzin gyis bslab gcun gnang dgos/ skabs mtshams la re glags ma khel bas 'u thug thabs zad kyi phyag 'jug gnang dgos pa gyur tshe/sku phyag gsum sngon btang gis phyag 'jug gnang lam yod stabs/ yongs 'dzin rin po ches 7paṇa chen rin po cher sku phyag 'bul skabs/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog ni khab rtse'i stan thog tu bzhugs pa ltar gyur/ yongs 'dzin gyi sku phyag grub pa dang 7paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs khri'i nye 'gram du bcar nas/344

skya che'i bar gyi cha/rin po che/ ngos rang gi bltas na bsam 'char yi ge de gong rim la ma phul na yag po 'dug ces gsungs/7paṇa chen rin po ches rgyu mtshan gang yin pa'i bka' rtsad gnang ba dang / yongs 'dzin rin po ches/ dgongs 'char gnang dgos pa yongs rdzogs khyed rang nas ha lam dbu khrid tshang mar dngos su zhus yod/ krung dbyang nas kyang mi mang po zhig mngags gtong byas nas zhib bsher byed du bcug yod/gsham rim nas kyang mu mthud nas gong rim la snyan seng zhus yod pa red/bshad srol ltar na/de snga'i tshogs 'du kha shas thog 'thus mi mang po zhig gis kyang zhus yod tshod 'dug der brten/ gsham 'og gi gnas tshul shes rtogs byed chog pa zhig red/ gal srid nor 'khrul yo bsrang dang gnad don thag gcod byed 'dod yod pa yin na sngon nas thag gcod byas chog gi yod pa red/ gal srid thag gcod byed 'dod med na bsam 'char yi ge kha shas shig phul na yang gong rim nas do snang byed rgyu ma red gsungs/7paṇa chen rin po ches/ bod khul gyi gnas tshul ni dmigs bsal zhig yin pa dang / rnyog 'dzing chen po yod stabs/ tha re tho re zhig bshad na krung dbyang gis khyon yongs dang 'thus tshang zhig shes rtogs byed mi thub pa dang /mthong chen byed rgyu yang khag po red/ rtsa ba'i cha nas bod khul gyi gnad don rnams thag gcod yag po zhig kyang byed thub rgyu min pa'i bka' phebs skabs/dngul chu rin po ches bdag gis sems khur byed pa ni bsam 'char gyi yi ge gong rim la phul rjes/ bod kyi gnad don thag gcod byed rgyur phan pa med pa ma zad/rin po che khyed rang la'ang rnyog dra 'byung srid ces zhus/345

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhing 'jug7paṇa chen rin po ches/ da cha srid jus legs su phyin yod pa dang /krung dbyang nas yang nas yang du mi byed pa gsum dang / rang sgrub gsum gyi byed phyogs lag len bstar rgyu yin pa'i khyab bsgrags byed kyi yod pas rnyog dra yong mi srid gsungs/yongs 'dzin dngul chu rin po che mchog gis/ skabs bdag la blo sems bde po zhig mi 'dug gnad don zhig lhag rgyu red snyam bzhin 'dugabadag gis bltas na 'di lo'i dpyid ka dang lo lnga'i gong gi dpyid ka dang 'dra mtshungs mthong gi 'dug bdag gis gnad don zhig lhag mi yong ngam snyam pa'i sems khral byed kyi yod/ nye dus bdag gis mo lung thengs kha shas shig brgyab pa yin/ mo 'bras yag po ma byung / srid jus dbyar ga'i gnam gshis ltar 'gyur sdog chen po yong srid/ de ring mi byed pa gsum dang / rang sgrub gsum bshad bzhin yod rung /sang nyin dam 'dzin gsum dang / 'thab rtsod gsum bshad srid/ de dus ga re gnang gi yin nam zhus/ 7paṇa chen rin po che ha cang thugs yid ches po'i ngang de 'a dra rtsa ba nas srid kyi ma red zhus/yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang dngul chu blo bzang chos 'phel rin po che spyan chab sil bzhin/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog phyi rgyal du chibs bsgyur gnang zin cing / da lta rin po che gcig rkyang du lhags yod stabs/gal srid rin po che sku nyid la skyon gnad cig byung ba yin na/ rin po che khyed rang tsam dang yang na nga tsho bkra shis lhun po dgon pa'i don kho na ma yin par/bod khul yongs kyi chos srid las don thog do phog 'byung srid pas/ bod mi dmangs sa ya kha shas la brten sa med pa zhig chags rgyu red zhu skabs/346

skya che'i bar gyi cha/7paṇa chen rin po ches thugs brtse zab mo'i sgo nas rang nyid kyi dga' bkur thos pa'i yongs 'dzin mchog la gzigs nas/ khyed kyi dgongs tshul ngas kyang gsal po shes kyi yod/ khyed rang nas kyang mkhyen gsal ltar krung dbyang la gnas tshul snyan seng zhu ba ni bsam blo gzab nan btang yod pas/ gal srid bod sa khul gyi las don yag po yod pa dang / rgyal khab stobs phyugami rigs dar spel/ mi dmangs bde skyid/ chos lugs dar rgyas 'byung thub pa yin na/ nga sgor la ma nyes khag g.yog cung zad cig phog na'ang blo 'gyod gtan nas med gsungs te/ gong 'bul gnang rgyu u tshugs mtha' skyel gnang /(yig 'bru khri bdun /ma zin grub pa dang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku ngo mas bkod khyab bzhin/ 7paṇa chen dgu pa'i gsung sgyur li'u ca' cun /skal bzang chos 'byor )pe cing du gdan 'dren zhus kyis rgya yig tu bsgyur bcugaphyi lo 1962 zla 5 tshes 18 nyin/ yig 'bru khri bdun gyi ma zin rgya yig tu par skrun gnang skabs/ tung pe khul du srid blon kra'o e len dang mjal 'phrad gnang / gnas tshul de'i skor la ring ran gyis gsus par/ srid blon kra'u e len gyis yig 'bru khri bdun skor la/ 7paṇa chen rin po che dang mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma zad/ ha lam nyin phyed ring snyan zhu'i 'bru don la zhib phra'i zhal ta gnang / mjal 'phrad skabs wu'u lan h+phu dang /zhi krung zhun/ li we han sogs rgyal khab dbu khrid dang / krang cing wu'u dang /krang go hwa/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal sogs bod kyi dpon rigs tsho yang yod/ srid blon kra'u e lan gyis/ go thos su khyed kyis bod kyi las don skor gyi dgongs 'char zhig yig thog nas ngos la sprad yod pa 'dra zhes zhu skabs/347

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhib 'jugabod kyi las don skor la bod stod dpon po krang cing hu'u dang 7paṇa chen rin po che dbar lta tshul mi mthun pa shugs chen yod stabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches ngar shugs dang bcas yig 'bru khri bdun gyi snying bsdus snyan gseng zhus shing /bka' zur nga phod kyis dgongs 'char la kha gsab phran bu gnang /gas /ji jitrītswa steng // / bye/sdubye—nye //sna —/zhe spu /mi ri pa hoX cig sheshā ri ri ri pha ci sdis rte 3 4jisgo khyi cha slong ye pho / khri mecigaci ciXrnyi ri /// sna 41 byug 1 sgo tho sto chi/ riX ci sa5/ //ci ri / ci sna / )/1 ci mi rigazhi ril /ji zhi shā 1 3rde rdo /sgo rtseḥ nyu)skusna /ri byu ci sne ra ci ) rici /rdo ri ri wa ci bye cu(7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang / kra'u e len/)srid blon kra'u e lan gyis/ g.yon gyi nor 'khrul nges par du yo bsrang byed dgos/ khyed tsho bde po med na/ nga tsho de bas bde po mi 'dug gang la zhe na khyim tshang chen po zhig red/ krung dbyang dang / ma'o kru'u zhi/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas nor 'khrul dag bcos gnang nges yin/29 btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol dang / rgyal khab la dga' zhen/ spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa bcas de gsum gyi thog nas bshad na/ nga tsho sprun zla yin pa dang /blo mthun yang red/yin na'ang / khyed kyis bshad pa'i nang gi nor ba tshang ma nyan mi dgos pa dang / bshad nor byung ba de tsho phyir 'don dgos/ de ltar ma byas na blo ma ma 'a ra ma yin la/ mchog nyid la dngos yod kyi byams sems rdzunaX56྅/ 414 —460446 4rtse 4 /spya'i lho 7/ /

skya che'i bar gyi cha/'chang ba zhig kyang ma red/ mchog nyid kyis snyan zhu legs bsgrigs byas rjes/pe cing du 'byor ba dang ngas bltas te gros mol byed chog bshad/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ khong nyid kyi yang dag pa'i rgyu mtshan mtha' 'khyongs gnang stabs/kra'u er len gyis ngas bshad pa'i skad char zhib tu bsam blo btang nas lhod lhod du dug sel bgyis shig nga da lta byang shar khul 'tshams gzigs la 'gro dgos pa bshad/khri bdun yig 'bru rgya yig tu legs sgrig zin pa dang / kra'u e lan pe cing du 'byor rjes slar yang bka' mol gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes byung zhing /krung dbyang gi dbu khrid nang nas bod kyi gnad don skor la mkhyen rtogs rgyas shos kra'o e len yin pa dang / kru'u e len gyis 7paṇa chen rin po che sku sger gyi gnas tshul dang mang tshogs kyi dka' ngal gzigs thub bzhin yod stabs/phyi lo 1962 zla 6 tshes 'gor/ snyan zhu sdum par grub pa dang / kra'u e len brgyud krung dbyang la gong 'bul zhus na legs pa'i gzigs tshul byung bas/snyan zhu'i 'go brjod du yang mdza' brtse ldan pa'i srid blon kra'u e len brgyud nas krung dbyang la/ (bod ljongs dang / bod rigs sa khul gzhan bcas kyi mang tshogs kyi dka' ngal dang / na 'ongs pa'i las don skor gyi snyan seng gros 'char//zhes bkod/ 349

le tshan lda pa/ yig 'bru khri bdun gyi snying don/ bsam 'char snyan zhu de rgya yig tu bsgyur rjes/ yi ge 'bru khri bdun chags pas mi rnams kyis rjod byed tshig gi cha nas (yig 'bru khri bdun//zhes dang / brjod bya don gyi cha nas (bod 'bangs sdug las skyob pa'i 'bod sgra/)zhes brjod kyi yod/ 'on kyang / gong phul snyan zhu dngos kyi 'go brjod du (bod dang bod rigs sa khul gzhan gyi mang tshogs kyi sdug bsngal dang phyin chad las ga'i bsam 'char//zhes/ phyag bstar ma phyag bris gnang yod //yig 'bru khri bdun/)snyan zhu'i brjod bya'i snying don ni/ rgya nag gung khran tang gis chol gsum bod kyi khyon du/ dmangs gtso bcos sgyur dang ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags/ zhes bod gzhung dgon mang gsum gyi rgyu dngos yod tshad rgya nag tu dbor zhing / bod mi rnams sdug shi/ ltogs shi/ mug shi/btson 'jug dung rdeg 'dzin bzung / bran bkol byas pa'i sdig nyes la dgag rgyag ther 'don gnang nas/ slad phyin srid jus yo bsrang byas te bod mi mang la bde skyid kyi kha theg yong ba byed dgos pa'i tha tshig bsgrags pa zhig yin/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i blo stobs dang thugs gshis las/ gnad don 'ther 'don byed pa'i rjod byed tshig 'bru ngar shugs ha cang gi tsha nan yin/ de yang / zing khrug zhod 'jags kyi skor la 'di ltar phyag bris gnang yod/thal drags pa'i ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags nang / bod mi ga tshod cig 350

skru che'i bar gyi cha/'dzin bzung byas yod pa'i grangs tshad ni dpag dka' ba dang / sa khul re re mi yag sdug dang nyes pa yod med la ma bltos par/ mi grangs 10000 lhag 'dzin bzung byas yod/ mi dkar nag khyad med du 'dzin bzung bya rgyu ni 'dzam gling thog gi drang bden gyi khrims lugs yongs dang 'gal yod pa red ces dang /dmangs garu'i bcos sgyur skor la/ bcos sgyur las 'gul de'i las don rnams la da dung dga' ba drug yod de/ 'khrug po la dga' ba/ yug chod la dga' ba/ sprel lad la dga' ba/ sgro btags la dga' ba/ rnyog bzo la dga' ba/leb dung la dga' ba ma zad/ mi dmangs spyi khang gis mi gcig la gyon pa lus gang gcig dang / mal stan gcig phor pa gcig bcas sger dngos gsum las med/ gnas tshul de lta'i khrod bod mi dmangs la za rgyu med pas ltogs shi thebs bzhin 'dug de ni khyed tshos brjod bzhin pa'i mun nag dang bran g.yog lam lugs yin pa'i bod rnying pa'i skabs su yang mthong rgyu med pa gsungs/30dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur dang ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags gtong ba'i srid jus des/ bod mi dmangs kyi sems khams bde thang la gnod 'tshe sbyin tshul la 'di ltar gsungs yod/ mi rnams kyis brjod gsal/ nga tsho shi rgyu phyi drags song / gal te snga po nas shi yod na shi mchod dang smon lam thob thub kyi red/ deng skabs shi na khyi shi ba nang bzhin dbugs chad ma thag sgo'i phyi logs su g.yugs kyi yod pa red/ de lta'i sdul bsngal myong bzhin pa'i bod mi dmangs kyis/ 7paṇa chen rin po che dang 'dra ba'i bod rigs mtho rim dbu khrid tshor re ba'i lhag ma bcol bzhin yod stabs/ khong nas bod mi mang gi 'thus tshab gnang ste/slad phyin bod kyi srid jus legs sgyur dgos pa'i skor la 'di ltar 'bri gnang zug skyes 0yi ga 'bru khri bdun gyi stan zhu/lapaṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/bde sru nga nams zhib kyi pa ra 'grems byas/pyi lo 1998lor/351

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing 'jugabod kyi sa khul gang sar pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mas ngos dang 'dra ba'i bod mi'i 'go khrid su zhig thug kyang / mig nas mig chu bzhur bzhin sems nang gi sdug gtam yod tshad brjod pa ma zad/ mig chu phyi ru bton nas sems nang gi sdug bsngal sel rgyur re ba byed kyi 'dug der brten/ bod mi rigs kyi 'tsho bar thugs khur mi chung ba gnang rgyu dang / lhag par du bod mi rnams ltogs shi mi thebs pa'i 'gan len yod pa zhu zhes bkod gnang mdzad yod/de ltar ngo log zing 'khug zhod 'jags dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur gyis bod mi dmangs la bod mi'i rang dbang dang / 'tsho ba/ chos lugs/yul goms gshis lugs/ rig dngos sogs la bzod dka' ba'i dmar gsod dang / tshabs che'i gtor bshig dang / dung rdeg tso brlag byung ba'i dngos byung gnas tshul rnams/ don tshan brgyad kyi sa bcad du dbye ste phul ba ni gsham gsal ltar yin/dang po/ ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags su gtong ba'i 'thab rtsod skor/gnyis pa/ dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur skor/gsum pa/ zhing 'brog thon skyed dang / mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i skor/bzhi pa/ 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las don skor/lnga pa/ dmangs gtso'i srid jus kyi lam lugs skor/drug pa/ 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang sgor 'dzin gyi gnad don skor/bdun pa/ chos lugs las don gyi gnad don skor/352

skya che'i bar gyi cha/brgyad pa/ mi rigs las don gyi gnad don skor bcas yin/gong gsal rnams nga'i sems steng gi skad cha yin pa ma zad/ bod rigs mi dmangs sa ya gsum gyi sems steng gi re ba yin pas/ ngos rang gi ming thog tu bod rigs mi dmangs kyi re ba yig thog tu bkod pa yin zhes/gong 'bul snyan zhu de 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku sgor gyi gzigs tshul dang / dgongs tshul zhig rgya nag gzhung la yar zhu byas pa ma yin par/ bod mi dmangs thun mong gi bsam 'char mtshon pa'i snyan zhu zhig yin pa'i gsal kha bstan/dgung grangs 24 la son pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu mchog gis gong 'bul snyan zhu'i mjug byang gi tshab tu/ las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bod mi rigs kyi bu rabs tsha rgyud kyi mtshan snyan la gnod pa'i shul rjes phra mo tsam yang nga'i lo rgyus nang mi 'jog pa'i dam bca' bzhag yod gsungs/go thos su/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis yig 'bru khri bdun gyi ngo bshus par phud cig bkra shis lhun po'i zhabs gras lho gling rim bzhi bsod nams dbang phyug /mingagatogs 54)la/ gser ṭam lnga 'gro gron gtong byed du gnang nas/ 7gong sa mchog la ched 'bul rdzongs sta mdzad kyang / lho gling rim bzhi bsod nams dbang phyug bod 'brug sa mtshams nas 'dzin bzung gis rgya mir rtsis sprad pas/ phyis sku ngo lha rgyal ri khri chen dang btson khang gcig pa yin pa/bod btsan po'i gdung rgyud sku ngo lha rgya ri khri chen gyis gsungs/ /353

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'jug len tshan drug pa/ bzod dka' ba'i 'thab rtsod/(bod 'bangs sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i gdung 'bod//ces pa'i gong 'bul snyan zhu de/ phyi lo 1962 zla 5 tshes 18 nyin/ srid blon kra'u e len brgyud rgya nag dbus gzhung la phul/ kra'u e lan gyis snyan zhu'i nang don la zhib phra'i ngang thengs shig gzigs rjes/ ngos 'dzin bdun dang / gnad don brgyad/chos lugs kyi rtsa don lnga bcas la dbye ste/ ngos 'dzin bdun nang nor 'khrul mang po yod pa dang / gnad don brgyad don dngos dang mthun pa/ chos lugs kyi rtsa don lnga shin tu nas yang dag pa'i ngos 'dzin byas/ ngos 'dzin bdun ni/dang po/ rang skyong dbang cha'i ngos 'dzin/ gnyis pa/ krung dbyang dang sa gnas las byed pas bod kyi gnad don la the thogs kyi ngos 'dzin/ gsum pa/mi rigs kyi gnad don rtsa med bzo dgos dang mi dgos pa'i ngos 'dzin /bzhi pa/ chos lugs gnad don rtsa med bzo dgos min gyi ngos 'dzin/ lnga pa/log spyod don rkyen gyi ngos 'dzin/ drug pa/ sa gnas kyi nor 'khrul ngos 'dzin/bdun pa/ rgyal khab kyi mdun lam dang gnad don gyi ngos 'dzin bcas yin/ngos 'dzin bdun gyi nang/ bod dang bod khul gyi las don la skyon brjod tsha nan gnang ba dang / rjod tshig rno ngar dang dza drag che ba/ zur za'i rang bzhin bcas la kra'u e lan tshor snang mi legs pa byung yod kyang / bka' zur nga yod la snyan zhu'i nang gi gnad don 'ga' zhig gal 'gangs ha cang che bas/354

skya che'i bar gyi cha/bod nas 'go khrid 'ga' zhig bskongs te/ thun mong thog yo bsrang bya rgyu'i bsam 'char zhib 'jug byed dgos pa'i bka' gnang /rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi drung che zhi krung zhun dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi blon chen li we han gyi gtso skyong gnang ste/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang / krang cin wu'u/ krang go ha/ bka' zur nga phod/ wang chi ma'i/sha phu'u ren/'phags pa lha sogs kyis durmi yun zla ba gcig lhag tu snyan zhu 'i 'bru don re re bzhin zhib 'jug dang gros bsdur gnang /phyi lo 1962 zla 7 tshes 19 nyin/ bod kyi las don legs bcos gtong ba'i yig cha khag bzhi gtan 'bebs byung ba ni/ dang po/ (bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi las don la legs bcos mnyam las kyis thun mong thog bsgrub rgyu'i 'brel bar shugs ston rgyag rgyu//gnyis pa//chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus mu mthud lag len mthar phyin bstar rgyu'i skor gyi gtan 'bebs 'ga' zhig /gsum pa/(ngo log zing 'khrug par thag gcod bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs mu mthud lag len mthar phyin bstar rgyu'i skor gyi dgongs 'char// bzhi pa//las byed pa gso skyo nga bya rgyu dang slob gso gtong rgyu//zhes pa gtan la phab cing / 7paṇa chen rin po che dang /krang cing wu'i mtshan thog nas rgyal srid spyi khyab khang la snyan seng zhus/3/phyi lo 1962 zla 7 tshes 20 nyin/ kru'u e lan gyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gtsos/ krung cing u'u dang / bka' zur nga phod/ 'phags pa lha sogs/bod rang skyong ljongs kyi 'go khrid dang mjal 'phrad gnang ste/ nga tshos 7paṇa chen bcu par yid ches zab mo yod/ 'phags pa lha dang / ci 'jigs med 1bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7paṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉sog ngos naXnang /bod ljongs mi dam ngas dpe sgrun khang /byi lo 1989 bla ca nang /355

7paṇa chen ber te ni zhing 'jugatshang ma btsan rgyal ring lugs la ngo rgol dang / gung khran tang gi dbu khrid dang len dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam du 'gro mkhan zhig red/ khyed tshos kyang las don u yon lhan khang gi blo mthun tsho mi rigs rtsa med gtong mkhan dang /chos lugs rtsa med gtong mkhan zhig tu mi bsam par/ bod kyi las don legs bcos gtong mkhan du yid ches bya dgos pa bshad pa dang sbrags/ bod don yig cha bzhi lag len bstar rgyu'i chog mchan bkod/ phyi lo 1962 zla 8 zla mjug du 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog lha sar phyir phebs gnang ba dang / zla 8 tshes 13 nas 9 tshes 2 nyin bar/ dmag dpon than ko san (skabs der krang wu'u dang krang go gnyis pe cing du yod/)gyi gtso skyong 'ogathengs drug pa'i rgyas 'dzoms gros tshogs bskongs te/ bod don yig cha don tshan bzhi de bod bsgyur gyis deb chung dpar skrun 'grem spel byas pa ma zad/yig cha'i dgongs don srid jus lag len bstar ched/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches chos lugs dang srid jus don 'khyol byed pa'i thugs 'gan dang / bka' zur nga phod kyis ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jugs su gtong ba rgya bskyed can du 'gyur bar yo bsrang byed pa'i thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu'i las bgos bskyon/32bod ljongs kyi ri klung kun tu sngar med kha dbugs gsar pa zhig 'phyur zhing / mang tshogs khrod ma'o kru zhi sku ngo mas 7paṇa chen rin po che'i re 'dun rnams khas len byas pas/ bod kyi dza drag gi gnas tshul mgyogs myur zhi 'jags yong ba'i dril bsgrags bod khams yongs la khyab/phyi lo 1962 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog lha sa'i cho 'phrul smon lam gyi tshogs mgon du chibs sgyur gnang skabs/ rgya nag gzhung gis rgyud smad dbod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyadagazhi'i 'e cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7paṇa chen rjes dran chen dbe/〉zhogan nang /bod ra ngas dmangs dpe kun khang /phyi lo 1989zla phyinang /356

kyi che'i bar gyi cha/du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bla sprul slob grwa zhes pa gsar du btsugs pa'i nang /tshe smon gling rin po che dang / byer lcog rin po che/ a mgon rin po che/ mi nyag chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ stag brag rin po che/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ lo bsam pa rin po che/ dga' ldan khri stag rin po che sogs/ dbu skra sbang ga li bzhag bcug pa rnams/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher khyad gsod ched khong gis gzigs thub pa'i mdun gral du bzhugs bcuga'on kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po ches bla sprul rnams gzigs pa dang /tshogs thog nas bka' bkyon dang sbrags dbu skra breg par gtong gnang mdzad/bsod bde dman pa'i chag sgo zhig la/ bod du bod kyi las don skor gyi don tshan bzhi can gyi yig cha lag bstar byas te yun ring ma song bar/ phyi lo 1962zla 8 pa'i pe te ha tshogs chen steng / ma'o kru zhis/ 'thab phyogs gcig sgyur gyis gral rim 'thab rtsod mi byed par/ mgo 'dogs ring lugs byed kyi 'dug ces/ li we han gyi ming bton nas skyon brjod byas pa dang /krang cing wu'ur/ khyed tshos 7paṇa chen mi rigs kyi dbu khrid cig tu gso skyong byed bsam gyi yod mod/ ngas bltas na khos dbu khrid byed thub rgyu ma red/yig 'bru khri bdun ni zhing bran bdag pos nga tshor tshur rgol byas pa zhig red/gral rim 'thab rtsod ni/ nyin nas nyin bar dang / zla nas zla bar/ lo nas lo bstud de byed dgos/ nam yang gral rim 'thab rtsod brjed mi nyan zhes pa'i than skad bsgrags/phyi lo 1962 zla skyo nang tshogs pa'i skabs brgyad pa'i rgyal yongs tshogs chen thengs bcu pa'i steng / krung go'i rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi srid blon gzhon pa dang drung che gcig lcogs sku zhabs zhi krung zhun la/ tang rgol ru tshogs mkhan du bsnyad de 'thab rtsod byas pa dang / mi ring bar li wi han 357

7paṇa chen ser te ni gib 'jugayang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang las ka gnas dbyung btang / khong gnyis kyi gnad don de 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang thad kur 'brel ba yod stabs/7paṇa chen rin po cher chab srid cham nad phog nges pa'i blo 'tshab cig bod kyi las don gnang mkhan tshang mar byung /ge — cici chi snye ༷ ci ri44 ji1 spreX cha cho ci shā 45ge'i /zhi ri tshotsho ri ——— ༷7) 〉〉 ri mo de shā ci miX / miX'o chi 1/ci ga //ri rtse ci ci cho sa ritsā spra risas riX da ga ——————— ca(7pa ṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang / krang cinga.u )rlung rta rgud pa'i mi la/ khyi las zhi mi snang ba/ zhes pa'i dpe ltar/phyi lo 1962 zla 9 zla mjug tu/ krang cing wu'u lha sar 'byor ba dang / pe te ho tshogs chen thog gi bsam tso dgongs don/ las don u yon lhan khang gi tshogs 'du'i mthar phyin brgyud bsgrags byas te/ (yig 'a bru khri bdun )gyi gong 'bul snyan zhu de/ zhing bran bdag pos nga tshor tshur rgol byas pa zhig red/ces ma'o yi bka' brgyud bsgrags byas zhing / 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'thab 'dzing gtong rgyu las 'go tshugs/bod las don u yon lhan khang gi thengs drug pa'i tshogs 'du'i steng nas/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi chog mchan thob pa'i bod don yig cha bzhi po lag bstar byed rgyu mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ma zad/ 7paṇa chen 358

skya che'i bar gyi cha/rin po cher/ pe cing du bshad pa dang bod du byas pa gnyis khag khag red /bsam/ 'char de dag la nga tshos kha ya byed kyi ma red/tā la'i bla mas mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs la zhu 'bod byas pa dang /phyi rgyal du bod srid gzhung btsugs pa red/ slad phyin nga tshos tā la'i bla ma log spyod pas btsan khrid byas pa bshad mi chog khyed kyis tā la'i bla mar rgol rdung 'thab rtsod bya rgyu'i rnam 'gyur bstan na/ da lta mgo bor yod pa'i las tshab zhes pa'i zhwa mo phud de/ tā la'i bla ma'i tshab tu krung ren du bsko rgyu yin pas/khyed rang pho brang po twar gnas sdod chog gi red ces bshad/7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog gi tshab byed pa'i ched du/ngan sems kyi re ngan gang 'dra zhig bcangs te hur brtson byas pa yin na/ 'di ni bod mi dmangs la nag nyes bsags pa red gsungs te/ 7gong sa mchog gi tshab tu bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren byed rgyu zhal bzhes gnang mi 'dug la/337paṇa chen rin po che khong nyid la nor 'khrul yod par yid ches gnang gi med la/ kho tsho dang bden pa'i 'thab rtsod gnang ste rang nyid dag sel gnang gi yod/ de ltar 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog dang bod las don u yon lhan khang gi gnad yod 'gan 'dzin tsho'i dbar 'gal zla byung zhing /kho tshos rgya nag dbus gzhung gi chog mchan thob pa bzhin/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher skyon brjod dang dang slob gso mu mthud byas/phyi lo 1962 zla 9 tshes 18 zla 11 tshes 4 bar tshogs pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi tshogs thengs bdun pa'i steng / bden don gsal ba'i sgron me/shog ngos rke canang /lha phrug nas brtsams/bod kyi chos rig dpar lang /pyi lo naX lor/359

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhib 'jug7paṇa chen rin po cher tshabs che'i rdung rdeg phog pa ma zad/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren las tshab gnas dbyung btang ste/mi dmangs la ngo rgol dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs la ngo rgol/ ngo log ngan sgrig gi zha mo gsum g.yogs te/mi dmangs la chos 'brel bka' slob gnang rgyu dam bsgrags dang /bod kyi chab srid las don thog the jus gnang rgyu med pa bzos/ bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'dzin mi snas/ khyed kyis nye char srid gros tshogs 'du'i thog gi gtam bshad la nor 'khrul chen po yod pas bskyar zhib bya dgos pa bshad/347paṇa chen rin po cher 'thab rtsod byed pa'i gnas tshul zhin bzhin dza drag tu phyin te/ kong po khul du btsan khrid byas pa ma zad/ 'thab rtsod phul te (yig 'bru khri bdun /gyi snyan zhu nor 'dzol byung bar ngos len dgos pa mtha' la bkar/'on kyang /7paṇa chen rin po ches/ yig 'bru khri bdun ni tang dang /mes rgyal/ mi rigs dang mi dmangs/ rang nyid kyi dad pa byed pa'i chos lugs bcas la dga' po byed pa'i dga' zhen bzhi gzhir bzung nas bris pa zhig yin pas/tshig 'bru kha shas thal drags pa dang lta stangs phyogs re ba yong srid pa phud/de min nor 'khrul med pa gsungs te nor 'khrul zhal bzhes ma gnang /35bka' zur nga phod kyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la 'thab rtsod phul ba'i sa la med la/ nga phod mchog nas kyang 7paṇa chen bcu par 'thab 4slob dpon chen za 7paṇa chen rin po che/ 'jam dpalachu'i tshos brtsams/bde srung nyams zhig khang gis par 'grems byas/pyi lo 1998lor/ 5bod kyi rigaganas lo rgyus dpyadagazhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7pa ṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉thog ngos 195nang ci/bod stongs dmangs dpe sgrunakhang /phyi lo 1989zla phyinang /360

skya che'i bar gyi cha/rtsod phul myong med pa gsungs myong mod/ go thos su/ phyi lo 1962 7paṇa chen rin po che kong po khul du zla gcig lhag btsan khrid byed skabs/ bka' zur nga phod kyis nor 'khrul ngos len dgos pa'i slob gso gnang skabs/36bka' zur nga phod kyis 'thab 'dzing gnang dgos byung ba 'dra ste/mda' zur dbra phrug ngag dbang gi mi tshe'i lo rgyus nang / 7paṇa chen rin po cher kong po'i nang nga phod kyis 'thab 'dzing phul ba'i par dang /mtho rgyus mang po bris myosad pa'i deb cig nyi tong nas gus kyi lag tu son pa de/gus pas 7paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag tu phul ba gsungs/37phyi lo 1963 nas 1964 lo mgo bar 7paṇa chen rin po cher rno ngar che ba'i 'thab rtsod phul med kyang / bod kyi las don thog the jus gnang dbang med cing / bzhugs gling rdo rje pho brang du phyi mi dang 'brel gcod kyi do dam 'og zhesad/ nyi ma 'o1 las ring ba'i bzang btson gyi 'tsho 'dun la bzhugs skabs/thugs la dgongs tshul 'dra min 'khrungs shing / khri bdun gyi snyan zhu'i nang /bden pa las rdzun bshad pa'i gnad don rtsa ba nas med pas/ dbus gzhung gi dbu khrid tshor bden pa snyan seng zhu dgongs pa yod kyang go skabs sprod kyi med/tha na rin po che nyid kyi las dbang yang ji ltar chags min thugs dogs dang the tshom gyi dra bar tshud/ gna' mi'i bod kyi gtam dper/ mi 'u thug na lha la zhu/ lha 'u thug na skyag rdzun zhes pa ltar/ 'a chad 'u la thug cing grogs 5rgya dam ra gyis bod nang spyod la sa 'das pa 'i bya ngan ji byas dngos byung gnas lugs ralas bsdus gsal bar mthong ba'i me lo nga / shog ngos 512nang /bod kyi shes rig dpar khang sa 7dbra phrug ngag dbang gi mi tshe'icilo rgyus/mi da cha/zhog ngos na49nang /mda' zur li thang dbra phrug ngag dbang gis bcams/ma myes rma chen bod kyi ris gzhung zhib 'jug gi pa ra 'grems byas/bye lo daX8lor/361

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhing 'dusamed kher rkyang du lhag pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/ khong nyid kyi gnas bab la khong rang nyid kyi tshod bgam/ mi thebs pa'i skabs/ bkra shis lhun po'i sku rten bkug nas mo btab pa/ dang / gting skyes rin po che bzhugs gling rdo rje pho brang du gdan zhu gnang ste pra phab tu bcug pa/38 rin po che sku nyid kyi mnal lam sogs la brtas nas/ 'byung 'gyur gyi las dbang la tshod dpog gnang /phyi lo 1964 lo'i nyin zhig 7paṇa chen rin po dang yongs 'dzin dngul chu rin po che rnam gnyis kyis/ bkra shis lhunapo'i spral sku gting skyes rin po che lha sar yod pa'i bzhugs gling rdo rje pho brang du gdon 'dren zhus te/las don gal chen po zhig bya rtsis yod pas/ lam 'gro yod min pra phab nas brtag dpyad bya dgos pa gsungs/ gting skyes rin po ches spra phab chog kyang /da lta 'dir pra chas 'khyer med la pra mig blta mkhan gyi phrug gu zhig kyang dgos pa zhus/7paṇa chen rin po ches gting skyes rin po che'i gzim khang nas/pra chas bzhes mkhan btang ba ma zad/ spyan bsal slob grwa'i bu bzhi pra mig blta mkhan du skad btang zhing / gting skyes rin po ches pra'i cho ga sgrub rjes/yongs 'dzin dngul chu rin po ches/ don chen gang gi ched pra phab rgyu'i gnas tshul yi ger bkod pa'i shog bsgril me long gi ngos su 'jog pa gnang ba dang /phrug gu bzhis rim pas me long las gang zhig mthong min lta ru bcugapra'i me long la blta mkhan phrug gu dang po dang / gnyis pas ci yang mthong med kyang / bzhi pa des lam skya thing nger gsal ba zhig gi thog 'gros ma 'dur la rgyug bzhin pa'i rta zhig gi steng mi zhig bzhon yod pa mthong /zhanagating skyes ren po ches pra pab rgyu'i dbang 'u nga de/lapaṇa chen chos kyi nyi mas bka' bzhin li thang shod drug rin po che'i sku ma dun nas zhus 'dug362

skya che'i bar gyi cha/gang 'tshams shig nas nag cing mtho ba'i brag ri zhig gis/ rta bzhon pa'i mi de'i lam bkag song ba dang / mi de yid sems skyo mdog ngang brag ri de'i rtse la blta skabs/ mgo steng gi zha mo yang sa la lhung ba mthong /39yang / pra phab pa'i lung brtag gzhan zhig la/ yar 'brog g.yu mtsho 'dra ba'i mtsho chen zhig gi ngogs su/ gzugs stobs che ba'i ngang pa zhig gis/ngang pa khyu tshogs shig gi sne 'khrid de rtsed 'jo'i rkyal rtsal ngoms bzhin pa'i skabs/ dgung nam mkha'i mthong nas bya nag zhig glo bur du 'phur yong ste/mtsho ngogs kyi ngang pa'i tshogs rnams bcom/ dus yun gang 'tshams shig nas gzugs stobs che ba'i ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dra ba de/ spu mdog log cing skyo ba'i nyams dang bcas kher rkyang du mtsho khar 'bab pa'i pra ltas rnams 7paṇa chen rin po cher zhu skabs/ thugs mi dgyes pa'i khro nyams bzhes pa gsungs/40pra ltas rnams las/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po dang / yongs 'dzin dngul chu rin po che rnam gnyis kyis gnang 'char yod pa'i las don la/gegs bar chen po yod pa'i thugs dogs chen po byung yod kyang / phyis su 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog lo dgu zla brgyad kyi btson dong 'grim zhing / gsang yum bzhes dgos chags pa'i lung ltas shig tu dgongs yod med ni bdag gis shod thub pa'i skad cha zhig min rung / dngos yod kyi gnas tshul la pa'i lung rnams de ltar chags 'dugade ltar mu mthud de pra phab tu bcug ste/ pra gcig phab rjes yang bskyar gcig phab nas pra'i ltas kyi 'grel ba gsan pa dang / skabs 'gar gnas don gcig la pra thengs mang phab nas pra ltas yag po zhig thon par thugs re gnang 9glang zur blo chos la sa༄ su bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshig po/phyi lo 2011zla 10tshes 16nyen/glang zur blo chos la gcing skyes rin po ches gsungs/4 glang zur blo chos sne gas su bcar 'dri zhus pa'i tshegs tho/phyi lo daX11zla 10tshes 15nyin/glang zur blo chos la gting skyes rin po ches gsu ngas /363

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'jugakyang rtsa ba nas ma thon/dka' ngal yod par 'grel brjod dgos pa'i don gnad shog bu'i thog bris nas/ mnal ma gzim gong sngag mgo'i 'og tu bcug pa'am/ yang na/mchod gshom sgang du bzhag ste/ dkon mchog la gsol ba btab cing rmi lam nang lan yong ba'i thugs re gnang / rmi lam rmi lam 'dra min sna tshogs btang zhing / de dag la 7paṇa chen rin po ches 'grel brjod gnang ma thub rkyen/mo ba dang bla chen khag la bka' 'dri zhus/rmi lam gcig la 'grel bshad mang po byung bas/ 'di dag khong sku ngo mas zin tho bskyon pa'am/ yang na/ khong gis ngag thog nas gsungs te gzhan la 'bri ru bcug pas/ rmi lam snga ltas kyi zin tho zhes pa zhig byung /41phyi lo 1963 zla 5 tshes 19 nyin btab pa'i mo rtags su/don ldan bkra shis dga' ba'i don/ /nga sems rang gis mnan pa dga' / /dmar po'i me ni ngab tsha yang / /sngo mo'i chu la sdo ba med/ /ces pa thon/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi lung bstan dang thugs brtag zhus pa'i mo lung dang / mnal lam tho bkod gnang ba rnams la/ gsham gsal gyi tshig 'grel dang dpyad gtam spel te/ khong la 'thab 'dzing gtong ba'i lag char bed spyod byas/ tshig 'grel/don snying dang ldan pa'i bkra shis dga' ba'i las ku'i don du/ so so'i sems pa so sos mnan na dga' gi red/ ma gzhi me dmar po de ngar po yod pa red /yin na yang chu sngon mo de la kha gtad bcag thub kyi ma red ces dang /41slob dpon chen po paṇa chen rin po chekhog 197nang /'jam dpal rgya mtshosabartsams/bde srung nyams zhib khang gis bsgyur/phyi lo 1997lor/364

kyi che'i bar gyi cha/dpyad gtam la/ dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byas pa nas bzung /7paṇa chen gyi ro langs rgyag pa'i log spyod nang ha cang smyo ham che ba dang / phyi lo 1963 zla 5 tshes 19 nyin/ kho pa'i ro langs kyi re 'dun 'grub min skor la pra phab pa'i nang don la/ don ldan bkra shis dga' ba'i don te/ chos srid gnyis ldan gyi bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs ro langs rgyag rgyu'i ched du/rang sems rang gis mnan nas go skabs 'tshol ba dang re ngan sgrub thabs byas thog spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dmar po'i me des/ bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi sngon mo'i chu las rgyal thabs med pa'i skad ngan brgyab pa des/ kho pas ro langs rgyag rgyur rngams pa'i sdig nyes kyi lkog g.yo de'i mthil gsal por brdol pa red ces dang /yang / phyi lo 1963 zla 7 tshes 7 nyin/ lung brtag zhus pa'i mo yig nang /dmar po'i mdog can gangs ljongs 'di/ /rdo brkos ri mo ma yin yang / /re zhig de la ma bstun na/ /de yis rang nyid mi bkur ro zhes/ /tshig 'grel/ kha dog dmar po yin pa'i bod 'di ni rdo la brkos pa'i ri mo nang bzhin ma red/ gnas skabs ring de la bstun thabs ma byas nas/des rang nyid la gong bkur yid ches byed kyi ma red ces 'khod/de bzhin phyi lo 1964 zla 8 tshes 24 nyin/ mnal lam brtag pa'i nang /dus kyi 'gyur ba yong 'go tshugs/ /der brten re zhig dmar por bstun/ /365

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'ardulathabs mkhas g.yo yis rmongs par bya/ /rim gyis phyi rkyen tshang ba na/ /dmar por rgol te de nas bskrod/tshig 'grel la/ thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas rgol g.yo nyen phud kyis/dus bsgugs 'os tshul phebs 'dug par brten/ rgya dmar la mdung rtse kha sprod kyi 'thab 'dzing byed mus 'di nyid gnas skabs bag nyal du btang nas/g.yo khram rdzun bshad kyis rgya dmar bslus te/ dus bsgugs bya rgyu'i mdzad phyogs srid jus bzung ba yin/ dpyad gtam la/ 7paṇa chen gyis nyin mtshan med par ro langs rgyag gyis byed kyi yod la/ tha na gnyid lam nang la'ang tang la ngo rgol dang /mi dmangs la ngo rgol/ mes rgyal kha bral du gtong ba bcas kyi gsar brjer ngo rgol gyi lkog g.yo ngan jus byed rgyu'i bsam blo 'khor gyi yod pa red ces bshad/ phyi lo 1963 zla 9 tshes 16 nyin/ mo yig nang /nga ni kun gyi mgo yin te/ /nga ni kun gyi ma yang yin/ /42sogs mo yig gi lung don dang mnal lam kyi nang don rnams/7paṇa chen rin che rang nyid dam yang na sku 'khor tshor/ tho yig bkod du bcug pas dus yun lo gcig tsam nang / nang don mi gcig pa'i mnal lam dang mo yig gi zin tho yig 'bru khri lhag tsam byung /mo lung dang mnal lam brtag pa'i zin bris la yig 'bru khri lhag zin pa sa sa nga la 'thab rtsod byed pa'i nang / gong brjod kyi tshig 'grel 4 ling dkag gung dgag dang /twa kha/ dang pa 'o chen la dgag skyon yig cha/bod rang skyo nga 7 ngas yig cha/gyi lo 1974lor 366

skya che'i bar gyi cha/dang dpyad gtam bzos nas/ dgag pa dang 'thab rtsod gtong ba'i lag char bed spyod byas/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 10 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bod la phebs thengs mtha' ma'i skabs/ bod rang ljongs srid gzhung gi dbu 'dzin rag gis/ lo rabs 60 nang btsan 'phrog byas pa'i 7paṇa chen rin ngo che'i (khri bdun yig 'bru'i )ma phyi dang mo yig rnams rtsis 'bul zhus/phyi lo 1964 lor/ rgya nag rgyal yongs su gtsang bsher bzhi'i las 'gul khyab spel btang ba dang / bod nang de'i thog slob gso chen po gsum 43gyi nang don kha snon byas/ slob gso gsum gyi las 'gul nang / 7paṇa chen rin po cher dung rdeg dang 'thab rtsod drag po phog phyi lo 1964 zla 2 tshes 19nas 29 bar tshogs pa'i lha sa'i smon lam chen mo'inyin mtha' mar krang go has paṇa chen rin po che smon lam tshogs mgon du gdan 'dren zhus te/ 7gong sa tā la'i bla mar dgag rgyag kha dung dgos pa'i btsan bka' btang /7paṇa chen bcu nga/ mchog gis/ lha ldan du gtsug lag khang gi gsung chos ra ba'i khyams ra'i steng nas/ dad ldan bod mi ser skya khri tsho brgal bar zhal phyogs te/ chos dad rang mos dgos/ bod kyi 'phel rgyas bod mi dmangs la brten dgos/ bla na med pa'i dbu 'dzin 7rgyal dbang thams cad ma/khyen pa ni phyi rgyal du btsan khrid byas pa red/ gal te 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa bde mo thang po byung ba yin na/ bod mi dmangs yongs rdzogs kyi khe phan dang mthun pa zhig red/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa gegs med bde 'khod byung ba yin na/ bod mi dmangs kyi bde skyid 'byung rtsa nyams dmas su phyin yod 4 gral rem 'thab rtsod kyi slo ba gso/skyol gces ring 'u gas kyi slo ba gso/spyi tshogs reng lugs kyi rma dun lam slob gso/367

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhing 'jugapa ma red/de ring nga tsho mnyam du 'dzoms pa'i go skabs de bzung nas/ ngos nyid kyis 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par bcangs pa'i sra brtan 'gyur med kyi dad sems gsal bsgrags byed rgyu yin/ bod ni dus tshod ring po mi 'gor bar tan tan rang btsan thob thub nges red/ bla na med pa'i 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa nges par du gser khri'i steng du phyir log phebs thub nges red/7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa khri lor brtan par shog ces khrom bsgrags gzugang /44skabs der dza sag lha smon ye shes tshul khrims kyis 7paṇa chen rin po cher/ de ltar mi gsung ba'i zhu 'bod gnang bas/ khong gnyis dbar kha rtsod shor zhing 7paṇa chen rin po ches lha smon dza sag la phyag 'jug gnang skabs/rgya mi'i dmag mi slebs nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa 'dzin bzung byas pa dang /krang go ha dang krang cing hu gnam gyur zhugs nas/ ma'o kru'u zhir 7paṇa chen rin po che'i bsgrags gtam snyan seng zhu bar phyin 'duga'on kyang / rgya nag gzhung phyogs kyi gsar 'gyur bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par nang / krung dbyangs sku tshab krang ci hu'u dang / bod rang skyongs ljongs kyi kru'u ren las tshab 7paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis kyis/ smon lam chen mor sku 'gyed gnang ba'i gsar 'gyur las/ gzhan gyi gnas tshul gang yang bkod med/phyi lo 1964 zla 7 nang krang dpon gnyis lha sar phyir 'khor ba dang /mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas 7paṇa chen log spyod ru tshogs thal ba'i rdul du rlog dgos zhes pa'i 'bod sgra bsgrags shing / 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'thab rtsod ma byas gong / krang cing hu'u dang krang go has/ bka' zur nga phod dang / lha smon ye 44bden don gsal ba'i sgroname/shos ngos na 8nang /lha phrug gis brtsams/bde srung las khungs kyi par 'grems byas/phyi la naX lor/368

skya che'i bar gyi cha/shes tshul khrims/ bsam sding rdo rje phag mo/ mtshams khung btsun pa'i dbu mdzad byams pa dbang mo/ 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal sogs bskongs nas/don tshan bcu 'khod pa'i 7paṇa chen gyi nag nyes kyi dpang rtags zhes pa rdzun bzo byas/ kho pa tshos rdzun bzo byas pa'i 7paṇa chen gyi nag nyes dpang rtags bcu ni /dang po/ bod kyi lugs srol bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin bskyar gso byed pa//de ni phyi lo 196 dang 1964 lo gnyis ring / 7paṇa chen rin po che bzhugs gling rdo rje pho brang du bzang btson byed skabs/ bkra shis lhun po'i sku rten bkug nas thugs brtag zhus pa'i mo yig dang /sku nyid kyi mnal lam las 'byung 'gyur gyi las dbang brtag pa'i ma nal lam zin bris rnams la bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin bskyar gso byed ma khan du nyes btsugs byas/)gnyis pa/ dka' chen dbang po dmar gsod btang ba//de ni rgya mis bkod jus bzhin gzhis rtse bsod nams lha mos/ 'phrul 'khor slob ga'i ru dpon dka' chen dbang po las don drang bzhag ma byung bas/ 'phrul 'khor slob grwa'i slob phrug 'gas bsad pa de/ 7paṇa chen bcu pas bkrongs pa'i bsgo na btsugs byas nas 'thab 'dzing phul/)gsum pa/ nga phod la me mda' gcig dang / mde'u brgya tham pa sprad skyedud pa/bzhi pa/ ma'o 'jab dmag rgyag stangs skor la gsang ba'i bzo grwa btsugs te/ rgya dmar la tshur rgol bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi bzos pa/(de ni gyi lo 19587paṇa chen rin po ches gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i 'phrul 'khor slob grwar/ 'jab dam ga yin pa'i nyes btsugs byas/lnga pa/ bud med dang lus 'brel byas yod pa/(de ni rgya mis bkod jus bzhin 'phags pa lhas/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches khong nyid kyi gcung po mgon po skyabs kyi sku zla pad+ma dbyang can dang 369

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'juga'agab mthun log g.yen byas tshul bston btsugs kyis 'thab 'dzing phul/ rjes su btsan g.yem gyi nag nyes drangs )drug pa/ gzhung la ngo rgol gyi yig 'bru khri bdun bris yod pa//de 7paṇa chen ren ngo ches dmangs gtso bcos sgyur dang ngo lo ga zing 'khrug zhod 'jalas zer ba'i khrod/ bod mi dmangs la bzod dka' ba'i dka' ngal gang 'dra da yig thos tu bkod nas rgya nag gzhung la phul bar/ gung khran tang la glang smyon lta ra gyi ngo rgol byed mkhan du bsgon btsugs kyis 'thab 'dzing phul/)bdun pa/ log spyod tā la'i bla ma la dad mos dang / mi mang bskong nas log spyod tā lar bstod glu dbyangs blangs pa//de ni phye lo 1964 lor/ gtsug lag khang gi gsung chos ra ba'i tshogs mgon nas / kyang cing cis 7gong ma chog la dgag pa rgyag dgos pa'i btsan bka' btang yang / 7paṇa chen bcu pas7gong sa mchog bod mi'i chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid yin pa dang /bod mi dam ngas kyi bde gyid kyi 'byung rtsa yin/ 7song sa ma chog la dad gus yod pa'i bka' slob khrom bsgra gas gnang bar/ log spyod par dad mos dang bstod glu blangs pa'i nyes pa btsugs te 'thab 'dzing phul/)brgyad pa/ rta dmag sgrig 'dzugs byas yod pa//de ni rgya mis bkod jus bzhin dgon pa gsar thub bsta na 'jigs grags kyis/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher de sngon sog pos phul ba'i rta pho 20yo da pa rnams la/ rta dmag sgrig 'dzugs byas te gung khyan tang la dmag rgyag rgyu dang / pham nyes byung na bros byol du 'gro ba'i ngan 'char sgrig par bston btsugs byas te 'thab 'dzing phul/)dgu pa/ dgon sde khag nas lha rten brkus 'khyer byas yod pa//deni phyi lo 1962 lor ma 'ongs sngon gzigs lta bu/ bod dbus gtsang khul gyi rten snying grags can ra sgreng gi sdo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje dang / ra tshags kyi rnal 'byor ma sogs bor brlag mi 'byung ba'i ched bsdu rub gnang ba rnams la brkus pa 'i bston 'dzugs byas te 'thab 'dzing phul/)bcu pa/ a mi ri kya'i gnam gru gtong bar mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur 370
