7paṇa chen nar te gi zhib 'jugagasungs don/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang btsugs nas lo bcu tsam phyin pa red/ kru'u ren ngo ma 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog red/ngos rang phyi lo 1959 lo nas kru'u ren las tshab la bsko gzhag byas byung /lo de'i ring ngos rang bsam blo'i gnas tshad mtho po med rkyen skyon dang nor 'khrul byung yod srid/ yin na'ang / blo mthun krang go ha dang zung sbrel gyis las don byas pa ma gtogs/ rang dgar thag gcod byes pa gang yang med/re bar tshogs thog 'di nas mi dmangs la dgongs bzhes kyis dgongs 'char don dngos dang mthun pa gnang rogs gsungs/tshogs 'du ming la bsam 'char tshogs 'du zhes btags yod kyang /dmigs yul gtso bo 7paṇa chen mchog la dgag rgyag skyon brjod zhu rgyu yin pas/dmag dpon krang ho has sngon nas gra sgrig yod pa ltar/ lha smon ye shes tshul khrims la gtam bshad bya dgos pa'i skul slong byas/ lha smon ye shes tshul khrims kyis gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gis gsar brje byed rgyu'i las don byed rgyu lta ci/da dung mang tshogs kyi rkang lag nas phyir 'then byed mkhan yang yod/ 'di dag tshang ma gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi skyon yin tshul bshad/de bzhin 'phags pa lhas skyon chen po yong sa rtsa ba ni 7paṇa chen la rags las yod/ de ring ngas gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin las tshab 7paṇa chen la bsam 'char gtong rgyur/ khyed nas gus par bla ma khra khra dang /chos 'bag gyon pa'i mi red gsungs byung / 'di 'dra ba'i gnas tshul mang po yod/ byas tsang gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi las don nang grub 'bras med par/skyon yong dgos pa ni 7paṇa chen rin po ches bzos pa sha stag red ces skyon brjod byas/46 khong gnyis kyi skyon brjod de dag ma nyes khag zhe gcig yin mod/45bsre gas kyang mi 'tshig pa'i bod shog ngos 9canang /kunabazang dpa la 'byor gyis brtsams/dpa la 'byor par khang /372

skya che'i bar gyi cha/dus skabs der skyon brjod phog min la lta dgos kyi med/phyi lo 1964 zla 8 tshes 5 nyin/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi tshogs khang du/ krang go ha g.yas su bsdad pa dang grang cing u g.yon du bsdad/ kho gnyis kyis 7paṇa chen rin po che dkyil btsir btang ba/krang go has 7paṇa chen rin po che'i nag nyes bcu khyab bsgrags dang sbrags/7paṇa chen gyis nges med rgol brdung dmag btsugs te/ ngo log zing 'khrug slong ba'i re ngan bcangs pa red/ khyed tshos bkag rdo chen po 'di gtor dgos/7paṇa chen ni dug sbral zhig red/ de ring nga tshos dug sbral gyi nang cha bton dgos/ zhes tshig ngar+sha bsgrags pa dang / ༄'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal (bod kyi grags can gyi sprul sku dang chab mdo byams pa gling gi dgon bdag dang bla ma/ yo ngas grags su 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'thab 'dzing gtong bzhin pa'i sku par zhig mjal rgyu yod pa'i g.yon ngos nas ngo gdong tsam mthong thub pa'i mi zhig yod de 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal red//yar langs nas 7paṇa chen rin po che'i zhal ras la 'gram lcag gzhus shing / thu lud btab nas 'thab rtsod kyi 'go tshugs pa dang /seng chen blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang /(rgyal rtse 'brong rtse dgon gyi dgon bdag dang bkras lhun dgon pa'i sprul sku yin//bsam sding rdo rje phag mo/(bsam lding dgon gyi dgon bdag dang bod kyi bud med kyi sprul sku che shos zhig yin/)rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs//phyi lo 1959gong rtse mgron yin zhing / phyi lo 2011 lor 'das //lha smon bsod nams lhun grub//de snga lapaṇa chen rin po che'i drung yig yin/ lo rabs 80 nang 7paṇa chen bcu par 'gyod bshags rim par phul/)phran rtsa rta mgrin rgyal rngo1//de snga bkras lhun bla brang gi zhabs gras yin/ lo rabs 80 nang 'gyod bshags rim par phul/mtshan zhabs rgya mtsho gling rin po che/(khong gi mtshan cha tshang rgya ma tsho gling thub bstan skal bzang zhu zhing / 7gong sa bcu bzhi pa'i mtshan zhabs zhu myong / da lta yongs grags su 7pa ṇa chen rin po cher 'thab 'dzing gtong bzhin pa'i sku par zhig mjal rgyu yod pa'i nang / g.yas su sku gzan bzhes pa'i 373

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhi' 'jugabla ma zhig yod pa de rgya ma/tsho gling rin ngo che red/)spom mda' stobs rgyas/(smar khams spom mda' tshang gi bu yin//dgon pa gsar thub bstan 'jigs bral/(kho ni dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur dang rig gnas gsar brje'i ska bas hur brtson can zhig red//bcas pas/ gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis rdog rgyag dang 'gram lcag gzhu bzhin/7paṇa chen log spyod mgo sgur dgos/7paṇa chen log spyod pas rang skyon ngos len byed dgos/ zhes pa'i 'ur sgra'i khrod du 'thab 'dzing phul/47kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la 'thab 'dzing phul rgyu khas len mi gnang mkhan tshor/ 7paṇa chen 'bring pa dang / 7paṇa chen chung ba/7paṇa chen ru tshogs kyi ming gnas 'dra min btags nas/ lha 'dre gdon gegs kyi 'bod sgra bsgrags te/ dgag pa/ 'thab rtsod/ do dam btson 'jug sogs byas/ thengs shig krang go has de mo rin po cher 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la 'thab 'dzing gtong bar sdings cha'i sgang yong dgos pa'i skul slong byas kyang /de mo rin po ches khong khro'i ngang tshogs ra nas zhal gyes zhus stabs/ phyis su lha 'dre gdon gegs kyi zha mo/ g.yogs nas 'thab 'dzing btang zhing /48 yongs 'dzin dngul chu rin po che sdug gsod khrod sku 'das pa dang / dza sag ci 'jigs med sogs/ lha 'dre gdon bgegs su brtsis te 'thab 'dzing dang btson 'jug dra/sa/7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mchog la 'thab 'dzing dang skyon brjod zhu mkhan gatherdo nges zhig 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal red 'dug 'phags pa lhas hur brtson pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin nas 'thab rtsod byed don ni/thengs 7pa chen rin po ches 'phags pa lhar/ khyed rang gi mdzad spyod 47bden ngon las la ba'i sgron me/thog ngos 2 9nang /lha phrug yis brtsam sa /bde srung la sa khungs kyi par 'grem sa byas /pyi 'o naX04lor/sku bod don gleng ba/'og ngos nan nang /dbang 'dus kyis brtsams/bod ljongs ri dam ngas dpe byu na lang /bye 'o ci1999lo ra/374

sku che'i bar gyi cha/de dam pa dang phal pa gang du yang ma 'dus pa'i spyod pa zhig tu 'gro yi 'dug pa'i bka' phebs pa 'phags pa lha'i thugs la phan tshab gnod du gyur pa gsungs la/sprul sku seng chen blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis 'thab 'dzing phul skabs// dbu sgur mi gnang bar seng chen la spyan khro mig ldir nas bzhugs pa gsungs/'thab rtsod dang thog ma'i nyin 17 ring / shing gi pho rtags bzos te bshang lam nang brgyus pa sogs/ dus rabs bar ma'i yo rob gling gi kla klo'i byed thabs 'ga' rgya nag gung khran tang gis/ nub phyogs bde ldan zhing gi mgon skyabs kun gzigs 7paṇa chen snang ba mtha' g.yas kyi sku lus steng spyad 'dug phyi lo 1964 zla 9 tshes 18 nyin/ krang go ha yis 'go brjod du/dus bab ngos 'dzin gsal por byas te/ mthun sgril la shugs snon dang 'thab rtsod la shugs snon brgyab ste/ dmangs gtso'i gsar brje mthar phyin legs sgrub thub pa'i ched dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs sgyur bkod la cha rkyen bzo ba'i ched 'bad brtson bya dgos pa'i chab srid las don gyi gtam bshad snyan sgron byas/deni 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la rdung rdeg tsha nan gyi 'thab rtsod dang / dgag pa rgyag pa 'i las rim 'go 'dzugs dgos pa'i skul brda zhig red/rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la/ hur brtson can dang / dmar srung dmag tshos 'thab 'dzing ji ltar btang yod med dngos su gzigs myong ba'i ser smad ri 'bur sprul skus gsungs na/rang skyong ljongs tshogs 'du'i thog log spyod 7paṇa chen dang / dgra dang rang phyogs kyi dbye mtshams bcad nas gting zab kyis dgag pa brgyab ste/ gnad don gsal 'don thub pa dgos zhes bshad song /375

7'kho chen zher te ni zhib 'dugade nas kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che gdan drangs byung / brjid nyams kyis byon nas zhabs stegs shig tu bzhugs grabs mdzad song bar/rgya rigs las byed cig gis khyod rang der sdod pa'i dus tshod yol zin pa red sa gdan thog sdod bshad song / rin po che lam seng sa gdan thog skyil krung mdzad de/ nyams snang med par bzhugs song bar skyi g.ya' ba zhig byung /zhib tu mjal bas zhal ra dang zhal rgyan sor gang tsam pa nag sog ger 'dug pas/ gzim chung du zhal ra 'breg byed tshun bsdus pa yin nam/yang na nyin mo rtag tu 'thab 'dzing tshogs chen du gdan zhus byas/ snga dgong dri ba bar mtshams med par zhus pas zhal ra breg pa'i long ma byung ba yin nam snyam pa zhig byung / skabs der na bza' ther ma du mdog gi phyu chen zhig dang /gru'u ser gyi sku 'jug cig bzhes/ mgul du phyag phreng cig kyang bzhes 'dug pa mjal/hur brtson can dang rgyal gces yar thon pa tshos 'thab 'dzing 'dri rtsad byed skabs/ zhal 'dzum pa tsam las bka' lan ye nas ma gnang /mtshams shig ring sku bzhengs gnang ste dbu sgur re bzhugs su bcug song /dbu dud spyan btsum nas dar cig bzhugs skabs/ rgya dpon tshos khyod mig btsum nas bsam blo ga re gtong gi yod ces mtha' bkar gtong dus/7paṇa chen rin po ches/ rgyal khrims lci pos gnya' ba mnan nas ngal ba mi bzad pa myong ba'i skabs 'dir/ ston pa shākya thub pa yid la dran nas 'dug pa las/ gzhan gang yang dran gyi mi 'dug gsungs/49kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi dgongs par lhag bsam 49dge rig las kyi myong ba/deb gnyis pa/shog15 nang /ser smad ri 'bur sprul skus brtsams /shes rig pa ra khang /phyi lo 1989lor/376

skya che'i bar gyi cha/rnam dag gi sgo nas bod mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal rnams/ rgya nag gzhung la yar zhu byas pa de ni rang nyid kyis dor du med pa'i las 'gan zhig dang / yang dag pa'i byed stangs shig yin pa las/ sku nyid kyi nor 'khrul gyi bya ba gang yang byas med pa dgongs bzhin yod la/bsam 'char yig cha de ni zing 'khrugs zhod 'jags dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur gyi 'bras bus/ bod mi dmangs la bzod dka' ba'i sdug bsngal sbyin pa'i gnas tshul ji bzhin bris pa zhig yin pas/ de bas kyang rang nyid kyi byed stangs ni yang dag pa zhig yin par dgongs bzhin yod stabs/mdung rtse kha sprod kyis rang nyid dag 'bud gnang zhing / skabs 'gar kha rtsod drag po bskyon te/ mdun cog thog phyag mtshur zhu ba dang / gsol ja'i bzhes phor g.yugs pa/ dgag yig dbral ba sogs gnang /slar yang 'thab rtsod nyin 45 byas rjes/ krang go has tshogs chen bskongs te/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher khrims gcod gang 'dra byed dgos min bsam 'char bsdu skabs/ chab srid gros tshogs kyi dpon rigs 'gas srog thog gtong dgos zhes dang / hur brtson can 'gas rgyang 'bud gtong dgos/btson 'jug byed dgos zhes bshad/ dus bkag btson bcug gi khrims thag gcod dgos pa'i bsam 'char sna tshogs shig bshad/krang go has nga tsho gung khran tang gis mi spyod ring lugs lag bstar byas te/ 7paṇa chen srog thog gtong gi ma red brjod kyang / 'thab 'dzing tshogs 'du skabs yab yum dang / yongs 'dzin dngul chuspru/ sku sger gyi las byed bskongs nas 'thab rtsod btang yod/yongs 'a dzin dngul chu rin po che dang phyag mdzod gnyis 'thab rtsod 377

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'juga'og tu sku srog shor zhing /50gnyan shul mkhyen rab 'od zer sogs 7paṇa 'bring ru tshogs dang /kyi /nor brang o rgyan sogs 7paṇa chung ru tshogs/32 bla brang zhabs 'bring rnams 7paṇa chen ru tshogs kyi ming gnas sprad de snga rjes su mi grangs 3000 lhag zin par 'thab 'dzing dang / rdung rdeg nyes zha g.yog pa sogs byas pa ma zad/ mi grangs 500 tsam la rnam pa 'dra min gyi khrims gcod btang 'dug53rgya nag gzhung gis thog mar yig 'bru khri bdun gyi snyan zhur bsnyad nas/7paṇa chen rin po che sku rkyang la 'thab rtsod btang yang / phyis su bkras lhun bla brang gi zhabs 'bring gtso bo lha smon dang / ci 'jigs med/ dngul chu rin po che/seng ge dpal ldan sogs tshang ma 7paṇa chen tshogs pa'i ngan jus 'don mkhan zhes brjod nas/ rkyang ṇa chen ru tshogs dang / 7paṇa chen rgyal khab ngo rgol tshogs pa zer ba sogs phyir bton byas/gzhis ka rtse dang lha sar 7paṇa chen chogs pas tang la ngo rgol dang rgyal khab la ngo log byed pa'i nyes spyod kyi 'grem ston byas pa ma zad/ hur brtson can dang / yar langs zhing bran khri ma 'bum skul slong byas te/ rnga rdung dar 'phyar gyis ther 'don dang 'thab rtsod byas/ mdor na/ khong dang khong gi sku 'khor tsam ma zad/ bod kyi ched du phyag las gnang mkhan tshang mar 7paṇa chen ru tshogs kyi nyes pa g.yogs nas 'thab rtsod phul/5༷ phye ma 19paXzla 7shes bya/byi dri la sa khungs /51dge sdig la sa kyi myo nga ba/deb gnyis pa /shog ngos 16danang /1989lor/52nor brang o rgyan byi gsung rtsom phyogs btus /shog799nang /spung go bod ris/ pa dpe skrun khang /naX lo ra/5 skyo dmar gyis bod nang mi spyo da la sa 'das pa'i bya ngan ji byas dngos byung gnas 'u gas rags bsdus/zhog ngos 51munang bod gzhung shes rig dpa ra khang /378

skru che'i bar gyi cha/tang rgol 7paṇa chen ru tshogs kyis rgyal khab la ngo rgol dang / tang la ngo rgol/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la ngo rgol byas pa'i nyes spyod 'grems ston/ zhes pa zhig da lta bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo tshugs yul drung spyi gling khar bshams/7paṇa chen gyi nyes spyod 'grems ston zer ba'i nang / me mda' dang / me skyogs/'jib 'khor/ tar 'phrin gyi yo chas/ rdo rje dmag zer ba'i dar cha/ ra sgreng gi jo bo/ ra tshag gi rnal 'byor ma/ shel brag gi slob dpon/ lha ru sman pa'i rgyal po/bsam yas bse pags smug chung zhal 'bag sogs bkrams nas/ de dag 7paṇa chen rin po ches gsar brjer ngo rgol byas pa'i nag nyes su bgrangs/skabs der 'grems ston khang der dngos su lta skor la 'gro myong ba'i bka' zur zhe bo bla bzang dar rgyas lags kyis gsungs na/ 7paṇa chen gyi nag nyes ther 'don gyi 'grems ston khang de'i nang / paṇa chen gyis nga'i lag pa bcad song zer mkhan mi lag g.yon pa med pa zhig gis/ nga'i lag pa bcad pa de 'di yin zhes/ am phrag nang nas kho rang gi lag pa las che ba'i lag pa skam po zhig ston tsam ston tsam byed kyi 'dug pa gsungs/54wu'u lan h+phu'u yis phul ba'i rta bcu bzhi sogs la/ rta dmag sbyong brdar gyis ri khul du 'jab dmag gra sgrig dang / khrin dbyis kyis phul ba'i dmag khyi bcu la/ gsar brje ngo rgol gyi gsang myul ru khag 'phrul 'khor slob grwa'i dge slob kyis lag rtsal tshod lta byas pa'i rlangs 'khor rnams la/ ngo log zing 'khrug pham nyes byung na rlangs 'khor nang bsdad na rgya gar la bros byol du 'gro'i nyes pa sogs btsugs/da dung / 'phrul 'khor slob grwar gsar rjer ngo rgol gyi mi sna gso skyong 54zhe po blo bzang dar byus kyi mi phro byung ba brjod pa /'os ngos na5nang /nor gling bod kyi reg gzhung gces skyo nga lang na008lor/379

7paṇa chen zheng te ni zhing 'jug byed sa yin pa bshad de/ rnga rdung dar 'phyar gyi sgo nas log spyod 7paṇa chen pham par rgyobs/ zhes pa'i 'bod sgra bsgrags te 'thab rtsod byas/'phrul 'khor slob grwa tang rgol dang gsar rjer ngo rgol byed sa'i rten gzhi zhig yin tshul shod pa ni ma nyes kha g.yogs rang red 'dug ste/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku ngo ma'i zhal sgo las nyan shan la 'di ltar gsungs yod/ nga rang gi 'gram du yod pa'i mi rnams rub rub bzos nas lag rtsal slob tu bcug ste rlangs 'khor gtong rgyu slob tu bcug pa dang / lag rtsal yod pa'i bzo pa kha shas skyed sring byas pa de red gsungs/7paṇa chen rin po ches ma nyes kha g.yog gis gyod gzhi dang yig 'bru khri bdun gyi gnad don skor bod nang gsal bshad bya thabs bral bas/pe cing du ma'o dang kra'u e len sogs la zhu gtugs 'grel brjod du 'gro chog pa'i re 'dun zhus kyang dang len byed mkhan med la/ rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi thengs bdun pa'i tshogs thog nas/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi gtso 'dzin las tshab kyi go gnas med pa bzos/tshogs 'du mjul sgril ma thag 7paṇa chen rin po ches tang la ngo rgol dang / mi dmangs la ngo rgol/ spyi tshogs ring lugs la ngo rgol byed pa'i zhwa mo gsum g.yogs/bka' zur nga phod kyis krang go ha la/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i gnad don ji tsam tshabs che na'ang / dgag pa nan po ji ltar rgyag dgos rung go gnas gnas dbyung btang mi rung ba dang / bka' zur nga phod rang nyid kyi bsam tshul de/ krang go ha brgyud rgya nag dbus gzhung la gsung ba'i re ba bton kyang don du 'khyol mi 'dug380

skya che'i bar gyi cha/phyi lo 1964 zla 10 nang kra'u e len gyis/ skabs gsum pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen gyi steng srid gzhung gi snyan sgron skabs/rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis bod mi dmangs kyi re ba ltar/ tā la'i bla ma'i rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi 'gan 'dzin las gnas dang mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi tshogs gzhon/ paṇa chen 'gan 'dzin las tshab dang 'thus mi'i las 'gan med pa bzos pa'i khyab bsgrags dang sbrags/ nga chos paṇa chen la bcos sgyur gtong ched ches mtha' ma'i go skabs shig sprod rgyu yin/ kho pa da lta nga tsho'i tshogs mi dkyus ma zhig yin pa bshad/phyi lo 1964 zla 12 nang srid blon kra'u e len gyi bka' ltar/7paṇa chen bcu pa'i phyag zung la lcags kyi bcings te/ btson skyel rlangs 'khor nang blugs nas pe cing du btsan khrid byas/ dus de nas phyi lo 1974bar 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gnas tshul sus kyang shes kyi med stabs/ 7gong sa mchog dang bod mi dmangs kyi thugs la/ rgya nag gzhung gis 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku bkrongs pa'i dogs pa dang thugs 'tshab chen po byung 'dugaphyi lo 1961 zla 4 tshes 19 nyin/ ldi li gsar khang gis/ bod mi tshos rgya nag dmar shog gis 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku bkrongs pa'i tshod dpag byed kyi yod pa bshad pa ma zad/ phyi lo 1965 zla 7 tshes 27 nyin/ dpal ldan sku sger yig tshang nas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku bkrongs pa'am yang na/pe cing du btsan khrid byas pa gang yin shes kyi med pa'i bsgrags gtam spel 'dug phyi lo 1965 zla 7 tshes 30 nyin/ ldi li gsar pa'i tshags shog steng /7paṇa chen bcu pa rgya dmar gzhung gis dmar gsod btang ba'i gnas tshul yang thon yod/ 381

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhi' 'dugaphyi lo 1967 zla 3 tshes 16 nyin/ re'u ṭar gsang khang gis/7gong sa mchog la 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i gnas tshul bcar 'dri zhus pa'i bka' lan du/ 7paṇa chen rin po che sku bkrongs pa'i dogs pa yod/ phyi lo 1964lo nas khong gi gnas tshul go thos gang yang ma byung gsungs/bod mi rnams kyis 'phags pa lha dang / seng chen/ bsam sding rdo rje phag mo/ rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs/ lha smon bsod nams lhun grub/dgon pa gsar thub bstan 'jigs bral/ phran rtsa rta mgrin rgyal po sogs la/rgya gzhung gis che mthong byas nas go gnas spar ba 'di/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la 'thab 'dzing btang ba las byung ba zhig yin pas/ kho tsho'i go gnas kyi rkastob stegs der/ 7paṇa spar zhes zur za dang 'phya smod byed kyi yod/lo rabs 80 nang / de snga'i bla brang gi zhabs 'bring lha smon bsod nams lhun grub dang / phran rtsa rta ma/grin rgyal pos 7paṇa chen bcu par bzod gsol gyi bshags pa 'bul bar bcar skabs/ thugs khros pa'i bzhin las/rta mgrin rgyal po/ yang nga la 'thab 'dzing gtong bar yong ba yin nam zhes gsungs/ phran rtsa rta 'phrin rgyal po sogs kyis bzod gsol snyan zhu rim par phul stabs/ thugs dngas pa'i bka' las/ de snga'i rnyog gleng tshang ma yar klung gtsang por bskyur dgos gsungs/ phyi lo 1987 lor/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches gzhis ka rtse skyid skyid na gar mi mang la bka' slob gnang skabs/ de sngon rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs mi dmangs la 'thab rtsod gtong mkhan skor zhigadeng sang yang ngos kyi mdun du kha btags 'khyer nas skyabs 'jug yong ba shod kyi/ sngon thon pa ni sngon thon pa rang red/ sngon ma sngon thon pa yin pa ma zad/deng sang ngos kyi mdun du yong dus kyang sngon thon pa red 'dug gsungs/ /382

skya che'i bar gyi cha/le tshan bdun pa/ lo dgu zla brgyad kyi bcon ra'i 'tsho me/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po mchog lo dgu dang zla brgyad kyi ring mun pa'i btson du 'jug mkhan su yin nam/ mi lo bcu bzhi do dam dang bcon 'jug byas pa'i lo zla'i nang / khong la bzod dka' ba'i mnar gcod dang sku ngal ji tsam byung yod/yang snying 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos nag nyes gang zhig bsags yod dam/ bod 'bangs sdul bsngal las skyob pa'i gdung 'bod (leg 'bru khri bdun//snyan zhu dang / 7gong sa mchog la dad sems kyi bstod pa phul ba gnyis/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog btson dong 'grim pa'i nag zhes su bgrangs 'dug phyi lo 1979 lor/ btsan bod gzhung gi sku tshab rnams la gsungs don/ ngos btson khang du 'jug rgyu'i nag nyes gnyis bgrangs byung / dang po/khyed kyis tā la'i log spyod dgra bor bstod bsngags btang ba de gang mi tshad yin/zhes 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa'i smon lam btab pa nag nyes su bgrangs byung /gnyis pa/ khyod la bla brang rgyal mtshan mtho'i thob thang ma gtogs/bod yul gzhan gyi 'gan khur jus gtogs med kyang / yig 'bru khri bdun gyi nang khyed kyis bod sa stod smad bar gsum gyi gnas tshul la jus med jus 383

7paṇa chen zher te gi zhing 'jugagatogs byas te/ khams a mdo bcas pa'i lo rgyus bgrangs te snyan zhu phul rgyu de/khyed kyis khyed rang la thob thang med pa'i las ka ma 'os pa byas pa red/ zhes rgyu mtshan de gnyis bgrangs nas btson 'jug byas byung gsungs/557paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dus yun mi lo dgu dang zla ba brgyad kyi ring du mun pa'i btson khang 'grims pa de/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pas g.yeng med ri la sgom sgrub bskyon pa'i lo zla dang mnyam yang / pe ta dang mdzes se rnam gnyis kyis rje btsun la sgom rgyags chu sdor phul zhing thugs gso la phebs pa bzhin/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher sems gso'i 'tshams 'dri zhu mkhan lta ci/da dung btson srung ba tshos mthong chung dang / sdigs dmod/ nges med kyi brnyas bcos bzed dgos pa 'di/ stag seng kha sprod lta bu'i kha ba gangs can pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnam gnyis kyis/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dang bod mi rigs ched ngal ba lhur du bzhes skabs/ 'phrad pa'i sku ngal las mi 'dra sa gtso bo zhig red/phyi lo 1964 lor/ srid blon kra'u e len gyis de snga pe cing dmangs garu'i mi drag u yon krang gzhon pa gran cun ru'u yi sdod khang du bzhugs gnas bkod sgrig byas/ 7paṇa chen rin po che pe cing du phebs 'byor zin pa'i 'go stod/ nyin ltar mi rigs u yon gyi zab sbyong 'dzin grwa grol ba dang / glog gnon bzo gyur ngal rtsol sgyur bkod du phebs dgos/pe cing gi dpon rigs tshos/ khyod rang gi mes rgyal la rgyab gtod byas te zing 'khrug bslangs nas/ mes rgyal kha bral du gtong dgos bsam gyi yod pa red/ khyed rang tsho bod rigs yongs kyi drag chas spras na'ang / mi grangs khri sum 555ngo 'ju chen la bcar 'dra zhus pa 'i tshig tho/gong tshes nyin/384

skya che'i bar gyi cha/brgya tsam las med pas ha las rgyu ga red yod ces/ ngag thog gi skyon brjod las/lha sa ltar dza drag gi 'thab rtsod bzed dgos med pas/ dmyal ba yang gsos kyi bde snang zhig thob mod/ stabs ma legs pa zhig la/ phyi lo 1966 lor/rig gnas gsar brje'i drag char gyi rlabs rgyun rgya nag gi mtha' dbus kun la ldang 'go tshugs/ma'o tse tung gis rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul de/ krung go'i ma rtsa ring lugs dbang bsgyur gral rim la phyogs pa'i dbang 'dzin pa tshor 'thab rtsod byed rgyu yin mod/ las dbang dang bsod bde dman pa zhig la/bod du ma rtsa ring lugs la 'gro ba'i gnad don med pas/ bod kyi rig gnas gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod kyi kha phyogs yongs rdzogs/ 7gong sa mchog dang 7paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis la dgag rgyag 'thab 'dzing dgos pa'i thog tu drangs 'dugabod kyi ri klung gang sar tā la'i ru tshogs dang / paṇa chen ru tshogs la dgag rgyag dang / 'thab rtsod byed rgyu'i 'ur sgras gnam sa yongs su khengs/las dbang gi bkod sgrig cig gis/ 7gong sa mchog srid don nyen g.yol du chibs kha legs grub kyis/ 'phags yul byang phyogs kyi dh+wa ram shā lar bod mang gtso'i srid gzhung gsar 'dzugs kyi mdzad pa rgyas bzhin yod stabs/mi dmangs kyi bu phrug tu bston pa'i hur brtson can dang / dmar srung dmag gi ru tshogs rnams/ gnam gyi ka bar 'bod pa'i ri bo hi ma la ya brgal te/7gong sa mchog la dgag rgyag 'thab rtsod byed pa'i go skabs yongs su shor bas/'khang ra'i sdug yus dang 'thab rtsod kyi ngar shugs yod tshad/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku rkyang gi steng du drangs/385

7paṇa chen ser te ni gis 'jugabod ljongs mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dmar srung dmag khag cig pe cing du phyin te/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang / rgyal sa'i mtho slob kyi dmar srung dmag dang mnyam 'brel bgyis nas/ 7paṇa chen la 'thab rtsod dgos pa'i 'bod sgra bsgrags/ phyi lo 1966 zla 3 tshes 10 nyin/ gsum bcu'i dus dran thongs drug pa'i steng / 7gong sa mchog gis 7paṇa chen rin po ches sangs bstan pa'i don du sku srog blos btang gnang ba'i mdzad pa ni/ sems dpa' chen po'i mdzad pa yin pas/ nga tshos nges par du rjes dran bya 'os pa dang /khong tsho'i snying stobs la nyams len dang mig dpe bya dgos pa zhig red/ dam pa de dag gi sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i smon lam 'debs dgos pa ni/ nga tshor skabs su babs pa zhig yin pa'i gsal bsgrags gnang /36tag tag lo de'i zla na mtshan mo zhig dmar srung dmag skor zhig7paṇa chen rin po che'i gzim shag nang 'dzul nas/ zog 'dren rlangs 'khor zhig gi nang btsan khrid zhus te/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa'i nang bkag nyar byas zhing / slob grwa'i nang gi dmar srung dmag stong phrag gis skyon brjod 'thab rtsod dang / gang 'dod kyi dri brtsad/ glog skud (ne lon gyi thag pa phra mo//phra mos sku gzugs bcings/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku sha rgyags pa yin stabs/glog skud sha gseng du thim nas mi mngon par gyur/ khong gis yang nas yang du glog skud glod pa'i re ba zhus kyang dang len byed mkhan lta ci/ da dung bzhin la mchil ma gtor zhing / nyes dung dang / tshig rtsub kyi smad ra btab/5755chab srid grwa ma sto na 〈195༷nas 1980〉shog ngos 9༷nang /snar thang pa ra khang /pyi 'o 1986lo ra/57 41te/41/yoX batha' 152 2// 07340 677khriche/༷ bya 8 9༷386

skya che'i bar gyi cha/dus skabs der rgya nag dbus gzhung las byed slob grwa'i chab srid dge rgan gnang bzhin pa'i bkra yon gyi gsungs na/ phyi lo 1966 lor/rgya nag gi rgyal sa pe cing du yod pa'i bod rigs dmag srung dmag tshos/bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin skabs kyi slob gso do dam khang du bzhugs pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'thab 'dzing gtong phyir/ krung dbyang mi rigs slob gling du 7paṇa chen rin po che dang sku 'khor tshang ma gdan 'dren zhus song /dmar srung dmag tshos 7paṇa chen rin po che'i gcung po'i sku zla pad dbyangs kyi mgo skra zang zing du breg pa dang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po che phebs 'khor las gzhol ma thag dmag srung dmag tshos me tog la bung ba 'khor ba bzhin rgyug yong ste/ shed shugs chen pos phar tshur 'bud rgyag dang / dog rgyag khur tshur zhus te 'thab 'dzing btang song /58dmar srung dmag tshos 'thab 'dzing gtong skabs/ rta lcags dang 'dra ba'i lko pa'i ske rags bzhus shing / lko pa'i ske rag gi lcags kyi thub chi 'am chab tse sa la zag kyang mtshams 'jog ma byas par 'thab 'dzing btang song /nyi ma tsha gdugs che zhing 'thab 'dzing nyin gang btang bas/ rin po che'i dbu skra'i gseng nas rngul chu khrum khrum du bzhur bzhin 'dug 'on kyang / khong ni blo stobs dang ldan pa zhig yin stabs/ gsung skad thengs gcig kyang skyon gyi mi 'dug gsungs/59phyi lo 1979 lor/ rgya lo don grub lags kyis pe cing du 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog mjal 'phrad zhu skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches khong nyid kyi sku stod kyi na bza' phud nas/ rig gnas gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod khrod/58 6474627 bcu 500 4lha 77/ bska 47lo:ma 200059cha kro/83 ta2 nya brtsa 500 lta 07 ho rke7lo: 2009387

gsungs/73a'o si the lu'o h+phu si cis/ nga gson por gnas pa ni nam yang ngas ji ltar byas nas/ yang bskyar las don 'ga' zhig bsgrub thub pa'i ched du yin gsungs pa bzhin/ rig gnas gsar brje'i 'thab rtsod 'di'i 'og nas/7paṇa chen rinapo che gson por 'tsho ba'i thugs re btang myong la/ 'thab rtsod kyi 'tshub kha dza drag pas rang shi skyo na rgyu'i dgongs pa'ang thengs mang bzhes 'dug la/74skabs 'ga' zhig tu rang shi skyon rtsis kyang gnang tshod/ 'on kyang / 'chi ba srog la thug kyang bod mi rigs dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa blos gtong mi rung zhing /75 slar yang bod mi rigs dang sangs rgyal bstan pa'i ched phyag las gnang 'dod kyis/ btson khang gi 'go khrid tshor/ khyed tshos nga stos mi gcig gi gzugs po 'di btson khang chung chung zhig gi nang bcug pa 'di/gung khran tang gi stobs shugs red/ 'on kyang / nga'i rnam par shes pa 'di khyed tshos dus nam yang bdag po rgyag thub kyi ma red/76 gsung bzhin sku gshegs mi nyan pa'i dam bca' brtan por bcangs/phyi lo 1974 zla zha nang srid blon kra'u e lan gyis bka' zur nga phod la/ 7paṇa chen rin po che phyag las gnang du 'jug dgos gsungs kyang /chab srid dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis bka' zur nga phod kyis lag len du 'khyol med pa ni ha cang blo pham pa'i gnas shig yin/ phyi lo 1964 nas 1978 bar gyi mi lo 14 ring / kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi gnas stangs ji chags la/7 pyi yu la du rang dbang /'os ngos 4 nanang /dzo/ཿ lung blo bzang dpa la ldan gyis bskyur/sdi li bod khang /byi lo naX8lor/74sku ngo zu 'o don grub la bcar 'dri zhus ri 'i tshig tho/song tshes nyin/75phyi lo 1985bde chen pho brang du bka' dbang gnang skabs kyi bka' slob/76'ju chen bub bstan la bcar 'dri zhus pa 'i tshig tho/nang tshesanyin/395

go lo thos lo zhig las khungs 'pher ba zhig su'ang shod rgyu mi 'dugaphyi lo 1967 zla 9 tshes 9 nyin/ bod rang skyong ljongs zhes pa'i dpon rigs shig gis/ 7paṇa chen rin po che rgya nag gi ngal rtsol sgyur bkod khang nas/rgyal khab gzhan du bros byol phebs pa'i bsgrags gtam spel stabs/ mi rnams kyis rgya nag gzhung gis bkrongs pa dang / zos byol du phebs na rgyal khab gang du phebs min la shod tshul 'dra min zhig byung 'dugaphyi lo 1969 zla 10 tshes 10 nyin/ rda ram shā la nas 7gong sa mchog gis/ 7paṇa chen rin po che rgya nag gi ngal rtsol sgyur bkod khang zhig nas bros byol du phebs tshul gsungs/ skabs der gsar 'gyur brgyud lam khag nang /7paṇa chen rin po che rgyal khab gang du bros byol la phebs min skor la gleng phyogs 'dra min byung ba ma zad/ gang du skyabs bcol du phebs tshul shod sa'i rgyal khab de'i dbu khrid tshos kyang / do snang chen po'i dgongs tshul gsung 'dugaphyi lo 1969 zla 9 tshes 16 nyin/ ldi li gsar pa nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog u ru su'i rogs skyor las/ rgya dmar gyi btson khang nas bros byol gnang ste/ sku 'khor dang bcas pa phyi sog tu zhabs sor bde 'khod byung tshul bshad 'dug la/ phyi lo 1969 lor/ rdo gling (bod kyi dbyin yi ga bskyar zhib gsar shog)nang / 7paṇa chen rin po che btson khang nas bros byol gyis/ 'brug nang skyabs bcol du phebs pa'i gnas tshul spel 'duga'abrug rgyal po 'jigs med rdo rje dbang phyug gis/ 'brug gi rgyal sa thim pu nas gnas tshul thos par gzhigs na/ 7paṇa chen rin po che 'brug nang bros byol gnang 'char 'khod/ 'on kyang / nga'i bsam par rgya mis 7paṇa chen rin po che sku bkrongs te/ gnas tshul de 'dra zhig bzos pa min nam snyam gyi yod/396

da lta'i char 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog 'brug nang phebs med ces/ phyi lo 1970zla 4 tshes 27 nyin/ 'grel brjod gnang 'dugaphyi lo 1969 zla 9 tshes 12 nyin/ ldi li gsar khang gis/ phyi lo 1968lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis rgya nag gzhung gi bka' bzhin/ rgya mo zhig dang 'khrungs sa bskyon rgyur zhal bzhes ma gnang rkyen/ ngal rtsol sgyur bkod khang zhig tu bkag bskyil byas stabs/ phyi lo 1969 zla 9 tshes 12 nyin/ ngal rtsol sgyur bkod khang gsang nas bros kyis rgya gar du skyabs bcol la phebs tshul bkod cing 'dugader brten/ rgya gar gyi srid blon in dra ghan rtsis/ bod kyi dbu khrid 7paṇa chen rin po che rgya gar du btsan byol la phebs rgyu'i re 'dun zhus tshe/ rgya gar gzhung gis khas len byed min thad bsam gzhigs byed bzhin yod/ 'on kyang /da lta su zhig gis 7paṇa chen rin po che gang du yod min shes kyi med/ khong zla ba gnyis kyi gong rgya nag gi ngal rtsol bsgyur bkod khang nas bros byol la phebs pa red gsung 'dug la/ 7gong sa mchog gis kyang 7paṇa chen bcu pa rgya gar du zhabs sor bde bar 'khod thub pa'i chos phyogs kyi zhabs rim gsog sgrub kyang gnang 'dugaphyi lo 1967 zla 9 tshes 3 nyin/ rdor gling tshags shog nang /7paṇa chen rin po che lha sa'i nye 'gram gyi ngal rtsol sgyur bkod khang du ngal rtsol gnang gin yod pa bshad la/ phyi lo 1970 zla 12 tshes 28 nyin/ shang kung gsar shog steng / 7paṇa chen rin po che ngal rtsol bsgyur bkod khang nas bros byol gyis/da lta bod nang go mtshon thogs pa'i ngo log zing 'khrug gi sne 'khrid gnang gi yod pa dang / ngo log zing 'khrug de'i nang rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs sbas skung 397

byas pa'i go mtshon mang po yod pa bshad/lo de'i yas mas su bod dbus gtsang khul du 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog rgya spu can zhig chags te/ rgya nag nang rlangs 'khor gtong bzhin bzhugs yod pa'i gleng phyogs khyab la/ yang / bod byang gi tsha 'dam shong nang / tsha 'don ngal rtsol las grwar ngal rtsol sgyur bkod gnang bzhin yod pa'ang bshad/ches 'jigs su rung ba'i dkrog gtam zhig ni/ phyi lo 1969 zla 12nang man ju ri ya'i btson khang zhig nang / mnar gcod tshad bral btang bas dgongs pa gzhan du gshegs pa'i gleng phyogs shig ri bo hi ma la yi rgyab ngos su khyab 'dug77 bdag gis bsam par rgya mis 7paṇa chen rin po che sku bkrong tshe/7gong sa mchog dang rgyal spyis do snang gang 'dra byed kyi yod min la nyams tshod len phyir/ gleng phyogs dang 'drogs 'go de 'dra zhig bslangs pa yin 'ang srid /don dngos dngos su 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog ni pe cing gi ngal rtsol sgyur bkod khang nas/ phyi rgyal du bros brol du phebs thub rgyu lta ci/ phyi lo 1968lo nas gdug rtsub che ba'i man ju ri yi btson khang zhig tu/ phyag zung la lcags 'thag skyon te kher rkyang ngang sto bkag gtong ba dang / skabs 'gar glog rgyugs gtong ba sogs/ rgya khrims btsan pos mnar gcod myong bzhin bzhugs yod/phyi lo 1974 lor ma'o kru'u zhi'i mgrin tshab pas/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog sku 'tsho bzhugs yin tshul bsgrags pa'i phyi lor/ rtsom pa po tan su yin gyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku gzigs bde 'tshams ngang slob sbyong byed bzhin bzhugs yod pa'i gnas tshul spel rjes/ mi rnams kyis da gzod gzhi khong 'tsho bzhugs gnang yod pa'i yid ches byas/77shes bya/ byi dril las khungs/398

rin po ches mi lo 10 tsam ring / nyin mtshan dus drug tu btson khang mnabs myong ba'i rgyu la thung las bzos pa'i sku stod sngo dkar zhig dang /ras kyi zhabs lham cha gcig ras kyi zhabs dor cha gcig da dung kha bzhengs che ba'i chu ras cha gcig bcas hral hrul du gyur pa'i btson chas la sku nyid kyis lhan pa bskyon pa rnams dang / bskul zad du gyur pa'i shin hwa tshig mdzod gcig rgya yig gi sbyong deb rnams rig dngos yin pas nyar tshags byed dgos pa'i zhal ta gnang ba bzhin/ da lta pe cing 7paṇa chen gzim shag tu mjal rgyu 'dug la/ rin po che sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs/ mtshams rer tshogs 'du'i steng bstan pa gnang ste/lo rgyus kyi dpang po yin zhes bka' gnang gi 'dug rtsom pa po 'jam dpal rgya mtshos/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher lo dgu zla brgyad kyi btson ra'i sdug bsngal ci byung gsung skul zhu skabs/ nyer char nga bod du sku gdung mchod rten gyi mdzad sgor 'gro rgyu dang / phyir log mtshams khyed rang la ge sar sgrung nang bzhin nyin shas la bshad chog gsungs 'dugastabs ma legs pa zhig la/ ge sar lha sgrung dang 'dra ba'i sku che'i gtam rgyud la rol myong byed pa'i go skabs ma byung gong / phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 27gyi mtshan gung / dgung grangs 51 la phebs pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa chog gi yun thung ba'i sku tshe'i mjug de bde chen skal bzang pho brang du rdzogs par byas so/ /399

kyi tshe'i stod kyai cha/sa bcad gsum pa/ skya tshe'i stod kyai cha/( 1938 — 1958)le tshan dang po/ 'khrungs yul dang khyim rgyud/ da lta'i mdo smad mtsho sngon zhing chen zhun hwa rdzong pus mdo'i ma ru sde pa'i pus mdo dpon tshang gi bu che ba mgon po tshe brtan mchog kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu par ngos 'dzin zhus pa dang sbrags/ rab tu byung ba'i chos ming la lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan gsol gnang ba khong /phyi lo 1938 lor/ yab gung tshe brtan dang yum bsod nams sgron ma gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/pus mdo dpon tshang la lo rgyus kyi gtam rgyud grags che yang lo ngo bcu'i rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gtor bshig nges can zhig phog pas/sngon ma'i rnam pa mjal ba'i skal ba bral yang / phyis bskyar bzhengs gnang bas/spen bad kyis brgyan pa'i phyi'i mkhar rgya mi che yang / nang rten phyag rdzas kyi rigs dang / gzim khri sogs da dung yang mjal rgyu 'dugapus mdo mgon po tshe brtan ni skya ming yin zhing / pus mdo yab gzhis sku 'khor la gcung po zhal lkug cig yod pa khong gi mtshan la mgon po rgyal lam mchod rten zhu/ de sngon mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gros kyi u yon yin/bod rnying pa'i skabs 7rgyal 7paṇa chen gyi yab la gung gi mtshan gnas yod pa 401

7paṇa chen zher te gi gi' 'jugabazhin yab gzhis tshe brtan la'ang gung gi mtshan gnas yod/bod rgya 'og tu shor rjes yab gung tshe brtan dang yum bsod nams smon ma rnam gnyis/rgyal yongs srid gros kyi u yon dang / bod rang skyong ljongs srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa sogs kyi mtshan gnas bzhes yod/ phyi lo 1989lor/ rgyal yab mchog dgongs pa cigashegs shing / phyi lo 2012 lor rgyal yum bsod nams sgron ma dgung lo dgu bcu go bdun la gshegs/ da lta gcung po mgon porgal sna3tsho zhing bzhugs yod/pha ci rig ciri ma tshosna ci ༷sa ri ༷ ci/lho ru ༷thong—— ciri7 ༷ ༷/no /ciX ru wadhe/༷///ci tsho ci byeX 4sa/ ri tsho mu rishā lhaX: snardo /khye khyiXrā shā na ru ci rtsuX tsho ri chiciX rdortsarme mes mi:)thu'u4〉/ /bye/ bye rme ༷ tshengasngo ji ci cas/rdo rāX7 wa wa— — ri'i /ri (ris/ 3(7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi 'khrungs gzhis pu sa mdo dpon tshang /)mtsho sngon zhing chen ma ru sde pa'i pus mdo dpon tshang ni 'khon rigs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i khyim rgyud a brtan las mched pa'i rgyud pa zhig yin/de yang pus mdo'i gdan rabs las/ sa skya 'khon rigs kyi khyim rgyud la/ a brta na zhes 'bod pa'i mi zhig yod pa de bod dbus gtsang nas a mdo la phebs shing / mdo smad rong po brgyud de pus mdo sa char slebs dus 'bud shing 'thu 402

skya che'i stod kyai cha/mkhan gyi mi zhig dang 'phrad/ mi des a brtan ni skyes gzugs khyad par can dang spyod pa kun las 'phags pa zhig yin pa gzigs pas/ ljon pa'i yal ga gdan du bting ste khong nyid pus mdor yun ring bzhugs dgos pa'i re ba zhus/a brtan gyis re ba dang du blangs te gzhis bcas/ a brtan spyang grung 'dzoms shing gzhung drang snying rje can zhig yin pas/ mi rnams kyis khong nyid sa phyogs de'i bdag por bkur bar bshad/ shod rgyun du/ sa skya gong ma rnam lnga'i ya rgyal 'gro mgon 'phags pas/bod rigs sa khul gyi chos lugs dang srid 'dzin gyi las don la do dam byed pa'i 'phrin las khur du bzhes skabs/ sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa zung gi sras kyi thu bo dka' bzhi pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / khong gi nu bo mi dbang a brtan bcas kyis/ grwa btsun mnga' bdag khag cig 'khrid de sa skya nas shar a mdo sa khul du mngags/khong gnyis kyis mtsho ston zhing chen rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rong po sa cha brgyud/ pus marda'i sa cha bdams nas gzhis bcas te dgon pa btab/a brtan gyis stong dpon gyi las gnas bzung zhing / dka' bzhi pas dgon pa'i chos lugs kyi gtso bdag gnang ste sa skya'i chos lugs dar spel btang /a brtan gyis pus mdo'i khri dpon gyi las gnas 'dzin skabs/ pus mdo'i spyi tshogs rnam pa ni bod rigs tsho khag gi ru pa spo ba'i 'brog pa sha stag yin zhing /mnga' khongs su reb gong stod smad dang kus te/ gcan tsha/ min ho sogs bsdus pa gsungs//pus mdo'i stong dpon dang po a brtan gyis rma chu'i 'gram brgyud nas 17paṇa chen bcu pa 'i 'khrungs yul dang khyim rgyud/thog ngos nan nang /krung go'e bod ljongs/phyi lo 1997/nanang /403

la'akho chen nar te ni zhi' 'jugango mtshar zhes pa'i sa char gnas spos te zhing 'brog gnyis kyi las ka gnyer/da lta'i bus mdo zhang ngo mtshar ma ru sde pa'i chu'i phar ngos su rdzong mkhar brtsigs kyang rjes su dmag 'khrug dang dus zing khrod rtsa med du phyin/ pus mdo stong dpon btsan pos ngo mtshar ma ru sde pa'i chu'i tshur ngos su slar yang mkhar rdzong brtsigs/ de yang / rgya bod dus zing skabs me yis 'jig ste med pa chags/phyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mes po/ pus mdo dpon tshang gi dpon rabs nyi shu pa stong dpon mchod rten pa'i skabs/ da lta'i mtsho sngon zhing chen ma ru grong sder dpon mkhar brtsigs kyang /skabs der pus mdo stong dpon dpal 'byor gyis 'khos kha dbul bas/ gzhi khyon ha cang chung ngu zhig las med pa'i dpon mkhar de'i nang / yab pus mdo dpon rabs 21 pa 'khon rigs tshe brtan dang / yum bsod rnams sgron ma gnyis kyi sras su ngo mtshar ba'i rtags ltas du ma dang bcas/ dus rabs 20bod la bka' drin che ba'i skyes chen mgon po tshe brtan 'khrungs/da lta ma ru sde pa'i pus mdo dpon tshang gi gzim shag mdun ngos su nga tsho'i mthong lam du yod pa'i ljon bzang 'di/ lha mo'i bla mtshor 7paṇa chen dgu pa'i yang sprul sa phyogs gang du 'khrungs min rtsad 'tshol skabs/ dpal lda na lha mos lung bstan pa'i sgo stong de gnyis las gcig yin par gsungs shing /mgon po tshe brtan yum gyi lhums su bzhugs dus/ yum gyi mnal lam du gos chen ser pos thum par grags pa'i a myes ri bo sogs kyang ma ru sde par yod/shod rgyun la/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog rgyal yum gyi mngal las 'khrungs pa'i nyin/ ma ru sde par 'ja' mtshon sna lnga shar zhing / ma gal gyi ljon bzang chen po de'i rtse nas khu byug gi gsung snyan grags myong ba'i gtam rgyud/da lta'ang pus mdo'i yul na pha gtam bu 'jags su yod skad/404

skya tshe'i ston kyai cha/mgon po tshe brtan lo gcig tsam nas bzung snyun gzhi lcid mos rgyun ring mnar ba ma zad/ dgung lo gsum skabs sku 'da' la khad du gyur/skabs der rim 'gro sman gtugs ci zhig byas kyang phan pa ma byung stabs/ pus mdo dpon tshang gi gnyen tshan bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi a lags bla kho 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshor lung brtag zhus/ a lags rin po ches dgon par bskyal nas rab tu byung dgos pa'i lung bstan phebs/de dus kyi dpon tshang la shul 'dzin bu rgyud gzhan med stabs/ bu gcig po de rab tu byung ma spobs na'ang / nad gzhi las thar thabs su dgon par mi bskyal ka med byung / dgung lo drug pa'i bar chos zhugs ma gnang bar skya chas bzhes te bis mdo dgon par bzhugs pas snyun mnar las yongs su grol/2da lta rde ra sdun du bzhugs pa'i pus mdo a khu ka les/ nyin zhig a lags g.yer skyong chung ba tshang gis/ nga skad btang ste phyag 'phrin gal chen zhig pus mdo'i dpon phrug la phul rogs gsungs kyi/ ngas de mur 'phrin yig gal chen de khyer nas bis mdo'i dpon tshang gi phyogs su phyin/ dpon phrug tshang la phyag 'phrin de phul bas khong gis gzigs tshar rjes/ a red lta /phru gu de gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug phag la bzhon nas phag khang nang du'ang 'dzul 'gro yi 'dug deng skabs kho dgon par bcol nas bzhag yod zer/ngas skad cha de'i nang don gsal po zhig rtogs thub na bsam ste/dpon phrug la 'os 'tsham gyi dogs 'dri byas par/khong gis a lags tshang gis bu chung der gnod btsog 'dra shor du ma 'jug ces bkod 'dug na/ phru gu skyes mtha' can zhig yin min mi shes mod/ tshub pa la phag gi rngog mar 'jus te phag dam dzad rnam bden pa'i rang mdangs gsal ba'i me lo nga /7paṇa chenarjes dran go sgrig tsholas chung /phyi lo 1999lor/405

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhing 'ardulakhang dang bya khang yan chad nang 'dzul nas glags khel gyi mi 'dug gsungs/phri shermi thes ci)nyi de zhi yings 'a na ra nas nga ba ma dbyar gzhung ga na pa dang /1(1 1rngo/shashā)( tu:rga /de/ /bya/ hāXrnod na a ma nga sa (7pa ṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i ma yum/ nga kha nang yur ma yar tshar rjes/ rtswa lngam slel po gang 'khar nas slebs song / de ma thag yam rig dag3 rang rang /༷/ 1(1 1byedro rāḥ/ //// doste/ ༷/1sge/ da na phrug dang da ga sa la ja ba la nas drangs ma na bsu byas//re/ /rdo1 :) /re/ /rdo )rdo 1(1a ma tshang ya rabs bzang da ldan pa bud da ga da la/ da na phrug 1de therdo:) rjes 1(1/ye ri tsho shesteskabs ra pus ma da na na pa dang / khang bu rang nga nas bshad na'ang dpa' blo khog can gyi mi zhig yin par bshad pa ma zad/ pho gsar skabs mi rkyal stong zhig kyang red zer/3shod rgyun zhig la/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog yum gyi mngal du yod dus/yab kyis ma yum bdung nas sgor la phud par brten/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog zhing kha'i rnang ma zhigatusku'akhrungasasozer// tsho /ci sku—4 rngu ’ ༷ —la tshoci nyuX cha (7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang yab yu ma sku 'khor/)ga7pa ṇa chen er te ni gleng ba/shog ngos 189 nang / 7paṇa chen er te ni zhabs zhu khang /phyi lo naX9lor/406

skya che'i stod kyai cha/le tshan gnyis pa/ yang sprul btsal 'tshol gyi brgyud rin /bod mi mang gis dus nam yang 'khang ra bya gzhir gyur pa'i bod gzhung dang bkras lhun bla brang gi don rkyen des/ bod bstan pa chab srid kyi don chen dang / bod mi'i zhi mthun phung dkrug bzos pa ma zad/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis dbar la'ang zhu log dbyen sbyor gyi sku ngal dang / 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang sprul ngos 'dzin dus thog tu zhu ma thub pa'i las 'dzol bzos yod/phyi lo 1923 lor gzhung bla'i don rkyen las 7paṇa chen dgu pa thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma gdan sa bkra shis lhun por bzhugs bzod bral te/bod nas zhal bral te khams sog yul/ du phyogs g.yol du phebs dgos byung /mi lo 15 yul gyar 'tsho bas thugs bsu na pa'i 7paṇa chen dgu pa mchopo/rang yul kha ba'i ljongs su chibs kha bsgyur skabs/ gzhung bla'i don rkyen las dbus gtsang du phebs ma thub par/ 'phar spyang gi zug rngu ldang ba'i mi med lung stong gi ba yan ha ri'i gsham du/ bod la mi dgos pa'i mi de nga red/ 'on kyang / sangs rgyas bstan pa de gang drag ci drag gsungs bzhin dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/de snga bkras lhun bla brang gi zhabs 'bring smon nub ldum ra ba blo bzang chos 'byor lags kyis gsungs na/ phyi lo 1922 lor bde chen pho brang gi ldebs bris su/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i ljags bkod bzhin/ phebs byams 407

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhing 'dugakyi byams 'gyogs pa rnams rgya rigs kyi gon pa gyon pa dang / phebs byams gzigs khra'i nang nas stag cig gis blta ba zhig 'bri ru 'jug gnang yod/de ni 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i dgung snying sogs/ ma 'ongs lung bstan ltar byung yod/ de dag rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs gtor brlags song zhes gsungs/4gsung rgyun gzhan zhig la/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mchog sku ma gshegs gong / bkra shis lhun por phyir phebs kyi phebs lam ri mor 'bri skabs/ phebs byams nang stag cig 'bri ru bcug gnang ba de/phyis su mi rnams kyis de ni 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mchog dgung snying stag lor phebs rgyu'i lung bstan du yid ches dang ngos 'dzin byas 'dug5phyi lo 1938 lo nas/ mi lo sum brgya drug cu'i srol rgyun byung rabs kyi lo rgyus ldan pa'i 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis kyi mchog sprul ngos 'dzin zhu ba'i srol dang cho ga ltar/ 7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung / gdan sa bkra shis lhun po/ mtsho sngon du bca' sdod 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i zhabs 'bring bcas kyis/ yang srid btsal 'tshol zhu ba'i las rim dbu 'dzugs zhus/gdan sa bkra shis lhun pos/ bkra shis lhun po'i rtse dgon khang gi rdo rje slob dpon pad rin mkhan po'am bi lung rin po che dang / drung ram pa spen pa tshe ring lha mo'i bla mtshor mtsho gzigs su mngags/ mtsho gzigs nang nags tshal gyi ljongs shig na shing sdong chen po gcig gi 'gram du stag gcig byung ba de'i 'khris su ri bong bzhis stag der 'khrug rtsod byed pa'i rnam pa dang /stag de dal bus nags gseb tu phar 'dzul 'gro ba zhig byung rjes/ bkras lhun bod kyi rig gnas 'o rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/deb na pa /shog ngos 1 skunang /5dben dkon chubs bris/ 7 ri ṇa chen bcu pa'i gam bcar lha bris blo bzang ngu na tshogs 408

skya tshe'i stod kyai cha/dgon pa'i mdun gyi phyag 'tshal sgang du yod pa'i maṇa ḍal thang ser po de thon po'i mdun ngos su mthun pa spun bzhi dang / rnga chen po gcig yod pa'i rnam pa de 'dra zhig gsal/6phyis su mi rnams kyis stag de 7paṇa chen bcu pa stag lo ba dang / 'os spral du dogs gzhi che shos lung rigs rgya mtsho sku 'das po khong lo khams byi ba dren pa dang lung bstan rtse mthun du rtsis shing / mtsho gsal de ji bzhin ri mor bris pa'i thang ka zhig kyang yod pa gsungs/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng pa'i yang srid rtsad gcod zhu phyogs skor gyi gzhi 'dzin sa gtso bo ni/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bla ma bla kho rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog gi lung bstan dang / lha chen la mo tshangs lcog gi lung / bkras lhun dgon pa'i gnyer gtad lha mo'i zan brtag7paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi sku gdung mdun zhus pa'i zan brtag rtse po ta la'i 'phags pa lo ke sha ra'i spyan sngar phul ba'i zan brtag lha mo'i bla mapo'i mtsho gsal rtags/ pha bong kha byams pa bstan 'dzin rin po che'i lung bstan/chab mdo'i shug rdzong dge bshes rin po'i lung bstan dgongs don rnams yin cing / lha bla'i lung brtag phal mo cher yang srid 'khrungs yul sa phyogs a mdo khul rang la bstan pa shas che khar/ dgung snying yang stag lo par bstan pa shas che ba byung /lhag don chab mdo'i shug rdzong dge bshes rin po cher bskyar du brtan zhu phul bar yin thag chod po'i sgo nas mdo smad khul rang du dgung snying stag lo par phebs yong zhes gsal por ston gnang mdzad/ chab mdo'i shug rdzong dge bshes rin po che ni/ skabs der mdo spyi bka' blon nas bod gzhung gi bstan snyobo/kyirigaganas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam ༄ bsgrigs/ deb 17pa/shog1nang /409

7paṇa chen ber te ni zhing 'jugasrid don gnad gal che'i skor la thugs brtag zhu yul yin skad/7lugs srol ltar na 7rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pas mo lung thugs brtag gnang dgos mod/ skabs der 7rgyal dbang bcu bzhi pa dgung grangs 4las son med stabs/ phyogs so sos bod shar phyogs su btsal 'tshol zhib phra zhus rjes/ mtsho sngon sku 'bum du bca' bzhugs bla brang zha bas 'bring tshos/7gong sa mchog dang / bod gzhung la 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid btsal 'tshol byed tshul gyi mtshan tho dang / snyan seng zhu bar dngul chu spral sku ched rdzong zhus/ ༄li pheng nyan gyis/ bod gzhung gis sku 'bum du bca' bzhugs bla brang zhabs 'bring chos/ mdo smad khul du btsal 'tshol zhib phra byung 'dug kyang /da dung dgas kong sogs yul gru gang sar zhib 'tshol dgos pa dang / bod gzhung nas 'bri chu'i nub ngos su bskyar 'tshol zhu mi ched gtong gnang rgyu yin pa'i bka' phebs pa bshad/bkras lhun bla brang gi dza sag zur khang nub blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis 'gan khur gtso bzhes kyi 'og tu/ chos 'khor rgyal lha mo'i bla mtsho gtsos bod dbus gtsang khul gyi bla lha'i lung brtag khag gi nang don dang / nang ma khang gis mdo smad khul gyi bla sprul khag la zhus pa'i lung brtag rtse sdur thog yang srid rtsad gcod bya yul sa gnas a mdo'i phyogs su gtan 'khel byas/dngul chu rin po ches a mdo chab cha dang / tshe gling sprul sku ngo las a tshogs khul/ gzim che blo bzang dpal ldan gyis dhi tsha dang / bya khyung khul/gsol che dam chos yar 'phel gyis dbu khrid pa'i dngos grub dang / lha rtse mig 7bod kyi ris gnas ma/ rgyus dbya da gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam sa bsgrigs/deb 17thos nanang /mi rims dpe kun khang /410

skya che'i stod kyai cha/dmar sogs/ pus mdo dang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil du brtsad 'tshol du phebs/gsol che dam chos yar 'phel la pus mdo ma ru sde pa'i dpon tshang nas mgon po tshe brtan rnyed gson byung /blo rig grung zhing rtags mtshan mang ba'i khye'u 17 sku 'bum dgon par gdan 'dren zhus te/ chos lugs kyi 'gro lugs ltar zhib rtsad byas pa'i khongs nas/ khye'u 5 yang srid 'os dmigs su med pa shes rjes/ slar yang khye'u 12sku 'bum dgon par gdan 'dren zhus/ khye'u lung rigs rgya mtsho/ sba bu bla ma/chos skyong bkra shis/ tshe dpag rdo rje/ a mdo rgyal mtshan/ bis mdo mgon po tshe brtan drug la rags tsam gtan 'khel byung /lung rigs rgya mtsho glo bur sku gshegs rkyen/ da dung 'os sprul khye'u lhag bsdad 5 yod pa rnams sku 'bum dgon par gdan 'dren zhus nas/7paṇa chen sku gong ma'i chos gos dang / snam sbyar/ sku gzan/ sku 'gag sogs na bza' dang / phyag 'phreng / mchod zhal sogs sku'i nyer chas rnams dang ngo 'dra gnyis re shing dkrol nang bsgrigs te ngos 'dzin byed du 'jugamagon po tshe brtan gyis 7paṇa chen sku gong ma'i sku'i nyer bos rnams the tshom dogs snang med par ngos 'dzin gnang zhing / sku 'bum bla brang yang steng du so phag bsgrigs yod pa zhig gi steng zhabs rjes 'jog gnang mdzad/shog bu'i steng bris pa'i khye'u lnga'i mtshan byang zan brtag bsgril te/ sku 'bum gser khang chen mo'i nang chos lugs gyi 'gro lugs ltar zan ril dkrug pas/mgon po tshe brtan gyi mtshan byang gzhan rnams kyi khrod nas ngo mtshar dang ldan pa'i ngang thon/pus mdo mgon po tshe brtan gyis mi tshogs kyi khrod nas/ 7paṇa chen 4 11

7paṇa chen ber te rna zhib 'dugadagu pa mchog la lha mo gzigs 'bul zhus myong ba'i dka' chen pa sangs kyi ming bos nas/ khong gis lha mo 'khrab shes kyi yod pa gsungs/ dka' chen pa sangs lags de sngon mjal myong med pas mi rnams ha las dad pa che skyes te/7paṇa chen pa mchog gi rnam shes khye'u 'di la yod pa'i yid ches kyis sku 'bum dgon du bsnyen bkur dang / bod gzhung la mgon po tshe brtan 'os spral du thon pa'i glog 'phrin phul/ nyin de gar bod gzhung gis mtsho sngon nang ma rteng la glog 'phrin 'byor ba'i nang / 7paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid skor 'phags pa lo ke sha ra'i spyan sngar zan brtag zhus par pus mdo dpon tshang gi bu ang dang po phebs song bas/ khong yang srid 'os sprul ang dang po yin zhes 'khod yod/phyi lo 1947 lor/ bod gzhung gis mdo stod li thang nas yin pa'i tshe ring rdo rje/ khong ni 7paṇa chen dgu pa mchog dkar mdzes su bzhugs skabs/nang ma khang gi tshem bze'i mi glar yong myong mkhan bza' tsho gnyis la/ dar mdo lce thog la'i brag phug cig tu sdod skabs btsas pa'i bu de yin/ pha ma gnyis nas bu de 'khrid de li thang du 'byor rjes/ shod drug skyabs mgon nas gsos nyar byas pa zhig red/ phyis su bkra shis lhun po'i rgya khang tshan du bsnyen bkur zhu rgyur gdan 'dren zhus pa khong dang / kun bde gling gi khyab khongs chab mdo khul dpa' shod rdzong nas yin pa'i tsha ba dpa' shod/ phyis su 'bras spungs tshogs chen sprul skur ngos 'dzin zhus pa khong gnyis gdan 'dren zhus/tsho khag gsum gyi brtsad 'tshol zhib phra gnang ba brgyud/ phyi lo 1947lor/ gzhung nas btsal 'tshol byung ba'i 'os sprul gnyis dang / mtsho sngon du bca' bzhugs bla brang zhabs 'bring gis btsal 'tshol zhus pa'i pus mdo mgon po tshe brtan gsum la gtan 'khel byung / /412

kyi tshe'i stod kyai cha/le tshan gsum pa/ yang rdzul ngos 'dzin thad gzhung bla'i rtsod sgogagazhung bla'i sku drag nang khul dam nyams kyi 'gal ba dza drag pas/ phyogs gnyis nas btsal 'tshol zhus pa'i 'os spral gsum las/ khye'u su zhig 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma'i༄ yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhu phyogs skor la/gzhung bla gnyis gas rang lta mkhregs 'dzin gnang ba des/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa ngos 'dzin zhu bar mi lo 10 'gor 'gyangs byung ba ma zad/ gung khran tang bod la yong ba'i mthun rkyen du yang gyur yod/dpyad gzhi'i yig tshags dang / kha rgyun rig pa sogs/ lo rgyus kyi khungs sne rnal ma rnams phan tshun go bsdur zhing gung legs par bsgrigs te dngos kyi don rnal ma gang yin rtsad 'tshol zhib nan cig byas na/ rnyog zing de rigs rgyu mtshan gang 'dra zhig la brten nas byung ba dang / rnyog zing de rigs kyi ngo bo dang /rnam pa gang yin rnams mngon du thon te/ lo rgyus kyi bden don rnal ma gang yin pa de rigs mngon gsal du thon mi srid pa zhig kyang ma red/bkras lhun bla brang gis mgon po tshe brtan 7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung gis zhal bzhes ma thob par/ mdo smad sku 'bum nas rgyal sa lha sar gdan zhu mi gnang ba dang / lha sar gdan zhu ma gnang na sku 'bum nas 7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung gis ngos len mi gnang ba'i gnad don de ni/ phyogs gnyis kus 7paṇa chen bcu pa 'khrul bral byung thabs kyi don chen la sems khur zhig 413

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'dugartsa ba nas ma yin/ de ni 'os sprul gang zhig 7paṇa chen bcu pa gtan 'khel byung min las/ gzhung bla gnyis kyi rgyal pham la thug yod pa de red /phyi lo 1923 lo nas bkras lhun bla brang gi chos srid 'dzin skyong yongs rdzogs gzhung gis gzhung bzhes btang zhing / bkras lhun bla brang gi chos srid dbang cha bod gzhung gis ched bskos dza sag bla ma'i lag tu yod stabs/gzhung bla'i don rkyen 'khrun chod ma byung gong tshod tshod du 'os sprul lha sar gdan 'dren zhu rgyu ni kho tsho'i kha che dbang thang la thad kur thug yod/ mtsho sngon sku 'bum du ngos 'dzin zhus tshe/ dus skabs der mdo smad phyogs yongs rdzogs bod gzhung gi dbang sgyur khyab khongs las 'gal bas/ bla brang nang ma khang gzhung 'og tu bsdu thub rgyu lta ci/ sku nar ma son pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa bed spyod kyis rgya nag gzhung dang ngan 'brel byas te/ bod gzhung la lo rgyus kyi 'khon lan slog nges pa'i dogs pa yod/bod gzhung gis mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen dgu pa'i yang srid min pa'i gleng gzhi bzo sa gzhan med stabs/ 7paṇa chen dgu pa phyi lo 1937 zla 12tshes 1 nyin dgongs pa rdzogs shing / mgon po tshe brtan phyi lo 1938 zla 2tshes 19 nyin 'khrungs pas/ de'i bar na zla 2 dang nyin 18 las med pas/de ni rgyal ba yab sras sku phreng rim byon nang byung myong med par ya la bston dkris kyis/ mgon po tshe brtan gcig tu ngos 'dzin mi byed par/ sngon la 'os gzhi'i khongs lha sar gdan 'dren zhus nas/ jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku mdun du 'os spral gzhan gnyis dang lhan gzan ril bsgril te ngos 'dzin zhu dgos zhes/ srid stong stag brag gi bka' rgyar/ bla brang nang khang gi zhabs 'bring tshos 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i 414

kyi che'i stod kyai cha/yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu rgyu de/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bla ma a lags bla kho tshang 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho mchog nas gtan 'khel thugs thag gcod gnang yong ba'i gsol 'debs zhus/ rgyu mtshan ni de sngon phyi lo 1936 lor/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mchog bod la phebs bzhes kyi lam bar ra rgya dgon du a lag bla kho rin po che dang mjal 'dzoms skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches bla kho rin po che la zhal gdams lta bu'i tshul du gsungs don/ bla ma rin po ches nga'i rjes 'jug 'di rnams sdug la ma gyar ba zhig khyed kyis thugs rjes gzigs zhes gsungs/8de ltar bla brang nang khang gi zhabs 'bring tshos a lags bla kho rin po cher gsol 'debs zhus par bla kho rin po che nas/ khyed chos sku 'bum dgon gyi gser sdong rin po che'i spyan sngar zan brtag zhu dgos pa dang / zan brtag nang gang phebs pa de rang la 'khrul bral yid ches byas na chog ces gsungs pa bzhin/sku 'bum gser sdong spyan sngar zan brtag las mgon po tshe brtan thon pas/yang srid 'khrul med du the tshom gnang mi dgos pas/ bskyar du gzan ril bsgril gnang mi 'os zhes bka' shag gi bka' rgya zhal bzhes ma gnang /bkras lhun zhabs 'bring bde dgon dpal mgon tshe ring gis/ bkras lhun pos 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid skor la/ zi ling sku 'bum du bkras lhun bla brang gi byes sdod zhabs 'bring rnams dang 'phros mol gyis/sa smad yul gyur sku bltams pa'i 7paṇa chen 'os sprul gnyis gdan zhu'i skor gyi don gcod mi sna/ bkras lhun drung che nor brang blo bzang rgyal mtshan dang /lha sde'i spyi 'thus shar rtse mkhan zur lho pa sprul sku pad+ma mtha' yas/ mi sde'i spyi 'thus 'tsho dpon nor khang bsod rdor/ las byar rtse drung gnas pa chos mdzad/ nga rang na bod kyi rim gnas lo rgyus dbya da gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam sa bsgribs /deb 1 shog10nang /mi rigs dpe kyu na khang /415

7paṇa chena'ar te ni zhing 'jugabacas bsko bzhag gis/ phyi lo 1946 zla 8 bkras lhun nas thon/mar lam lha sar srid skyong stag brag gsung rab mthu stobs dang /bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen/ bka' blon mdo mkhar phun tshogs/ rab rgyas/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma/drung che lcog steng thub bstan nor bzang / 'bum thang chos 'phel thub bstan/rgyal 'bum sgang ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ rtsis dpon klu khang pa tshe dbang rab brtan dang / zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/rnam sras gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med sogs la 'bul mtshan dang gang ci'i skyabs 'jug tu bcar/bod gzhung bka' shag nas srid skyong gi bka' bzhin/ kun gzigs rin po che'i yang srid 'os sprul gsum la gtan 'khel bas/ zi ling khul yod 'os sprul gnyis po 'di ga lha ldan du 'phral du gdan zhu bya dgos pa dang / sngar srol bod sdod am ban gyi tshab byas te jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku mdun du/ gser bum dkrugs te mtshan byang bton nas gtan 'bebs gnang rgyu de yin rung deng skabs gong ma'i lugs med pas da cha 'os sprul gsum gyi mtshan byang gzan sgril nang blugs nas dkrug 'don bya rgyur/khyod tsho bkras lhun bla brang gi gzhis byes zhabs 'bring rnams kyi 'dod mos ltar lag len bstar rgyu yin gshis/ de lugs khyod tshos zi ling yul gyur yod pa'i 'os sprul gnyis po gdan zhu dang bcas/ sa smad du yod pa'i bkras bla'i zhabs 'bring sogs sang ma bod du mnyam 'byor yong ba dang / 'os sprul 416

skya tshe'i stod gyi cha/phebs skyel du bsnyad btags rgya rigs dpon dmag sogs mnyam bsres dra༄5 na mi 'grigs pa gsungs/9bkra shis lhun po'i sku 'bum gyi 'os spral gdan zhu'i mi snas/ lha sar phur lcog byams mgon rin po che dang / ra sgreng rin po che mjal skabs/ 'os sprul mgon po tshe brtan rang thugs dam bzang phebs byung lugs bka' slob phebs pa dang / lha bla'i lung gzhan du'ang 'di rang bzang shos yin pa phebs/bla brang nang ma khang gi zhabs 'bring tshos/ dgung grangs 8 la son pa'i mgon po tshe brtan/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dngos 'drar sku 'bum gyi gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus yod kyang / 7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung gis da dung ngos len gnang med/drung che nor brang sogs 'os sprul gdan zhu ba rnams/ byes bzhugs nang ma khang gi zhabs 'bring dang yun ring zhib gros gnang ba'i rjes su/ gzhis byes zhabs 'bring thun mong gi ming thog nas/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid du mgon po tshe brtan gcig thog tu gtan 'khel yong bar/ dkyil khang blo bzang bzod pa dang dngul chu spral sku blo bzang chos 'phel bod gzhung la zhu 'bul du phebs ༄sku 'bum bla brang zhabs 'bring tsho/ bod gzhung gis mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen bcu par zhal bzhes nam yong bar bsgug bsdad na/ khri ston mdzad sgo nar 'gyangs su gyur par sems 'tshab yod stabs/ phyi lo 1944 zla 1tshes 3 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog gis zhal bzhes med bzhin 7paṇa chen bcu pa 9bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/deb 4pa/shog 92nas 1na ba ra/mi risas dpe sun khang /phyi lo 1981lor/417

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhing 'jugedangos 'drar sku 'bum du gdan drangs te/ phyi lo 1944 zla 5 tshes 5 nyin/sku 'bum bkra shis khang gsar du khri 'don gyi mdzad sgo gnang /tshes 15 nyin sku 'bum byams pa gling du/ skyabs rje bla kho rdo rje 'chang 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mchos mkhan po dang / rje 'jigs med rgya mtshos dus go ba/ rgya yag blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis grogs dan/sku 'bum mkhan khri 'dzin pa stong 'khor ho thog thu blo bzang byang chub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ gser tog no mon han blo bzang 'jam dpalabastan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ thar shul spral sku dge legs dbang phyug chos skyong rgya mtsho/ ko'u ba spral sku blo bzang bshad theb rgya mtsho/ a kya yongs 'dzin dkon mchog sbyin pa so|sa/gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i dane 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su/ tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa phul te rje btsun blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gsol zhing / bla kho rin po dang rgya yag rin po che rnam gnyis yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ dbang lung zab chos kyi chos bka' gsan bzhes gnang ba'i dbu tshugs/phyi lo 1947 lor/ sa smad nang ma khang zhabs 'bring dang / bkra shis lhun po nas 'byor ba'i drung che nor brang blo rgyan ngo las kyis/ gzhis byes bkras lhun bla brang gi tshab zhus te go min tang la re 'dun don tshan gnyis zhus/ dang po/7paṇa chen yang srid sa gnas 'di gar gcig thog gnas 'khel thog bod la gdan zhu thub pa dang/ 7paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gyi mtshan snyan thob thang slar gso yong ba dang / gnyis pa/ sku srung dmag rnams rang khongs su bsdad 'thus dang zas rdzogs go lag sogs sngar bzhin yong ba zhus kyang don min ma byung /phyi lo 1948 lor/ bod gzhung gi tshong don sku tshab rtsis dpon zha sgab 418

skya che zi sto da kyi cha par/ dza sag ci 'jigs med dang / lha smon ye shes tshul khrims/ blo bzang rin chen gsum gyis/ nga tshos rang gzhung la dgos nges kyi bde sdug thung thung zhig las zhu rgyu med/ snga lo dza sag ser skya'i gdong la yang zhus yod pa ltar/ nga tshos ngos 'dzin zhus pa'i sprul sku der 7paṇa chen yang srid ngo mar thugs gtan 'khel ba dang / bkras bla'i sngar gyi 'dzin dbang bdag thob rnams rang 'jags yong ba/gzhung stsal dza bla ngo las phyir 'then mdzad rgyu de gsum la zhal bzhes gtsang ma gnang na tshul mthun phyir log zhu rgyu rang yin nges kyang / nga tsho'i bar du sus zhus ma shes pa'i dkrug shing lta bus zhu rtsa lam du lhong min 'dug pas/ sku tshos rgyal khab tu snyan seng yag po gnang skyong yong ba zhes zhus/phyi lo 1949 lor/ bkras lhun bla brang gi drung che nor brang blo rgyan lha ldan du srid skyong stag brag dang / bka' shag la sla ra yang bus mdo mgon po tshe brtan/ 7paṇa chen yang srid ngos len yong ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus kyang /bod gzhung gis bla brang nang ma khang gi lugs mthun zhu 'bod la bdag sprod ma byung /bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi srol rgyun byung rabs lo rgyus nang / yab sras gnyis phan tshun yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang dgos pa ma zad/7rgyal ba yab sras gang sku tshe ma zin pa'i skabs/ gang sku 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa de sku nar ma son pas yang srid ngos 'dzin gnang ma thub kyang / chos lugs kyi 'gro lugs gzhan las ngos 'dzin zhus pa'i 7rgyal ba yab sras de/ gang 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa des nges par du ngos len yodadagos/ gal srid ngos len ma thob tshe de ni lo rgyus kyi 7rgyal ba7paṇa chen ngo ma zhig chags kyi med stabs/ bod bstan srid kyi 'gro don gnang thub rgyu ha cang gi dka' ba'i gnas shig red/419

7paṇa chen zher te gi zhib 'thugasku 'bum bla brang zhabs 'bring tshos btsal 'tshol ngos 'dzin zhus pa'i mgon po tshe brtan/ 7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung gis khas len gnang med par brten/ bla brang zhabs 'bring tshos rang nyid kyi rtsa don mtha' 'khyol dang /yang srid khri 'don nar lus su gyur dogs kyi blo 'tshab ma bzod par/ nan cing bkras bla'i don gcod ci 'jigs med kyis/ rang gi mthun grogs su brtsi ba'i go min srid gzhung nas/ ngos 'dzin chog mchan yong ba'i tar 'phrin nag po zhig bskur ba'i lam nor du bzhud/de dus kyi go mi tang gis bod gzhung la mthun 'brel srid jus 'dzin bzhin yod stabs/ thog ma'i char nang ma khang gi zhu ngor bdag sprod ma byas par/yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu ba ni bod kyi chos phyogs kyi gal che'i don chen zhig yin pas/ bod kyi chos lugs bdag pos khas len byed dgos/ mig sngar lam seng thag gcod byed mi 'os/ sngon la lha sa'i rgyal tshab stag brag la tar 'phrin zhig gtong rgyu yin/ tar lan 'byor rjes gzhi nas zhib 'jug byed rgyu yin pa bshad/skad cha de lhag bsam dag gi gtam zhig min kyang / bstod ma shes na smad pa'i dpe ru gyur ba ltar/ lo rgyus la 'gan khyer ba'i gtam zhig chags yod/bod gzhung gis khye'u gsum lha sar gdan 'dren zhus nas gzan ril bsgril ba'i lugs ltar ngos 'dzin gnang rgyu mtha' 'khyongs gnang bzhin yod pa ni/ go min srid gzhung la 'byor ba'i rgyal tshab stag brag gi tar lan du/ zi ling gi khye'u sngon la lha sar gdan 'dren zhus te gzhi nas ngos 'dzin gnang rgyu las/rang sor nas ngos 'dzin zhus na sngar srol dang mi mthun pa gsungs/ de ltar phyogs so so'i dgongs bzhed u tshugs mtha' skyel gnang bas/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang spral ngos 'dzin gtan 'khel gnang rgyur/ yun ring 'gor 'gyangs kyi bar chajo chen po bzos/420

skya tshe'i sto da kyi cha/phyi lo 1949 zla 5 nang zing ling khul du gung khran tang gi shugs rkyen chen po slebs pas/ sa smad nang ma khang la 'jigs snang dang blo 'tshab chen po bzos pa ma zad/ 7paṇa chen yang sprul gdan zhu byed phyogs thad sku 'bum du yod pa'i gzhis byes zhabs 'bring rnams phan tshun thugs snang ma gshin pa byung bas/ zi ling du bzhugs pa'i mgon po tshe brtan 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po sku phreng bcu bzhi pa thugs gtan 'khel phyorges dang mtshungs par/ bod sa zin mtshams gcig thog gtan 'khel yong ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus par/ bod gzhung nas khyod tshos 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po gdan zhu dang / thugs gtan 'khel ba'i mdzad phyogs ltar yong ba'i re zhu byed pa ni ha cang thal che drags pa zhig yin pa'i bka' bkyon las zhal bzhes ma thob/dus skabs der bkras shis lhun po bla brang gi sku tshab dngul chu sprul sku dang / bde gzim dpal mgon tshe ring zung / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyi mdun skyabs 'jug zhu bar bcar skabs/ khyod tshos da bar lugs mthun bde sdug zhu yi yod kyang / deng sang snyan zhu 'bul stangs log bkar red/khyod tsho phyi rtag tu g.yang mo gcig khyu yin yang nang rtag tu ma re bu re red/ khe nyen gyi bsam gzhigs byed dgos/ da nas nga'i shag tu yong mi dgos zhes khro gnyer bsdus nas bka' bkyon phebs shing / rtsis dpon klu khang par nang bcar zhu skabs/ nga la dbang jus yod pa ma red/ bla dpon rnam par zhabs skul yang yang zhu dgos/ nga'i go thos su sa smad du yod pa'i 7paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gung khran gyi rta rgyab tu bzhon rtsis byed kyi yod 'dra bas/ de 'dra byas na khyod tsho'i zhu mos la don smin yong rgyu phar bzhag tshang mar mtshan shas gang min yong gzhir/de lugs bzhugs sgar la gnas tshul yag po gtong rgyu gal che gsungs/1010bod kyi rigaganas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/deb 4/shog sbyonanas 1na bar/mi rigs dpe kun khang /phyi lo 1981lo ra/421

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jugabla brang zhabs 'bring tshos gzhung la zhu 'bod byas par don 'bras smin rgyu'i thugs re bral stabs/ phyi lo 1949 zla 6 tshes 3 nyin/ bkras lhun bla brang gi las byed ci 'jigs med kyis slar yang rgya nag go min srid gzhung gi srid 'dzin li tsung ran la/ 7paṇa chen yang srid ngos 'dzin chog mchan dang /gser bum dkrug mi dgos pa'i re skul zhus/ nyin de ni bod gzhung gis lha sdod go mi tang gi don gcod dran shin cang dang / gung khran tang gi myul mar dogs pa'i 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal sogs rgya gar brgyud rgya nag tu phyir log btang ba'i nyin mo dang 'khel yod/li tsung ran bod gzhung gi bya spyod la yi ma rangs pas/ sa smad bla brang zhabs 'bring gi zhus ngo bzhin mtsho sngon du yod pa'i khye'u mgon po tshe brtan ni/ mkhyen dpyod rab tu rgyas shing blo rig shin tu gsal ba zhig yin stabs/7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu ba'i yang srid yin par nor 'khrul med la/ gser bum/ dkrug 'don gyi mdzad sgo tshogs mi dgos par/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu par ngos 'dzin byed chog tshul bshad pa dang sbrags/ sku 'bum dgon du khri 'don gyi mdzad sgo gzab rgyas shig tshogs/bla brang dang go mi tang gi bya spyod la bod gzhung dgongs 'dzol gyis/dpa' shod 'os spral gdan zhur/ khe smad dang bkras bla'i ldan lhun gnyis mngags/lha sare 'byor jos kun gling bla brang du bzhugs kyang / sku 'khor gyi 'gro gron tshang ma bkras lhun bla brang nas btang zhing / 'os sprul yongs 'dzin du gting skyes sprul sku dang / 'tsho ba'i do dam par lde 'chang bsko 'dzugs gnang / phyis 'bras spungs tshogs chen sprul skur bzhag cing da lta phyi rgyal du yo/da/ gting skyes sprul skur li thang nas rnyed pa'i 'os spral rdo rje tshe ring / phyis bkras lhun rgya khang rdzun gyi tshogs chen spra skur bskos pa |nyis lha sar gdan 'dren zhus/ go thos su/422 ༄

skya che'i sto da kyai cha/bod gzhung gis tsha ba dpa' shod kyi 'os spral/ 7paṇa chen yang spral du yongs bsgrags ngos 'dzin gnang med kyang / naX don ngos 'dzin zhu 'chor gyis bkra shis lhun po'i dkyil khang grwa tshang gi dkyil khang rin po che yongs 'dzin lta bur bsko gzhag gnang ba gsungs/11ma'o kru zhis nub byang bcings grol gtong rgyu'i byed phyogs skor gyi mdzub ston nang / 7paṇa chen lan kur yod pas phar rgol byed skabs/ 7paṇa chen la srung skyob byas te bod bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i gra sgrig byed dgos pa'i bka' rgya btang / skabs der 7paṇa chen nang khang gi dza sag bla ma blo bzang rgyal mtshan/drung che lha smon ye shes tshul khrims/ mdzad mgron tā bla ma ngag dbang sbyin pa/chab srid 'gan 'dzin ci g.yu rgyal//ce 'jigs med kyi a khu// slob ston 'gan 'dzin blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ spyi gnyer 'gan 'dzin thub bstan nyi ma sogs/gung go dmag 'khrug las g.yol ched sku 'bum las zhal gyes te tu'u lan rdzong shang sder bzhugs yod/phyi lo 1949 zla 9 tshes 5 nyin/ gung khran tang gi nub byang cus kyi dmag dpung gis/ sku 'bum nang khang dang 'brel ba byas te gung khran tang gi srid jus dril bsgrags byas/ sku 'bum bzhugs sgar du yod pa'i 'gan khur blo bzang 'phrin las kyis/ shang sder bzhugs pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po che dang /zhabs 'bring las sne tshor snyan seng zhu bar bcar/ dza sag gtsos zhabs 'bring tsho gung khran tang la dogs pa yod kyang / mnyam las byas na 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dang / bzhugs sgar nang khang bod la log thub rgyur yid ches kyis khengs te/gung khran tang la re ba chen po bcol te/ ci 'jigs med zi ling du gung khran tang la 'brel ba byed par mngags/11no yo na bde dbang palas kyi zhal gsungs/423

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'jugaphyi lo 1949 zla 9 ci 'jigs med dang / dza sag bla ma blo bzang 'phrin las sogs kyis 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mchog gi sku par 'khyer te/lan kyur nub byang cud kyi dmag dpon phan ming thug par bskyod/ bkras mthong ci 'jigs med kyis gung khran tang dang mnyam las gnang bar/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pas gang zhig gnang dgos min shes 'dod kyi bsam tshul shugs chen bstan stabs/ rgya dpon phan ming gis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi rgyal gces bsam pa nga tsho nub byang bca' sdod bcings 'grol dmag gis shes kyi yod/'on kyang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog rgyal spyi'i thog mtshan snyan yod pa'i bod kyi chos lugs kyi gtso 'dzin zhig yin pa dang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis mes rgyal dang gung khran tang la 'chang ba'i lhag bsam zol med de/rgyal yongs mi dmangs kun gyis shes rtogs thub na yag po yod tshul bshad par/bkras mthong ci 'jigs med kyis de ltar yin na nga tshos byed stangs gang zhig la brten nas/ shes rtogs de rigs thub pa byed dgos pa dris/phan ming gis khyed tsho gros bsdur byas te/ gal te 7paṇa chen mchog gis 'os shing 'tsham pa 'dug dgongs na/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab 'dzugs pa'i khyab bsgrags rgyal yongs su gang mgyogs bya rgyu yin pas/khong gis go skabs de dang bstun nas nga tsho'i mi rigs khang gi mi dmangs kyi gtso 'dzin la tar yig cig btang nas/ khyed tsho'i langs phyogs mtshon par gnang na gang 'dra 'dug pa dris/mthar phan ming gis yig 'bru re dang tshig grub re re bzhin bkod jus byas te//de ltar byas lugs phan ming kho rang gi rtsom yig nang gsal//ci 'jigs med dang /424

kyi tshe'i sto da kyi cha/7paṇa chen rin po che'i drung yig sung kri hu'us/ bris shing / dgung lo 11 la son pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi mtshan thog nas ma'o kru'u zhir phul/11 tar yig cha tshang gsham gsal/pe cin du/ kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang / krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi spyi khyab si ling kru'u te mchog la/ mchog rnam gnyis kyis dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i sgo nas rgyal 'bangs skyob pa'i don chen gnang ba dang / dmag dpung gang du 'byor yang rgyal yongs gang sar dga' spro rab tu skyes kyi yod la/7paṇa chen sku thog rim byon la rgyal khab kyis bka' drin che bzhes gnang bar 'os bkur lhad med yod/ lo 20 lhag tsam mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs bdag dbang cha tshang yong ba'i ched du/ gang sar bskyod de ltod g.yeng spu tsam yang med pa'i 'bad brtson byas yod kyang / gus par grub 'bras ma byung bar brten/yun ring po blo sems mi bde ba'i ngang bod la log rgyu'i bka' bsgugs nas mtsho sngon du lus song / bkra shis pa zhig la mchog rnam gnyis kyi 'go khrid 'og nub byang bcings grol thob pa dang krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dbu brnyes thub pa byung bar sems shugs yod pa'i mi rnams kyis sems 'gul thebs byung zhes mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur thog shod kyi yod/ slad phyin mi dmangs bde zhing skyed pa dang rgyal khab dar rgyas yong rgyu'i re ba yod pa/ bod bcings grol myur thob yong rgyu yin pa bcas la brten 7paṇa chen rin po ches mi dmangs yongs kyi tshab gnang nas mchog rnam gnyis la bla na med pa'i gus 'dud dang brtsi srung dga' gus tshad med zhu rgyu yin/7paṇa chen er te nis/ 12bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad bzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/'don thengs 15pa /'o/ga nang /mi rigs dpe skrunakhang /phyi lo 1984lor 425

byepa/cheXb1༷duXs 1 nyinaphyi lo 1950 zla 4 tshes 16 nas/ mtsho sngon 'thab phyogs cig gyur khang gis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi skor la las ka byed shugs che ru btang zhing /ci 'jigs med kyis lan kru'i nub byang dmag khul rteng gi dmag dpon phan ming la dgongs skor zhus te/ zhi an du nub byang dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi dbu khrid pheng te ha'o mjal 'phrad du phyin/ pheng te ha'os ma'o kru zhir 7paṇa chen rten 'bul tshogs pa pe cing du nam bcar skor la dgongs skor zhus par/ zla 8tshes 3 nyin/ ma'o kru'u zhis ci 'jigs med pe cin du yong nas/ kho tsho'i re 'dun dang bsam 'char thad nyan rgyur yid mthun byas//— 426

skya tshe'i sto da kyi cha/cile tshan bzhi sda/ lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen rin pho che chags pa/rgya dmar nag gnyis dbar khyod shi nga gson gyi nang 'khrug dza drag kyang /bod rgya khongs su bston ched gnyis gas mtsho sngon sku 'bum du yod pa'i bla brang nang ma khang chab srid kyi lag char bod spyod gtong rgyur hab thob yod/ gung go nang 'khrug gis sa smad nang ma khang gi gnas bab la yo lang nges can zhig thebs rgyu bshad mi dgos stabs/ bla brang nang ma khang lo mang 'brel 'dris yod pa'i go min tang gi rjes su 'brangs nas the wan du 'gro 'am/ chos lugs dug tu lta ba'i gung khran tang gi rta rgyab tu bzhon te bod la log yang na/ bod gzhung la bton pa'i cha rkyen gsum /mtsho sngo na du yod pa 'i bla brang nang ma khang gi zhabs 'breng lugs mthun bod la log rgyur bod gzhung la cha rkyen gsum bdon yod pa ni/mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen yang srid ngo mar ngos len dang / bkras bla'i sngar gyi 'dzin dbang bdag thob rnams rang 'jags phyir slo ga gzhung bskos dza bla ngo las phyir 'then mdzad rgyu//blos btang gis bod gzhung gi bka' ltar/ mgon po tshe brtan lha sar gdan 'dren zhus te/ 'os spral gzhan gnyis dang lhan gzan rtags las ngos 'dzin zhu dgos/ ༄las don mang po zhig bkras lhun bla brang gis ngos 'dzin zhus zin pa'i dgung lo 11 las son med pa'i 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i mtshan thog nas bsgrub dgos kyi yod stabs/ phyi lo 1949 zla 10 tshes 1 nyin/ phan ming gi bkod mngags bzhin ci 'jigs med kyis/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i mtshan 427

7paṇa chen ser te ni gis 'jugathog nas/ gung khran tang dbu brnyes par rten 'brel dang / gang myur bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyur re zhing sgug pa'i gong gi tar 'phrin de btang ste/gung khran tang gi rjes su 'brangs rgyu'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa des/ ma'o kru zhis rgyal spyi'i thog bod kyi bla chen zhig gis bod la bcings grol gtong rgyu'i re skul snyan zhu 'byor tshul bsgrags te/ gung khran tang bod la yong rgyur char pa chu grogs su gyur yod/ma'o kru zhi'i bsgrags gtam de bod gzhung gis gsan pa dang / rgya nag dmar po dang mtsho sngon bla brang nang ma khang mnyam 'brel yin pa shes te/ bod gzhung gis drung rtsis yan gyi tshogs 'du bskongs te/ sa smad nang ma khang gis gung khran tang dang mnyam 'brel gyis byang lam brgyud bod du yong rtsis byed kyi yod skad la/ bya chags pa'i shing med par bzo dgos pas/ sngon la bkra shis lhun po rtsa med bzo dgos pa dang / de nas lha sar yod pa'i bkras bla'i don gcod pa rnams do dam btson 'jug byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi srid skyong dang bka' shag la phul ba ma zad/phyi lo 1950 lor/ byang brgyud zhi drag spyi 'doms bka' blon mdo mkhar ba dang / me skyogs rgyag mkhan drung 'khor kha shas/ kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi dmag dpung gzhis rtse'i nye 'dabs kun skyob gling pho brang nang du bca' stod byas/13dus skabs der bla brang nang ma khang gi zhabs 'bring tshos bsam 'dun dang / bshad tshul gcig rang yod pa ni/ rgya nag nas sngar bzhin bod sdod am ban chu thog brgyud phebs rgyu'i re ba dang / bod 'dir rgya mi sngo chags ger khengs 1 bod kyi reg gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi rgyu cha bdam/sa bsgrigs deb 4pa /shog ngos 90nang /mi rigs dpe sgrun khang phyi tsha 1981lo ra/428

skya che'i stod kyi cha/pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 14smon lam brgyab pa tsam ma zad/ chab mdo rgya lag tu shor ba thos skabs dga' tshor yang skyes skad/15de ltar gzhung bla'i 'gal ba rtse mor son zhing / kun gzigs 7paṇa chen dgu pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu ba'i gnad don chab srid 'thab rtsod kyi rgya ru tshud stabs/ mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen dgu pa'i yang spral yin min la ma bltos par/ 7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung gis bla brang rgo zhu 'bod ltar/7paṇa chen bcu par khas len thob rgyu min pa gsal po chags shing / da cha bla brang nang ma khang la 'gro lam gcig rang yod pa ni/ blo thag rbad gcod kyis gung khran tang gis rgyab skyor 'tshol rgyu de red/ phyi lo 1950 zla 8 tshes 3 nyin/ ma'o tse tung gis pe cing nas mtsho ston du yod pa'i phang te ho la glog 'phrin btang nas/ 7paṇa chen gyi ngo tshab pe cing du gtong dgos pa'i bka' btang zhing / phyi lo 1950 zla 9 par nang ma sgang gi dza sag ci 'jigs med dang / no yon tshul sgang / mdzo ra wang don grub/sog po blo bzang bcas ngo g.yog bdun pe cing du ma'o kru'u zhi thug par phebs/ma'o tse tung gis bod bcings 'grol gtong rgyu'i skor gyi gnad don la gsal bshad byas pa dang / phyi lo 1951 zla 2 tshes 27 nyin/ nub byang dmag srid cus kyi dmag dpon h+phan ming / 7paṇa chen bzhugs sgar gyi ngo tshab dang / yung han krang ngo tshab las rogs su bskos/phyi lo 1950 zla 4 tshes 39 nyin/ h+phan ming gis 7paṇa chen rin po che dang / nang ma sgang gi mtho rim zhabs gras 45 ste 'khrid kyis/ pe cing du 14pod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs deb 4pa /shog ngos 9༷nang /mi rigs dpe sgrun khang /gyi lo 1981lo ra/15bod kyi rig gnas lorgyus dpyad gan rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs deb 4pa/shog ngos 9༷nang /mi rigs dpe sgrun khang /pyi lo 1981lor/429
