7paṇa chen ser te gi zhing 'jus don tshan bcu bdun gyi gnad don gsan par gdan 'dren zhus/16 phyi lo 1951zla 5 tshes 23 nyin/ bod rgya gros 'dun don tshan bcu bdun gyi sngon 'gror/rgya nag gzhung gis 7gong sa mchog nas mgon po tshe brtan ngos 'dzin khas len dgos pa'i cha rkyen bton/ mi mang po zhig gis de ni bla brang nang ma khang gi zhus ngo bzhin bton par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/dus skabs der lha sa'i bkra shis lhun po'i don gcod sku tshab gzhis ka rtser phebs nas bka' gros mthil phyin gnang rjes/ gdan sa bkra shis lhun po'i gnad yod mi sna kha cig gro mo dung dkar dgon na phyogs g.yol du bzhugs pa'i 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sku mdun du bcar te/ pus mdo mgon po tshe brtan lha bla'i lung brtag dang / 7paṇa chen sku gong ma'i lung bstan bka' yig dang yongs su rtse mthun byung bas/ ngos 'dzin gtan 'khel yong ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus/pe cing nas bka' blon nga phod kyis grog 'phrin brgyud/ 7paṇa chen nang ma khang nas ngos 'dzin zhus pa ma zad/ krung hwa min go'i srid gzhung gis dngos su chog mchan bkod pa'i a mde'i phyogs 'khrungs pa'i 'os sprul der zhal bzhes ma gnang na/ rgya bod gros mol la gnod skyon yong tshul phul thebs/ phyi lo 1951zla 7 tshes 19 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog gis pus mdo mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu par 'khrul bral ngos 'dzin dang sbrags/ bstan 'dzin 'phrin las 'jigs med chos kyi dbang phyug ces pa'i mtshan gsol gnang /7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung bka' shag gis/ pe cing du yod pa'i bod gzhung bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med la/ 7paṇa chen rin 16 bden don gsal ba'i sgron me/lha phrug sgas brtsams /bde srung las khungs kyis par 'grems byas/430

skya che 'i tsā da kyai cha/ po che'i sku skye'i gnad don de bkra shis lhun po'i mkhan po bzhi dang / nang ma khang gi dpon rigs lhan 'dzoms gros tshogs thog nas/ gang thub ci thub kyis 7gong sa mchog nas ngos 'dzin gnang rgyu'i re 'dun zhus yod la/ da res rgya phyogs kyis kyang ngos 'dzin bya rgyu'i blang bya mtha' gcig tu bton 'dug stabs/nga tsho gzhis byes tshang mas der mos mthun yod pa'i tar lan gnang bas/17bka' zur nga phod kyis bod gzhung bka' shag gi mtshan thog nas/ 7gong sa mchog gis mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen bcu par ngos 'dzin gnang bar rten 'brel zhus/ rgya nag gung khran tang gis chings don sngon 'gror/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i gnad don bton med tshe/ gzhung bla'i don rkyen las 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog dang bod gzhung gis/ bkras lhun bla brang gis ngos 'dzin zhus pa'i pus mdo ma ru sde pa'i bus mdo dpon tshang gi sras mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid 'khrul bral yin min la ma bltos par/ ngos 'dzin /bas len gnang rgyu ha cang khag po yin/spyi nor 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog gis/ nga tsho'i sku tshab gtso bo nga phod nas glog 'phrin zhig btang 'byor du/ rgya mi'i 'os spral der khas len ma byas na gros mol la skyon gnod yong gi yod tshul 'khod 'byeg gzhung dang /dgon khag gis 'go khrid tshos sngar lam brtag dpyad dgos tshul brjod kyi yod kyang / skabs der de ltar yong thabs med stabs/ rim bzhin da lta'i mchog sprul rin po che 'di ngo mar gyur pa gsungs/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ gung khran tang med na/7paṇa chen nga'i da lta'i gnas bab yod pa ma red/ ces pa'i zhal gsung bka' 1 krung gung tang gi 'o rgyus yig cha deb na shog ngos 1 gnang nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med gsungs/431

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'dugaslob de yang lo rgyus kyi gnas bab 'di 'dra zhig la gsungs pa los yin/phyi lo 1951 bod zla 5 tshes 19 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog gis tar 'phrin nang / ngos nas 'di gar thugs dam zhus par/ gang nyid 7paṇa chen sku gong ma'i yang srid 'khrul bral ngos 'dzin thag gcod byung zhing / bkra shis lhun por yang bkod khyab btang zin gsungs pa ltar/ bkras lhun dza bla thub bstan chos ldan gyis lha sdod don gcod thun mong la/ bkra shis lhun po'i zur bzhi zhabs 'bring lha sde mi sde tshang mas gsol 'debs zhus don ltar/ da lam 7gong sa skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i thugs dam bzang phebs dgongs don/ sa smad du yod pa'i 'os spral mgon po tshe brtan/7paṇa chen yang srid du thugs gtan 'khel ba'i bka' bstong spyi bo'i mdzes rgyan du thob pa'i bka' rgya bstsal/bka' tar des 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu phyogs skor gyi rnyog gleng la 'khrun chod kyi bzhi shad bskyon zhing / pus mdo mgon po tshe brtan chos srid kyi 'gro lugs gnyis kyi steng nas/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chags pa'i rgyal rnga zhig kyang yin/phyi lo 1951 zla 5 tshes 30 nyin/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches/7gong sa mchog la rten 'brel zhu yig cig phul zhing / 7gong sa mchog nas kyang lo de'i zla 7 tshes 19 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher bstsal ba'i bka' yig nang /mchog nyid 7paṇa chen sku gong ma'i yang spral 'khrul ba med par/ bkra shis lhun por yongs khyab gsal bsgrags dang / pe sdung phebs bzhugs nga phod la'ang gsal 'debs zhus yod/ da lta mchog nyid gang myur dog thon gyis dgon par phyir log phebs skyong yod pa'i 'phrin lan nor bu gling ga nas bka' bstsal/432

kyi che'i stod kyi cha/bod gzhung dang bkras lhun bla brang bar/ 7paṇa chen yang sprul ngos 'dzin zhu phyogs kyi gnad don phud/ da dung don rkyen gzhan zhig yod pa ni/ phyi lo 1923 lor/ 7paṇa chen dgu pa phyogs g.yol du phebs dgos pa'i don rkyen yin/gnad don de gzhi rtsa'i cha nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang thag gcod byung mod/ lag len dngos kyi thog zhib phra'i gtsang sel byung med/phyi lo 1951 zla 8 tshes 1 nyin/ bkras bla'i dza tā rim (dza sag bkras mthong ci 'jigs med/ tā bla ma ngag dbang sbyin pa/ rim gzhi dpa' 'dun//gsum/ mtsho sngon bla brang bzhugs sgar nas stod nyi ma lha sa'i phyogs su/ gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang dang lhan bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i chos gzhis mkhar dbang gi rtsod rnyog 'khrun gcod zhi mol dang / skyid skyid na khar 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa phebs bsu'i go sgrig las don ched chibs rdog thon gnang mdzad//433

7paṇa chen nar te ni gi' 'dugale tshan lda sda/ yab sras lhan 'dzoms kyi skal bzang /phyi lo 1951 zla 9 tshes 11 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog gis lha ldan rgyal khab nas/ a mdo sku 'bum dgon par bzhugs yod pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu par phyag 'phrin zhig bstsal ba'i nang / bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon mtshungs med 7paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog gi sprul sku rin po che'i drung du/'bebs sor 5 bsegs 'gros kyi/ zhu ba/ deng phun sum tshogs pa'i dus kyi char yang / stobs bcu mnga' ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul rol pa gsang gsum mtshan dpe'i zla ris mngon par gsal zhing / mdzad 'phrin bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar 'phro bzhin par 'tsho gzhes ni bka' drin che/ 'dir yang / 'du ba sgoms shing / bstan srid 'gro ba yongs la phan bde spel ba'i lhag bsam mchog tu dkar bar mchis/mtshams gsol/ kun gzigs mchog spral rin po che nyid/ rgya zla 12nang sku 'bum nas bod ljongs chos kyi zhing sar drobs thon thub pa'i dgongs bzhes gnang mus/ ngos kyang dga' spro chen po byung bas/ bla brang rang khungs nas gdan zhu 'phral bcar dgos pa'i bkod khyab kyis ched bcar song ba'i thogagazhung gnas nas kyang da lam dmigs bsal gdan zhur mkhan chung blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang / mda' dpon mkhar rna ba/ gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan 'thus bcas/ gar mjal sar bcar ba'i bsko brdzong song ba bzhin 434

kyi che'i stod kyai cha/phebs 'gyangs su ma song ba'i 'phral phebs thub pa zhu rgyu/ slad mar yang / zab gsang mtshan dpe'i bkod par lam gnas kun tu tshur mthong snang ngor 'gal rkyen nye zho mi bzhes ngos/ mtha' yas 'gro blo'i mos ngo dang mthun 'jug 'phrin las phul cher skyong ba ga nas/ ring min 'dzum zhal ltod mjal chog par nang ma'i phebs tshogs kyang yod pa mkhyen/zhu 'degs lha rdzas nang mdzod bcas lcags yos bod zla 9 tshes 11 bzang por phul/18 zhes 'khod /7gong sa 7rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog dang bod gzhung gis/ mkhan chung me tog rgyal mtshan dang / kha dang mda' dpon sku 'khor/ sku 'bum du 7paṇa chen bcu pa phebs bsur ched rdzong zhus pa dang / phyi lo 1 951 zla 12 tshes 9nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi gna' mkhar zi ling nas/khong dang na zla mnyam pa'i khri ka rdzong gi ye shes /da lta bod ljongs par len khang na yod/rgya ming la nyan shan zer//sogs/ zhabs g.yog chig stong lhag gis rta dril rnga mong gi khal ma chig khri sum stong brgal ba ded nas/ stod dbus gtsang dam pa chos kyi zhing sar sku tshe'i rin thang 'tshol bar mngon du phyogs 'dugashang sde dang / chu dmar leb/ gdang la/ nag chu sogs brgyud chos ldan zhing khams nyi ma lha ldan du zhabs sor 'khod/ ye shes kyi dran gso ltar na/phyi lo 1952 zla zha zla mjug tu/ 7paṇa chen rin po che sku 'khor dang bcas pa/bod byang thang nag chu grong rdal du 'byor skabs/ nag chur sdod pa'i bka' shag gi spyi khyab gnyis dang / nag chu dgon pa'i bla ma/ 'brog pa mang tshogs sogs mi grangs stong phrag 'gas phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus pa dang / ra sgreng nas lde snyenam yig bod rang skyo nga ljo ngas yig tshags lang na yod 'dugargyu cha bdams bsgrigs 'don thengs 9shogan4 nang /435

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhi'agaduga'achang blo bzang nyi ma ched btang gis/ byang ra sgreng du dgon du gnas gzigs su spyan 'dren zhus/'phan po brgyud lcags ri phra mor zhes pa'i bzhugs sgar du/ bka' blon zur khang gis phebs bsu 'tshams 'dri dang bcas/ dus yun nyin grangs 133 'grul bzhud gnang mthar/ phyi lo 1952 zla 4 tshes 27 nyin/'brom stod bzhugs sgar du/ zla 4 tshes 28 nyin pho brang po ta lar 7rgyal ba yab sras mjal 'phrad zhu phyogs skor bka' mol byung yod/ 'on kyang / blo pham dgos pa zhig la mjal 'phrad kyi ngo bo de chab srid kyi rnam par gyur 'dugade yang rgya nag gzhung gi bod bskyod dmag dpung nub byang cud kyis/7paṇa chen bcu pa'i sngar yod go thob slar gso'i rgyab skyor dang / bod gzhung gis phyogs nas bsnyad 'dogs dang bston dkyis kyis/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i go thob dang phugs rkyen gcog thabs gnang 'dug gnas tshul de'i skor sto ri se than gyi bod kyi deng rabs lo rgyus bam po gnyis pa'i nang / 7gong sa bcu bzhi pa mchog la bcar 'dri dang / phan ming gi skad cha bkod 'dug pa gzhir bzung /bka' zur shan kha pa'i lo rgyus rang byung lhad med zangs nang gsungs pa gsum zhib bsdur bkod na/bod gzhung gis 7rgyal ba yab sras thog ma'i mjal 'phrad ji ltar gnang phyogs skor/ 7paṇa chen nang ma khang la gros 'char zhig phul 'dug pa'i nang / 7paṇa chenarin po ches 7gong sa mchog la sku phyag 'bul dgos pa/7paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs khri de 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs khri las dan bkyag gnyis kyi dma' ba dgos pa/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la 436

sku che'i stod kyai cha/rten 'bul bstar dgos pa/ 7paṇa chen rin po che gtsug lag khang du bca' sdod mi chog pa bcas red 'dug19bod gzhung gi dgongs 'char de 7paṇa chen rin po cher phyag tu son pa dang / nang ma khang gi dpon rigs rnams khong khro drag tu langs te/ gnas bab de 'dra zhig gi 'og nas lha sar phyin pa las/ gzhis ka rtser thad kur log rgyu yag pa bshad/ phyogs gnyis kus gnad don la bab bstun zhig rtsa ba nas ma gnang stabs/ bod las don u yon lhan khang zhes pa'i rgya mi'i las byed chos/bya thabs ci ltar spyod pa'i 'tshogs 'du bskongs 'dugaya mtshan dgos pa zhig la/ gzhung bla gnyis kyi don rkyen dang 'dra bar/ rgya nag gzhung gi bod bskyod dmag dpung lto nub cud dang nub byang cud gnyis la'ang 'gal zla 'dug der brten/ krang go ha sogs lho nub cud kyis 7paṇa chen rin po che bod gzhung gi 'og la gtugs dgos pa bshad de/7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la sku phyag 'bul dgos pa'i bsam tshul 'dzin pa dang / phan ming sogs nub byung cud kyis 7gong sa mchog dang 7paṇa chen rin po che go thob 'dra mnyam yin pas na/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la sku phyag 'bul mi dgos pa'i langs phyogs bzung /gnad don der bod las don u yon lhan khang gis the jus chen pos/gzhung bla phyogs gnyis kyi sku tshab bskongs nas gros bsdur bya dgos pa'i bsam tshul bshad pa ma zad/ bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid nang khul du yang gnad don der lta tshul gnyis byung yod pa'i snyan seng rgya nag dbus gzhung la zhus 'dug 19 45 yoXs0(70spu ba1160(50154293389 lo /5thab ku 00131khu/ba 437

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhi' 'jugargya nag dbus gzhung gis/ tā la'i bla ma dang 7paṇa chen bla ma thad kur mjal 'phrad kyis gros mol nges par du bya dgos/ 'on kyang / bod las don u yon lhan khang gis gzab nan ngang gdan don de lag 'og tu yag po nyar dgos pa bshad/ mthar rgya nag dbus gzhung gi bka' khyab bzhin/ bod gzhung gi phyogs gnas bka' blon nga phod dang / sne'u shar/ nang ma khang gi phyogs nas ci 'jigs sogs lhan 'dzoms kyis gros mol gnang 'dug mod/phyogs so so'i 'dod pa mkhreg bzung las/ bab bstun gyi dgongs pa zhig ma bzhes pas/ gros mol la 'bras bu gang yang 'don mi 'dug207gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog ni bod mi'i chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po yin pas/ dgung na'i bab sogs phyogs gang nas bsam kyang /7pa ṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis sku phyag 'bul rgyu'i dgongs pa bzhes kyang /nang ma khang gi dza sag ci 'jigs med dang / dza ga lha smon ye shes tshul khrims sogs dang/ rgya nag gzhung gi bod bskyod dmag dpung nub byang bcud kyi dmag dpon phan ming sogs rgya dpon 'gas/ khong gi dgongs bzhed la mos mthun zhus mi 'dug21de yang / nang ma khang gi 'thus mi ce 'jigs med sogs kyis/ 7gong sa mchog 7paṇa chen rin po che phebs bsu zhu bar bcar dgos pa dang /227paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la sku phyag 'bul mi dgos pa/ phan tshun bzhugs mol skabs bzhugs khri mtho dman gcig mtshungs dgos tshul bshad par/ bod gzhung gi 'thus mi bka' blon nga phod kyis/ 7rgyal ba yab sras thog 204713 000(7076ba1163 50/pa pa ba2389 smo1༷/56ba 6 60/31dzi ba 21 chi ri 9 rngo chakhri na btsan rgolaskul skyobs /rdob dang ngo /shog150nang /tsong kha lha mo tshe ring /ma skyes rma chen bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug lang /438

kyi che 'i stod kyi cha/ma'i mjal 'phrad skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la sku phyag mi gnang ba dang bzhugs khri sgron yul zhal phyogs sogs/ 7gong sa mchog dang 'dra mnyam gru bzhi'i dgongs bzhes gnang bab 'di dag chos srid gnyis ku'i thad nas lugs srol 'apre rtsis med 'di 'dri'i dgongs pa bzhes kyi yod tshe/snga 'phros kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog 7gong sa mchog mjal phyag tu phebs ma dgos par lha sar bzhugs te/ gzhung bla gnyis kyi mdzad phyogs sngar srol ji yod yig gzhi go bsdur gnang na 'gab tshul la mtha' la bkar zhing /nang ma khang gi 'a thus mi ce 'jigs med sogs kyis/ da lam 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la sku phyag 'bul ma dgos pa dang / slad chos 'brel zhus mtshams sku phyag dang man ḍal sogs 'bul rgyu las/ da res lam seng sku phyag gnang rgyu mi 'gab pa zhus par/ bka' blon nga phod kyis sku phyag gnang na mjal 'phrad gaganang rgyu gsungs/23de ltar phyogs gnyis pos gros mol yun ring byas kyang gzhi mthun ma byung rkyen/ bod las don u yon lhan khang gis gnad don de'i thog nang 'grig gi gros don tshogs 'du bskyar du bskongs nas/7paṇa chen rin po che mchog ni 7gong sa mchog las dgung na gzhon zhing / tha na bla slob kyi 'brel ba med mod/ 'on kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog dang thog mar mjal 'phrad zhu skabs/ sku phyag nges par du 'bul dgos/ de nas phyogs gnyis go thob 'dra mnyam gyi thog nas phan tshun dbu thug gi 'tshams 'dri gnang rgyu/ bzhugs khri'i gnad don thad lo rgyus nang 7gong sa mchog dge rgan yin stabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs khri las dan bkyag gcig gi mtho ba yod mod/ da cha bzhugs khri 'dra mnyam dang /7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la rten 'bul sngon bstar dang bcas da rang gi lo rgyus rang byung lhad med bzang /shog 7canang / shan la pas brtsam sa/bod kyi dpe mdzod bang /phyi lo 19༷ lor 439

7paṇa chen zher te gi zhing 'jugaphan tshun rten 'bul bstar dgos pa sogs bshad/ de ltar yun ring gros mol byas mthar/ bod las don u yon lhan khang gis 'os 'tshams kyi thag gcod cig byas pa ni gsham gsal ltar red/7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la sku phyag 'bul skabs/7gong sa mchog bzhugs khri'i mdun sku bzhengs gnang rgyu dang / phan tshun nang mdzod bstar 'bul dang dbu thug gnang rgyu/ bzhugs khri mtho dman 'dra mnyam sgron rgyu sogs red/ gzhung bla phyogs gnyis gas thag gcod der mthun yong phyir/krang go ha bod gzhung 'thus mi bka' blon nga phod dang / phan ming gis nang ma khang gi 'thus mi ci 'jigs med go bskon blo 'gug byed pa phyin 'dug la/ga zhung bla phyogs gnyis kyi 'thus mis kyang / thag gcod der mos mthun dang sbrags/ de las 'gyur ba mi 'gro ba'i 'gan len thub pa dgos rgyu'i re ba'ang bton 'dug24rgya yig gi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'ga' zhig nang / krung dbyang sku tshab krang cing 'us bar 'dum gnang ste/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis thog ma'i mjal 'phrad skabs/ yab sras phyogs gnyis ka sku bzhengs kyis dbu thug gnang rjes/ mjal dar rtse sprod gnang rgyu'i thag chod byung yod kyang / dngos gzhi mjal 'phrad skabs/ 7gong sa mchog bzhugs khri'i steng bzhugs shing /khri'i g.yas g.yon du mgron gnyer bzhugs yod stabs/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches sku phyag phul ba dang / 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog khri las babs nas dbu thug dang mjal dar rtse sprod gnang zhes dang /da yod kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha khag 'ga' zhig gi nang / 7rgyal ba yab 24 45 chi 00097070ba1163 50/pal293389 smodzi/5yi 6 00/cugs ba 440

kyi tshe'i stod kyai cha/sras thog mar mjal 'phrad skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la sku phyag ma phul zhes dang / 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la sku phyag phul skabs/ 7gong sa mchog sku bzhengs gnang med ces pa la sogs/shod tshul mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig 'dug 'on kyang / dngos yod gnas tshul ji yin skor/sku zhabs sto ri se than gyis 7gong sa mchog bka' 'dri zhus par/7gong sa mchog gis/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches sku phyag phul stabs/ ngos bzhugs khri las bab te bzhugs khri'i mdun du langs nas bsdad pa yin zhes gsungs/25zhal gsung de las 7paṇa chen rin po che sku phyag phul ba dang / 7gong sa mchog bzhugs khri'i bdun sku bzhengs yod pa'i dngos yod gnas tshul de gsal kha byung yod/bod brgyud nang bstan gyi srol rgyun chos phyogs nas 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen khyad med cing / 7gong sa sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgyal mtsho'i skabs/7rgyal ba yab sras bzhugs khri mtho dman 'dra mnyam gnang lam dang /26yab sras skyes rabs lo rgyus nang phan tshun ngos 'dzin dang / bla slob dad pa'i sku phyag 'bul ba'i las byang thun min yod pa ni/ 7rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshos/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes la sku phyag phul ba dang /7paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes kyis/ 7rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshor sku phyag phul ba dang / 7rgyal ba sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtshos/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes la sku phyag phul ba/7paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi mas/ 7rgyal ba sku phreng brgyad pa 254515 000(5sku ba11ye 50/70292391 7617thab ku buX 31khu 0 naphyiraka ra chos byung gangs ljongs rig mdzod/deb 9pa /zhog ngos rtenang /bod ljongs dmangs dpe byu na khang /441

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhil 'juga' jam dpal rgya mtshor sku phyag 'bul ba'i las byang thun min yod pa bzhin /7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog ni/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mchog las/ chos srid gnyis thad nas bslab pa bgres pas/ sku phyag 'bul rgyu ya rabs dam pa'i rgyan du gyur pa smos ci dgos/'on kyang / yab sras dgung khyad mi lo gsum las med cing / bla slob kyi 'brel ba yang byung med stabs/ thog ma'i mjal 'phrad la dbu thug dang /mjal dar sne sprod/ thang shang gnang ste sku phyag ma phul yang de tsam gyi lugs 'gal las 'dzol zhig tu mi sems/ gang lags she na/ lo rgyus thog gi 7rgyal ba yab sras sku phreng rim byon thog ma'i mjal 'phrad skabs/ bla slob dang chos 'brel ma byung gong sku phyag phul min ci rigs byung yod pas so/blo gzur bos bshad na/ nang ma khang gis 7paṇa chen rin po che'i go thob sogs/ 7gong sa mchog dang 'dra mnyam dgos pa bshad pa ni mi 'tshams pa zhig red la/ bod gzhung gi zhabs 'bring tshos 7paṇa chen rin po cher lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen rin po che lha sar phebs pa ltar phebs bsu ma zhus par/ khong gi go thob dang shugs rkyen gcog thabs byas pa ni blo pham gyi gzhi las ma 'das/dper na/ 7paṇa chen sku gong ma rnams lha sar zhabs sor 'khod skabs/ gtsug lag khang gi rgyal rgyal sgo'i steng gzim chung gang rung zhig tu bzhugs lam yod kyang / skabs der gtsug la khang du bzhugs mi chog pa bshad pa sogs red/ 'on kyang / mtha' ma gtsug lag khang rgyal sgo'i steng /bla brang snang srid rab gsal du phebs ston mdzad sgo dang / gzim chung kun gsal du bzhugs zhag mdzad 'dug442

kyi che'i stod kyai cha/phyi lo 1952 zla 4 tshes 22 phyi dro'i chu tshod 4 steng / 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis thog ma'i mjal 'phrad kyi gtan 'khel dang / pho brang po ta la'i shar brgyud gzim chung du go sgrig gnang 'dug po ta la'i shar brgyud gzim/ chung ni nub brgyud gzi ma chung las thog dpang mtho ba yod stabs/7gong sa mchog bzhugs khri'i steng sku bzhengs gnang skabs/ dbu gug gug gnang mi dgos pa'i khyad par yo/da pa gsungs/ ri tsho ma ji 457tshe cas//rgyu// /spya 0/rdo wa //ṣ+ṭhashāḥ/shāshā/ 2 rnyo //༷ /shā/shā ༷tshaX /bye ci ni//ri / me'ilha 4 /ci cas sgo chos/the ༷ ci /sgyu misgo 94)mo ga lha zhe 0sdu 4 6khusbyo/4 'ji bye /skopho ri ri 7546ra slo ṇ+ḍaṃ/ lha'isnge dzā rdo'il ) ṭaṃ ru ri sherngaci / cha ci ru wa/ mi ci rini/sne/sa bye sa ri ཿ /ri snyo ṭ+wāṃ la / / tī bye // 4 5 9 4 pa/ sto snye 0 1phyi lo 1952 zla 4 tshes 28 nyin/ rgyal ba yas sras thog ma/'i mjal 'phrad/bskal ba bzang po'i mjal 'phrad kyi dus der/ bod mi mang chos rnga dung dar 'phyar gyis bkra shis rten 'brel zhu dgos pa zhig la/ gzhung bla'i zhabs 'bring tsho'i lo rgyus kyi zhe 'khon da dung gtsang sel thub med pa'i khar/dngos gzhi mjal 'phrad kyi mdzad sgo'i skabs/ bod gzhung gi mjal 'phrad go sgrig pa spyi khyab mkhan po sogs kyis/ nga yod dang ci 'jigs med rnam gnyis gros bsdur gyis/ mjal 'phrad ji ltar shu ba'i gyon/ mthun las ltog te /443

snyedaṇa chen nar te gi zhib 'dug 7paṇa chen rin po che'i bzhugs khri de ha cang dma' zhing chung ngu zhig sgron yod pa des/27nang ma khang gi las sne tsho khong khro drag po langs te/ mtsho sngon nas yong ba'i rgya mi'i sku srung tshos/ me mda' sbag sbag 'khyer te gzim chung nang 'tshang ga brgyab ste yong grabs byas pa dang / gzim 'gag cha phreng pas rta lcag gzhu grabs byas/bla brang zhabs 'bring tshos rgya dpon grang cing 'ur/ khyed tsho dang bod gzhung mnyam mthun gyis nga tshor mgo skor gtong gi/ dbu thug dang mjal dar sne sprod kyi kha dan yod kyang / dngos gzhi'i mjal 'phrad skabs btsan po dbang shed kyis sku phyag 'bul du bcug song zhes 'khang ra yang byas skad/287gong sa 7rgyal ba'i dbang po sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen pos/ phyi lo 1952 lor/ khong dgung lo bcu bzhir phebs dus/ lha sar phran thug 'phrad du phebs skabs/ bkra shis lhun po'i las byed tsam ma zad/ rgya mi'i dpon rigs kyang mnyam du yod/ khong go gnas dang / dgung lo phran las chung bar brten/rnam kun gyi lugs srol ltar gyi mdzad sgor phebs kyang / lam srol de tshor rgya mi dang las byed 'ga' shas mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur byung yod/ khong rnams kyi re 'dod la 7paṇa chen rin po che phran dang 'dra mnyam gyi bzhugs khri sogs dgos 'dod yod par brten/ thog ma'i mjal 'phrad de bde ltod bag phebs shig rang ma byung /mdzad sgo rnyog dra tsha po de tshar rjes/ shar brgyud gzim chung nang ngos gnyis sku rkyang du mjal ba yin/ gal che ba ni ngos dang 7paṇa chen rin po che gnyis gsol tshigs mnyam du bzhes te bka' mol phran bu zhu rgyu byung / 7paṇa chen rin po che a mdo'i phru gu lha sar phebs ma thag pa dngos nas lhad med pa'i byis rwaped/’/ji ci stong 28 1 ci 1 rngo tsang 444

ci 'i che'i stod kyai cha/pa dgung lo gzhon gzhon zhig 'dug rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bab de rang la bzhag na dngos gnas yag po yong ba 'dug snyam pa'i mthong tshul gsal po byung zhes gsungs/297paṇa chen rin po che lha sar zla gcig lhag tsam bzhugs rjes/ phyi lo 1952 zla 6 tshes 8 nyin/ rkyang/ṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku sger gyi rnam pa'i thog nas nor gling du 7gong sa mchog la thon mjal zhu bar bcar/ de ni 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis mjal 'phrad gnang thengs bzhi pa de yin/ khong rnam gnyis lhan du nor bu gling kha'i rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang la spro 'cham gzigs skor gnang /7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gtsug lag khang du phyir log phebs khar/7gong sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog gis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la mjal dar dang / gser rta rmig ma/ dmigs bsal du bzos pa'i zhabs lham/ sku ngo ma'i chibs dril bcas phul gnang ste phebs skyel zhu lugs mtshon par gnang /7gong sa mchog gis/ nga'i mthong snang la khong ni sku na gzhon pa/ thugs rgyud drang po/ yid brtan 'pher ba zhig 'dug nga las lo gsum gyis sku na gzhon pa dang / da bar mtshan dbang gang yang med par brten/ khong gi rang bzhin lhad med dang /thugs sems skyid po/ mjal bag bro bo yod pa de tshor ngos rang mos po dang /khong dang nye mthun yod pa'i nyams snang shar byung / khong la 'byung 'gyur sku ngal ga 'dra zhig yong rgyu'i skor ngos gnyis gas skabs der shes kyi med pa gsungs/30gzigs tshul de ni 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis/ 7gong sa mchog la na phyi yā la du rang dbang lha lu nga pa blo bzang phun tshogs kyis dbyin nas bsgyur/sdi li bod khang /gyi lo zhaXnan ra/ ༷bye yu la du rang dbang /lha lung blo bzang dari rmi ldan gyis bgyi ra/ldi le bod khang /phyi lo naX tsha/ra 445

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhib 'jugabazhag pa'i lhad med kyi mi gshis red la/ 7gong sa mchog gis 7paṇa chen rin po che'i thugs gshis la gnang ba'i ya/nga dag pa'i gdeng 'jog cig kyang yin srid/phyi lo 1952 zla 6 tshes 9 nyin/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dbus lha ldan zhing nas/ gtsang ljongs gtsug rgyan gzhis rtse bkras lhun du chibs kha bskyur/lha sa nas le dbar nyi shu'i rgyang thag chod pa'i 'bras spungs dgon gyi bar lha sa'i mi mang dang / gdan gsum sku tshab/ bka' shag gi bka' blon/ bod dmag khul khang sogs kyis dbu gur phub ste/ dga' skyel zhu ba'i mdzad sgo zab rgyas 31gas/phyi lo 1952 zla 6 tshes 23 bod zla 5 tshes 11 nyin/ dgung grangs 15 phebs pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po/ mi lo sum cu lhag bral ba'i rang gdan chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun po'i phyogs su zhabs sor 'khod/ nyin der bkra shis rten 'brel g.yang du khug pa'i ltas su/ bdud rtsi'i char chen po babs shing / skyid skyed na khar nyin lnga drug ring mjal ma/nga gtong gnang mdzad/bod gzhung nas bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen gtsos/ las bya rtse mgron rme ru don dbang / bshad sgra sras dga' ldan dpal 'byor ngo las bcas/7paṇa chen rin po che chibs skyel dang khri gsol rten 'brel zhu ba ched du brdzangs gnang //31 1'a 〉 ba pa sa gsung ri 'i srid don rgyal rabs/446

skya che'i stod kyai cha/le tshan drug pa/ legs bcos la mkho ba'i slob gnyer gsar 'azhugs/ phyi lo 1952 lor/ 7paṇa chen ba cu pa gung khran tang gis rogs skyor las/ gdan sa bkra shis lhun por zhabs sor 'khod pa dga' spro zhu 'os kyang / gzhung bla'i dbar rgya mis dbyen sbyor phung dkrug las/ bla ma'i mdzad spyod ci 'dra yong min thad bod mi phal mo cher blo 'tshab sbyin kyang / mchog spral rin po che phyi nang yongs nas 'tshar longs dang / rang stobs kyi nus pa/ zlog gcod kyi blo kha rgyas pa/ lhag par bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i chos srid kyi mdzad khur bzhes pa nas bzung / gzhung sar mthun lam dang / bkris lhun po'i slob gnyer legs sgrig bla brang gi chab srid la dus bstun legs bcos kyi mdzad 'char la bsam tshe/ skyes bu dam pa'i rang rtags shugs kyis mngon pa'i nges pa rnyed thub/phyi lo 1952 lor/ 7ṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mchog mdo smad sku 'bum dgon nas/ gtsang ljongs gdan sa bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi chos sde chen por chibs zhal bsgyur ba dang / gdan sa'i zur bzhi'i mkhan po dang /spral sku/ dge bshes che khag lhan rgyas tshogs chen bskongs te/ rang cag ni ston zlo sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug dge tshul slong gi sdom ldan sha stag cig la song /thos bsam sgom gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum byang chub pa zhig dgos/mi su 'dra zhig gis dri ba nam byung la/ lan rgyag thub pa dang yi ge'i lam nas 447

7paṇa chen zher te gi zhib 'dugabaton thub pa zhig dgos gal cher brten/bar lam rang res yi ge bri rgyur 'thus shor phran bu byung ba bskyar gso'i ched/ tshang mas so so'i byang tshad la dpag pa'i sbyang shing dang / shog thog yi ge bskyar sbyong dgos pa'i bka' bstsal zhing / zla re'i yig tshad 'gran bsdur skabs 7paṇa chen bcu pa sku ngo phebs kyis ang ki gnang ba dang /nang bstan grub mtha' khag gi yig cha bsdu rub kyis dpe mdzod gsar du bskrun te/ chos dang / rig gnas/ lo rgyus sogs la don gnyer yod rigs/dpe mdzod khang du dpe cha lta klog chog pa'i go skabs bstsal/32phyi lo 1954 lor/ lha ngam phun gsum gtsos bkra shis lhun po'i gzhis dgon bshad grwa yod pa rnams kyi slob gnyer tshags tshud yong slad/ gzhis dgon khag dang / gdan sa se ra byes smad kyi gtsang pa khang tshan du yod pa'i lha ngam phun gsum gyi dpe cha ba dang / bkra shis lhun po'i dka' chen bcas bkras lhun rdo gcal chen mor rtsod rgyugs thengs dang po bzhes/de dus 7rgyal ba yab sras rgya nag tu phebs dgos byung bas gzigs zhib mdzad khom ma byung yang / phyi lo 1958 lor/ rtsod rgyugs thengs gnyis pa bde chen pho brang gi tshoms chen du bzhes skabs/ 7paṇa chen bcu pas bde chen pho brang gi rnam thar sgo gsum zhes pa'i gzim chung sbug ma nas/ tshoms chen nang gseng ras kyi yol ba'i rgyab nas gzigs zhib mdzad/ser byes gtsang pa khang tshan nas phebs pa'i rje drung bstan 'dzin sogs/ rtsod rgyugs pa rnams kyi rtsod rgyugs bzhes stangs la/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa thugs kyi yid dbang 'phrog ste/ gdan sa nas phebs mkhan tshos dpe cha yag dpal pa'i skal bar 'phrad pa 'i myong tshor/shog ngos cananang / phag ri dngos grub khang gsar blo spos chos dar gyis brtsams/448

skya che'i sto da kyi cha/po gzigs 'dug dper na/ lha mo 'khrab ma khan lta bur mtshon na/ 'khrab stangs rbad de mi 'dra ba red 'dug dpe cha lta dgos byung na/ 'gro sa gdan sa gsum yin pa gsungs/33phyi lo 1956 lor/ 7paṇa chen brgyad pa'i skabs/ kun gzigs slob grwa dang / gso rig slob grwa zhes pa zhig yod skad kyang bar skabs nas rgyun chad/phyi lo 1956 lor/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pas bla sprul dang / mtshan zhabs/dge bshes 21 la mdo sngags zab sbyong dang rig gnas dpyad bsdur ched/bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i kun gzigs pho brang ngam/ rtse nyid 'od gzim chung du slob grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang / slob grwa der kun gzigs slob grwa dang /nyi 'od slob grwa/ rtse slob grwa sogs don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su byung zhing /bla brang yig tshang las khungs kyi thad ku'i 'dzin skyong bkod 'doms 'og yod/34rjes sor skyid skyid na khar spos nas slob grwa'i ming la spyan gsal slob grwa zhes gatresal/slob gnyer ba'i khongs su gdan sa bkras shis lhun po'i khang tshan re nas slob ma gnyis dang / gzhis dgon khag zhabs 'bring / gzim shag grong drag bcas nas slob ma gnyis re phud/ spyi tshogs thog nas lo chung slob zhugs byed blo yod rigs tshang ma bsdu len gnang gi yod/ slob ma'i grangs 'bor 300lhag tsam zin/ spyan gsal slob grwa'i dge rgan du zur khang rtse mgron don grub tshe ring dang / 'od gsal nang pas yig gzugs dang 'bri traklog dge rgan gnang /ser gling dam pa lags kyis lasatsha wartu/ dka' chen pad+ma lags kyis sum sku gtsang ljongs lha rtse chos nye'i byung rabs bub bstan mdzes gyon/shogan 1nang /ska la bzang mkhas grub kyis bsgrigs bod kyi dpemadzod khang /byi lo naX9lor/ 4 mi 'o phyiX dga' de na pho brang rjes dran chod deb na ga sangs rgyas bas na dar gyis ched rtsom//bod kyi dpe mdzod khang /phyi dril las lungs/byi ngo na002lo ra/449

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhing 'jugartags dag snya na dang / lo rgyus slob khrid gnang / nye 'od slob grwa nas thon nga 'i slob gnyer ba ni/ rgya gar lto phyogs bkra shis lhu na ngo 'i ma/khan rin ngo che rdo rje 'chang blo bzang bzod pa lags dang / rgya gar lho phyogs ser byes gtsang nga khang tshan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang don yod lags sogs yin /spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho bzhin skyid na'i gso rig slob grwa nyams gso rgya bskyed kyis/ mdar pa dka' chen dpal bzang lags dang / gtsang stod ngam ring pa zhesal khrims/(mtshan gzhan pa sangs zhu zheng ma khas dbang ma/khyen rab nor bu'i slob ma'i gtso bo yi na/)lcags pa dka' chen spen pa lags sogs sma na dge la ched du bskos/ slob grwa de nas thon pa'i slo ba phrug tshos/ lo rabs 80nang bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong lte ba'i las khungs khag nang / bod kyi rig gnas kyi gtso 'gan rkang 'dzin pa'i slob dpon zhe cig chags yod pa ni/gzhis rtse bod sman khang gi yon krang 'bum/ rams pa byams pa 'phrin las/ dang /phun tshogs lags/ ngam ring bod sman khang gi 'bum rams pa zhabs drung lags/ dang / rab 'byams nga/ rgyas pa yon tan tshe ring / bod ljongs nyi na re'i tshags par khang gi spyi khyab rtsom sgrig pa gzhon pa/ dbang phyug gzhis rtse slob 'bring dang po'i dbu 'dzin bsod nams rin chen/ gzhis rtse dge 'os slob grwa'i rgan rgyal mtshan cesags ni dpe ma31na tsam yin/35phyi lo 1958 lor/ phyi lo 1956 lor gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i 'phrul 'khor slob gas rgya bskyed gnang / slob grwa 'dir pho nyams dod cing gzugs thang 'pher ba'i slob phrug 300 lhag tsam yod pa rnams kyis// lus la snam bu'i phyu pa bsnams shing / dbu sgra rgya lcang gi lhas ma/ rna bar gser gyi da57pa 'o cherarinapo 'i che'ejosas brjongangang ri ri rī boza nga 'azen jo rje ༷'a ca tsham byis bcaca za sdu thags nga peXr bang 450

kyi che 'i sto da kyi cha/a long / sked par 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam/ gnyis kyi sku pa ra ga'u btags yo/da/las byed pa'i bu dru ga gsum/ ma gtogs/ gzhan tshang ma zhing pa'i bu phrug las sku drag gi sra/sa gcig kyang me/da/ slo ba grwa'i nang bcu shog 17 yo/da nga/'i nang /rlangs 'khor ru lag la bcu shog gnyis/ bzo las ru khag la bcu shog gnyis/glog brnyan ru khag la bcu shog gcig rta rtsal ru lag la bcu shog lnga dang bcas par ru dpo na drug yod/rgya rigs krang shan gyis rlangs 'khor dang rta rtsa' ru khag gi ru dpon byas nga dang / byams pa bkra shis bzo las ru khag bi ru dpon/ nor khang nor bu tshe ring gi slob grwa'i ru dngo/na/ zhabs sdod rdo rje glos brnyan ru dpon/nor brang o rgyan dang phran rtsa rta mgrin dbang rgyal po rnam gnyis bod yig dang rig rtsa la/ ru dpon red/ 'phrul 'khor slob grwa'i rgyun ldan las rim nang zhogs pa rgyugs shar dang drag rtsal/ sbyong brdar/ zhogs zas rjes/ bod yig 'bri sbyong dang nyin gung khag so so'i sbyong brdar/ dgong dro gzhas dang sgrol ma zhal 'don gnang rgyu de yin/ 'phrul 'khor slob grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i dmigs yul ni/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku ngo ma'i zhal gsung las/ da lta'i lam lugs ni shin tu rjes lus yin zhing / nga tsho'i srid ga zhung gi mnga' khongs dpal 'byor thad nas 'bru lta bu chags nyen yod/ nas/ 'bru ni rtse gnyis/ phra la dkyil sbom po red /nga tsho'i gong srid gzhung dang gsham mi ser gnyis ka dbul po red/ bar du sku drag tsho gcig rgyags nga/ chags bzhi na 'dug/ de ni sku drag tshos yar gzhung la gyong gtong ba dang / mar mi ser la za brnyas byas te byung ba zhig red/ngos kyis da yod lam lugs rnams sgyur bcos ched las/ lungs khag 451

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhing 'jugegacig dang / slob grwa khag gcig gnyer nas bsam blo'i go rtogs gong mtho'i 'go khrid byed thub pa'i mi zhe gcig gso skyong byas te/ bsam blo'i chu tshad mtho tsam slebs rigs rim bzhin/ gnas spar byed rtsis yod na khyod chos kyang slob dmangs 31ra bsam blos gsar pa 'aXkhrogs thub nga dang / las ka gsar pa/ byed thub pa dgos pa'i slob gso thongs/ dang po srid gzhung yag po bzos dang /de nas mi ser la phan bde sgrub dgos/ de 'dra yong min ni gzhung las byed po zhabs 'bring la rag lus pas/ slad 'phrul 'khor :|ba grwar zhi drag rig gnas bcas sbyang thog yon tshad lag 'khyer lon ma thub par bla brang srid gzhung gi zhabs 'bring la bsko gzhag byed kyi min pa gsungs//36 rigacad kyi reg gnas 'o rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rtu cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7pa ṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉zag ngos meX9nas 119dang 119nas 1 bar/bod ljongs mi dam ngas dpe 'i na lang /pyi lo 1989zla phyinang /452

le tshan bdun lnga/ nang bstan gsan sbyong dang ljags rtsom/bla ma'i yang srid ni chos lugs kyi brgyud 'dzin pa gal chen zhig tu brtsis te/ sku na phra mo'i dus nas 'dul khrims bslab sdom dang / sgrig lam kun spyod/ lhag par du mdo sngags kyi gzhung gsan sbyong la do nan chen pos/bslab bcun dang gso skyong byed kyi yod pas/ 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen rnam gnyis ni de bas kyang brjod me dgos pa zhig los yin/'on kyang / spyir 'dzam gling dang yang sgos bod spyi tshogs kyi dus bab zang zing khrod 'tshar yongs byung ba'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku na gzhon nu'i skabs nas/ chab srid 'thab rtsod kyi g.yul sar btsud stabs/ sku na gzhon dus kyi dus tshod yongs rdzogs/ gzhan yul sa mthar nges med 'tsho 'dun gyi sku ngal nang thim ste/ thugs blo gcig sgril gyi sku yon gsan sbyong la thugs rig 'grim pa'i go skabs yongs rdzogs shor/phyi lo 1949 zla 8 tshes 13 nyin/ bla brang nang ma khang gi zhabs 'bring tshos/ dgung lo 11 la phebs pa'i pus mdo mgon po tshe brtan sku 'bum dgon par gdan zhu khri gsol mdzad pa dang / yongs 'dzin bgres par bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi bla kho rin po che dang / yongs 'dzin sku gzhon du sku 'bum dgon pa'i rgya yag rin po che rnam gnyis gdan zhu gnang / bla kho rin po che dgung grangs 8) phebs kyang / sku ngal khyad bsad kyis sku 'bum du ched phebs kyis zla 453

7pa chen zher te ni zhib 'jug shas bstud mar/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mchog la dus/ 'khor dbang chen gyis/ mtshan dbang lung khrid gsum/ bum pa gang byo'i tshul du 'bul gnang mdzad /ring po ma song bar bla kho rin po che sku tshe ma zin stabs/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil/ gyi a lags 'jigs med dang / yongs 'dzin sku gzhon rgya yag spral sku bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rnam gnyis bsko bzhag gnang bzhin/ yongs 'dzirno gyi drung nas/ bod yig slob sbyong dang dbang lung zab chos gsan sbyong gi dbu tshugs kyang / rgya yag rin po ches yongs 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan rkang bzhes gnang ste / snga dro bod yig dang / sum/ rtags/ 'don cha sogs slob khrid gnang /phyi lo 1952 lor/ gdan sa bkra shis lhun por chibs sgyur ska bas/ yongs 'dzin rgya yag rin po che lhan phebs gnang yang / ring po ma thogs pa/ra rgya yag rin po che rang dgon sku 'bum gdan sar phyir phebs pas/ ma/do sngags gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba bkras lhun dgon gyi dka' chen rtse phud/ thos bsam gling grwa tshang gi rdzong kha dka' chen ang nyi ma lags yongs 'dzin du bsko gzhag gnang /yongs 'dzin rin po che'i drung nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs dang /dbang lung man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan phul mdzad/ dka' chen ang nyi ma lags kyis yongs 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan lo gsum bzhes rjes/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dngul chu sprul sku blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis yongs 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan bzhes/yongs 'dzin dngul chu'i drung du lo yi bgrang bya gnyis kyi ring / zhogs snga langs dang dgong phyi gzim gyis rgyun spyod cho ga phyag len dang / 'jigs byed/ dus 'khor/ gzhung blo 'dzin/ yig gzugs khrid sbyong dang / rta nag dge 'dun blo 454

kyi che'i sto da kyai cha/bzang gi bsdu sa gzhung nas bzung gzhung chen lnga dang rgyud sde bcas la gsan bsam mthar phyin gnang skabs/ bkras lhun dgon gyi dka' chen rdo gdan pa blo bzang bkra shis sogs mtshan zhabs su bskos/phyi medu 1952 mthor/ lha rtse lhug pas 31gas phebs gdan zhus ltar/bkra shis lhun po'i 'dus tshogs kyi tshogs mgon du thengs dang po chibs sgyur bskyangs/ rim pas phyogs 'byor khang gsar dang / rdo gdan pa/ nor bu brang khang bcas kyis 31gas/ phebs zhus/phyi lo 1954 bod zla zha nang bkras lhu na sprul sku hre hor gzigs rgya rin po ches sbyin bdag gnang zhing gsol 'debs zhus ngo bzhin/dgung mtho 17 la phebs nga 'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa ma/chog gis bde chen skal bzang pho brang du/ dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs khri bcu la nye bar/ dpal dus kyi 'khor 'o'i dbang chen dang / phyi lo 1956 lor/ phyog ri dngos grub lang gsar gyis sbyin bdag dang gsol 'debs zhus don bzhin/ bde chen skal bzang pho brang du byang chub lam rim chen mo'i bshad lung zung 'brel skyes bu chung ngu'i bshad khred zab rgyas kyang bstsal/m+bhi lo 1956 'o1ra/ rgya gar du 7rgyal ba yab sras/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das te lo nyis stong lnga brgya 'khor ba'i dus dran la phebs skabs/ wa ra na si nang bstan gtsug lag slob gling gis nang bstan paṇa ṭi ta'i mtshan 'dzin ma/tshan nas phul zhing /3 7 gnas mchog der nang pa'i skye bo stong tsho brgal bar 7phyi ro 19 (57rgyal ba 7pa r+ṇa chen ho bar du chibs sgyur ska bas / be ra na si nang bsta na btsug la spe slo ba gra'i /mi cu /tsha las dbang ca ne cha rgyasadramachog ches lke rgyal ba rmi ba sra sa rnam bzhis la da cha rgya sar nang ji sangs skyos bstsa na ri dar spel gyi snyesas 'gan bzhes rolas cizhu ska bas 4spong samachos ses ba'ad mo dang rgyu bas/sku rtsed kyi rnam pas byas na nga tsho'i bo gnas di brje bo mug dbos/sngo nam bod kyi lo tsa ba dang rgya sar gye paṇa ṭi ta red/ da cha bod kyi pa cha 'i to dang rtsa gar gyi she tsa ba zhes bsgyu ra dbos gsung 'dugader brten/nang bstan paṇa ṭi rta'i ma tshan banas gu ri bar sem/sa/455

7paṇa chen er te ni zhil 'jugablo nga na bdun ma'i gsung chos bka' drin bstsa la/ ridzā mi ci ri sa rmo sa ri rig cirmug ci sa /khril casa'i nardoX ༷ ṇaX la tsha ri ri ci ༷ñdza ri ri ris rici lang ci ci rig sa ri ri ma tho tsho ci cas rig cho tsho ci rwa rdo ci ming casnyo cing ) cachos na dzo lke ri rnye tso mi ci ———47)ge ga — — — ༷ rdo chang ciri dze ci mi sdu ci tre sa pa sna ra ci ci /tsho cici bye sa ci /cici ci bye) ci ri ciX ri ri ri (7pa ṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis gsung chos gnang bzhin pa/)gdan sa bkra shis lhun po dang / mtsho sngon sku 'bum sogs su dus 'khor dbang chen/ 'jigs byed kyi dbang sogs ma sngags gzhung ljags khrid dang / dbang lung man ngag bka' chos ci rigs stsol gnang mdzad/phyi lo 1958 lor/ bkra sa lhun d+ku gcal steng dka' chen dam bca' las/dka' chen rab 'byams smra ba'i mtshan gnas bzhes /7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog sku na gzhon dus kyi sku tshe yongs rdzogs/ chab srid dus zing dang yul gyar 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal nang thim ste/bod brgyud nang bstan gsan nga thog thugs sems gcig sgril gnang ba'i 456

skya che'i sto da kyi cha/ go skabs byung med stabs/ kun gzigs sku gong ma na rim bzhin rgyal bstan 'a chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhyen rlabs chung ba mngon mod/ phyi lo 1963lo yar sngon dgung lo 25 ma phebs gong / nang bstan gsan sbyong gnang ba'i go skabs phran bu thob pa'i sku che'i stod du/ ljags rtsom pu ti gsum lhag 'jogs gnang mdzad pa dang / lhag par phyi lo 1944 lo dgung grangs 7la son dus/ sku rtsed gnang skabs thol byung du thog ma'i bka' rtsom lta bur/kun la snyoms mdzad med po rnam dag pa//btsan po phyug po med po sdug mthong ba /sangs rgyas dkon mchog btsan po sgom chung sgoms 'jug pa//sangs rgyas dkon mchog thugs dad la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes sho lo ka gcig gsungs pa sogs la bsam tshe/ skyes stobs kyi shes rab che zhing thugs rig rgod po zhig yin pa zur bltas leb mthong ltar yin na/sku tshe hril po rgyal bstan 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i skal ba dang rgyang du chod cing /sku che'i bar cha thams cad 'thab rtsod dang btson dong nang lhung zhing / sku tshe'i mjug la rgyal bstan nyams gso dang / rig gzhung dar rgyas/ dpal 'byor gong spel/ mi rigs rang skyong gi mdzad pas dus kyi khom pa yod tshad 'phrog 'durge pa de yang / snyigs dus kyi bstan par bsub dka' ba'i pham kha zhig yin par sems so/ 'di nas 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis dgung lo 25 sngon du/ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung 'bum pod gsum gyi dkar chag la thengs shig gzigs dang / cagasung 'bum ma/drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bka' drin rjes su dran te 457

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib cigazhugaslar yang thugs rje'i char rgyun skul ba'i gsol 'debs dbyangs kyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba/)(rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i gsang ba mchog gi rnam par thar pa dad pa'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba/)(yongs 'dzin a lags 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs pa don ldan tshig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba/)(rje btsun 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya ma tsho dang bcom/ lda na 'das dpal he ru ka gnyis ngo bo dbyer me da pa'i sgo nas gso/la ba 'debs pa dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba/)(dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang dngos grub 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba/)(tshe rabs rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon tshig 'di mdo sma da kyi chos grwa chen po bkra shis 'khyil gyi phyag mdzod mkhan po skal bzang bstan nga/ rgya mtsho nas bskul ba ltar ma/dzad//(bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dkar po dbyer med kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dngos grub kun 'byung zhes/ bya/)(dus 'khor la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor kā la par 'jug par bskul ba drang srong rje'i bden tshig ces bya ba//(tshe rabs rjes 'dzin gyi smon tshig dngos/ grub 'gugs pa/'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba/)('dod don legs tshogs dpyid kyi dpal mo 'gugs nga 'i khu byug mgrin pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba/'di sku 'bum grwa rgyun bshad sgrub rgya mtshos bskul ngor kun gling gzim chung du sbyar/)(gsol 'debs dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba/)(rjes 'dzin gsol 'debs zhes pa/)/blo gros bzang po ma//(dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gi sta gon bshad pa dang bcas nga /)(dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gyi brda sbyor bshad pa'i mtshams sbyor/)(dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gong chen rdo rje slo ba dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas pa'i brda sbyor/)(mchod gtor nang ma/chod bcas 'bul ba'i tshul/)(dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi smin byed dbang gi sngon 'gro/)(dpal rdo rje 'jigs 458

skya che 'i stso da kye cha byed lha bcu gsum gyi smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim nga gsal bar bkod pa/)/dpal gsang ba 'dus nga/'i sgo nas/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du lha la dbang bskur ba dang 'brel ba'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga la/ga len du dril ba dge legs rgya mtsho'e char 'bebs kyi rten thabs legs byas sprin gyi sgra dbyangs /)/bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgo/ nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du lha la dbang bskur ba dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas par bya ba'i rim/ pa nag 'gros su/ bkod pa 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i chu 'dzin/)(dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi sgo nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du lha la dbang bskur ba dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs kyi lhan thabs 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i chu 'dzin zhes bya/)gsu nga 'bum kha/(che'i dbang bskur gyi sngo na 'gro chos bshad mdor bsdus dang tshe dbang rgyas pa'i rim pa nag 'gros su bkod pa/)('phags ma/chog spyan ras gzigs kyi smin byed dbang ge sngon 'gro sta gon gyi rim pa rnams zhu ba'i rten du maṇa ḍal 'bul tshul dang gzungs ring /)('phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i smin byed dbang gi sngon 'gro sta gon gyi rim pa/)('phags mchog thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig nga 'i sgrub dkyil dbang chog dang bcas pa thar par bgrod pa'i myur lam zhes bya ba/)(khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs kyi rjes chog yang lhan thabs nag 'gros su bkod pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gtor chen drug cu pa'i rnam gzhag dam nyams kyi srog gcod/ma/tshon cha 'bar ba'i 'phrul 'khor bka' rgya can sngags khang dus gtor mdzad bzhin nag ngo/ 'gro shes/ su bris pa)(myur ma/dzad mgon po'i gtor sgrub gtor chen gyi rim pa sogs kyi rnam/ dbye zhes bya ba/)(ma/gon po gtor chen skor la/)/nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la 459

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing 'jugamachod gtor chen skor la shog)/nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod gtor bskang gso bya ba'i rim pa rgyun 'khyer lag len 'khrigs su bsgrigs pa mgon po'i thugs mnyes par byed pa'i bstod dbyangs rngams pa'i sgra sgrog dngos grub 'phrin las 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu non po zhes bya ba/)(bstan srung zung gi gtor 'bul 'phrin bcol/)(jo bo chen po'i bsangs mchod 'dod don lhun grub ces bya/)(gter sgo'i bsangs mchod las bzhi'i 'phrin las 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba//(rje btsun ku ru ku le le'i bstod sprin srid gsum dbang du 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba/)(7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen pos a lags 'jigs med rgya mtsho nas gsan pa'i gsan yig zab rgyas bdud rtsa'i sbrang char/)(7gong sa paṇa chen thams thad mkhyen pa blo bzang 'phrin las lhub grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rab byung sdom pa dang dbang rjes gnang lung khrid bcas kyi gsan yig nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba/)gsung 'bum ga(dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i smin byed dbang gi sngon 'gro sta gon gyi rim pa la/)(dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i smin byed dbang gi sngon 'gro sta gon gyi rim pa/)('jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i rgyud 'debs zhes bya ba/ )(7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i gsung sngon 'gro'i skor/)(skyes rabs so bzhi'i sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad rtsom pa po'i che ba'i yon tan brjod dang 'brel ba'i gsung bshad/)(skyes rabs so bzhi'i gsung bshad theg chen bdud rtsi'i yang snying zhes bya ba/)(7gong sa skyabs mgon chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gi sems bskyed mchod pa gnang skabs kyi rgyud 'debs/)(sems bskyed kyi cho ga bla ma dam pa'i phyag bzhes gsal bar bkod pa/)(lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum gyi 'grel pa skal 460

skya tshe'i sto da kyi cha/ldan rna ba'i bcud len zhes bya ba/)(lam yongs rdzogs kyi 'khrid byin rlabs spungs zhus kyi steng nas gtong tshul skal bzang re skong zhes bya ba/)(rab rgyal me sprel phyi lo 1956 ston pa myang ngan las 'das nas lo ngo nyis stong lnga brgya 'khor ba'i dus dran du skyabs mgon 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po rgya gar du phebs skabs gsung chos blo sbyong don bdun pa'i gsung bshad zin bris/)(kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches phyi lo 1986 gtsug lag khang du cho 'phrul smon lam skabs ser skya mang tshogs la bstsal ba'i bka' chos zhal gsung /)(gong sa 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po'i bka' slob bslab bya/)('jam bzhad rin po ches gtsos pa'i bla spral khag la brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs kyi skor/)(gdan sa 'di ga'i grwa zlong bzhi'i khri 'dzin sogs bla ma du ma'i bstod tshogs gsol 'debs/ bla brgyud gtor 'bul gyi kha skong rim pa /(brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs 'dod don re skong zhes bya/)(7gong sa skyabs mgon thams bcad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i mdzad rim re'u mig dge zhes bya ba/)(myur byon gsol 'debs thugs rje'i sprin phung bskul sogs myur byon gsol 'debs kyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa/)(7gong sa skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog gis rim pa khag gi 'go khrid sogs la snga phyir bstsal ba'i chab shog ka la ping po'i mgrin rnga zhes bya ba/)(gsung 'phrin chab shog rim pa rnams la shog)(7gong sa paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen pos mdo khams gtsang khul gyi skyes chen dam pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzi na mdzad skor drang srong zhal gsang lung bstan zhes bya ba/)(chos kyi 'khor lo skor ba'i mdo zhes par brkos smon tshig)(legs gsung ka la ping ga'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/)461

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jusagasung 'bum nang ma 'khod nga// (tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi bsdu sa don rnam/ bshad thar lam gsal byed ltar bkod pa/)(sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel don gsal ba'i bsdus don rnam bshad snying po rgyan ltar logs su bkod pa zhes bya ba/)(rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal lta ra dbu ma 'jug pa'i bsdu sa don//(mdzod ṭika thar lam gsal byed ltar chos ma/ngon pa mdzod kyi sa bcad/)(dam pa'i chos 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba'i bsdus don rin 'phreng snying ngo )sogs ljags rtsom mdzad/phyi lo 9980 lor/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog go gnas slar gapo'i srid jus kyi gsos rlung dang lhan du/ rin po ches bod rigs sa khul gang sar zhabs kyis bcags nas 'jigs byed dpa' bo bcu gcig pa'i dbang dang / skyes rabs/ dmigs brtse ma// ma ṇi/ sham bha la'i smon lam/ tshe lha rnam gsum/dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ thugs rje chen po/ skyabs 'gro/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs myur bar mkho ba'i bka' chos dang dbang 'u nga bshad khrid gnang zhing /yongs 'dzin dang lhan du nyin ltar chu tshod gnyis lhag bod brgyud nang bsta na chos lugs kyi gsung rab zhib 'jug gnang gin yod/7paṇa chen bcu pa lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis / khong nyid u yon krang gzhon pa'i las gnas dgongs khrol zhus nas/ ched mngags chos/ lugs las don la zhib 'jug bya rgyu yin/ bod kyi chos lugs dang / rig gnas//lo rgyus bcas la brgyud rim/ ldan pa'i sgo nas legs sgrig byas te phyag dpe bka' rtsom bya rgyu yin/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang / 7paṇa chen sku thog gong ma tshang mas gsung rtsom shul bzhag gnang yod/ ngos kyis kyang mi rigs kyi rig gnas ched du legs skyes nges can zhig 'bul rgyu yin zhes bka' slob phebs /462

kyi che'i sto da kye cha / le chan brgyad pa/ yab sras lhan gyis bstan srid bskyangs pa/7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin rgya mchos/ mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu par ngos 'dzin gnang zhing / lha ldan zhing gi pho brang po tā lar 7rgyal ba yab sras mjal 'phrad ngos/bod sde pa gzhung gis bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen ched du/gdan sa bkra shis lhun por phebs skyel dang khri ston mdzad sgor gcig lcogs su gtong gnang mdzad cing /kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa lhun grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gis/ phyi lo 1952 lor/ lha ldan nor bu gling ka nas 7gong sa mchog la thon phyag zhu skabs kyi bka' mol thugs bcangs kyis/ bod gzhung zhabs gras tsho'i bya spyod la zhe sun dang / rgya'i dmag dpon phen ming dang bla brang gi zhabs gras ngan pa 'ga'i brjod bab kyi 'og tu mi 'gro bar/ rang stobs kyi thugs bzhed rgyas shing / grangs med bskal pa'i sngon nas thugs/ bskyed dam bcas bzhin/bod brgyud nang bstan dar spel dang / bod mi rigs kyi bde skyid ched 7gong sa ma/chog dang lhan du yab sras gser 'phreng lugs srol bzhin/ bod kyi chos srid bya bar lo rgyus kyi 7paṇa chen gong rim bzhin zhabs 'dregs sgrub pa'i thugs bskyed las/ phyi lo 1953 lor/ 7gong sa ta la'i bla mar re skul skyabs 'jug 'di 'dra zhig zhu gnang mdzad yod/ r+ṣa463

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jug༄༄/ /lha mi'i rnam 'dren 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog gi zhabs khri'i drung du/ nang ma spros med kyi zhu 'bras/ lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las bzang po khyab gdal du skyong ba'i thugs bskyed kyi go cha bla lhag tu bskyed pa'i bka' drin skyong bar zhu/rang ngos nas kyang tshul der gcig las gnyis su med pa'i phyar ba gru bzhi'i ram 'degs zhu 'os shes nus gang thon dam don zhu rgyur/ lar nas phran rang gi chos srid byed sgo gang ci gegs med legs grub yong ba'i lugs gnyis kyi grogs rgyab re ltos zhu yul/ 7gong sa mchog nyid las gzhan du ma mchis par gang ci'i blo 'char nang gnas zhu 'os rim zhu chog par thugs brtse'i 'ching ba mi ltod pa'i skyabs 'jug dang / blang dor ston pa'i nang ma'i bka' slob kyang da mkho bzhin yang yang thig mjal stsol ba bcas rnam mkhyen dngas shel me long du yud mnga' mkhye na mkhyen zhes sbug dam phyag 'phrin dang /38 rang gdan bkra shis lhun por mdo sngags rig pa'i gzhung la thugs blo 'grus pos gsan sbyong la gzhol skabs/ phyi lo 1954 lor/ rgya nag rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi tshogs chen skabs dang po zhes/ rgya nag gzhung gi rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs byed pa'i tshogs 'dur/ 7gong sa mchog dang 7paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis phebs dgos pa'i bkod khyab 'byor/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches gnas tshul ji 'gab 7gong sa mchog la dgongs skor lam ston zhus pa'i sbug dam nang ma'i nang /༄7/ /lha mi'i rnam 'dren 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gi zhabs khri'i drung du/ nang ma spros med kyi zhu ba/ nye sngon gzhis rtser bca' sdod 87pa r+ṇa chen spu phreng bcu pa chen pa'i gsu nga 'bum spa pa/bkras/ lhun pa ra ma /464

skya che'i stod kyai cha/rgya dpon dang /krung dbyang gi bka' 'brel ring min pe cing du rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyi sku tshab tshogs 'du chen po tshogs rgyu de'i thog bod phyogs nas 7tā la'i bla ma dang / 7paṇa chen er ti ni rnam gnyes ngos phebs thub pa byung na gang legs yong rgyur dga' bsu yin zhes phebs don/ bka' shag sogs la bka' bsdur gyis tshogs 'dur 'phral phebs gnang rgyu thugs gtan 'khel ba bzhin/ 'di nas phran ngos kyang ngo bskyod thub pa byung na gang legs yong lugs brjod skor de khar thugs gtan ji 'khel sogs/ blo dogs chod min don gyi legs slob zhu bsam tshes bdun nyin ched kyis 'bul lam zhus pa de khar zhabs 'byor mchis shag la/bka' phebs rigs ma byung rung de rjes 'dir stod rgya dpon nas tar gnas 'byor gsal du/ 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor 'di dang 'di zhes sogs lam pa dang bcas de nas 'char zla tshes la phebs thon gnang rgyur nges gtan ltar/ de lugs 'di nas kyang 'phral don dgos lugs brjod 'dug don/dus tshes shin tu myur bas gang ci'i babs nas thon gra ji bzhin 'grig re ma mchis kyang / de nas sku 'khor phebs tshe thugs gtan 'khel stabs sngon zhus bzhin mdzad sgo phyogs mthun dgos gal la brten/ 'di nas phran ngos ngo 'khor yang 'char tshes la thon thub pa byas te/ de khar tshes bcu la 'byor ba zhu rgyu de nyin zhal dngos mjal zhing gsol chog pa gsungs/7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis thugs dogs 'jigs snang dang bcas/lha sa dang gzhis ka rtse nas chibs thon gnang / shi an du lhan 'dzoms byung ba dang me 'khor las be cing du lhan rgyas phebs/ srid blon kra'u e lan dang dmag spyi kra'u te gtsos bzo ba dang / slob phrug mang pos dga' bsu'i sne len byas/phyi lo 1954 zla 9 tshes 1 nyin/ krung nan he ru ma'o dang mjal 'phrad gnang 465

snyed za chen er te sna r+shazu ci'ajugaste / rgyal/ ba yab sras/ rnam gnyis kyis gsan bsam/ slob gnyer la thugs 'grus dang / me sa rgyal dang bod mi dmangs kyi ched ma/dzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i smon 'dun zhus /zla 9 tshes 27 nyin/ rgyal/ yongs mi dam/ngas 'thus mi tshogs chen thengs dang po'i steng / 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang ngo ma chog u yon krang sku gzhon dang / wang/ṇa chen rin po u yon dang / lo de'i zla 12 tshes 25 nyin/7paṇa chen rin po che srid gros u/ yon sku gzhon dang / 7gong sa mchog la/ u yo na gyi mtshan gnas phul//yong ṇa chen rin ngo che rgya skad sbyong rgyu'i thugs 'dod ltar/ ma/'o kru'u zhis khas len bzhin 'thab phyogs gcig gyur khang gis kyang ting bsko gzhag byas/ yu na ring yul skor 'tsham sa gzigs kyis shing lug bod kyi lo gsar yang pe cing du rten 'brel zhus / 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen rnam gnyis la/ ma/'o dang /'i/'u hra'o chi/ kra'u e 'i/na sogs kyis rten 'brel gyi 'tsham/sa 'dri zhus/sngi zo 1955 zla 3 tshes/ 9 nyin kra'u e lan gyis gtso skyong gnang ste / rgya' srid sbyi/ khyab khang gi rgyal yongs tshogs/ chen thengs bdun nga 'tshogs/ tshogs 'du'i ste nga ched ma/ngags kyis las don la gros bsdur dang sbrags/ bod rang two nga ljo ngas gra sgrig u yo/na lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu'i thag gcod byas te/ 7gong sa mchog kun ren dang / rkyang ṇa chen rin ngo che kra'u ren sku gzhon du bskos/ma 'o kru'u zhis pe cing khra kon gsol ma/gron khang du bzhugs pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mjal 'phra da zhus te/ kha sang 7ta la'i bla ma ra ma/jal 'phrad byas pa dang / de ring ched du khyed rang phebs sgye la zhu bar yong ba yin/ mi rigs so sor rang mi rigs kyi dbu khrid cig yo da dgos nga dang / bod mi rigs la 466

kyi che'i rmyo nga kyi cha 7tā la'i rkyang ṇa chen khyed rnam gnyis yo da nga sa ha cang ya ga ngo/ yin pa bshad/7paṇa chen rin po ches/ tsham tshom med par nga dbu khrid min zhes bka' lan bskyon/ khong gi bka' lan la r+ya/'o tse tung do snang chen ngo skyes te/ gzab nan ngang ngas bltas na bod nang gtso 'dzin ma/'o dang / kru'u te khri lor brtan pa'i 'bod tshig gcig ngo ma bsgrags par/ ta la'i bla ma khre lor brtan par shog7paṇa chen bla ma khri lor brtan pa shog ces/ rjo/'i 'bod tshig ya nga bsgrags dgos pa bshad/ma'o yi skad cha de bshad nas ring po ma/ song ba'i zla shas rjes/ 7rgyal ba yab sras/ pe cing du rgyal sto na dus chen la phebs skabs/ bod skyod lta skor tshogs pa'i tshogs mi rnams pas/ 7tā la'i bla ma khri lo brtan pa shog 7paṇa chen bla ma khri lo brtan pa shog ces/ 'bodapa sgra sgrog bzhin phebs bsu zhus/phyi lo 1955 zla 3 tshes 12 nyin/ 7rgyal ba yab sras bod du phyir phebs gnang ba dang zla 4 tshes 22 nyin/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dngos su btsugs/ rgyal khab kyi blon chen gzhon nga dang dmag spyi gcig lcogs khran yi lha sar rten 'brel mdzad sgor bcar/ bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gis/ don tshan bcu bdun gyi gros chod dog rol du btang zhing / 7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung gis sngar gyi mtshan dbang tham sa cad gsar 'dzugs las khungs des bzung zhing / 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren sku gzhon du bsko gzhag gnang /dus de nas phyi lo 1959 bar gyi dus yun mi lo 4 yi ring / ya/ba sras lhan rgyas kyis bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid gnang /467

7paṇa chen yer te ni jing 'jug/waX /bye/bye—— / ci — — ——— ci skre sru / blo ཿ/ /tshoṣ+ṭha ri byu ༷/ ngu mibye/ tram̐ ri sku/ri rdo ci'iri ri rtsi/sdi|skye( shā cisto natshortso / byedu hūṃ/ rdo ci / mi ༷swā duci ri 4 r+sha ske ri /rdo ci sdu ci 4ci me rtse rdzol ḍā ri 3 ༷ring ci sna tsho cas rno ci ci sna ci sko wa nga —————2——༷ snangalaXdro— /phyi lo 1956 lor/ 7gong sa mchog dang / 7paṇa chen rin po che/ khran yi/)7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog bod skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi kra'u ren sku gzhon du bsko gzhag byas pa ni/ bla brang rgyal mtshan mtho po'i chos srid kyi bdag po tsam ma zad/ bod kyi chab srid kyi sku gzhon dbu khrid kyi go gnas phul bar/ gzhung zhabs 'ga' mi 'dod pa'i bsam pa yod mus steng /ci 'jigs med dang phan ming gi zhus dbang du song ba lta bus/bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gis bcos sgyur gtong rgyu'i 'ur langs rgyag skabs/ bcos sgyur gtong rgyur rgyab skyor gnang ba ma zad/bla brang gi sa khul rnams tshod lta'i sa khul du 'os sbyor gnang bas/ bod mi mang po zhig 7paṇa chen bcu par dad log lta bus/ 7paṇa chen ni nga lhu bla ma ma red/kho rgya mi'i bla ma red/ dmar shog bla ma red/ khos rgya mi'i las don sgrub kyi yod pa red/ kho pa'i sems nang nga tsho'i mi rigs med ces pa'i mtshan smad zhus//39༵ ༵ bye dpon che cho rkyang khya chen rin po che/ 'jam dpa la rgya rmi tshos brtsam mu / bde srung nyam sa zhib khang bis par 'grems byas / phyi lo 1998 lor

slu che'i stod kyai cha/le tshan dgu pa/ yar thon gyi mdzod pa than thun/ mi rnams kyis 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis phyi lo 1949 zla 10tshes 1 nyin/ ma'o kru'u zhir tar 'phrin btang nas gung khran tang gis bod bcings 'grol gtong ba'i re ba zhus yod/ de ni 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi sku tshe hril po'i mdzad 'phrin gyi nag thig che shos shig yin pa'i 'khang ra byed kyi 'dug mod/ bdag gis bsam na chod sdom de ni yang dag gnad du 'khel zhig rtsa ba nas ma red/rgyu mtshan gang la zhe na/ tar 'phrin de ni phan ming gi bkod jus bzhin ci 'jigs med kyis bris pa phan ming rang gis bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs nang rtsom yig spel 'dug pas na/ phan ming gi lkog g.yo bslu brid 'og shor ba'i ci 'jigs med kyis/ sku na chung ba'i 7paṇa chen rin po che'i mtshan gnas bed spyod byas pa zhig yin pa rtogs thub/gcig nas dus skabs der 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog dgung lo 11las son med la/ gnyis su na lo rabs naX nang / 7paṇa chen rin po ches gung khran tang dang mnyam las gnang ba'i gnas tshul rjes dran gnang skabs/sku ngo mas ma'o tse tung la tar 'phrin de 'dra zhig btang myong ba rtsa ba nas gsungs ma myong bas so/nga tshos 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi dgongs pa mi yi ngang tshul du blos bslangs te/ khong gi sku tshe hril po'i mdzad 'phrin gangs dkar lhun po'i 469

7pa chen er te ni zhir ca'ajug dbus nas/ nag nog gi skra nyag rkang gcig 'tshol ba'i ngal ba ra zhugs na/phal cher de ni wang ṇa chen bcu pa mchog dgung grangs 16 nas 20 bar te/byi 'o/ 1954 nas phyi lo 19((9 bar yin par sem/sa/ phyi lo 1951 lor/7gong sa ma chog gis mgon po tshe brtan rkyang ṇa chen bcu nga ra ngos 'jin 'khrul bral/ dang / phyi lo 1952 lor/ gdan sa bkras/ lhun dgon par zhabs sor 'khod thub pa byung ya nga /phyi lo 1923 nas 1951 bar gzhung dang bla brang gi don rkyen las/bod gzhung gi sku drag 'gas dus yun mi lo 30 nang / bla brang gi zhabs gras tshor sdug thang dang / rdzong stod gnas sne ba 'gas mi ser la gzigs tshul mi legs/ pa'i lta stangs ji snyed cig gnang 'dug dper na/ bla brang gi zhabs 'bring che gras lha smon ye shes tshul khrims kyi gcung ngo tshe brtan phun tshogs/phyi lo 1942 lor lha smon tshang gi a/ zhang bod gzhung gi rim bzhi chab spel 'jigs med kun dga'i bu tshab tu ster ba so gas/ bla brang gi sku drag che lag gi bu gcig gzhung gi sku drag gzim shag la mag par ster ba'am/ yang na khyim tshang zla bsgril gtong ba sogs thabs shes sna tshogs brgyud/ bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs rag thabs/ bya dgos byung /phyi lo/ 1951 lor/ ci 'jigs med gtsos pa 'i bla brang gi zhabs 'bring 'gas/ gung khrin tang rgyab rtsar ngom/ ste 7gong sa mchog ges/ bus/ mdo mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen bcu par 'khrul bral ngos 'dzin dang / gtsang ljongs gdan sa bkra shis lhun po chibs kha bsgyur thub pa dang / gzhung bskos dza sag bla ma/'i ma/dun nas bkras bla'i bdag dbang tshur rag par 'dod blo ma tshim nga/ra/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen gong ma/ gsang byol gnang dgos byung zhing /47 0

spu che'i sto nga du cha bkra shis lhun ngo/'i ma khar dbang yo ngas/ kyi dbang jus bod gzhung this/ gzhung bzhes gnang ba'i lo rgyus/ kyi las 'dzol 'a/ zhe 'bo/ na gye bas ma/ nga sa / tsho7rgyal ba 7pa khya chen rnam gnyis/ chos srid go gnas 'dra ma nyam dang / gzhes ka rtse'i spyi rdzong gi gtsos gam pa 'a/ a/ra rgyab bkra lhun bla brang gi bdag thob byas chog nga/ dgos lugs bshad pa ma zad//() slad bkra lhun bla brang gzhung gis ma/nga' 'og tu khral 'jal khrims khur mi dgos pa/ gtsang rang skyong yong ba'i 'char gzhi la/nub bang bod dmag khal khang gi dmag dpon phan ming yis rbab sor jus sku ring sna ra pa 2407 rigazi 'don dang / sku na chung ba'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa ma/chog la go bsko na blo 'gug byas 'dugaphyi lo 19 (2 zla 4 tshes/ 28 nyin/ kun gzigs/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa ma chog lha sa ra chibs bsgyur skabs// gzab sbreng rta gral gyi ma/dun du ma'o kru zhi dang / kru'u tes gnyis kyi 'dra par chen po gnyis bsgrengs yod pa dang / zhabs 'bring ska 'khor pal mo/ ches bod chas gyon med par rgya chas/ dang /bcings 'grol dam/rgo chas sha sta ga gyon yo da phebs yod pa der/ bod mi pal cho ches mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan 'dug4/bod gzhung gi zhabs 'bring phal mo che gtsos bod mi ma/nga ngo zhig gis/ nga/ṇa chen nang rme/ khang gi zhabs 'bring tshos/ gung khran tang gis bod du dpung 'jug byed dgos pa'i re 'bod shugs che byas yod pa brten nas /rgya mi bod la bslebs pa'i gtam 'chal yongs grags su bshad 'dug la//42bod gzhung gi sku drag 'gas kyang / bod mi mang na/sa wang ṇa chen rin ngo cher bcangs pa'i sem/sa 'gog gyer/ phyi lo 1952 nas 19 /5 bar tsam da/4 dge slo nga blo bzang bstsa na'adzen gye mi spebacesasongangos 146nar ṭ+wāṃ rnye 3004ra ra du41se slo nga byo bzang bsngan 'dzen rtse mi tshe bcibashingangos 14nyinang sa ro na snyiX4ḍi ra/42dka' sdu ga 'os na byung ba brjod nga shog ngos 04 nang /sdub stonar bas bcun byi lo 1998mar 471

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhi' 'jug7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la ma'o tse tung gi phru gur 7paṇa chen gyi ming btags te/43gang khran tang gis rgya nag tu btsan 'gel byas pa zhig red/ 7paṇa chen ngo ma bkras lhun rgya khang tshan gyi tshogs chen spral skur ngos 'dzin zhus pa'i li thang rdo rje tshe ring yin pa'i gleng phyogs bzos thes/44 lha sa'i dmangs khrod gzhes :drog tu dzi5nga /bcings bkrol bod la slebs kyang // lta ba 'gyur gyi ma red//7paṇa chen bod la phebs kyang // phyag dbang zhu gi ma red//45ces btang 'dug gong gsal gyi gleng phyogs dang dmangs khrod gzhas tshig de dag las/ bod gzhung gi zhabs 'bring 'ga' shas dang mi mang mi nyung ba zhig gis/ 7paṇa chen rin po cher 'dzin pa'i mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur dang /skabs de'i gnas tshul shes thub kyi 'dug la/ bla brang gis 7paṇa chen rin po che mtsho sngon nas lha sar thog mar gdan zhu gnang stangs de srol rgyun dang rbad de mi mthun zhing / bod mi'i sems khams kyi rma kha la tsha bshos pa ltar gyi na zug ni blo pham che/ de bas kyang bod mi skya ser mtho dman mi nyung ba zhig gis/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog rgya phrug tu ngos 'dzin gnang ba blo pham che/der brten/ bla brang zhabs 'bring 'ga' dang rgya mi tshos/ sku nar ma son pa'i 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la 7paṇa chen sku gong ma'i gnas tshul log 'grel dang / da cha blo spobs mtho tsam gnang dgos pa'i zhu log 'dra min phul stabs/ thun mong snang ngor khong rang gi dgongs tshul nyar ma thub par/4 gi slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin byi mi tshe gcigasong ngos 154nang /phyi lo daX4lo ra/44pod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dbya da gzhi'i rgyu cha bdam gas bsgrigs/deb sanyis pa/shog rtenang /mi rigs dpe kun khang /phyi lo 198 lor/45ka sbug 0sar 'gyur me long /phyi lo 1953zla 5tshes canan/472

kyi che'i stod kyai cha/phan ming dang ci 'jigs med kyi zhus dbang du song ba'i mdzad 'phrin than thun zhig kyang byung 'dug nga ni khas ma len ka med kyi gnas tshul zhig red/dper na/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi lo rgyus goms srol ltar na 7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen rnam gnyis thog ma'i mjal 'phrad skabs/ sku phyag dang / dbu thugamajal dar sne sprod gnang lam yod kyang / phyi lo 1954 lor/ rgya nag pe cing du skabs dang po'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs tshogs chen ched/ dbus gtsang sa khul gnyis nas chibs thon gnang ba'i yab sras rnam gnyis shis an du lhan 'dzoms gnang skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la phyag btang ste 'tshams 'dri zhu ba las/ dbu thug dang / phyag rtse sprod gnang med/46mdor na/ mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la ngos 'dzin zhus pa'i nyin de nas/ rgya dang gzhu nga bla'i chab srid 'thab 'khrug khrod/'gro 'dug dang smra brjod kyi rang dbang 'tsho ba yongs su bral zhing / 'jigs nyen dam bsgrags kyi 'og tu skyo gdung gu dog gi tshor ba yun ring myong dgos byung zhing / zang zing gi yo lang rgod pa'i 'tsho gnas dang khor yug zhan pos bde skyid rang dbang zhig gtan nas thob mi 'dugaphyi lo 1956 lor/ dmangs garu'i bcos sgyur la bod gzhung mang gis ngo rgol byed kyi yod kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po che phan ming dang ci 'jigs med kyis zhus dbang du song ba lta bus/ phyi lo 1 956 zla 4 bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang btsugs pa'i tshogs chen snyan sgron steng / dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur dang thog phran gyi mnga' 'og sa khul du tshod lta bya rgyur 'dod pa yod/nyams myong thob rjes ljongs yongs su khyab gdal du gtong rgyu yin/ gal te tshogs ji phyi lo naX10blo 1tshes ༷nyin rtsom pa po bdag la 7yong sa ma chog gi gzim chung mjal kha'i skabs kyi bka' slob/473

7paṇa chen yer te ni snang 'jug chen gyis bsam 'char 'dir mos ma/thun byas nas/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas chog mchan gnang rgyur phul te 'a/ma sang tshod lta byas chog gsungs pa'i bka' mol ni hur brtson can gye dgongs pa zhig tu bdag gi sems so/der brten/ skabs der rgya nag gzhung gis bcos sgyur gyi dus bab la dpe ma/tshon zhig bzhag yo da pa ni/ ta la'i ru tshogs ni glang gcig dang 'dra bar paṇa chen ru tshogs kyis sna khug zirno nas 'khrid nga/ dang / krung dbyang gis rgyab nas 'ded kyi yong pas khong ma 'gro rang 'gro chags kyi yod pa bshad/skad cha de dag las nga tshos gnad don gcig shes thub pa ni/ skabs de dus kyi 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi dgongs pa dang bka' slob mang dag cig gung khran tang gi srid jus bod du spel 'gyur mthun rkyen du gyur gyi yod pa de red/bkras mthong ci 'jigs med ni gtsang rta nag sger bkras mthong ba'i bu yin zhing / rta nag ni gdan sa bkra shis lhun po'i chos 'bangs gzhis ka zhig kyang red/ byes rabs 20 pa'i dus mgor/ gtsang rta nag gi sger bkras mthong pa/ dang sger lung shar ba gnyis phan tshun zhe 'khon che zhing / lung shar bod gzhung gi rtsis pa'i khong gi lcam rta nag bkras mthong gzhis 'og tu sgos gzhis su tshe ma zin/phung po dur khrod du skyel bar rta nag bkras mthong gzhis sdod ci 'jigs med kyi phas/ dbyar ka 'ong gseb tu ro skyel ba 'os min zhes/ phung po dur khrod nas lung shar gye gzhis su phyir log btang ba'i zhe 'khon dang /ci 'jigs med kyi a khu ci g.yul rgyal bod gzhung gis rim bzhi las ka nas gnas dbyung rgyang 'bud btang bas/ gzhung la 'khon 'dzin yo da mus/ phyi lo 1923 lor/ gzhung bla'i don rkyen las 7paṇa chen dgu pa rgya sog yul du phyogs 474

kyi che' sto nga kyi cha g.yo/la la phebs skabs/ ci g.yu la rgyal mtsho thog brgyud lang/khya chen sku phreng dgu pa'i zhabs rjes/ su/ 'brangs skabs// ci 'jigs med kyang lhan du khrid/h+phan ming ni rgya nag dbus gzhung gis sa smad nang ma khang bod du phebs skyel du mngasas nga 'i bod 'a sa don mu/ yon lha na khang nub byang cud kyi bod sdo/da dam/ga dngo na yin/ rgya nag gzhung gis bod la btang ba'i nub byang cud dang lho nub cud kyi dmag dpung bar 'gal ba byung ba ma zad/ 'gal/ ba de'i dbar gzhung dang bla grang bed spyod kyis nub byang cud kyis bla brang dang lto/ nub cud kyis bod gzhung gi phyo gas su 'a/ngas/ nub byang cud kyi dam/ga dngo na h+phan ming dang ci 'jigs med gnyis kyis/ bkras lhun bla brang ngam/ gtsang khrul rang skyong ljongs 'dzugs/ rgyu'i las 'gul/ spel ma nga dag cig spe'/ 'dugabashad tshul zhig 'a// phyi 'o 19 /6 lor/ rgya gar byang chub chos tshogs kyis 7rgyal ba yab sras rgya gar du gdan zhu bzhin chibs/ sgyur skabs/7rgyal ba yab sras gdan zhu gnang mkhan rgya gar gzhung gi chibs/ 'khor gyi ste nga /bod dang rgya gar gyi rgyal dar re btags yod pa rgya mis ma/thong / 7paṇa chen rin po ches rgya mi'i bkod mngags bzhin thugs khros/ pa'i rnam/ pas// bod kyi dam ga dar mar phab bcug cing rgya mi'i rgyal dar 'dogs/ dgos pa gsungs/47rgya gar gzhung dang 31gas pa khag gi gzhung bla'i zhabs 'gras gseṅgel byedrogs lhan rgyas gshe1nga skabs// bla brang gi zhabs/ gras/ 'gas gasdo/nga zhabs/ 31ra tre| bab kyi gus zhabs med par/ 'dra ma/nyam nga btsan gyis khengs nga sa/ gsol tshigs zhu skabs bang gi sngon la rgyug 'gro ba serdzogs/ mig lam du mi ma/dzes pa'i 34 3//3/ci/43/chotsho 3 —6/ 1khu7//1〉 ༅ ṣ+ṭha 0/ 314 ci spre475

7pa ṇa chen yer te ni jib 'jugalas 'dzol yang byung ba mngon/48phyi lo 1956 dang 1957 so sor/ 7gong sa mchog gtsang gzhis ka rtser chibs sgyur skabs/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la lo rgyus kyi phebs bsu bzhin go sgrig ma/ thub pa de yang / phen ming dang ci 'jigs med sogs/ rgya mi dang bla zhabs klad stong 'gas byed bab las byung ba gor ma chag kyang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa'i thugs gshis kha ri kha thug de dang 'brel ba nges can yod pa'i dogs 'char che ste/ 7gong sa mchog gis/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches rgya mir blo gtad gnang ba de/ khong rang la phan pa'i don du gnang gi yod pa'i thugs dogs kyang 'khrungs pa gsungs/'on kyang / 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi 'khrug cha dod pa'i sku che'i stod kyi sngon thon gyi mdzad 'phrin than thun dag la/ sku che'i smad kyi char ldog phyogs kyi lo rgyus bslab byar nyams myong zab mo thebs 'dug ste/ phyi lo 1983lor/ ser smad ri 'bur spral skus pe cing du 7paṇa chen rin po che mjal 'phrad zhu skabs/ 7rgyal ba yab dīsas thugs nang gcig tu dkar ba'i thog nas/ bod ljongs su thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i thugs bskyed nam yang mi 'dor ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus 'dug par/7paṇa chen bcu pa chen pos/ de snga gzhung bla'i las byed 'ga'i byed las la brten nas khra ge khru ge 'ga' byung ba red/ de'i bar nas khe bzang bzos te (rgya nag gzhung /)dpe mi srid pa'i gyong chen po rag byung / ldog phyogs kyi nyams myong de ngos kyis rtsa ba nas brjed kyi ma red gsungs//49ji phyi ma naX1༷zla 1tshes ༷nyin com pa por 7gong sa mchog gi gzim chung rmi jal zhu'i skabs kyi bka' slob/49dge sdig las kyi rnyo nga ba/smad cha/thog 7phyinang/ser smad ri 'bur spru la mus brtsams/shes rig par khang /phyi lo 1989lor/476

skya che'i stod gyi cha/le tshan bcu pa/ yab sras lhan cig 'phags drwa 'i yul du phebs pa/gnas mchog rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi rtswa mchog grong du rnam 'dren bzhi pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gyi skye bo'i blo sna chos la bskul phyir/ sku zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan nas/ mi lo nyis stong lnga brgya 'khor ba'i dus dran skabs/ rgya gar gzhu nga dang byang chub chen po'i chos tshogs kyis/ 7rgyal ba yab sras mgron gyi gtso bor gdan 'dren zhus 'dugaphyi lo 1956 zla 11 tshes 20 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog lha lhan nas chibs thon gnang zhing / stag gru khar bkra lhun bla brang gis ci 'jigs med dang /chu shar du rgyal yab kyis gtsos bla brang gi zhabs 'bring ser skya yongs rdzogs/grwa tshang bzhi'i mkhan bla sprul las sne dang bcas pas phebs bsu'i dbu gur dang bcas/ gdan sa bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi chos sde chen po'i nang phebs bsu zhus/ yongs 'dzin dngul chu sprul skus sku phyag dang mjal dar phul zhing /byams khang dang / rnam rgyal lha khang bdun brgyud bla brang kun gsal du gdan 'dren zhus/gdan sa bkra shis lhun po'i bla brang kun gsal ltag sgo'i phyi rol du/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gis phebs sgug gnang zhing / phebes bsu'i ma/jal dar sne sprod gnang ste dbu gtugs mdzad pa dang / lhan rgyas kun 477

wang r+ṇa chen er te sna zhir ca'athubagasal dbu rtse'i gzim/ chung zhal phra lto gzigs nang phebs/ gzem chung nang snga ra sro la/ bzhags/ khri dang go rim sogs mi dgos nga ra/ ci bas bde'i gso ri/ khyo ga gis brtsod de shar nub zhal/ spros zhabs 'khod kyi 'tshams 'dri grub ma/tshams / 7pa ṇa chen rin po che bla brang du phebs shing / 7gong sa ma/chog bkras lhu na nyi 'od tshom/sa chen du nge bas ston dkar spror gdan 'dren zhus/ ba kras lhu na bla brang gis 7gong sa/ ma chog gi bzhugs sgrig skyid skyid na kha'i pho brang dbu rtse'i gzim/ chung du go sgrig dang / dgong dro'i gso la tshigs 'bul bar 7paṇa chen rin po che bcar zhing / lha na bzhes grub mtsham sa dbu rtse gzim chung du thugs/ r+sha nga gshin ngo 'i ngang kyi lho da bzhugs ma/dzad/tshes 19 nogs nga bkras lhun rkyi da skyid kha na nas chibs thon bskya ngas khar/ wang/ṇa chen rin po ches dbu g.yab sdings char phebs skyel du bcar/tshes 21 7nga ṇa chen bcu pa gzhis rtse nas chibs thon gnang / gro mo/ la rgyab kyi 'bras ljo ngas ma/tsho 'gor zhag sdo da nyin gzhung bla'i zhabs gras dang / rgya gar gzhung gi phebs bsu ba/ krung go bod sdod u yon lhan khang gi phebs skyel ba/rgya gar bca' bzhugs rgya nag sku tshab/ ka sbu ga bod kyi bde don tshogs pa bcas kyi phebs bsu dbu gur gyis 'tsho 'go sa gzhi ra dogs par byas/ska bas der bod rgya'i dbar chings yig don tshan bcu bdun bzhag zin cing / 7gong sa mchog rgya nag mi mang spyi mthun rgya la khab kyi u yon krang gzhon pa dang / wang/khya chen rin po ches rgyal yo ngas srid gros kyi tshogs gtso gzhon pa'i go gnas bzhes yod/ chab srid dus/ 'gyur gyi gnas bab de 'dri 'ogabla brang nang ma/ lang ni rgya nag gzhung dang mnyam las bya rgyur lhag bsam rnam/ dag red 'dug la/ bod gzhung ni dbu gnyis ma'i tshul kyis bzhugs 'dug478

kyi che'i stod kyai cha/skabs der ka sbug bod kyi bde don tshogs pas 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du bca' bzhugs/ gnang dgos nga dang / bod gzhung yis gung rgol gnang dgos pa'i brgyud skul gnang gi 'dugagazhung bla gnyis kyi rgya nag gzhung la 'dzin pa'i langs phyogs 'gal ba ltag sprod du yod pa des/ rgya gzhung dang gzhung bla'i zhabs 'bring 'gas/ya ba sra sa rnam gnyis rgya gar da chibs sgyur skabs// thugs snang gshin pa'i zhabs zhu sgrub rgyu lta ci/ don chod kyi ma/dzad dka' ji snyed cig bzos 'dugadaper na/ 7rgyal ba ya/ba sra sa/ 'bras/ ljongs rgyal po/'i chibs/ 'khor nang chibs/ sgyur ska bas/ chibs 'khor gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgya gar dang / bod kyi rgyal dar re btsugs/ yod/ bod kyi rgyal/ dar btsugs yod pa de/ dhi li rgya nag gzhung tshab kyi skad sgyur bas mthong ba dang / 7gong sa mchog u yon krang galogan pa dang 7paṇa chen rin po che rgyal yongs srid gros kyi dbu 'dzin gzhon pa red/khong rnam gnyis ni rgyal lab rim/ pa'i dbu khrid yin pas/ kho chos bya spyod ci zhig spel rtsis yod sko ra bshad/gnas 〈sngol de li tso min gyis yab sras rnam/ gnyis la zhu skabs/ 7gong sa mchog gis thugs snang me/da kyis zhal 'dzum bzhin chibs 'khor nang phebs/dus yun gang 'tsham phyin pa'i rjes su/ rgya gar bca' sdod rgya nag gzhung tshab chen mo'i ska da sgyu ra rgya mis/ des/ 7gong sa mchog gi phebs 'khor steng gi bod kyi rgyal dar phab nas rgya mi/'i rgyal dar btsugs 'dug 'on kyang / 7paṇa chen rin ngo ches lha na bcar rgya mi'i dngo na rigs kye bka' bzhin bod kyi rgyal dar phab nas/ rgya chi/snye'i rgyal dar 'dzugs dgos pa gsung par bshad/ze ()50 tsā lta 'i me)sha ṣ+ka/ snyo ji /nya na/ /ṣ+ṭha/ nga —3ci 'i ༈ nga 1 441 smyo479

7paṇa chen yer te ni zhib 'jug〉〉〉 2//snadzirdzosgyu rjesaX /6sgyu ri/rna /tre〈〈rto36spyordo nge rdo ( ri~Xdī dzo ༷6tsho tre reX〉 sti(khri ngesaXdro 〉sdus lte ༷༷༵༵ 'i ge ri sdoX:snyo /tshorngo6rnye /ri 3༷dz+raXnānatreḥ ri ༄ ri/snye rmothu/rdo/ribyu di rusaXjom7mi / gsal/zhesanirdo sna miXri /ci )treX/sgo/rmeXrnespyo~X'adzo two sdus 〉kyi / /ga tshu / 4454 ༷ ci /shāriXsaX ri ṭī rdoXci ci ga ri ri ci ༷ / ri tshoX /ci sa ri 〉ge /stiphrengs/// chi ge'iXsti/ci sna 6)rdo///sgyuX /snro rdo ji riX lho/ kyi gle snye rdociri ci lhu lku tsho ti sdo ༷ ci byu/sdo rme spu ju sno ru ri tho sa ༈ sgo glu/rte ciXs ci ci ༷༷ / ñtsaX ca ṇi / ༷ snang shā ri ru /45 4 44 5 74 4 ༷ ri ri 4 4 ri 8sgyu bye riX wa) te sgormāXsi ci/rdo / rdu nye shā ci ces wa ci /rdo///sna ci /diri rto'aji/༷ ri do rdo ci rirderdo sna tsho ri cho pa// riXri ci ci sna ཿri /|// 'i / sku ka ༷rdo ri caXri tsho ri/ 3 /47/ru /dro wa /ri/r+sā43༷༷t+ta /ci ri ra wa——— ske / /sna ri ri(phyi lo 1956 lor/ 7gong sa mchog dang 7paṇa chen rin po che rgya gar du chibs sgyur/)zla 11 tshes 23 / 24 so sor la nga sa mchog sa byang chub chos tshogs kyi mdzad dang / tshogs 'du/ ba na dga' bsu'i gsol ston sogs kyi steng gnang rgyu'i bka' slob tshang ma bod las na u yon lhan khang sa/ bod sdod rgya nag gzhung las khungs nas sngon bzos byas pa'i gsung 'phrin nang /kru r+sha// dī// ༵ /du yo/ sdo ༵ snroX / dmangs/ sa bod rgya khongs yin bzhag da dung / rkya nga sa mchog bod sa ma thon bar phebs la du bcar ba'i dmag ga na pa dran ming yes/ khyed u yon krang ga na pa yin pas/bod tsam ma zad rgya nag sku tshab kyang red/ ra ba na/ rgya nag yar rgyas dang mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas ji yod gsung da sa la/ mi su ga thug ༷༷da byung yang rgya nag dang mes rgyal bod nang gsungs da sa pa'i mngags
