kyi tshe'i sto da kyai cha/bcol nan du zhus 'dug517gong sa mchog rgya gar du chibs sgyur zin rjes/ ka sbug bod kyi bde don tshogs pa'i 'go gtso sku ngo zha sgab pa sogs dang / 7rgyal ba'i chibs zhabs kun bde gling dza sag dang bcas pas/ 7gong sa mchog gis byang chub chos tshogs kyi mdzad sgo'i steng gnang rgyu'i gsung 'phrin la nang mol gnang mthar/bka' sbug bde don tshogs pas rgya mes bzos pa'i gsung bshad de gnang na/thal cha che drags pas chibs sgyur gnang ba las ma gnang ba yag gi red/ rgya mis bkod sgrig byas pa'i gsung 'phrin rtsa ba nas gnang rgyu mi 'dug ces zhus te/lhan bcar bka' shag la bka' 'dri dgongs skor tsam ma zhus par gsung 'phrin gsar bzos gnang 'dug32mthar 7gong sa mchog gis byang chub chos tshogs kyi mdzad sgo gtsos/tshogs 'du dang / gsol tshigs sogs gnas yul gang du gsung bshad gnang kyang / ka sbug bod kyi bde don tshogs pa dang / kun bde gling gis gsar bzo gnang ba'i gsung 'phrin gyi dgongs don bzhin/ rgya gar dang bod gnyis kyi nang bstan 'brel ba dang / rgya gar dang bod mi dmangs kyi mdza' mthun mnyam 'brel skor gyi gsung bshad zhe cig gnang bas/3 3 rgya nag gzhung mi dga' ba yang shugs chen byung 'dug54'on kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog ni chings yig don tshan bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor nang / rgya nag gung khran tang dang mnyam 'brel gnang 51ngos kyi yu la dang ngos kyi mi rma nga /laspong sa ma chog gi rang rnam/5dngas rgyun lo rgyus /2sku tshe'i lo cargyus rags bsdus /kun bde gling la bcar 'dri/bod kyi dpe mdzod khang phyi 'o 1995lor/5 pyi lo 1957bla 5tshes 14gsar 'byur long /497gong salachog gis byang chub chos tshogs su bstsal ba'i gsu nga 'phrin ngo ma/phyi lo 1957zla 5tshes me'ugasar 'gyur me long /481

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhi' 'jugargyu'i sngon thon gyi dgongs pa'i yo lang 'phyur bzhin yod stabs/ gsung bshad tshang ma lha sa nas rgya mis bzos pa'i gsung 'phrin ji bzhin/ nga tsho mes po'i rgyal khab kyi khongs gtogs nang pa'i chos pa rnams zhugs thu ba pa zhes dang /nged cag krung go'i rgyal yongs kyi sa gnas yongs kyi zhes pa'i tha snyad dag bed spyod gnang 'dug557rgyal ba yab sras rgya gar du lhan rgyas chibs sgyur gnang ba de lhan phebs kyi mtha' ma tsam ma zad/ sku tshe hril po'i nang gi mjal 'phrad tha ma de yang red/ skabs der bka' sbug bod kyi bde don tshogs pa dang bla brang gi zhabs 'bring 'ga'i las 'dzol las/ yab sras rdo rje gdan dang / sa ra tha na /rgyal po'i khab/ bya rgod phung po'i ri/ na len ṭa/ lum+bi'i tshal/ ku shi na gar/san ci/ a jun ta sogs la lhan phebs skabs/ thugs zhe dgyes pa'i go skabs shig rtsa nas byin mi 'dugade'i skor bod gzhung dpe mdzod khang nas bton pa'i gra ma zla ba tshe ring gi mi che'i lo rgyus nang / bkras lhun bla brang gi zhabs 'bring lha rtse zla ba tshe ring gis/ rgyal rtse gra ma zla ba tshe ring la 'grel brjod byas pa zhig bkod pa'i nang / 7rgyal ba yab sras rdo rje gdan du zhabs sor rim 'khod skabs/thog mar 7gong sa mchog gis gsung chos bstsal smin bkrin che rgyu dang /de dag grub mtshams 7paṇa chen rin po ches gsung chos bstsal rgyu'i mdzad rim 'char 'god gnang mi rgya gar nang nga 'i chos tshogs kyi mdzad gtso rnam pas/7rgyal ba yab sras dgung na'i bab dang / lhag par dbu gnas mtshan mthong gzhir bzhag bzhugs khri 11na rgyag bo| sgrig zhu skabs/55gyi lo 1957zla 5tshes 14 las ra 'gyur me lo nga ngag rgyuna'o rgyus /nasku 7 ngo rgyus rags bsdu sa/kun bde gling mu bcar 'dre/bod kye dpe ma dzod lang /phyi lo 1995lo ra/482

skya tshe'i sto da kyai cha/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po cher bzhugs 'bol gcig dma' ba dang / rma bya'i dbu gdugs thob thang med tshul gsungs 'dug par/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches de dag dngos yod gnas tshul du zhal bzhes dang / 7gong sa mchog bod kha ba gangs can pa'i chos srid gnyis kyi bdag po dbu gnas mtho shos red ces bka' phebs yod kyang / bkras lhun bla brang gi zhabs 'bring dza sag ci 'jigs med dang /dza sag lha smon ye shes tshul khrims gnyis kyis rgya dmar gyi ngan skul ltag shed kho nas lugs bstun nyan shes ma byas par/ thob thang 'dra mnyam dgos 'dra'i lab gleng dbang gis/ mtha' don mdzad 'char bzhin gsung chos gnang thub pa byung med pa gsungs/56 gsung tshul de dang mi 'dra ba zhig ni/ da lta bde skyid gling du bzhugs pa'i 7gong sa mchog gi chibs 'khor kha lo ba zur pa kun dga' lags kyis gsungs na/ phyi lo 1957 lor/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rdo rje gdan du phebs/7gong sa mchog gis gsung chos gnang grub pa'i sang nyin/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches gsung chos gnang gtan 'khel yod/ bla brang zhabs 'bring tshos gzhung zhabs dang ka sbug bde don tshogs pa'i 'brel yod tshor/7gong sa mchog gsung chos grub pa dang bzhugs khri de sang nyin kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po ches gsung chos gnang sa g.yar rgyu'i re ba zhus yod/bod gzhung zhabs gras 'ga' dang ka sbug bod kyi bde don tshogs pas/7gong sa mchog gsung chos grub pa dang bzhugs khri bsdu gsog brgyab pas sang nyin 7paṇa chen rin po che gsung chos gnang sa'i bzhugs khri med par 56mi tse'i 'o rgyus srong por ba da pa sgyu ma'i ro' rtsed/gra ma zla ba tshe ring /ngag rgyun lo rgyus/na pa/bod kyi dpe mdzod lang /phyi lo na010lo ra/483

7paṇa chen ber te ni gis 'jugagyur/nyin de'i mtshan mor bod mi bsam yod 'gas/shing sgam bsgrigs nas/sang nyin de 7paṇa chen rin po ches gsung chos gnang sa'i bzhugs khri thebs chag cig bsgron thub kyang / 7paṇa chen rin po che sku sha 'jol bas bzhugs khri chag grabs byas pa'i sku ngal yang byung bar gsungs/57gong du drangs pa'i gra ma zla ba tshe ring dang / kun dga' lags gnyis kyi gsung tshul dbar he dpag phran tsam 'dug mod/ nga tshos rtogs thub pa'i gnas tshul zhig de ni/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis rdo rje gdan du gnas mjal dang gsung chos gnang skabs/ gzhung bla'i zhabs 'bring 'ga' dang /ka sbug bde don tshogs pa/ rgya mi bcas kyi byed spyod las/ dgra dga' gnyen sdug gi las 'dzol tshabs chen zhig byung ba de red/de 'dra ba'i blo pham rang bzhin gnas tshul ji snyed cig byung 'dug pa ni/ 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam gnyis rgya gar dang bod kyi sa mtshams sgang tog rgyal sar zhabs sor 'khod skabs/ 7gong sa mchog la 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i pho brang gi mchod khang bkra shis dge 'phel du bzhugs sgrig gnang ba dang /7paṇa chen rin po cher gsol mgron khang zhig tu bzhugs sgrig gnang bar/chubakras bla'i zhabs 'bring mang po zhig mi 'dod pa chen po byung 'dugaphyi lo 1957 zla 1 nang lcag ra ta dmag sgar du zhabs sor 'khod skabs/ rgya gar gzhung gi phebs sgrig pas yab sras gnyis kyi sne len bzhugs sgrig sogs la khyad par chen po btang ba dang / mtshams re 7paṇa chen rin po che'i ba sa ga mgron khang dkyus ma'i nang du bkod sgrig gnang bar/57dga' spag blo bzang rdo rjes kun dga' la gas su bcar 'dri zhus pa'i skor/kho por gsung ska bas kyi tshigs tho/phyi lo naX8lor/484

kyi che'i sto da kyai cha/bla brang gi zhabs 'bring tsho'i thugs la mi 'dod pa'i sems pa shugs chen byung 'dug la/ rdo rje gdan dang / 'bras ljongs/ lcag ra ta sogs kyi gnas tshul de dag tshang ma ka sbug bod kyi bde don tshogs pas brgyud skul las byung ba'i dogs gzhi byung 'dugashod srol zhig la/ 7rgyal ba yab sras glang chen sa la rab brtan la chibs nas/ rgya gar gyi srid blon ne ha ru mjal 'phrad du chibs sgyur skabs/ba ku la rin po ches chibs khrid gnang bzhin pa'i 7paṇa chen rin po che chibs pa'i glang chen de/ ka sbug bde don tshogs pa'i jus bkod bzhin srid blon ne ru'i mdun nas kha bsgyur gyis khrid pa bshad/mtha' ma'i gzigs skor lcag ra tar rdzogs pa byas shing / phyi lo 1957zla 1 tshes 22 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog ka sbug bod kyi bde don tshogs pas ka sbug tu chibs sgyur dang bka' chos bstsal gnang skyong yong ba'i gdan zhu phul zhing / 7paṇa chen rin po cher gdan zhu gnang mkhan byung med/ gnas tshul der 7gong sa mchog kyang thugs sems bde po med pa 'gyur bas/7paṇa chen rin po che ka sbug bde don tshogs pas gdan zhu byas med kyang /khong dang lhan du phebs na 'grig pa dang / ka sbug brgyud bod la lhan rgyas byon chog pa gsungs/587rgyal ba yab sras lhan rgyas rgya gar du chibs sgyur skabs/ thugs snang gshin pa'i zhabs zhu sgrub ma thub pa'i lan khag gtso bo ka sbug bde don 52bod kyi reg gnas lo rgyus dpya da gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/〈7pa ṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉thog ngos 158nang /bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrunasang /phyi lo 1989bla phyinang /52bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs / 〈7paṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/〉sog ngos zhi nang /bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe smu na khang /phyi lo 1989ba phyinang /485

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhib 'ardul tshogs par yod snang ste/ bka' blon nga phod kyis ci 'jigs med brgyud 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog la/ ka sbug bod kyi bden don tshogs pa'i bya spyod dag7paṇa chen rin po cher ched du dmigs pa zhig min pa'i dgongs sel zhus69'dug pa las shes thub kyi 'dug7gong sa mchog gis/ phyi lo 1956 lor/ rgya gar byang chub chen po'i chos tshogs nas sangs rgyas myang 'das kyi rjes dran la gdan 'dren zhus gnang ba ltar/ 7paṇa chen rin po che dang ngos bkra shis lhun por 'khyug tsam mjal/ bkra shis lhun po nas rgya gar du yong nas gang tsam bshibs pa yin/de dus skabs re 7paṇa chen rin po che'i zhabs 'bring tsho'i zhu phyogs sam/de 'dra'i thog nas phran bu dgongs pa bzhes stangs dngos yod gnas tshul cha tshang ma mkhyen pa'am ma dgongs pa'i rnam pa phran bu thon gyi 'dug de ni thugs khag med pa zhig red/ dngos yod gnas tshul spyir btang mthong tshul la 7paṇa chen rin po che'i mi'i gshis ka gyong po zhig dang / blo stobs yod pa zhig yin pa gsal po red/ ces gsungs/7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi bcos min thugs gshis dang / kha ri kha thug dngos thog bden 'tshol/ hur brtson gyi mdzad tshul 'ga' zhig la/mi dmangs phal ba tshos go ba len mi thub pa ni dngos gnas kyi dka' ngal zhig red/7gong sa mchog gis/ sangs rgyas myang 'das kyi dus dran zin te rgya gar nas phyir bod la phebs skabs/ gzhis rtser rnyog gra phran bu byung gsungs/bdag gis gzhis rtser rnyog gra byung ba'i gnas tshul zhib 'jug byed skabs/486

sku tshe'i sto da kyi cha/phral rkyen 7gong sa mchog gi gzhis ka rtse chibs sgyur skabs/ bzhugs sgar spyi rdzong du gnang dang bkras lhun du gnang min skor las byung 'dug kyang / rtsa ba'i rgyu ni 7gong sa mchog lha sa nas gzhis rtser chibs sgyur skabs/ bla brang gis phebs bsu'i dbu gur gzhis rtse'i nye 'gram chu shar du go sgrig zhus 'dug kyang /bkra lhun bla brang dza sag bkra mthong ce 'jigs med kyis/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog 7gong sa mchog phebs bsur chu shar du ngo phebs gnang mi dgos pa kun gzigs gzim chung gi byang sgo ka brgyad ma'i nang gi sgo 'gram du phebs bsu zhus na 'grig lugs zhus pa dang /66phebs ston dkar spro'i mdzad chen la bcar med pa/ gzim chung lhan rgyas dang gsol tshigs skabs zhabs stegs mtho dman 'dra mnyam thog phan tshun zhal sprod du bzhugs pa der/ gzhung zhabs phal mo che'i gzigs ngor bla brang zhabs gras tshos/7rgyal ba 7paṇa chen 'dra mnyam gyi lta phyogs bzung ba'i tshor snang byung 'dug la/bod gzhung gi mtho rim dpon rigs re zung gis/ 7gong sa mchog lha ldan rgyal khab nas gzhis rtse bkras lhun dgon du chibs sgyur gnang dus/ bkra shis lhun po'i bla brang nas phebs bsu phebs sgrig lugs mthun zhus med pas/ da lan rtag rten ched sngon la gzhis ka rtse bsam grub rtse rdzong rang la zhabs sor 'khod rgyu legs pa bshad de gdan 'dren zhus 'dug61phyogs mtshungs 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis kyang / sngon la bkras lhun bla brang rang la zhabs sor 'khod gnang yong ba'i gdan zhur/ dza sag bkras 60bod kyi dpesadzod lang gi dpa ra bsgrun zhus pa 'i gra ma zla ba tshe ring si yo the sa/ 51dbe slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi mi tshe sacigashong ngos 15nanang /phyi lo na ༷4lor/487

7paṇa chen ser te ni zhib 'jugamathong pa rgyal rtser gtong gnang mdzad pa bcas mdzad dka' che tsam byung 'dugamathar gzhung zhabs 'gas gzhis rtse rdzong de bzhin 7rgyal ba lnga pa chen pos bod kyi srid dbang thog mar bzhes pa'i rdzong chen khyad par can yin pa zhus te/sngon la gzhis rtse spyi rdzong du gdan zhu gnang 'dugaphyi lo 1957 zla 1 tshes 3 nyin/ dpal 'khor chos sde nas/ gtsang ljongs lha sde mi sde yongs kyi dang dod dang ldan pa'i ser sbrengs dang / bro gzhas gos tshar du dngar bas sngon bsus te/ gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i rdzong du zhabs sor 'khod/ bkras lhun bla brang nas gdan zhu gnang ba ltar tshes 7 nyin/7gong sa chen po ston 'khor bkras lhun bla brang du chibs sgyur dang / tshes 9nyin bkras lhun 'dus tshogs su gsung chos gnang /sku ngo zhwa sgab pas bkras lhun bla brang gis/ 7gong sa sngon la gzhis ka rtse spyi rdzong du chibs sgyur bskyangs par khag 'dogs kyis/ bla khongs mi ser gyi ser sbrengs dang / bro gzhas sogs phyir 'then byas pa dang / rjes su 7gong sa chen po ston 'khor bkras lhun bla brang du gdan zhu gnang ba tsam las spros te/7kun gzigs mchog nas go bab lugs mthun ji bzhin ma mdzad pa der/thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ bod ljongs chos srid gnyis kyi bdag por brten sngar lam gus 'dud bkur gzos zhu gnang mdzad 'os smos med khar/so skye phal pa zhig yin yang / gzhis byes dang / gnas mgron babs nas phebs bsu skyel mdzad dgos pas/ tshul de las ldog ste snga rjes chibs sgyur skabs sngar lam phebs bsu skyel sogs lugs mthun gus 'dud tshul ldan zhig rang mdzad pa der bod mi ser skya yongs yid ngor mi 'jug cing / skyes chen dam pa'i rnam thar la 'phya smod byed yag gi gzhi chen po zhig byung 'dug gsungs/gsung tshul de ni gzhung phyogs langs phyogs yin pa snang ste/488

4 kyi che'i sto da kyai cha/dus skabs der dngos gzhi'i las rim gyi mgo mjug bar gsum nang mnyam gzhug gnang myong ba'i 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin khri byang rdo rje 'chang dang / bkra lhun bla brang gi zhabs 'bring lha smon bsod nams lhun grub rnam gnyis kyi gsung stangs dang zha sgab pa'i gsung stangs dbar khyad par phran bu 'dugalha smon bsod nam lhun grub kyis/ 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du chibs sgyur skabs/ bla brang gis phebs sgrig sne shan du/ nga rang la 7paṇa chen rin po che sku ngo mas dmigs 'dzugs gnang ste bka' mngags 'di ltar gnang byung /da res khyod rang ched du sngon gtong byed don/ da lam gyi byed sgo 'di bod gzhung dang bkras bla'i mthun sgril sogs chab srid thad gal che zhing /khyod rang gzhung phyogs 'brel 'dris rgyus mnga'i bab bcas dmigs 'dzugs kyis btang ba yin na zhu sgo 'thus shor med cing / gzhung bla'i dbar mthun lam la gnod pa'i bya spyod rigs mi 'byung ba gal cher 'dzin dgos/ 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chibs byed chibs sbug tu yod pa'i ngos kyi bzhon rta bzhon dril gyi khongs nas/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i thugs la gang mnyes gang dgos gsungs rung de rang 'bul dgos pa gsungs/62zhes 'khod/7gong sa mchog rgya gar nas lha ldan chibs sgyur skabs/ phyi lo 1957zla 12 tshes 25 nyin/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches/ 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang por 'di lta'i chab shog phul ba'i nang / ༄7//7lha mi'i rnam 'dren 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i zhabs drung du/canabod kyi lo rgyus rig gnayodabyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/7paṇa chen rje dran chod spegashog ngos 1bzhinang /bod nyo ngas mi dmangs dpe skrun lang /phyi lo 1989lor 489

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhi 'dug nang ma stabs der zhu gsol/ mchog nyid rna thos zer ba'i la chu 'phrang gsum shin tu ngan rtsub de 'drar nye zho phra mo tsam ma bzhes par/ bod sa gro mo dung dkar dgon du 7zhabs sor legs 'khod grub gdong sku'i 'tshams zhu dang po dang chab sbrags/ 'di gar sku lhod bzhugs bskyangs rgyur chibs sgyur yong ba'i gdan zhu 7snyan seng zhu bar mi sna ched gnyer gdong zhu yig 'bul lam zhus pa'i bka' lan phebs gsal du/da lam gnas tshul du gzhis rtser 'byor skabs/ bla brang du gra sgrig gnang mus yin na bskyod 'khod dgos lugs phebs pa ltar yid bcangs zhu rgyur/ gzhis rtse rdzong 'di yang 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po sku phreng lnga pa chen pos zhabs kyis bcags pa'i pho brang khyad can la brten/ nges par bskyod 'khod dgos lugs gzhis rtse rdzong 'dus snga phyir nan zhu'i thogagazhis byes zhabs 'bring rnams nas kyang de don legs che'i snyan seng nan zhu byung ba bcas zhib cha rgyal rtse nas nang gsal phul chog pa/ zhes rang re'i don dam rgya lar g.yo lhad spru tsam med pa'i rang rtags gsal rjen phebs sgo bsam bzhin yid spro'i gnas gyur bka' drin mchog tu che lags shing / bdag kyang kha sngon mkha' lam brgyud 'di ga rang gdan du 'byor rjes/ cung zad sa chu brje mtshams kyis nyer len las gzugs khams mi bde tsam mchis kyang /'phrod bsten dang sbrags mchog nyid ston 'khor 'di ga bkras lhun gdan sar phyir phebs skabs bzhugs yul sogs/ gang ci'i phebs sgrig sa bab gnas tshul la gzhigs pa'i zab gzeng dgos pa'i bkod khyab nang ma sgang la gzab nan dang sbrel/ mdzad 'char sngon phul bzhin ang gsar zhu mus yin na/gzhis rtse khul du zhabs sor skabs bkras lhun du nges 'khod ma zad/rtsa ba'i bzhugs gnas de nyid du thugs gtan 'khel ba byung na/ chos thams cad 490

kyi tshe'i sto da kyai cha/rten 'brel la bltos pa'i bod ljongs bstan dang 'gro spyi'i legs tshogs rtags rten gyi sarga mi 'tshol zhing / gzur gnas ser skya mi dmangs kyi re 'dun dang mthun pa'i phyi nang gang sar mdzes lam che zhing / yab sras gnyis ku'i mtshan dang bod nang khul gyi dam tshig mthun sgril la thugs snon sogs dgos pa dge mtshan mang po dang ldan pa yong nges snyam pa bcas/ lhag bsam zol med kyi bsam 'char re 'dun lags na/ legs che'i bka' lan gsal rjen thugs rje che ba bcas rnam mkhyen zab mor chub pa mkhyen mkhyen// zhu 'degs rab dkar lha rdzas bcas/phyi lo 1957 zla 12 tshes 25 nyin dge bar phul/63 zhes 'khod/7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la phul ba'i bka' yig de las/ 7gong sa mchog gzhis rtser chibs sgyur skabs/ gang du bzhugs gdan 'jags min las/ sngon la gang du phebs min gyi klan ka zhig red mi 'dug la/7paṇa chen rin po ches 7gong sa mchog bzhugs gnas bkras lhun bla brang du gnang skyong yong ba'i skyabs 'jug de yang / rgyal rtse min par 7gong sa mchog gro mor zhabs sor 'khod bstun/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches ched brdzangs 'tshams zhu dang po'i skabs nas zhus pa phyag sam las ra sprod thub kyi 'dugalar nas gzhis rtse spyi rdzong de bzhin 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos bod kyi srid dbang thog mar bzhes pa'i rdzong chen khyad par can las sngon la spyi rdzong du phebs par gsungs na/ bkra shis lhun po ni 7rgyal dbang sku phreng dang po rje dge 'dun grub kyis phyag btab pa'i 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma'i ma dgon de yin snyo 7paṇa chen sku preng bcu pa'i chab shog 7 rī pad+ma'i mgrin rnga/gsum/ 'bum po da ga sī /shog ngos 5daXnang /bkras lhun ri ra ma/491

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhing 'jugapas na cis kyang sngon phebs dgos pas so/spyi rdzong dang lnga pa chen po'i lo rgyus bgrang pa ni srid don pas zhal g.yor sa zhig las/ bzhugs gnas bkras lhun dgon du me gnang rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni gong zhus ltar/ 7gong sa mchog gzhis rtser chibs sgyur skabs bla brang dzegis phebs bsu skyel lugs mthun ma byung bar gzhung zhabs 'ga' mi dga' byung bas bzhugs sgrig gzhis rtse spyi rdzong du gnang rgyu'i thag gcod byas 'dug pa de red/7gong sa mchog bkras lhun du bzhugs zhag ma gnang bar/ rgya mi'i bkod byus 'og tu yod pa'i bkras bla'i zhabs 'bring 'ga'i ngan byus 'ogabakras lhun grwa bsasan nam zhabs 'bring gi (zha sga ba pas bla khongs mi ser gsungs pa me bden/dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis/ dbe 'dun nga/ mang che bas phebs bsu se ra sbreng zhu bar bcar 'dug la /rkya khang tshan dang har gdong khang tshan gyi dge 'dun yongs rdzogs phebs bsur 'byor 'dug gsungs/64)ser sbrengs dang bro gzhas sogs zhu mi chog pa'i bkag bsdoms byas/'on kyang / zla 3 tshes 9 7gong sa mchog bkra lhun dgon du gnas gzigs dang / nyi 'od mthong yangs su phebs ston dkar spro rgyas gshom dang /rten 'byung mdzad sgo sngar lam gra rgyas phun sum tshogs pa bstar ba ma zad/65tshes 10 nyin bkras lhun tshogs chen rdo gcal du bkras lhun dge 'dun rnams dang yab gzhis sku 'khor la lam rim bsdus don bka' chos bstsal/ tshes 11dang 12 nyin bde chen pho brang gi mdun thang spang gshongs su gtsang khul rdzong 64dge slong blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyi mi tshe gcigazag 15 nang /phyi lo naX ma ra/55mdzad rnamasnying rje'i rol mtsho/pod/4shog naX nang /nor gling bod kyi ril gzhung gces skyong khang /phyi lo naX10lor/492

kyi tshe'i stod kyi cha/gzhis ser skya mi mang la thugs rje chen po'i bka' dbang bstsal/'on kyang / zla 3 tshes 1666 nyin bkras lhun bla brang gis/ 7gong sa mchog gsol tshigs rgyas pa'i steng gdan zhu gnang ba der phebs mi 'dugaganas tshul de'i skor la gra ma zla ba tshe ring dang / lha smon bsod nams lhun grub gnyis kyis zur tsam gsungs 'dug pa drangs na/gra ma zla ba tshe ring gis/ bzhugs zhag 13/zla natshes 16)gsol ston rgyas 'bul ched gdan zhu phul song /de'i nyin dang po'i snga dror gzhis rtse spyi rdzong nas bkras lhun ri zur bar phebs bsu dang / chibs zhabs 'jib 'khor mang po bstar bsgrigs pa'i bar seng nas/ bkras lhun zhabs khongs sku drag gzugs babs che chung tshad ldan gos log dang / lham 'ja' chen/ dbu zhwa lcags mda'/rgya gri phor shubs sogs tshos gzhi sngo nag gzhi mtshungs thog dbu skra'i rgyab la gser gyi ga'u btags pa zhig dza drag myur stabs ngang rgyugs phebs 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung du sku bcar zhus song /gzhis rtse spyi rdzong gi gzhung sgo'i mdun/ sku srung me rdor dpal ldan chos grags lags dang / gus pa zla ba tshe ring / dmag dkyus bzhi 'jib 'khor thog med cig nang phebs sgug zhus te bsdad yod pa nas gsal por mthong /de mur gong gsal sku drag phebs ma thag sgo srung gzhung dmag ga dang gzhis rtse dmag mi bzhi pos khong la gus 'dud zhus 'brel rdzong nang shar phebs gnang song /phyogawagong samachog bla brang nas gsol tshigs la gdan zhu gnang ba'i tshes grangs gsal kha mi 'dug kyang /gra ma phyi zla ba tshe ring gis bzhugs zhag 1 par gso la tshigs su gdan zhu gnang zhes gsung 'dug par gzhigs na/tshes gzhis rtser zhabs sor 'chad pa dang /bzhugs zhag1 pa de tshes 15la 'a la ji 'dugayang bka' blon rag kha thar gsol tshigs la phebs te nyen gzhis kyi rjes su grongs gsung par gzhigs na/rag kha shar tshes 1 grongs 'dug pas/gsol tshigs gdan zhu'i tshes grangs ni tshes me yin dgos par snang /rgya mi'i gsar shog nang rag kha shar tshes 1 'i grongs pa bshad/493

7paṇa chen ser te gi zhing 'dulasku drag de nyid 7gong sa mchog gi sku mdun du bcar te/ ngu 'bod thog gal che'i gnas lugs snyan seng zhus te/ chu tshod phyed tsam rjes gzhi nas spyan gnyis mchi zhags 'khor 'khor ngang phyir phebs gnang byung / de mtshams gong sa mchog de nyin bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i thugs spror chibs sgyur bskyang rgyu min pa'i gsal bsgrags gnang ste/ bkras lhun thugs spro'i sku mgron gtso bor bka' blon rag ga shag mdo mkhar phun tshogs rab rgyas phebs pa gsungs/67lha smon bsod nams lhun grub kyis/ gzhis ka rtser 7rgyal ba yab sras mjal 'dzoms gnang rgyur/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis thugs khur che bzhes mdzad de/ mjal 'dzoms gnang rgyur gtan 'khel ba ltar/ 7paṇa chen rin po ches bde chen skal bzang pho brang du/ gzhung bla'i sku drag ser skya yongs la gsol ston sgrog tse lnga bcu tsam dang / khong rang gi gzim chung du 7rgyal ba yab sras gnyis nang lugs lhan 'dzoms gnang sa gra sgrig cha tshang mdzad pa dang /de'i sang nyin 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor bde chen pho brang du chibs sgyur gnang nges gtan 'khel zin pa de ltar rung / rgyu rkyen ngo ma gang yin ngas mi shes kyang / sang zhogs der 7rgyal ba rin po ches gtong gnang ba red ces/ sa gnas srid gzhung (bodagazhung )gi rtse mgron bstan pa lags /phyi lo 1011lor grongs pa'i sku ngo bstan pa bzod pa lags yin par snang / gang la zhe na/ khong gi mi che'i lo rgyus nang /skabs der 7gong sa mchog gis 7paṇa chen rin po cher bstsal ba'i phyag yig cig bde chen pho brang du skyel ba phyin pa'i skor 'khod 'duga'on kyang / mdzad rnam snying rje'i rol mtsho'i nang rtse ma/gron thub bstan bsta na pa zhes bkod 'dug)zer ba phebs nas/ 7rgyal ba rin po che sku khams bde min gyis phebs thub ma song zhes snyan seng zhus song /zhi mi 7 'o rgyus sro nga ngo ra bshad pa sgyuma'i rol rtsed/shog ngos 14zha nang gra ma zla ba tshe ring/ngag tshon lo rgyus smo /bod kyi dpe mdzod khang /phyi lo daX10lo ra 494

skya che'i stso da kyai cha/de dus 7paṇa chen rin po che mchog gis/ 7rgyal ba rin po che mchog mjal 'phrad du phebs rgyur dgyes tshor chen po gnang ba dang / phebs ma thub par thugs pham chen po gnang ba nga rang gis dngos su mthong byung ba ma zad/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog gis/ nga tsho'i ngos/ nas lhag bsam rnam dag gis gra sgrig zhus kyang phebs ma thub na nga tshor thabs shes med/ gso la ston gra sgrig zin pas nga rang tsho mnyam du longs su spyod rgyu red gsungs byung zhes 'khod/68 7gong sa mchog 7paṇa chen rin po ches phul ba'i gsol tshigs la chibs sgyur ma thub de/ gzhung dang bla brang phyogs gnyis gas nor 'khrul ma yin par/ de ni rgya nag gzhung gis dbyin skyor lkog jus las byung ba snang ste/gra ma bzhi zla ba tshe ring gis// skabs der rgya dmar gyi g.yo jus dmigs/ rtsis ga re bzung gi yod min gsal shes dka' ba/ gang ltar rgya rigs sman pa khag gcig gis 7bo|nga sa mchog gi ljags smin gcesal chas shel dam/ nang zhus par chu tsha po blugs te brtag dpyad yang yang zhu ba dang / bod gzhung mang gnyis kyi dgongs babs mos mthun med bzhin du sku srung phyi ma'i gras su rgya dmag 30tham pa rang shed u tshugs kyis rtag bcar zhu yi 'dug pa bshad la/69 7gong sa mchog 7paṇa chen rin po che'i gsol ston la phebs khar bla brang zhabs 'bring zhig dza drag ngang 7gong sa mchog mjal khar bcar ba dang chibs sgyur mi gnang ba'i thag gcod gnang 'dug70gal srid bkras lhun bla brang gi 7gong sa mchog bde chen pho brang du gdan zhu gnang 'dod la bar chad med na/ bla brang gi zhabs 'bring ga ge phyinabod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i skyu chab bdams bsgrigs/7pa ṇa chen rjes dran ched deb/shog ngos smon nang /bod ljongs mi dam ngas cadape skrun khang /phyi lo 1989lo ra/69 mi za'icalo rgyus sro nga ngo ra bshad pa sgyu ma'i rol rtsed/shos151nang /deb srung 27/bod kyi dpe ma dzod lang /phyi lo na010lo ra/70 mi tshe'i lo rgyus srong por bathad pa sgyu ma'i rol rtsed/shog161nang /deb phreng na /bod kye dpe mdzod khang phyi lo naX1༷lor/495

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing 'jugamo zhig 7gong sa mchog gi sku mdun du dza drag myur thabs kyi bcar ba dang /de rjes 7gong sa mchog bde chen po brang du gsol tshigs thugs spro la bcar rgyu min pa'i thag gcod gnang don mi 'dug snyam/ bdag gis zhus pa'i dogs pa de la'ang rgyu mtshan med pa min ste/ bla brang gi thugs spro'i sku mgron gtso bo bod gzhung gi dmag spyi dang bka' blon gcig lcogs rag ga shag mdo mkhar phun tshogs rab rgyas/ bla brang gi gsol tshigs thugs spror phebs rjes nyin gnyis kyi rjes su bsnyun gzhi med par glog bur du sku 'das pa de yang / rgya mis gsol dug pa'i dogs pa byed chog pa zhig red snyam/skabs de'i gnas tshul gyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum la zhugs myong ba'i yongs 'dzin 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin khri byang rdo rje 'chang gis/ 7rgyal mchog yab sras rnam gnyis nang don dgongs pa snod gcig tu dkar zhing /thugs mnyes gshin po kho na las cung zad tsam 'da' ba ma mchis kyang / spyir dga' ldan pho brang gzhung dang / bkras lhun bla brang gnyis dbar mthun lam dam gtsang sel med kyi 'brel zab cig yong du re nas/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che mdo smad nas lha sar thog mar byon skabs dang / 'di res (phyi lo19577gong sa mchog gzhis rtser chibs sgyur /gyi skabs sogs/ snga phyi du mar gzhung khongs gnad yod kyi zhabs 'bring 'brel zab khag la rma med pa'i bsam 'char zhu khul yang /chos zab bdud zab kyi dpe ltar gcig tu na rgya nag phyogs kyis bod nang khul ya bral gtong rtsis kyi ngan g.yo'i thabs byus dang / gnyis su na bla brang dang gzhung gnyis ma'i zhabs 'bring yid srubs snying zhugs can bstan sel bgyi ba'i mthu lhag par brtas pa la la'i byed las la brten lugs legs shig byung ma song gsungs//71 71ci bas rje khri byang rinapo tsho rang rnam 'khrul snang sgyu ma 'i zlos gar/496

skya che'i stod kyai cha/le tshan bcu gcig dgongs rdzogs mchod 'dul/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 27 nyi na/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po mchog glo bur du sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas ngan/ 7gong sa mchog gis gsan ma thag thugs khral tshad med kyis zhal mdangs 'gyur zhing /yud tsam thugs dam spyan dmigs la bzhugs shing / gang mgyogs bod du sku gdung rin po che'i spyan sngar dbus/ gdan sa bkra shis lhun po dang / se 'bras dga' gsum/ sku 'bum/ bla brang bkris 'khyil bcas su/ 7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dang / dul mtshon dkyil 'khor bzhengs rgyu/mchod 'bul gsol 'debs zhu bar sku tshab tu/ byang rtse chos rjes dbu khrid pa'i dge 'dun pa bcu 'gro skyod mchog pa'i re 'dun zhus kyang / rgya nag gzhung gis khas len mthun 'gyur ma byas stabs re 'bras don du son med kyang / zla de'i tshes 30 nyin 7paṇa chen rin po che'i yab yum gnyis la thugs gso'i bka' tar bstsal 'dugabod gzhung gis kyang / nyin gsum mya ngan zhu rgyu'i gsal bsgrags gnang zhing / bod gzhung chos rig lhan khang nas ris med dgon sde khag la/dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul rgya che zhu dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang thog theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang gi rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin sna lnga stong tshar dang / 7gong sa chen po mchog tshogs mgon du chibs sgyur gyis bzhugs sgar khul gyi gzhung sger tshogs gsum gyis bla mchod bde stong dbyer med ma'i 497

7paṇa chen yer te ni jib 'jugasgo nas mchod 'bul dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brjod/ smon lam rnam brgyad sogs 'don gnang mdzad/ skabs de'i chos don bka' blon zhe bo blo bzang dar rgyas kyis/ 7gong sa mchog la maṇa ṭal sku gsung thugs rten dang /slar yang mgyogs bsngo zhu rten bdag cag gi ston pa'i sku brnyan bcas 'bul gnang mdzad cing / chos don drung che skal bzang ye shes lags nas tshogs dbus su/ 7paṇa chen rin po che glo bur dgongs pa chos dbyings su them tshul bstan pa dang / bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs dgongs zab mo ci mchis yongs su rdzogs pa/ mchog gi sprul sku'i yang srid mgyogs myur byon pa'i thugs smon 7skyabs 'jug yong ba'i snyan seng 'bod skul zhus/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 31 gzhis kyi gdan sa bkra shis lhun po'i chos sde nas/ bod ljongs rlung 'phrin brgyud 7gong sa rgyal ba'i dbang po thams cad mkhyen pa mchog la/ 7paṇa chen rin po che mya ngan las 'das pa dang /mchog gi spral sku'i yang srid myur du byon pa'i skyabs zhu gsol 'debs zhus/ pa'i nang / ༄༄7/ /lhar bcas srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan 7gong sa skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i zhabs pad gser khri mngon mtho'i drung du/gus pas phyag dang bcas te zhu gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyi bka' drin gsum ldan mtshan brjod par dka' ba don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/skyabs mgon kun gzigs 7paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa rje btsun blo bzang 'phrin las lhun 'grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog ga dul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir/ bod rab byung 17 sa pho 'brug lo'i zla 12 tshes 21 nyin gyi dgong dro pe cing chu tshod 8/30 thog gzhis rtse bde chen skal bzang pho brang gi gzim chung bshad sgrub 'phel rgyas gling du/498

kyi che'i stod kyai cha/re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan song bas/ mgon po gang gi zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo/ yongs su rdzogs shing / mchog gi spral sku'i zla zhal gsar pa bstan 'gro'i mgon du myur ba nyid du byon pa'i bsngo rnon skyabs 'jug brtse chen rdo rje'i gur khang nas nam yang mi 'dor ba mkhyen/mkhyen/ zhes gsol 'debs rten rab dkar lha rdzas nang mdzod dri bral dang /rin chen gnyis pa rta rmig ma lnga dang bzang gos tshon mdog yug chen bdun gus phyag dang bcas bkra shis lhun po nas/phyi lo 1989 zla 1 tshes 29 bzang por/phul zhes 'khod/727gong sa rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa mchog gis ldi lir bca' bzhugs rgya nag gzhung tshab brgyud gzhis kyi gdan sa bkra shis lhun por bka' lan bstsal don/༄7/ /chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun po'i mkhan bla 'dus mang lhan drung du/ched 'bul/7paṇa chen rin po che nas bar lam rang dbang bral zhing / gzhan dbang btsan po'i dus bab sku ngal ci che'i gnas stangs 'og rgyal ba'i bsten pa rin po che dang / bod mi rigs kyi 'phral yun khe phan ched gang thub ci nus kyis thabs shes 'bad brtson sku ngal lhur bzhes gnang dang gnang bzhin pa de ltar yang / nye dus rang gi gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod mus thog sa 'brug bod zla 12 tshes 21 dgong dro bde chen pho brang du glo bur dgongs pa zhi dbyings su mnal ba'i gnas tshul thos pa shin tu blo pham gyi rang bzhin du gyur/'on kyang / skyes bu dam pa'i mdzad pa bstan 'gro'i bde don 'ba' zanathod kyi lo rgyus ris gnas dpya da gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/shog 98nang /lapar chen rin po che dran gso zhu ba'i ched bsgrigs/bod ljongs srid spos kyis rtsom sgrig byas /bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe sgrun khang /phyi lo 1989lor/499

7paṇa chen nar te ni zhing 'jugazhig tu song gshis/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i bzhed dgongs mtha' dag gegs med lhun gyis 'grub ste/ mchog spral yang srid 'khrul bral nges rnyed myur du byon pa'i slad/ 'di ga theg chen sdus gling gtsug lag khang du / bod zla 12tshes 23 nyin ngo bskyod mchod 'bul smon lam smin sgrub thog rgya bal khul sogs ris med mgon khag tshang mar mchod sprin dang 'brel/ kun gzigs rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs ched 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sa ya gcig tsam 'bad sgrub byed 'char du mchis/de ga bkra lhun nas 'di gar skyabs 'jug lha sa'i rlung 'phrin thog rgyang bsrings bgyis pa yang go thos byung don/ dmigs bsal 'bod skul bgyis min la ma ltos par/ kun gzigs rin po che'i thugs dgongs rdzogs shing yang srid 'khrul bral nges rnyed yong thabs la/ gzhan dbang 'gal rkyen ma byung phyin 'di nas lhag bsam sems khur bskyed bzhin du yod pas blo g.yeng ma dgos/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid 'khrul bral nges rnyed myur byon smon tshig tu/ gsol ba drang srong bden pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes pa brtsams bris 'di nang zur bsrings ltar/ ngo bshus spel 'grems gsol 'debs 'bad 'bungs byed lugs/ gtso bo de ga bkras lhun gdan sar dge 'dun ji yod thugs mthun khrims gtsang ngos/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng gong rim nas ji ltar thugs bskyed lam ston gnang don bzhin/ tshad gzhung gtso gyur mdo rgyud rgya mtshor thos bsam slob gnyer shugs bskyed thog thos don rgyud la sbyar ba'i nyams len tshul bzhin dgos pa spyi sgos tshang mar shin tu don gal che/rgan rabs tsho'i blo gsal/ kun gzigs rin po che sku phreng gong rim nas/ dus 'khor la thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams bzhes thugs gtsigs gnang mus ltar/ da lam kun gzigs rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs ched/ de ga bkra snroshā rang du rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i dus 'khor sgrub mchod

7paṇa chen zher te ni shib 'arduladamangs gtso bdag gnyer u yon lhan khang gis/ 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i yang srid 'khrul bral btsal 'tshol dang / ngos 'dzin zhu rgyu sogs kyi las don bsgrub nas/rgyal srid spyi khyab khang la chog mchan 'god rgyur 'bul dgos pa'i bka' rgya bsgrags/gnas tshul der lan 'debs kyi tshul du/ 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog nas phyi lo 1989 zla 2 tshes 1 nyin/ da lta 7paṇa chen rin po che'i yang srid btsal 'tshol dang /ngos 'dzin zhu rgyu'i las 'gan de nga'i phrag thog tu babs yod ces gsung /gong du brjod pa ltar/ phyi lo 1989 zla 2 tshes 7 nyin rgya nag nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi tshogs gtso kra'o phu'u kru'u yi ming thog nas/ phyi lo 1989 zla 2tshes 15 'tshog rgyu'i 7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs mya ngan gyi mdzad sgor/7gong sa mchog chibs sgyur phebs gnang yong pa'i gdan zhu'i mgron shog cig sku'i gcen po rgyal lo don 'grub brgyud tshes 10 nyin 7gong sa mchog gi phyag tu son mod/srid don gnas tshul gyi rkyen pas 7gong sa mchog 7paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul la bcar thub mi 'dugagazhi lus bod mi rnams dang dgon sde khag gis ma bskul dang blangs ngang /kun gzigs rin po che'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dang smon lam gsol 'debs rgya che bsgrubs zhing / rgya nag mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rim pa khag gi srid gzhung khag nas kyang mya ngan tshogs 'du dang / grags can gnas dgon khag gi brten mchog spyan sngar dgongs tshogs mchod 'bul yang gnang / lha sar bod rang skyong ljongs kyi mya ngan tshogs 'du bskongs 'tshog byas pa ma zad/ pe cing kong ci'i dgon dang / dga' ldan byin chags gling / ri bo rtse lnga/ glang chen 'gying ri/ ri bo po ta la /ci'u hwa ri bo/ bkra shis lhun po/ se ra/ 'bras spung / dga' ldan/ sku 'bum/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil sogs bod khul gyi ris med dgon sde khag tu dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dang gsol tshogs rgya cher gnang 'dug/ //502

skya che'i stod kyai cha/le tshan bcu gnyis/ gdung brten gsar bzhengs/gangs rgyan tshong rgi dbu khrid dge legs kyis/ da thengs khong gzhis ka rtser phebs dus/ gnas tshul zhig mkhyen gyi yad pa 'dra po 'dug khong gis khong rang gi gser gdung bzhengs mkhan mi gnyis snga sa nas gra sgrig zhus 'dug gsungs/747paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa mya ngan las 'das rjes/ zhabs zhu'i las don gal che shos ni gdung rten bzhengs rgyu de yin zhing / de ni phyi lo 1990zla 9 tshes 20 nyin bzhengs 'go tshugs shing / bkras lhun byams khang dang 7paṇa chen sku phreng bzhi pa'i sku gdung mchod khang gnyis kyi dbus su/ mchod khang shar bkra shis rnam rgyal la dpe blangs te/ gna' deng zung 'brel gyi rnam pa'i thog bzhengs yod/ de ltar bzhengs dgos don ni mchod khang shar ni 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa sku ngo mas ljags bkod gnang ba zhig yin pa so/7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i gdung rten gyi mtshan la srid gsum rnam rgyal zhu zhing / phyi lo 1993 zla 8 tshes 30 nyin 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i sku gdung rin po che gdung rten srid gsum rnam rgyal nang bzhugs su gsol nas rab gnas kyi cho ga mdzad/ gdung rten gyi sku tshad la smi 11/52 yod pa dang /gdung rten de ni ser spyi rgya 614 dang / dngul dkar spyi rgya 275/ ar las 'gro gron shog dngul sgor khri 6400 btang yod/ mchod khang gi spyi'i rgya khyon la spyi khre gru bzhi pa 1933 yod pa dang / mchod khang gi mtho tshad la kung khre 35/25yo se nga dngos gzhir mtho tshad kung khre 11/55 yod cing / mchod 74phyi lo 1989zla tshes 11zhin/gza' spen pa/1601 la mi gsar khang /503

7paṇa chen nar te gi zhib 'jugakhang gi ldebs bris thog brtsegs steng mar gdung dkar spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong thog tshad ma dang / thog brtsegs bar mar bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' bzhi'i mi sna gtso bo'i snang brnyan dang / 7paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa dang bcu pa'i snang brnyan/ shod thog la dkyil 'khor dang grub mtha' ris med kyis mtshon pa'i ldebs bris ngo mtshar can gyi phyogs bzhir khyab bo//504
༵nguladabarngo (6sdo (tres ṅgewa ji shātā rngo wa( /chos ba 'a cirigs snye phul /

mdug byang /tshing rkang gnyis tsam lo ngo gsum gyis grub/ klog bzhin gdong la dga' ba'i mchi ma khengs/ yig 'bru re rer khrag gis sbags pa las mi lo bcu'i skyo ngal brjod las 'das/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag gis mi lo 5bsam gzhigs kyi kha phyogs dang do snang gi rtsol nus yod tshad/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa chen po'i sku tshe hril por zhib tshags pos rgyus yon byed pa'i bya bar gzhol ba yin/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po'i sku tshe la rgyus lon byed pa'i spro snang dang bya gzhag lci mos/ lo de dag nang sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung mang po zhig bcom song la/ kha dkar khog nag gi grogs po 'ga' yang dgra ru gyur song / —'on kyang / khu sim pa'i kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba yod tshad/ kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po bzhud pa'i zhabs rjes 'tshol sdud dang / zhabs rjes kyi ngos dang zur rnam chags rim gang sar mjal kha zhu skabs/ khong gi sku tshe hril po'i dgongs pa bzhes phyogs la rlabs che ba'i 'gyur ba chen po gsum byung ba'i tshor snang byung ba ni/dang po/ phyi lo 1949 nas 1959 bar/ mgon po tshe brtan 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog la ngos 'dzin zhus pa nas/ 'gro 'dug spyod gsum gyi rang dbang yod tshad rgya mi dang / gzhung bla'i don rkyen las bla brang gi sku drag tshos brgyud skul lam/ yang na khong gi thugs gshis ji ltar lags kyang /506

mjug byang /khong nyid kyi gnas bab dang / bla brang gi mkhar dbang bdag thob slar gso'i ched/ gung khran tang la re ba chen po bcol zhing tang dang mnyam las gnang rgyu'i thugs blo 'gog med cig yod pa de yin/gnyis pa/ phyi lo 1958 nas 1978 bar/ rang nyid kyi bsam blo rang gis nyar thub cing / bstan srid mi rigs kyi bya bar mkhyen rlabs rgyas pa dang /rgya nag gung khran tang gi srid dbang bod la yong ba 'gog phyir/ bod gzhung dang gdung shugs chig sgril gyis gung khran tang la kha gtad gcog dgos pa'i dgongs tshul gsungs shing / bod mi mang dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don chen slad/'jigs nyen gang la'ang 'dzems pa med par rgya nag gung khran tang la mdung rtse kha gtad kyi 'thab rtsod gnang ba de red/phyi lo 1979 nas 1989 bar/ rgya nag gung khran tang dang lo mang 'thab rtsod gnang ba'i nyams myong las/ dus kyi 'khor phyogs la dgongs pa zab bzhes kyis/ gung khran tang gis bod la dbang sgyur bya rgyu zhal bzhes gnang zhing /dbang sgyur bya rgyu zhal bzhes gnang ba'i khe dbang phran bu des/ bod kyi nang bstan dang / da gon pa/ chab dpal rig gsum/ mi mang gi rang dbang bcas kyi me ro rmang nas gsos shing / bod rigs sa khongs rang skyong don 'khyol yong ba'i ched/ sku che'i mtha' mjug de yang legs skyes su phul/mdor na/ 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog gi khri thog tu 'khod pa'i nyin de nas/ rgyal bstan mi rigs dang bcas pa dar spel slad/ skyid sdug gi la klung sgang gshongs mang po brgyud pa'i rlabs che ba'i shul bzhag des/ khong ni dus nam yang bod mi mang gi snying khong du nub pa med par gnas yod/507

7paṇa chen zher te ni zhing 'jugaphyi lo 2009zla 12 tshes 30 nyin/ 7gong sa mchog gis yongs khyab tu/kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa mchog sku gshegs rkyen la zhib 'jug dgos gal gyi bka' slob thengs gnyis bstud mar phebs pa des/ bdag la blo khog bskyed de lo mang ring kun gzigs 7paṇa chen bcu pa chen po dang 'brel ba'i bod rgya dbyin gsum gyi yig cha khag sum brgya lhag la zhib mo blo yis 'jug pa'i myong ba rnams/ yi ge'i gzugs su sdeb pa'i spro ba brtas stabs/ da cha 〈7paṇa chen er te ni zhib 'jug〉ces pa 'di grub song bas/ rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyis khra chung spyan gyi mdun du nyams su bzhes rogs/bsam blo'i gnas tshad dang /shes yon gyi chu tshad/ nyams myong gi rmang gzhi/ mthong rgya'i bar snang bcas las brtsams chos deb chung de'i nang bsam bzhin ma yin pa'i nor 'khrul ji snyed cig shor yod pa brjod med lags na/khyed rnams la bcos min gyis dgongs sel zhu rgyu dang / gzur gnas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis lhag pa'i bsam pas nor 'dzol gang yod shes byed khungs su bstan te lam ston mdzad rogs//zhes gtsang la stod ngam ring rdzong mdog gzhung byang khang gsar zur khang gi bu rgyud du skyes pa tshe dbang stobs lags sam/ ming gzha na byang bdag rig ldan nam/ gtsang drug stobs lags su 'bod pas sa rā bod kyi mtho rim slob gnyer khang du yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /phyi lo 2012 zla 12 tshes 10 nyin/508
